title: Senior Software Engineer (Disaster Recovery, DevOps, Site Reliability, Database, Cloud)
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
  
  
At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
**Your Team's Impact**
The candidate will be part of the ITDR Team in RE - Reliability Engineering supporting Core Infrastructure.
  
  
We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented ITDR Data Recoverability Engineer to strengthen the organization's ability to identify, recover, validate, and trust critical data required to support business service recovery and operational resilience.
  
  
This role combines data governance, recoverability analysis, dependency mapping, operational resilience, recovery assurance, and recovery validation disciplines. Working across business, application, infrastructure, cloud, architecture, and disaster recovery teams, you will identify critical data assets, understand how they support business services, assess recoverability risks, validate recovery outcomes, and improve confidence in recovery readiness across the enterprise.
  
  
Success in this role requires a strong understanding of how data, applications, infrastructure, and business processes interact during recovery events, with a focus on ensuring recovered data is complete, accurate, usable, and trusted when business operations resume.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Identify, classify, and maintain inventories of critical data assets supporting business services, including ownership, recovery requirements, recovery objectives, recovery priorities, and recovery classifications.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to identify critical business services, supporting data assets, recovery requirements, and business recovery priorities.
* Support Business Impact Analysis (BIA), operational resilience assessments, and recovery planning activities by identifying critical business services, supporting data assets, recovery dependencies, recovery requirements, and recoverability risks that may impact business service recovery.
* Maintain recovery-related metadata, recovery classifications, ownership records, and supporting information required to support recovery planning, validation, testing, and governance activities.
* Support implementation and continuous improvement of data governance, metadata management, dependency mapping, and recovery management capabilities that strengthen business service recoverability.
* Develop and maintain relationships and dependency models between business services, applications, databases, infrastructure components, cloud platforms, identity services, third-party services, and critical data assets.
* Analyze and document recovery dependencies required to support business service restoration, recovery prioritization, and restoration sequencing.
* Collaborate with business, application, infrastructure, architecture, cloud, and disaster recovery teams to assess recoverability capabilities and identify recovery gaps.
* Conduct recoverability assessments and evaluate risks related to data loss, corruption, dependency failures, unauthorized access, incomplete recovery, or other conditions that may impact business service recovery.
* Recommend improvements that strengthen recovery readiness, operational resilience, and recovery assurance capabilities.
* Define and maintain recovery validation requirements, reconciliation controls, data integrity verification processes, and business acceptance criteria used to confirm recovered data is complete, accurate, usable, and trusted.
* Support recovery testing, recovery exercises, tabletop exercises, and recovery events by validating critical data assets and confirming recovery outcomes.
* Coordinate business acceptance activities and support validation of critical business services following recovery testing and recovery events.
* Document testing outcomes, validation results, identified gaps, remediation activities, and lessons learned.
* Support development and maintenance of recovery validation procedures, evidence requirements, and recovery assurance practices.
* Design and maintain recoverability metrics, dashboards, reporting, and automated controls used to measure recovery readiness, recovery validation outcomes, dependency risks, and overall recoverability posture.
* Develop reporting used to communicate recoverability posture, testing outcomes, recovery risks, validation results, and recovery readiness to business and technology stakeholders.
* Track remediation activities and support continuous improvement initiatives that improve business service recoverability and operational resilience.
* Maintain recovery testing evidence, governance artifacts, audit documentation, and supporting records required for regulatory, compliance, governance, and audit reviews.
* Monitor industry practices, emerging technologies, and regulatory developments and recommend enhancements that strengthen recoverability, operational resilience, and recovery assurance capabilities.
* Support compliance with applicable operational resilience, recovery governance, regulatory, security, and audit requirements, including DORA, SOX, ISO 22301, ISO 27001, ISO 27031, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-34, and related standards.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years of experience in disaster recovery, operational resilience, recovery assurance, business continuity, cloud engineering, platform engineering, site reliability engineering (SRE), infrastructure engineering, data governance, data management, technology risk, or related disciplines involving recovery readiness, dependency analysis, critical data management, or resilience initiatives.
* Candidates should have experience with some combination of AWS, Azure, or GCC, Kubernetes, Infrastructure platforms, Disaster Recovery Testing, Recovery Validation, Dependency Analysis, Service Mapping, Recovery Readiness, Operational Resilience
* The ideal candidate has experience in operational resilience, disaster recovery, recovery assurance, cloud or infrastructure operations, data governance, or related disciplines and is comfortable analysing how critical data, applications, infrastructure, and business processes interact to support successful recovery of business services.
* Experience administering backup technologies is helpful but not required; the primary focus of this role is understanding, validating, and improving recoverability across the enterprise.

**Critical Skills**

* Understanding of backup, restore, replication, failover, disaster recovery, cyber recovery, and resilience testing concepts.
* Experience participating in recovery testing, resilience exercises, validation activities, failover testing, or operational readiness reviews.
* Familiarity with recovery planning, recovery sequencing, recovery validation, recovery assurance, and operational resilience principles.
* Ability to analyze recovery architectures and identify technology dependencies impacting recovery objectives.
* Experience analyzing and documenting relationships between business services, applications, databases, infrastructure components, cloud services, identity systems, third-party services, and critical data assets.
* Ability to identify recoverability risks associated with dependency failures, incomplete recovery, data loss, corruption, or unauthorized modification.
* Understanding of critical data asset management, data dependency analysis, and recovery prioritization concepts.
* Experience with data validation, reconciliation processes, completeness checks, integrity verification, and business acceptance validation.
* Understanding of data lifecycle management, metadata management, recovery classifications, and critical data asset concepts.
* Working knowledge of applications, databases, cloud platforms, infrastructure technologies, identity services, storage systems, and data platforms that support critical business services.
* Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP and the services commonly used to support enterprise workloads.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess business service impacts, recoverability challenges, and operational resilience risks.
* Ability to prioritize work and support multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
* Familiarity with DORA, SOX, ISO 22301, ISO 27001, ISO 27031, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-34, and related resilience, recovery, and governance frameworks.

**Additional Skills**

* Understanding of governance, metadata, dependency mapping, CMDB, recovery assurance, or resilience platforms such as Microsoft Purview, ServiceNow, Collibra, Rubrik, LeanIX, Ardoq, or similar technologies.
* Experience supporting critical business service recovery, dependency mapping, recoverability assessments, recovery validation, or operational resilience initiatives within financial services, fintech, banking, insurance, or other highly regulated environments.
* Familiarity with IT service management (ITSM), Configuration Management Databases (CMDB), enterprise architecture repositories, or service mapping capabilities used to manage application, infrastructure, and business service relationships.
* Experience developing metrics, dashboards, reporting, or governance artifacts used to communicate recoverability posture, testing outcomes, and recovery readiness to technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience working within financial services, fintech, banking, capital markets, insurance, or other highly regulated environments.
* Relevant certifications or coursework in data governance, disaster recovery, operational resilience, business continuity, risk management, cloud platforms, or related disciplines.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to work effectively across business, application, infrastructure, recovery, architecture, risk, and governance teams.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, Engineering, Business Technology, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, or a related field.

**What's In It For You**
At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:
  
  

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

**Learn More About Our Benefits Here.**
Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.
  
  
**Company Overview**
FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.
  
  
At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

You will take features from working backwards from the customer through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and documentation — and you stay accountable for how they behave in production long after they ship.Own features and components of our payment systems end-to-end. The business problem and the technology direction will be understood; how to actually build it will not be, and that part is yours.Design the solution and make the tradeoffs. You will code independently, and you will have senior and principal engineers to pull in when a tradeoff is genuinely hard or when a design needs to line up with where the architecture is heading.Work directly with product managers and business stakeholders — finance, tax, and accounts payable operations — to understand what they need and why, so that you build the right thing. You will hear the requirement first-hand rather than through a written hand-off, and you will be expected to push back when the ask and the outcome do not line up.Ship incrementally. Large payment changes land safely through staged rollout and measurement, not through a single release.Reduce operational load. Our best work turns a recurring manual intervention into a code fix or a self-healing mechanism, not another runbook step.Leave the system better explained than you found it. What you build should be maintainable and extensible by an engineer who has never seen it, which means clear documentation and design choices that hold up without you in the room.Raise the bar around you: code review as a teaching mechanism, mentoring engineers earlier in their careers, and getting new teammates productive on how our software is built, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture.Building with agentic AIWe are not experimenting with AI on the side — it is how we work. You will use AI agents across the development lifecycle: exploring unfamiliar systems, drafting and reviewing designs, generating and testing code, triaging production issues, and automating the operational work that used to consume a week of on-call. We expect engineers to be strong directors of these agents and rigorous verifiers of their output. The judgment stays with you: you are accountable for what ships, whether you typed it or an agent did. Agentic capabilities are increasingly part of the systems themselves — automating decisions and investigations that previously required a human in the loop — and you will have room to build them.Why this teamPayments is one of the few places in software where the business logic is genuinely hard, the scale is enormous, and a mistake has an immediate real-world consequence — a vendor who does not get paid when they expected. If you want real ownership, global scope, and the freedom to build with the newest tools available rather than waiting for permission to try them, this is a good place to build a career.Basic Qualifications 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field Experience programming with at least one software programming languagePreferred Qualifications 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems Experience with cloud computing or web services or related areas Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settingsOur inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Wellbeing Program Designer (Growth Practice Architect)
description:
**How to apply:**
we don't review easy-apply profiles. Apply through our form so we can see your real work: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeYletoHQQwV8pZPZoTRrlKwdsMOlDeMwipQqlF6D\_VVkSFvA/viewform?usp=pp\_url&entry.1653201307=LinkedIn . It takes about 20 minutes, plus a 60 to 90 second video.

Turn ancient wisdom and modern psychology into small daily practices people actually do, and finish.

**About Kitab**

Kitab brings ancient wisdom to modern problems, so people can Know, Grow and Free themselves. We have the ideas, the texts and the experts. Wisdom is everywhere; doing it daily is the hard part. We need a psychology-trained designer who turns it into reflections, journaling prompts, habit plans, guided exercises and multi-week programs that people do on a busy Tuesday morning.

**The role**

On-site in Hyderabad, full-time, 1 opening, reporting to Tameesh Sud. Experience: 3 to 4 years in coaching, counselling, wellbeing programs, learning design or personal-growth content. Education: Bachelor's or Master's in Psychology. You will design and write the personal growth practices at the heart of the Kitab app, each grounded in a recognised psychology framework and in the wisdom texts, and written so people want to finish it.

You will own one number: 25 practices and your first multi-week program live within your first 90 days, every one mapped to a framework and with completion improving on the baseline. After that, you will grow it into a practice library people come back to every day.

This is a founder-style role. You'll work across product, content, our experts and the data, take on problems nobody has solved neatly yet, and own whether people actually finish what you design.

**What you'll own**

* Growth practices: daily practices, challenges and multi-week programs on purpose, focus, anxiety, relationships, discipline and self-awareness.
* Evidence behind every practice: each one maps to a recognised framework such as CBT, ACT, positive psychology (PERMA), habit science or ICF coaching competencies.
* Wisdom meets science: map ideas from texts like the Bhagavad Gita to modern psychology.
* Expert input into product: turn what senior advisors and experts tell us into structured, user-ready practices, scripts and in-app flows.
* Safety: clear guardrails, and people pointed to professional help whenever a practice touches therapy or crisis.
* Learning from users: completion and feedback data decide what to improve, expand or retire.

**Your scorecard (90 days)**

* Practice design template and framework library, agreed with experts, live by day 30
* Practices live in the app: 5 by day 30, 15 by day 60, 25 by day 90
* First multi-week growth program live by day 90
* Completion rate of practices started: +15% vs baseline by day 90
* 100% of practices mapped to a recognised framework and expert-signed
* A weekly feedback loop with real Kitab users feeding the roadmap

**How AI fits this role**

You bring the psychology judgement. AI multiplies your output.

* Research faster: summarise studies, compare frameworks and pull passages from the texts, then check them against the originals.
* Draft at scale: first drafts of practices, prompts and program variants, which you refine for accuracy, tone and safety.
* Personalise: prompt templates that adapt a practice to a person's goal, mood or level, and AI-guided reflection flows inside the app.
* Stress-test: use AI to check practices for clarity and cultural fit, and to flag what needs an expert's eye.
* Prompt engineering is a core skill: you write, test and refine prompts until tools like Claude or ChatGPT give reliable, safe output.
* Where AI doesn't get a say: anything that looks like therapy or crisis support. There, your judgement leads and people are pointed to professional help.

**What you bring**

* A Bachelor's or Master's in Psychology
* 3 to 4 years in life coaching, counselling, wellbeing programs, learning design or personal-development content
* Working knowledge of CBT, ACT, positive psychology and habit science
* Practices or programs you've designed that real people used, with numbers if you have them
* Prompt engineering: you write and test prompts until the output is exactly what you need
* Strong content writing: practices, reflection prompts and audio or video scripts that people want to finish, with samples to show
* Warm, simple English that turns a big idea into three doable steps
* A founder mindset: you own whether people finish what you design and treat a practice nobody completes as your problem to fix

**Nice to have:**
ICF coaching certification (ACC or PCC); the Bhagavad Gita, Upanishads or Yoga Sutras; Hindi or Telugu; wellness, edtech or consumer app experience.

**Why join**

* Build at an early-stage company with the scope, speed and ownership most people wait years for
* Shape the core experience of a mission-led app, with direct access to the founders and senior experts
* Help millions of people build habits that make them calmer, clearer and more self-aware
* Build your own practice library from the ground up and grow into a lead role

**How we select**

Form, then we shortlist, then a phone screen and proof of work with Ganesh, a 60-minute assignment (shared only after the call), an alignment round with Nihal, and a final conversation with Ravi.

Rolling applications, shortlisted every Friday. Women are strongly encouraged to apply. Questions or trouble submitting the form? WhatsApp +91 63012 56771 or email hr@kitab.com. We don't take applications by email.

title: Credit Risk Researcher, Vice President
description:
As a Vice President in Credit Risk Research at Citi, you will conduct high-impact analysis across wholesale and retail portfolios that directly shapes how the firm identifies, measures, and manages credit exposure. This individual contributor role gives you the platform to inform senior leadership, influence governance frameworks, and apply deep credit risk expertise to decisions with firm-wide consequences. If you can translate complex analysis into clear, actionable insight, this position offers the scope and visibility to make a lasting impact.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Conduct in-depth credit risk research across wholesale and retail portfolios, producing assessments that equip senior leadership with well-informed risk decisions.
* Develop and refine credit risk measurement methodologies, keeping Citi's approach to credit risk rigorous and aligned with evolving market conditions.
* Analyze credit portfolios to identify emerging risk concentrations, trends, and vulnerabilities, translating findings into clear risk mitigation recommendations.
* Monitor counterparty and sector-level credit risk trends to maintain an accurate, current view of Citi's credit exposures.
* Produce high-quality risk assessment reports and research outputs that communicate complex findings clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Present research conclusions to senior business and risk leaders, informing strategic credit risk decisions.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of credit risk governance frameworks, embedding research outputs into risk oversight processes.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Hold a bachelor's degree in economics, finance, statistics, or a related quantitative field.
* Bring 8+ years of experience in financial services and analytics, with deep expertise in wholesale or retail credit risk research or a closely related discipline.
* Apply strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills to develop and enhance credit risk measurement methodologies.
* Interpret complex credit data to identify material risk themes and draw well-reasoned conclusions.
* Communicate nuanced credit risk findings clearly and confidently to senior and executive-level audiences, in writing and in person.
* Maintain familiarity with credit risk governance frameworks and the regulatory environment governing credit risk management in banking.
* Manage multiple research workstreams simultaneously, delivering rigorous, high-quality outputs within defined timelines.

**Beneficial Skills & Qualifications**

* Hold an advanced degree, such as a Master's, in economics, finance, statistics, or a related quantitative field.

What We Offer
  
  
At Citi, Credit Risk Research Vice Presidents work at the center of one of the world's most significant financial institutions, with direct access to complex, high-stakes analysis and the leadership teams who act on it.
  
  

* Work in a hybrid model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, balancing structure with flexibility.
* Gain direct exposure to senior risk and business leadership, with your research informing decisions at the highest levels of the firm.
* Influence credit risk governance frameworks that shape Citi's wholesale and retail portfolio strategy.
* Build your career through Citi's global network of risk professionals and ongoing learning opportunities in credit risk.
* Thrive in a performance-driven environment that recognizes intellectual contribution, accountability, and high-quality analytical work.
* Access comprehensive wellbeing support and resources designed to support work-life balance.

Join Citi as a Vice President in Credit Risk Research and apply your expertise where it shapes the credit risk intelligence guiding one of the world's leading financial institutions.

title: Sr. SRE Engineer
description:
Role Overview
  
  
The selected SRE and DevOps professional will be responsible for maintaining highly available production systems, managing cloud infrastructure, improving observability, and supporting reliable deployment and operations practices. The role combines hands-on engineering with incident response, infrastructure automation, performance optimization, and continuous reliability improvement.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have experience working in production-critical environments where system availability, quick incident resolution, effective monitoring, and preventive engineering are essential.
  
  
Key Responsibilities1. Site Reliability and Production Operations
  
  

* Monitor production systems and maintain service availability, performance, and operational stability.
* Participate in production support and scheduled on-call rotations, including the resolution of critical incidents.
* Investigate system failures, perform root cause analysis, document post-incident findings, and implement preventive measures.
* Identify recurring operational issues and reduce manual intervention through automation.
* Improve service reliability using measurable indicators, service objectives, availability targets, and error-budget practices.
* Contribute to capacity planning, disaster recovery, high availability, redundancy, and failover strategies.
* Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Engineering
* Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Work with cloud compute, storage, networking, access management, monitoring, and cloud-native services.
* Support containerized applications and manage Kubernetes-based infrastructure, including AKS, EKS, GKE, or equivalent platforms.
* Troubleshoot cluster health, application workloads, resource utilization, scaling, networking, and deployment-related issues.
* Work with Helm and other relevant deployment tools to maintain consistent application releases.
* Infrastructure Automation and DevOps
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
* Support automated infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and repeatable deployment processes.
* Work with Git-based development workflows, including GitHub, GitLab, Azure Repos, or equivalent platforms.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and improve deployment reliability through automation.
* Develop scripts using Python and/or Bash to simplify operational activities and eliminate repetitive tasks.
* Monitoring, Observability and Performance
* Build and maintain monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting solutions for production environments.
* Work with observability platforms such as OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, Golden Signals(including Latency, errors, traffic, saturation), AWS CloudWatch, and GCP Cloud Monitoring.
* Apply the four Golden Signals—latency, traffic, errors, and saturation—to monitor service health and identify performance issues.
* Improve distributed tracing and establish meaningful alerts that reflect actual system health and user impact.
* Investigate performance bottlenecks across infrastructure, applications, networks, and distributed systems.
* Linux, Networking and Security
* Troubleshoot Linux-based systems and production infrastructure issues.
* Apply networking fundamentals, including DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing, SSL/TLS, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Follow cloud security best practices for identity and access management, network segmentation, and secrets management.
* Support vulnerability remediation, security improvements, and compliance-related activities in collaboration with relevant teams.

Technical Environment
  
  
The role involves cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, Terraform, scripting, production support, monitoring, and modern reliability engineering practices. Experience with one major cloud platform is important, while exposure to multiple cloud environments can be beneficial.
  
  
Additional exposure to Go (Golang), OpenSearch, ELK Stack, AI/ML production platforms, Azure AI services, AI Foundry, RAG-based workloads, and enterprise observability frameworks would be advantageous.

title: Assistant Manager - Climate Action (Biodiversity)
description:
**Job Overview:**

In this role one will conceptualise, plan, implement and monitor United Way Mumbai’s biodiversity conservation, afforestation, Miyawaki plantation, Agri-Horti plantation, mangrove restoration and ecological restoration projects, and will build the science behind them. The role combines field implementation with ecological rigour: choosing native species and sites, setting up baseline and monitoring protocols, and showing corporate and institutional partners measurable ecological outcomes. The role works closely with the programme, impact assessment, CSR partnership and volunteering teams.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Design biodiversity conservation, afforestation, mangrove and wetland restoration projects aligned with UWM’s Climate Action strategy and partner CSR priorities.
* Select suitable native and indigenous species for each site after assessing soil, rainfall, hydrology and local biodiversity.
* Prepare technical proposals, work plans, budgets and bills of quantities, including survival, maintenance and protection plans.
* Advise on plantation models such as dense native (Miyawaki-type) plantations, agroforestry, mangrove restoration and nursery-based approaches, and on site suitability.
* Lead on-ground execution of plantation, restoration and conservation projects with NGO partners, forest departments, panchayats and community groups.
* Oversee nurseries, sapling procurement and quality, site preparation, planting, watering, protection and post-plantation maintenance.
* Visit sites regularly to check plantation quality, survival rates, geo-tagging and adherence to timelines, and resolve implementation issues.
* Support nature awareness activities such as nature trails, bird walks and school and college sessions.
* Conduct or commission baseline and periodic ecological impact assessments covering flora, fauna, canopy cover and habitat condition.
* Set biodiversity indicators and monitoring protocols (survival rate, species diversity, canopy cover, geotagging, carbon or soil indicators where relevant) and track them over time.
* Work with the Impact Assessment team to build M&E frameworks, field data tools and dashboards, and to commission third-party evaluations.
* Turn field data into clear findings and lessons that improve future project design.
* Build and maintain working relationships with the State Forest Departments, municipal bodies, research institutions, universities and local NGOs.
* Obtain permissions and clearances needed for plantation and restoration work on forest, wetland and public land.
* Identify and vet NGO and technical partners for biodiversity projects.
* Co-create biodiversity projects with corporate partners and present technical approaches in meetings and proposals.
* Prepare quarterly, annual and ad hoc progress reports, utilisation updates and impact stories for donors.
* Plan and run employee volunteering activities (plantation drives, clean-ups, nature trails) with safe, scientifically sound field protocols.
* Guide and mentor Coordinators and Executives in the Climate Action team, and manage field staff and partner teams.
* Track project budgets and expenditure and keep spending within approved limits.
* Contribute to knowledge products such as case studies, sector notes and presentations, and keep abreast of developments in biodiversity policy and practice in India.

**Profile requisites:**

* M.Sc. in Forestry/ Botany from a recognised university or institute (for example, FRI Dehradun, or an agricultural, science or forestry university).
* 4–6 years of relevant experience in biodiversity conservation, afforestation, Miyawaki plantation, Agri-Horti plantation, mangrove restoration and ecological restoration projects.
* Hands-on experience running plantation or restoration projects in the field, including nursery work and survival monitoring.
* Clear written and spoken English and Hindi; working Marathi is an advantage.
* Strong report writing, proposal development and presentation skills for corporate and government audiences.
* Ability to coordinate with communities, government officials, volunteers and corporate teams.
* Willingness to travel and work in field conditions including coastal, wetland and rural sites.

**Remuneration:** Subject to relevant qualification, experience & merit; the salary range is INR 6 to 10 LPA. If you think you might be suitable, apply now and we'll reach out to you soon.

title: Principal-Talent Sourcing
description:
### **About Us**

Global, inclusive and innovative - welcome to AMS, where talent connects across cultures and backgrounds to shape the future of work.

We work with leading organizations to design and deliver talent strategies that bring together people, process, data and technology, helping millions of people find meaningful work every year. Our diverse, connected community collaborates to create results for clients and opportunities for our people to learn, grow and make an impact.

At AMS, we look for people who bring more than experience, and we welcome different perspectives and ways of thinking.

  

### **The Role**

What if your skills mattered more than your job title?

At AMS, we’re building teams that are curious, collaborative, and committed to doing great work. We’re looking for a Principal-Talent sourcing who enjoys learning and values teamwork. If you’re good at wealth and private banking hiring, and excited to grow in a supportive environment, you might be exactly who we’re looking for.

### **Key Accountabilities**

What you’ll do:

* Apply advanced sourcing expertise to identify and engage high-quality passive talent.
* Use market insights and sourcing strategies to build future-ready talent pipelines.
* Collaborate with recruiters to convert talent pipelines into successful hires.
* Contribute to workforce planning through proactive talent community building.
* Drive sourcing excellence by leveraging data, technology, and candidate insights
* Stakeholder management skills to advise hiring managers and drive hiring decisions.

### **Skills & Requirements**

* Demonstrated ability in proactive sourcing and passive candidate engagement.
* Strength in talent mapping, market research, and relationship building.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS/CRM platforms, and sourcing technologies.
* Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, consultative, and data-driven environment.
* Strong communication, decision-making, and stakeholder partnering skills.
* Ability to build and nurture strategic talent pipelines aligned to future hiring needs.
* Hands-on wealth and private banking hiring experience, such as RM, affluent and private banking, and wealth advisory roles

### **Why AMS?**

At AMS, we come from every walk of life - and that’s what makes us unique. Our culture is open, inclusive and built on trust. We empower our people with the flexibility and autonomy to work in ways that bring out their best. We offer career opportunities in every direction you want to explore.

**We offer**

* Growth and development focused on your strengths
* The opportunity to develop a career within one of the world’s leading organisations specialising in talent and workforce solutions.
* A team that values being Passionate, Bold, and Authentic
* Supportive communities such as our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
* Volunteer day - you get one additional paid day off each year to volunteer for a cause that matters to you
* A competitive reward and benefits package
* Hybrid model

  

**Our statement**

We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage people with diverse skills, perspectives, and experiences to apply. title: Adult Vaccine Business Lead
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**JOB DESCRIPTION: ADULT VACCINE BUSINESS LEAD**

REPORTING TO: ADULT VACCINE BUSINESS HEAD

**BACKGROUND**

* In April 2023 GSK India launched the global asset – Shingrix (Zoster Vaccine) in India
* The success of this launch will determine the success of GSK India, not just in the Adult Vaccines Category but will impact the launch prospects for all future innovative global assets in India

**SHINGLES VACCINE MARKET**

* Shingrix is creating its own category as it is the only vaccine in this HZ space

**KEY DELIVERABLES OF ADULT VACCINE BUSINESS LEAD**

1. As an ‘ADULT VACCINE BUSINESS LEAD’ you will be responsible for facilitating the identification and onboarding a minimum of ~30 ‘high end’ Cardio HCPs per Direct Report (Product Specialist) ADULT VACCINE USER (HCP controls Vx journey of patients) with in 4-6 months and continue to expand width and depth of such accounts thereafter

* Focus: High End Cardiologist, Consulting Diabetologist, Cardio Physician, Endocrinologist, Nephrologists / Transplant surgeons, Internists, Rheumatologists, Gastroenterologists, Hematologists, ID Specialists, and Top End Pulmonologists
* This would entail enabling your team on the therapy knowledge on vaccinology esp Cardiology therapy area related to Shingles; educating HCP’s about the significant role of Shingrix in protecting their patients and their families; explaining the commercials and how that can help build an Adult Vaccination Practice (AVAX) practice; supporting HCP with relevant marketing material, patient outreach programs, customizing key marketing messages/communication to customer based on their profile and effectively driving in-clinic discussion; and establishing an end-to-end vaccination ecosystem for HCP practice right from ordering to vaccination

2. As an ‘ADULT VACCINE BUSINESS LEAD’ you will also be required to engage local leadership of Premium Diagnostic, Pharmacy, Corporate Hospital Chains to establish “Vaccination Clinics” for walk in patients/ consumers

3. Ensure development and implementation of multi-channel business plan to achieve business objectives and support the team through coaching to adjust plans wherever required

4. Coaches the field sales team to build their understanding of territory performance, develop actionable insights, identify territory opportunities, and to develop insight based, multi-channel territory business plans that deliver business objectives

**REQUIREMENTS FOR ADULT VACCINE BUSINESS LEAD ROLE**

1. Existing network with high end Cardio / Diabetes / Endo / Nephro / Consultant Physician in focus markets preferred

2. Minimum Sales experience of 10+ years with 5+ years of people management experience

3. Experience in launching new innovative therapies

4. Must possess excellent selling skills, commercial acumen, scientific orientation, problem solving, business planning & Execution and Collaboration & partnership with multiple stakeholders

5. Coaching, Performance Management and People Management & Development skills

**Please Note:**

**This is a parallel grade movement and employees in grade 8B and above would be eligible to apply.**

**Skills**

Competitive Sales, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Healthcare Market, Launch Excellence, Patient Impact, Sales Models, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Lead Architect - Java, Kubernetes
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

A career with us is a journey, not a destination. This could be the next best step in your technical career. Join us.
  
  
As a Lead Architect at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial & Investment Bank, you are an integral part of a team that works to develop high-quality architecture solutions for various software applications on modern cloud-based technologies. As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for conducting critical architecture solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of project goals.
  
  
**Job responsibilities**

* Engages technical teams and business stakeholders to discuss and propose technical approaches to meet current and future needs
* Defines the technical target state of their product and drives achievement of the strategy
* Leverages enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate architecture discovery and decisioning, with human-in-the-loop validation and appropriate handling of sensitive data.
* Evaluates recommendations and provides feedback on new technologies, including outcomes-oriented evaluation sessions with external vendors, startups, and internal teams to assess architectural designs and applicability within existing systems and information
* Executes creative software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with the ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or break down technical problems
* Develops secure and high-quality production code, and reviews and debugs code written by others
* Identifies opportunities to eliminate or automate remediation of recurring issues to improve overall operational stability of software applications and systems
* Establishes reuse-first AI-enabled engineering patterns and governance across SDLC/toolchain practices, ensuring traceability/auditability, resiliency, and security controls.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on architecture concepts and 5+ years applied experience
* Hands-on practical experience delivering system design, application development, testing, and operational stability for large-scale, distributed, mission-critical systems
* Advanced in one or more programming language(s) Java 17+ with Spring Boot and microservices.
* Proficient across SDLC execution, including automation/continuous delivery practices and agile methods such as CI/CD, application resiliency, and security
* Demonstrated proficiency within a technical discipline (e.g., cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.) and ability to evaluate current and emerging technologies to recommend future-state solutions
* Experience applying enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment in software engineering and architecture workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to evaluate and integrate AI-enabled capabilities into cloud-native architectures while meeting resiliency, security, and auditability requirements.
* In-depth knowledge of the financial services industry and their IT systems
* Strong knowledge of architecture patterns such as event-driven and streaming (Kafka), CQRS, Saga, domain-driven design and API design. Strong data architecture skills, including data modeling, Oracle and complex SQL, NoSQL, and options such as ODS, data lake, data warehouse, OLTP and OLAP
* Practical cloud-native experience with AWS (or equivalent), Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and observability
* Experience with architecture modeling tools such as C4, UML or Lucid. Ability to independently solve complex design problems, with strong communication skills to simplify complexity and influence senior business and technology stakeholders

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Domain knowledge of intraday liquidity, cash management, payments or reconciliation, including intraday liquidity monitoring requirements (e.g., BCBS 248)
* Cloud architecture certification (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect) or TOGAF. Experience with SRE practices (SLOs/SLIs), chaos engineering and FinOps
* Experience building agentic AI or GenAI applications (e.g., RAG, multi-step orchestration, guardrails, evaluation and monitoring)
* Experience establishing reference architectures, blueprints, golden paths and architecture review practices. Track record of modernizing legacy platforms in a regulated environment and understanding of hybrid and multi-cloud operating models, and distributed caching (e.g., Redis, Hazelcast)

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: IAM Violation Management Analyst
description:
Join us as an IAM Violation Management Analyst at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
  
  
To be successful as a IAM Violation Management Analyst, you should have experience with:
  
  
**Must Have Skills**

* Experience and In-depth Knowledge on Identity and Access Management specifically Segregation of Duties, Joiner Leaver Mover (JML), Privilege Access Management & Access Recertification Controls.
* Strong analytic, incident management and problem management
* Ability to handle large volumes of repetitive tasks while maintaining a high attention to detail.
* Good team player and interpersonal skills
* Good expertise in Microsoft Excel and Macros to perform analysis with large data sets on daily basis.
* Excellent Written & Verbal Communication skills.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Working Knowledge on AD, Microsoft Entra ID, LDAP.
* Proficiency in SQL & ORACLE to extract data evidence for audit and reconcile large datasets.
* Deep skill in Interpreting User Access entitlements, Group Memberships, and permissions across applications, platforms & tools to spot policy breaches and ability to define & maintain technical role matrix, understanding of Role & Rule Based Access controls & SSO Technologies.
* Practical understanding of NIST, SOX & ISO 27001 Frameworks.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To manage and implement Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies, processes, technologies and standards for all IAM functions to ensure the secure access and use of sensitive information across the organisation.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Collaboration with stakeholders and IT teams to understand, analyse and implement IAM solutions into the banks process and infrastructure needs including authentication, authorisation, access management and single sign-on capabilities.
* Management and development of policies, processes and standards for all essential IAM functions aligned to the banks security and regulatory requirements.
* Execution of IAM audits to monitor processes and ensure that they comply with policies and regulations and identify potential security risks.
* Execution of incident investigations to respond to IAM related security events, identify the root cause of the incident and implement corrective measures efficiently.
* Identification of emerging IAM technologies and industry trends by collaborating with networks and conferences to gain IAM expertise and best practice.
* Development of IAM governance documents and reports to align the implementation and adherence of policies across the organisation.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To meet the needs of stakeholders/ customers through specialist advice and support
* Perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard which will impact both the role itself and surrounding roles.
* Likely to have responsibility for specific processes within a team
* They may lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources. They supervise a team, allocate work requirements and coordinate team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they manage own workload, take responsibility for the implementation of systems and processes within own work area and participate on projects broader than direct team.
* Execute work requirements as identified in processes and procedures, collaborating with and impacting on the work of closely related teams.
* Check work of colleagues within team to meet internal and stakeholder requirements.
* Provide specialist advice and support pertaining to own work area.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how all teams in area contribute to the objectives of the broader sub-function, delivering impact on the work of collaborating teams.
* Continually develop awareness of the underlying principles and concepts on which the work within the area of responsibility is based, building upon administrative / operational expertise.
* Make judgements based on practise and previous experience.
* Assess the validity and applicability of previous or similar experiences and evaluate options under circumstances that are not covered by procedures.
* Communicate sensitive or difficult information to customers in areas related specifically to customer advice or day to day administrative requirements.
* Build relationships with stakeholders/ customers to identify and address their needs.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Minimum 2–4 years of experience in school admissions, educational counseling, or education sales.

Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills.

Strong leadership, counseling, negotiation, and convincing abilities.

Proven ability to achieve admission and revenue targets.

Good knowledge of school admission procedures and parent engagement.

Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, email, WhatsApp, and CRM tools.

Strong follow-up, organizational, and time-management skills.

Ability to work independently and manage responsibilities effectively.

title: SAP SuccessFactors Time Tracking & Time Off Consultant
description: SuccessFactors / Employee Central Time Migration ProgrammeJob Title: SAP SuccessFactors Time Tracking & Time Off ConsultantLocation: Pune, India (VE3 Pune office; hybrid)Position Type: Full-timeExperience Level: 5-9 yearsWorking Pattern: Offshore delivery with overlap into UK business hours to align with the onshore teamRole Overview:We are seeking an experienced SAP SuccessFactors Time Tracking and Time Off Consultant to design and deliver the time and attendance solution on a large-scale SuccessFactors and Employee Central Payroll (ECP) transformation. The programme migrates a complex UK public sector payroll and HR estate from legacy SAP ECC / SAP HCM into the SAP SuccessFactors landscape, covering approximately 65,000 employees across 17 payroll areas, multiple public sector pension schemes (LGPS, Teachers, NHS), a significant multiple-employment population, and more than 60 integration interfaces.This role is based in VE3's Pune office as part of an onshore-offshore delivery model, working with a daily overlap into UK business hours alongside the onshore team. Time and attendance data is a direct upstream dependency for payroll accuracy, so this role sits at the heart of the delivery. The consultant will design and configure Time Tracking and Time Off (Employee Central Time Management) for a diverse public sector workforce - including shift workers, term-time-only staff, casual and relief workers, and employees holding multiple concurrent employments - and ensure clean, accurate time results flow into ECP ahead of the parallel payroll runs and go-live.RequirementsKey Responsibilities Time solution design. Own the end-to-end design and configuration of SuccessFactors Time Tracking and Time Off, aligned to SAP best practice and the programme's 'Adopt not Adapt' principle. Configuration. Build and unit test the full time solution, including: Work schedules, daily and period work schedule variants, and public holiday calendars Absence and attendance types, accrual rules and quotas Time valuation / time evaluation rules generating pay-relevant results Overtime, premium, shift, unsocial hours, standby and call-out rules Manager and employee self-service time approval via SAP Fiori Payroll integration. Design and validate the interface from Time to Employee Central Payroll, mapping time results to the correct wage types, and confirm that absences, premiums and bank holiday pay are reflected correctly in payroll. Complex population handling. Design time recording for term-time-only staff, casual and relief workers, and the multiple-employment population, where each employment carries its own work schedule and time profile. Testing support. Produce unit test evidence, support system integration testing and UAT, and ensure time-to-payroll scenarios are proven in the parallel payroll runs. Cutover and hypercare. Support data migration of time-related data, cutover activities, and hypercare through go-live, resolving defects within agreed service levels. Documentation and knowledge transfer. Produce configuration workbooks and knowledge-transfer materials, and support the client's SAP Centre of Excellence team in building in-house capability. Onshore-offshore collaboration. Work closely with the onshore UK-based functional, technical and programme leads, maintaining a daily overlap with UK business hours throughout the delivery lifecycle. Technical Skills & Experience: Strong hands-on configuration experience in SuccessFactors Time Tracking and Time Off (Employee Central Time Management), including time valuation rules and time type builder. Work schedules, holiday calendars, absence and accrual design across a complex, multi-population workforce. Solid understanding of the integration between Time, Employee Central and Employee Central Payroll, and how time results drive gross pay. Working knowledge of the UK payroll / HR domain the programme serves, including how absence, overtime and premiums affect pay and pension. Experience delivering within large, complex transformation programmes using SAP Activate and structured testing cycles. Essential Experience SuccessFactors Time Tracking and/or Time Off design and configuration Work schedule, absence, accrual and time valuation configuration Time-to-payroll integration (Employee Central Payroll or SAP Payroll) Complex workforce time scenarios (shift, overtime, premium, self-service) Delivery within full-cycle SuccessFactors or SAP HR implementations Desirable Experience UK public sector or local authority workforce (term-time-only, casual, relief) Multiple-employment / concurrent employment time handling SAP Cross-Application Time Sheet (CATS) and legacy time migration SAP Fiori time approval scenarios Employee Central core configuration exposure Certifications Desirable: SAP SuccessFactors certification in Time Management / Time Tracking; SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central certification. Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Clear communication and documentation discipline Ability to work effectively across business and technical teams Attention to detail and a quality-first mindset appropriate to a payroll programme Proactive approach to risk and issue identification Ability to manage priorities within a large transformation programme

title: Talent Growth | Senior Analyst
description:
**Talent Growth | Senior Analyst**

Nobody is ordinary! It is just how you explore your talents!

Let’s start with what we are
**not**
looking for

**Role:**
As a Talent Growth Specialist, you are the primary hunter for the technical talent that powers Searce globally. You are not a "generalist recruiter"; you are a Tech Talent Consultant. You will tap into AMER's strategic markets to find "Solvers" who fit the HAPPIER mold. Your goal is to engineer a high-velocity talent pipeline that scales our regional business units..

**Major Roles & Responsibilities**

title: Engineer in Training
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
  
  
We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Summary:**
Rockwell Automation recruits Engineering Graduates (Freshers or less than 12 months experience) with the title of "Engineer in Training (EIT)". You will undergo structured 1-year training program which includes classroom trainings as well as job rotations in multiple functions, as part of this program you are entitled to choose your career path by choosing one of the functions you have undergone in the job rotations.
  
  
You will initially report to the Regional Training Business Manager, AP and have a hybrid schedule working in any Rockwell Location, India and after completion of training program, you will report to your functional manager depending on your career path selection in the rotation program.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Actively engage and demonstrate in the first 1-year training program
* Leverage trainings and job rotation opportunities, by developing and demonstrating your capabilities in the rotation program
* After the 1-year training program, you will choose any of the following functions as your career path & gets placed in that functionAutomation Project EngineeringAutomation Field Services EngineeringCyber & Network Project EngineerManufacturing Operations Management/Information Solutions EngineerTechnical Proposal Engineer
* After choosing the specific function, your roles & responsibilities may vary based on the function you chose as your career path, some of those major responsibilities may include the following…Support manufacturing industries in their innovate, Design, Operate & Maintain lifecycle phases.Visit to manufacturing industries to delivery projects or servicesDevelop & Delivery Digital Transformation solution to manufacturing industriesCybersecurity & Network solutions to industries for secure & sustainable operationsAutomation products & software project programming and commissioningAutomation products & software services including troubleshooting and maintenanceAutomation / MES Project Design & Development

**The Essentials - You Will Have**

* B.E. graduates from the 2026 batch specializing in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or Electronics & Communication Engineering
* Fresh graduate / Less than 12 months experience in the field
* Adequate knowledge of core Electrical and Electronics engineering concepts.
* Basic understanding of Computer Science fundamentals and programming languages e.g. C, C++ etc.
* After completing training, candidates will be expected to visit customer sites for industrial automation project implementation
* The role requires the ability to travel up to 75% of the time.

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have**

* Analytical approach to programming and automation solution development
* Certifications in core subjects, industry internship, innovative projects
* Experimental mindset, creativity and deliver innovative solutions

**What We Offer**
Our benefits package includes …
  
  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!

*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

description:
**Role Summary**
The Applications Development Technical Lead Analyst is a senior engineering and architectural leadership role based in India, operating as a key regional anchor within the global Position Management technology organization.
  
  
In this capacity, you will serve as the principal designer, systems architect, and hands-on lead engineer for mission-critical, low latency, and high-throughput platform. This platforms powers real-time controls, intraday position aggregation, P&L, commissions, anomaly detection, and live risk enforcement across global trading desks.
  
  
As an engineering leader, you will collaborate extensively with other global teams and stakeholders across Asia, Europe, and Americas. You will champion modern engineering practices - actively designing, building, and prototyping using AI-augmented tools such as GitHub Copilot, Devin to accelerate development of lifecycles, elevate code quality, and modernize enterprise architectures. Additionally, you will serve as the primary regional and global technical contact for Risk Managers, Product Owners, Front-Office Trading Desks, and cross-functional technology partners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architecture, System Design & Core Engineering (Hands-on)
* Architect & Design: Lead the end-to-end technical architecture and low-level design for distributed, fault-tolerant, high-concurrency risk calculation and position management engines supporting global trading sessions.
* Hands-on Development: 10+ years of experience to actively write, review, and optimize high-performance, multi-threaded production code primarily in C++, with targeted high-performance/low-latency modules in Java and exploring Rust where ultra-low latency memory safety and deterministic execution are required.
* AI-Augmented Engineering: Champion the adoption of modern AI development workflows (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Devin, AI-driven code review, and automated test generation) to enhance developer productivity, modernize legacy components, and accelerate time-to-market.
* Middleware & Event Streams: Design resilient, low-latency, event-driven pipelines using enterprise messaging backbones such as Apache Kafka, Solace PubSub+, and other low-latency middleware fabrics.
* Relational Databases: Proficiency in SQL writing queries and improve efficiency
* Performance Tuning: Profile, benchmark, and optimize CPU usage, memory layout, network serialization, and IPC for low latency.

**Global Stakeholder Collaboration & Technical Advisory**

* Key Technical Liaison: Act as a technical contact and subject matter expert (SME) for Risk Managers, Product Owners, Trading Desks, Quantitative Analysts, and Operations across APAC and global hubs.
* Global Team Alignment: Partner closely with regional and global engineering pods across Singapore, London, New York, and other tech centers to ensure seamless platform rollouts, operational stability, and cohesive architecture standards.
* Cross-Technology Coordination: Interface closely with upstream Order Management Systems (OMS), Execution Management Systems (EMS), Market Data feeds, and downstream Clearing/Settlement and Regulatory reporting platforms across multiple asset classes (FX, Equities, Rates, Commodities, Credit).
* Requirement Translation: Translate complex quantitative risk models, margin methodologies, and regional/global regulatory requirements into scalable, deterministic technical architecture

**Mentorship & Regional/Global Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and mentor junior engineers in regional teams in distributed systems design, clean code practices, and modern AI-assisted engineering techniques.
* Lead architectural design reviews and rigorous peer code reviews to ensure reliability, security, and maintainability across distributed codebases.
* Partner with engineering managers and Scrum Masters across time zones on sprint planning, technical estimations, dependency resolution, and milestone delivery.

**Technical Proficiencies**
:
  
  

* Java: Practical experience or working knowledge of Java for performance-critical, memory-safe, or low-latency system components and cross-language interoperability
* C++: Proficiency in modern C++, memory management/profiling, lock-free data structures, concurrent programming, and low-latency tuning in Linux platforms.
* SQL: Hands-on experience writing SQL procedures, and practical knowledge of indexes

**Education**
:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree / University degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent STEM discipline.
* Master’s degree (Desirable) in Computer Science, Financial Engineering, or related quantitative field

title: Data Scientist
description:
Data Scientist – Predictive Intelligence Engine (PIE)

About Codvo.ai

Codvo.ai is an AI-native technology services company that helps global enterprises build and scale data, cloud and AI solutions. Our teams deliver for Fortune 500 clients across Oil & Gas, Energy, MedTech and other regulated industries.

Role overview

We are hiring a Data Scientist with hands-on Predictive Intelligence Engine (PIE) experience to turn enterprise and industrial data into models that forecast outcomes and prevent failures. You will own problems end to end: framing the question, building and validating models, and putting them into production with engineering teams. The role works directly with client stakeholders and suits someone who enjoys both technical depth and business impact.

Key responsibilities

* Design, build and enhance models and pipelines within the Predictive Intelligence Engine (PIE), partnering with stakeholders to translate problems into measurable predictive use cases.
* Build, validate and tune predictive models for forecasting, failure prediction, risk scoring, churn and demand.
* Develop predictive maintenance and anomaly detection solutions using sensor, IoT and time-series data from industrial assets.
* Engineer features from large structured and unstructured datasets, including historian and operational data.
* Apply statistical methods, survival analysis and experiment design to measure model impact.
* Build and evaluate GenAI / LLM solutions such as RAG pipelines where they strengthen predictive workflows.
* Work with data and ML engineers to deploy models into production and monitor accuracy, drift and retraining (MLOps).
* Present predictions and their business value to technical and non-technical audiences through dashboards and clear recommendations.
* Document models, assumptions and results, following data governance and compliance standards.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute to reusable predictive assets and best practices.

Required qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering or a related field.
* 10+ years of hands-on data science experience, with at least 3 years building predictive models.
* Hands-on experience building or working on a Predictive Intelligence Engine (PIE) in production, such as predictive maintenance, demand forecasting or failure / risk prediction.
* Strong time-series forecasting skills (ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM or gradient-boosted models such as XGBoost / LightGBM).
* Strong Python skills, including pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn and TensorFlow or PyTorch.
* Advanced SQL and experience working with large datasets.
* Solid grounding in statistics, probability, model validation and performance metrics.
* Working knowledge of a cloud platform: Azure, AWS or GCP.
* Clear communication skills and comfort working with client stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications

* Experience with industrial data sources such as AVEVA PI / OSIsoft PI historians, SCADA, IoT and sensor streams.
* Experience with real-time or streaming prediction (Kafka, Spark Streaming, Azure Event Hubs).
* MLOps tools such as MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure ML, SageMaker or Databricks.
* Experience with GenAI and LLMs: RAG, vector databases, LangChain / LlamaIndex or agentic AI workflows.
* Visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Domain exposure to Oil & Gas, Energy, LNG, Manufacturing or Healthcare / MedTech.
* Experience in a client-facing consulting or services environment.

What we offer and how to apply

* Build Predictive Intelligence Engine (PIE) solutions for Fortune 500 enterprises.
* Exposure to the latest GenAI and agentic AI work in an AI-native company.
* Learning budget, certifications and a clear growth path.
* Competitive compensation, health insurance and hybrid working.
