title: EPR/ESG & Sustainability Reporting Analyst
description:
At Columbia, we’re as passionate about the outdoors as you are. And while our gear is available worldwide, we’re proud to be based in the Pacific Northwest, where natural wonders are our playground.

Every product we make and every task we undertake is inspired by the famous words of our founder Gert Boyle: “It’s perfect. Now make it better.” As pioneers of relentless improvement, we are constantly evolving.

We believe the outdoors is ours to protect and strive to keep our planet healthy. We believe in empowering people to experience the outdoors to the fullest.

And we believe in you.

  

**ABOUT THE POSITION**

  

Columbia is addressing the rapidly growing demand for information on corporate environmental performance by seeking a dedicated **EPR & Sustainability Reporting Analyst** to assist in the creation and delivery of sustainability information to key stakeholders - shareholders, regulators, customers, and employees. This role will support both Columbia’s extended producer responsibility (EPR) reporting obligations for packaging and textiles and global climate reporting obligations in accordance with evolving regulations and frameworks.

  

The **EPR & Sustainability Reporting Analyst** will report with a dotted line to the Climate Reporting Controller based in the United States. They will be responsible for calculating portions of our global emissions footprint, compiling required EPR disclosure metrics, and various internal stakeholders in need of information regarding EPR and climate. The **EPR & Sustainability Reporting Analyst** may also work closely with the Corporate Responsibility team on any climate target work. This is a non-supervisory role. The position will be based in Columbia’s Bengaluru, India office.

The **EPR & Sustainability Reporting Analyst’s** responsibilities are global in scope and require working closely with multiple functions and regions across the organization to ensure timely and accurate reporting of EPR and climate disclosures in a standardized and controlled process.

**HOW YOU’LL MAKE A DIFFERENCE**

* Help calculate the Company’s global carbon emissions footprint and other relevant EPR metrics, with assistance from internal functions that source data.
* Design and develop policies and procedures for capturing, calculating, processing, and reporting EPR and climate-related data.
* Assist with the reporting of EPR and climate-related numerical disclosures wherever they are disclosed. These disclosures will be used to support compliance with emerging and existing global regulations.
* Work cross functionally with global teams in sustainability, materials, manufacturing, logistics, travel, legal, accounting, finance and others to ensure disclosures are complete and accurate.
* Provide insight and recommendations to help automate EPR and climate reporting processes in consultation with the Climate Reporting Controller, help manage the Company’s enterprise climate reporting software for tracking and measuring climate program metrics.
* Provide technical expertise on climate reporting policies, guidelines, and requirements.
* Keep current on global EPR and Climate reporting frameworks, evolving disclosure trends, and best practices.
* Collaborate with partners across the organization and provide insight to support public disclosures.
* Assist with external reviews and assurance engagements of the information within Columbia’s EPR and climate disclosures.
* Support internal stakeholder across the business in their understanding of EPR and Climate and any related implications.
* Engage with third party providers and consulting firms as needed, under the supervision of the Climate Reporting Controller.
Provide additional review, training and support to other team members as needed.  

**YOU ARE**

* Knowledgeable about global climate reporting legislation (e.g., California SB261, California SB 253, CSRD, CSDDD, EU Taxonomy) and reporting guidelines (GHG Protocol, SASB, TCFC, ISSB, CSRD, 40 CFR 98).
* Comfortable engaging with internal stakeholders across the business.
* An excellent communicator capable of conveying complex concepts clearly and logically.
* Interested in change management, including a desire to help manage change across an organization with successful outcomes.
* A critical thinker with demonstrated analytical skill and capacity to identify, assess and prioritize competing interests and needs.
* Comfortable executing strategic processes and initiatives within a fast-paced, deadline-oriented, and complex environment.
Practiced in maintaining confidentiality and appropriate discretion. Your ethics and integrity are unquestionable.  

  

**EXPERIENE AND QUALIFIATIONS**

  

* 3+ years’ experience in sustainability accounting and reporting
* In-depth knowledge of the Greenhouse Gas Protocol, with 3+ years of experience in calculating emissions footprints
* Apparel and footwear industry experience preferred, including familiarity with EPR-specific reporting requirements for textile and apparel companies.
* Experience includes familiarity with SBTis
* Knowledgeable about, and experience with Salesforce products is preferred. Initial Salesforce Administrator Certification is a plus but not required.
* Experience with third-party audits of inventories, and with auditors/assurance providers
* Experience in broader ESG strategy, data analytics, and/or preparation of corporate disclosures
* Ability to manage projects at a local (micro) level while also monitoring/having oversight of a broad range of initiatives at a program (macro) level

* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Finance, Accounting, any of the physical sciences, or a business-related field preferred.

* Proficiency leveraging Microsoft Excel and other business software
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and work well under time constraints preferred
* Ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously preferred
Flexibility and able to adjust to shifting priorities preferred

description: OverviewWELCOME TO SITAAt SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.Are you ready to love your job?The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.About The TeamWe are a global integration and delivery team. We implement, integrate and support border management and passenger data solutions for government customers around the world. We deploy and configure applications, integrate them with government and airline systems, ship regular releases, and support them in production. Our solutions run in secure on-premises, customer-hosted and cloud environments, and our teams are spread across several regions and time zones.PURPOSEThe Lead Technical Architect owns the technical design of the team's solutions, from early estimation through to production. You'll define solution and integration architectures for high-availability, message-driven systems built on Java microservices and Kubernetes. You'll set the technical direction for environments, CI/CD and platform standards, and act as the senior technical authority for engineering teams, customers and partners.Key ResponsibilitiesSolution and integration architectureDesign end-to-end solution architectures for new implementations, enhancements and modernisation programmes. logic into configurable rules, and plan data migration.Make technology decisions, for example choosing between relational and NoSQL data stores, based on functional need, non-functional requirements and licence cost.Platform, environments and DevOpsDefine the target platform architecture on Kubernetes, including namespaces, ingress, storage, secrets management and environment isolation.Design environment strategy and promotion paths (development, CI, functional test, certification, staging, production) with immutable release artefacts and automated quality gates.Set CI/CD and code-quality standards with DevOps teams, including build pipelines, artefact registries, and static and open-source security scanning.Non-functional and security designDesign for high availability, scalability and disaster recovery, including active/DR topologies, cross-site replication, backup and agreed RTO/RPO targets.Define security architecture: identity and access management, service-to-service authorisation, encryption, network segmentation and compliance with government security requirements.Define observability standards (logging, monitoring, alerting, audit) and make sure solutions are ready to hand over to operations.Delivery leadershipTurn business and customer requirements into technical scope, work breakdowns and effort estimates for proposals and roadmaps.Run design reviews and code-quality reviews, and make sure delivery follows the agreed architecture.Act as the senior technical escalation point for complex production incidents, and lead root-cause analysis and long-term fixes.Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies and technical debt.Stakeholder engagement and mentoringPresent and defend architecture to customers, government stakeholders, partners and internal leadership.Guide and mentor engineers, and build architecture capability across distributed teams.Keep architecture documentation, reference designs and standards up to date.QualificationsSKILLS AND EXPERIENCEEssential12+ years in software engineering, with at least 4–5 years as a solution, technical or integration architect on complex enterprise systems.Application architecture: Java microservices, domain-driven design, REST/SOAP API design, and rules-engine-driven applications.Messaging and integration: IBM MQ, Apache Kafka, and integration middleware such as Apache Camel / Karaf; XML/JSON message design.Containers and orchestration: Kubernetes (including Rancher on RHEL), Docker, Helm, and NGINX / ingress and load balancing.Data: Oracle (19c) and MongoDB; data modelling, replication and large-scale data migration and reconciliation.Search and observability: Elastic (Elasticsearch / ELK) for logging, search and audit; application monitoring tools such as Dynatrace or Grafana.Identity and security: ForgeRock or equivalent IAM, OAuth2/OpenID Connect, PKI/TLS, and API gateway security.DevOps and CI/CD: Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Git, Harbor / Nexus / Azure Container Registry, SonarQube, Mend and Black Duck.Proven experience designing high-availability, disaster-recovery and secure on-premises solutions.Strong written and spoken communication, including writing architecture documents and presenting to senior and customer stakeholders.DesirableStorage and backup: MinIO, Longhorn and Kubernetes-native backup such as Veeam Kasten.Public cloud experience (Azure, AWS) and hybrid deployment models.Experience with mobile back-end services and API-based partner integrations.Knowledge of the aviation, travel or border management domain, such as passenger data standards (API/PNR, PNRGOV), interactive APIs and electronic travel authorisation.Experience working with government customers and security accreditation processes.Architecture certification such as TOGAF, or cloud or Kubernetes certifications (CKA/CKAD, Azure/AWS Architect).KEY ATTRIBUTESPragmatic decision-maker who balances technical quality with cost, risk and delivery timelines.Clear communicator who can explain complex designs to technical and non-technical audiences.Hands-on enough to prototype, review code and troubleshoot production issues.Works well with distributed teams and can lead without direct authority.Flexible about working across time zones when customer workshops, releases or production incidents need it.Education & QualificationsDegree in a technical discipline (e.g. Computer Science Engineering Mathematics etc.) or sufficient work experience to demonstrate proficiency at this level.What We OfferWe're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.🏡 Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)⏰ Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans.🌎 Flex-Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.🌿 Employee Wellbeing: We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.🚀 Professional Development: At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative, and Airport Council International -available to all employees-to specialized solutions like Pluralsight for technology upskilling, Harvard Business Publishing for people leadership, Stanford for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.🙌 Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Solution Area Specialists - Digital Natives
description:
**Overview**
The Azure Solution Specialist for India's Digital Native business plays a pivotal role in accelerating cloud and AI adoption, driving strategic customer engagements, and delivering sustained Azure consumption growth in one of the most dynamic, technically sophisticated, and highly competitive market segments.
  
  
The role requires a
**strong challenger mindset, deep technical acumen, commercial agility, and an uncompromising focus on execution and customer outcomes**
. Digital Native customers operate at exceptional speed, with technically proficient founders, CTOs, and engineering leaders who expect credible technical engagement, differentiated thinking, rapid turnaround, and tangible outcomes from every interaction.
  
  
The Solution Specialist is expected to operate as a trusted strategic advisor and growth leader, proactively challenging conventional approaches, shaping customer technology strategies, and identifying opportunities across AI, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, migration, and modernization. Success requires the ability to connect Microsoft's technology differentiation with customer business priorities, influence complex technical and commercial decisions, and compete effectively in a rapidly evolving cloud and AI ecosystem.
  
  
Working across customer leadership, engineering teams, partners, and Microsoft's broader organization, the specialist will lead high-value opportunities from identification through execution, accelerate pipeline conversion, and drive predictable business results. The role demands strong ownership, bias for action, disciplined sales execution, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while consistently delivering at the pace of Digital Native customers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Customer Engagement & Business Ownership
* Drive high-impact customer engagement: Lead strategic conversations with founders, CTOs, engineering leaders, and senior decision-makers across Digital Native accounts. Demonstrate strong technical credibility, business acumen, and the ability to translate complex Azure and AI capabilities into differentiated customer outcomes.
* Operate at Digital Native speed: Embrace a customer-first, high-velocity execution mindset, ensuring rapid turnaround, proactive follow-through, and measurable outcomes from every customer interaction. Prioritize meaningful customer-facing engagements and maintain a strong field presence to accelerate business opportunities.
* Demonstrate a hunter and challenger mindset: Proactively identify, create, and pursue new business opportunities across existing and prospective customers. Challenge conventional thinking, uncover unmet needs, influence technology decisions, and position Microsoft as a strategic partner for cloud and AI innovation.
* Lead with ownership and accountability: Take end-to-end ownership of customer opportunities, proactively navigating technical, commercial, and organizational complexities. Demonstrate leadership in removing execution barriers, driving decisions, and ensuring timely delivery of customer commitments.
* Orchestrate the Microsoft virtual team (v-team): Lead cross-functional collaboration across Account Teams, Customer Success, Engineering, Global Partner Solutions, and other stakeholders. Mobilize the right expertise, establish clear accountability, and drive coordinated execution to deliver customer outcomes.
* Build trusted, long-term customer partnerships: Align Azure and AI transformation strategies with customer priorities, including security, scalability, reliability, performance, and cost optimization. Strengthen executive relationships while driving adoption, expansion, and sustained customer success.
* Sales & Pipeline Management
* Own predictable business outcomes: Drive accountability for Azure revenue, consumption growth, pipeline creation, and sales commitments. Maintain a rigorous operating rhythm focused on forecast accuracy, opportunity progression, and consistent delivery against business targets.
* Build and accelerate a healthy pipeline: Demonstrate a strong hunter mindset by continuously identifying whitespace, creating qualified opportunities, expanding workload penetration, and converting customer engagements into measurable business growth.
* Drive proactive risk management and churn prevention: Establish early visibility into consumption risks, competitive threats, customer dissatisfaction, workload migration risks, and potential revenue erosion. Proactively mobilize stakeholders and execute mitigation plans to protect and grow the Azure business.
* Maintain disciplined forecasting and pipeline hygiene: Ensure accurate opportunity qualification, realistic close dates, consumption projections, and timely CRM updates. Surface risks, dependencies, and forecast deviations early, with clear mitigation actions and ownership.
* Accelerate deal execution and consumption realization: Lead complex, high-value opportunities through technical validation, commercial alignment, deal closure, deployment, and consumption ramp-up. Partner effectively with the broader v-team to minimize friction and accelerate time to value.
* Leverage data and AI-driven insights: Utilize customer consumption trends, market intelligence, sales analytics, and AI-powered tools to identify growth opportunities, improve forecast predictability, anticipate risks, and strengthen sales execution.
* Sales Strategy, Competitive Leadership & Market Development
* Drive a differentiated Azure and AI growth strategy: Develop and execute account-specific strategies that position Microsoft Azure as a preferred platform for Digital Native innovation, spanning AI applications, agentic AI, data platforms, cloud-native architectures, infrastructure, and modernization.
* Demonstrate strong competitive intelligence: Maintain a deep understanding of competing cloud and AI platforms, emerging technologies, market dynamics, and competitive positioning. Confidently articulate Microsoft's differentiation across technology, performance, economics, security, and ecosystem capabilities.
* Lead with a challenger perspective: Bring informed points of view into customer discussions, constructively challenge existing architectures and technology choices, and influence strategic decisions through technical insights, commercial understanding, and compelling business value.
* Continuously develop technical and market expertise: Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and a strong learning mindset. Stay current with rapid advancements in AI models, cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, architecture patterns, and competitive offerings to remain relevant to highly technical customers.
* Translate market insights into actionable growth opportunities: Proactively identify emerging workloads, whitespace, industry trends, and customer investment priorities. Build targeted sales plays that accelerate Azure adoption, expand market share, and create new consumption opportunities.
* Lead cross-organizational execution: Influence and align account teams, technical specialists, engineering, customer success, and partner organizations around shared business priorities. Demonstrate leadership beyond direct reporting lines to accelerate execution and deliver results.
* Champion a culture of urgency, accountability, and continuous improvement: Bring an entrepreneurial mindset, bias for action, resilience, and strong execution discipline. Continuously challenge the status quo, simplify complexity, and raise the bar for customer engagement and business performance.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or a related field, with relevant experience in enterprise technology sales, cloud solutions, solution consulting, or business development. Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* Proven experience driving complex, high-value technology sales opportunities, with demonstrated success in customer acquisition, strategic account development, pipeline creation, and revenue or consumption growth.
* Broad understanding of cloud and AI technologies, with the ability to lead strategic customer conversations across cloud infrastructure, application modernization, cloud-native architectures, developer platforms, artificial intelligence, data and analytics, databases, and security.
* Ability to connect multiple technology domains into cohesive customer transformation strategies, identify cross-solution opportunities, and lead differentiated sales plays aligned with customer business priorities, technology roadmaps, and long-term growth objectives.
* Strong technical acumen and architectural understanding, with the confidence to engage technically sophisticated founders, CTOs, CIOs, architects, and engineering leaders. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling business value and influence strategic technology decisions.
* Demonstrated hunter and challenger mindset, with the ability to proactively create demand, uncover whitespace, challenge established approaches, compete for strategic workloads, and convert emerging customer needs into qualified business opportunities.
* Strong understanding of the competitive cloud and AI landscape, including hyperscale cloud platforms, emerging AI ecosystems, developer technologies, and evolving customer architecture preferences. Ability to articulate differentiated value propositions across technical capabilities, commercial considerations, and business outcomes.
* Proven ability to operate in high-velocity, competitive, and ambiguous environments, demonstrating agility, urgency, resilience, and a strong bias for action. Comfortable managing multiple priorities while ensuring rapid turnaround and meaningful outcomes from customer engagements.
* Strong business ownership and commercial acumen, including opportunity qualification, deal strategy, pipeline management, consumption forecasting, competitive positioning, and proactive identification of business risks and customer churn signals.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional virtual teams, orchestrating technical, engineering, customer success, partner, and commercial resources to accelerate opportunity execution and customer value realization.
* Customer-first approach, with a strong commitment to spending meaningful time engaging customers, understanding their technology and business challenges, and building trusted relationships through consistent execution and measurable outcomes.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities, with the ability to leverage customer consumption insights, market intelligence, competitive trends, and AI-powered sales tools to identify growth opportunities, improve forecast predictability, and drive informed business decisions.
* Strong learning agility and intellectual curiosity, with a commitment to continuously developing technical depth, broadening solution-area expertise, and staying ahead of rapidly evolving cloud, AI, and competitive technologies.
* Excellent communication, executive presence, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence both technical and business decision-makers and lead outcome-oriented discussions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Preferred experience working with Digital Native businesses, SaaS companies, technology startups, ISVs, or high-growth technology organizations.
* Experience engaging directly with technical founders, CTOs, engineering leadership, and product teams in fast-paced, innovation-led environments.
* Demonstrated success in driving multi-workload cloud adoption, including infrastructure modernization, cloud-native application development, AI transformation, data platform modernization, and security-led customer engagements.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry, cloud infrastructure, modern application and database platforms, Microsoft Fabric, GitHub, and cloud security technologies, or equivalent competitive platforms.
* Experience developing competitive displacement strategies, winning strategic workloads, expanding cloud consumption, and protecting existing business through proactive customer engagement.
* Relevant cloud, AI, architecture, or security certifications, along with demonstrated commitment to continuous technical and professional development.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
**requesting accommodations.**

Full-Time

From intimate ceremonies to grand multi-day weddings, we bring ideas to life—and we’re looking for a sharp, creative storyteller to capture that energy and turn it into a standout digital presence.

This is an on-site

role. You will be on the ground at weddings and events capturing real-time, behind-the-scenes, and aesthetic content, and at the desk planning calendars, editing Reels, and driving day-to-day social media growth.

  Proactive, organized, and able to stay calm and creative in fast-paced live environments.

  Familiarity with AI tools for ideation/copywriting and basic Meta Ads/boosting.

What We Offer

* Full creative ownership to shape the brand’s voice and visual identity.
* Front-row access to vibrant weddings, destination events, and luxury setups.
* Competitive full-time compensation plus event travel allowances.
* Direct collaboration with the founding and operations teams.

title: Senior Cloud Manager
company: Recruise: Executive Search and Talent Advisory
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**Cloud Strategy Architecture and Execution**

* Define and execute cloud and hybrid infrastructure strategy, including a multi-year roadmap aligned with product needs, customer commitments, risk, capacity, and financial goals.
* Own workload placement and platform decisions across Azure, AWS, and colocation. Evaluate consolidation, managed services, modernization, and retention of existing platforms using explicit business and technical criteria.
* Establish architecture standards for networking, identity, compute, storage, containers, environment separation, tenant isolation, observability, resilience, and lifecycle management.
* Lead delivery of migrations, platform improvements, and infrastructure programs from business case through design, implementation, production acceptance, and verified benefits.
* Own colocation operations, hardware and software lifecycle, capacity, connectivity, facility-provider performance, and phased retirement where justified by the strategy.
* Maintain service and dependency inventories, accountable owners, technical documentation, and decision records across hosting environments.

**Production Operations and Continuous Incident Response**

* Build and lead the Production Operations function with 24x7x365 coverage, backup coverage, shift or on-call schedules, documented handoffs, and tested escalation paths.
* Own the operational response to all SaaS production incidents, including outages, degraded performance, failed transactions or jobs, database issues, and third-party service failures.
* Establish severity definitions, response and escalation expectations, incident command roles, incident records, communication cadence, and criteria for service restoration and incident closure.
* Coordinate Engineering, database specialists, Security, vendors, and customer-facing teams during incidents. Retain incident coordination ownership while the appropriate specialists diagnose and implement fixes.
* Ensure accurate and timely impact assessments and status updates reach internal stakeholders and the teams responsible for customer communications.
* Define service-level indicators and objectives for customer-facing workflows; implement actionable monitoring, alert routing, dashboards, runbooks, and dependency visibility.
* Lead post-incident reviews and problem management. Assign root-cause investigations and corrective actions, verify completion, and reduce recurring incidents and operational toil.
* Set production readiness and change controls covering observability, support documentation, capacity, recovery, maintenance windows, rollback, and emergency changes.

**Database Infrastructure and Operational Processes**

* Own database platform architecture and administration across managed and self-hosted environments, including provisioning, configuration, inventory, ownership, and support lifecycle.
* Establish database availability, replication, failover, backup, retention, point-in-time recovery, and disaster recovery standards aligned with business recovery objectives.
* Verify backups through restore exercises and data validation. Maintain recovery runbooks and measure actual recovery time and recoverable data loss.
* Lead database monitoring, performance diagnosis, capacity forecasting, storage management, maintenance, and job scheduling; partner with Engineering on query, index, and application access improvements.
* Own operational controls for database patching, version upgrades, schema deployments, data changes, and migrations, including approval, testing, compatibility, rollback limits, and validation.
* Manage privileged access, encryption, secrets, audit logging, retention, and secure handling of production data in partnership with Security and accountable data owners.
* Define safe processes for nonproduction data refreshes, masking, reconciliation, and data integrity checks. Ensure database incidents and changes integrate with Production Operations.

**Automation Security and Resilience**

* Establish infrastructure-as-code and reviewed delivery pipelines using Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, or equivalent tools. Standardize reusable patterns, testing, state protection, drift detection, and controlled rollout.
* Automate provisioning, maintenance, monitoring, recovery tasks, and routine operational workflows; provide governed self-service capabilities for Engineering.
* Implement cloud and database security controls with Security leadership, including least privilege, network segmentation, vulnerability remediation, secrets management, audit evidence, and exception tracking.
* Own infrastructure and database disaster recovery planning and exercises. Validate end-to-end SaaS recovery with Engineering and Production Operations, including dependencies, data consistency, and failback.

**Financial Vendor and Program Management**

* Own cloud, colocation, and database infrastructure budgets, forecasts, cost allocation, capacity plans, and optimization initiatives in partnership with Finance.
* Evaluate total cost, including licensing, support, connectivity, data transfer, recovery capacity, and migration costs. Track utilization and service unit costs without compromising agreed reliability or security.
* Manage providers, contracts, renewals, service commitments, support escalation, and vendor performance. Maintain continuity and exit plans for critical services.
* Prioritize operational risk reduction and strategic delivery using explicit outcomes, resource plans, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and executive decisions.

**Leadership and Operating Accountability**

* Build, manage, and develop Cloud Engineering, Production Operations, and database operations capabilities with clear roles, performance expectations, coaching, and succession plans.
* Plan staffing and skills for continuous operations and project execution. Use cross-training, backup coverage, and workload management to reduce single-person dependencies and fatigue.
* Maintain a culture of service ownership, accurate reporting, disciplined change, learning from incidents, and measurable improvement.
* Report service health, material risks, recovery readiness, incident trends, spending, and roadmap execution to the CTO and relevant stakeholders.

**Ownership and Partnerships**

This role is the accountable owner for cloud strategy and execution, production incident operations, and database operations. Software Engineering remains responsible for application design and code fixes and participates in production diagnosis and recovery. Security leads security policy and security incident response; Production Operations coordinates service impact and restoration with Security. Product and customer-facing teams help establish business priorities and communicate with customers. These partnerships do not transfer this role's operational accountability for ensuring incidents are handled and follow-up actions reach closure.

**Measures of Success**

* Achievement of agreed SaaS service objectives, with customer impact and duration of incidents visible and improving.
* Reliable 24x7x365 coverage; timely detection, acknowledgement, escalation, restoration, and stakeholder updates against agreed targets.
* Reduced incident recurrence, actionable alert volume, manual toil, and overdue corrective actions.
* Proven infrastructure and database recovery against agreed recovery time and data loss objectives, supported by restore and failover exercises.
* Stable database performance and capacity; successful maintenance and changes with verified data integrity and recoverability.
* Predictable roadmap delivery and migration outcomes, with production readiness and safe retirement of replaced platforms.
* Improved resource utilization and service unit costs, accurate forecasts, and effective vendor performance.
* Timely remediation of security and lifecycle risks, increased automation, and stronger team capability and succession coverage.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive infrastructure, cloud, platform engineering, or production operations experience; 5+ years leading relevant engineering or operations teams.
* Demonstrated ownership of cloud strategy and execution, with substantial operating experience in both Azure and AWS and in colocation or hybrid environments.
* Experience leading a 24x7 production operations organization supporting customer-facing SaaS, including major incident command, escalation, service restoration, and problem management.
* Experience leading database infrastructure and administration, including performance, availability, backup and restore, recovery testing, upgrades, migrations, and production change controls.
* Strong architecture and troubleshooting skills across networking, identity, compute, storage, containers, observability, and application and database dependencies.
* Practical experience with infrastructure-as-code, automated delivery pipelines, cloud governance, security controls, and operational readiness.
* Demonstrated success delivering cloud transformation and infrastructure modernization while sustaining production service.
* Strong financial, vendor, program, and people management skills, including global collaboration and clear communication during high-impact incidents.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

description:

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and execute end-to-end data migration activities for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Procurement.
* Work with business and functional teams to identify source data, transformation rules, dependencies, and target-system requirements.
* Prepare and maintain data-migration strategies, object lists, mapping documents, conversion specifications, and reconciliation reports.

* Develop and validate Oracle data-load files using tools and methods such as FBDI, ADFdi, spreadsheet loaders, REST APIs, SOAP services, and scheduled processes.

+ Chart of Accounts and other financial reference data

+ Purchase agreements, purchase orders, requisitions, and related open transactions
+ Customers, customer accounts, sites, contacts, and profiles

* Support mock conversions, conference-room pilots, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover rehearsals, and production deployment.
* Maintain migration logs, issue trackers, control totals, exception reports, and sign-off documentation.
* Coordinate with Oracle functional and technical teams to address configuration and integration dependencies.

* Practical knowledge of Oracle Fusion FBDI templates, interface tables, import processes, and error-resolution procedures.
* Good understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials and Procurement data structures and business processes.

* Ability to analyse large data files and identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, or invalid records.
* Working knowledge of SQL and experience preparing data extracts and reconciliation queries.
* Experience working with CSV files, Microsoft Excel, and data-transformation utilities.
* Strong understanding of data dependencies, reference keys, sequencing, and parent-child relationships.
* Ability to prepare technical design documents, mapping documents, load instructions, and reconciliation reports.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work with business users, functional consultants, developers, and project management teams.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple migration objects, and meet project deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Oracle Fusion Cloud certification in Financials, Procurement, or related areas.
* Experience migrating data from Oracle E-Business Suite or other legacy ERP applications.
* Knowledge of BI Publisher, OTBI, Oracle Integration Cloud, REST APIs, and SOAP web services.
* Experience with high-volume data migration and performance optimization.
* Experience supporting multiple mock conversions and production cutovers.
* Familiarity with data governance, audit, security, and handling sensitive financial and supplier information.

* Source-to-target mapping and transformation documents
* Validated data-load files
* Load execution and error-resolution reports
* Source-to-target reconciliation results

description:
**Mott MacDonald**
is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

**brilliant**

**Global Delivery Service Centre at Mott MacDonald**
Global Delivery Services Centre (GDSC) is a high-impact business unit within Mott MacDonald, dedicated to enhancing project delivery across our global operations.
  
  
As part of GDSC, you’ll join a team that champions excellence in both technical and digital disciplines, supporting projects at every stage of the lifecycle—from concept to completion. We work to international design standards and regulations, ensuring our contributions meet the highest benchmarks of quality and innovation.
  
  
At GDSC, you’ll be empowered to collaborate across borders, grow your expertise, and make a meaningful impact on infrastructure and development projects that shape communities worldwide.
  
  
The Business Intelligence Analyst will be based in India and support the West Unit in North America on pursuits and projects. The role will consolidate client, market, competitor, and internal intelligence into practical insights for account plans, capture plans and proposals.
  
  
**Job Responsiblities:**
In this role, you’ll be expected to:
  

* Build detailed client profiles covering leadership, board priorities, capital improvement programs, budgets, and procurement history.
* Track relevant federal, state and local funding sources and monitor procurement portals and agency announcements for upcoming opportunities.
* Research competitors, including recent wins, key staff, and incumbent positions.
* Identify potential teaming partners and Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE) and Small Business Enterprise (SBE) firms.
* Identify relevant Mott MacDonald North America projects, references and staff experience to support pursuits.
* Prepare accurate, ready-to-use project descriptions, evidence and supporting data for proposals.
* Produce concise research briefs ahead of capture, account planning and strategy meetings, clearly explaining the implications for each pursuit.
* Build and maintain Power BI dashboards covering the opportunity pipeline and win/loss performance.
* Maintain accurate and current CRM data and support continuous improvement in data quality.
* Respond to research requests from business development leads and pursuit teams, presenting findings clearly and concisely.
* Communicate confidently with North America teams through Microsoft Teams and written updates in US English.
* Demonstrate an understanding of US business culture, including direct communication, ownership, responsiveness and meeting deadlines.
* Build trust while working remotely and respond flexibly to urgent requests, key deadlines and interview requirements.

**Candidate requirements:**

* Degree in business, economics, data analytics, engineering or related fields.
* 8–10 years of experience in business intelligence, market research, or business development research.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and Power BI skills, with practical CRM experience.
* Strong analytical and research capability, with the ability to turn large volumes of information into clear, actionable insights.
* Curious, resourceful, and detail-oriented, with consistently high quality standards.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and remain calm and organized under tight or changing deadlines.
* Proactive and accountable, with the ability to identify risks early, suggest solutions and follow tasks through to completion.
* Collaborative, adaptable and receptive to feedback.
* Professional and confident when engaging senior stakeholders.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Willingness to work India-based hours with 2–3 hours of daily overlap with US Pacific morning hours, with flexibility around key deadlines and interviews.

**Preferred:**

* Familiarity with US public agencies, infrastructure markets and public-sector procurement.
* Experience conducting research for bids, proposals, capture planning or business development activities.
* Experience supporting teams or clients in North America, particularly the US and Canada.
* Knowledge of public funding sources, procurement portals and agency capital improvement programs.
* Experience researching potential teaming partners, DBE/SBE firms and competitor positioning.
* Curiosity and practical experience using AI-enabled research, analysis or productivity tools.

**Flexible working**
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.
  
  
**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing

**Employment Compliance Requirement**
As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**
By applying, you
**confirm**
that you can provide valid documentation if and when required.

title: Agile-TC-CS-AEET-Manager-ZT
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Cyber Security – Technology Consulting – Infrastructure Security – Zero Trust Security - Manager**
As part of our EY Cyber Security team, you shall be responsible for defining, solutioning, integrating, and implementing innovative solutions which will enhance our service delivery quality, as well as help us strategically elevate technology driven transformation for our clients. You’ll also help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for an Infrastructure Security professional with solution mindset and hands on security engineering expertise in Zero Trust Security, risk and controls concepts, architecture design. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the rollout of next generation market relevant solutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* A Security- Design & Architect professional who is responsible for designing, building, testing and implementing security within an organisation’s IT infrastructure- On Prem & Cloud.
* Professional is expected to have a thorough understanding of complex IT systems and stay up to date with the latest security standards, systems and authentication protocols, as well as best practice security products.
* Identify requirements, design document and implement technical solutions for scalable and resilient network architecture.
* Well versed with Zero Trust use cases , business & technical requirements.
* Experience in Zero Trust Security Architecture and Solution Design.
* Experience in Zero-Trust and micro-segmentation solutions including Guardicore and Illumio.
* Individual should possess experience in planning, design, deployment, configuration, integration and management of network protection controls including Next gen firewalls- Palo Alto, Checkpoint, Fortinet, SDN Security, DDoS Protection, IPS, VPN, Wireless security, NAC and network authentication solutions to protect IT assets and should be responsible for deployment of any changes, plug-ins, or configuration as requested by client.
* Proven expertise in designing and delivering SASE transformations across leading platforms such as Palo Alto, Netskope, Zscaler, and Fortinet, including strategy and assessment, vendor selection, PoC validation, architecture design, and enterprise-scale implementation.
* Plan, design, deploy, configure, integrate, and manage WAF, proxy/Zscaler solutions.
* Possess hands on experience in segmenting networks, applications, and data to limit exposure to attacks.
* Plan, design, deploy, configure, integrate and manage platform protection controls including virtualisation protection solutions on Hypervisors and thin client’s security solutions.
* Good understanding of security concepts and technologies including, but not limited to TCP/IP, LDAP, DHCP, DNS, web filtering etc.
* Should be well-versed with network documentation that includes network drawings, text descriptions and equipment configurations, designing HLDs and LLDs.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Serve as highly technical security expert to bring security transformation to both new and legacy infrastructure.
* Deep technical understanding of architecture and solutioning of infrastructure security components.
* Deep knowledge of services and service delivery approach and methodology for infrastructure security including governance and operating models.
* Proven track record in building and maintaining trusted relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel and flex work timings as and when required.
* Ability to change and adapt in a hyper-growth environment.
* Self-starter and strategic thinker.
* Drive C-suite/senior leadership level meetings and discussion.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and executive presence that enable effective engagement with senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and communicate the technical and security related issues to client/business stakeholders.
* Clearly demonstrates proven extensive abilities with leveraging creative thinking and problem-solving skills, individual initiative, and utilizing Office 365, MS Office (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint) and Google Docs.
* Communicating in an organized and knowledgeable manner in written and verbal formats including delivering clear requests for information and communicating potential conflicts.
* Must communicate consistently and drive objectives, relying on fact-based decisions about risk that optimize the trade-off between risk mitigation and business performance.
* Good presentation, project management, facilitation and delivery skills as well as strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to create domain specific training content and deliver training effectively.
* Develop/Implement automation solutions and capabilities that are clearly aligned to client business, technology and threat posture.
* Demonstrates ability to track developments and changes in the digital business and threat environments to ensure that they're adequately addressed in client’s security strategy plans and architecture artefacts.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 8-12 years of experience in Information Technology experience, with specialization in Cyber Security roles that include multiple areas of specialization. Professional-level knowledge in areas from the following:

+ Zero Trust Security Strategy and Implementation
+ Security Engineering & Architecture assessments
+ Possess understanding in firewalls, VPNs, NAC, SDWAN, WAF, Proxy, EDR/XDR etc.
+ Expert level experience with deployment, maintenance and operations of one or more major network security Devices
+ Cloud Security Architecture
+ Entrepreneurial approach to solving security problems with consultative skills
+ Well versed with Zero Trust use cases , business & technical requirements.
+ Experience in Zero Trust Security Architecture and Solution Design.
+ Experience in Zero-Trust and micro-segmentation solutions including Guardicore and Illumio.
+ Individual should possess experience in planning, design, deployment, configuration, integration and management of network protection controls including Next gen firewalls- Palo Alto, Checkpoint, Fortinet, SDN Security, DDoS Protection, IPS, VPN, Wireless security, NAC and network authentication solutions to protect IT assets and should be responsible for deployment of any changes, plug-ins, or configuration as requested by client.
+ Proven expertise in designing and delivering SASE transformations across leading platforms such as Palo Alto, Netskope, Zscaler, and Fortinet, including strategy and assessment, vendor selection, PoC validation, architecture design, and enterprise-scale implementation.
+ Plan, design, deploy, configure, integrate, and manage WAF, proxy/Zscaler solutions.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good soft skills i.e. verbal & written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF, Zscaler)

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Software Engineer III Aws Aurora PostgreSQL DB
description:
**Job Description**
We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
  
  
As a Cloud Database Administrator at JPMorgan Chase within Consumer & Community Banking Technology, you will support the administration, engineering, and operational stability of cloud database platforms. You will help design, implement, monitor, and optimize highly available database environments across technologies including Cassandra, CockroachDB, Oracle, Aurora PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB. You will partner with application teams, architects, information architects, and database designers to deliver secure, resilient, and scalable database solutions that meet service level agreements, reduce operational risk, and improve customer experience.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Administer highly available and scalable cloud database environments across Cassandra, CockroachDB, Oracle, Aurora PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB.
* Design database solutions that support application resiliency, performance, security, and operational stability requirements.
* Implement physical data models, database designs, data access patterns, and table maintenance routines aligned to application needs.
* Maintain high availability capabilities through data partitioning, replication, backup, recovery, and failover practices.
* Resolve database performance, capacity, replication, and data integrity issues through structured troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
* Monitor database health, service levels, alerts, and operational trends to identify risks before they impact production stability.
* Optimize database performance using tuning practices, monitoring insights, automation opportunities, and capacity management techniques.
* Execute database upgrades, migrations, patching, and configuration changes with disciplined change management and risk controls.
* Collaborate with application architects, information architects, database designers, and engineering teams to select and implement fit-for-purpose database platforms.
* Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification in database administration, database engineering, software engineering, or related technical discipline and 3+ years of applied experience.
* Hands-on experience administering, supporting, or engineering databases in a large-scale corporate or production environment.
* Practical experience with one or more cloud database technologies, including Cassandra, CockroachDB, Oracle, Aurora PostgreSQL, or DynamoDB.
* Working knowledge of AWS services, cloud infrastructure concepts, and database deployment patterns in resilient production environments.
* Experience with database performance factors, monitoring tools, tuning practices, backup procedures, and recovery approaches.
* Understanding of fault detection, incident response, root cause analysis, and production issue resolution processes.
* Experience implementing or supporting high availability features, including replication, partitioning, failover, and disaster recovery practices.
* Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
* Knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle and agile delivery practices, including change management, operational readiness, and release controls.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence technical stakeholders and explain database risks, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Java, Spring Boot, Python, or related programming and scripting languages.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, Spinnaker, or comparable enterprise deployment platforms.
* Exposure to automation patterns that improve database operations, self-service, monitoring, and incident resolution.
* Experience supporting credit card, banking, payments, or other high-volume financial services applications.
* Ability to translate operational trends into recommendations that improve resiliency, performance, and customer experience.
* Demonstrated interest in continuous learning, technical mentoring, and building strong engineering practices across teams.

The

The role leads secure, scalable integration design on SAP Business Technology Platform, with particular focus on SAP S/4HANA, SAP Document and Reporting Compliance, business applications, external partners, and government e-invoicing platforms.
  
  
This position reports to the IT Director, Enterprise Applications and is part of the global Information Technology team. The role is based in India, and will operate in a onsite work model, subject to local site requirements.
  
  
**In this role you will have the opportunity to**

* Define and maintain the enterprise integration strategy and architecture, including standards, principles, reusable patterns, and governance using SAP Integration Suite and SAP best practices.
* Lead end-to-end integration architecture and solution design across SAP Integration Suite capabilities, selecting the appropriate API, event-driven, synchronous, asynchronous, batch, file, and B2B/EDI approaches based on business needs.

* Enable AI-assisted and emerging technology solutions, including Joule and Joule Studio, by providing secure APIs, events, business context, appropriate controls, observability, and human oversight.
* Ensure integration reliability, compliance, and modernization, including monitoring, error handling, performance, service levels, clean-core alignment, regulatory requirements, global e-invoicing, and migration of legacy interfaces such as SAP PI/PO.
* Provide technical leadership and oversight, including architecture reviews, design documentation, technical risk assessments, partner deliverables, developer/consultant mentoring, complex issue resolution, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.

**The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* 10+ years of SAP architecture experience, including at least 5 years delivering solutions on SAP BTP, with hands-on experience with Joule.
* Demonstrated leadership of complex SAP transformation programs, including at least three end-to-end SAP BTP integration implementations or comparable enterprise initiatives.
* Deep expertise in SAP Integration Suite and BTP architecture, including Cloud Integration, API Management, event-driven integration, hybrid connectivity, identity services, environments and runtimes, monitoring, CI/CD, and secure operations.
* Strong SAP and enterprise integration expertise, including integration of SAP S/4HANA with SAP and non-SAP platforms using REST, SOAP, OData, IDoc, RFC, SFTP, messaging technologies, XML, JSON, XSLT, and Groovy.
* Experience designing secure, reliable, and AI-enabled enterprise integrations, including Joule/AI agents, API and tool access, authorization, auditability, OAuth 2.0, SAML, certificates, mutual TLS, exception handling, performance, availability, and responsible AI controls.
* Strong technical leadership and communication skills, with the ability to translate business, technical, security, and compliance requirements into architecture decisions and lead internal teams and external partners through design, build, testing, deployment, hyper care, and operational transition.

**Travel**

* Up to 20 percent travel, including international travel, based on project and deployment needs.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in**

* SAP Integration Advisor, Trading Partner Management, Advanced Event Mesh, SAP Cloud ALM, or comparable observability and service-management tooling.
* Current SAP certification in Integration Suite, BTP solution architecture, or a closely related discipline.

title: GM - Facility Management
description:
Back To Home Page

**GM - Facility Management**
============================

Date: 27 Nov 2026

Location:
Mumbai\_HO, Mumbai\_HO, IN

Company: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Ltd.

**Job Purpose**
---------------

**Role Purpose**

The General Manager – Facility Management will lead the end-to-end facility management function across Mahindra Lifespaces' operational residential communities, ensuring operational excellence, customer satisfaction, financial discipline, statutory compliance, and seamless stakeholder management. The role will be responsible for preserving asset value, driving superior living experiences, managing community governance, and ensuring efficient transition of projects from construction to long-term operations.

**Principal Accountabilities**
------------------------------

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operations, Compliance & Asset Management**

* Establish FM governance frameworks, SOPs, and service standards across projects.
* Ensure statutory, safety, environmental, and process compliance in line with company and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee operation, maintenance, and lifecycle management of all MEP and infrastructure assets, including electrical systems, DG sets, fire & life safety systems, lifts, HVAC, STP/WTP, water networks, and common amenities.
* Drive preventive and predictive maintenance programs to maximize asset uptime and reliability.
* Lead safety audits, emergency preparedness, risk mitigation, and business continuity initiatives.

**Financial & CAM Management**

* Own annual operating plans (AOPs), facility budgets, and cost management initiatives.
* Ensure timely CAM budgeting, billing, collection, reconciliation, and financial reporting.
* Monitor receivables, collection efficiency, operational expenditures, and utility costs.
* Drive cost optimization, energy efficiency, and sustainable resource management without compromising service quality.

**Customer Experience & Service Management**

* Drive customer-centric facility operations across all managed communities.
* Govern service request management, ensuring adherence to defined TATs, quality standards, and escalation protocols.
* Monitor complaint volumes, ageing, closure effectiveness, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* Resolve critical customer escalations through effective cross-functional coordination.
* Lead resident engagement programs and initiatives to enhance community experience.

**Society & Stakeholder Management**

* Manage relationships with Resident Welfare Associations, Co-operative Housing Societies, Apartment Associations, and governing committees.
* Support society formation, governance stabilization, and operational readiness.
* Facilitate smooth handover of facilities operations, common assets, contracts, documentation, and CAM-related financials to society governing bodies.
* Act as the primary interface between MLDL and community stakeholders on operational and service-related matters.

**Project Handover & DLP Management**

* Work closely with Projects, Construction, Quality, and Customer Experience teams during project handover.
* Drive snagging and de-snagging closure to ensure operational readiness of common areas and infrastructure.
* Monitor closure of Defect Liability Period (DLP) complaints and unresolved project-related issues.
* Ensure structured transition of all MEP assets, systems, contracts, and documentation from project teams to Facility Management operations.

**Performance Measure of Success**
----------------------------------

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT/NPS)
* Service Request TAT and Escalation Closure
* CAM Billing, Collection Efficiency & Receivables
* Budget Adherence & Cost Optimization
* Asset Uptime & Preventive Maintenance Compliance
* Statutory and Safety Compliance Scores
* Snagging/DLP Closure Performance
* Society Handover Milestones
* Team Performance & Capability Development

**Key Relationships**
---------------------

**Qualification and Experience**
--------------------------------

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, or Civil); MBA/PGDM preferred.
* Certifications in Facility Management, EHS, Asset Management, or Property Management would be advantageous.
* 18-25 years of experience in Facility Management, Property Management, Real Estate Operations, or Integrated Facilities Management.
* Proven leadership experience managing large residential townships, integrated developments, mixed-use communities, or commercial assets.

Strong expertise in facilities operations, CAM management, customer engagement, compliance, society management, and project handovers

title: Azure Public Tier Developer
description:
**What You Will Do:**

• Build the publish job. Normal changes go out once an hour. A revoke, a suspension, or a lapsed approval goes out within 5 minutes.

• Copy only the fields the public is allowed to see. Stop the copy if an unknown field appears. Hide part of the first name before the row is saved. Never write back to Dataverse.

• Design the Azure SQL tables and indexes for a last-name search and for browsing by course and country.

• Build the API in API Management. The ABS website calls it with no key. Other companies get a free key that ABS can switch off.

• Build these calls: verify a certificate, list courses, list providers for a course, and list providers.

• Clean last names the same way on save and on search, then match them exactly. Return three different answers, and use the same failure text when the name is wrong or the number is unknown.

• Build the public website for the check and the course-first directory, including a maintenance page and a switch that can hide the public data without a new release.

• Work with security so names with apostrophes, hyphens, and accents are not blocked by the firewall.

**Education & Experience:**

• 5 to 8 years of software development, with hands-on Azure and a JavaScript front end.

• BE/BTech degree in a technical field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Certifications:**

• AZ-204, Azure Developer Associate.

**Good to Have:**

• AZ-700, Azure Network Engineer.

• AZ-500, Azure Security Engineer.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:**

**Must Have:**

• Azure Functions, including a private network path back only to the services this API is allowed to call.

• Azure API Management (APIM): products, keys, quotas, policies, and OpenAPI.

• REST API design. The public API must not return a list of people.

• Azure SQL: table design, T-SQL, and indexes.

• Azure Key Vault and managed identity. No secrets in config files.

• Azure Virtual Network, private endpoints, and VNet peering.

• A JavaScript front end on Azure Static Web Apps or Azure App Service.

• Application integration between the public API and the read-only SQL database.

• Azure Logic Apps where a publish or notification step is a workflow rather than code.

**Good to Have:**

• Azure Front Door, WAF, and bot protection.

• Rate limiting.

• Unicode and international name handling, including accents and double-barrel surnames.

• WCAG accessibility.

• Microsoft Entra ID.

• Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.

**Notice Period:**
Immediate to 15 days

**Cloud Architecture & Engineering**

* Design and implement scalable cloud landing zone solutions of moderate complexity on GCP or Azure, following the established architectural framework.
* Independently deploy and manage applications on cloud platforms.
* Assess the impact of changes on existing cloud solutions before implementation.
* Collaborate with the existing Cloud Infrastructure Team and cross-functional teams to ensure effective cloud integration.

**Security, Reliability & Cost Optimization**

* Manage and improve the security, reliability and cost-effectiveness of cloud infrastructure.
* Continuously monitor and optimise cloud resources to improve efficiency and performance.
* Develop and implement security measures to protect data and applications.
* Support cloud governance, security and operational best practices.

**Automation & Operations**

* Implement automation strategies using tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
* Diagnose and resolve cloud environment issues of moderate complexity.
* Support the ongoing operation, maintenance and improvement of cloud platforms.

**Collaboration & Documentation**

* Document technical concepts clearly to support understanding among team members and stakeholders.
* Partner with engineering, infrastructure and platform teams to support cloud adoption and operational excellence.
* Contribute to team knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives.

**YOUR TALENT:**

* 4-8 years of experience in Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering or DevOps roles.
* Hands-on cloud engineering experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and/or Microsoft Azure.
* Understanding of cloud-native architecture principles, including containerisation (Kubernetes, Docker) and microservices.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation tools such as Terraform or Ansible for provisioning and configuration management.
* Knowledge of cloud security practices, identity and access management, and data protection standards.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices for continuous delivery and automated testing.
* Monitoring and observability skills using Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, Coralogix, Datadog, or equivalent tools relevant to your cloud platform.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**About the role**

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of Prism products and supporting infrastructure in Azure. This is a hands-on role where you’ll design and optimize platform services, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment processes for enterprise-grade applications.

This person should be a can-do, high-achieving individual with strong product and domain expertise, who thrives on collaboration and has experience building secure, resilient cloud infrastructure. You’ll champion engineering excellence and automation, foster best practices, and bring a genuine passion for technology and continuous improvement to everything you do.

**Location:**
Pune, India.

*Permanent, Hybrid working model.*

**Your responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain Azure infrastructure using the appropriate tooling required.
* Design and configure CI/CD pipelines, containers, virtual networks, and monitoring dashboards.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for multi-tenant setups in Azure.
* Optimize performance and cost of Azure resources.
* Apply governance policies (Azure AD, security, networking).
* Collaborate with development, QA, and Product teams to ensure quality and timely delivery.
* Contribute to evolving scalable, secure, observable architectures (APIs, microservices, event-driven).
* Embed DevSecOps and SRE principles into platform engineering practices (SLOs, error budgets, incident management).
* Drive continuous improvement using metrics-led approaches (e.g., DORA).

**Competencies**

* Demonstrated leadership ability, team management, and interpersonal skills.
* Change leadership—drives adoption of new ways of working, collaboration, continuous improvement with high levels of trust and autonomy.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills, including the capability and gravitas to operate execs, engineers, and regulators/auditors.
* Client/Customer-centric mindset; measurable impact on revenue, activation, retention, and costtoserve.-centric mindset; measurable impact on revenue, activation, retention, and cost-to-serve.
* Ability to create a positive and collaborative climate in which people want to do their best by providing appropriate challenge, support and direction.

**Your skills**

* 8+ years of experience in delivering fast paced and agile system Engineering ideally in regulated FinTech or payments/banking/wealth.
* Mentored engineering teams of 10+ across multiple parallel product lines, guiding developers working within microservices architectures and Cloud‑native environments (AWS/Azure/GCP).
* Engineering excellence leader with deep SDLC mastery with a pragmatic implementation approach to architecture, platform and tooling.
* Embedded DevSecOps and automated policy and quality controls in delivery pipelines, ideally with Azure DevOps.
* Extensive change management experience and evidential metrics-based delivery capability.
* Standardised logging/metrics/tracing (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana); built comprehensive dashboards and runbooks.
* Owned Service reliability: SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, chaos experiments, game days, incident command.

**Nice to haves-to-Haves**

* Mortgage origination and servicing, Payments, core banking, or lending domain expertise.
* Production experience with Kubernetes, IaC (Terraform), service meshes, and GitOps (Argo CD/Flux).
* Navigated PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR; partnered with Risk/Compliance and auditors and delivered audit-ready evidence.
* Privacy engineering (GDPR, data residency)
* Experience leading across multiple geographies/time zones.

**Success Metrics (what you will be measured on)**

* DORA: Lead time, Deployment frequency, Change failure rate, MTTR.
* Reliability: SLO attainment (%), incident rate and severity mix, mean time to detect (MTTD).
* Quality: Escaped defects, defect density, automated test coverage, flaky test rate.
* Security/Compliance: Vulnerability SLA adherence, audit/control pass rate.
* Delivery & Product: Roadmap predictability, value throughput (e.g., OKR progress), time-to-market.
* People & Culture: eNPS, attrition of regrettable talent, internal mobility, DEI indicators.
* Cost & Efficiency: Cloud unit economics, cost-to-serve, build time, onboarding time to first PR.

**Pepper Advantage’s values and culture**

Our mission is to help people succeed. Our clients, our customers, our employees. Our Values are ‘Can do’, ‘Balanced’ and ‘Real’.

Pepper Advantage’s values support our vision, shape our culture and define how we interact with other employees and the attitudes we adopt towards our customers and clients. The values of Pepper Advantage support the organisation’s mission statement.

Pepper Advantage’s unique outcome focused corporate culture aims to deliver fairness and value for clients and customers, consistently exceeding expectations in all measurable performance areas.

*Pepper Advantage is an equal opportunities employer.*

*Role profiles are subject to change in line with business needs.*
