title: Full Stack Angular UI Developer
description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

The Digital Software Engineer Intm Analyst is a seasoned professional role. This individual will apply in-depth disciplinary knowledge of modern web technologies to contribute to the development of new user-facing features, the optimization of frontend architectures, and the improvement of development workflows.

The ideal candidate is a highly skilled, full-stack-capable UI Developer with deep expertise in **Angular** and **Node.js**. You will integrate subject matter and industry expertise to design, build, and maintain robust, scalable, and accessible digital applications. This role requires an in-depth understanding of how frontend applications integrate with backend microservices, as well as how engineering teams coordinate to achieve overall business objectives.

You will evaluate moderately complex and variable technical challenges, weigh architectural alternatives, and balance performance, security, and usability requirements. Strong analytical, communication, and diplomacy skills are required to collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor junior developers, and influence technical decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**1. Application Design & Development**
---------------------------------------

* **Feature Delivery:** Accountable for executing and driving mid-to-large-scale UI feature design and development efforts to completion, serving as a technical lead on medium-scale projects and supporting the execution of larger digital initiatives.
* **Technical Autonomy:** Operate with considerable autonomy and discretion to significantly influence application design, component architecture, and state management strategies by providing subject-specific expertise in Angular, React, and Node.js.
* **Code Quality:** Turn complex application designs and UX wireframes into clean, well-structured, reusable, and highly performant code adhering to modern software engineering principles.
* **Standards & Blueprints:** Assist with the development of enterprise standards for coding, testing, debugging, and implementation, ensuring that frontend designs adhere to the overall digital architecture blueprint and design systems.

**2. Troubleshooting & Performance Optimization**
-------------------------------------------------

* **Problem Solving:** Act as a key resource for analyzing, troubleshooting, and resolving complex coding, application performance, and design challenges across the frontend and Node.js BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) layers.
* **Root Cause Analysis:** Conduct deep-dive research into the root causes of development bottlenecks, rendering issues, memory leaks, and API latency, and drive the resolution of defects.
* **System Dependencies:** Maintain a comprehensive understanding of runtime properties, build dependencies, and environmental configurations (e.g., Webpack/Vite configurations, Node.js runtime, containerization, and upstream/downstream API integrations).

**3. Technical Leadership & Collaboration**
-------------------------------------------

* **Design Leadership:** Participate in and lead technical design discussions, playing a key role in driving architectural decisions based on your deep knowledge of the codebase, industry trends, and team capabilities.
* **Vendor & Partner Integration:** Partner with industry vendors and internal UX design teams to implement digital design systems, evaluate third-party components, and align implementation roadmaps to increase development velocity.
* **SDLC Lifecycle:** Participate in the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), identifying dependencies between Agile and Waterfall delivery models, executing comprehensive test plans, and ensuring rigorous software quality standards.
* **Knowledge Sharing:** Proactively share knowledge with the team through engineering forums, brown bags, and technical documentation, demonstrating a commitment to continuous learning and industry certifications.

**4. Risk, Compliance & Governance**
------------------------------------

* **Risk Assessment:** Appropriately assess risk when technical and business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding assets by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations.
* **Secure Coding:** Adhere to secure coding practices (e.g., OWASP Top 10, prevention of XSS, CSRF, and SQL injection) and ensure robust authentication/authorization flows (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT) are implemented across UI and Node.js layers.
* **Process Optimization:** Continuously assess development processes, test automation, and deployment pipelines to streamline or eliminate redundant processes across the build, delivery, and production environments.

**Technical Skills & Competencies**
-----------------------------------

**Required Technical Expertise:**
---------------------------------

* **Frontend Frameworks:** Proficient in **Angular** (latest versions, RxJS, NgRx/State Management)
* **Backend-for-Frontend (BFF):** Strong experience building scalable APIs, middleware, and orchestration layers using **Node.js** (Express.js, NestJS, or Fastify).
* **Core Web Technologies:** Advanced knowledge of HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, TypeScript, and modern CSS frameworks (e.g., Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap).
* **Data Structures & Algorithms:** Proficient in client-side information modeling, state normalization, data structures, and efficient algorithms for data manipulation.
* **API Integration:** Deep understanding of RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and asynchronous message patterns.
* **Testing Frameworks:** Experience writing robust unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using Jest, Jasmine, and Cypress.
* **Build & CI/CD Tools:** Familiarity with modern bundlers (Webpack, Vite, Rollup), package managers (npm, yarn, pnpm), and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Tekton, Harness, Git).

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have:**
-----------------------------

* Experience with **Micro-frontend** architectures and Monorepo management tools (e.g., Nx, Lerna).
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift).
* Understanding of web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and semantic HTML.
* Cloud platform knowledge

**Recommended Qualifications**
------------------------------

* **Experience:** 5–8 years of professional experience in a product development or software engineering environment, with a strong track record of delivering high-quality web applications.
* **Agile Delivery:** Proven experience delivering software within an Agile/Scrum methodology.
* **Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to assume informal or formal leadership roles within engineering teams, including coaching and mentoring junior developers.
* **Soft Skills:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and diplomatically resolve discordant views.
* **Adaptability:** Experience in driving technical and cultural change within engineering teams (e.g., adopting new frameworks, improving test coverage, or automating processes).

**Analyst Engineer – Supervising Associate**
Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 300,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world-class technology infrastructure.
  
  
Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**The opportunity**
This role is responsible for delivering IT products to schedule, budget and quality. The role must have adequate technical skills to successfully deliver quality code in a teaming environment.

The candidate will be expected to deliver quality, robust code which performs well and has the ability to scale as needed.

* IT background with experience across the development life cycle using Agile methodology

* Azure (azure dev ops environment)

The candidate should be a self-starter with the ability to work independently as well as in a team environment. The candidate should have effective communication skills where ideas are presented in a clear, concise manner. The candidate should have good analytical and problem- solving skills to manage multiple factors on a project simultaneously. The role requires the ability to multi-task using Agile Methodology.
  
  
**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive reeration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Experience implementing enterprise metadata, lineage, and semantic-governance frameworks.

title: Web Developer
description:
**Summary**
We are seeking a Senior Ansible Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team and serve as the subject matter expert for enterprise Ansible automation. The role involves designing scalable automation frameworks, establishing Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) standards, mentoring engineers, and reducing manual operational effort across large-scale, multi-environment infrastructure.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
Automation Architecture & Development
  
  
Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade Ansible playbooks, roles, collections, and inventories across development, staging, and production environments.
  
  
Build reusable, modular Ansible roles following Galaxy standards and organizational best practices.
  
  
Develop and maintain Ansible Collections for internal distribution.
  
  
Create custom Ansible modules and plugins in Python, including action, callback, connection, and lookup plugins.
  
  
Implement reliable, idempotent, and fault-tolerant automation for OS hardening, application deployment, configuration management, and cloud provisioning.
  
  
CI/CD & Automation Platform
  
  
Integrate Ansible with Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps pipelines.
  
  
Implement automated testing using Molecule, Testinfra, and pytest.
  
  
Administer Ansible Automation Platform (AAP)/AWX, including organizations, inventories, credentials, projects, templates, and workflows.
  
  
Follow GitOps practices and manage automation code using Git.
  
  
Define Ansible coding standards, ansible-lint rules, code-review practices, and development guidelines.
  
  
Infrastructure & Cloud Automation
  
  
Automate AWS, Microsoft Azure, and GCP environments using Ansible cloud modules and dynamic inventories.
  
  
Integrate Ansible with Terraform for hybrid IaC workflows covering provisioning and configuration management.
  
  
Automate infrastructure patching, compliance enforcement, configuration management, and drift remediation at scale.
  
  
Security & Compliance
  
  
Manage secrets using Ansible Vault and integrate with enterprise secret-management platforms.
  
  
Automate CIS Benchmark and STIG-based system hardening and compliance.
  
  
Review existing automation for security risks, including hardcoded credentials, insecure configurations, and unnecessary privilege escalation.
  
  
**Required Technical Skills**
Strong hands-on experience with Ansible Automation Platform (AAP) or AWX administration.
  
  
Expert understanding of Ansible architecture, including control/managed nodes, static and dynamic inventories, facts, SSH, WinRM, and network CLI connections.
  
  
Advanced knowledge of playbook constructs including handlers, loops, conditionals, blocks, tags, delegation, error handling, failed\_when, rescue, and related features.
  
  
Advanced Jinja2 templating, filters, tests, custom filters, and complex data transformations.
  
  
Strong Python skills for scripting and custom Ansible module development.
  
  
Deep understanding of Ansible roles, including defaults, vars, metadata dependencies, include\_role, and import\_role.
  
  
Experience developing and publishing Ansible Collections through Galaxy or private Automation Hub.
  
  
Knowledge of Ansible performance tuning through ansible.cfg, including forks, pipelining, SSH multiplexing, and callback plugins.
  
  
Linux administration experience across RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu, including networking, systemd, and package management.
  
  
Experience with Git workflows, branching, pull requests, and tagging.
  
  
Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and Ansible Kubernetes modules.
  
  
Experience with Ansible Vault and enterprise secrets-management solutions.
  
  
Event-Driven Ansible (EDA), AWX, and Receptor experience is advantageous.
  
  
Leadership & Governance
  
  
Conduct Ansible code reviews and mentor junior and mid-level engineers.
  
  
Establish and enforce automation architecture, coding, testing, and review standards.
  
  
Create architecture documentation, operational runbooks, and onboarding guides.
  
  
Evaluate and recommend tools and technologies within the Ansible ecosystem.

title: Full Stack Engineer, Aladdin Data, Vice President.
description:
Locations: **Gurgaon, India**

  

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

**Full Stack Engineer, Aladdin Data, Vice President**
-----------------------------------------------------

  
  

**Your team**
-------------

The Product Master team within Aladdin Data, BlackRock Data Office (BDO), is building a strategic enterprise platform to centrally manage BlackRock’s investment products across their lifecycle. The platform aims to establish a trusted, governed, and scalable Product Book of Records (PBOR), providing a consistent source of investment product information across BlackRock.

The team develops capabilities spanning product master data and hierarchies, share classes, product onboarding and approvals, product-to-portfolio relationships, integration with Aladdin and downstream consumers, data governance, auditability, and platform modernization. We partner with product management, business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable solutions.

  
  

**Your role and impact**
------------------------

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for the Product Master team, designing and developing modern enterprise applications that combine robust Java backend services with intuitive, scalable Angular interfaces for managing investment products throughout their lifecycle.

You will help shape architecture and implementation across user interfaces, application programming interfaces (APIs), services, and database layers while remaining actively involved in coding and end-to-end technical delivery.

  
  

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

* Provide hands-on technical leadership across Product Master, defining full-stack architecture and mentoring engineers while owning delivery through production.
* Design and develop scalable full-stack applications using Java 17+, Spring Boot, Angular and TypeScript, including Representational State Transfer (REST) APIs, microservices and backend integrations.
* Build responsive, reusable and accessible Angular experiences, applying effective component architecture, state management, routing and performance optimization.
* Implement complex investment-product workflows and data-driven experiences with secure, efficient integration across frontend and backend services.
* Design and optimize Structured Query Language (SQL) queries, database interactions and application data models supporting Product Master capabilities.
* Establish engineering standards across code quality, automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), security and observability, and troubleshoot issues across the application stack.
* Explore artificial intelligence (AI) and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) capabilities that enhance user experiences and engineering workflows.
  

  

**Your experience**
-------------------

* Strong hands-on experience with Java 17+, Spring, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems and enterprise integration patterns.
* Strong experience with Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS, including components, services, routing, reactive forms, RxJS and reusable user-interface development.
* Experience developing and maintaining enterprise frontend applications with an understanding of accessibility, responsive design, browser compatibility, performance and frontend state management.
* Experience with secure API integration, authentication and authorization, along with strong SQL, relational database and application data-modeling skills.
* Experience with automated backend and frontend testing, Git, CI/CD, automated deployment, debugging and production troubleshooting.
* Demonstrated ability to independently design and deliver complex full-stack capabilities while providing technical guidance and mentoring engineers.
* Exposure to cloud-native architectures, distributed event streaming and messaging platforms, modern data platforms, application modernization, AI and GenAI solutions; experience with financial services or governed investment-product data is beneficial.

**Our benefits**
  
  
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

  

**About BlackRock**

  
  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  
  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  
  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Full Stack Developer (C# / .NET / Angular / Azure)
description:
**About Ace Rooms Ltd**

Ace Rooms Ltd is a UK-based B2B travel technology company with over 16 years of experience in global hotel and transfer distribution. Our platform enables travel agents and API partners to search live inventory, book hotels and transfers, and manage payments. We are currently undergoing a full greenfield platform rebuild on Microsoft Azure, migrating from a legacy monolith to a modern, service-based architecture.

**Role Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer to join our core in-house engineering team in Kolkata and contribute to the ground-up rebuild of our hotel-distribution platform. Working across both the .NET back end and Angular front end on Microsoft Azure, you will build end-to-end features, RESTful APIs, and responsive user interfaces while collaborating closely with our backend, frontend, and QA engineers to ensure shared technical ownership across the stack.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end features using C# / .NET (ASP.NET Core) on the back end and Angular (TypeScript) on the front end.
* Build, consume, and version RESTful APIs connecting our Angular single-page application (SPA) and third-party travel partner integrations.
* Develop responsive, high-performance UI components in Angular for hotel/transfer search, live pricing, and booking workflows.
* Implement and manage Azure SQL database schemas; write efficient, optimised T-SQL and Entity Framework Core queries.
* Work with Redis caching, Azure Service Bus, and Azure API Management (APIM) to support high-speed availability searches and asynchronous booking events.
* Implement server-side payment validation, booking lifecycle management, and idempotency controls.
* Manage application secrets via Azure Key Vault and follow strict secure-coding standards (parameterised queries, input validation, and OWASP best practices).
* Maintain GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, participate in peer Pull Request (PR) code reviews across both front end and back end, and maintain clear technical documentation.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* **Back End:** Solid commercial experience building back-end services with C#, .NET (ASP.NET Core), and Entity Framework Core.
* **Front End:** Strong commercial experience building modern, responsive web applications with Angular (TypeScript, RxJS, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS).
* **Databases:** Azure SQL / SQL Server schema design and T-SQL query optimisation.
* **Microsoft Azure:** Hands-on experience with Azure App Service, Redis Cache, Service Bus, Key Vault, and APIM.
* **APIs & Data Exchange:** Designing RESTful APIs and handling high-volume JSON/XML payloads for supplier and partner integrations.
* **CI/CD & Git:** Experience with GitHub Actions pipelines, feature-branch workflows, and Pull Request code reviews.
* **Security & Quality:** Awareness of secure coding standards, secrets management, and unit/integration testing.
* **Communication:** Clear written and spoken English with the ability to collaborate directly with UK leadership and document technical decisions concisely.

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience in travel technology (bed banks, hotel/transfer APIs, channel managers, or GDS connectivity).
* Familiarity with .NET 8/9/10 and recent versions of Angular (v17+).
* Familiarity with Azure AD B2C or Microsoft Entra for authentication and authorisation.
* Understanding of high-concurrency booking platforms (caching strategies, idempotency, and ledger integrity).

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent commercial experience).
* Minimum 4–5 years of commercial full-stack software development experience with .NET and Angular.

**What We Offer**

* **Greenfield Platform Rebuild:** Direct influence on architecture, UI/UX, and engineering standards from the ground up.
* **Stability & Direct UK Collaboration:** Full-time, permanent role with an established, profitable UK travel-technology company (16+ years in operation).
* **Work Schedule:** Monday to Friday, 12:00 Noon – 9:00 PM IST (overlapping with UK business hours).
* **Compensation & Benefits:** Competitive salary negotiable based on experience, plus Provident Fund.

### **Company Overview**

Please visit our company website for more information

* AI: Identify useful HCM use cases; assess feasibility, data access, human oversight and output validation.
* Presales: Lead discovery, shape solution scope, explain assumptions and exclusions, contribute estimates and deliver business-focused demonstrations.
* Leadership: Mentor consultants, review deliverables, resolve design disagreements and communicate risks with clear recommendations.

title: WeRize - Senior Software Engineer - Backend
description:
**About The Job**
**About WeRize:**
Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India's largest full stack fintech platform for 500 million underserved middle-class customers who live in 5000+ small towns of India.
  
  
WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd).
  
  
This customer segment is not served by private sector banks, Insurers and Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks.
  
  
PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property, health and life insurance and investment products.
  
  
WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans, savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit.
  
  
While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need proper guidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves.
  
  
So, a pure digital model doesn't work for this segment.
  
  
WeRize has innovated on this front through its 'Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)', a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support.
  
  
These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions.
  
  
Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on-the-ground financial services providers.
  
  
Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when compared to upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn't work for this segment.
  
  
While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city.
  
  
That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies.
  
  
WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet-on-street team of its own.
  
  
This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.
  
  
To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com
  
  
**Role Description**
As an Backend Engineer, you'll play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable backend systems.
  
  
You'll collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other engineering teams to deliver features and enhancements that meet business and user needs with high quality.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and deploy scalable backend services, APIs, and microservices.
* Write clean, modular, and maintainable code with a focus on performance and reliability.
* Own end-to-end feature development from technical design to deployment.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and architecture planning.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize backend performance in production environments.
* Contribute to improving engineering practices, automation, and CI/CD processes.

**Attributes We Are Looking For**

* 3 - 6 years of hands-on experience in backend development.
* Proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, or similar backend frameworks.
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.
* Experience working with RESTful APIs, SQL/NoSQL databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
* Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced, agile environment.
* Startup or fintech experience is highly desirable.

**About The Team**

If frontend hasn’t been your main thing, that gap is far smaller than it used to be.
  
  
What we can’t teach is taste: the sense of what a good interface feels like, and the instinct to notice when something is confusing, slow or ugly before a user has to tell you.
  
  
Everyone here writes code with LLMs — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, whatever works, on the paid tier, and we don’t count tokens. Producing code is cheap now, so what we hire for is judgment, verification, specification and taste. One hard rule: you own every line you ship, whether you typed it or not. “The model wrote it” is not an explanation in code review, in a postmortem, or in a design discussion.
  
  
**About The Role**
Join us in building technology for the next generation of retail commerce. You will work on real-world product and platform problems, partnering closely with product, business, and operations teams.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own backend features and systems end-to-end, from understanding the problem to production.
* Build reliable and scalable services, APIs, and data flows.
* Make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, simplicity, scalability, and maintainability.
* Debug production issues and improve system reliability.
* Use AI tools to accelerate development while reviewing and validating the output.
* Work effectively in an environment with ambiguity and changing requirements.

**What We're Looking For**

* 4 -6 years of relevant backend engineering experience.
* Strong programming fundamentals and hands-on experience with Go or JavaScript
* Experience building production backend services, APIs, and data-intensive applications.
* Strong understanding of databases, distributed systems, system design, and backend fundamentals.
* Good problem-solving, debugging, and ownership skills.
* Ability to understand product and business context, not just technical requirements.
* Experience using AI coding tools with the ability to critically evaluate their output

**Description**
You'll work on one of the world's largest transactional distributed systems, solving complex tax calculation challenges that impact millions of customers globally. Join a team building mission-critical services that process millions of requests per minute while maintaining accuracy and compliance across constantly evolving global tax regulations.
  
  
Imagine building systems that power tax calculations for every Amazon transaction worldwide—from physical goods to digital services. In this role, you'll tackle the intricate challenge of computing correct tax amounts thousands of times per second while ensuring audit compliance across dozens of countries. You'll collaborate with peers across Amazon's business to design and operate highly scalable, reliable systems that handle hundreds of millions of records. Whether you're drawn to solving complex distributed systems problems or using technology to address real business challenges, this is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on a platform that touches billions of transactions annually.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and implement scalable software solutions that calculate taxes accurately and efficiently across Amazon's global operations, handling millions of service requests per minute
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions that meet tax compliance standards worldwide
* Develop, test, and deploy high-quality distributed system software using software engineering best practices and modern development methodologies
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design reviews, code reviews, documentation, testing, and operational support of production systems
* Contribute to system reliability and performance by monitoring production metrics, identifying optimization opportunities, and implementing improvements to ensure our services meet demanding scale and accuracy requirements

A day in the life
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll engage with the full software development lifecycle—from initial design conversations through deployment and operations. You might start your day reviewing a proposal to optimize tax calculation performance, then move into code review with teammates, discussing architectural approaches to handle increased transaction volume. You'll write and test code in our Java, Linux, and Oracle-based environment, collaborate with engineers across different Amazon business units to understand their tax requirements, and participate in on-call rotations to ensure our services remain reliable. Your work directly influences how quickly and accurately customers receive tax information at checkout, and you'll see the real-world impact of your contributions through our monitoring and metrics.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are a group of engineers committed to building and maintaining the tax platform that serves as the backbone for tax compliance across Amazon's global operations. Our team values technical depth, collaborative problem-solving, and a shared commitment to operational excellence. We work closely with business stakeholders, finance teams, and engineers across Amazon to understand evolving tax requirements and translate them into scalable solutions. We're focused on staying ahead of complex, ever-changing global tax regulations while continuously improving system performance and reliability. When you join us, you'll work alongside talented engineers who are passionate about distributed systems, take ownership of their work, and support one another in solving challenging problems. We're building the future of tax technology at scale, and we're excited to have you contribute your skills and perspective to this mission.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MLOps & AI: Experience with MLOps tools, model monitoring, and utilizing ML models at scale.
* Distributed Systems: Experience with Apache Kafka, real-time compute frameworks, and high-performance data modeling. Expertise in hybrid/vector search architectures and large-scale data pipeline management.

* Networking expertise: Deep understanding of network protocol architecture and its impact on application performance. CCNA/CCNP/Devnet level of Cisco networking knowledge is a strong plus.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Software Development Engineer 4
description:
**About The Team/Role**
We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer in the WEX Mobility Engineering organization. This role will sit in the North America Mobility team, which delivers fleet management and mobility payments solutions to large customers and partners across North America. The Mobility development organization spans the United States, Brazil, and India.
  
  
Our Mobility systems provide SaaS and API solutions to customers and partners. Mobility products enable credit issuance to fleet companies and their workers through WEX and cobranded credit cards, usable at fueling stations and select other merchants. We provide fleet managers and operators with fuel discounts and flexible spend controls that restrict fleet members to configured merchants, amounts, and transaction velocity.
  
  
As a Staff Software Engineer, you will provide deep technical leadership across multiple teams and services. You will solve architectural problems that cross team boundaries, establish reusable engineering patterns, and align technology decisions with customer and business outcomes. You will remain hands-on in foundational and technically difficult areas while enabling other engineers and teams to deliver safely and quickly.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Define and evolve architecture across multiple Mobility services, identifying and resolving bottlenecks that cross team boundaries.
* Lead architecture reviews and technical workshops with engineering, product, security, compliance, operations, and partner teams to align on complex flows and long-term direction.
* Establish golden paths, reference architectures, and reusable libraries or frameworks for APIs, service communication, event-driven integrations, data access, observability, and cloud infrastructure.
* Set technical standards for public REST APIs, internal gRPC APIs, service contracts, versioning, compatibility, and integration patterns using Java, Spring Boot, ODATA, SQL, and related technologies.
* Design secure, scalable, highly available, and resilient internet-scale systems for fleet management and mobility payments, balancing customer experience, cost, performance, and operational risk.
* Lead security-by-design and compliance-by-design practices, including threat modeling, API security, authorization standards, PCI DSS considerations, data protection, and auditability across multiple teams.
* Define common SLIs, SLOs, operational readiness expectations, and observability standards; drive chaos testing and resilience improvements across critical services.
* Identify recurring classes of defects, reliability issues, and operational toil across services, then drive systemic fixes rather than isolated patches.
* Create reusable CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code patterns, such as standardized Helm charts, Argo workflows, Terraform modules, and secure cloud resource templates, to improve delivery speed and consistency.
* Set organizational expectations for code quality, testing strategy, maintainability, and production behavior. Select or influence testing frameworks and promote effective unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, concurrency, and performance testing.
* Code selectively in foundational, high-risk, or technically challenging components; use prototypes and technical spikes to validate architecture before broad adoption.
* Debug complex issues across service boundaries, lead technical resolution during major incidents, and drive completion of Corrective of Errors (COE) actions and lasting reliability improvements.
* Build self-service tools, dashboards, and automation that enable engineers, support teams, and operational partners to diagnose and resolve issues without manual intervention.
* Shape cross-team roadmaps by identifying dependencies, critical-path risks, architectural constraints, and opportunities to reduce technical debt before they affect delivery.
* Translate architectural risks and technology investments into business language, connecting decisions to customer experience, revenue, retention, operational efficiency, and risk reduction.
* Mentor senior engineers, advocate for the growth and visibility of engineers across the organization, and build a culture of thoughtful technical decision-making and inclusive collaboration.
* Evaluate emerging technologies through cost-benefit analysis; build safe adoption paths for high-value technologies and coach teams through technical transitions.
* Leverage AI-enabled development tools and design responsible AI solutions, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration, state and memory management, evaluation, safety controls, and production integrations where they create measurable value.
* Maintain durable documentation, including architecture decision records, design documents, reference implementations, runbooks, COE documents, change-management plans, and operational-readiness plans.

**Experience You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 7-12 years of professional software engineering experience, including demonstrated technical leadership across multiple teams or systems.
* Deep understanding of data structures and algorithms, object-oriented design, distributed systems, and complex problem solving.
* Proven experience designing and evolving internet-scale services with strong scalability, availability, security, reliability, and operability characteristics.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build alignment among technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Expertise in backend development using Java or C#, with frameworks such as Spring Boot; strong experience building and optimizing RESTful APIs, ODATA services, gRPC interfaces, and SQL-based systems.
* Experience defining service boundaries, integration contracts, platform patterns, and architecture standards used by multiple teams.
* Experience with event-driven architecture and technologies such as Kafka, cloud-native architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code.
* Experience establishing observability, SLI/SLO, incident-management, resilience-testing, and production-readiness practices.
* Experience with secure API design, threat modeling, compliance-by-design, and PCI DSS or other regulated payment environments.
* Ability to leverage AI-enabled development tools such as Cursor AI, Kiro, and GitHub Copilot to accelerate delivery, automate documentation, improve code quality, and coach other engineers in secure adoption.
* Experience designing or deploying production-grade AI agents, copilots, multi-agent systems, or distributed AI architectures; familiarity with vector databases and AI evaluation, safety, and responsible-AI practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience in card payments, fleet management, mobility, or other financial technology domains.
* Experience with mobile development on iOS or Android.
* Experience leading organization-wide or multi-team platform, modernization, or reliability initiatives.
* Experience creating internal developer platforms, golden paths, reusable frameworks, or engineering standards adopted by multiple teams.
* Experience building AI skills and deploying AI solutions to production environments.
* Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, or Milvus.
* Knowledge of AI evaluation techniques, safety practices, governance, and responsible AI principles.

title: Software Engineer I - Backend (Kirana Club)
description: About The TeamWe're a small engineering team, so scope is wide and ownership is real. You'll ship to production in your first week, and everyweek after that.Every engineering role here is back-end-leaning fullstack. Most of your time goes into services, data models and APIs, but youown your work all the way to the screen — and the screen should look like someone cared. If frontend hasn't been your mainthing, that gap is far smaller than it used to be. What we can't teach is taste: the sense of what a good interface feels like, andthe instinct to notice when something is confusing, slow or ugly before a user has to tell you.Everyone here writes code with LLMs — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, whatever works, on the paid tier, and we don't counttokens. Producing code is cheap now, so what we hire for is judgment, verification, specification and taste. One hard rule: youown every line you ship, whether you typed it or not. "The model wrote it" is not an explanation in code review, in apostmortem, or in a design discussion.About The RoleThis is a backend-leaning fullstack role, and a high-volume learning one. You'll build and ship features end to end — from thedata model through the API to the screen someone actually uses — writing a lot of code and getting a lot of reviews. You'll betrusted with production early and work on real problems from your first week. The goal for your first year is simple: to becomesomeone the team can hand an ambiguous problem to.What You'll Do Build and ship well-scoped features end to end, including the data model, the API, and the interface that consumes it. Deploy to production several times a week, starting with small changes and growing into larger ones. Debug production issues by reading logs, traces and stack traces, and get to the root cause rather than to a workaround. Build the frontend for the features you own — clean, usable, with the loading, empty and error states actually handledrather than left for later. Write tests that would genuinely catch the bug you're worried about. Participate in code review on both sides: have your work critiqued, and learn to critique others'. Ask questions early and often. Being stuck quietly for a day is the only real mistake here.What We're Looking For At least 1 year of full-time experience. Strong fundamentals in at least one programming language. We don't mind which. Working knowledge of SQL and relational data modelling. Comfort building a working, decent-looking interface for what you build. You don't need to have been a frontend engineer,but you should be able to tell good UI from bad and care about the difference. Evidence that you've built something real and finished it — a project with actual users, a substantial internshipcontribution, or an open-source PR that survived review. Debugging instinct: when something breaks, you form a hypothesis instead of changing things at random. Comfort using AI coding tools, and equal comfort being asked to explain any line of the output.Our StackGo, Python and Node/TypeScript on the backend. React, Next.js and React Native on the client.We pick the language that fits the problem rather than standardising for its own sake, so expect to work in more than one ofthese and to learn at least one of them here. Framework experience is not a filter — we hire for the ability to pick things up,and most people are productive in an unfamiliar part of this stack within a few weeks.

description:
**Job Title:**
**Staff Cloud Engineer**

  
  

**Multi-Cloud Automation, Governance & Platform Engineering**

  
  

**About the Role**

  
  

We are looking for an experienced Senior Cloud Platform Engineer to join our Cloud Management & Platform Engineering team.

  
  

In this role, you will design, build, and operate enterprise-scale multi-cloud governance and enablement platforms across Google Cloud, IBM Cloud, AWS, and Azure. You will leverage Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, platform engineering practices, and AI-driven operational tooling to improve security, consistency, scalability, and developer experience across our cloud estate.

  
  

This is a highly technical, hands-on engineering role focused on cloud automation, governance, security, and platform reliability.

  
  

**What You'll Do**

  
  

**Cloud Platform Engineering**

  

  
* Design and build cloud governance and enablement services across multi-cloud environments (GCP, IBM Cloud, AWS, Azure).
  
  
* Develop reusable platform capabilities that accelerate secure cloud adoption.
  
  
* Implement and maintain cloud account/project onboarding frameworks.
  
  
* Design and manage enterprise cloud networking, security, and connectivity patterns.
  
  
* Maintain integrations with observability, monitoring, logging, and security platforms.

* Design enterprise logging, telemetry, and SIEM integration patterns.
  
  
* Develop and maintain golden VM images and hardened infrastructure baselines.
  

  

**Infrastructure as Code & Automation**

* Drive platform modernization through automation-first engineering practices.
  

  

**Cloud Governance & Security**

  

  
* Translate security, compliance, and governance requirements into cloud-native policies and guardrails.
  
  
* Define and implement enterprise cloud governance standards.
  
  
* Partner with Security, Architecture, and Engineering teams to establish secure access control models.
  
  
* Improve cloud posture management through automation and continuous compliance monitoring.
  
  
* Design scalable governance frameworks that balance security with developer productivity.
  

  

**AI & Intelligent Operations**

  

  
* Design and implement AI-assisted and agentic workflows to streamline cloud operations and governance activities.
  
  
* Explore and deploy automation capabilities leveraging AI/ML technologies.
  
  
* Develop operational tooling that improves incident response, remediation, and platform insights.
  

  

**Reliability & Operations**

  

  
* Operate and support business-critical cloud management platforms.
  
  
* Participate in an on-call rotation supporting cloud platform services.
  
  
* Drive reliability, availability, and performance improvements.
  
  
* Implement robust observability, monitoring, alerting, and operational support patterns.
  

  

**Technical Leadership**

  

  
* Act as a technical SME for AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and IBM Cloud platforms.
  
  
* Mentor engineers and contribute to engineering best practices.
  
  
* Partner with stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  
  
* Contribute to platform strategy, architecture, and roadmap planning.
  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

  
  

**Experience**

  

  
* 5+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering.
  
  
* 3+ years of hands-on experience building Infrastructure as Code solutions.
  
  
* 3+ years of experience operating cloud platforms at enterprise scale.
  
  
* Experience working in multi-cloud environments.
  
  
* Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, networking, and automation.
  **Candidate must be available during US business hours through the training period. Upon successful completion of training and demonstrated independence in the role, working hours may be renegotiated to better align with UK or India time zones.**
  

  

**Cloud Platforms**

  
  

Hands-on experience with:

  

  
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (Preferred)
  
  
* AWS
  
  
* Azure
  

  

Additional experience with the following is highly desirable:

  

  
* IBM Cloud
  

  

**Infrastructure & Automation**

  
  

Strong hands-on experience with:

  

  
* Terraform
  
  
* Ansible
  
  
* Python
  
  
* Go
  
  
* Bash/Shell scripting
  
  
* Cloud Provider APIs and SDKs
  
  
* CI/CD platforms and GitOps practices
  

  

**Cloud Governance & Security**

  
  

Experience with:

  

  
* Policy-as-Code
  
  
* IAM and Access Governance
  
  
* Compliance Automation
  
  
* Security Guardrails
  
  
* Cloud Security Best Practices
  
  
* Logging, Monitoring, and Observability Platforms
  
  
* SIEM Integration
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

  
* Experience designing enterprise-scale cloud platforms.
  
  
* Experience working within a Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) or Platform Engineering organization.
  
  
* Experience implementing Internal Developer Platforms (IDP).
  
  
* Experience with AI-powered operational tooling or agentic automation frameworks.
  
  
* Familiarity with:
  
  
* Terragrunt
  
  
* PowerShell
  
  
* JavaScript / Node.js
  
  
* Kubernetes
  
  
* GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins
  
  
* Open Policy Agent (OPA)
  
  
* Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) solutions
  

  

**What Success Looks Like**

  

  
* Increased automation and reduction in manual cloud operations.
  
  
* Improved cloud governance and security posture.
  
  
* Faster and more consistent cloud onboarding and provisioning.
  
  
* Enhanced developer experience through reusable platform services.

title: Senior Environments Engineer II AWS II CI/CD
description:
**Responsibilities**

* Environment Architecture & Ownership: Drive the design, provisioning, and ongoing optimization of cloud-based developer, test, and staging environments across multiple Security product lines, ensuring high availability and consistency.
* Cloud-Native Infrastructure Automation: Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code pipelines to provision and manage AWS environments reproducibly, enabling teams to self-serve environment needs at scale.
* Environment Standardization: Define and enforce environment standards across CASB, DLP, and Web product teams, reducing configuration drift and ensuring parity between dev, test, and staging tiers.
* CI/CD Environment Integration: Collaborate with product engineering teams to wire environments seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines, supporting build, integration, and end-to-end test workflows.
* Observability & Health: Instrument environments with monitoring, alerting, and cost visibility tooling so teams have clear insight into environment health and resource consumption.
* Developer Enablement: Act as a trusted partner to product engineering teams — identifying friction points in environment workflows and driving automation to remove them.
* Security & Compliance Alignment: Ensure cloud environments adhere to IAM least-privilege principles, network segmentation standards, and corporate security guidelines without slowing developer velocity.

**Requirements**

* 8 to 11 years of relevant industry experience, with at least 7 years focused on cloud infrastructure or environments engineering.
* Cloud Environment Mastery: Extensive hands-on experience building and managing cloud-native environments — including compute, networking, storage, and identity — in AWS for multi-product or multi-team organizations.
* Infrastructure as Code Discipline: Strong ability to author, review, and maintain IaC at scale, with a clear understanding of state management, modularity, and reuse patterns.
* Independent Operator: Demonstrated ability to own ambiguous environment problems end-to-end — from requirements through implementation to documentation — without requiring close supervision.
* Security-Aware Mindset: Working knowledge of cloud security principles (IAM, VPC boundaries, secrets management, least privilege) applied to engineering environments, not just production.
* Collaborative Communication: Strong interpersonal skills to work across distributed product teams, translating their environment needs into scalable infrastructure solutions.
* Operational Rigor: Experience managing environment lifecycle (creation, maintenance, teardown, cost governance) with a bias toward automation over manual toil.

**Tooling Requirements**
**Deep Core Expertise**

* Infrastructure as Code: Strong hands-on experience writing and maintaining Terraform modules and CloudFormation templates to provision and configure AWS environments end-to-end.
* AWS Cloud Architecture: Deep practical knowledge of AWS services including EC2, EKS, ECS, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, Secrets Manager, Route53, and CloudWatch — applied specifically to engineering environment use cases.
* Container Orchestration: Hands-on experience deploying and managing workloads on Kubernetes (EKS), including authoring Helm charts and managing cluster configuration.
* CI/CD Pipeline Integration: Solid experience integrating environment provisioning with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Harness to support automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
* Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in Python and/or Shell scripting to build environment tooling, automate operational tasks, and extend existing frameworks.

**Broad / Functional Competency**

* Configuration Management: Familiarity with Ansible or similar tools for post-provisioning configuration and drift remediation across environment fleets.
* GitOps & Continuous Delivery: Working knowledge of ArgoCD or Flux for managing environment state declaratively.
* Observability Tooling: Experience integrating environments with monitoring and logging platforms (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana) for health and cost visibility.
* Software Supply Chain Basics: Familiarity with Artifactory for artifact management and container registry operations within environment pipelines.
* Linux Systems: Comfortable administering Linux-based systems as the primary OS for environment workloads.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

Role purpose
  
Implement, test and support well-defined slices of X3 modernisation while developing strong X3 domain knowledge and safe engineering habits.
  
X3 context
  
Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics.
  
The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes.
  
Required technical and domain skills
  
- Strong software engineering experience in modern programming languages such as Rust, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Python, Java, or C#, with a proven ability to build, test, deploy, and operate production-grade services.
  
- Solid foundation in software design, object-oriented and distributed systems principles, API-first development, automated testing, debugging, source control, CI/CD, and Agile delivery practices.
  
- Required understanding of distributed systems, including service-to-service communication, event-driven architectures, scalability, resiliency patterns, fault tolerance, asynchronous processing, observability, and data consistency trade-offs.
  
- Experience designing and consuming REST, GraphQL, and event-based integrations, with strong understanding of API contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, and secure service interactions.
  
- Experience working with relational databases and document databases, including data modeling, performance optimization, reliability, migration, and operational considerations.
  
- Familiarity with cloud-native engineering practices, including containers, orchestration platforms, infrastructure automation, observability, secure software supply chains, and operational readiness.
  
- Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes.
  
- Practical experience with modern web application development using React and TypeScript or equivalent modern dynamic UX frameworks, including component-based architectures, responsive and accessible user experiences, state management, browser diagnostics, and automated UI testing.
  
- Ability to learn and work effectively within Sage X3 business processes, metadata-driven architectures, extensibility models, modernization initiatives, and SaaS transformation programs.
  
- Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across distributed global engineering teams and contribute to technical design discussions and code reviews.
  
Modern platform skills for this role
  
- Implement and test service/API contracts and integrations in the assigned discipline; follow secure CI/CD, identity/secrets and telemetry patterns, and contribute compatibility, upgrade and rollback checks. Build hands-on container or IaC skills when required by the owned service, using team-supported paths.
  
Preferred skills
  
- Commercial ERP, manufacturing, distribution or finance experience, including L4G/4GL or Progress 4GL.
  
- React, automated API testing, telemetry, batch processing or migration tooling.
  
- Practical use of AI coding assistants with human review and regression checks.
  
Experience and qualifications
  
Typically 2+ years of professional software development, or equivalent practical experience. Degree, diploma or apprenticeship in computer science, engineering or a related discipline is desirable.
  
Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications.
  
Expected outcomes / success measures
  
- Owned work is delivered to agreed acceptance criteria with useful tests and no avoidable regression.
  
- The engineer builds confidence in X3 domain knowledge and contributes to safe modernisation decisions.
  
- Defects, risks and support issues are surfaced early with enough evidence to act.
  
- Learning, review feedback and delivery estimates become more accurate over time.
  
Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role’s owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant.
  
Key stakeholders and collaboration model
  
Works with Senior and Principal Engineers, Automation, Product, Architecture, Security, Cloud Support/L3 and Customer Services. India-based delivery is integrated with distributed squads and planned Europe/North America overlap.
  
Sage behaviours / leadership expectations
  
Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Asks good questions, honours commitments, learns from feedback and keeps quality visible.
  
Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Core accountabilities and decision ownership
  
- Implement features, fixes, APIs, components or migration assets from clear designs and acceptance criteria.
  
- Write maintainable code and automated tests, participate in review, and keep technical documentation and operational notes current.
  
- Learn X3 processes, metadata, Xtrem/X3 architecture and the effect of changes on customers, partners and upgrades.
  
- Use CI/CD, observability and local diagnostics to find problems early; escalate uncertainty with evidence.
  
- Contribute to refactoring, automation, accessibility, performance and reliability improvements within the squad.
  
Decision ownership:
  
Implementation choices within agreed patterns, test coverage for owned changes, and prompt escalation when requirements, customer behaviour, security or rollback are unclear.
  
Common capability baseline
  
All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level:
  
- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role.
  
- Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need.
  
- Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities.
  
- Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths.
  
- Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence.
  
- Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership.
  
- Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities.
  
- Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate.
  
- Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

  
  

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.

  
  

**ROLE PROFILE:**
-----------------

As a Software Engineer in LSEG’s Real-Time Engineering organisation, you will work on a global low-latency market data platform that sends billions of price updates per-day around the globe. In this role, you will build APIs, telemetry pipelines and synthetic monitoring services that show how reliably and quickly market data reaches customers. You will work with experienced engineers to develop production software, measure performance and enable observability of a globally distributed platform. Prior market-data or observability experience is not required; we are looking for strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity and a willingness to learn.

  
  

**ROLE SUMMARY:**
-----------------

You will work with experienced engineers to build the software and data stack that measures how our Real-Time application delivers data from hundreds of global exchanges to thousands of customers. You will help turn software signals and synthetic monitoring data into useful end-to-end insight across LSEG’s Real-Time platform.

  
  

You will contribute to software that brings together telemetry from individual applications and services, helping engineering and operations teams understand service health, performance and customer impact.

This is a hands-on development role for an engineer at an early stage of their career who wants to build experience in mission-critical distributed systems, observability, cloud-native engineering and real-time financial technology.

  
  

**WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING**

* Build and improve software components that aggregate, correlate and present data from over 30 global distribution sites.
* Develop applications and data-processing logic that help identify performance issues, service degradation and hotspots across distributed systems.
* Contribute to telemetry pipelines that ingest, transform and route metrics, logs and traces into a common observability layer.
* Deliver synthetic monitoring capabilities that measure the performance and experience of Real-Time services from locations around the world.
* Develop APIs, automation and configuration used to manage observability services and capabilities.
* Use Git, CI/CD and configuration-as-code practices to deploy and maintain software and observability assets consistently across environments.
* Work with engineering squads to add and improve instrumentation within applications across Development, Test, PPE and Production environments.
* Work alongside expert engineers to learn modern approaches to observability, distributed systems, cloud-native software and real-time data platforms.
* Contribute ideas and improvements as the Real-Time observability platform continues to evolve.
  

  

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**
---------------------

**Essential**

* Hands-on software engineering experience, gained through employment, a graduate role, or open-source contribution.
* Ability to write and explain software in a performance-oriented languages such as Go, modern C++ or Rust.
* A good understanding of core software engineering concepts and an interest in building reliable, maintainable applications.
* Familiarity with APIs, Git and modern software development practices.
* An interest in one or more of the following areas: market data, observability, distributed systems, telemetry, data pipelines, real-time systems, performance engineering or cloud-native technology.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving ability in complex engineering or academic domain.
* A willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies and develop knowledge of complex systems.
* Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineers across different teams.

**Desirable**

You do not need experience in all of the areas below. Exposure to any of them would be useful:

* Financial markets, market data or other real-time or latency-sensitive systems.
* Metrics, logging, distributed tracing or observability platforms.
* OpenTelemetry SDKs, collectors or telemetry standards.
* Kubernetes, containers or cloud platforms.
* Data-processing, event-streaming or telemetry-pipeline technologies.
* CI/CD, GitOps or configuration-as-code approaches.
* Synthetic monitoring, automated testing, probes or distributed agents.
  

  

**WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN**
-----------------------------

This role provides an opportunity to develop your engineering skills while working on technology operating at significant global scale. You will gain hands-on experience with distributed systems, cloud-native engineering and real-time financial data while working alongside experienced engineers who can support your development. You will apply that learning with the opportunity to work on systems that deliver financial information across global markets.

**Career Stage:**

Senior Associate  
  
  

**LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy.**

Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions.

  
  

Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance.

  

Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy.

  
  

Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops.

  

Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you.

title: Senior Telecom Software Developer (5G RAN / CNF)
description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on **Senio**r **Developer** to lead the design and implementation of high-throughput, low-latency 5G gNB (Next-Generation NodeB) software. You will bridge the gap between high-level architectural vision and low-level system execution, driving the evolution of our 5G RAN stack into resilient, cloud-native microservices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Architecture & Design:** Architect end-to-end 5G gNB Distributed Unit (DU) and Centralized Unit (CU) components as scalable, cloud-native network functions (CNFs).
* **Hands-On C++ Development:** Write clean, maintainable, and ultra-low-latency modern C++ (C++17/C++20) code for Layer 2 (MAC, RLC, PDCP) and Layer 3 (RRC, NGAP, F1AP) protocol stacks.
* **Data Plane Optimization:** Design and optimize high-speed packet processing pipelines using **DPDK** (Data Plane Development Kit), bypassing the kernel to maximize throughput and minimize jitter.
* **System-Level Engineering:** Architect multi-threaded, lock-free applications on Linux, optimizing CPU pinning, NUMA awareness, memory management, and hardware acceleration (e.g., SmartNICs, SR-IOV).
* **Cloud-Native Transformation:** Lead the containerization and orchestration of 5G workloads on Kubernetes, ensuring seamless lifecycle management, high availability, and observability.
* **Technical Leadership:** Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, conduct rigorous architecture and code reviews, and establish best practices for performance profiling and benchmarking.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 5 to 8 years of proven experience in telecom software engineering, with at least 3+ years in a technical leadership or architectural capacity.
* **5G & RAN Expertise:** Deep understanding of 3GPP 5G NR specifications, specifically around **gNB architecture (CU/DU split)**, **Layer 2** (MAC scheduling, RLC, PDCP, SDAP), and **Layer 3** signaling protocols.
* **Programming Mastery:** Expert-level proficiency in **modern C++** and Linux system programming (IPC, shared memory, POSIX threads, socket programming, profiling tools like perf and gdb).
* **Packet Processing & Networking:** Strong hands-on experience with **DPDK**, SR-IOV, and core computer networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, SCTP, GTP-U, VLAN, QoS).
* **Cloud-Native Stack:** Practical experience deploying and debugging **CNFs** on Kubernetes/OpenShift, utilizing Helm, Docker, and cloud-native networking plugins (Multus, Calico, Cilium).

**Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)**

* Experience with O-RAN (Open RAN) architectures, interfaces (Open Fronthaul, E2, A1, O1), and RIC integration.
* Familiarity with hardware offloading technologies (e.g., Intel FlexRAN, NVIDIA Aerial, or FPGA/ASIC-based lookaside/inline acceleration).
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for telco workloads and automated performance testing frameworks.
