We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Security Architect - Device & Medical Device Security to own security architecture for VCS connected medical devices, from secure boot to post-market, so our products are secure by design and ready for regulators, working alongside the existing software security architecture capability.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in device security, embedded systems security, medical device cybersecurity, secure hardware and firmware design, product security engineering, and cybersecurity risk management. The role focuses on ensuring that security is built into products from concept through decommissioning while meeting regulatory, safety, privacy, and business requirements.

The Security Architect will guide product teams in the definition of security requirements for devices, communication interfaces, cloud integrations, manufacturing and provisioning environments, and service ecosystems and serve as reviewer/ subject matter expert for security risk assessments, threat modelling and overall security concepts. The role complements the existing software security architecture capability and therefore places primary emphasis on physical and connected devices, embedded platforms, firmware, medical device cybersecurity, and product lifecycle security.

**Primary duties and responsibilities**

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Medical Device Security Architecture:**

• Define and maintain security architecture principles, reference architectures, and design patterns for medical devices and connected product ecosystems.

• Establish minimum security requirements across hardware, firmware, embedded software, connectivity, cloud integration, and service infrastructure.

• Provide security guidance throughout the product lifecycle, from concept and design through production, post-market monitoring, servicing, and retirement.

**Embedded & Device Security:**

• Architect secure firmware update, patching, rollback protection, and recovery capabilities.

• Ensure the establishment of device identity, authentication, authorization, certificate management, and cryptographic controls in close collaboration with the product teams.

**Security Risk Management & Threat Modeling:**

• Guide and review the creation of threat modeling and attack-surface analysis for devices, interfaces, and product ecosystems.

• Review cybersecurity risk assessments and security risk management documentation.

**Connected Device & Ecosystem Security:**

• Design secure communication architectures for device-to-device, device-to-cloud, service, mobile, and clinical environment integrations.

**Product Security Governance:**

• Define secure engineering requirements, security architecture review processes, and security design gates for device development teams.

• Create and maintain product security standards, reusable patterns, checklists, and reference architectures.

• Provide security sign-off or documented risk-based recommendations at relevant product development milestones.

**Supplier & Supply Chain Security:**

• Assess cybersecurity risks associated with suppliers, third-party components, contract manufacturers, and external development partners.

• Define security requirements for externally sourced hardware, firmware, software, and services.

• Support secure manufacturing, provisioning, distribution, maintenance, and end-of-life processes.

**Leadership & Collaboration:**

* Serve as the subject-matter expert for device and medical device security.

Align with Senior manager for Cybersecurity and Data protection on security roadmap for devices.  

  

**Success Metrics**

**First Year Goals**

* Achieve 100% security architecture review coverage for prioritized VCS medical device products and major new device product developments.

* Ensure 100% of prioritized products have current threat models and cybersecurity risk assessments, with critical/high risks traceable to controls and verification evidence.

Establish and implement VCS device security standards and reusable architecture patterns covering secure boot, firmware updates, device identity, cryptography and secure provisioning.  



**Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, Medical Engineering, Cybersecurity, Embedded Systems Engineering, or a related field.

• **Experience:** 12-15 years of experience in cybersecurity, product security, embedded systems security, security architecture, or related engineering disciplines.

• At least 5 years of relevant experience in device security, embedded security, operational technology security, or medical device cybersecurity.

• Experience working in regulated environments such as medical devices, diagnostics, healthcare, life sciences, industrial systems, or similarly safety-critical products.

• Practical experience across multiple device or product development programs is strongly preferred.
  
  
**Technical Skills**

**Medical Device & Product Security – must have:**

• Medical device cybersecurity architecture and secure product lifecycle management.

• Cybersecurity risk management, threat modeling, attack-surface analysis, and security requirements engineering.

• Product vulnerability management, penetration-test oversight, SBOM governance, and software supply chain security.

**Embedded & Device Security – must have:**

• Embedded Linux and RTOS security concepts.

• Firmware security, secure boot, code signing, secure storage, device hardening, and protected update mechanisms.

• TPM, hardware root of trust, trusted execution, device identity, secure provisioning, and secure decommissioning.

• Hardware and software interface security, including wired, wireless, removable media, debug, and service interfaces.

  

**Security Architecture & Cryptography – must have:**

• Security architecture reviews and secure design patterns.

• Identity and access management, least privilege, Zero Trust, network segmentation, and secure remote access.

• Applied cryptography, PKI, certificates, key management, HSM technologies, TLS, hashing, and encryption.

**Connectivity & Medical Protocols – nice-to-have:**

• Security of connected device ecosystems and device-to-cloud communication.

• Knowledge of DICOM and exposure to HL7/FHIR is preferred.

• API security, secure networking, telemetry protection, monitoring, and logging.

  

**Cloud & Infrastructure Security- nice-to-have:**

• Understanding of Azure security services and cloud-connected device architectures.

• Experience with identity services, key management, network security, security monitoring, and cloud security controls.

  
  

**Regulatory & Standards Knowledge- nice to have:**

• Strong understanding of applicable medical device cybersecurity regulations, standards, and guidance such as FDA cybersecurity guidance, IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, AAMI TIR57/TIR97, MDR/IVDR, and relevant NIST publications.

• Ability to translate regulatory and standards requirements into implementable architecture controls and verifiable engineering requirements.

  

**Soft Skills**

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and systems-thinking skills.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and design-articulation skills.

* pragmatic risk trade-offs (enabling, not just blocking),

* a coaching and mentoring mindset,

* owning outcomes across R&D, QA/RA and Service

• Ability to lead through influence and work effectively across engineering, quality, regulatory, product, manufacturing, and service functions.

• Ability to mentor technical teams and establish a strong security culture.

• Detail-oriented, evidence-driven, and able to balance security, safety, usability, regulatory, and business requirements.

• Excellent documentation and presentation skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

• **Certifications:** CISSP, CSSLP, ISA/IEC 62443, IEC 81001-5-1, Azure Security Engineer, or comparable product-security and medical-device cybersecurity credentials are desirable.

• **Experience:** Previous experience with medical devices, ophthalmology devices, diagnostic or imaging systems, connected healthcare products, or IoT/OT security is highly preferred.

• Experience supporting regulatory submissions, technical documentation, security audits, product penetration testing, and post-market cybersecurity activities is an advantage.

title: Head of Product
description:
#### **Job Description**

**Location:** Bengaluru, with regular travel to our Raipur head office. **Reports to:** CEO. **Type:** Full-time.

### **About Elxer**

Elxer has connected Chhattisgarh since 2014. We run fibre broadband for homes and businesses, enterprise connectivity (leased lines, managed Wi-Fi and security), a data centre, and Elxer Solar for rooftop solar installations. We build much of our own technology in-house, including our customer app, field and sales app, HR system and a new operations platform, and we use AI across the business. We are now creating a product function, and we are looking for the leader to own it.

### **The role**

You will own what Elxer builds and sells, and why: the software our teams and customers use every day, and the services we add on top of a connection, a rack or a solar installation. You will turn business problems into clear, prioritised products, take them to real users and prove they work with measured results. You will not be judged on documents or features shipped alone.

You will work directly with the CEO. You will partner with the Software team, which owns architecture and delivery, and with Sales, Operations, Network, Support, Marketing, Finance and HR as business owners. An AI product assistant will support analysis, requirements drafting and reporting.

### **Key responsibilities**

**Portfolio and roadmap**

* Own one product portfolio across the new operations platform, the in-house systems that run the business today (customer and field apps, HRMS, billing and ticketing integrations) and our experimental tools.
* Build and run the idea register, scoring and quarterly roadmap. Decide with the CEO what to build, improve, retire or stop.
* Set clear rules for when an experimental tool becomes a supported product or is retired.

**Discovery and requirements**

* Spend regular time with field engineers, NOC, support agents, sales teams and customers to find the problems worth solving.
* Write problem statements, user journeys, acceptance criteria and non-goals that the Software team can estimate and build against.
* Make sure each business owner confirms the need before work starts and accepts the result before it counts as done.

**Commercial products and services**

* Shape the add-on and complementary products for home, enterprise, wholesale and solar customers, such as managed Wi-Fi, managed security, CCTV with cloud storage and solar maintenance.
* For each one, define the offer, SLA, pricing inputs, billing, fulfilment, support model and compliance checks, then hand over a launch-ready package to Sales and Marketing.
* Work with Finance on margin and with legal advisers on licence scope before anything is sold.

**Delivery and quality**

* Track each product slice from idea to production, and raise blockers early.
* Keep product data honest: correct metric definitions, complete records and dashboards management can trust.
* Plan releases with the Software lead, so changes reach users safely and with training.

**Measurement**

* Define and report product measures: active users by function, adoption, idea-to-production lead time, add-on attach rates and ARPU, churn and support tickets per customer.
* Present a monthly product review to the CEO.

**Team**

* Build the product function over time, starting with yourself and the AI assistant, and later product analysts or owners.

**Compliance**

* Make sure products follow India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, TRAI and DoT licence conditions, CERT-In directions and labour-law requirements where they apply.

### **What success looks like in the first year**

* One product register and roadmap in use across all software and services, reviewed every quarter.
* At least one platform slice used daily by real business users, with acceptance recorded by its business owner.
* Trusted definitions and dashboards for tickets, attendance and leads.
* At least two complementary products launched with measured attach rate and margin.
* A shorter, measured idea-to-production lead time.

### **Must have**

* 8+ years in product management, with 3+ years owning a roadmap and outcomes for an internal platform, a B2B product or a service business: ISP or telecom, SaaS, logistics, fintech, energy or a similar operations-heavy category.
* Has shipped products used by field or operations teams, not only web or consumer apps.
* Strong in discovery and requirements: can turn a messy workflow into clear acceptance criteria.
* Analytical: comfortable with SQL or BI tools, funnels, unit economics and product metrics.
* Works well with engineers. Understands APIs, data models, mobile apps and release processes well enough to make sound trade-offs.
* Excellent Hindi and English; clear writing.

### **Good to have**

* Experience with broadband or telecom systems: billing, Radius/AAA, ticketing, GIS or network inventory.
* Experience pricing and launching a service product, including SLAs and margins.
* Familiarity with HR, field-workforce or CRM systems.
* Uses AI tools in everyday product work.
* Engineering degree; MBA a plus, not a requirement.

### **What we offer**

* A leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, with the mandate to build the product function from scratch.
* Real influence over what a growing regional technology group builds and sells.
* In-house engineering, our own data and AI tools to work with.
* Competitive compensation based on experience.

### **How to apply**

Apply on this page, or email your CV and a short note on a product you led, the problem it solved and the measured result, to **hr@elxer.com** with the subject "Head of Product".

title: Data Engineering Manager
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a Manager, Data Engineering to join Resmed’s Global Data Platform team in Bengaluru, India.

In this role, you will lead two small engineering teams: a Services team that builds and maintains an in-house Python and Django application enabling self-service of data lake services, and an Integration team of experienced engineers responsible for Confluent Kafka and related integration capabilities.

Your primary focus will be leading the Services team – setting technical direction, protecting code quality and guiding how the application’s design evolves – while supporting the Integration team’s senior engineers with direction, prioritization and stakeholder alignment.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead, coach and develop two small engineering teams, creating clear priorities, ownership and strong engineering practices.
* Lead the Services team in building and evolving an in-house Python and Django application that enables safe, governed self-service of data lake capabilities for data engineers and internal users.
* Build a deep understanding of why the application was built, how its codebase is organized and its core domain concepts (such as capabilities, components and deployments), and ensure new work stays consistent with them.
* Guide the application’s object-oriented design, including the intended use of abstract classes and established extension patterns, keeping the design pragmatic rather than rigid.
* Own engineering discipline across the codebase, including pre-commit hooks, CI checks, automated testing and code review. Ensure failing checks are owned and fixed promptly so that every change can be merged with confidence.
* Lead the responsible use of AI-assisted and agentic coding, including GitHub Copilot, applying the team’s agent-coding guidance during development and review so that generated code follows existing patterns rather than adding unnecessary code, configuration files, classes or packages.
* Exercise sound judgement about what not to build, keeping the application simple, maintainable and focused on its purpose.
* Oversee infrastructure as code using Terraform, and Kubernetes deployments using Helm, working with the internal developer platform team and keeping shared deployment charts current as platform standards evolve.
* Support the Integration team’s senior engineers in setting the direction for Confluent Kafka and related AWS capabilities, with a focus on availability, scalability, security, observability and cost.
* Own platform health and operational performance, including capacity, SLIs/SLOs, incident resolution, resilience and continuous improvement.
* Manage roadmaps and backlogs from discovery and design through implementation, adoption and ongoing support.
Partner with architecture, security, governance, infrastructure, vendors and engineering teams to make sound technology decisions and deliver dependable platform services.  

**What You Bring**

* A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically, 12+ years of relevant engineering experience, including experience leading and managing software engineering teams.
* Strong, hands-on Python software engineering skills, including production experience building and maintaining web applications with Django.
* Strong testing habits across unit and integration testing, and a track record of keeping code quality high through code review, pre-commit hooks and CI checks.
* Solid object-oriented design skills, including abstraction, abstract classes and extensible frameworks, with the ability to understand, respect and extend an established codebase.
* Practical experience deploying and operating applications on Kubernetes, using Helm charts and Terraform-based infrastructure as code.
* Experience using AI-assisted or agentic coding tools within clear engineering guardrails, and the judgement to keep generated changes minimal, consistent and maintainable.
* Experience building self-service engineering platforms, internal developer tools or automation.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to translate technical choices into clear risks, costs and outcomes.
* The ability to lead architecture and design discussions and make evidence-based technology trade-offs.
Experience developing engineers through clear expectations, coaching, feedback and meaningful ownership.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of Apache Kafka or the Confluent ecosystem, including topics, partitions, consumer groups, Schema Registry, Kafka Connect, security and monitoring.
* Practical experience with AWS, including networking, IAM, compute, storage, observability or managed data services.
* Good knowledge of data lake concepts and Snowflake or Databricks, along with database technologies such as Oracle Database, Microsoft SQL Server, MongoDB or PostgreSQL.
* Knowledge of batch and stream-processing patterns, data ingestion, orchestration, transformation, error handling and data-quality controls.
* Experience with Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, dbt or equivalent orchestration and transformation technologies.
* Experience working with an internal developer platform or platform engineering team to adopt shared deployment standards and tooling.
Understanding of secure software development, data security, identity and access management, privacy and compliance.  

**Why Join Resmed**

You will help shape the engineering standards and self-service capabilities that make data engineering easier to scale. The teams are building capabilities that increase engineering velocity across the Global Data Platform environment. If you enjoy leading engineering teams, maintaining high-quality codebases, improving developer experience and turning complex platform work into simpler, faster and more reliable services, this role offers the scope to make a meaningful impact.

Joining Resmed means building a career that is challenging, supportive and purposeful. We aim to create a diverse and inclusive workplace where people can contribute their ideas, develop their capabilities and do meaningful work.

#LI-India

Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

title: Senior Data Engineer, FBA Growth Segments Intelligence
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

WW FBA Growth Segments has a multi-year charter to accelerate Fulfillment by Amazon's growth into its largest untapped product segments. We focus on categories where FBA has a large addressable opportunity but low penetration. Four structural barriers hold that penetration back: cost economics, fulfillment complexity, catalog limitations and seller trust gaps. Our portfolio spans heavy and bulky goods, premium electronics and appliances, multi-component products, and Amazon Business supply chain.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to build and own the data foundation for the full portfolio. The mission areas are non-sort economics, high-ASP seller trust, multi-box fulfillment, seller growth and B2B supply chain. You will turn ambiguous business questions into clear data architecture. You will deliver datasets that depend on source systems owned by other organizations. Because the team supports the whole portfolio, you will build shared data assets that more than one mission can reuse, instead of one-off pipelines.  
  
The role sits at the intersection of data engineering and AI. You will own the data layer that decides whether GenAI-powered insights are accurate, fast and trusted. You will work on an executive-level initiative to deliver proactive, AI-generated insights on Growth Segments metrics to FBA leadership worldwide.  
  
The role needs strength in two areas. First, you will set a high bar for data architecture, data quality and operational excellence. Second, you will drive delivery across organizational boundaries. That means aligning partner teams in catalog, fulfillment, pricing, seller experience and transportation on data contracts, dependencies and launch dates. You will work closely with Product, Program Management, Business Intelligence, Science and Software Engineering partners to decide what data we build, in what order, and how we measure success.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Data foundation and architecture  

* Architect a scalable, cost-optimized S3-based data lakehouse. It will unify Growth Segments data across selection, inventory, fees, cost-to-serve, seller and customer domains.
* Lead the migration from a Redshift-centric architecture to a lakehouse model, with defined targets for query performance and cost.
* Design flat, denormalized datasets that embed ASIN, seller and segment attributes. These make queries simple for analysts and GenAI agents.

  
Data quality and operations  

* Design standard ingestion patterns with built-in quality checks, staging-first policies and automated validation gates.
* Set up metadata management with automated data classification and lineage tracking.
* Define data quality SLAs, runbooks and schema change management processes for every production dataset.
* Build orchestration for metrics workflows with full audit trails and alerting on late or incomplete upstream data.

  
AI-ready data  

* Design semantic data models that balance analytical performance with LLM retrieval needs, including drill-down across Time Geography Category Segment.
* Partner with Science and Software Engineering to validate GenAI agent responses against governed metrics and close accuracy gaps.
* Build federated query capabilities across domains, with query optimization for interactive and agent-driven use.

  
Leadership  

* Turn ambiguous mission-area problems into data roadmaps with clear milestones and owners.
* Negotiate data contracts and dependencies with partner teams across Amazon.
* Mentor data engineers and BI engineers. Raise the bar through design reviews, code reviews and operational reviews.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of data engineering experience
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience with SQL
* Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS
* Experience mentoring team members on best practices

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR
* Experience operating large data warehouses

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Embedded Bootloader Engineer - UFS/ZeBu
description:
**Job Requirements**  

Role Embedded Bootloader Engineer - UFS / ZeBu

Experience 3-6 years

Primary Skills Embedded C, BootROM/Bootloader, UFS, Synopsys ZeBu, SoC bring-up and validation

Work Focus UFS boot development and pre-silicon validation on RTL/emulation platforms

Role Summary

We are looking for an Embedded Bootloader Engineer with 3-6 years of experience in low-level embedded software, bootloader development and SoC validation. The engineer will bring up and validate UFS boot functionality on an existing ROM bootloader using RTL/emulation platforms such as Synopsys ZeBu.

The role covers BootROM execution against the SoC RTL/emulation environment, UFS link and protocol bring-up using Synopsys UFS VIP/transactors, boot partition access, SBL integration, error handling, regression testing and technical documentation.

Key Responsibilities and Mandatory Skills

* 3-6 years of hands-on embedded software or firmware development experience, with strong programming skills in Embedded C.
* Set up and validate the incoming ROM bootloader, CPU and Synopsys ZeBu emulation environment, including the required transactors.
* Load and execute ROM images; perform CPU reset, BootROM entry, memory and basic platform sanity checks.
* Understand the existing boot flow and develop or extend the UFS boot path in the ROM bootloader.
* Integrate and configure UFS transactor-based Synopsys VIP and validate UFS device initialization and link establishment.
* Debug UFS initialization, link, command, transaction, timeout and protocol issues across BootROM, controller, RTL and verification environments.
* Possess working knowledge of UFS, including Boot LUN or boot partition access, data transfer, error handling, and general UniPro/M-PHY concepts.
* Perform register-level and transaction-level analysis using software logs, waveforms, register dumps and protocol traces.
* Implement and validate access to the UFS boot partition or Boot LUN, boot-image read, memory loading and BootROM-to-SBL handoff.
* Implement and validate the complete UFS boot flow, including positive, negative, recovery, and error scenarios.
* Develop the UFS boot validation test plan, test cases, expected results and acceptance criteria.
* Execute bootloader and system-level tests and regressions on ZeBu/RTL environments and verify non-regression of existing boot flows.
* Triage failures and determine whether the issue originates in BootROM/software, RTL integration, the UFS subsystem, VIP/transactor, or the test environment.
* Maintain requirement-to-test traceability and prepare test execution, defect analysis and regression reports.
* Prepare and maintain the environment setup/user guide, bootloader design documentation, UFS boot-flow documentation, test plan, test procedures, test cases, validation reports and known-issue notes.
* Demonstrate a good understanding of processor reset/startup, memory-mapped I/O, register-level programming, interrupts, clocks, resets, memory initialization and low-level hardware/software interaction.
* Have practical experience with BootROM, bootloader development, SoC/board bring-up, boot-device integration, pre-silicon firmware validation or an equivalent low-level embedded domain.
* Collaborate effectively with firmware, RTL, Design Verification and emulation teams to resolve hardware/software integration issues.

Preferred Skills

* Synopsys UFS VIP and Synopsys ZeBu experience.
* ARM-based SoC architecture and AXI/APB bus understanding.
* JTAG and low-level debugger experience.
* Python or Shell scripting for test automation.
* Git or comparable source-control system.
* Familiarity with SystemVerilog/UVM environments from a firmware and debug perspective.
* Jira

Qualifications

* B.Tech / BE / M.Tech / MS in Electrical/Electronics/Computer Science
* A strong portfolio of projects, demos, or deployed systems showcasing practical AI/ML work.
* Candidates with exceptional practical experience will be considered regardless of formal education.

What We Value

* Building over theorizing — show us what you've built.
* Problem-solving mindset with a bias for action.
* Ability to learn fast and adapt to new tools and frameworks.
* Clear communication and ability to explain complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Qualifications & Skills

title: Systems Integration Senior Analyst
description:
**Req ID:** 399127
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Senior Analyst to join our team in Chennai, Tamil Nādu (IN-TN), India (IN).
  
  
NTT Data Services is Hiring!
  
  
Position's Overview
  
  
At NTT DATA, we know that with the right people on board, anything is possible. The quality, integrity, and commitment of our employees are key factors in our company’s growth, market presence and our ability to help our clients stay ahead of the competition. By hiring the best people and helping them grow both professionally and personally, we ensure a bright future for NTT DATA and for the people who work here.
  
  
NTT DATA, Inc. currently seeks an “Automotive Lead Engineer” to join our team in India
  
  
Position's General Duties and Tasks
  
  
**In these roles you will be responsible for:**  
Core Embedded Development Integration
  

* TCU Firmware Implementation: Write and test robust, efficient code in C/C++ for TCU firmware, implementing features related to connectivity, security, and vehicle interface logic.
* Protocol Development: Implement communication handlers for in-vehicle protocols, including CAN, LIN, and Automotive Ethernet (SOME/IP, DoIP), ensuring reliable data exchange with vehicle ECUs.
* Backend Platform Integration: Integrate the TCU application layer with the Backend platform to establish a secure, reliable data pipeline from the vehicle to the cloud backend.
* Connectivity Management: Integrate and configure the Transatel SIM/eSIM solution within the embedded stack, developing logic for seamless network selection and data tunneling.

2. Software Quality Security
  

* FOTA Implementation: Implement and rigorously test the software logic for Firmware Over-the-Air (FOTA) updates, including secure validation checks and fail-safe rollback mechanisms.
* Security Implementation: Implement security primitives, focusing on authenticated communication (e.g., TLS/DTLS) and secure storage within the TCU environment.
* Testing Validation: Develop unit tests, integration tests, and conduct debugging using tools like CANoe, Wireshark, JTAG, and oscilloscopes to ensure features meet automotive reliability standards.
* Code Review: Actively participate in code reviews, applying established coding standards and best practices to maintain code quality and stability.

3. Collaboration Process
  

* Collaborate closely with the Edge/TCU Integration Lead and the OTA Integration Specialist to ensure seamless end-to-end data flow.
* Work with hardware engineers to assist in board bring-up and driver integration for peripherals.
* Contribute to documentation and ensure adherence to development processes relevant to ISO 26262 (Functional Safety) and ASPICE

4. Validation, Testing Quality Assurance (Added Focus)
  

* Test Case Development: Design and execute unit tests, integration tests, and system-level tests (white-box and black-box) for all TCU firmware features.
* Diagnostic Analysis: Conduct detailed debugging and logging analysis using industry-standard tools to isolate and resolve complex software, hardware, and protocol issues.
* Regression Automation: Develop and maintain automated test scripts (often in Python) to support continuous integration and regression testing for FOTA and new feature releases.
* HIL/SIL Support: Support VV activities by working closely with validation teams on Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) environments.

**Requirements for this role include:**  
Must-Have
  
  
A. Core Technical Mastery (Must-Have)
  

* Experience: 3 to 5 years of professional experience in embedded software development, with a minimum of 1 year in the automotive domain (TCU, IVI, Telematics, or high-level ECU).
* Languages: Expert-level proficiency in C/C++ for embedded systems development. Proficiency in Python for scripting and automation.
* Operating Systems: Hands-on experience developing features on Embedded Linux (Yocto/Buildroot) or relevant Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS like FreeRTOS, QNX).
* Communication: Proven experience implementing and debugging CAN, LIN, and/or Automotive Ethernet protocols.
* Debugging: Proficient use of standard debugging tools such as JTAG, oscilloscopes, and CAN analyzers (Vector/PCAN).

B. Highly Desired Qualifications
  

* Connected Car Platforms: Prior experience working with Connected automotive data aggregation/OTA platforms is a strong asset.
* Connectivity: Practical experience integrating and managing commercial cellular modules (4G/5G), including AT commands and network hand-off logic.
* Security: Familiarity with Secure Boot concepts and implementing secure communication protocols (TLS/DTLS/MQTT).
* Standards: Knowledge of ISO 26262 functional safety development and quality processes (ASPICE).

C. Validation Tools (Strengthened)
  

* Debugging Tools: Proficient use of standard hardware and software debugging tools such as JTAG, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.
* Protocol Analysis: Hands-on experience with CAN analyzers (Vector CANoe/PCAN) and network sniffers like Wireshark for diagnosing protocol-level issues.
* Testing Methodologies: Experience in developing comprehensive unit tests and integration tests for embedded components.
* Automation: Familiarity with test automation frameworks and tools used in a CI/CD pipeline for embedded systems.

Behavioral Competencies
  

* Ownership: Takes full responsibility for feature implementation, from design documentation to unit testing and delivery.
* Problem-Solver: Possesses strong diagnostic skills to quickly isolate and resolve complex bugs across software and hardware layers.

**Collaborative:** Works effectively within a multi-disciplinary team, communicating technical issues clearly to both embedded and cloud engineers
  
  
**Preferences:** -
  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or related fields.
* Ability to communicate (oral/written) effectively to exchange information with our client.
* Ability to collaborate in team of Global Engineers working from North America, India
* The required schedule for this position is Monday-Friday (00:00am to 00:00pm IST). The shift timings can be changed as per client requirements. Additionally, resources may have to do overtime and work on weekend’s basis business requirement.

About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. title: Lead Test Engineer
description:
**Position Summary**

A rewarding career at HID Global beckons you! We are looking for a Lead Test Engineer, who is responsible for quality-assuring the next generation of our Cloud platform developments. We are a leading company in the trusted source of innovative products, solutions and services that help millions of customers around the globe create, manage and use secure Identities.

  

**Who are we?**

HID powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely. We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,000 worldwide employees. Check us out: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/hidglobal/mycompany/

  

**About HID Global, Chennai**

HID Global’s, Flagship R&D Center in Chennai hosts 300 employees in a 48000 square foot space dedicated to delivering innovative product development for customers and provide an excellent platform for scaling our operations in delivering secure access solutions. Here we deliver cloud-based solutions, web and mobile application development. The Chennai R&D Center is seen as the subject matter expert and talent pool on the latest cloud technologies, logical and physical access systems, data engineering including AI/ML, cryptographic key management systems, and other mobile-based smart card delivery systems.

  

**Are You Ready to Join the Team?**

“HID Global is hiring for the role of **Lead Test Engineer** for their Product Development team. This is a Quality Assurance role, and the person is intended to create test suites and automate the Product testing and certify the software that will be released to Customers.

  

**Overview:**

As a Senior Test Engineer with 8 years of experience in test automation and web services (API) testing. Candidates should be familiar with Automating the Web Services Testing with Industry Standard along with Open-Source test tools (Soap UI, JMeter, Selenium, Robo Framework). Also we require strong technical skills on (Python/Java/jav script language, front end technologies like React OR Angular, CSS, BDD, Jenkins, REST API, SELENIUM/UFT/Appium, postman).

  

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Good Exposure to Web Service Testing, Security Testing,
* Automating the Web Services Testing with Industry Standard Open-Source test tools (Soap UI, JMeter, Selenium, Robo Framework)
* Require strong Technical Skills on (Python/Java/jav script language, front end technologies like React OR Angular, CSS, BDD, Jenkins, REST API, SELENIUM/UFT/Appium, postman any IDE (ECLIPSE/INTELLIJ/VSCODE), knowledge in different stacks( MEAN/MERN)
* Enable full-fledged automation system to improve the test productivity.
* Integrated Automated Test Suites to CI/CD Pipelines.
* Identify test automation opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness of test services.
* Contribute to test automation scripting standards and best practices.
* Work closely with the project team to insure that all SW code, requirements and other documentation are complete, validated as accurate and cataloged appropriately in our system repositories.
* Develop, document, implement and operate an end-to-end SW QA process that is appropriate for our development organization and products / services.
* Develop test plans, schedules, test cases and execute tests accordingly to assure minimal SW releases containing bugs. Track, follow up and ensure that all bugs are remediated, and code is released effectively.
* Perform Functional testing, Systems integration testing and Client acceptance testing.
* Work with the project test team to make sure that the deliverables meet the project expectations in teams of schedule, quality and scope.
* Assist in the end-to-end design development and implementation process as appropriate to insure quality SW is being deployed throughout our development, test, preproduction and production environments.
* Work in tandem with release engineer, Coordinate until the build is deployed to production and do the appropriate post validation steps to complete the deployment process.
* Testing the web-based applications, Page flows verification and validation using appropriate test tools and automation test framework.
* Automating the test process for web pages starting from login through workflow verification and validation. Should work with Load and stress tests. Should prepare datasets for the applications that are developed by HID cross functional teams.

  

**Technical Skillsets:**

* Hands on experience with Test Automation tools: SOAP UI, Selenium.
* Good knowledge with DevOps Practices: CI/CD, Test Suite integration with CI/CD Pipelines
* Good knowledge with Cloud Hosted Solution Evaluation.

  

**Preferred Qualities:**

* An undergraduate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required, with graduate degree preferred.
* Min 4 years of overall experience in Software Development Testing.
* Outstanding communication skills in both written, verbal and presentation skills
* Excellent organizational and time management skills with attention to detail.
* Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Creative thinker with a vision and a passion to create something cutting edge.

  

**Why apply?**

* **Empowerment:** You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
* **Innovation**: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part-time job seekers.
* **Integrity:** You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted

  

**We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!**
  
On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.
  
  
When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

**Windchill Data Migration Engineer**

**Pune**

As a Windchill Data Migration Engineer, you will design, test, and build data migration solutions supporting Rockwell Automation's enterprise-wide implementation of PTC Windchill as its Product Lifecycle Management platform. You will report through the global IT Product Lifecycle Management organization and work hybrid at our Pune, Chennai, Noida, or Bangalore location. In this hands-on role, you will analyze data and develop transformations and automation. You will also validate results and deploy migration solutions. You will do all this in collaboration with the Senior Data Migration Engineer, business users, and the broader Windchill team.

**Your Responsibilities:**

* Build end-to-end PLM data synchronization and migration activities, including technical planning, scope analysis, development, testing, validation, and deployment.
* Perform data extraction, transformation, and loading using Windchill Bulk Migrator (WBM), custom Java APIs, Python and SQL scripts, and other relevant utilities.
* Analyze source data, identify data-quality issues, and implement appropriate cleansing and transformation logic.
* Conduct migration testing, data reconciliation, and pre- and post-migration validation.
* Collaborate with our users, functional analysts, migration engineers, and the broader Windchill support team.
* Apply data migration methodologies, transformation techniques, validation processes, and scripting to automate migration activities.
* Use AI-assisted development techniques to create reusable migration assets and accelerators.
* Ensure migrated data meets our requirements, technical standards, and data-integrity expectations.
* Redesign the existing data synchronization process to make it compliant with Windchill+.
  

  
  

**The Essentials – You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of relevant experience, including hands-on PLM data migration in a PTC Windchill environment for objects such as Parts, BOMs, and CAD documents.
* Experience with the Windchill data model, including WTPart, EPMDocument, Product Structure/BOM, Change Management, Lifecycle Management, Workflows, and Classification.
* Hands-on experience with Windchill Bulk Migrator (WBM), Java APIs, SQL, Python, and other scripting languages.
* Experience with Oracle or Microsoft SQL Server, including data extraction, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
* Experience with ETL tools, migration frameworks, and data-quality management practices.
* Hands-on experience with Windchill APIs, Windchill REST Services (WRS), Info\*Engine, and customization development.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery models and large-scale global implementation programs.
* Written and verbal communication skills in English.
  

  
  

**The Preferred – You Might Also Have:**

* Experience supporting Windchill+ or cloud-hosted Windchill environments.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development techniques and reusable migration accelerators.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams and stakeholders.
* PTC Windchill or related PLM certification.
  

  
  

**What We Offer:**

Our benefits package includes:

* Calm premium membership for mindfulness
* Volunteer Paid Time Off available after 6 months
* Company donation matching program
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through OnTrack
* On-demand digital course library for professional development
* ... and other local benefits!

At Rockwell Automation, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

**#LI-Hybrid**

**#LI- KV1**

Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**What you can look forward to as an Architect – Data & AI:**

* End to End Architecture Ownership: Own architecture and design of production grade Data & AI platforms spanning cloud infrastructure (Azure), data platforms, ML/LLM systems, and agentic workflows—from concept through deployment, operation, and evolution.
* Agentic AI Systems (Production First): Architect and drive AI agents using LangGraph, LangChain Expression Language (LCEL), Semantic Kernel, or similar frameworks, emphasizing context engineering, tool routing, memory strategies, guardrails, and deterministic workflows over prompt hacks.
* Context & Retrieval Engineering: Design robust RAG and non RAG context pipelines using vector databases (Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector), embeddings lifecycle, chunking strategies, re ranking, caching, and fallback logic that work at scale.
* Model & Agent Evaluation: Define and operationalize agent evaluation frameworks (offline + online), including regression tests, task success metrics, hallucination detection, latency/cost controls, and MCP style orchestration patterns for controlled agent execution.
* Data Platform Architecture: Architect data mesh aligned platforms with domain data products, Delta Lake, Databricks, Spark, event driven pipelines, relational and NoSQL databases, and clear ownership, governance, and interoperability models.
* Production Deployment & Ops: Lead production deployments using Azure ML, Databricks, AKS, MLflow, CI/CD, feature stores, monitoring, logging, and incident ready observability for both ML models and AI agents.
* Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Act as a senior architect across teams—review designs, mentor engineers, align with product and business stakeholders, and make explicit trade offs across cost, risk, performance, and maintainability.

**Your profile as an Architect – Data & AI :**

* 11–12 years building Data & AI systems, with proven production deployments of ML and agent based AI systems (not PoCs or demos).
* Strong hands on experience with Python, data tooling (Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, Azure Data Factory), and cloud native architectures on Azure.
* Demonstrated expertise in agent design patterns, context engineering, retrieval strategies, tool calling, memory management, and failure mode handling.
* Solid grounding in data architecture and databases (SQL, NoSQL, lakehouse, vector stores), including experience in data mesh or domain oriented data platforms.
* Experience operating AI systems in real environments—security, access control, cost management, latency, reliability, and compliance are second nature.
* Comfortable leading architecture forums, influencing technical direction, and working closely with product, business, and engineering leadership.
* Pragmatic mindset: focused on what runs reliably in production, not chasing the latest Generative AI buzzwords.

Building HSBC’s Lakehouse Foundation

----------------------------

title: Software Engineer III - DBA, AWS, Aurora PostgreSQL
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.

As a Cloud Database Administrator at JPMorgan Chase within Consumer & Community Banking Technology, you will support the administration, engineering, and operational stability of cloud database platforms. You will help design, implement, monitor, and optimize highly available database environments across technologies including Cassandra, CockroachDB, Oracle, Aurora PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB. You will partner with application teams, architects, information architects, and database designers to deliver secure, resilient, and scalable database solutions that meet service level agreements, reduce operational risk, and improve customer experience.  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Administer highly available and scalable cloud database environments across Cassandra, CockroachDB, Oracle, Aurora PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB.
* Design database solutions that support application resiliency, performance, security, and operational stability requirements.
* Implement physical data models, database designs, data access patterns, and table maintenance routines aligned to application needs.
* Maintain high availability capabilities through data partitioning, replication, backup, recovery, and failover practices.
* Resolve database performance, capacity, replication, and data integrity issues through structured troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
* Monitor database health, service levels, alerts, and operational trends to identify risks before they impact production stability.
* Optimize database performance using tuning practices, monitoring insights, automation opportunities, and capacity management techniques.
* Execute database upgrades, migrations, patching, and configuration changes with disciplined change management and risk controls.
* Collaborate with application architects, information architects, database designers, and engineering teams to select and implement fit-for-purpose database platforms.
* Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.  
    
  **Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**
* Formal training or certification in database administration, database engineering, software engineering, or related technical discipline and 3+ years of applied experience.
* Hands-on experience administering, supporting, or engineering databases in a large-scale corporate or production environment.
* Practical experience with one or more cloud database technologies, including Cassandra, CockroachDB, Oracle, Aurora PostgreSQL, or DynamoDB.
* Working knowledge of AWS services, cloud infrastructure concepts, and database deployment patterns in resilient production environments.
* Experience with database performance factors, monitoring tools, tuning practices, backup procedures, and recovery approaches.
* Understanding of fault detection, incident response, root cause analysis, and production issue resolution processes.
* Experience implementing or supporting high availability features, including replication, partitioning, failover, and disaster recovery practices.
* Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
* Knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle and agile delivery practices, including change management, operational readiness, and release controls.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence technical stakeholders and explain database risks, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly.

  **Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Java, Spring Boot, Python, or related programming and scripting languages.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, Spinnaker, or comparable enterprise deployment platforms.
* Exposure to automation patterns that improve database operations, self-service, monitoring, and incident resolution.
* Experience supporting credit card, banking, payments, or other high-volume financial services applications.
* Ability to translate operational trends into recommendations that improve resiliency, performance, and customer experience.
* Demonstrated interest in continuous learning, technical mentoring, and building strong engineering practices across teams.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.
  
  
**What We Do...**
Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.
  
  
That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.
  
  
**About The Staff Engineer Role…**
The Staff Engineer is a key driver of complex engineering initiatives, mentoring engineers, and setting technical direction within SiteMinder’s technical domain. The Staff Engineer is responsible for design and delivery, acting as the technical domain custodian to maintain system resilience and scalability, as well as building new technology and solution capabilities.
  
  
The Staff Engineer should operate with a high degree of autonomy and be accountable for building scalable, reliable, and maintainable systems that meet business needs.
  
  
**What You’ll Do…**

* Perform spikes on backlog items to identify risks and clarify scope.
* Lead other engineers in defining technical requirements.
* Provide solution options during research and delivery.
* Help the team decide on solution decomposition and implementation plans.
* Conduct technical change impact evaluations.
* Write detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured project and architecture documentation.
* Independently lead and complete solution development for complex projects.
* Prior experience in hospitality, technology, and Global Distribution Systems (GDS) is highly desirable.
* Contribute to and lead standards within guilds.
* Be responsible for scalability and reliability improvements across your portfolio, following industry best practices and working with peers to ensure consistency.
* Define system resilience and performance strategies at a portfolio/project level.
* Act as a key driver in identifying and implementing improvements in our Ways of Working, ensuring the team maintains a culture of continuous learning and is always looking for ways to improve engineering processes.
* Mentor, train, and coach other engineers.
* Provide people leadership to engineers when required.

**What You Have…**

* Experience in engineering across multiple programming languages and technologies, including JVM, Node.js, and Vue.js.
* Experience coaching engineers and developing engineering practices.
* Experience facilitating requirements gathering and solution design.
* Strong complex problem-solving skills and forward-thinking ability to support and manage escalated technical challenges and issues.
* AWS experience with EC2, Kinesis, SQS, ElastiCache, Lambda, S3, etc.
* In-depth experience in microservices and API architecture and solution design.
* Professional experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) and key-value/document databases (DynamoDB, Cassandra, MongoDB, Redis).
* Experience continuously improving code quality, testing, pipelines, and CI/CD systems.
* Curious mindset with a continuous focus on improving technology stacks, automation, and testing.

**Our Perks & Benefits…**

* Mental health and well-being initiatives.
* Generous parental leave policy, including secondary caregiver leave.
* Flexibility to work in a hybrid model (3 days in the office).
* Paid birthday, study, and volunteering leave every year.
* Sponsored social clubs, team events, and celebrations.
* Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to help you connect and get involved.
* Investment in your personal growth through training and development opportunities.

When you apply, feel free to share your pronouns and let us know if you need any adjustments during the interview process, we’re here to support you. We also warmly encourage applications from people from underrepresented backgrounds.

description:
**Job Description**
About Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS)
  
  
Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS) helps customers maximize the value of their Oracle technology investments, from implementation and adoption to ongoing improvement. Bringing together Oracle product expertise, industry understanding, and delivery experience, CSS works with customers to address business priorities, strengthen technology adoption, and achieve measurable outcomes.
  
  
Within CSS, Oracle Innovation Studios brings together specialists across AI Studio, Cloud Platforms Studio, Industry Studios, Fusion Apps Studios, and Security Studio. Our teams co-innovate with customers to identify valuable use cases, validate ideas through prototypes, and deliver secure, scalable solutions. We collaborate across Studios, Product Development, sales, and delivery, combining reusable assets and practical AI capabilities to improve delivery productivity and turn business priorities into lasting customer value.
  
  
Why join CSS?
  
  

* Build on your expertise. Deepen your Oracle specialization while expanding your understanding of connected business processes and technologies across the Oracle ecosystem.
* Apply AI to real business needs. Develop practical knowledge of AI and automation through customer solutions and improvements to the way we design, build, and deliver.
* Connect your work to customer outcomes. Contribute across discovery, solution design, prototyping, delivery, and adoption, with opportunities shaped by your role and Studio.
* Learn through collaboration. Work with specialists, architects, engineers, and functional experts across Studios and Product Development to strengthen your solution judgment.
* Extend your impact. Create reusable assets and share knowledge through mentoring, workshops, demonstrations, technical publications, and continuous learning.

Fusion Apps Studios
  
  
Fusion Apps Studios help customers realize greater value from Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications by improving business processes, adopting new capabilities, and making better use of embedded AI. The team assesses existing environments, identifies adoption and process gaps, and develops practical improvement roadmaps. Solutions prioritize standard functionality, supported by integration and extensions where needed. Depending on the role, work may include Visual Builder Studio, Oracle Integration Cloud, and Oracle APEX. Join Fusion Apps Studios to deepen your functional or technical expertise while broadening your contribution to customer advisory, connected processes, and business transformation.
  
  
As an Oracle Fusion HCM Solution Architect, you will own end-to-end solution design across two designated HCM services, translating complex business requirements into integrated, secure and effective solutions. You will combine deep hands-on expertise in your primary service with sufficient functional depth in the secondary service to evaluate, challenge and approve solution designs.
  
  
You will lead customer engagements across discovery, design, configuration reviews, testing, cutover and post-go-live resolution. Working with functional consultants, technical specialists and senior customer stakeholders, you will govern cross-service design decisions, resolve dependencies and evaluate downstream business impacts.
  
  
The role combines functional architecture, delivery leadership, customer advisory and presales responsibilities. You will mentor consultants, maintain solution quality, identify practical AI opportunities and communicate design alternatives, trade-offs and recommendations to support successful implementation outcomes.
  
  
Occasional travel will be required.
  
  
**Experience**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Completed 4 end-to-end implementations with solution design ownership across the two required services.
* Led discovery, design workshops, configuration reviews, testing, cutover and post-go-live resolution.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex cross-service decisions, including alternatives considered, trade-offs and delivery outcomes.
* Led functional and technical teams and presented solution recommendations to senior client stakeholders.

**Product Skills**

* Demonstrate deep hands-on knowledge in a primary service and sufficient depth in the second service to design, challenge and approve solutions.
* Translate business requirements into an integrated HCM solution covering processes, enterprise and workforce structures, data, approvals and security.
* Define subservice scope, dependencies and end-to-end scenarios; resolve conflicting requirements across workstreams.
* Assess requirements for data migration, integrations, reporting, HCM Extract and Fast Formula; review designs with technical specialists.
* Evaluate downstream impacts on Payroll, Workforce Management, Rewards and Talent, as applicable.
* Define the testing, reconciliation and cutover approach across the assigned services.
* Govern design decisions, configuration standards, exceptions and solution documentation.

**Common Skills**

* Security: Assess role access, data access, segregation of duties and sensitive-data handling.
* AI: Identify useful HCM use cases; assess feasibility, data access, human oversight and output validation.
* Presales: Lead discovery, shape solution scope, explain assumptions and exclusions, contribute estimates and deliver business-focused demonstrations.
* Leadership: Mentor consultants, review deliverables, resolve design disagreements and communicate risks with clear recommendations.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Overview of Role:
  
  
The AI Forward Deployed Engineer partners directly with business stakeholders to identify high-value opportunities and convert them into secure, scalable and measurable AI solutions. The role combines strong software engineering, generative AI and machine learning capability with stakeholder-facing delivery. It owns the journey from discovery and rapid prototyping through enterprise integration, production deployment, adoption and continuous improvement.
  
  
KPIs:
  
  

* Business Impact: Measured value delivered through AI solutions, including efficiency, quality, revenue, cost or risk outcomes.
* Time to Production: Speed and predictability in progressing priority use cases from discovery and proof of concept to production.
* Solution Quality and Reliability: Accuracy, relevance, latency, availability, scalability and operational stability of deployed solutions.
* Adoption and Stakeholder Satisfaction: Active usage, stakeholder feedback and successful integration into business workflows.
* Security and Governance: Adherence to data privacy, access control, responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.
* Reusability and Enablement: Reusable accelerators, reference implementations, documentation and knowledge transfer created for broader adoption.

Key Year One Deliverables:
  
  

* Opportunity and Current-State Assessment: Assess priority business opportunities, existing AI capabilities, data sources, platforms, integrations and delivery constraints.
* Stakeholder Needs Analysis: Define business objectives, user needs, success measures, adoption barriers and technical requirements with key stakeholders.
* Prioritized Delivery Roadmap: Create and maintain a roadmap based on business value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and resource needs.
* Prototypes and Proofs of Concept: Develop rapid prototypes to validate technical feasibility, user value and solution direction.
* Production AI Solutions: Build, deploy and operationalize selected AI solutions with appropriate security, scalability, reliability and support readiness.
* Enterprise Integration: Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, identity systems, APIs, data sources and operational workflows.
* Evaluation and Observability: Establish evaluation, error-analysis, logging, metrics, tracing, usage and cost-monitoring mechanisms.
* Documentation and Enablement: Deliver architecture documentation, runbooks, reusable patterns, training and knowledge transfer for users and support teams.

Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Engineering, Data Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience developing software, machine learning or generative AI solutions through internships, academic projects or professional environments; production deployment experience is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Experience and Skills:
  
  

* Software Engineering: Strong Python programming; backend and API development using FastAPI, Flask REST or equivalent; REST APIs, SQL, relational databases, Git, testing, debugging and code review.
* Generative AI and Context Engineering: Large language models, prompt and context engineering, RAG and Graph RAG, embeddings, semantic search, vector databases, tool/function calling, memory, agent orchestration and evaluation.
* Machine Learning: ML and deep-learning fundamentals, natural language processing, model evaluation, data preprocessing and experience with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow.
* Production Engineering: Containerization, CI/CD, cloud or on-premises deployment, observability, performance tuning, scalability, resilience and production troubleshooting. Familiarity with multi-model architectures, AI gateways, model routing, token and cost management, and model selection is preferred.
* Data and Integration: Data pipelines, enterprise application integration, identity and access management, secure configuration and interoperability across systems.
* AI Quality and Governance: Evaluation frameworks, error analysis, guardrails, responsible AI, data privacy, security, access control, lifecycle management and usage/cost monitoring.
* Forward Deployed Delivery: Stakeholder discovery, problem decomposition, rapid prototyping, ambiguity management, end-to-end ownership, documentation and knowledge transfer.
* Good to Have: Microsoft Azure and Azure OpenAI; LangGraph, LangChain or comparable frameworks; Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector or FAISS; Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL and Redis; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana; LiteLLM or comparable AI gateways.

Key Behaviors:
  
  

* Customer and Business Focus: Builds trusted stakeholder relationships and keeps solutions anchored to measurable user and business outcomes.
* Ownership: Takes responsibility from discovery through production stabilization, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Problem Solving: Uses structured analysis and hands-on troubleshooting across application, model, data, integration and infrastructure layers.
* Agility and Adaptability: Works effectively with ambiguity, changing priorities and evolving AI technologies.
* Collaboration and Communication: Explains complex topics clearly and works effectively across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security and business teams.
* Continuous Learning: Actively evaluates new approaches while applying sound engineering judgment, governance and evidence-based decision-making.
* Attention to Detail: Maintains high standards for quality, security, documentation and operational readiness.

Reporting Structure:
  
  
This role reports to the Innovation department lead.
  
  
Visteon Culture
  
  
If you thrive in a fast-paced organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability and a growth mindset to stay ahead of the curve, Visteon is the place. We value high performance and a drive for results. Innovation, risk-taking and continuous learning help us keep pace with the ever-changing landscape of our industry and remain market leaders. At Visteon, you can be more.
