title: Principal AI Engineer - Enterprise Transformation
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD | Redzone is building an enterprise AI platform to support AI-enabled and agentic workflows across the organisation. The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is accountable for turning that ambition into deployed, measured, production workflows across priority business functions.
  
  
The CoE is small, senior and high-leverage. It sets architecture and standards, builds reusable capability, and delivers through a combination of internal engineering and external implementation partners. This is one of six foundational hires and the first dedicated engineering hire in the team.
  
  
**Job Description**
The
**Senior AI Engineer**
is the primary builder in the CoE. You will take prioritised workflows from architecture and PRD through to working, evaluated, production-grade AI systems — and, just as importantly, factor what you build into a reusable component library so that the fifth workflow costs a fraction of the first.
  
  
This is an applied engineering role with unusually high leverage. You are not building one product; you are building the components, patterns and reference implementations that internal engineers and external partner pods will use to build many. The work spans retrieval, agent orchestration, evaluation, and the unglamorous production engineering — latency, cost, failure handling, observability — that separates a demo from a system the business can depend on.
  
  
**Where this role sits**
**Reports to:**
Head of the AI Centre of Excellence
  
  
**Technical direction from:**
Lead AI Architect — you will work alongside them daily, and you are expected to push back when a design will not survive contact with production
  
  
**Works with:**
The functional AI Engagement Specialists who own the workflows, PRDs and quality bar for the business functions in scope
  
  
**Also partners with**
QAD engineering teams, Data & Platform Engineering, Security & GRC, and external system integrators
  
  
**Scope:**
Foundational engineering hire. Expect to set the engineering standard, mentor subsequent hires, and review partner-delivered code.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Building AI and agentic workflows**

* Build production AI and agentic workflows end to end — from PRD and architecture through implementation, evaluation, release and iteration in production.
* Design and implement agent orchestration: multi-step flows, tool and API invocation, planning and routing, state and memory, retries, fallbacks, timeouts and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Make the judgement call on deterministic control flow versus model-driven control flow — and default to the former wherever it produces the same outcome more reliably and more cheaply.
* Integrate with enterprise systems — ERP, CRM, support, services delivery, knowledge and data platforms — including systems with imperfect APIs and imperfect data.

**Retrieval and context engineering**

* Own the retrieval stack: corpus onboarding, document parsing, chunking strategy, embedding selection, hybrid lexical and vector search, reranking, metadata filtering and query transformation.
* Implement permission-aware retrieval so that a user or an agent can only ever retrieve what that identity is entitled to see — non-negotiable in an enterprise context.
* Handle freshness and incremental indexing so that retrieval reflects the state of the business rather than a snapshot from onboarding day.
* Measure retrieval quality explicitly and treat it as a tunable subsystem with its own metrics, not as an assumption.

**Model selection, tuning and evaluation**

* Select, tune and route models across tiers based on measured quality, latency and cost — not on reputation or recency.
* Own prompt engineering, versioning, structured output and context strategy as versioned, tested artefacts under source control.
* Apply fine-tuning, adapters or distillation only where evidence shows the return justifies the operating burden — and be able to make that argument either way.
* Build the evaluation harness: golden datasets, offline evaluation, LLM-as-judge with human calibration, regression suites running in CI, and online quality monitoring with structured feedback capture.
* Work with the Engagement Specialists to turn a business quality bar into measurable criteria — and be honest when a workflow does not clear it.

**The reusable component library**

* Design, build and maintain the shared component library — SDKs, shared services, templates, reference implementations and documentation — that both internal engineers and partner pods build against.
* Treat internal engineers and SI teams as customers of your library: versioning, backwards compatibility, examples, and documentation good enough that people use it without asking you.
* Review partner-delivered code and designs for conformance, quality and maintainability.

**Production engineering and operations**

* Meet explicit latency and cost budgets per workflow, using caching, batching, streaming, model tiering and prompt efficiency.
* Build for graceful degradation: provider outages, rate limits, backpressure, partial failures and safe fallbacks.
* Implement observability for non-deterministic systems — full step-level tracing, token and cost telemetry, quality dashboards, and a triage path for incidents where nothing crashed but the output was wrong.
* Own infrastructure as code, CI/CD, environment promotion, secret and credential handling, and testing discipline for everything the CoE ships.
* Participate in the operational support model for live AI workflows, including post-incident review and remediation.

**Craft and team**

* Set the engineering standard for the CoE and raise it as the team grows.
* Mentor subsequent engineering hires and partner engineers.
* Document decisions and trade-offs so that the next engineer inherits reasoning, not just code.

**Qualifications**
**What we are looking for**
**Essential**

* 6+ years of professional software engineering, including 2+ years building and operating production LLM or GenAI systems — systems with real users and real operating cost, not notebooks or proofs of concept.
* Excellent Python, plus working competence in at least one other language (TypeScript, Go, Java or similar).
* Genuine production retrieval experience — you have built a RAG or hybrid search system, measured it, found it wanting, and improved it.
* Agent orchestration experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, Google ADK, Strands, CrewAI or equivalent — together with the judgement to know when a framework is the wrong answer.
* Strong AWS and/or GCP experience, including managed AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Vertex AI or equivalent) alongside core compute, serverless, networking, IAM and managed data services.
* API design and enterprise integration, including authentication and authorisation patterns — OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, service-to-service authentication, and delegated or on-behalf-of access.
* Containerisation, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CDK or equivalent), CI/CD and real testing discipline.
* Evaluation rigour — you can define what “good” means numerically for a subjective task, defend the definition, and act on the result.
* Cost and latency awareness as a design instinct, not an afterthought raised by finance.
* Clear written communication — design notes, documentation and honest status.
* Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities in an early-stage function.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Vector and hybrid search infrastructure at production scale — OpenSearch, pgvector, Vertex AI Search, Elasticsearch, Pinecone, Weaviate or similar.
* Evaluation and observability tooling — LangSmith, Langfuse, Phoenix, Braintrust, Ragas, DeepEval or equivalent.
* Multi-tenant SaaS engineering, and the data isolation discipline that comes with it.
* ERP, manufacturing or supply chain data experience.
* Classical ML and MLOps background — feature stores, model registries, monitoring and drift.
* Fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, or model serving and optimisation.
* Experience building internal platforms or SDKs consumed by other engineers.
* Open-source contribution in the AI engineering ecosystem.

**The technical environment**
A predominantly AWS estate with a meaningful GCP footprint, multi-tenant SaaS products, ERP and manufacturing data, and a heterogeneous set of enterprise systems across CRM, support, services delivery, marketing and data platforms. Engineering capacity is a mix of internal team and external implementation partners.
  
  
The AI toolchain is not fixed. You will help select it — and then live with the consequences, which is the correct incentive.
  
  
**What This Role Is Not**

* Not a prompt engineering role. Prompting is one component of a system that also has retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, infrastructure and an operating cost.
* Not a research scientist role. We are not training foundation models. We are shipping reliable systems on top of them.
* Not a specification-writing role. You will build, and you will read partner code line by line.
* Not a role where quality is somebody else’s problem. If it goes to production, you own how well it works.

**What Success Looks Like**
**First 3 months**

* The first prioritised workflow in production or at production readiness, with a working evaluation harness behind it.
* Baseline engineering standards operating — repository structure, CI/CD, environments, tracing, secret handling.
* A shared understanding with the architect and the Engagement Specialists of what “good” means, expressed as numbers.

**First 6 months**

* The first version of the reusable component library in use — by you, by internal engineers, and by at least one partner pod.
* Multiple workflows live, with quality, latency and cost per transaction instrumented and visible.
* Regression evaluation running in CI, so a change that degrades quality fails before release rather than in front of a customer.

**First 12 months**

* Demonstrably lower build cost and cycle time for each successive workflow, attributable to reuse.
* A production estate that is operable by the team — monitored, documented, supported, and not dependent on any one person.
* Partner-delivered code that meets the same standard as internal code, because the standard and the review are real.

**How We Assess**

* Technical conversation on a production AI system you built — architecture, evaluation approach, what broke, what you would do differently.
* Practical exercise in retrieval or agent orchestration, discussed rather than graded in isolation.
* Code and design review — you review something of ours, we review something of yours.
* Collaboration interview with the CoE and a functional stakeholder.

**Additional Information**

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

**About QAD**
QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
  
  
QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
  
  
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

title: AI Engineer
description:
We’re seeking a AI Engineer to design and ship production-grade agentic AI systems that automate complex workflows end-to-end. This is a hands-on role with significant technical ownership. You’ll work closely with the Chief Architect, product, engineering, and domain experts to translate ambiguous, high-impact problems into reliable AI-driven user experiences.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
Ship AI capabilities that measurably improve user outcomes (quality, time saved, throughput)
  
  
Build systems that are reliable by design: evals, observability, safety, and cost/latency controls from day one
  
  
Iterate quickly using a tight loop of instrument → evaluate → improve → deploy
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Agentic AI Feature & Workflow Development**
  
  

* Build and integrate AI-driven features using LLM APIs (OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini on Vertex AI)
* Design and implement tool-using agents (structured function calling, schema validation, retries, fallbacks)
* Build multi-agent workflows when appropriate (e.g., planner/worker, reviewer/critic, specialist routing) and know when a simpler architecture is better
* Create agentic workflows such as document understanding, extraction, reasoning over evidence, task automation, and multi-step decision support
* Own context engineering end-to-end:

+ dynamic context assembly (retrieval + state + tool outputs)
+ context budgeting and compression/summarization
+ grounding strategies to reduce hallucinations and improve consistency

* Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and search workflows using off-the-shelf vector stores and embedding services

**Evaluation, Quality & Iteration (Core)**

* Establish evaluation frameworks for accuracy, reliability, and output quality
* Build task-specific eval suites: golden datasets, adversarial cases, regression tests, and rubric-based scoring
* Set up automated evaluation pipelines and release gates (CI/CD-friendly) tied to prompt/model/version changes
* Define and monitor online metrics (e.g., task success rate, human override rate, safety flags, latency, cost) and run experiments/A-B tests where appropriate
* Use LLM-as-judge responsibly: calibrate, validate, and pair with human labels when needed

**Engineering, Integration & Observability**

* Develop scalable backend services and APIs that incorporate AI functionality
* Integrate AI pipelines into existing cloud, microservices, and event-driven architectures
* Implement observability and analytics for all AI features (tracing, evaluations, prompt versioning, cost tracking) Example tooling: Langfuse (and/or OpenTelemetry-compatible stacks)
* Ensure reliability, uptime, performance, and security of AI services
* Build internal tooling for evaluation, testing, prompt/version management, and safe deployment

**Product & Collaboration**

* Partner with product managers, designers, the Chief Architect, and domain SMEs to shape AI-first solutions
* Rapidly prototype concepts and iterate based on user feedback and measurable eval results
* Translate business problems into well-structured AI workflows without requiring ML model training
* Document system behavior, known failure modes, and operational playbooks

**Governance & Safety**

* Implement guardrails, checks, and fallback logic for safe and predictable AI behavior
* Help define and follow compliance, privacy, and responsible AI guidelines
* Design for safe tool execution (bounded actions, permissions, escalation paths, human-in the-loop review

**What You Bring**
**Core Strengths (Required)**

* Strong software engineering background (Python preferred) and experience shipping backend services
* Deep hands-on experience building agentic LLM systems from first principles: agent loops, tool interfaces, planning/replanning, memory/state, and failure handling
* Strong context engineering ability: retrieval strategies, routing, grounding, context budgeting, and long-context tradeoffs
* Strong evaluation discipline: golden datasets, regression gating, automated eval pipelines, and online monitoring
* Practical experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini) and AI orchestration frameworks
* Excellent debugging, systems thinking, and problem decomposition skills
* Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with high ownership

**Signals We Value**
  
  

* You’ve shipped an LLM/agent system in production and can clearly explain:

+ the failure modes you discovered
+ the evals you built to catch regressions
+ how you improved cost/latency while increasing quality
+ how you monitored and iterated safely over time

* You keep up with industry developments (model releases, frameworks, best practices) and can translate them into pragmatic improvement

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or GCP), microservices, and event-driven systems
* Experience with observability stacks (OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Honeycomb) and AI-specific tooling (e.g., Langfuse, Braintrust, HumanLoop, W&B Weave)
* Experience with workflow orchestration for long-running jobs (Temporal, Celery, Airflow)
* Experience building enterprise AI features (permissions, auditability, compliance constraints)
* Experience with safety/policy layers (PII handling, prompt injection defenses, sandboxed tool execution)

**Why Join Us**

* Build core AI capabilities that directly impact users and product strategy
* Work on cutting-edge, real-world agentic systems—focused on applied engineering (no model training required)
* High ownership, fast iteration cycles, and strong cross-functional collaboration
* Competitive compensation and opportunities for rapid advancement

**What Your First 90 Days Could Look Like**
Ship one production agent workflow end-to-end with:
  
  

* tracing + observability
* an offline eval suite with regression gates
* cost/latency targets and monitoring
* documented failure modes and fallback path

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: VP - Senior Java Engineer - IB Tech and CRM/ Analytics
description:

The firm provides a broad range of financial services to institutional investors, corporations, and governments, including investment banking, equities, fixed income, asset management, and wealth management.

* Mentor and lead junior and mid\-level engineers, setting clear standards through code reviews and technical guidance
* Independently identify, scope, and propose solutions to complex technical problems with minimal direction
* Partner closely with Investment Banking stakeholders, product managers, and cross\-functional technology teams
* Optimize systems for performance, scalability, resiliency, and low\-latency operation
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, contributing to planning, execution, and continuous improvement


**Required Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of hands\-on experience building enterprise\-grade backend systems
* Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, microservices architecture, and distributed systems
* Proven experience with Kafka and event\-driven architectures in high\-throughput environments
* Solid experience with SQL and data modeling, including relational and NoSQL systems
* Hands\-on experience with AWS, containerized deployments (EKS, Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines
* Demonstrated ability to design fault\-tolerant, highly available systems
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders


**Seniority \& Leadership Expectations (VP Level)**
* Independently architects multi\-service, cloud\-native solutions, clearly articulating trade\-offs and design rationale
* Demonstrated track record of leading engineering delivery end\-to\-end
* Proactively identifies performance, scalability, and reliability risks before they impact production
* Sets a strong example for code quality, maintainability, and operational excellence
* Comfortable operating with high ownership and accountability in a fast\-paced environment


**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Experience**
* Exposure to Investment Banking or Financial Services domains
* Experience with Python (FastAPI) in addition to Java
* Knowledge of the extended Apache ecosystem
* Experience with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce)
* Familiarity with BI and analytics tools (Tableau CRM, Cognos, Power BI)
* Exposure to ETL / data engineering platforms (Databricks, StreamSets, MuleSoft)
* Front\-end exposure (Angular, React, TypeScript) is a plus


**About The Team**
 The IB Tech \& CRM/Analytics team leads the firm’s global digital transformation, delivering modern, cloud\-native platforms that replace legacy systems and provide actionable insights, decision support, and transparency across client and business workflows. The team operates at the forefront of the firm’s cloud and data strategy and partners closely with senior business leadership.
   

  

**About Us**
 Jefferies is a leading global, full\-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
   

  

 At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. title: AWS Cloud Architect
description:
**AWS Cloud Architect**

**Managed Services Operations**

Pune, India | v1.1 | October 2026

  
  
  
  

**Role at a glance**
====================

**Job title**

AWS Cloud Architect

  

**Location**

Pune, India

  

**Function**

Managed Services Operations

  

**Reports to**

CIO

  

**Role type**

Senior individual contributor; technical leadership through design authority, review and mentoring.

  

**Key interfaces**

UK and Pune platform and operations teams (including SRE), application engineering, Security Operations, delivery and business stakeholders

  

**Experience guide**

Typically 812 years in relevant engineering roles, including 5+ years designing and delivering AWS solutions (guide, not a cap)

  

**Decision rights**

Owns AWS architecture decisions and design standards within Idox policy; escalates material cost, risk or policy exceptions

**About the role**
==================

Design the AWS foundations behind Idox software that supports government and industry. You will turn business, application and security needs into secure, resilient and commercially sound AWS solutions, own the architecture decisions behind them, and make sure they are accepted into service by the teams that run them.

Based in Pune, you will work with our internal platform and operational teams across the UK and Pune, alongside application engineering and Security Operations. This is an architecture and technical leadership role. It is not a ticket-handling, routine patching or on-call ownership position but your designs must work for the people who operate them.

Were passionate about helping our people grow. From day one, youll have mentoring and support from experienced colleagues, with clear opportunities to build technical depth, take on technical leadership and expand your impact.

**Scope and accountability**
============================

To avoid overlap with operational and security roles, accountabilities are defined as follows:

**Area**

**AWS Cloud Architect**

**Partner teams**

Solution design

Accountable: designs, ADRs, service selection, Well-Architected reviews

Application teams provide requirements; delivery teams implement

  

Landing zones & guardrails

Accountable: account structure, Control Tower, networking, IAM and guardrail design

Platform/SRE build and run; Security Operations assures

  

Infrastructure as code

Accountable: module standards, patterns and review

Platform/SRE engineers build and maintain day to day

  

Resilience & DR

Accountable: RTO/RPO design and DR approach

Operations run backups, tests and recovery

  

Run, patching & on-call

Not owned - architectural support for serious or recurring incidents only

Owned by operations/SRE

  

Security & vulnerabilities

Accountable: secure design and architectural remediation

Security Operations owns threat, risk review and assurance

  

Cost

Accountable: cost models, FinOps patterns, right-sizing guidance

Service owners and finance own budgets

**Key responsibilities:**
=========================

**Solution architecture**
-------------------------

* Translate business, application and security requirements into high- and low-level designs, architecture decision records and delivery priorities.
* Lead AWS Well-Architected reviews and explain trade-offs across security, reliability, performance, sustainability and cost.
* Select fit-for-purpose compute, storage, database and integration patterns based on the workload, not by default.
* Guide implementation and confirm delivered solutions meet the agreed architecture and acceptance criteria.

**Resilience & service improvement**
------------------------------------

* Agree and document availability, RTO and RPO targets with stakeholders and operations.
* Design backup and disaster recovery approaches, and partner with operations to test restoration and recovery.
* Address performance and capacity risks, and turn lessons from serious or recurring incidents into design improvements.

**Operational readiness & handover**
------------------------------------

* Agree operational-readiness acceptance with UK and Pune teams before production release, covering monitoring, support ownership and alert routing.
* Ensure runbooks, dependencies, recovery and rollback plans are documented, usable and handed over.
* Design actionable observability with application and operations engineers and close supportability gaps before release.

**Automation & modernisation**
------------------------------

* Set standards for reusable, tested Terraform modules delivered through version control, peer review and CI/CD.
* Plan cloud migrations and application modernisation, balancing continuity, delivery effort and long-term maintainability.
* Guide container and serverless adoption where justified, with clear validation, rollout and rollback strategies.

**Security, governance & assurance**
------------------------------------

* Architect secure multi-account landing zones using AWS Organizations, Control Tower and governance guardrails.
* Design VPC and hybrid connectivity, least-privilege IAM, encryption, secrets management and audit logging in line with Idox policies.
* Partner with Security Operations on threat and risk reviews, audit evidence and architectural remediation of vulnerabilities.
* Make security and data-protection requirements explicit in designs and verify implementation with delivery teams.

**Collaboration & technical leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Agree practical solutions and delivery dependencies with application teams, operational leadership and business stakeholders.
* Mentor engineers, review designs and maintain shared architecture standards that enable teams rather than create bottlenecks.
* Communicate technical, commercial and security trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Cost & architectural ownership**
----------------------------------

* Model AWS costs and guide FinOps practice, including tagging, cost allocation, right-sizing and purchasing commitments.
* Maintain an architecture improvement roadmap informed by service health, business priorities and measured outcomes.
* Remain accountable for architectural quality through delivery and handover, with operational ownership agreed for each service.

**What success looks like**
===========================

**First 6 months**
------------------

* **Architecture standards:** core AWS design standards, ADR template and Terraform module standards agreed and in use.
* **Visibility:** current AWS estate reviewed against Well-Architected, with prioritised risks and an improvement roadmap.
* **Readiness:** operational-readiness acceptance criteria agreed with UK and Pune operations and applied to new releases.

**First 12 months**
-------------------

* **Design authority:** all material AWS changes go through documented design and review, without becoming a delivery bottleneck.
* **Resilience:** RTO/RPO agreed and DR tested for priority services.
* **Cost:** tagging and cost allocation in place, with right-sizing and commitment recommendations delivering measurable savings.
* **Assurance:** design documentation available to support customer, ISO and audit evidence requests.

**Skills & Qualifications**
===========================

**Essential**
-------------

* Proven ownership of AWS solution design and delivery into production, with examples of decisions and outcomes.
* Typically 812 years in relevant engineering roles, including 5+ years designing and delivering AWS solutions; equivalent demonstrated expertise welcome.
* Strong judgement across EC2, S3, RDS/Aurora, ElastiCache, EKS/ECS and Lambda - depth where relevant matters more than breadth.
* Hands-on Terraform, reusable modules, version control and CI/CD, and the ability to review engineering quality.
* Multi-account AWS design, networking, IAM, encryption and auditable security controls.
* Migration or modernisation planning, resilience design, recovery testing and capacity decisions.
* Sound Linux and networking fundamentals, and the ability to assess container and serverless patterns and their operational impact.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including designs, ADRs, cost models and handover documentation.

**Desirable**
-------------

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, or equivalent evidence of advanced AWS architecture capability.
* Experience in regulated software or multi-tenant SaaS.
* Hybrid connectivity and FinOps practice.
* A relevant degree or practical equivalent (a postgraduate qualification is not required).

**To be successful, you should bring:**
=======================================

* **Curiosity and sound judgement:** you ask the questions that expose constraints and make decisions teams can explain and maintain.
* **Collaboration:** you respect operational expertise and build trust across UK and Pune colleagues.
* **Ownership:** you balance delivery speed, service risk and sustainable engineering.
* **Challenge:** you discuss commercial and technical options confidently and question assumptions constructively.
* **Practical:** you can show what you designed, why, and how it performed in production.

**Benefits and working arrangements**
=====================================

This position is based in Pune. Office attendance, working arrangements, applicable Pune benefits and a competitive remuneration package will be confirmed during recruitment.

**How to apply**
================

Send your CV and a short cover letter (maximum 500 words) to join.us@idoxgroup.com with the subject line AWS Cloud Architect Pune. Please include your salary expectation and an example of an AWS architecture you have delivered. Do not include confidential customer information.

Applicants must be eligible to work in India. Recruitment may include proportionate identity, employment reference and security checks, subject to applicable local law and the requirements of the role.

Privacy notice: as part of recruitment we collect information such as that contained in your CV, cover letter and interview notes. Please read our Recruitment Data Privacy Policy at https://www.idoxgroup.com/policies.

title: Lead Data Architect
description:
Overview:

**WELCOME TO SITA**
-------------------

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
==================

We are a global integration and delivery team. We implement, integrate and support border management and passenger data solutions for government customers around the world. We deploy and configure applications, integrate them with government and airline systems, ship regular releases, and support them in production. Our solutions run in secure on-premises, customer-hosted and cloud environments, and our teams are spread across several regions and time zones.

**PURPOSE**
-----------

The Lead Technical Architect owns the technical design of the team's solutions, from early estimation through to production. You'll define solution and integration architectures for high-availability, message-driven systems built on Java microservices and Kubernetes. You'll set the technical direction for environments, CI/CD and platform standards, and act as the senior technical authority for engineering teams, customers and partners.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
========================

**Solution and integration architecture**
-----------------------------------------

* Design end-to-end solution architectures for new implementations, enhancements and modernisation programmes. This includes high-level and low-level designs, interface specifications and architecture decision records.
* Design integration patterns across synchronous REST/SOAP APIs, enterprise messaging (IBM MQ) and event streaming (Kafka). Keep external interface contracts stable while internal components are modernised.
* Lead legacy-to-modern re-platforming: break down monolithic applications into microservices, move embedded business logic into configurable rules, and plan data migration.
* Make technology decisions, for example choosing between relational and NoSQL data stores, based on functional need, non-functional requirements and licence cost.

**Platform, environments and DevOps**
-------------------------------------

* Define the target platform architecture on Kubernetes, including namespaces, ingress, storage, secrets management and environment isolation.
* Design environment strategy and promotion paths (development, CI, functional test, certification, staging, production) with immutable release artefacts and automated quality gates.
* Set CI/CD and code-quality standards with DevOps teams, including build pipelines, artefact registries, and static and open-source security scanning.

**Non-functional and security design**
--------------------------------------

* Design for high availability, scalability and disaster recovery, including active/DR topologies, cross-site replication, backup and agreed RTO/RPO targets.
* Define security architecture: identity and access management, service-to-service authorisation, encryption, network segmentation and compliance with government security requirements.
* Define observability standards (logging, monitoring, alerting, audit) and make sure solutions are ready to hand over to operations.

**Delivery leadership**
-----------------------

* Turn business and customer requirements into technical scope, work breakdowns and effort estimates for proposals and roadmaps.
* Run design reviews and code-quality reviews, and make sure delivery follows the agreed architecture.
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for complex production incidents, and lead root-cause analysis and long-term fixes.
* Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies and technical debt.

**Stakeholder engagement and mentoring**
----------------------------------------

* Present and defend architecture to customers, government stakeholders, partners and internal leadership.
* Guide and mentor engineers, and build architecture capability across distributed teams.
* Keep architecture documentation, reference designs and standards up to date.

Qualifications:

**SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**
=========================

**Essential**
-------------

* 12+ years in software engineering, with at least 4–5 years as a solution, technical or integration architect on complex enterprise systems.
* **Application architecture: Java** microservices, domain-driven design, REST/SOAP API design, and rules-engine-driven applications.
* **Messaging and integration: IBM MQ**, **Apache Kafka**, and integration middleware such as **Apache Camel / Karaf**; XML/JSON message design.
* **Containers and orchestration: Kubernetes** (including **Rancher** on **RHEL**), Docker, Helm, and **NGINX** / ingress and load balancing.
* **Data: Oracle** (19c) and **MongoDB**; data modelling, replication and large-scale data migration and reconciliation.
* **Search and observability: Elastic (Elasticsearch / ELK)** for logging, search and audit; application monitoring tools such as **Dynatrace** or Grafana.
* **Identity and security: ForgeRock** or equivalent IAM, OAuth2/OpenID Connect, PKI/TLS, and API gateway security.
* **DevOps and CI/CD: Jenkins**, **Azure DevOps**, Git, **Harbor** / **Nexus** / Azure Container Registry, **SonarQube**, **Mend** and **Black Duck**.
* Proven experience designing high-availability, disaster-recovery and secure on-premises solutions.
* Strong written and spoken communication, including writing architecture documents and presenting to senior and customer stakeholders.

**Desirable**
-------------

* **Storage and backup: MinIO**, **Longhorn** and Kubernetes-native backup such as **Veeam Kasten**.
* Public cloud experience (Azure, AWS) and hybrid deployment models.
* Experience with mobile back-end services and API-based partner integrations.
* Knowledge of the aviation, travel or border management domain, such as passenger data standards (API/PNR, PNRGOV), interactive APIs and electronic travel authorisation.
* Experience working with government customers and security accreditation processes.
* Architecture certification such as TOGAF, or cloud or Kubernetes certifications (CKA/CKAD, Azure/AWS Architect).

**KEY ATTRIBUTES**
==================

* Pragmatic decision-maker who balances technical quality with cost, risk and delivery timelines.
* Clear communicator who can explain complex designs to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Hands-on enough to prototype, review code and troubleshoot production issues.
* Works well with distributed teams and can lead without direct authority.
* Flexible about working across time zones when customer workshops, releases or production incidents need it.

**EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------------

Degree in a technical discipline (e.g. Computer Science Engineering Mathematics etc.) or sufficient work experience to demonstrate proficiency at this level.

**WHAT WE OFFER**
-----------------

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

**Flex Week:** Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)

* **Flex Day:** Make your workday suit your life and plans.

**Flex-Location:** Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.

**Employee Wellbeing:** We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

**Professional Development:** At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** and **Airport Council International** -available to all employees-to specialized solutions like **Pluralsight** for technology upskilling, **Harvard Business Publishing** for people leadership, **Stanford** for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.

**Competitive Benefits:** Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.*

title: SystemC/TLM Virtual Prototyping Engineer
description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India **Date posted** 11/26/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19942****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **11/26/2026**

### **We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent years building simulation models that bridge hardware and software, and you understand that a virtual prototype is only valuable if it helps a software engineer start writing code six months before silicon arrives. The difference between a model that accelerates a project and one that sits unused is usually in the details you caught early, the peripheral behavior you got right, or the bus protocol you modeled accurately enough that Linux actually boots.

Working in C++ and SystemC feels natural to you. You do not need a complete specification to start modeling, you talk to the right people, fill in the gaps, and build something that works well enough to unblock the next team. You have debugged enough bring-up issues to know that the problem is rarely where it first appears, and you are the kind of engineer who digs until you find the actual root cause.

Mentoring matters to you. When a junior engineer gets stuck on a tricky integration issue, you do not just fix it, you walk them through the why so they can handle it next time. At Synopsys, you will work on virtual prototyping platforms that power early software development for some of the most advanced chips being designed today.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Design and develop virtual prototypes for SoC, MCU, and ECU platforms across automotive, datacenter, AI, and mobile applications using SystemC-based modeling frameworks
* Model, integrate, and test peripherals including timers, DMA controllers, interrupt controllers, and communication interfaces within complex system-level platforms
* Collaborate with IP teams, architects, and customers to define modeling requirements and create Electronic System Level specifications
* Debug and resolve technical issues across hardware models and software stacks, ensuring virtual platforms support Linux, Android, AutoSAR, and embedded application bring-up
* Mentor junior engineers and consultants through platform creation, validation workflows, and software integration activities

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Accelerate time-to-market for next-generation automotive, AI, datacenter, and mobile products by enabling software development months before silicon availability
* Improve software and hardware integration quality by providing high-fidelity simulation environments that catch issues early in the development cycle
* Enable customer success by delivering robust virtual prototypes that support complex bring-up scenarios and real-world software workloads
* Build the technical capability of the team by mentoring engineers and sharing knowledge that elevates the quality of future platforms
* Influence product roadmaps and modeling strategies through direct customer engagement and feedback loops that shape what gets built next

### **What You'll Need**

* **6+ years of hands-on experience** in system-level design, **virtual prototyping, or SoC/MCU/ECU platform development**
* **Strong proficiency in C/C++ for performance-critical modeling and simulation work**
* Experience **modeling and integrating SoC peripherals** using **SystemC, TLM, or HDL** for simulation environments
* Solid understanding of **SoC architectures,** embedded software stacks, and serial bus protocols including CAN, LIN, SPI, and I2C
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* Experience with Synopsys Virtualizer, multi-core platform development, or AI-assisted development flows like GitHub Copilot is a strong plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can explain a tricky peripheral timing issue to a software engineer in two sentences without losing the technical nuance
* When a model does not behave as expected, you instrument, trace, and debug until you understand exactly what is happening
* You manage multiple platform deliverables at once without dropping threads, and you know how to prioritize when deadlines collide
* You take ownership of problems even when they cross team boundaries, and you follow through until the issue is actually resolved
* Customer conversations energize you because you see them as opportunities to understand real use cases and deliver something that genuinely helps

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will join a world-class development team focused on System Level Design and virtual prototyping. The team is dedicated to creating simulation models for a wide range of application domains, from automotive and AI to datacenters and mobile. Collaboration, knowledge sharing, and a commitment to excellence define the culture as the team empowers customers to achieve early software development and testing success.

### **Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  
  

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

* Security: Assess role access, data access, segregation of duties and sensitive-data handling.
* AI: Identify useful HCM use cases; assess feasibility, data access, human oversight and output validation.
* Presales: Lead discovery, shape solution scope, explain assumptions and exclusions, contribute estimates and deliver business-focused demonstrations.

* 12 years of experience in development, testing and deployment of consumer electronics/embedded systems.
* Experience with embedded programming in C/C++.
* Experience with embedded systems, kernel, RTOS or firmware, device driver.
* Knowledge of ARM, system BIOS, device drivers.

**About the job**
-----------------

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes way beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started - and as a manager, you guide the way.  
  
With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

Google Silicon is a custom silicon group in consumer hardware. The SiValSW (Silicon Validation Software) team's mission is to create a unified development platform for system software (SoCs, infrastructures, and accelerators/custom-IPs) with backends on emulator, simulator, and silicon. The team develops portable and reusable system software scaled across different families and tiers of SoCs, and supports system software deployment for tape-out, bring-up, and validation efforts across both Silicon Validation (SiVal) and System Level Test (SLT).

Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. We aim to make people's lives better through technology.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead an engineering team in driving software strategy, architectural design, and execution for pre-silicon and post-silicon validation across custom SoC families.
* Deliver boot platform software and lowlevel drivers tailored for silicon validation and SLT execution.
* Develop firmware and system software for key IP blocks, including power, peripherals, memory modules etc.
* Drive software development across core domains including platform software (BSP, firmware, drivers), security architecture/systems, and system power and performance.
* Mentor and guide team members on software architecture, code quality, and engineering best practices, fostering technical excellence.

description:

Amazon Freight is building an innovative transportation network with the vision of redefining shipping for its customers. description:
### **Description**

As a Senior Development Operations Engineer at Infor, you will be instrumental in designing, building, and maintaining the infrastructure and automation that supports Infor’s cloud-native applications. You’ll work closely with engineering, product, and infrastructure teams to streamline CI/CD pipelines, improve system reliability, and ensure seamless delivery of our cloud services.

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

  

* **Agent Design & Orchestration:** Design, build, and operate multi-step agents and multi-agent workflows, including task decomposition, planning, handoffs, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* **Tool, Skill & MCP Management:** Own the catalog of tools, skills, and MCP connectors agents can call (Snowflake, ServiceNow, Jira, SharePoint), including scoping, permissions, and lifecycle.
* **Agent Evaluation & Reliability:** Build eval suites for task success, tool-call accuracy, and guardrail adherence; run trajectory reviews, and diagnose looping, drift, and hallucinated actions.
* **Context, Memory & Knowledge Grounding:** Manage prompts, context windows, memory, and retrieval sources (semantic models, vector stores) so agents stay accurate, current, and grounded in enterprise data.
* **Agent Governance & Safe Autonomy:** Define autonomy levels, approval gates, and action boundaries; enforce least-privilege access, audit trails, and prompt-injection and data-leak controls.
* **AI FinOps & Cost Governance:** Track and forecast token, compute, and licensing spend by agent, team, and use case; set budgets, quotas, and alerts; report cost per task and unit economics; and optimize model routing, caching, and prompt design.
* **Performance, Use Case Delivery & Adoption:** Monitor success rate, latency, and escalation rate; partner with business teams to identify, pilot, and scale high-value agent use cases; and measure ROI with training and playbooks.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience

title: Senior Performance Test Automation Engineer - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Overview**
=================

We are looking for a Senior Performance Test Engineer with strong hands-on automation skills. The role is a blend of performance engineering (about 60%) and test automation (about 40%).

You will own the performance testing lifecycle for business-critical applications. This covers workload modelling, test execution, bottleneck analysis and reporting. You will also build and maintain automation frameworks and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines. You will work with developers, architects and DevOps teams to make sure applications meet performance, scalability and resilience targets.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Performance Testing**
-----------------------

* Define the performance test strategy, plan and approach for applications and releases.

* Derive workload models from production data and business volumes, and define NFRs/SLAs (response time percentiles, throughput, error rate, resource utilization).

* Design, script and execute load, stress, soak, spike, scalability and breakpoint tests.

* Monitor applications and infrastructure with APM and observability tools. Identify bottlenecks across the application, database, middleware and infrastructure layers.

* Analyze thread dumps, heap dumps, GC logs and slow queries, and recommend tuning.

* Prepare clear performance test reports with findings, trends, risks and go/no-go recommendations.

* Review and baseline results across releases and track performance regressions.

* Provide guidance on capacity, scalability and resilience (autoscaling, failover and caching).

**Test Automation**
-------------------

* Design, build and maintain scalable automation frameworks for API and, where needed, UI testing.

* Develop automated regression suites and reusable test components with good coding practices.

* Integrate automated functional and performance tests into CI/CD pipelines with pass/fail quality gates.

* Enable shift-left performance testing (component-level and API-level checks in the pipeline).

* Manage test code in Git with branching, pull requests and peer reviews.

* Build dashboards and automated reports for test results and trends.

* Contribute to test data automation and environment readiness checks.

**Leadership and Collaboration**
--------------------------------

* Act as the technical lead for performance and automation in the team. Mentor junior engineers and review scripts and frameworks.

* Work in Agile/Scrum teams, estimate effort and track work in Jira.

* Present results and risks to technical and business stakeholders.

* Define and promote testing standards and best practices.

**Mandatory Skills**
====================

**Performance Testing (Primary)**
---------------------------------

* 7+ years of hands-on performance testing and engineering experience.

* Strong command of performance testing concepts: workload modelling, think time, pacing, concurrency, percentiles and Little's Law.

* Expert in **Apache JMeter and/or LoadRunner** (scripting, correlation, parameterization, distributed execution, analysis).

* Experience with at least one APM or observability tool: **Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Grafana/Prometheus, Splunk or ELK**.

* Proven bottleneck analysis skills: JVM and GC tuning, thread and connection pools, DB query tuning, CPU/memory/I/O analysis.

* Strong knowledge of HTTP/HTTPS, REST and SOAP, and of authentication mechanisms (OAuth2, JWT, SSO).

* Good understanding of microservices, distributed systems, caching and load balancing.

* Good SQL skills, with experience in at least one RDBMS (Oracle, PostgreSQL or SQL Server).

**Test Automation (Secondary)**
-------------------------------

* 5+ years of hands-on test automation experience.

* Strong programming or scripting skills in **Java or Python** (JavaScript/TypeScript or Groovy also acceptable).

* Experience with API automation tools: **REST Assured, Karate, Postman/Newman or equivalent**.

* Experience with UI automation: **Selenium/Playwright**.

* Experience designing automation frameworks (data-driven, modular, reusable) with reporting.

* Hands-on **CI/CD integration** using Jenkins, Harness, Tekton, GitLab CI or similar.

* Proficiency with **Git** (Bitbucket or GitHub).

**General**
-----------

* Experience in Agile delivery and defect and work tracking with Jira.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.

* Ability to work independently and own deliverables end to end.

**Good-to-Have Skills**
=======================

* Load testing with **Gatling, k6, NeoLoad or BlazeMeter**.

* Experience on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and **containers/OpenShift/Kubernetes** (HPA, resource limits, autoscaling validation).

* Messaging and data platforms: **Kafka, IBM MQ, MongoDB, Redis**.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Site Reliability EngineeroVERVIEW-  
Who is Mastercard? We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere, by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.  
About the Role  
The Mastercard Authorization Platform is an international message processing system that serves all Mastercard principals, affiliates, and associations: large and small, automated and non-automated. The Authorization Platform transmits authorization validation data among issuers, acquirers, and points of interaction.  
The Authorization Platform refers to both hardware (the physical communications lines of the Mastercard Network and Mastercard interface processors [MIPs]) and software (the Mastercard Network authorization application).  
As a Senior Engineer in BizOps, you will play a pivotal role in advancing Mastercard’s authorization observability and operational intelligence. This role focuses on engineering solutions that enhance platform instrumentation, cross-team integration, and real-time alerting across multi-platform environments.  
Your responsibilities include building and maintaining impact and blast-radius reporting in partnership with Incident Manager teams to enable rapid delivery of metrics for incidents affecting Transaction Switching Authorization. You’ll also engineer internal SLA/SLO monitoring, dashboarding, reporting systems, and support customer-facing data enablement for latency and decline inquiries.  
You’ll collaborate with BizOps Squad Leads to define and deliver release observability requirements, ensuring robust logging and monitoring for new and enhanced components. You’ll also support SLA/SLO documentation and cross-team reviews to identify and implement improvements.  
In addition, you’ll develop custom data solutions for operational authorization needs, including dashboards, alerts, and reporting for BizOps and engineering teams. You’ll also contribute to next-  
gen data enablement using AI/ML and Mastercard platforms like AI Ops to improve incident detection and prevention.  
Finally, you’ll support specialized initiatives to improve the authorization experience across Transaction Switching and Auth-connected programs, addressing customer issues, configuration errors, and data mismatches.  
  
Role  

Serve as the primary contact responsible for the overall health, performance, and capacity of Mastercard applications.  

Support services before they go live through activities such as system design consulting, capacity planning, and launch reviews.  

Partner with the development and product team of a new application to establish the right monitoring and alerting strategy and create the framework to achieve zero downtime during deployment.  

Implement data-driven monitoring and alerting strategies to ensure application health and performance.  

Design and manage ETL processes to ensure data is accurately and efficiently moved between systems.  

Create dashboards and reports using tools like PowerBI to visualize application performance and capacity.  

Perform operability and resilience design and implement and maintain highly reliable and scalable infrastructure.  

Perform root cause analysis of incidents and collaborate with development teams to resolve issues.  

Participate in on-call rotations and be available to respond to critical incidents.  

Complete end-to-end run ownership of the product.  

Practice sustainable incident response and blameless post-mortems while taking a holistic approach to problem-solving and optimizing time to recover.  

Automate data-driven alerts to proactively escalate issues. Work with development teams to establish SLOs and improve reliability.  

Develop and maintain data pipelines to support real-time monitoring and alerting.  

Analyze incident data to identify trends and improve system reliability.  

Utilize predictive models to forecast potential issues and proactively address them.  

Tackle complex development, automation, and business process problems. Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design, through deployment, operation, and refinement.

Daignostix, the AI arm of TRS based in Whitefield, Bengaluru, builds clinical AI for medical imaging and healthcare workflows. TRS also maintains an active academic and research focus, including AI in radiology (www.radguru.net).

**Role Summary**

Daignostix builds the AI behind TRS's 24x7 teleradiology operations and the products used by radiologists, hospital partners and internal teams. Beyond clinical imaging models, this includes algorithms that route and prioritise cases, predict TAT and forecast volumes and radiologist coverage, along with mobile applications that put these capabilities in users' hands.

As a Junior AI Engineer – Applied AI (Non-Clinical), you will build and ship operational ML algorithms and AI-enabled mobile features end to end under the guidance of senior engineers, using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code to move quickly without compromising quality. This role does not work on clinical diagnostic models.

Build, train and evaluate models for case routing and worklist prioritisation, TAT prediction, radiologist scheduling and RVU/volume forecasting, and anomaly detection on operational data.

Build AI-enabled features in mobile apps (React Native, Flutter or native iOS/Android) and integrate them with backend model services.

●

Convert, optimize, and deploy machine learning models such as LightGBM, XGBoost, and scikit-learn models for production use, balancing accuracy, inference latency, memory usage, and model size.

●

Build data pipelines from operational systems, define success metrics with operations stakeholders, and measure model impact against baselines in production.

●

Use Claude Code and similar agentic coding tools in day-to-day development, while owning the review, testing and correctness of everything you ship.

●

Package models as tested services (Python, Docker, FastAPI) with unit and regression tests, logging and monitoring. Senior engineers lead architecture and deployment.

Work with operations, product and engineering teams to turn workflow problems into measurable AI solutions.

**Education.**
B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/MS/M.Sc. from an IIT, IISc, IIIT, BITS Pilani or a comparably selective institution, in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic record.

2-4 years of hands-on software and ML engineering, including mobile applications and ML models that reached real users.

At least one mobile app or ML system that you personally built and shipped to real users, and can defend in technical depth.

Strong Python skills with hands-on experience in machine learning frameworks and libraries such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, and LightGBM, along with proficiency in building and deploying production-grade ML solutions.

Regular use of Claude Code or similar agentic coding tools on real projects, with sound judgement in reviewing and testing AI-generated code.

Tabular, time-series and optimisation problems: feature engineering, gradient-boosted models, forecasting, classification metrics and experimental design.

App store releases, mobile analytics and exposure to healthcare workflows.

title: Junior AI Engineer
description:
**About Teleradiology Solutions / Daignostix**

Teleradiology Solutions (TRS), founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, provides 24x7 diagnostic radiology reporting to over 150 hospitals across 21 countries, through a network of radiologists (US, Indian certified) and technology-driven workflows.

Daignostix, the AI arm of TRS based in Whitefield, Bengaluru, builds clinical AI for medical imaging and healthcare workflows. TRS also maintains an active academic and research focus, including AI in radiology (www.radguru.net).

**Role Summary:**

Daignostix builds clinical AI for CT, MR, X-ray and ultrasound, with algorithms spanning neuro and stroke, pulmonary embolism, aortic pathology, urology, spine and rib fracture, solid-organ trauma and paediatric chest. Our models are used alongside radiologists (US, Indian certified), so quality is judged by clinical performance and reliability, not benchmark scores.

As a Junior AI Engineer, you will own scoped model workstreams (data, training, evaluation and error analysis) under the guidance of senior AI engineers, and support the move of validated models into production. Medical-imaging experience is welcome but not required; serious hands-on deep-learning work is.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

● Model development. Train, fine-tune and evaluate CNN- and transformer-based models for classification, detection and segmentation, starting from strong baselines and running disciplined, reproducible experiments.

● Scoped ownership. Own a defined model workstream under senior review, from dataset preparation through training, validation, documentation and hand-off.

● Data pipelines. Build and maintain DICOM pipelines for ingestion, de-identification, series selection, pre-processing, augmentation, annotation handling and dataset versioning.

● Evaluation and error analysis. Report clinical metrics (sensitivity, specificity, PPV/NPV, ROC-AUC/PR-AUC, per-case and per-lesion), analyse false positives and negatives by subgroup, and explain why the model fails.

● Radiologist collaboration. Work with radiologists (US, Indian certified) to define labels, review difficult cases and turn clinical feedback into measurable model improvements.

● Production support. Contribute to packaging validated models as tested inference services (Python, Docker, FastAPI), including unit and regression tests that confirm changes do not alter clinical outputs. Senior engineers lead serving architecture, optimisation and deployment.

**Requirements:**

**Must-have:**

● Education. B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/MS/M.Sc. from an IIT, IISc, IIIT, BITS Pilani or a comparably selective institution, in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic record.

● Experience. 2-4 years of hands-on AI/ML engineering or research experience, including deep-learning work beyond coursework, tutorials, notebooks or API wrappers.

● Proof of building. At least one substantial computer-vision system or research contribution that you personally drove into a reproducible pipeline, service or real downstream use, and can defend in technical depth.

● Programming. Strong Python and NumPy, and deep hands-on experience in PyTorch or TensorFlow/Keras. Able to debug data loaders, leakage, incorrect metrics and unstable training.

● Fundamentals. Solid grounding in deep learning and computer vision (CNNs, vision transformers, detection, segmentation, transfer learning) and in statistics and experimental design (ROC/PR analysis, thresholds, calibration).

● Engineering basics. Linux, Git, clean modular Python, Docker, pytest and basic CI/CD.

Good-to-have:

● Medical imaging. Experience with DICOM/NIfTI, MONAI or nnU-Net.

● Production exposure. Model serving with FastAPI, ONNX/TensorRT, and experiment tracking with MLflow or Weights & Biases.

● LLMs and cloud. Exposure to LLMs, embeddings or RAG, and to one of AWS, Azure or GCP. These add to, but do not replace, core deep-learning skills.

**Key Skills:**

Python | PyTorch | TensorFlow / Keras | NumPy | OpenCV | scikit-learn | CNNs | Vision Transformers | Detection | Segmentation | DICOM / NIfTI | Clinical Metrics | Error Analysis | Git | Linux | Docker | FastAPI | pytest | MLflow / Weights & Biases

**Why Join Daignostix:**

● Real clinical AI. Build models for real medical-imaging workflows and see how they affect radiologists and patients.

● Direct access to radiologists. Work closely with subspecialist radiologists (US, Indian certified) on ground truth, difficult cases and failure analysis.

● Mentorship with ownership. Senior technical review, dedicated on-premise GPU infrastructure, and visibility across development, deployment, clinical validation and regulatory pathways.

title: Senior Business Intelligence Engineer, FBA Growth Segments Intelligence
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

WW FBA Growth Segments has a multi-year charter to accelerate Fulfillment by Amazon's growth into its largest untapped product segments. We focus on categories where FBA has a large addressable opportunity but low penetration. Four structural barriers hold that penetration back: cost economics, fulfillment complexity, catalog limitations and seller trust gaps. Our portfolio spans heavy and bulky goods, premium electronics and appliances, multi-component products, and Amazon Business supply chain.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer to set the analytics strategy for the full portfolio. The mission areas are non-sort economics, high-ASP seller trust, multi-box fulfillment, seller growth and B2B supply chain. You will own the metrics framework that FBA leadership uses to track segment growth and to make investment decisions. You will turn ambiguous business problems into measurement plans, reporting roadmaps and insights that change decisions. Because the team supports the whole portfolio, you will decide where analytics effort goes as priorities change. You will also build shared reporting assets that more than one mission can reuse.  
  
The role sits at the intersection of business intelligence, metrics governance and AI-powered analytics. You will own the governed metrics layer behind WBR, MBR and QBR reviews. You will also make sure AI-generated insights match those governed metrics, so leaders can trust them.  
  
The role needs strength in two areas. First, you will set a high bar for metric definitions, analytical rigor and reporting quality. Second, you will drive alignment across organizational boundaries. That means getting partner teams in catalog, fulfillment, pricing, seller experience and transportation to agree on shared definitions, data contracts and timelines. You will work closely with Product, Program Management, Data Engineering, Science and Finance partners to decide what we measure, how we measure it, and how we act on it.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Metrics strategy and governance  

* Define the metrics framework for Growth Segments, covering input and output metrics for each mission area.
* Own the metric registry as the single source of truth. Each metric includes formula, source mapping, owner, data quality rules and interpretation guidance.
* Lead the change control process for metric definitions across Growth Segments and partner teams.
* Reconcile metrics across dashboards, WBR/MBR decks and source systems. Close definition gaps at the root.
* Hand governed definitions to Data Engineering as build specs, with clear acceptance criteria.

  
Reporting and self-service  

* Design the reporting architecture for WBR, MBR and QBR cadences. Remove manual data pulls.
* Own production-grade QuickSight dashboards and self-service tools for leadership and stakeholders across regions.
* Set standards for dashboard design, refresh SLAs, query performance and documentation.

  
Insights and business impact  

* Lead deep-dives and root-cause analysis on metric movements. Present drivers and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Build opportunity-sizing and program impact models to guide investment decisions across segments.
* Design measurement plans and experiments for new programs before launch.

  
AI-powered analytics  

* Partner with Data Engineering on AI-ready data models, including flat, denormalized datasets for GenAI agent retrieval.
* Own the validation framework for AI-generated insights against governed metrics. Track accuracy and close gaps.
* Define the semantic layer, business glossary and question coverage that GenAI agents need to answer leadership questions.

  
Leadership  

* Turn ambiguous problems into analytics roadmaps with clear milestones, owners and dates.
* Align partner teams on shared definitions, data contracts and dependencies.
* Mentor BIEs and BAs. Raise the bar through analysis reviews, SQL reviews and dashboard reviews.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 10+ years of professional or military experience
* 5+ years of SQL experience
* Experience programming to extract, transform and clean large (multi-TB) data sets
* Experience with theory and practice of design of experiments and statistical analysis of results
* Experience with AWS technologies
* Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
* Experience with theory and practice of information retrieval, data science, machine learning and data mining

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs
* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
