title: Data Engineer - Senior 7 (Data Modeler)
description:
**Job Summary**
Leads projects for design, development and maintenance of a data and analytics platform. Effectively and efficiently process, store and make data available to analysts and other consumers. Works with key business stakeholders, IT experts and subject-matter experts to plan, design and deliver optimal analytics and data science solutions. Works on one or many product teams at a time.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Designs and automates deployment of our distributed system for ingesting and transforming data from various types of sources (relational, event-based, unstructured). Designs and implements framework to continuously monitor and troubleshoot data quality and data integrity issues. Implements data governance processes and methods for managing metadata, access, retention to data for internal and external users. Designs and provide guidance on building reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Designs and implements physical data models to define the database structure. Optimizing database performance through efficient indexing and table relationships. Participates in optimizing, testing, and troubleshooting of data pipelines. Designs, develops and operates large scale data storage and processing solutions using different distributed and cloud based platforms for storing data (e.g. Data Lakes, Hadoop, Hbase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Accumulo, DynamoDB, others). Uses innovative and modern tools, techniques and architectures to partially or completely automate the most-common, repeatable and tedious data preparation and integration tasks in order to minimize manual and error-prone processes and improve productivity. Assists with renovating the data management infrastructure to drive automation in data integration and management. Ensures the timeliness and success of critical analytics initiatives by using agile development technologies such as DevOps, Scrum, Kanban Coaches and develops less experienced team members.
  
  
**Competencies**
System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
  
  
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  
  
Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  
  
Data Extraction - Performs data extract-transform-load (ETL) activities from variety of sources and transforms them for consumption by various downstream applications and users using appropriate tools and technologies.
  
  
Programming - Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  
  
Quality Assurance Metrics - Applies the science of measurement to assess whether a solution meets its intended outcomes using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including the SDLC standards, tools, metrics and key performance indicators, to deliver a quality product.
  
  
Solution Documentation - Documents information and solution based on knowledge gained as part of product development activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.
  
  
Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.
  
  
Data Quality - Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.
  
  
Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
College, university, or equivalent degree in relevant technical discipline, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
**Experience**
Intermediate experience in a relevant discipline area is required. Knowledge of the latest technologies and trends in data engineering are highly preferred and includes:
  
  

* Familiarity analyzing complex business systems, industry requirements, and/or data regulations
* Background in processing and managing large data sets
* Design and development for a Big Data platform using open source and third-party tools
* SPARK, Scala/Java, Map-Reduce, Hive, Hbase, and Kafka or equivalent college coursework
* SQL query language
* Clustered compute cloud-based implementation experience
* Experience developing applications requiring large file movement for a Cloud-based environment and other data extraction tools and methods from a variety of sources
* Experience in building analytical solutions

**Intermediate Experiences In The Following Are Preferred**

* Experience with IoT technology
* Experience in Agile software development

Core Responsibilities Unique to the Role
  
  

* Lead the design, governance, and continuous evolution of enterprise data models and data products, including conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling. Review and approve data model changes, new source integrations, tables, attributes, and relationships introduced across data products to ensure alignment with enterprise data architecture standards, modelling principles, scalability, reusability, and business requirements. 2) Design and build reliable, high-performance data engineering solutions including data ingestion, transformation, integration, and orchestration pipelines across cloud data platforms, ensuring data quality, security, governance, scalability, and operational excellence throughout the enterprise data lifecycle across Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Product Lifecycle, and other Enterprise Products domains. 3) Partner with Data Engineers, Solution Engineers, Analysts, and Business Stakeholders to translate business requirements into governed, discoverable, and AI-ready data products by applying Data-as-a-Product principles, metadata standards, lineage, semantic modelling, and data governance practices that enable trusted enterprise data

**Required Skills, Education, Or Experience**

* 8+ years of strong experience in enterprise data modelling and data engineering, supporting large-scale data warehouses, lakehouses, semantic models, and enterprise data products on modern cloud platforms. 2) Strong expertise in enterprise data modelling, including conceptual, logical, and physical data models, dimensional modelling (Star/Snowflake), Data Vault, normalized and canonical models, semantic modelling, master data management, and enterprise data architecture standards. 3) Proven experience governing and reviewing enterprise data models across multiple data products, including evaluation of new source systems, entities, attributes, relationships, and model enhancements to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles, data standards, scalability, reusability, and long-term maintainability. 4) Experience designing and implementing data solutions across the complete data lifecycle, including Source Systems, Data Ingestion, Raw/Bronze, Curated/Silver, Business/Gold, Semantic Layers, and Enterprise Data Products, ensuring data quality, governance, security, performance, and operational excellence. 5) Strong hands-on expertise in data engineering and cloud data platforms, including Snowflake, Databricks, SQL, Matillion, dbt,Power BI with experience building scalable, high-performance data pipelines, data integration solutions, and reusable enterprise data assets. 6) Proven ability to lead technical design and data model reviews and collaborate with Solution Engineers, Data Engineers, Architects, and Business Stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable data products and establish enterprise-wide data modelling, engineering, and governance best practices.

**Preferred (Nice To Have) Skills, Education, Or Experience**

* Experience working within a Data-as-a-Product operating model, including enterprise data modelling, semantic layer design, data cataloging, metadata management, data lineage, data product certification, governance practices, and development of reusable data assets supporting analytics and self-service consumption. 2) Experience supporting AI-ready data platforms and advanced analytics initiatives, including GenAI, AI/ML, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, semantic search, knowledge management, and scalable data engineering and data modelling practices that enable trusted enterprise AI solutions.

title: Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) Database Administrator
description:
We need a hands-on Senior Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) Database Administrator with 7–10 years of Oracle DBA experience and strong, demonstrable experience administering Oracle EBS database environments. The resource should be proficient in Oracle Database 19c, RAC, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, backup and recovery, patching, cloning, performance troubleshooting, and EBS database operations. The role will support migration of the Oracle EBS database from Azure to Oracle Database@AWS, but the primary requirement is deep Oracle EBS database administration expertise. Exposure to Oracle Database@AWS, OCI, Exadata, or ZDM is preferred rather than mandatory. The EBS application-tier migration is being handled by another partner.

**Job Description:** Senior Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) Database Administrator

**Experience:** 7–10 years

**Role:** Senior Oracle EBS Database Administrator

**Location:** India

**Project:** Oracle EBS Database Administration and Database Migration

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Oracle EBS Database Administrator with strong experience managing, supporting, troubleshooting, and migrating Oracle E-Business Suite database environments.

The resource will be responsible for the database layer of the Oracle EBS environment, including database administration, availability, backup and recovery, cloning, patching support, performance monitoring and tuning, migration readiness, validation, cutover, and post-production support. The immediate engagement includes migration of an Oracle EBS database currently hosted on Azure to Oracle Database@AWS. The EBS application-tier migration will be managed by another implementation partner.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer and support Oracle databases underpinning Oracle E-Business Suite environments.

* Perform EBS database health checks, troubleshooting, capacity reviews, and performance monitoring and tuning.

* Support EBS database cloning, refreshes, backup and recovery, patching activities, and environment maintenance.

* Manage Oracle Database 19c environments and associated RAC, ASM, Data Guard, listener, services, and storage configurations, as applicable.

* Use RMAN for backup, recovery, duplication, and migration activities.

* Perform database performance analysis using AWR/ASH and resolve database-related performance issues affecting EBS workloads.

* Assess the existing Oracle EBS database environment hosted on Azure and identify migration prerequisites and dependencies.

* Plan and execute the EBS database migration, including rehearsals, validation, production cutover, and rollback planning.

* Prepare database migration, operational, and cutover runbooks.

* Coordinate closely with the EBS application migration partner on application-to-database connectivity, validation, and cutover activities.

* Troubleshoot database-related issues during testing and production cutover.

* Provide post-production hypercare, knowledge transfer, and handover documentation.

**Required Skills**

* 7+ years of hands-on Oracle DBA experience, with significant experience supporting Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) database environments.

* Strong Oracle EBS database administration and troubleshooting experience.

* Good hands-on experience with Oracle Database 19c.

* Strong experience with:

◦ Oracle EBS database operations and support

◦ RMAN backup, recovery, duplication, and restore

◦ RAC

◦ ASM

◦ Data Guard

◦ Database cloning and refresh activities

◦ Database patching and maintenance

◦ Performance troubleshooting and tuning

◦ AWR/ASH

◦ Linux

* Experience planning and executing Oracle database migrations and production cutovers.

* Ability to independently troubleshoot complex database issues in an Oracle EBS environment.

* Good coordination skills for working with application, infrastructure, network, and implementation teams during migration and cutover.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Oracle Exadata or Oracle cloud database services.

* Exposure to Oracle Database@AWS.

* OCI / Exadata Database Service experience.

* Oracle Zero Downtime Migration (ZDM) experience.

* Basic understanding of AWS networking/connectivity concepts such as VPC, subnets, DNS, and security groups.

* Previous Azure-to-AWS or Oracle cloud database migration experience.

Work Location: In person

**About GSC Outsourcing**

GSC Outsourcing Private Limited is a professional outsourcing firm providing Finance & Accounting (F&A) and business support services to international clients. We support businesses across the USA, Canada, UK, Australia, UAE, and other global markets through efficient, technology-driven accounting and outsourcing solutions.

We are looking for an **AI-enabled US Accountant** who has strong practical experience in US accounting, excellent hands-on expertise in QuickBooks, and advanced proficiency in using **Claude AI (Anthropic)** to streamline, automate, analyze, and execute accounting workflows.

**Role Overview**

The ideal candidate should be comfortable performing routine and complex accounting tasks using QuickBooks while leveraging Claude AI extensively for accounting analysis, reconciliations, financial reporting, transaction reviews, problem-solving, workflow automation, and documentation.

We are specifically looking for someone who knows how to integrate AI into real-world accounting operations—not just someone who has basic knowledge of AI tools.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage day-to-day US accounting operations using QuickBooks Online (QBO).
* Utilize Claude AI extensively to support and execute accounting workflows, improve efficiency, and minimize manual work.
* Perform bank, credit card, and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoicing, expense categorization, and transaction posting.
* Prepare monthly financial statements, including Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow reports.
* Leverage Claude to analyze accounting data, identify discrepancies, investigate unusual transactions, and assist with month-end closing.
* Use AI to review general ledger accounts, transaction classifications, reconciliations, and financial reports.
* Create and optimize AI prompts and repeatable workflows for bookkeeping and accounting processes.
* Use Claude for Excel/CSV data analysis, accounting schedules, variance analysis, and financial summaries.
* Assist with accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, depreciation, journal entries, and adjusting entries.
* Maintain proper documentation, workpapers, and accounting records.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive accounting processes using AI.
* Validate AI-generated accounting outputs for accuracy, compliance, and reliability before finalizing client deliverables.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 1–4 years of experience in US Accounting or US Bookkeeping.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of **QuickBooks Online (QBO)**.
* Practical, advanced working proficiency with **Claude AI** for accounting tasks.
* Understanding of US GAAP fundamentals and US bookkeeping practices.
* Strong knowledge of bank reconciliation, general ledger, AP, AR, journal entries, and month-end closing.
* Experience handling US client books and accounting data.
* Strong Excel skills, including working with financial data, formulas, spreadsheets, and CSV files.
* Ability to independently use AI tools to solve accounting problems and improve workflow efficiency.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience using Claude Projects, Artifacts, file uploads, or other advanced Claude features for accounting workflows.
* Experience creating reusable AI prompts for accounting operations.
* Exposure to AI-assisted automation, accounting workflow optimization, and financial data analysis.
* Familiarity with other AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or Microsoft Copilot.

title: GBM - Systematic Credit - Quantitative Engineering - Associate - Bengaluru
description:
**Team Overview**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Systematic Credit Team is a global, multi-disciplinary market-making group that leverages advanced quantitative methods, technology, and deep market insights to trade corporate bonds, credit derivatives, and Fixed Income ETFs.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of financial engineering, machine learning, and high-performance computing, our team in Bengaluru works in lockstep with global desks in New York, London, and Hong Kong. We design, backtest, and deploy systematic market-making strategies that provide liquidity, capture alpha, and manage risk in historically fragmented and over-the-counter (OTC) credit markets.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Quantitative Researcher at the Associate or Vice President level, you will drive the research agenda and infrastructure for our systematic credit market-making strategies. You will take ownership of the end-to-end quantitative pipeline—from sourcing and structuring complex credit datasets to engineering predictive features, building alpha models, and developing the core platforms that democratize signal generation across the broader team.
  
  
For candidates entering at the Vice President (VP) level, you will also be expected to lead key architectural decisions for our research platform, mentor junior researchers, and collaborate directly with global trading desks to transition models from research into production.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Alpha Generation & Strategy Development: Conduct rigorous statistical research to identify predictive signals (alphas) across corporate bonds and credit ETFs. Apply advanced time-series analysis, machine learning, and alternative data processing to model credit spread dynamics.
* Consolidated Research-Grade Data Framework & Pipeline: Architect and build a consolidated, high-performance, research-grade data framework and pipeline to back signal generation. Ingest, clean, and normalize diverse, noisy credit datasets (e.g., TRACE, dealer runs, electronic communication network feeds) to establish a robust "Golden Source" for quantitative research.
* AI-Driven Self-Service Signal Backtesting Platform: Design, develop, and maintain an open, scalable, AI-based platform that allows researchers and traders to seamlessly upload signal ideas, leverage machine learning for automated parameter tuning, and backtest them against a standardized, point-in-time, and bias-free simulation framework.
* Quantitative Infrastructure & Tooling: Collaborate with quantitative developers to build and scale backtesting engines, simulation frameworks, and production-grade analytics libraries. Ensure research code is modular, well-tested, and optimized for high-performance computing environments.

**Required Experience & Education**

* Education: Master’s or PhD degree in a highly quantitative STEM discipline (e.g., Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research, or Financial Engineering).

**Experience**

* 3+ years of professional experience in quantitative research, financial engineering, or data science.

**Core Competencies & Technical Skills**

* Quantitative & Fixed Income Foundations: Deep understanding of probability, statistics, linear algebra, and time-series analysis, paired with a strong conceptual grasp of bond pricing, yield-to-price conversions, credit spreads, and interest rate risk (duration/convexity).
* Advanced Programming: Advanced proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-Learn) with a software engineering mindset—combining rapid mathematical prototyping with clean, modular, and well-documented code. Object-oriented programming in C++ or Java is highly desirable.
* Data Engineering & Quantitative Toolkit: Experience managing large-scale, noisy, and unstructured datasets using SQL and high-performance time-series databases (e.g., KDB+/Q, ClickHouse). Proficient in applying machine learning techniques (regression, tree-based models, neural networks) to financial data.
* Intellectual Honesty & Collaborative Communication: Driven to understand market mechanics rather than just curve-fitting. Possesses the analytical honesty to challenge assumptions, iterate on failed hypotheses, and translate complex quantitative concepts into clear, actionable insights for global stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct experience researching systematic corporate bond or credit derivatives strategies.
* Experience building self-service quantitative research platforms, APIs, or shared backtesting frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with KDB+/Q or managing large-scale, tick-level financial datasets.

 Auric AI Labs is developing the world's most advanced AI\-powered vision intelligence platform for defense applications. Our system processes satellite (EO, IR, SAR, hyperspectral) and drone imagery to detect, classify, and track high\-value enemy assets like tanks, radars, missile launchers, aircraft, and warships.

* Shape the future of AI\-driven defense solutions while making a direct contribution to national security.

EisnerAmper is seeking a detail-oriented Sales Pipeline Data Analyst to support CRM data quality and pipeline management across its Advisory Services Group and Outsourced Services Group.

The candidate will be responsible for auditing, cleaning, maintaining, and validating sales pipeline data within NetSuite CRM and other approved CRM platforms.

The role involves identifying duplicate, incomplete, inaccurate, stale, and misclassified opportunity records, coordinating with business development professionals and practice leadership to resolve discrepancies, and ensuring reliable pipeline reporting, forecasting, and KPI tracking.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on CRM experience, strong Excel skills, excellent attention to detail, and an understanding of sales pipeline management and data quality processes.

Key Responsibilities

**CRM Data Management & Data Quality**

* Conduct regular audits of CRM and sales pipeline records.
* Identify and resolve duplicate, stale, incomplete, inaccurate, and non-compliant records.
* Maintain CRM data quality through daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly hygiene activities.
* Validate opportunity fields, stages, ownership, close dates, service line coding, and originator attribution.
* Update and correct CRM records while ensuring compliance with established data standards.
* Investigate data discrepancies and escalate unresolved issues when necessary.

**Sales Pipeline Management**

* Monitor aging, stalled, dormant, duplicate, and misclassified opportunities.
* Coordinate with opportunity owners and stakeholders to obtain missing information.
* Ensure accurate opportunity classifications and timely updates.
* Support pipeline reporting, forecasting, and KPI accuracy.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Prepare and distribute pipeline hygiene reports, scorecards, and exception reports.
* Support pipeline review meetings through data preparation and follow-up activities.
* Assist in creating and maintaining CRM reports, dashboards, and data quality monitoring tools.
* Identify recurring data quality trends and recommend improvements.

**Process Improvement & Documentation**

* Maintain CRM data quality procedures, SOPs, hygiene checklists, and field definitions.
* Document recurring data issues and recommend process improvements.
* Identify opportunities for automation and improved reporting workflows.
* Support consistent CRM practices across NetSuite, Salesforce, HubSpot, and other approved platforms.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work with Growth teams, business development professionals, and practice leadership.
* Communicate data quality issues and follow up on corrective actions.
* Guide CRM users on data entry standards and opportunity management procedures.
* Ensure stakeholders follow established CRM data quality requirements.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales Operations, Data Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 2+ years of experience working with CRM systems.
* Experience in CRM data entry, cleanup, auditing, or quality assurance.
* Exceptional attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate discrepancies and identify root causes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate with stakeholders and follow up on corrective actions.
* Availability for at least 3–4 hours of regular overlap with U.S. business hours.

Desired Qualifications

* Experience with NetSuite CRM, Salesforce, HubSpot, or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including:
* Filtering and sorting large datasets.
* VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and other lookup functions.
* Pivot tables.
* Data validation and cleanup.
* Understanding of sales pipeline stages, forecasting, lead attribution, and opportunity ownership.
* Experience supporting professional services, consulting, accounting, or advisory organizations.
* Exposure to SQL, Power BI, Tableau, and reporting tools.
* Experience using AI, automation, or data analysis tools to improve data quality and operational workflows.

title: Senior Specialist , Data Science
description:
Job Description
  
  
Senior Specialist – Brand Strategy Analytics (BSA)
  
At our company, we are leveraging analytics and technology as we invent for life on behalf of patients around the world. Our Digital Human Health (DHH) organization brings this purpose to life by transforming how we understand patients, markets, customers, and brands, and by leveraging data, analytics, and technology to enable better, faster, value-driven decisions.
  
  
The Senior Specialist – Brand Strategy Analytics (BSA), based out in India, will serve as a strategic thought partner and team leader supporting US and global business teams. Leading across products and therapeutic areas, the individual will drive a high-performing analytical team to act as a strategic thought partner and help framing critical business questions, integrate diverse healthcare and commercial analytics into actionable recommendations across the commercial lifecycle—from understanding disease and patient flows through opportunity assessment, launch excellence, and brand performance. As a key leadership figure within DHH India, the candidate will influence senior stakeholders, navigate organizational maturity, drive talent strategy and AI-enabled capability building, cross-geography alignment, and the execution of high-impact strategic initiatives that advance our commercial capabilities.
  
  
Role Overview
  
The Senior Specialist will lead a team of analytical professionals, partnering with US and global brand leaders, and cross-functional partners to translate strategic priorities and ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and decision-ready recommendations. Rather than focusing on individual analyses or isolated datasets, the individual will guide their team to connect insights across multiple analytical sources and capabilities to develop an integrated perspective on patients, markets, competitors, and brand performance, answering three fundamental questions: What is happening? Why is it happening? And what should we consider doing next?
  
  
This role requires deep therapeutic-area domain expertise, pharmaceutical commercial acumen, unstructured problem-solving, stakeholder engagement, and analytical depth. Leading initiatives end-to-end, the Senior Specialist will manage a strategic analytical roadmap, partner closely with adjacent commercial capabilities—including forecasting, market research, and competitive intelligence—to develop a unified brand perspective. Crucially, the individual will serve as a key driver of DHH and BSA enterprise capability. They will actively lead cross-functional communities of practice and institutionalize scalable analytical frameworks across therapeutic areas, mentor and shape the talent profile of junior colleagues, and champion innovative technologies (including GenAI) under appropriate governance to maximize commercial productivity and strategic impact across the organization.
  
  
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:
  
  

* Commercial Strategy Market Insights
* Lead and direct end-to-end analytical roadmaps to answer critical global and regional brand strategy questions across disease understanding, patient opportunity, market dynamics, brand performance, and pipeline brands/assets.
* Leverage expert-level knowledge of US and global commercial databases and healthcare markets to strategically identify, structure, and guide the team’s utilization of diverse data sources (including claims, EHR, syndicated market data, specialty pharmacy, hub, and SDoH data).
* Direct commercial cohort and patient-flow analyses to evaluate treatment dynamics, lines of therapy, switching patterns, compliance, and treatment funnels, converting complex data observations into quantified market opportunities and strategic growth pools.
* Align and integrate analytical findings with critical commercial milestones, driving the development of evidence-based patient-flow inputs, assumptions, and market insights for pipeline brand evaluations, business development decisions, forecasting, scenario planning, and brand strategy.
* Champion launch strategy and launch excellence by designing comprehensive performance measurement frameworks—including launch KPIs, leading indicators, and tracking thresholds—to enable proactive brand management and post-launch optimization.

Advanced Analytics Methodology
  
  

* Determine the appropriate methodological depth of analytics based on the strategic decision required, guiding the team on when descriptive business synthesis is sufficient and when statistical, predictive, or advanced methodologies add incremental decision value.
* Provide functional and methodological direction on how the team extracts, integrates, and analyzes complex commercial datasets (utilizing SQL, Python/R, Databricks, and Dataiku) to ensure technical execution aligns perfectly with the brands strategic questions.
* Establish robust analytical quality standards and validation frameworks within the team, ensuring data interpretations, commercial business rules, and cohort definitions are highly reliable, logical, and standardized.
* Guide the triangulation of quantitative analyses with qualitative insights, training the team to account for data representativeness, coverage limitations, and commercial context to produce robust strategic recommendations.
* Govern the deployment of emerging capabilities (including GenAI and prompt-based analytics) within team workflows, selectively leveraging automation to accelerate commercial data synthesis, coding efficiency, and knowledge reuse.

description: Roles & Responsibilities Develop Databricks notebooks, jobs, and workflows to replicate and enhance DB2/Guidewire-based pipelines and transformations. Integrate Databricks with AWS/S3 or Azure ADLS, ADF/Synapse, Key Vault, and Snowflake as required. Optimize Databricks clusters, jobs, and queries for performance and cost. Implement incremental loads, CDC patterns, and batch schedules for large datasets. Collaborate with Snowflake and dbt teams to ensure consistent data models and data contracts. Participate in data validation and reconciliation between DB2 400 / Guiderwire and Databricks outputs. Follow coding standards, version control, and CI/CD practices using Git/Azure DevOps. Provide defect fixes and support during SIT/UAT and post go-live stabilization. Experience :Legacy Demystification & Ingestion (DB2/400 & Guidewire)8+ years of experience in databricks with understanding complex legacy data models and getting that data into the cloud: Extracting DB2/AS400: Experience with Change Data Capture (CDC) or scheduled batch extractions from DB2 into cloud storage. Involves working through JDBC connections, mapping table dependencies, and re-platforming legacy SQL to distributed computing standards. Handling Guidewire Data: Integrating with Guidewire Cloud Data Access (CDA) or InsuranceSuite to replicate complex P&C (Property & Casualty) insurance schemas. Business Logic Refactoring: Translating rigid legacy procedural code (e.g., RPG/COBOL background logic, stored procedures) into scalable distributed patterns (PySpark, Spark SQL, and Scala). title: Data Engineer II, Alexa AI - ML Engineering
description:
**Description**
Join Alexa AI - ML Engineering and help power personalized, proactive experiences for hundreds of millions of Alexa customers worldwide. As a Data Engineer II, you will design and own the large-scale data pipelines that turn raw customer-interaction signals into the context and features our personalization and proactive-agent models depend on, working side-by-side with SDEs to shape our data strategy and architecture.
  
  

* You will build and operate ETL/ELT pipelines processing billions of records a day, using AWS big-data services (Glue, EMR, Kinesis, Redshift, DynamoDB) and distributed compute.
* You will partner with SDEs and applied scientists to define data strategy, contracts, and feature pipelines, and to decide architecture direction together.
* You will own operational health: data migrations, schema/platform updates, and triage of pipeline tickets, directly supporting the SDE team's work.
* This is a high-visibility role: the data you deliver, and keep running, directly shapes what Alexa proactively tells customers, and when.

Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Partner closely with SDEs to help define data strategy, architecture direction, and the long-term roadmap for the team's data platform.
* Design, build, and own ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest, transform, and load customer-interaction and context data at a scale of billions of records per day.
* Own operational items end-to-end: data migrations, schema and platform updates, and triage/resolution of data-pipeline tickets, providing day-to-day support to the SDE team.
* Partner with applied scientists and ML engineers to define data contracts, feature pipelines, and data-quality checks feeding personalization and proactive-agent models.
* Operate and continuously improve production pipelines: optimize data delivery, redesign for scalability, manage deployments, and drive root-cause fixes for pipeline incidents.
* Establish and document best practices for data modeling, warehousing, and pipeline design across the team.

A day in the life
  
  
You'll join SDEs in a design discussion to shape data strategy and architecture, then pick up a migration or platform-update ticket and see it through to resolution. You'll trace a data-quality issue in a personalization feature pipeline, support SDEs with any operational asks on your pipelines, and monitor the health of systems processing billions of daily customer-interaction events. You'll partner with applied scientists to onboard new signal sources and triage pipeline alerts.
  
  
**About The Team**
Alexa AI - ML Engineering builds the personalization and proactive-intelligence systems that let Alexa anticipate what customers need before they ask. Data Engineers work side-by-side with SDEs and applied scientists, combining data strategy and large-scale engineering to turn billions of daily customer-interaction signals into the context, features, and content that drive Alexa's ranking, personalization, and proactive-agent experiences. We value ownership, data quality, and working backwards from the customer.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of data engineering experience
* 4+ years of SQL experience
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
* Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)

title: Network Engineer
description:
**Network Engineer**

**Location:** Bengaluru

**Employment type:** Contractual / Work from Office

**Experience:** 5-8 years

**Availability:** Immediate joiners only

**About Us**

We are a growth systems company that partners with businesses to create structure, clarity, and momentum in how they grow. We believe growth is not achieved through isolated efforts, but through well-built systems that work together over time.

Our work sits at the intersection of strategy, technology, branding, and marketing, bringing these elements together into integrated systems designed to scale.

**The Role**

We are looking for an experienced **Network Engineer** with a minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in network infrastructure management, routing and switching, network security, and cloud connectivity.

The candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, managing, and troubleshooting network infrastructure, including establishing secure and reliable connectivity between two geographically separate physical locations and cloud environments.

The role involves working on a cloud data migration project, ensuring seamless communication, secure data transfer, network availability, and minimal disruption to business operations.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Network Infrastructure Management**

* Design, configure, implement, and maintain LAN, WAN, WLAN, and enterprise network infrastructure.
* Configure and manage routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, and other network devices.
* Manage VLANs, trunking, STP, EtherChannel, subnetting, and IP addressing.
* Implement and troubleshoot routing protocols such as OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, and static routing.
* Monitor network performance, identify bottlenecks, and proactively resolve connectivity issues.
* Ensure network availability, reliability, scalability, and optimal performance.
* Maintain network configurations, backups, topology diagrams, and technical documentation.

**2. Cloud Data Migration & Multi-Site Network Connectivity**

* Plan, design, and implement secure network connectivity between two geographically separate physical locations to facilitate cloud data migration.
* Establish and manage secure communication channels between both locations and cloud environments using Site-to-Site VPN, IPsec VPN, dedicated connectivity, or equivalent technologies.
* Configure and manage routers, switches, firewalls, gateways, and network interfaces required for inter-site and cloud connectivity.
* Assess existing network infrastructure, bandwidth requirements, latency, throughput, and connectivity limitations before initiating data migration.
* Design and implement network architecture to ensure uninterrupted and secure data transfer between both physical locations and cloud platforms.
* Configure routing, VLANs, subnetting, firewall rules, NAT, and access control policies to enable secure communication across both locations.
* Coordinate with cloud infrastructure teams to establish connectivity with platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Monitor network performance during large-scale data transfers and troubleshoot latency, packet loss, bandwidth constraints, and connectivity failures.
* Implement network redundancy, failover mechanisms, and backup connectivity to minimise migration downtime.
* Ensure secure data transmission through encryption, firewall policies, and appropriate network security controls.
* Perform network testing, connectivity validation, and performance assessments before, during, and after migration.
* Coordinate with cloud architects, system administrators, storage teams, and external vendors to ensure successful migration execution.
* Support post-migration network optimisation, troubleshooting, and validation to ensure stable connectivity between both physical locations and cloud environments.

**3. Network Security & Firewall Management**

* Configure and maintain network security policies, firewall rules, VPNs, and access control mechanisms.
* Manage firewall solutions such as Fortinet, Palo Alto, Cisco ASA, Check Point, or equivalent technologies.
* Implement and manage IPsec VPN, SSL VPN, NAT, ACLs, and network access control.
* Monitor network traffic, identify potential security threats, and implement preventive measures.
* Ensure compliance with network security standards and organisational policies.
* Perform regular security reviews, configuration audits, and vulnerability assessments in coordination with the security team.

**4. Network Monitoring & Troubleshooting**

* Monitor network infrastructure using tools such as Wireshark, PRTG, SolarWinds, or Zabbix.
* Troubleshoot complex network issues involving packet loss, latency, routing, DNS, DHCP, and connectivity.
* Identify root causes of network outages and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Perform regular network health checks and preventive maintenance.
* Maintain incident reports, troubleshooting records, and network performance documentation.

**5. Infrastructure Maintenance & Coordination**

* Manage network infrastructure upgrades, configurations, backups, and patch management.
* Coordinate with system administrators, cybersecurity teams, cloud engineers, and external service providers.
* Work with internet service providers and vendors for network implementation, support, and issue escalation.
* Support disaster recovery planning, business continuity, and network failover testing.
* Maintain updated network architecture diagrams, SOPs, and configuration records.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in Network Engineering or Network Administration.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, OSI Model, IPv4, IPv6, subnetting, and network fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, Fortinet, or equivalent networking technologies.
* Strong knowledge of routing and switching technologies.
* Practical experience with routing protocols such as OSPF, BGP, and EIGRP.
* Hands-on experience in firewall configuration and management.
* Experience with IPsec VPN, SSL VPN, NAT, ACLs, and network segmentation.
* Experience establishing connectivity between multiple physical locations and cloud environments.
* Strong understanding of Site-to-Site VPN and secure inter-site connectivity.
* Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud networking.
* Knowledge of DNS, DHCP, VLANs, STP, and network troubleshooting.
* Experience with network monitoring and diagnostic tools.
* Understanding of bandwidth planning, latency optimisation, redundancy, and failover configurations.

**Good To Have**

* Cisco CCNA, CCNP, JNCIA, or equivalent networking certifications.
* Experience with AWS Direct Connect, AWS Site-to-Site VPN, Azure VPN Gateway, or Azure ExpressRoute.
* Knowledge of cloud networking concepts, including VPC, VNet, subnets, route tables, gateways, and network security groups.
* Experience handling large-volume data transfers across geographically distributed infrastructure.
* Exposure to SD-WAN and enterprise wireless networking.
* Knowledge of network automation using Python, Ansible, or scripting tools.
* Understanding of high availability, redundancy, load balancing, and disaster recovery.
* Experience working with enterprise-scale network infrastructure.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field.
* Relevant professional certifications in networking will be an added advantage.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong practical experience in managing and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructure.
* Ability to independently design, configure, and manage network connectivity across multiple physical locations.
* Prior experience supporting cloud data migration or large-scale infrastructure migration projects.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with cross-functional technical teams.
* Proactive approach towards network security, performance optimisation, and infrastructure reliability.

title: Lead Test Engineer
description:
Overview:

**WELCOME TO SITA**
-------------------

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
==================

We are a global integration and delivery team. We implement, integrate and support border management and passenger data solutions for government customers around the world. We deploy and configure applications, integrate them with government and airline systems, ship regular releases, and support them in production. Our teams are spread across several regions and time zones.

**PURPOSE**
-----------

The Lead Test Engineer owns end-to-end quality for the team's deliveries. You'll plan, design and run functional, integration, non-functional and regression testing for complex, message-driven systems. You'll also lead the move from manual regression testing to a scalable automated test framework. You'll work closely with engineers, DevOps, product teams and customer stakeholders to make sure each release is stable, high-performing and ready for production.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

**Test strategy and planning**
------------------------------

* Write test strategies, test plans and test cases for releases, customer implementations, data migrations and environment builds.
* Define test scope, entry and exit criteria, and the evidence needed for formal sign-off at each stage.
* Estimate test effort and fit test activities into sprint and release plans.

**Functional and integration testing**
--------------------------------------

* Test end-to-end flows across distributed systems, including message queues, REST/SOAP APIs, rules engines and third-party integrations.
* Check business rules, decision logic, data transformation, and audit and logging behaviour.
* Run system integration testing with customers, end-to-end testing and production verification testing.
* Test role-based access, user workflows and the user interface.

**Non-functional testing**
--------------------------

* Plan and run load, stress, soak and performance testing using realistic production volumes.
* Test high-availability, failover and disaster-recovery behaviour against agreed RTO/RPO targets.
* Run negative and resilience scenarios, such as downstream services becoming unavailable, service restarts, and retry and recovery behaviour.

**Test automation**
-------------------

* Design, build and maintain a reusable regression automation framework for APIs, messaging and data validation.
* Run automated tests across development, test and production-like environments.
* Add automated tests to CI/CD pipelines with DevOps, so release cycles are shorter and more predictable.

**Data migration testing**
--------------------------

* Test data migrations: record-count reconciliation, field-level comparison, business-rule checks, mock cutover rehearsals and verification after migration.

**Defect management and reporting**
-----------------------------------

* Run defect triage and severity classification, and track defects through to closure with development teams.
* Produce test summary reports, reconciliation reports and quality dashboards. Give go/no-go input for releases.

**Leadership and collaboration**
--------------------------------

* Guide and mentor test engineers. Review their test design and execution.
* Work with engineering, DevOps, project managers and customer test teams in different time zones.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of quality engineering practices.

Qualifications:

**SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**
=========================

**Essential**
-------------

* 8+ years in software testing or quality engineering, with at least 2–3 years in a lead or senior role.
* Strong experience testing integration-heavy, message-driven systems: REST/SOAP APIs, IBM MQ or equivalent, and XML/JSON message formats.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Prime Video Finance
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon’s Prime Video is a premium on-demand video entertainment service that offers customers the greatest choice in what to watch from popular Amazon Original TV shows such as The Grand Tour, Jack Ryan, The Boys and the recent Golden Globe winning The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel, to Original Movies like the Oscar-winning Manchester by the Sea and The Salesman. The service also offers TV shows that are exclusively available for Prime members in each country such as American Gods, Mr Robot and Outlander, and more recently live sport including the US Open tennis and Premier League football. Prime Video is at the forefront of the entertainment industry and growing fast - now available in more than 240 countries and territories worldwide – and we work in a dynamic, and exciting environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.  
  
Prime Video Finance BI team seeks a business intelligence engineer to support Prime Video strategy and performance. You will be responsible for the production of key business reporting to leadership, building scalable data solutions to complex problems and performing ad-hoc deep dives to better understand and value performance metrics. You will work with upstream tech teams to create complex data ingestion pipelines for critical data sources, and create actionable KPIs for business teams. In this role, you will also work with key business stakeholders from Finance and Business organizations to identify challenges and translate them into technical requirements that can be solved with BI and Analytics tools.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The successful candidate will thrive in a data driven environment that it driven to deliver insights that is timely, accurate and actionable to aid decision support. Motivated by solving complex problems and excited about using data analytics to drive a business forward, the successful candidate will relish the opportunity of driving forward Prime Video's analytics to the next level. Some of the key responsibilities of this role will include:  
  
Own business-critical reporting that is leveraged globally by hundreds of users; from developing and maintaining large-scale data structures and ETL pipelines to creating reporting in Quicksight or Excel.  
Gather business requirements from key stakeholders in Finance and Business teams, and translate into scalable and automated solutions.  
Provide informed analysis, insight and recommendations around our business metrics to drive optimisation and more effective decision making.  
Build strong relationships with the Data Engineering and Core Analytics Tooling teams to enhance upstream data sources and develop data processes to enable more scalable and accurate reporting.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* 2+ years of Tableau Desktop, Quicksight or other relevant data visualization software experience
* Bachelor's degree or above in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
* Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
* Experience using SQL (Structured Query Language) to pull data from a database or data warehouse
* Experience using Python scripting to process data for modeling

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree or above in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
* Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.
* Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
* Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
* Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business

title: Field Signal Processing & Data Analysis Engineer
description:
Job Overview  
We are looking for a technically strong and analytical Field Signal Processing & Data Analysis Engineer to support UAV-based radar and sensing operations.

The role involves planning data acquisition activities, managing mission-related data workflows, validating sensor data quality, performing preliminary analysis and ensuring accurate transfer of field-acquired data to signal processing teams.

The ideal candidate should have a strong academic foundation in Mathematics and Physics, along with good programming skills in Python and C. Candidates with exposure to radar, RF systems, UAVs, remote sensing, imaging systems or scientific data analysis will be preferred.

This is a field-based technical role requiring regular travel across India alongside the technical team.  
Key Responsibilities  
Create and manage flight missions and data acquisition plans based on operational requirements.  
Support field teams in planning and executing data acquisition activities.  
Perform post-flight data transfer, validation and quality checks.  
Verify data integrity, including file completeness, timestamps, navigation data and acquisition parameters.  
Perform preliminary analysis of radar and sensor data to identify anomalies, inconsistencies and potential data-quality issues.  
Maintain traceability between flight configurations, acquired data and processing outputs.  
Prepare structured data handover packages for signal processing and engineering teams.  
Support troubleshooting of data acquisition, navigation and processing-related issues.  
Maintain technical documentation, including flight records, data logs, validation reports and analysis summaries.  
Coordinate with field operations and engineering teams to ensure accurate and timely data workflows.  
Eligibility & Requirements  
Bachelor's degree in Physics, Electronics, Computer Science, Signal Processing or a related technical discipline.  
Strong academic foundation in Mathematics and Physics, with good academic performance in both subjects.  
Strong programming skills in Python and C.  
Working knowledge of SQL and handling structured datasets.  
Familiarity with C++, MATLAB or equivalent scientific and data-analysis tools will be an advantage.  
Experience or exposure to technical data analysis, scientific data workflows or complex datasets.  
Strong mathematical, analytical and problem-solving abilities.  
Ability to interpret technical datasets and identify inconsistencies or anomalies.  
Must be willing to travel across India, including monthly travel with the technical team, based on project requirements.  
Preferred Experience & Technical Exposure  
Candidates with exposure to any of the following areas will be preferred:  
SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) and radar systems.  
RF systems and signal processing.  
UAV/drone platforms and aerial data acquisition.  
Imaging systems and sensor data processing.  
Remote sensing and geospatial datasets.  
Navigation data, flight logs and data acquisition workflows.  
Scientific computing, numerical analysis and algorithm development.  
Important Job Information  
This is a field-based technical position involving regular PAN-India travel.  
Monthly travel with the technical team is mandatory.  
Candidates should be comfortable working at different project locations across India.  
The role involves both field-level data acquisition support and technical data validation and analysis.  
Candidates must be comfortable working with technical teams in field and engineering environments.

title: Field Operations Manager
description:
Job Overview  
We are looking for a hands-on and highly disciplined Field Operations Manager to lead and coordinate field deployments for advanced UAV-based radar and sensing operations.

The role involves managing end-to-end field execution, coordinating technical teams, overseeing equipment deployment, handling operational logistics and ensuring that all field activities are carried out safely and efficiently.

This is a field-intensive position requiring extensive travel across India, including deployment at remote project locations. Candidates with an Ex-Army or Defence background and experience in managing field operations, teams and logistics will be preferred.  
Key Responsibilities  
Lead and coordinate field deployment activities, including equipment transportation, site readiness, operational planning and team coordination.  
Manage end-to-end execution of approved field test plans, ensuring adherence to operational procedures, flight sequences and mission requirements.  
Coordinate site permissions, area clearances, ATC coordination, logistics and other field access requirements.  
Conduct operational briefings and coordinate effectively with pilots, system engineers, data engineers and field technicians.  
Oversee daily flight operations, including GO/NO-GO decisions, sortie sequencing, turnaround activities and operational reporting.  
Ensure the safe handling, deployment and recovery of large UAV platforms and associated payload systems.  
Maintain operational documentation, including flight logs, checklists, issue trackers and field reports.  
Coordinate troubleshooting activities and escalate technical issues to the relevant engineering teams.  
Manage field teams and ensure operational discipline, safety, quality and timely mission execution.  
Drive operational efficiency while ensuring compliance with defined safety and operational procedures.  
Eligibility & Requirements  
Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Engineering, Aviation, Management or a related discipline.  
Ex-Army or Defence background will be strongly preferred.  
Experience managing field operations, technical deployments, logistics or multidisciplinary teams.  
Strong coordination, team management and operational planning abilities.  
Good understanding of field procedures, technical workflows and operational requirements.  
Must be comfortable working in field-based environments and travelling extensively across India.  
Willingness to work at remote project locations depending on operational requirements.  
Valid driving licence and ability to operate company vehicles for field deployment.  
Strong communication, decision-making and problem-solving skills.  
Preferred Experience  
Experience in UAV/drone operations, radar systems, aerospace systems or engineering test environments.  
Prior experience coordinating logistics, permissions and safety-critical operations.  
Experience managing teams and operations in remote or challenging field environments.  
Ex-Defence personnel with relevant operational leadership experience are particularly encouraged to apply.  
Important Job Information  
This is primarily a field-based position and not a regular office-based role.  
Candidates must be willing to travel across India based on ongoing project requirements.  
Travel may involve extended stays at project locations.  
Candidates must be comfortable coordinating with technical teams and managing field operations independently.

**Let me tell you about the role (intent)**

We are looking for a skilled Data Governance Analyst with hands-on experience in enterprise data catalog platforms such as Alation, Collibra, Atlan, or Informatica. The ideal candidate will bring strong knowledge of metadata management, catalog metamodel design, business glossary curation, taxonomy and ontology design, policies, standards, and asset relationship management. The role requires the ability to understand business requirements, analyze data and metadata, and translate business needs into structured, high-quality catalog constructs that improve data discoverability, trust, and governance adoption across the enterprise.

**What you will deliver (responsibilities)**

Success will be measured by the ability of the incumbent to deliver clear, impactful outcomes that drive bp’s governance standards and increase value by improving efficiencies using tooling capabilities. Key responsibilities include:

* Administer, configure, and continuously enhance the enterprise data catalog platform, including Alation, Collibra, Atlan, Informatica, or equivalent tools.

* Develop, maintain, and improve metadata models, asset types, hierarchies, relationships, templates, and catalog workflows.

* Monitor metadata health across Critical Data Elements (CDEs), data domains, and catalog assets, and drive improvements in quality, completeness, and consistency.

* Guide data stewards in business glossary curation, ensuring terms are defined, structured, and maintained in line with agreed design principles.

* Create and maintain self-service workflows and templates to support efficient creation, upload, and maintenance of catalog assets.

* Onboard and document enterprise data assets, including datasets, tables, columns, APIs, reports, dashboards, metrics, and other governed assets, ensuring metadata completeness and accuracy.

* Link business terms to data assets and establish cross-asset relationships, including lineage, ownership, classifications, policies, standards, and controls.

* Document and maintain data policies, standards, and guidelines within the catalog, ensuring alignment with enterprise governance practices.

* Support data owners, stewards, SMEs, and business teams in onboarding, documenting, certifying, and governing their data assets.

* Perform metadata quality checks, identify gaps, and recommend improvements to strengthen metadata consistency, coverage, usability, and adoption.

* Hands-on experience with catalog APIs to extract, transform, and utilize metadata for building intuitive business dashboards that provide insights into business terms, data domains, and approved Critical Data Elements (CDEs)

**What you will need to be successful (experience, job requirements & qualifications)**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related field.

* Exposure to data quality, data catalog and quality tool integration, data access governance, AI Governance, and data marketplace concepts.

* Certifications in Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Informatica, DAMA, DCAM, or related disciplines are optional but advantageous.

* Experience using GenAI capabilities to support metadata enrichment, catalog curation, classification, and governance automation.

* 5-7 years of experience in metadata management, data governance, and data cataloging.

* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major data catalog platform, such as Alation, Collibra, Atlan, Informatica, or a similar platform.

* Solid understanding of metadata management, catalog metamodels, data domains, subdomains, CDE concepts, and data product structures.

* Experience designing and managing business glossaries, taxonomies, data classifications, and sensitivity models.

* Ability to understand business processes, KPIs, and data requirements, and translate them into meaningful catalog metadata.

* Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or equivalent platforms; SQL; ETL/ELT concepts; and BI tools such as Power BI.

* Strong analytical thinking, stakeholder communication, collaboration, and documentation skills.

* Knowledge of data governance principles and frameworks such as DAMA or DCAM is advantageous.

title: Senior Analyst Business Finance
description:
Overview:

**WELCOME TO SITA**
-------------------

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

**PURPOSE**
-----------

Support the financial performance, planning and control of SITA’s Borders Business Unit through accurate reporting, insightful analysis and effective business partnering. The role provides dependable financial information and forward-looking insight to support revenue, margin, cash and cost decisions across a global portfolio.

Reporting directly to the Director, Business Finance for Borders, the Senior Analyst will work closely with Business Finance, Project Financial Control, Commercial, Delivery and regional teams. The role requires ownership of recurring deliverables, constructive challenge of assumptions and the ability to turn complex data into clear recommendations for business leaders.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

* **Financial reporting and performance analysis:** Prepare and validate monthly, quarterly and annual BU financial reporting, including revenue, gross margin, operating costs and cash performance. Explain actuals versus budget, forecast and prior year, highlighting underlying drivers, risks and opportunities.
* **Month-end close and financial control:** Support close activities, review accruals, deferrals, cost allocations and revenue/cost alignment with relevant accounting teams. Reconcile management information to financial systems, investigate exceptions and maintain a clear audit trail.
* **Budgeting, forecasting and long-range planning:** Consolidate inputs for budgets, rolling forecasts and the four-year business plan. Maintain robust revenue, margin, cost and headcount models; challenge assumptions and coordinate timely inputs from P&L owners and regional stakeholders.
* **Cash flow and working capital:** Consolidate project cash inflow and outflow projections with Project Financial Controllers, track forecast changes and identify collections, billing and cash-conversion risks for management review.
* **Business partnering and stakeholder follow-up:** Support monthly performance reviews with business and cost owners. Obtain explanations for variances, challenge the quality of submissions and translate analysis into practical actions and decisions.
* **Commercial and strategic analysis:** Prepare ad hoc profitability, pricing, investment and scenario analyses for contracts, products, business initiatives and potential acquisitions. Maintain financial models and assess financial implications of strategic options.
* **Cost optimisation and benefits tracking:** Model savings and margin-improvement initiatives, validate baselines and assumptions, monitor delivery against targets and flag shortfalls or changes in expected benefits.
* **Financial governance and compliance:** Apply SITA finance policies, internal controls and relevant IFRS principles. Support balance-sheet reviews, audit requests and consistency between statutory and management reporting, escalating material issues promptly.
* **Process transformation, innovation and AI:** Bring an open, curious and innovative mindset to challenge established ways of working and proactively redesign and transform finance processes, rather than simply making incremental improvements. Leverage Excel, Power BI, SITA finance systems and appropriate AI-enabled tools to automate workflows, enhance analytical insight, strengthen controls and deliver scalable, measurable improvements, in line with SITA information-security and data-governance requirements.

Qualifications:

**Education and Qualifications**
================================

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Economics, Business or a related discipline.
* Professional accounting qualification such as Chartered Accountant (CA) from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI), Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) from the Institute of Cost Accountants of India, ACCA, CPA, CIMA or an equivalent internationally recognised qualification, completed or at an advanced stage, is preferred.
* Strong grounding in financial accounting, management accounting, financial reporting and internal controls; an MBA in Finance is advantageous.

**Experience**
==============

* Typically 5+ years of relevant experience in Business Finance, FP&A, management accounting or financial controlling.
* Demonstrated experience delivering monthly reporting, variance analysis, budgets and forecasts in a complex business.
* Experience building financial models and turning operational data into commercially relevant recommendations.
* Exposure to revenue and margin analysis, cost control, cash forecasting and management reporting.
* Experience in a multinational, matrix or technology/services organisation is desirable.
* Evidence of working independently with cross-functional stakeholders, managing deadlines and constructively challenging inputs.

**Knowledge and Skills**
========================

* Advanced Excel skills, including robust financial modelling, reconciliations and large-data analysis.
* Strong FP&A capability across P&L drivers, forecasting, scenario analysis, cost and cash flow.
* Good grasp of accounting controls, accruals, deferrals, revenue/cost matching and allocation principles.
* Analytical rigour, excellent attention to detail and the judgement to distinguish material issues from noise.
* Proficiency with Power BI, reporting automation and enterprise finance systems; willingness and ability to adopt AI-enabled tools responsibly for financial analysis and process redesign.
* Ability to produce concise, decision-ready commentary and presentations for senior management.
* Clear English communication, confident stakeholder engagement and a collaborative approach across functions and cultures.
* Strong innovative and transformational mindset: open to new ideas, willing to challenge the status quo and capable of reimagining end-to-end processes, not merely improving existing steps. Able to identify opportunities to use automation and AI to deliver materially better efficiency, quality and business insight.
* Self-motivated, adaptable and organised; able to manage competing priorities and collaborate across Indian and European time zones.

**WHAT WE OFFER**
-----------------

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

**Flex Week:** Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)

* **Flex Day:** Make your workday suit your life and plans.

**Flex-Location:** Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.

**Employee Wellbeing:** We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

**Professional Development:** At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** and **Airport Council International** -available to all employees-to specialized solutions like **Pluralsight** for technology upskilling, **Harvard Business Publishing** for people leadership, **Stanford** for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.

**Competitive Benefits:** Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.*

description:

Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ: AEIS), enables design breakthroughs and drives growth for leading semiconductor and industrial customers. Our precision power and control technologies, along with our applications know-how, inspire close partnerships and innovation in thin-film and industrial manufacturing. We are proud of our rich heritage, award-winning technologies, and we value the talents and contributions of all Advanced Energy's employees worldwide.

  

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

  

The Senior Business Analyst – SAP S/4HANA Production Planning (PP) is responsible for leading business process analysis, solution design, implementation, optimization, and support activities related to SAP S/4HANA Production Planning. The role serves as a strategic liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams to ensure SAP solutions effectively support manufacturing and production planning processes.

  

The incumbent will leverage deep functional expertise in SAP Production Planning and extensive knowledge of manufacturing operations to drive process improvements, standardization, automation initiatives, and digital transformation projects. This role requires strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and project delivery capabilities while ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and SAP best practices.

  

**ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Business Analysis & Solution Design**

* Lead business analysis, requirements gathering, process assessment, and solution design initiatives for SAP S/4HANA Production Planning.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to analyze business needs and translate them into scalable SAP solutions.
* Facilitate workshops to evaluate current-state and future-state business processes.
* Develop business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specifications, process flows, and solution design documentation.
* Ensure SAP solutions align with business objectives, operational requirements, and SAP best practices.
  

* **SAP Production Planning Functional Expertise**

* Configure, support, and optimize end-to-end SAP PP processes, including:

* Demand Management
* Sales & Operations Planning (where applicable)
* Material Requirements Planning (MRP / MRP Live)
* Long-Term Planning (LTP)
* Planned Orders
* Production Orders
* Capacity Planning
* Production Scheduling
* Shop Floor Control
* Production Execution
* Goods Movements
* Production Confirmations
* Order Settlement and Closure
  

* **Master Data Management**

* Manage and support production planning master data including:

* Material Master
* Bills of Material (BOM)
* Work Centers
* Routings
* Production Versions
* Planning Parameters
* Production Resources and Tools (where applicable)
  

* **Process Improvement & Optimization**

* Identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct root cause analysis and recommend sustainable solutions.
* Drive process efficiency and operational excellence initiatives.
* Support adoption of SAP S/4HANA best practices and industry standards.
  

* **Integration & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Support integration and business processes across:

* SAP Materials Management (MM)
* SAP Sales & Distribution (SD)
* SAP Quality Management (QM)
* SAP Finance & Controlling (FI/CO)
* SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM)
