title: Slate Administrator
description:
ApplyBoard simplifies the study abroad application process by connecting international students, international student advisors, and educational institutions on one personalized platform. For more than a decade, ApplyBoard's team members have been dedicated to breaking down barriers to international education, while thriving at a company that invests in their career growth. Our six core values guide us in our mission to educate the world, and are the foundation of our company culture. As an organization built on diversity, our team members are representative of the students we support.

**The Opportunity:**

The position is accountable for configuration, data integrity, integrations, communications delivery, security, and the day to day operational health of the platform that carries every prospective student from first inquiry through enrollment.

This is a technical position. The incumbent writes queries, builds source formats, maintains the Slate rules engine, and owns the integration between Slate and Ellucian Colleague. The position has no direct reports.

**What You’ll Be Doing Every Day:**

**Platform Configuration and Ownership**

* Configure and maintain Slate application forms, events, portals, decision letters, materials, checklists, and status workflows.
* Build and maintain the Slate rules engine, including population rules, field maintenance rules, and workflow automation.
* Administer Slate Reader, including bins, review steps, scoring, and committee workflow for application review.
* Administer datasets, prompts, custom fields, and configurable joins, and enforce a documented field governance standard so the schema remains supportable.
* Manage sandbox and test instances, release testing, and controlled promotion of configuration changes to production.
* Evaluate Technologies quarterly releases and recommend adoption of capabilities that reduce institutional effort.

**Data, Integration, and Reporting**

* Own the bidirectional integration between Slate and Ellucian Colleague, including student record creation, program and term mapping, and financial aid touchpoints.
* Build and maintain source formats and inbound feeds, including Common App, test scores, transcript services, search names, National Student Clearinghouse, and international partner files.
* Author and maintain queries, exports, and scheduled jobs supporting daily operations and executive reporting.
* Own record matching, deduplication, and merge logic, and maintain the documented data dictionary and funnel stage definitions.
* Produce funnel and yield reporting that reconciles to the student information system, and resolve discrepancies before they reach Cabinet or Board reporting.
* Partner with the data and analytics team so that Slate data lands correctly in the University reporting environment.

**Communications Delivery**

* Administer Slate Deliver for email and text messaging, including templates, campaigns, deliverability, authentication records, suppression lists, and bounce management.
* Execute and maintain the migration of student text messaging to Slate Deliver, including opt in records, consent history, and number provisioning.
* Maintain compliance with CAN-SPAM, TCPA, and University communication governance standards.
* Enforce message frequency and audience governance so that students are not over contacted across communication platforms.

**Security, Compliance, and Governance**

* Administer role based permissions on a least privilege basis, and execute quarterly access reviews and same day offboarding.
* Maintain FERPA compliance in all configuration, reporting, and third party data sharing.
* Maintain configuration documentation, change logs, and recovery procedures for the platform.
* Support information security review of new Slate integrations, connectors, and vendor data exchanges.

**Support, Training, and Project Delivery**

* Serve as tier 2 and tier 3 support for Slate users across Admissions, Enrollment, Financial Aid, and Athletics.
* Develop and deliver training and written documentation for functional users so that platform capability is not concentrated in a single person.
* Contribute to project delivery for CRM consolidation, platform retirement, and downstream integration work.
* Participate in the Slate user community and applicable professional development.
* Perform other job related duties as assigned.

**What You Bring to the Table:**

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the essential functions of this position.

**Knowledge:**

* Bachelor’s degree, or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.
* Two or more years of hands-on Slate administration or configuration experience in a higher education setting.
* Working knowledge of Slate Rules, Source Formats, Configurable Joins, Deliver, and Reader.
* Knowledge of admissions and enrollment funnel operations, including application review, decision release, and yield activity.
* Knowledge of FERPA, CAN-SPAM, and TCPA as they apply to student records and student communication.
* Knowledge of student information system data structures. Ellucian Colleague experience preferred.
* Technolutions Slate certification or documented Slate Summit training preferred.
* Experience migrating from Salesforce or another CRM platform to Slate preferred.

**Skills:**

* Query writing skill in SQL or Slate query logic, including subqueries, joins, and exports, performed independently and without vendor assistance.
* Configuration skill across a CRM platform, including forms, workflow automation, and permission structures.
* Integration skill, including file based feeds, scheduled jobs, and web service connections between systems.
* Technical writing skill sufficient to produce documentation that another administrator can follow.
* Working skill with XML, XSLT, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as used in Slate portals and Deliver templates, preferred.
* Scripting skill in Python or a comparable language for data preparation, preferred.
* Troubleshooting skill sufficient to isolate a defect between the CRM, the integration layer, and the student information system.

**Abilities:**

* Ability to translate a functional request into a supportable technical configuration, and to decline configuration that will not scale.
* Ability to treat platform health as a personal accountability rather than a queue of tickets.
* Ability to reconcile reported figures to the source system, and to withhold any figure that cannot be substantiated.
* Ability to work to deadline during peak application, decision release, and term start cycles, including occasional evening and weekend hours.
* Ability to partner effectively with admissions counselors, enrollment leadership, and technical staff.
* Ability to maintain the confidentiality of student records at all times.

**About ApplyBoard**

ApplyBoard empowers students around the world to access international education. Our global team leverages cutting-edge technology to build innovative tools and share sector insights that support our network of international students and 1,500+ partner institutions. We've helped more than 1,300,000 students from over 180 countries with their study abroad journey so far, and we're just getting started.

Ready to join us? We're grateful for your interest in joining the ApplyBoard team. However, only select applicants will be contacted for an interview.

We may use artificial intelligence tools to support the hiring process, potentially while reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing applicant responses. These tools don't replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are made by our team members. If you'd like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

ApplyBoard welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates in all aspects of the hiring and selection process.

title: Telecommunications Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Convertway by Unicommerce is an AI-powered omnichannel marketing platform that helps e-commerce brands convert customer intent into measurable revenue. It enables brands to capture subscribers and automate high-impact journeys such as welcome flows, abandoned cart recovery, COD confirmation, win-back campaigns, and post-purchase engagement across AI Voice, WhatsApp, SMS, and Email. By combining autonomous AI Voice Agents, intelligent messaging, and real-time intent detection, Convertway engages high-intent shoppers instantly, recovers lost sales, and drives repeat purchases without manual follow-ups. The platform supports key revenue moments like abandoned cart recovery, COD confirmation, and post-purchase engagement, while leveraging billions of data points each month to deliver seamless omnichannel experiences. Teams at Convertway work on solutions that directly improve conversion rates, customer engagement, and retention for leading e-commerce brands.

**Role Description**
The Telecommunications Specialist role at Convertway by Unicommerce is a full-time, on-site position based in Ghaziabad. This role involves configuring, maintaining, and monitoring telecommunications systems that support AI Voice, WhatsApp, SMS, and other communication channels used in Convertway’s customer engagement journeys. The specialist will manage call routing, voice infrastructure, and messaging platforms to ensure reliable, high-quality connectivity and minimal downtime. Day-to-day responsibilities include troubleshooting network and telephony issues, coordinating with internal product and engineering teams, and working with vendors or service providers to resolve technical problems. The role also includes tracking performance metrics, implementing improvements to communication flows, and supporting customer-facing teams with telecommunication-related queries or escalations.

* Ability to work with telecommunications systems and infrastructure, including experience with Telecommunications Systems and general Telecommunications concepts.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills for diagnosing and resolving telephony, network, and messaging-related issues.
* Effective communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and clearly document technical configurations and incident resolutions.
* Customer service orientation to support internal stakeholders and ensure reliable communication experiences for end users.
* Familiarity with VoIP, SIP, and cloud-based communication platforms; experience with omnichannel or contact center solutions is an advantage.
* Relevant technical degree or diploma (e.g., Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Science, or related field) or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work on-site in Ghaziabad, manage multiple tasks, and respond to issues in a timely and organized manner.
* Exposure to e-commerce, SaaS, or marketing technology environments and understanding of data privacy and security practices is beneficial.

title: Security Architect - DevSecOps + Application Security
description:
Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.
  
  
**Why we need this role**
We are looking for a Security Architect specialising in Application Security and DevSecOps to join the Security and Resilience – Security Architecture team.
  
  
This role will act as a subject matter expert for secure software development and DevSecOps practices, supporting the integration of security controls into Colt’s development pipelines and ensuring applications are secure by design and by default.
  
  
The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, DevOps, Cloud, SOC and Risk teams to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring that Colt’s applications and services are designed, built and tested with security as a core requirement.
  
  
**The Role Combines**

* Application security architecture and design
* DevSecOps pipeline integration and tooling
* Security assurance and governance across internally developed applications

**You Will Play An Important Role In Supporting**

* Secure software development practices across Colt
* Security integration into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab)
* Reduction of vulnerabilities through automated scanning and testing
* Assurance of internet-facing applications through structured penetration testing activities

**What You Will Do**
  
  

* Provide security architecture expertise for application security and DevSecOps, supporting standards and best practices across the software development lifecycle
* Contribute to the target architecture for secure software development, aligned to Colt’s Secure by Design principles
* Support the integration of security controls into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab), including automated testing and policy enforcement
* Design and implement application security controls, including:

+ Static Application Security Testing (SAST)
+ Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST)
+ Software Composition Analysis (SCA) / dependency scanning
+ Secrets and credentials scanning

* Work with engineering teams to ensure consistent adoption of DevSecOps practices and secure coding approaches
* Support security architecture reviews and assurance activities for internally developed applications and services
* Identify and help reduce risks related to application vulnerabilities, insecure coding practices and exposed credentials
* Support the coordination and execution of third-party penetration testing of Colt’s internet-facing applications
* Assist in defining test scope, tracking execution and ensuring remediation of findings is properly managed
* Provide guidance to engineering teams on remediation and prioritisation of vulnerabilities
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of secure coding standards and architectural patterns
* Ensure alignment with regulatory requirements such as TSA, DORA and ISO27001 in application design and deployment
* Promote a security-first culture within development teams, including awareness and best practices
* Maintain awareness of emerging risks and technologies, including basic AI/LLM-related application risks, and support translation into practical controls where required
* Produce and maintain architecture artefacts, standards and guidance documentation

**Must Haves**
**What we're looking for**

* 5+ years of experience in information security, with a strong focus on application security and DevSecOps
* Strong understanding of secure software development practices and common application security risks (e.g. OWASP Top 10)
* Hands-on experience working with or integrating DevSecOps tooling within CI/CD environments (e.g. GitLab pipelines)
* Experience with application security testing tools and practices, including: SAST, DAST, SCA / dependency scanning and Secrets / credentials scanning.
* Experience contributing to security design reviews for applications and APIs
* Experience supporting or participating in penetration testing activities, including remediation tracking
* Strong understanding of modern application architectures (e.g. APIs, microservices, cloud-native applications)
* Knowledge of authentication and session management concepts within applications
* Experience performing or supporting risk assessments aligned to recognised frameworks
* Ability to translate technical vulnerabilities into business-aligned risk and remediation actions
* Strong collaboration skills with engineering and development teams
* Strong communication skills (technical and non-technical)

**Might Haves**

* Experience with GitLab security tooling and pipeline integrations
* Familiarity with cloud-native application security (Azure / GCP environments)
* Exposure to API security controls and testing approaches
* Basic understanding of AI/LLM application risks, such as prompt injection or data exposure
* Experience working within regulated environments (telecommunications, financial services, critical infrastructure)
* Understanding of Telecoms Security Act (TSA) requirements in application design

**What We Offer You**
**Looking to make a mark?**
At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.
  
  
Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.
  
  
Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.
  
  
We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.
  
  
**Diversity and inclusion**

* Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.

**Most Recently We Have**

* Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
* Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
* Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our DEI pages.

**Benefits**
Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.
  
  

* Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
* Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
* Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
* Global Family Leave Policy.
* Employee Assistance Program.
* Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.

**A global network**

* When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

title: Advertising Account Manager
description:
As an advertising Account Manager, you'll work within an advertising or multi\-service agency, acting as a link between the agency and its clients. You'll be responsible for the coordination of advertising campaigns and therefore communicating clearly to all those involved. You may also be known as an account handler.
 



  





 It is vital to understand the needs of your clients, which you'll learn through liaising closely with them throughout campaigns, often on a daily basis. You'll also manage administrative and campaign work to ensure that advertising projects are completed on time and on budget.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 As an advertising Account Manager, you'll need to:
 


* meet and liaise with clients to discuss and identify their marketing requirements
* work with agency colleagues to devise an advertising campaign that meets the client's brief and budget
* present (alongside agency colleagues \- particularly the account manager) the campaign ideas and budget to the client
* work with the agency heads to brief media, creative and research staff and assist with the formulation of marketing strategies
* liaise with, and act as the link between, the client and the advertising agency by maintaining regular contact with both
* ensure that communication flows effectively
* negotiate with clients and agency staff about the details of campaigns
* present creative work to clients for approval or modification
* handle budgets, manage campaign costs, and invoice clients
* write client reports
* monitor the effectiveness of campaigns
* undertake administrative tasks
* arrange and attend meetings
* make pitches, along with other agency staff, with the aim of securing new business for the agency.



  





**What to expect** 



* Although you'll generally be office\-based, travel within the working day is frequent as you'll be expected to visit clients and may attend TV shoots, radio recordings or castings. Absence from home overnight and overseas work or travel is occasionally required.
* The working environment is generally informal, although the smart dress is often the norm. The role can involve socializing with clients.



  





**Qualifications** 




 Although this area of work is open to all graduates, a degree or HND in the following subjects may improve your chances, especially as advertising is an increasingly competitive sector to enter:
 


* advertising
* business/management
* communications
* English
* marketing



  





**Skills** 




 You will need to show evidence of the following:
 


* excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* a proactive attitude, with the ability to use initiative
* excellent organizational skills
* the ability to work under pressure and assimilate large quantities of information quickly, while maintaining attention to detail
* drive
* flexibility
* effective teamworking skills
* influencing and negotiation skills
* oral and written communication skills
* commercial awareness
* a passion for advertising and an understanding of what makes a good advertisement
* a willingness to learn
* resilience, to enable you to deal with problems and constructive criticism
* IT literacy and an awareness of how the industry is developing in light of new communication technologies.

title: Cloud DBA Migration Consultant
description:
Are you passionate about helping organizations modernize and migrate business-critical databases to the cloud?

Do you enjoy solving complex database migration challenges across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments?

Would you like to work on large-scale cloud transformation projects while combining database expertise, customer engagement, and migration delivery?

At SoftwareOne, we help organizations modernize their data platforms and accelerate cloud adoption through expert consulting and delivery services. We are looking for a Cloud Database Migration DBA to support database transformation initiatives across AWS, Azure, and on-premises environments, helping customers migrate, optimize, and modernize their database workloads.

As a Cloud Database Migration DBA, you will be responsible for assessing, planning, and executing database migration and modernization projects across cloud and on-premises environments. Working closely with Cloud Architects, Infrastructure Engineers, Application Teams, Security Specialists, and customer stakeholders, you will ensure successful migration outcomes while minimizing risk, downtime, and business disruption.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Delivering database migration and modernization projects across on-premises, AWS, Azure, and managed database platforms.
* Performing database assessments, compatibility reviews, migration planning, sizing recommendations, and technical discovery activities.
* Designing and executing migration approaches, validation plans, cutover strategies, rollback plans, and post-migration support activities.
* Supporting database administration activities including performance tuning, backup and recovery, replication, security, availability, and disaster recovery.
* Troubleshooting migration issues, replication challenges, connectivity problems, performance bottlenecks, and data consistency concerns.
* Collaborating with customer and project teams to develop migration runbooks, technical documentation, knowledge transfer materials, and successful project outcomes.

**Job Requirements**

Strong experience working with enterprise database platforms such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL.

Practical experience delivering cloud database migration projects involving AWS and/or Azure database services.

Strong understanding of database migration methodologies including assessment, schema conversion, remediation, validation, reconciliation, and cutover execution.

Knowledge of Change Data Capture (CDC), replication technologies, high availability, disaster recovery, backup and recovery, and downtime minimization strategies.

Strong SQL skills, database performance troubleshooting expertise, and experience optimizing database workloads.

Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and customer-facing consulting skills.

**Company description**


SoftwareOne and Crayon have come together to form a global, AI-powered software and cloud solutions provider with a bold vision for the future. We empower our teams to work across borders, innovate fearlessly, and continuously develop their skills through world-class learning and development programs. Whether you're passionate about cloud, software, data, AI, or building meaningful client relationships, you’ll find a place to thrive here. Join us and be part of a purpose-driven culture where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your career can go global.

title: Principal Technical Account Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Oracle Database Consultant**
We are seeking Oracle Database professionals to provide 24x7 operational and advanced support for mission-critical customer environments. The role includes database administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, performance tuning, high availability, backup/recovery, patching, and incident resolution across Oracle Database platforms.
  
  

* Administer, monitor, maintain, patch, upgrade, and troubleshoot Oracle Database environments.
* Perform SQL, database, memory, and performance tuning; analyze AWR/ASH and resolve complex performance issues.
* Manage Oracle RAC, ASM, RMAN, Data Guard, Fast-Start Failover, backup/recovery, and disaster-recovery operations.
* Support Oracle GoldenGate, Exadata, multitenant databases (CDB/PDB), Enterprise Manager, and OCI-hosted databases where applicable.
* Conduct database health checks, capacity reviews, proactive risk identification, and operational reporting.
* Resolve incidents within SLA, lead technical escalations, document root causes, and maintain support runbooks.
* Work closely with customer IT teams, Oracle Support, Development, and internal SMEs to drive issues to closure.
* Support database security capabilities including TDE, Oracle Key Vault, Database Vault, wallets, and AVDF where required.
* Provide clear customer communication, technical status updates, and action plans during critical incidents.

**Desired profile:**

* L3 DBA / SME: 10+ years of experience with advanced expertise in Oracle Database, Exadata, RAC, ASM, Data Guard, GoldenGate, performance tuning, backup/recovery, and high-severity escalations.
* Experience with Oracle Database 11g, 12c, 18c, and 19c; OCI and Oracle Enterprise Manager experience is preferred.
* BE/BTech/MCA/MS or equivalent experience; Oracle OCA/OCP, OCI, or Autonomous Database certifications are desirable.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, customer-management, and escalation-management skills.
* Willingness to work in a 24x7 support model and travel to customer locations when required.

**Qualifications:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field. Oracle certifications (e.g., OCI , OCA, OCP) are preferred.
* Experience: 8-12 years of hands-on experience with Oracle cloud administration and support.
* Shift : 24\*7 Shift working from Client Site Chennai / Bangalore . No remote or WFH allowed.

**Personal Skills**

* Strong experience in service delivery and/or project management is required.
* Oracle products and services knowledge will be highly appreciated as well as experience in Oracle HW platforms and OS.
* Experience on Enterprise Customers is required
* Excellent communication / relationship building skills
* Customer focused and results oriented

* Organized with strong attention to detail
* Decision making / problem solving skills
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent activities (customer engagements)
* Highly professional: Ability to deal with senior and exec stakeholders with confidence
* Strong analytic skills and ability to identify potential risks and issues

**Responsibilities**
**Technical Skills for an L3 / Senior Database Administrator**

* Advanced Oracle Database administration, architecture, upgrades, and patching.
* Expert performance tuning using AWR, ASH, ADDM, execution plans, and SQL optimization.
* Administration and troubleshooting of Oracle RAC, ASM, and Data Guard.
* Oracle GoldenGate (GG) configuration, replication monitoring, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Advanced RMAN backup and recovery, including point-in-time recovery and recovery validation.
* Database security, including Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), Oracle Database Vault, access controls, privilege management, and security hardening.
* Oracle Audit Vault and Database Firewall (AVDF) deployment, configuration, audit collection, monitoring, and policy management.
* Ownership of complex production incidents, root cause analysis, and preventive actions.
* Planning and execution of database migrations and upgrades with minimal downtime.
* Capacity planning, storage optimization, and automation using SQL, PL/SQL, and Linux/Unix shell scripting.
* Disaster recovery planning, failover testing, and business continuity support.
* Technical leadership, mentoring of L1/L2 teams, and review of database changes and operational procedures.

* AI & ML Skillset ( Good to have )
* Python: The core programming language for AI and Machine Learning.
* Essential Libraries:

+ NumPy for numerical computation and array handling.
+ Pandas for data manipulation and analysis.
+ Matplotlib/Seaborn for data visualization.

* ML/DL Frameworks: Hands-on experience with:

+ Scikit-learn for traditional ML models.
+ TensorFlow/Keras or PyTorch for Deep Learning implementations.

* SQL: Proficiency in querying and retrieving data from databases.
* Git: Competence in version control for collaborative development.
* Familiarity with various neural network architectures (CNNs, RNNs, Transformers).
* Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI principles.
* Big Data Tools: Exposure to platforms like Spark or cloud services for handling large datasets.

**Responsibilities**
  
  

* Develop and Manage the Oracle Customer Relationships by forming long term customer relationships with key customer contacts. Work is non-routine and complex, involving the application of advanced technical/business skills in area of specialization. Provides direction and mentoring to more junior team members. Understand customer’s industry drivers, organization structure and key stakeholders, key projects and goals, and critical success factors as well as technical infrastructure and roadmap.

* Coordinate delivery of Oracle Services, operating as the primary delivery contact to the customer, aiding and facilitating customer communications and activities across other Oracle lines of business.
* Responsible for delivering to the contracted terms, effective and efficient use of Oracle delivery resources, achieving the contract margin and revenue objectives.
* Identify and submit delivery leads for new opportunities and contract renewals.
* Act as a point of contact for any major incidents, responsible for managing communication and customer expectations through resolution.
* Establish and maintain a delivery governance model with the customer at the management and executive levels.
* Perform scope and risk management.
* Contribute to initiatives for Oracle delivery organizational process improvement and tool development.
* Conduct periodic Service Account Planning and Account Reviews.

* The CSS TAM is a customer advocate and must demonstrate customer obsession by placing the client needs first.

* Should possess strong technical skills on Database and DB products to advocate to customer the use cases and guide the customer and team of Oracle CSS Engineers through the lifecycle of Oracle Technology product adoption

:

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. title: Staff Quality Engineer - SDET
description:
**Strength in Trust**
OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
  
  
The Challenge
  
  

* We are looking for a Staff level SDET to support our product development teams. As the Staff SDET, you will play a crucial role in shaping and leading our software testing strategy. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing robust test automation frameworks, mentoring a team of SDETs (Software Development Engineer in Test), and ensuring the overall quality and reliability of our software products.

**Your Mission**

* Provide technical leadership and guidance to the SDET team.
* Collaborate with development and QE (Quality Engineering) teams to integrate testing into the software development process.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient test automation frameworks and test architectures.
* Rub shoulders with developers in writing unit and integration tests using their tools and frameworks.
* Ensure the frameworks support various testing types, including functional, integration, and performance testing.
* Mentor and guide junior SDETs, providing technical expertise and career development support.
* Conduct training sessions to enhance the skills of the testing team.
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the team.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop comprehensive test plans.
* Execute and oversee the execution of test cases, ensuring thorough coverage of functional and non-functional requirements.
* Analyze test results and provide meaningful insights to improve product quality.
* Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and user stories.
* Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, providing clear updates on testing progress and issues.
* Add, maintain, and update scripts in existing automation suite, helping with running the suite across various checkpoints in the release cycle.
* Participate in various POCs (Proof of Concept) to keep the automation framework and technology relevant and current to product offerings.
* Conduct peer reviews of test code and automation frameworks.

**You Are**

* You are a seasoned SDET with an automate anything anywhere attitude who is looking for a challenging technical leadership role in a dynamic and innovative company.
* You can efficiently find the underlying cause of a failure (in an integrated environment) and alert the right team.
* You are consistently willing to pitch in to support a long running deployment, even after hours.
* You are willing to learn and pick up new skillsets to support the ever-changing technology landscape like Cloud computing & AI (Artificial Intelligence).
* You can understand complex product and deployment architectures and create efficient test solutions.
* You want to be part of a team that is passionate about delivering high-quality software solutions.

**Your Experience Includes**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical or business field.
* 10+ years of relevant experience working as a developer, automation engineer or SDET.
* 8+ years of experience coding in Java and must have strong practical knowledge of OOPs and Core Java principles.
* 4+ years of experience contributing to Test-Driven Development or BDD (Behavior Driven Development) with tools like Cucumber, Junit, Mockito, or TestNG.
* 3+ years of experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Circle CI, or Azure DevOps with the ability to create test pipelines using Java or Groovy.
* 4+ years of experience with Selenium or Cypress frameworks for automating GUI (User Interface) and E2E tests of the application.
* 4+ years of experience with REST Assured or similar tools like Postman for automating APIs.
* 4+ years of experience working in a highly automated CI/CD environment.
* 4+ years of experience with source control tools such as Bitbucket, GitHub or GitLab.
* 2+ years of experience mining meaningful logs for troubleshooting using tools like Splunk, Dynatrace or Coralogix.
* 3+ years of experience working in a cloud shop preferably Azure with exposure to various Azure services like Gateways, Redis, Storage, VMs (virtual machines) and Kubernetes clusters.
* 3+ years of experience in testing mobile applications, both native and websites using Appium on both real devices and simulators either in a private farm of 3rd party vendors like Sauce Labs or BrowserStack.
* 4+ years of experience working with geographically distributed teams in US, Canada, and India.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work as part of a team, demonstrate initiative, solve problems independently and mentor others.
* Passion for high quality work and attention to detail.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.

**Extra Awesome**

* Prior exposure to AI/ML systems and how to use them in testing thus making test pipeline more intelligent.
* Experience in analyzing the CPU Utilization, Memory usage, Network usage, Garbage Collection and DB Parameters and DB Reports to verify the performance of the applications.
* Ability to spin up scalable test architecture using Docker or Kubernetes.
* Experience with Kubernetes and extended usage patterns for test grids, auto scale properties.

Where we Work
  
  
We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
  
  
Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
  
  
**Benefits**
As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
  
  
Resources
  
  
Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
  
  

* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data
  
  
You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview
**.**
You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
  
  
Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
  
  
**Our Commitment to You**
When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.
  
  
OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

title: Diagnostic Procedure Engineer
description:
Delivery of dealer diagnostic content for Ford (including Lincoln and joint ventures) vehicle programs globally
  
  
**Ideal Candidate**
The ideal candidate is one which has a vehicle repair background on both mechanical and electronic vehicle systems plus is proficient with authoring applications and has experience with basic coding languages and have authored diagnostic documents. Candidate could create logical steps to lead technicians to identify reasons for failure.
  
  
**Diagnostic Authoring R&R**

* Work with Design engineers to understand vehicle electrical architecture, how it can fail and how it can be diagnosed
* Work with core team to determine if previously authored diagnostics can be leveraged or if new diagnostics needs to be developed
* Work with Design engineers to analyze system functionality and architecture to develop detailed component-level Description and Operation documentation.
* Utilize software tools to design, develop, create and test the diagnostic routines for implementation on the authorised diagnostic tool.
* Validates and signs-off diagnostics routines using simulation tools, test rigs and vehicles as necessary
* Work with Design and Release engineers to resolve issues within Part 2 specifications
* Work with Technical Assistance Center to resolve diagnostic issues in the field
* Develop the necessary images and system diagrams needed for diagnostics and Description and Operation documentation.

**Skills**

* Excellent communication skills and clear written/verbal communication skills.
* Strong understanding of automotive electrical and mechanical architectures.
* Ability to interpret Ford Part 2 diagnostic data specifications.
* Experience with Arbortext or similar XML-based authoring tools for technical documentation.
* Hands-on experience with Grade-X or other OTX authoring tools.
* Ability to interpret complex electrical wiring diagrams.
* Strong understanding of UDS (Unified Diagnostic Services) and communications protocols (CAN)
* Excellent problem-solving skills and familiarity with software editors.
* Vehicle validation skills and hands-on experience performing diagnostic test runs on vehicle.
* Experience with 3DX, Teamcenter, Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.
* Experience with Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word)
* Ideally hands-on experience servicing or repairing vehicles or similar products.
* Good team player but also ability to focus and work alone to meet deadlines.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent.
* 4+ years of experience with vehicle architecture, system & diagnostics experience.
* Strong technical, troubleshooting, and strategical skills around vehicle software and systems.
* Deep understanding of UDS (ISO 14229), and CAN/CAN-FD networking.
* Strong analytical skills to debug complex communication issues between ECUs and service tools

* Hazard identification and HIRA/JSA
* Work at height

* Permit-to-work and LOTO
* Electrical safety
* Chemical handling and MSDS
* Fire safety and extinguisher handling
* First aid
* Emergency preparedness
* Behaviour-based safety
* Run mock drills, toolbox talks and safety campaigns (Road Safety Month, National Safety Week, Fire Service Week).
* Prepare training material, run pre- and post-training assessments, keep attendance and training records, and gather feedback to measure how well each training worked.

***Incident investigation and root cause analysis (RCA)***
***(Support & Assist Lead Investigator)***

* Investigate incidents, near misses and dangerous occurrences at client sites: visit the scene, collect evidence and interview witnesses.
* Apply structured RCA methods, including:
* **5 Whys, Fishbone diagram, Fault Tree Analysis**
* Find the immediate, underlying and root causes, including management system gaps, not just unsafe acts.
* Write clear investigation reports with corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), then follow up until each action is closed.
* Turn lessons learned into safety alerts and refresher trainings for client teams.

***Audits, inspections and compliance (Support & Assist Lead Auditor)***

* Carry out safety inspections, risk assessments (HIRA/JSA) and safety audits (IS 14489).
* Support statutory compliance under the Factories Act and Tamil Nadu Factories Rules, and maintain HSE documentation.

***Reporting and business support***

* Prepare HSE reports and dashboards, including on our digital platform, HSEFQ.
* Help with cost estimates for client proposals.
* Travel to client sites across Tamil Nadu and South India as needed.

title: Oracle Fusion HCM - Consulting Technical Manager
description:
**Job Description**
As an Oracle Fusion HCM Technical Manager, you will design and deliver technical solutions for Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementations, helping customers move accurate data into production and support their HCM business processes. You will own technical deliverables from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization. Working closely with functional consultants, client stakeholders, and integration teams, you will develop Fast Formulas, HCM Extracts, and HCM Data Loader (HDL), VBS (Visual Basic Studio) and AI Agent Studio solutions, supported by SQL and BI Publisher. Your scope includes data conversion and migration, from legacy source analysis and mapping to mock conversions, production loading, validation, and reconciliation. The role suits a Manager with at least 10 years of relevant professional experience who can independently resolve complex implementation issues, document technical decisions, protect sensitive employee information, and support delivery quality through reviews, mentoring, and clear communication.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Gather business and technical requirements and translate them into technical specifications and solution designs that support HCM implementation needs.
* Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot Fast Formulas supporting HCM business processes and HCM Extracts to deliver validated results.
* Design and develop HCM Extracts, defining extraction criteria, records, attributes, changes-only processing, scheduling, and outbound delivery.
* Build and execute HDL loads, managing business object dependencies, effective-dated records, load sequencing, and error resolution to load data accurately.
* Own data conversion and migration, covering source analysis, source-to-target mapping, transformation, cleansing, loading, validation, and reconciliation.
* Plan and execute mock conversions and final production migration during cutover, supporting post-load validation and post-go-live stabilization.
* Develop SQL queries and BI Publisher reports to support extracts, data validation, reconciliation, and business reporting.
* Diagnose technical defects and data discrepancies, support system integration and user acceptance testing, and collaborate with functional teams to validate HCM data structures, rules, and module dependencies.
* Prepare technical designs, mapping specifications, migration runbooks, test evidence, and deployment documentation, applying HCM data security and access controls when handling sensitive employee information.
* Review technical deliverables, mentor team members, and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies to support delivery quality and stakeholder alignment.

**Skills - Mandatory**
**Experience**

* Minimum 15 years of relevant professional experience in HCM technical consulting, enterprise application development, or implementation delivery.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience delivering Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementations.

**Technical Skills**

* Fast Formulas: Strong expertise in formula development, database items, contexts, debugging, and validation.
* HCM Extracts: Strong expertise in extract definitions, changes-only processing, formula usage, scheduling, and delivery.
* HCM Data Loader (HDL): Strong hands-on experience in file preparation, business object relationships, effective dating, and troubleshooting failed loads.
* Data conversion: Proven experience in legacy data assessment, mapping, transformation, cleansing, and reconciliation. Experience in migration planning, mock cycles, cutover execution, and post-load validation.
* SQL and BI Publisher: Strong SQL skills and experience using BI Publisher for reporting and implementation support.
* Technical delivery: Ability to independently own deliverables and resolve complex implementation issues, with strong analytical and documentation skills.
* Data security: Ability to apply HCM data security and access controls when handling sensitive employee information.

**Functional Skills**

* Working knowledge of Core HR, workforce structures, worker and assignment data, and dependencies across HCM modules.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with functional consultants, client stakeholders, and integration teams.

**Leadership**

* Ability to review technical deliverables, mentor team members, and communicate delivery progress, risks, and dependencies.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with HCM Spreadsheet Data Loader (HSDL), AI Agent Studio, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), and Fusion HCM REST APIs and VBCS.
* Experience supporting technical requirements across Payroll, Absence Management, Time and Labor, Talent Management, or Recruiting.
* Experience with complex legacy migrations and global HCM implementations.
* Relevant Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM certifications.

**Self Assessment Questions**
Before applying, please consider the following questions:
  
  

* Do I have at least 10 years of relevant professional experience in HCM technical consulting, enterprise application development, or implementation delivery, and hands-on Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementation experience?
* Can I develop, debug, and validate Fast Formulas using database items and contexts, and deliver HCM Extracts with changes-only processing, scheduling, and delivery?
* Can I prepare and troubleshoot HDL loads, managing business object relationships, effective-dated records, and load sequencing?
* Can I own data conversion and migration from source assessment, mapping, transformation, and cleansing through mock cycles, cutover, post-load validation, and reconciliation?
* Can I use SQL and BI Publisher, apply Core HR data and security knowledge, and independently deliver documented technical solutions while collaborating with stakeholders and mentoring colleagues?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Associate - Business Management Associate, Operations Analytics and Transformation
description:
**Job Description**
Join a team that turns complex data into clear business insights and measurable outcomes. You will support strategic initiatives through analytics, automation, reporting, governance, and stakeholder engagement. This role offers the opportunity to strengthen reporting controls, improve processes, and drive transformation. You will partner closely with stakeholders across regions and time zones.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a Business Management Associate within Finance and Business Management supporting Operations, you will enable strategic initiatives through data analysis, automation, and financial and operational reporting. You will translate complex information into actionable insights, strengthen reporting controls, and contribute to measurable business outcomes. You will support Operations across India and the Philippines and collaborate closely with stakeholders in the United States and other regions. This role requires working hours aligned to Europe, the Middle East and Africa, with flexibility for cross-regional meetings and business priorities.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  

* Coordinate priorities, requirements, governance forums, management updates, and deliverables across Operations, Finance and Business Management, data and analytics teams, and Technology, partnering with stakeholders across regions and time zones.
* Analyze portfolio performance, identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and provide actionable insights to support management decisions.
* Track strategic priorities, delivery milestones, and expected benefits; proactively manage dependencies and escalate risks.
* Manage, cleanse, validate, and reconcile artificial intelligence program datasets and internal platform extracts; investigate variances and root causes.
* Deliver financial and operational reporting on artificial intelligence impact, including benefits, costs, investment metrics, key performance indicators, milestones, and risks; use trend analysis to explain performance and key business drivers.
* Support measurement and validation of artificial intelligence and automation outcomes, including productivity gains, cost efficiencies, and investment returns.
* Develop and maintain Microsoft Excel and workflow automation solutions (for example, Alteryx or comparable tools) for data preparation, transformation, and calculations.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate recurring processes to improve efficiency and control effectiveness.
* Reconcile workflow and dashboard outputs to approved source data; investigate reporting and control exceptions before publication.
* Define business and reporting requirements, coordinate technology enhancements, testing, and controlled implementation, and maintain documentation, methodologies, and access guidance.
* Provide ad hoc analysis, management presentations, reconciliations, and reporting to support evolving Operations priorities.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
* Relevant experience in business management, management reporting, analytics, automation, or operations reporting, preferably in financial services.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (large datasets, formulas, PivotTables, lookups, and reconciliations) and hands-on experience with Alteryx or comparable workflow automation and data-preparation tools.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a controls mindset, with the ability to interpret complex data and deliver concise, management-ready insights.
* Effective stakeholder communication, ownership, and prioritization across teams and time zones, including willingness to work hours aligned to Europe, the Middle East and Africa and accommodate meetings with United States-based stakeholders as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Working knowledge of Python, SQL, or comparable analytical tools.
* Familiarity with Tableau, HTML-based reporting, SharePoint, or similar platforms.
* Exposure to artificial intelligence, generative artificial intelligence, automation, transformation, and portfolio governance, ideally within operations and/or finance and business management.
* Understanding of business cases and investment metrics such as return on investment, net present value, payback period, internal rate of return, and benefit-to-cost ratio.

title: Head Copy and Content
description:
**About the role**
------------------

### **About the Role**

Della Townships is looking for a sharp, big-picture Head of Copy to lead storytelling for our luxury township projects. This is much more than regular ad or web writing—it takes a senior creative thinker who can turn raw building drawings, technical fact sheets, town layouts, and early ideas into moving, meaningful brand stories. You will own the full content plan and writing direction across every channel, turning Della’s design style and lifestyle vision into words that excite very wealthy buyers, investors, and partners.

### **What You Will Do**

Storytelling & Building the Core Story

Turning Facts into Stories: Break down detailed building specs, town-planning notes, eco/sustainability numbers, and design ideas into inspiring, easy-to-connect stories.

Owning the Brand Voice: Set, guide, and shape a clear, upscale writing style for Della Townships across all projects so the luxury tone stays steady everywhere.

Shaping Early Ideas: Work directly with leaders, architects, and design teams to catch the heart of upcoming projects and turn rough ideas into main campaign themes.

### **Content Strategy & Planning**

Content & Launch Plans: Build step-by-step content plans tied to project stages—from early teaser campaigns and investor previews to big launches and long-term brand building.

Planning Across All Channels: Plan and guide connected messaging across print and digital touchpoints, including coffee-table books, investor slide decks, brochures, sales-center displays, videos/films, social media, and thought-leadership articles/PR.

Messages for Different Groups: Shape the story to fit different audiences, such as homebuyers, NRI investors, sales partners, and business collaborators.

Creative Leadership & Hands-On Writing

Writing Key Pieces Yourself: Personally lead top-level brand statements, founder vision letters, video/film scripts, big speeches, and important investor messages.

Guiding Writers & Agencies: Lead, coach, and check the work of in-house copywriters and outside creative agencies to raise writing quality and big-picture thinking.

Working Across Teams: Team up smoothly with art directors, brand managers, ad/marketing teams, and sales leaders so visuals and words support each other.

**What we expect**
------------------

### **What We Are Looking For**

Experience: 6 - 8 years of proven work in copywriting, brand storytelling, and content planning in luxury real estate, hospitality, lifestyle brands, or top creative/ad agencies.

Past Work (Portfolio): A clear track record of taking technical or idea-heavy briefs and turning them into standout campaigns, luxury print pieces (coffee-table books, brand films), and convincing pitch stories.

Planning Skills: Proven skill in building organized content schedules, launch guides, and multi-channel communication plans—not just writing single ads or posts.

Writing & Language Skill: Very strong English with the range to switch from poetic, emotional storytelling to clear, persuasive business writing.

Working with Leaders: Strong executive presence and comfort working closely with vision-driven founders, architects, and senior leaders in a fast-moving setup.

Job Description – Logistics Executive (Singapore Operations)Role overview

Bookkeeping 360 LLP is hiring a Logistics Executive (Shipment Administrator) in Mumbai to support Singapore operations. The role owns each rubber trade from signed contract to payment received.

Item

Commodities

Origins

Vietnam, Malaysia

Systems

Etradeup (stages 6–11), Excel trackers, shipping-line and vessel tracking portals

**Purpose:** make sure every contracted shipment has freight compared and booked with the shipping line, is loaded on time, documented correctly, tracked at sea, and invoiced and paid without gaps. The role is the single point of contact between buyers, origin logistics teams, shipping lines, banks and internal departments.

Key responsibilities

The duties follow the five phases of the Shipment Administrator SOP and are recorded in Etradeup as each stage is completed.

1. **Contract preparation (Phase I)**

o Collect deal details from Sales or the Logistics Manager: type, commodity, price, quantity, party, contract number, origin and destination.

o Draft sales and purchase contracts on the correct template and route them to \_\_\_ for approval by 3 pm daily.

o Get internal signatures from authorised signatories (\_\_\_ and \_\_\_).

o Track countersignature by the buyer or supplier within 3 days and flag overdue contracts.

o Keep the weekly Contract Summary (sales and purchase tabs by month, with status and shipment completion) and file signed contracts digitally.

2. **Pre-shipment coordination (Phase II)**

o Obtain weekly contract summaries from Vietnam and Malaysia; send each origin a two-month shipment schedule.

o Monitor daily all contracts due to ship within the next month.

o Collect shipping instructions and marks from buyers and pass them to the origin team promptly.

o Confirm bookings and vessel details, and make sure pre-loading inspection is done by the origin logistics team or Quality Manager.

o Appoint a forwarding agent, with Management approval, where an origin has no in-house representative.

o Escalate any shipment delay to Management immediately.

3. **Shipping documentation (Phase III)**

o Collect inspection reports, loading photos, packing list, phytosanitary certificate, certificate of origin and certificate of analysis.

o Check the draft bill of lading against the contract and buyer instructions before it is finalised.

o Send the shipping declaration to the buyer after vessel departure.

o Arrange insurance, bill of exchange, beneficiary and utilisation certificates, cover letter and courier of originals.

o Record and verify freight invoices; request the sales invoice from the India back office before originals arrive.

o Assemble a complete, accurate document set for the bank or buyer, and track originals to the bank.

4. **Shipments at sea (Phase IV)**

o Track every vessel daily and send buyers regular ETA updates, including delays or early arrivals.

o Confirm freight is paid per contract terms and documents reach the destination in time for clearance.

o Coordinate with local port agents for clearance documents.

5. **Invoicing and payment follow-up (Phase V)**

o Send invoices in the buyer's required format with the full document set.

o Track payment due dates, follow up with buyers, and monitor bank receipts.

o Escalate non-payment to Finance or Legal and keep the weekly outstanding-invoice report.

6. **Systems and reporting**

o Upload, mark received and close documents in Etradeup stages 6–11 (shipment plan to payment and closure) and clear finish-later tasks so trades can close.

o Prepare the weekly reports: contract summary, documents received vs. held, and outstanding invoices.

o Give end-of-day status updates to the Singapore management team.

Qualifications, experience and skills

The ideal candidate has 3 years or more of export documentation or shipping work in agri-commodities, ideally with Vietnam or Malaysia origins.

description:
**Job Title:** Sales Manager – Watch Channel

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for experienced and proactive Area Sales Managers to join our Watch channel team for Mumbai. The primary responsibility of this role is to appoint, develop, and manage new retail partners to expand our market presence. The ideal candidate should have 7-8 years of experience in channel sales management as an Area Sales Manager or Regional Sales Manager within a related industry.

1. **Retail Partner Development**:

* Identify, appoint, and onboard new retailers in the assigned region to expand market reach.

* Foster strong relationships with new and existing retail partners, providing support to maximize their potential and ensure growth.

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.

* Demonstrated success in retail partner appointment and development.

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain long-term relationships with retail partners.

* Proven ability to work independently and strategically in a competitive market.

* Willingness to travel frequently within the territory.

10+ yrs. of overall IT experience

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
**We are seeking experienced Oracle Fusion Cloud Data Migration Consultants to support the migration of master, reference, and transactional data into Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Procurement(Optional). The consultants will work closely with functional, technical, business, and source-system teams to ensure that data is extracted, transformed, validated, loaded, reconciled, and signed off successfully**
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and execute end-to-end data migration activities for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Procurement.
* Work with business and functional teams to identify source data, transformation rules, dependencies, and target-system requirements.
* Prepare and maintain data-migration strategies, object lists, mapping documents, conversion specifications, and reconciliation reports.
* Perform data profiling, cleansing, transformation, validation, and duplicate analysis.
* Develop and validate Oracle data-load files using tools and methods such as FBDI, ADFdi, spreadsheet loaders, REST APIs, SOAP services, and scheduled processes.
* Support the migration of relevant data objects, including:

+ Chart of Accounts and other financial reference data
+ Suppliers, supplier sites, contacts, addresses, and bank details
+ Procurement business units, agents, categories, and approved supplier information
+ Purchase agreements, purchase orders, requisitions, and related open transactions
+ Customers, customer accounts, sites, contacts, and profiles
+ Payables and Receivables open transactions
+ General Ledger balances and journals
+ Fixed Assets and Cash Management data, where applicable

* Analyse and resolve load errors, rejected records, reference-data issues, and data-quality exceptions.
* Ensure that parent-child relationships and cross-file references remain consistent across migration files.
* Perform pre-load and post-load validations and reconcile migrated data against source-system totals.
* Support mock conversions, conference-room pilots, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover rehearsals, and production deployment.
* Maintain migration logs, issue trackers, control totals, exception reports, and sign-off documentation.
* Coordinate with Oracle functional and technical teams to address configuration and integration dependencies.
* Support production cutover and post-go-live data-migration activities.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Strong hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Procurement data migration.
* Experience in at least one full-cycle Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation involving data conversion.
* Practical knowledge of Oracle Fusion FBDI templates, interface tables, import processes, and error-resolution procedures.
* Good understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials and Procurement data structures and business processes.
* Experience with data extraction, mapping, transformation, validation, loading, and reconciliation.
* Ability to analyse large data files and identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, or invalid records.
* Working knowledge of SQL and experience preparing data extracts and reconciliation queries.
* Experience working with CSV files, Microsoft Excel, and data-transformation utilities.
* Strong understanding of data dependencies, reference keys, sequencing, and parent-child relationships.
* Ability to prepare technical design documents, mapping documents, load instructions, and reconciliation reports.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work with business users, functional consultants, developers, and project management teams.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple migration objects, and meet project deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Oracle Fusion Cloud certification in Financials, Procurement, or related areas.
* Experience migrating data from Oracle E-Business Suite or other legacy ERP applications.
* Knowledge of BI Publisher, OTBI, Oracle Integration Cloud, REST APIs, and SOAP web services.
* Experience with high-volume data migration and performance optimization.
* Experience supporting multiple mock conversions and production cutovers.
* Familiarity with data governance, audit, security, and handling sensitive financial and supplier information.

**Expected Deliverables**

* Approved data-migration strategy and object inventory
* Source-to-target mapping and transformation documents
* Validated data-load files
* Load execution and error-resolution reports
* Source-to-target reconciliation results
* Cutover plans and execution checklists
* Migration completion and business sign-off documentation

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

title: Power Platform Technical Lead
description:
**About Persistent**
We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q2 FY27 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens™ Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026.
  
  
**About Position**
We are seeking a Power Platform Technical Lead with strong technical expertise to design, develop, and deploy high-performance solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Power Virtual Agents). You will be responsible for architecting and building custom applications, integrating them with enterprise systems, automating workflows, and creating dynamic business intelligence solutions. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, project managers, and IT teams to ensure seamless integration with other systems and high-quality delivery of innovative, scalable solutions
  
  

* Role: Power Platform Technical Lead
* Location: Pune
* Experience: 8 to 12 Years
* Job Type: Full-Time Employment

**What You'll Do**

* Design, develop, and deploy Canvas Apps, Model-driven Apps, Power Automate Desktop Flows, and Power Pages.
* Build and automate complex workflows using MS Power Automate, integrating with internal and third-party systems like Dynamics 365, SAP, SharePoint, and custom APIs.
* Develop and deploy Power Virtual Agents chatbots for customer and employee automation tasks.
* Integrate Power Platform solutions with Azure SQL, SharePoint, Dynamics 365, and external systems via Logic App and custom connectors.
* Optimize and refine PowerBI reports using Power Query and DAX to enhance performance, particularly for large datasets, while designing interactive dashboards that enable data-driven decision-making across business units.
* Develop automation workflows in MS Power Automate to streamline business processes and integrate with enterprise systems like Salesforce, SAP, and O365.
* Build custom connectors and leverage Azure API Management to integrate Power Platform solutions with external systems and ensure scalability.
* Implement ALM Smart using Cloud - Microsoft Azure DevOps, managing version control, CI CD Pipeline, and solution deployment across environments.
* Ensure data security, statutory compliance, and IT governance by applying best practices for user roles, permissions, and Data Loss Prevention DLP policies.
* Provide troubleshooting and support for existing solutions, resolving issues and implementing enhancements to improve functionality.
* Stay updated on new features and best practices in Power Platform and Azure, proactively recommending improvements and innovations.

**Expertise You'll Bring**

* Minimum of 8+ years working with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, MS Power Automate, PowerBI, Power Virtual Agents).
* Proficient in building Canvas Apps and Power Apps - Model Driven Apps using PowerApps with a strong understanding of the app lifecycle and performance optimization techniques.
* Strong experience with MS Power Automate to create advanced workflows, including custom connectors, Integration amp; APIs, and handling system integrations (e.g., Dynamics 365, Salesforce, SAP).
* Advanced skills in PowerBI, including Power Query, DAX for data modeling, and report/dashboard optimization for large datasets.
* Experience in building Logic App and Azure Functions to extend the capabilities of Power Platform applications.
* Skilled in creating custom connectors to integrate external APIs and systems with Power Platform using REST APIs and Azure API Management.
* Experience with Power Platform Component Framework for building custom controls and extensions for apps.
* Proficient in Cloud - Microsoft Azure DevOps, implementing CI CD Pipeline for Power Platform solutions, and managing source code through version control systems.
* Strong experience in security management within Power Platform, including setting up Access and Authorization RBAC, implementing Data Loss Prevention DLP policies, and ensuring compliance with data governance best practices.
* Proficient in Jscript, TypeScript, and C for custom development and creating reusable components for PowerApps and MS Power Automate.
* Familiarity with Powershell for automating Power Platform deployments, handling environment configurations, and managing solutions.
* Deep knowledge of GCP integration, particularly with Azure SQL, Azure Functions, and other cloud-native technologies to extend Power Platform capabilities.
* Experience with Agile methodologies and project management tools.
