title: Oracle Fusion HCM Technical - Principal Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
As an Oracle Fusion HCM Technical Consultant, you will design and deliver technical solutions for Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementations, helping customers move accurate data into production and support their HCM business processes. You will own technical deliverables from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization. Working closely with functional consultants, client stakeholders, and integration teams, you will develop Fast Formulas, HCM Extracts, and HCM Data Loader (HDL) and AI Agent Studio solutions, supported by SQL and BI Publisher. Your scope includes data conversion and migration, from legacy source analysis and mapping to mock conversions, production loading, validation, and reconciliation. The role suits a consultant with at least 10 years of relevant professional experience who can independently resolve complex implementation issues, document technical decisions, protect sensitive employee information, and support delivery quality through reviews, mentoring, and clear communication.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Gather business and technical requirements and translate them into technical specifications and solution designs that support HCM implementation needs.
* Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot Fast Formulas supporting HCM business processes and HCM Extracts to deliver validated results.
* Design and develop HCM Extracts, defining extraction criteria, records, attributes, changes-only processing, scheduling, and outbound delivery.
* Build and execute HDL loads, managing business object dependencies, effective-dated records, load sequencing, and error resolution to load data accurately.
* Own data conversion and migration, covering source analysis, source-to-target mapping, transformation, cleansing, loading, validation, and reconciliation.
* Plan and execute mock conversions and final production migration during cutover, supporting post-load validation and post-go-live stabilization.
* Develop SQL queries and BI Publisher reports to support extracts, data validation, reconciliation, and business reporting.
* Diagnose technical defects and data discrepancies, support system integration and user acceptance testing, and collaborate with functional teams to validate HCM data structures, rules, and module dependencies.
* Prepare technical designs, mapping specifications, migration runbooks, test evidence, and deployment documentation, applying HCM data security and access controls when handling sensitive employee information.
* Review technical deliverables, mentor team members, and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies to support delivery quality and stakeholder alignment.

**Skills - Mandatory**
**Experience**

* Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience in HCM technical consulting, enterprise application development, or implementation delivery.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience delivering Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementations.

**Technical Skills**

* Fast Formulas: Strong expertise in formula development, database items, contexts, debugging, and validation.
* HCM Extracts: Strong expertise in extract definitions, changes-only processing, formula usage, scheduling, and delivery.
* HCM Data Loader (HDL): Strong hands-on experience in file preparation, business object relationships, effective dating, and troubleshooting failed loads.
* Data conversion: Proven experience in legacy data assessment, mapping, transformation, cleansing, and reconciliation. Experience in migration planning, mock cycles, cutover execution, and post-load validation.
* SQL and BI Publisher: Strong SQL skills and experience using BI Publisher for reporting and implementation support.
* Technical delivery: Ability to independently own deliverables and resolve complex implementation issues, with strong analytical and documentation skills.
* Data security: Ability to apply HCM data security and access controls when handling sensitive employee information.

**Functional Skills**

* Working knowledge of Core HR, workforce structures, worker and assignment data, and dependencies across HCM modules.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with functional consultants, client stakeholders, and integration teams.

**Leadership**

* Ability to review technical deliverables, mentor team members, and communicate delivery progress, risks, and dependencies.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with HCM Spreadsheet Data Loader (HSDL), AI Agent Studio, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), and Fusion HCM REST APIs and VBCS.
* Experience supporting technical requirements across Payroll, Absence Management, Time and Labor, Talent Management, or Recruiting.
* Experience with complex legacy migrations and global HCM implementations.
* Relevant Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM certifications.

**Self Assessment Questions**
Before applying, please consider the following questions:
  
  

* Do I have at least 10 years of relevant professional experience in HCM technical consulting, enterprise application development, or implementation delivery, and hands-on Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementation experience?
* Can I develop, debug, and validate Fast Formulas using database items and contexts, and deliver HCM Extracts with changes-only processing, scheduling, and delivery?
* Can I prepare and troubleshoot HDL loads, managing business object relationships, effective-dated records, and load sequencing?
* Can I own data conversion and migration from source assessment, mapping, transformation, and cleansing through mock cycles, cutover, post-load validation, and reconciliation?
* Can I use SQL and BI Publisher, apply Core HR data and security knowledge, and independently deliver documented technical solutions while collaborating with stakeholders and mentoring colleagues?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Application Development Group Manager
description:
Citi is looking for a senior Software Development Lead to take end-to-end technical ownership to work on applications within its Shared Services technology team in Pune. In this role, you will architect, build, and deliver enterprise-scale software solutions that sit at the heart of critical securities and custody workflows, shaping how Citi's technology platforms perform at global scale. You will combine deep Java engineering expertise with senior leadership, guiding a team of engineers while influencing technical direction and partnering with business, operations and data stakeholders across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Architect and design end-to-end software solutions for high-volume securities finance applications, ensuring systems are scalable, resilient, and aligned to enterprise standards.
* Hands on role building and delivering new application capabilities using Core Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and microservice patterns deployed via Docker and Kubernetes.
* Lead the technical analysis of complex business processes, translating requirements into well-structured application designs that address upstream, downstream, and partner system dependencies.
* Define and enforce engineering standards across the full development lifecycle, covering design, coding, testing, debugging, and production implementation.
* Mentor and develop engineers and analysts, allocating work effectively and building team capability to deliver against ambitious delivery goals.
* Partner with senior business leaders and end users to capture functional requirements and incorporate them into cohesive system designs that meet regulatory and compliance needs.
* Identify and manage technical and operational risk within delivery decisions, escalating issues transparently and maintaining the integrity of systems and controls.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* 15+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering complex application systems in financial services environments.
* Deep proficiency in Core Java, Java EE, PL/SQL, Spring, Spring Boot, Hibernate, RESTful API development, and Unix scripting, with the ability to architect services independently.
* Practical experience with microservice architecture and container orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes, and with messaging systems including Kafka and MQ Series.
* Proficiency in Oracle and MSSQL relational databases, including writing complex SQL queries and applying data profiling and data mapping tools.
* Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Devin, or Claude as part of daily engineering workflows.
* Demonstrated ability to lead engineering teams, manage cross-functional delivery, and communicate technical decisions clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Familiarity with regulatory data requirements, data governance, and compliance considerations in a financial services context.

**Beneficial Skills & Qualifications**

* Deep knowledge of Custody, Funds, or Securities Finance, including an understanding of how these functions operate across front, middle, and back-office environments will be an added advantage
* A Master's degree in a relevant technical or quantitative discipline.

title: Lead Python and Spark Data Engineer - Vice President
description:
**About Citi**
Citi, the leading global financial services company, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients.
  
  
Citi’s Mission and Value Proposition explains what we do and Citi Leadership Standards explain how we do it. Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients’ and the public’s trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviours that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.
  
  
Diversity is a key business imperative and a source of strength at Citi. We serve clients from every walk of life, every background and every origin. Our goal is to have our workforce reflect this same diversity at all levels. Citi has made it a priority to foster a culture where the best people want to work, where individuals are promoted based on merit, where we value and demand respect for others and where opportunities to develop are widely available to all.
  
  
**About Team And Platform**
Citi Futures and Derivatives Clearing Technology supports a rapidly growing business that uses technological innovation to maintain competitive advantage in a constantly evolving market. Working closely with the business, external vendors and internal technology teams, you would build-out and maintain our next generation clearing platforms. You would manage complex projects that will involve everything from incorporating a new functionality within the existing ecosystem, to analyzing new requirements, documenting solutions, managing implementation and testing systems, ensuring that they are fit for purpose. You would regularly work with a range of Business Analysts and high-profile stakeholders.
  
  
The Data and Reporting team develops and supports a platform that provides client reporting and feeds other downstream applications within Citi. It provides reporting such as real-time trades, positions, initial and variation margin, positions and balances for external clients and internal users such as traders, operations and sales. A major ongoing initiative is to modernize the existing platform in order to provide scale and to enhance product offerings and new business requirements.
  
  
As the development lead for the data and reporting, you will lead the team to deliver best in class technical solutions to meet the needs of our Futures and Clearing business. This includes researching best practices, designing the application and data and integration architecture, designing the solutions, and delivering our application to the business. The team works closely with cross-functional business users, QA engineers and BAs collaborating to deliver best in class solutions. This role suits experienced architects/developers who have excellent communication and are passionate about driving technical solutions through leadership, excellence, collaboration.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Own a large-scale data warehouse; develop data products; and lead the architecture, design, development, and maintenance of scalable and secure data architectures to support downstream reporting applications, data integration, and simplified complex data processes — utilizing best engineering practices and data lifecycle management principles.
* Identify, evaluate, implement improvements to legacy systems, ensure alignment with target architecture design

title: Staff Software Engineer - (Development & Quality)
description:
**About Kaseya**
Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.
  
  
We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.
  
  
At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar.
*We build it.*
**Staff Software Engineer, Endpoint Agent**
(Development & Automation Testing)
  
  
**Why Kaseya?**
Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated by combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology architecture, but also how engineering teams leverage AI to build high-quality software faster and more effectively.
  
  
Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer to help develop and maintain Kaseya's endpoint management agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms.
  
  
This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on building secure, reliable, and scalable endpoint management capabilities. The ideal candidate is passionate about operating systems, systems programming, device management, endpoint security, and software quality.
  
  
Unlike traditional development environments where quality ownership is separated, our engineers own the full software lifecycle. You will design, develop, test, deploy, and support your solutions while building automated validation alongside the features you create. Successful candidates combine strong software engineering skills with a quality-first mindset and leverage automation to ensure reliability, maintainability, and release confidence at scale.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design and implement new features for endpoint agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms.
* Develop software components supporting monitoring, automation, patching, inventory collection, remote actions, scripting, and device management.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
* Own features throughout the entire lifecycle from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support.
* Build automated tests and validation frameworks alongside feature development.
* Develop automated coverage for functional, integration, regression, resiliency, and system-level scenarios.
* Improve software quality through testability, diagnostics, telemetry, and automation.
* Investigate customer-reported issues and production escalations.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventative solutions to avoid future recurrence.
* Reproduce complex issues across diverse operating system and endpoint environments.
* Improve agent stability, performance, scalability, security, and reliability.
* Develop integrations with operating system management, security frameworks, and device management APIs.
* Build telemetry and diagnostics capabilities that improve product supportability and troubleshooting.
* Collaborate with Product, Support, Cloud Platform, Security, and Engineering teams to deliver customer-focused solutions.
* Participate in design discussions, code reviews, architecture reviews, and sprint planning activities.
* Utilize AI-assisted development and testing tools to accelerate engineering productivity and improve software quality.

**What You Bring**
**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience developing system software, endpoint software, platform services, or related applications.
* Strong proficiency in C# and .NET, including experience building production-grade applications and services.
* Experience building automated tests and validation capabilities as part of the software development lifecycle.
* Experience developing automated test frameworks and validation tooling using technologies such as xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, Selenium, Playwright or similar testing frameworks
* Experience with Windows system programming concepts such as Win32 APIs, Windows Services, WMI, Registry operations, process management, threading, security models, or related operating system capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of operating system fundamentals, including: Processes and threads, Filesystems, Networking, Services and daemons, Security models, Privilege management, Performance and resource utilization
* Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Experience developing software that interacts with operating system services, APIs, or management frameworks.
* Understanding of software quality engineering principles, test automation, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as coding assistants, code generation tools, or intelligent debugging solutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with RMM, UEM, EDR, XDR, endpoint security, or device management products.
* Knowledge of C, C++, Rust, Go
* Experience with Microsoft Intune, Apple MDM, Android Enterprise, or Linux management platforms.
* Knowledge of PowerShell, Bash, Python, AppleScript, or other scripting technologies.
* Experience building test frameworks, automation libraries, or system-level validation tooling.
* Experience working with virtualization, containerization, or automated device provisioning environments.
* Familiarity with endpoint telemetry, diagnostics, observability, and monitoring systems.

**What Success Looks Like**
A successful Senior Endpoint Software Engineer at Kaseya:
  
  

* Builds secure, scalable, and high-quality endpoint software.
* Owns features end-to-end from design through production support.
* Demonstrates strong ownership of both software development and quality.
* Develops automated validation alongside feature implementation.
* Solves complex customer, platform, and operating system challenges.
* Improves the reliability, performance, security, and maintainability of endpoint agents.
* Rapidly diagnoses issues and implements long-term corrective solutions.
* Partners effectively across Product, Support, Security, Platform, and Engineering teams.
* Leverages AI-native engineering practices to improve productivity and accelerate delivery.
* Continuously grows expertise in operating systems, endpoint management, systems programming, and modern software development practices.

**Additional Information**
*Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

title: SQL Developer
description:
Job Title: Advanced SQL Developer
  
Location: Noida, India (On-site)
  
Budget: As per company standards
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
Role Summary
  
We are looking for an Advanced SQL Developer who lives and breathes T-SQL and Azure SQL performance. This role centers on four pillars: performance tuning at scale, database architecture for a multi-tenant healthcare platform, SQL code.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
Performance Tuning
  
• Tune complex T-SQL stored procedures, views, and ad-hoc queries against tables with hundreds of millions of rows.
  
  
• Analyze execution plans, wait statistics, and Query Store data to identify and resolve CPU, IO, memory, and tempdb bottlenecks.
  
  
  
Database Architecture
  
• Contribute to the architecture of a multi-tenant Azure SQL platform using a database-per-tenant pattern with replicated reference data.
  
• Define standards for schema migrations, versioning, and zero-downtime deployments.
  
Performance Monitoring and Load Testing
  
• Own the performance monitoring stack across Azure SQL using Database Watcher, Redgate Monitor, SolarWinds DPA, Query Store, and Extended Events.
  
• Build and maintain load testing harnesses (Azure Load Testing, JMeter, or equivalent) that exercise the data tier under realistic concurrency and data volumes.
  
• Partner with engineering teams to integrate database performance gates into CI/CD pipelines.
  
Code Reviews and Best Practices
  
• Lead T-SQL code reviews across US and India engineering teams, enforcing standards for readability, parameterization, transaction scope, error handling, and security.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
• 7+ years of professional SQL Server / Azure SQL development experience.
  
  
• Expert-level T-SQL: window functions, CTEs, recursive queries, dynamic SQL, JSON handling, temporal tables.
  
  
• Proven track record of optimizing queries against very large, wide-column transactional tables.
  
  
• Deep knowledge of SQL Server internals: query optimizer, indexing, statistics, locking and isolation, tempdb, and memory grants.
  
  
• Hands-on experience with Azure SQL Database in production at scale.
  
  
• Production experience with MySQL, including query tuning, indexing, and replication.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
• Healthcare or HIPAA-regulated environment experience.
  
  
• Familiarity with .NET / C# data access patterns (Dapper, Entity Framework).
  
  
• Experience with Azure Load Testing, JMeter, k6, or similar tooling against database backends.
  
• Experience with CDC, replication, and ETL/ELT pipeline design.
  
• Exposure to Power BI semantic models and DAX optimization.
  
• Exposure to NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cosmos DB, DynamoDB) and PostgreSQL.

:

**Job Summary**
---------------

A Data Analyst (Manager) within Financial Crime Surveillance Operations (FCSO) Data & Reporting will play a key role in converting FCSO data into actionable intelligence for management and business decision-making. Working with functional stakeholders, Product Owners and Enterprise Data Management, the role will analyse business needs and translate them into high-quality dashboards, advanced visualisations and analytical solutions using MicroStrategy/ Power BI/ Tableau, or any emerging analytical technologies that clearly demonstrate trends, patterns, exceptions and key business drivers.
  
As the visualisation expert, the role will collaborate across business, data, technology, project teams, partners and third-party vendors to deliver solutions aligned with the Bank’s data standards and governance framework

* Understanding, Analysing and interpretation of business requirements and translate requirements into visually appealing dashboards.

• Creating visualizations in MicroStrategy/Tableau/Power BI
  
• Independently design, build, test MicroStrategy /Tableau / Power BI reports dashboards, cubes and objects, projects, security matrix.
  
• Rationalizing, Performance tuning, testing, and troubleshooting new and existing reports, dashboards.
  
• Produce accurate and insightful dashboards and reports detailing the health, content and insights available from the data, making that actionable for stakeholders and meaningful for management decision making
  
• Participate in Agile Ceremonies as a functional data expert and work with a cross functional agile team
  
• Innovate with how we present Data to senior management to make actionable insights and metrics enabling business to take data driven decisions.

------------------------

**Strategy**

* Work for FCSO Data and Reporting team strategic solutions & initiatives

**Business**  
• Define clear, concise and detailed business requirements for FCSO Data that clearly document the data elements and formats that are needed, outline detailed transformation expectations and list the critical data elements that will enable downstream processes to operate effectively.

**Processes**  
• Work with FCSO business Data & Reporting users & process owners to constantly improve, refine and expand the data products, improve the quality and effectiveness of those processes, as well as help them to make sense of the data, providing training where required, and derive meaningful BI / MI

**People & Talent**  
• Learn all the FCSO processes regularly and apply the knowledge in the Data and MI ensuring effective stakeholder engagement.

**Risk Management**  
• The ability to interpret the logic in Strategic MI & identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures.

**Governance**  
• Follow TTO and FCSO change governance process, document all the changes and communicate the stakeholders for UVT(Users Verification Testing).

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.

• Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  
• Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**  
**• FCSO Management Team, who provide the team priorities in terms of Data and MI production related tasks, requirements, objectives, and strategy**  
**• Downstream Process Owners, who depend on the data to perform their business function**

These dashboards enable Management and business users to monitor performance, identify trends and exceptions, derive actionable insights, and make informed, data-driven decisions.**

**Position Summary**
**Job Title: Assistant Manager – US Consulting Services BISO (L40)**
Do you have the drive to engage in cyber security to protect organizations from potential security exposures or threats? If your answer is yes, we have the right opportunity for you!
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
This role would be part of the Cyber Security team and would support application and cloud platform teams in managing security findings and meeting security requirements throughout the application lifecycle. You would coordinate security reviews, vulnerability and penetration-test remediation, exception assessments, and release-readiness activities. You would collaborate and coordinate with application owners and various key stakeholders, both onshore and offshore, such as cyber, risk, vulnerability management, penetration testing, networking, IAM(Identity and Access Management), and data protection to document risks, track actions, and escalate unresolved issues through established governance channels.

* Coordinate security reviews, scans, penetration tests, evidence collection, and release-readiness activities.
* Track and coordinate remediation of vulnerability and penetration-test findings, including retests and findings without available fixes.
* Review security exception requests, remediation plans, compensating controls, and required approvals.
* Coordinate with application, cyber, risk, and infrastructure teams to resolve blockers and escalate overdue or high-impact risks.

title: Creative Lead (Design & Reels)
description:
We’re looking for someone who can make great work and help a team make better work.

At Jive Jar, you’ll lead the creative work for our own brand and our clients. One day you might design the first visual for a campaign. The next, you might sit with an editor to fix the opening of a Reel or turn a handful of references into a direction the whole team can follow.

If your feedback goes beyond “make it pop” and you can show someone exactly what to change and why, we’d like to see your work.

What you’ll own

• Creative direction for campaigns and content. Turn marketing briefs into concepts, mood boards, and clear directions for social posts, ad creatives, campaigns, and short-form video.

• Hands-on design. Create key visuals and first drafts yourself when the team needs a strong starting point. Set the standard for typography, layout, colour, and consistency across brands.

• Reels from idea to final cut. Work with creators, designers, and editors on hooks, scripts, storyboards, shot lists, edits, captions, and covers. Know when to simplify an idea, rewrite the opening, or ask for a reshoot.

• Team guidance and quality control. Give useful feedback early, explain the reasoning behind it, and review work before it goes to a client or gets published.

• Trends and performance. Stay close to what’s working across Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and paid social. Use audience retention and campaign results to decide what to test next, without copying every trend.

• Practical use of AI. Use AI tools to explore concepts, draft storyboards, and produce variations faster. Teach the team where these tools help, what needs human review, and how to protect client assets and avoid generic output.

What we’re looking for

• Around 3–8 years of experience in brand design, social creative, content production, or creative direction. We care more about the work and the responsibility you’ve owned than the exact number of years.

• A portfolio that shows both strong visual design and short-form video. We want to see what you personally made, what you directed, and what changed because of your feedback.

• Experience guiding designers or editors, reviewing their work, and delivering across multiple briefs. Agency or multi-client experience is a strong plus.

• Comfort working hands-on with design and video tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve. We’re not looking for a checklist of software.

• At least one real example of using AI in a creative workflow, with a clear explanation of what it sped up and what you still handled yourself.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days, the team should have clearer briefs, fewer avoidable revision rounds, and a consistent standard for what’s ready to publish. We should also have a few repeatable Reel formats that the team can shoot, edit, and improve without starting from scratch every time.

How to apply

Apply with your portfolio and 2–3 examples you’d like to walk us through, including at least one Reel or short-form video. For each example, tell us briefly what the brief was, what you personally owned, and what you’d do differently today.

With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Role Summary
  
  
The L2 SAN & Storage Engineer is responsible for the day-to-day operations, provisioning, maintenance, and troubleshooting of enterprise shared storage devices, fabric networks, and backup technologies. This role provides Level 2 escalation support to ensure the demanding up-time, responsiveness, and performance of production storage and backup environments. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with Dell PowerMax, Dell Unity, and Data Domain, combined with deep knowledge of iSCSI protocols, VMware host environments, and solid ITSM practices.
  
  
Technical & Process Profile Summary
  
  
Storage Technologies: Dell PowerMax, Dell Unity (File & Block)
  
  
Backup Technologies: Dell Data Domain, Veeam, Oracle RMAN
  
  
Protocols & Networking: iSCSI, Fibre Channel (FC)
  
  
Host & Virtualization: VMware vSphere (ESXi), Windows Server, RHEL/OEL
  
  
Monitoring Tools: SolarWinds, Splunk (Log analysis & dashboard tracking)
  
  
Ticketing & Operations: JIRA (Incident, Change, Service Requests), ITSM Framework
  
  
Shift Timings: 24x7 Operations (Rotational Shifts)
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Storage Administration: Perform day-to-day provisioning and allocation of storage, including creating Storage Groups, Aggregates, Volumes, LUNs (Thin/Thick), and managing Storage Virtual Machines (SVM) across Dell PowerMax and Dell Unity platforms.
  
  
Host Connectivity & Virtualization: Configure, map, and troubleshoot host-side storage connectivity within a highly virtualized VMware ESXi environment, including cluster configurations, multi-pathing (PSP/NMP), and datastore management.
  
  
Protocol Management: Implement, manage, and troubleshoot storage connectivity using iSCSI (software/hardware initiators, network binding, CHAP authentication) and Fibre Channel fabric protocols.
  
  
Enterprise Monitoring: Proactively monitor storage array health, replication status, and fabric alerts using SolarWinds. Leverage Splunk to track alerts, analyze system logs, and review dashboards to investigate storage performance anomalies.
  
  
ITSM & Queue Management: Own the operational queue within JIRA, acting as the L2 technical owner for Incident Management, Service Requests, and Problem Management. Ensure all operational activities strictly follow organizational ITSM frameworks.
  
  
Backup & Recovery Operations: Administer and monitor enterprise backups utilizing Dell Data Domain and Veeam. Triage backup failures for business-critical volumes and databases (SQL/Oracle via RMAN).
  
  
Lifecycle & Maintenance: Coordinate with hardware vendors (e.g., Dell) for physical component replacements (disks, controllers, SFPs) and assist L3/Architecture teams with storage microcode/firmware upgrades and data migrations.
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent practical combination of education and experience.
  
  
Experience: 5-7 years of dedicated experience in enterprise SAN/NAS storage and backup infrastructure support.
  
  
Storage Expertise: Proven hands-on administration experience with Dell PowerMax and Dell Unity storage arrays.
  
  
Network & Protocols: Direct hands-on experience configuring iSCSI storage networks alongside traditional Fibre Channel switching.
  
  
Virtualization Exposure: Operational knowledge of VMware vSphere environments, focusing on how ESXi hosts interact with shared enterprise storage.
  
  
Tools & Processes: Practical experience tracking work via JIRA and a strong foundational understanding of ITSM methodologies (Incident, Change, and Problem workflows).
  
  
Monitoring Skills: Experience using SolarWinds for infrastructure health monitoring and Splunk for analyzing technical logs.
  
  
Collaborate with client, network, server, database, and application teams to resolve storage and connectivity issues.
  
  
Participate in change management, patching, upgrades, and maintenance windows.
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Excellent communication and documentation skills.

title: Security Engineer
description:
**About Us**
We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.
  
  
Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!
  
  
**Senior Security Engineer**
**Job Description**
The Senior Security Engineer will be a hands-on security professional with experience in offensive security, embedded systems, product security, and vulnerability research. This role will be responsible for helping to build, mature, and support the Copeland Product Security Program. This cross-functional position will work directly with product development teams to assess, design, test, and improve the security of Copeland products and services throughout their lifecycle.
  
  
This position will also support Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) activities, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, and cybersecurity regulatory readiness efforts including the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).
  
  
**As a Security Engineer, You Will**
**Product Security Testing & Research**
Perform product security testing and reporting, including but not limited to:
  
  

* Black-box reverse engineering of hardware and firmware
* Vulnerability research
* Exploit development
* Fuzz testing
* Protocol reverse engineering
* Hardware security assessments
* Embedded software security reviews

**Penetration Testing**
**Conduct Manual Penetration Testing Of**

* Mobile Applications (iOS & Android)
* Web Applications
* APIs and Microservices
* Cloud Infrastructure
* Network Systems
* IoT Devices

**Product Security Engineering**

* Facilitate threat modeling with product, application, infrastructure, and engineering teams.
* Conduct architecture and design reviews to identify security weaknesses early in the development lifecycle.
* Support Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) activities and Secure-by-Design initiatives.
* Review security requirements for connected products and cloud-based solutions.
* Partner with engineering teams to develop effective security controls and mitigations.

**PSIRT & Vulnerability Management**

* Support Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) operations.
* Investigate and validate externally reported vulnerabilities.
* Coordinate vulnerability triage, remediation, and disclosure activities.
* Participate in CVE identification, CVSS scoring, and security advisory development.
* Engage with security researchers, vulnerability disclosure programs, and industry partners.
* Assist with incident response activities involving Copeland products.

**AI & Emerging Technology Security**

* Perform security assessments of AI/ML and Generative AI-enabled products and services.
* Evaluate risks associated with AI agents, model supply chains, prompt injection, model poisoning, and data leakage.
* Help define security controls for AI-powered products and services.
* Assess third-party AI technologies and integrations for security risk.

**Security Awareness & Program Development**

* Perform security training and outreach to development and engineering teams.
* Support security champion programs and secure coding initiatives.
* Maintain product security metrics, documentation, dashboards, and operational procedures.
* Assist with continuous improvement of product security tools and processes.

**Regulatory & Compliance Support**

* Support cybersecurity compliance initiatives related to connected products.
* Assist with vulnerability management and reporting obligations under cybersecurity regulations and standards.
* Collaborate with legal, compliance, and product teams during product security investigations and regulatory reporting activities.
* Support readiness activities related to regulations such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), coordinated vulnerability disclosure processes, and secure product development requirements.

**Department Summary**
The Copeland Product Security department is focused on ensuring that our products are secure and that we are protecting our customers from relevant cyber threats by proactively identifying, addressing, and preventing vulnerabilities that could impact the confidentiality, integrity, availability, or safety of our products, services, and solutions.
  
  
We seek individuals with experience and innovative ideas in Product Security, Embedded Systems Security, IoT Security, AI Security, and Product Security Incident Response who are passionate about securing connected products and supporting secure-by-design development practices.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* You look beyond the obvious and do not stop at the first answer.
* You enjoy solving complex technical problems and understanding how systems truly work.
* You are comfortable communicating technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* You maintain strong collaborative relationships across diverse teams and locations.
* You challenge assumptions respectfully and are comfortable participating in technical debate.
* You possess a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* You enjoy learning new technologies and adapting to emerging threats and industry trends.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience with any combination of the following: embedded systems and IoT security, red teaming, or penetration testing.
* Experience conducting security testing of embedded hardware and the ability to identify and manipulate debug interfaces (UART, JTAG, SWD, etc.) and peripheral buses (SPI, I2C, etc.).
* Experience performing Binary Reverse Engineering of ARM, MIPS, and PowerPC firmware using industry-standard tools such as IDA Pro, Binary Ninja, Ghidra, etc.
* Experience planning and executing Red Team exercises.
* Experience performing Fuzz Testing of industrial communication protocols like Wi-Fi / BLE / Wireless HART / PROFINET/ MODBUS / Ethernet IP/ OPC UA/ HART /FF.
* Understanding of secure boot processes, bootloaders, cryptographic implementations, and trusted execution concepts.
* Understanding network, web, IoT, and industrial-related protocols such as TCP/UDP, HTTPS, MQTTS, CoAP, Modbus, Ethernet/IP, DNP3, OPC-UA, etc.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical skills and problem-solving capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) operations, including vulnerability triage, CVSS scoring, authoring security advisories, and coordinated vulnerability disclosure activities.
* Understanding of cybersecurity regulations affecting connected products, including EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), IEC 62443, NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF).
* Experience working with Cloud Security Architectures.
* Understanding cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud.
* Experience with programming languages such as Python, C, C++, C#, Assembly, Go, Rust, etc.
* Experience with software supply chain security, including SBOM generation and analysis, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), CI/CD security.
* Knowledge of embedded Linux required, knowledge of Real-Time Operating Systems a plus.
* Hands-on experience assessing AI/ML Systems, Generative AI Applications, LLM-based Applications, Autonomous Agents.
* Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP Top 10, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

**Our Commitment to Our People**
Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.
  
  
Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.
  
  
Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
  
  
Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!
  
  
**Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging**
At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Copeland is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

title: AI QE
description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many products we use every day are conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
  
  
We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer with 5+ years of hands-on experience in software testing and test automation to join our growing Quality Center of Excellence.
  
  
In this role, you will design, develop, and execute automated tests across Siemens software products in a multiplatform environment. You will combine strong software testing fundamentals with programming and automation skills to improve product quality, test coverage, and release confidence.
  
  
You will work closely with Product Management, Software Development, Applications Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams, while also collaborating with other QA specialists across Siemens in areas such as automation, performance testing, and security testing.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a logical thinker and strong problem solver who enjoys understanding how software works, identifying defects, automating repetitive activities, and continuously improving the way software is tested.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop test automation: Design, implement, maintain, and execute automated tests for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end scenarios using appropriate frameworks and programming languages for Teamcenter.
* Drive test coverage: Work with Product Managers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to understand requirements, identify risks, define test cases, and develop effective automation strategies for new features and product releases.
* Apply AI-assisted techniques to accelerate test-case generation, script development, test-data preparation, defect analysis, log analysis, troubleshooting, and regression optimization.
* Enable continuous testing: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide rapid feedback, detect defects early, and improve the efficiency and reliability of software delivery.
* Test APIs and data: Perform API testing using RESTful services and tools such as Postman or Swagger, and validate application data using SQL queries and SPARQL where applicable.
* Investigate and resolve quality issues: Execute automated and functional tests, analyze failures and results, identify defects, perform structured troubleshooting, and collaborate with development teams to drive resolution.
* Improve automation frameworks: Continuously enhance existing test frameworks, scripts, and utilities to improve maintainability, efficiency, reliability, and test coverage.
* Collaborate and contribute to quality excellence: Maintain clear test documentation, share knowledge, and collaborate with the Siemens Quality Center of Excellence to adopt effective quality engineering practices and emerging testing technologies.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in Teamcenter quality engineering and test automation, including automated validation of Teamcenter applications, APIs, integrations, and containerized solutions.Strong programming or scripting skills in Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable language, with the ability to develop maintainable automation solutions.
* Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Playwright, TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent.
* Experience with API testing and database validation, including RESTful APIs, SQL queries, and tools such as Postman or Swagger.
* Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, with an understanding of integrating automated tests into pipelines.
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, TDD, and BDD, combined with strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to AI agents, LLM-driven applications, or AI-assisted automation, including technologies such as Anthropic Claude or equivalent.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization technologies.
* Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner.
* Familiarity with security testing practices such as DAST and penetration testing concepts.
* Experience testing browser-based applications, including functionality, performance, and cross-browser compatibility.
* Experience with defect and test management tools such as Polarion.

**Why us?**
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
**Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday**

title: Senior Finance Specialist
description:
**We're looking for a**

**Senior Finance Specialist**
=============================

**This role is** **Office Based, Pune Office**

**Job Title: Senior Finance Specialist\_FX specialist**

**Company Overview:**

Cornerstone OnDemand (CSOD) is at a critically important juncture in the company’s lifecycle. CSOD is the world’s largest and most successful stand-alone unified Talent Management company and one of the world’s largest SaaS companies. The company is entering a phase of achieving scale and global expansion through continued relentless execution.

You will work with Finance and business teams across the world, with particularly close collaboration with colleagues in the UK and US. The Global Process Owner for the principal activities is based in the UK.

**Job Summary:**

The role will be responsible for FX accounting, analysis and controls within the global finance function. The role is responsible for ensuring the accuracy of exchange rates, review & understanding of system generated revaluation transactions, investigation of FX movements and delivery of clear monthly and quarterly analysis. This is a hands-on role for an experienced analyst who can take ownership of close activities, work independently with detailed accounting data, apply sound judgement and explain FX impacts clearly to finance stakeholders. In addition, this role will be responsible for the administration of our close management tool, FloQast.

This role is based in Pune office and will require the applicant to align with UK working hours.

Over time, the role may support other accounting and finance activities as business needs evolve.

**In this role you will...**
============================

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **FX rate management:** Manage monthly exchange-rate data and rate packs across Oracle ERP and Oracle EPM, ensuring rates are complete, accurate and reconciled between systems.
* **Rate validation and controls:** Compare system rates with an appropriate independent market source, investigate material variances and maintain clear evidence that rate uploads and control checks have been completed.
* **Monthly and quarterly FX analysis:** Prepare monthly, quarterly and year-to-date analysis of foreign exchange movements, identify the main drivers and provide clear supporting schedules and commentary for Finance stakeholders.
* **Revaluation review:** Confirm foreign-currency revaluations have run successfully across relevant business units and entities. Review significant revaluations by account, investigate unexpected or zero-impact results and verify that the correct exchange rates have been applied.
* **Balance-sheet currency review:** Analyze balance-sheet accounts containing multiple currencies, identify balances requiring correction or clearing, and work with account owners to resolve inappropriate or unusual foreign-currency positions.
* **Oracle EPM operations and controls:** Monitor key Oracle EPM processes and control outputs, and partner with Finance Systems or IT teams to resolve data, period or system issues.
* **Accounting and audit support:** Prepare and review journal entries and reconciliations, respond to FX-related queries, provide audit-ready schedules and evidence, and support US GAAP, statutory and external audit requirements.
* **Process improvement and projects:** Maintain clear working papers and process documentation, support finance-system testing and change initiatives, and lead practical, technology-enabled improvements to the efficiency, consistency and control of FX processes.
* **Stakeholder management:** Build effective relationships across functions and regions, take ownership of issues through to resolution, communicate risks early and provide dependable accounting support with limited supervision.

**You've got what it takes if you have...**
===========================================

**Experience:**

* 4+ years of experience working within a global multi-currency organization working specifically with FX
* Proven hands-on ownership of month-end close, journal entries, balance-sheet reconciliations, financial analysis and resolution of complex accounting issues.
* Experience working directly with global stakeholders and delivering accurate outcomes under recurring deadlines with limited supervision.
* Experience in a multinational, Shared Service Centre (SSC), Global Business Services (GBS), BPO, SaaS or technology environment is preferred.

**Skills:**

* Strong practical understanding of foreign-currency accounting, exchange rates and revaluation, with the ability to investigate and clearly explain FX movements.
* Strong accounting knowledge and judgement, with the ability to identify risks, determine an appropriate course of action and escalate matters when required.
* Hands-on experience using Oracle ERP, Oracle EPM or comparable finance systems.
* Strong Excel and data-analysis skills, with the ability to work accurately with large or detailed datasets and identify unusual trends or exceptions.
* Advanced English and good written and verbal communication skills to interact upward and cross-functionally are a must.
* Experience of technology-enabled process improvement.
* Strong ownership, organisation and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise, challenge appropriately and take issues through to resolution.
* A control-focused mindset with strong attention to accuracy, completeness, documentation and audit readiness.
* Must be comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced global organisation undergoing significant transformation.

**Qualifications:**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting
* Chartered Accountant (CA – ICAI)

**Extra dose of awesome if you have…**

* A track record of simplifying or automating accounting processes and improving financial controls.
* Additional language skills.

#LI-Onsite

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**Who We Are:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

Check us out on LinkedIn, Comparably, Glassdoor, and Facebook!

title: Team Leader - TPRC (Chennai, TN, IN, 600 117)
description:
**Vestas is well-known in wind technology and actively contributes to its development. Vestas’ core business comprises the development, manufacture, sale, marketing, and maintenance of Wind Turbines. Come and join us at Vestas!**
**Service > Global Service Delivery > Service GCC**
Service GCC - Turbine Performance Reporting Center (TPRC) is responsible for leading a team of analysts delivering turbine performance data, reporting, and insights to regions and global teams. In addition to delivering results, this role will guide the evolution of performance reporting into a value-focused capability by creating data-driven insights, refining processes and systems, and expanding the GCC’s impact on Service performance, decision-making, and customer value. The role brings together team leadership, operational accountability, continuous improvement, and strategic insight creation, with an emphasis on automation, while ensuring dependable data quality, efficiency, and business impact.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop an effective team while building a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning
* Promote operational excellence by ensuring timely, accurate, and quality delivery of reporting, data verification, and case management activities
* Manage workload planning, resource allocation, and capacity to consistently meet service level commitments
* Monitor key performance metrics including productivity, quality, backlog, ageing, and SLA compliance, taking corrective actions when required
* Serve as the primary point of contact for regional stakeholders, ensuring alignment on priorities, risks, and delivery expectations
* Build effective cross-functional partnerships with operations, customer service, and technical teams to resolve complex issues
* Support performance improvement initiatives by identifying process gaps, eliminating inefficiencies, and implementing sustainable solutions
* Utilize data and insights to support decision-making, enhance customer experience, and improve operational outcomes.
* Ensure effective governance, documentation, escalation management, and business continuity across team operations.
* Support best practices, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement to help ensure business and customer success.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering/Business/Analytics/Finance/Statistics/Mathematics/Computer Science/a related field
* 8-12 years of experience in service operations, analytics, turbine performance, shared services, or global delivery environments
* Minimum 2 years of people leadership experience with direct team management responsibilities
* Demonstrated ability to manage operational delivery, quality, capacity planning, and stakeholder expectations
* Experience in GCC, Shared Services, or Global Business Services (GBS) environments
* Exposure to wind energy operations, turbine performance analytics, or contractual reporting
* Certifications in Lean, Six Sigma, Quality, or Data Analytics are
* Solid leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement mindset

**Competencies**

* Lead, coach, and develop a balanced team while building engagement and accountability
* Support operational excellence through effective capacity planning, backlog management, and SLA delivery
* Leverage KPIs and performance metrics to improve productivity, quality, and customer outcomes
* Promote quality standards, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Solve complex operational challenges through data-driven root cause analysis and corrective actions
* Collaborate with regional stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure seamless service delivery
* Coordinate change initiatives, including process improvements, automation, and new service transitions
* Communicate priorities, risks, and business outcomes effectively to stakeholders at all levels
* Consistently deliver on SLA, quality, productivity, and backlog targets while ensuring reliable service delivery
* Build and develop a productive, engaged team that promotes accountability and continuous improvement
* Deliver accurate and timely reporting, data verification, and case management outcomes
* Manage transitions, risks, and stakeholder expectations while minimizing business disruption
* Generate measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, quality, and revenue protection

**What We Offer**
We offer a very exciting job in a flat, multicultural, and evolving department focusing on reaching high-quality results. To us, it is all about knowing the market and our customers, defining the right solutions, and getting it done - all in the best possible way. We would like you to participate in that mission.
  
  
**Additional Information**
Your primary workplace will be Vestas India, Chennai.
  
  
Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including before the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 15th December 2026.
  
  
**Our commitment to a fair hiring**
At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.
  
  
**DEIB Statement**
At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.
  
  
**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process
  
  
**About Vestas**
Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.
  
  
Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.
  
  
With 39,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.
  
  
Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.
  
  
To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

title: Senior Consultant- SAP FICO
description:
**Job Title: Senior Consultant - SAP FICO**
**Career Level: D2**
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to turn deep SAP FI/CO expertise into business outcomes that help speed life-changing medicines to patients? Join a team that marries purposeful work with high-tech platforms, where your functional mastery and technical know-how power core financial processes at global scale.
  
  
You will be the go-to consultant translating business needs into robust SAP solutions—keeping our procure-to-pay and order-to-cash financial flows accurate, compliant and fast. Backed by significant investment and a modern technology environment, you will tackle complex integrations, streamline interfaces and elevate data quality so our scientists and clinicians can focus on what matters most.
  
  
Can you see yourself owning critical integrations and shaping how we demonstrate SAP to scale across markets while unlocking new levels of efficiency and insight?
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Issue Resolution and Continuous Improvement: Triage, analyze and resolve SAP FI/CO issues reported by business users; identify root causes and deliver fixes that improve stability, control and user experience.
* Change and Enhancement Delivery: Gather requirements, design and configure solutions, manage testing and deploy enhancements that meet business needs and regulatory standards.
* Integration Ownership: Lead and optimize p2p to fi and fi to Sotc integrations; ensure interfaces, Idocs and Z developments deliver reliable, reconciled, end-to-end financial data flows.
* Collaborator Engagement: Partner with finance, procurement and operational teams to capture requirements, set expectations and provide timely progress updates and user guidance.
* Quality and Documentation: Produce clear functional specifications, test plans and user documentation; support knowledge transfer and adoption.
* Delivery Rigor: Complete tasks assigned by the team lead and project coordinator on time; manage risks, dependencies and change/release cycles with rigor.
* Data and Controls: Safeguard data integrity across FI/CO processes; support period-end close, reconciliations and audit/controls readiness.
* Future-Ready Finance: Contribute to automation, analytics and cloud-enabled improvements that elevate performance and reduce manual effort over time.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* 7-9 years of experience and functional knowledge in their domain and good technical knowledge in the FI and CO modules.
* Work experience in core modules of FI&CO, p2p to fi & fi to Sotc integrations, Interfaces, wbs, Idocs, z developments etc.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience working as a Functional Consultant resolving SAP issues and delivering change/enhancements for business users.
* Hands-on exposure to SAP S/4HANA Finance and/or Central Finance migration or greenfield initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of integration patterns across procurement, order-to-cash, project systems and reporting, including interface monitoring and error handling.
* Comfort with Agile ways of working, including backlog management, user stories and iterative delivery.
* Proficiency with SAP Solution Manager/ChaRM, testing tools and structured documentation practices.
* Ability to lead requirements workshops, translate process needs into functional designs and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partners.
* Domain understanding of accounting and controlling processes (e.g., period-end close, IFRS considerations, product costing, profitability analysis) in a global environment.
* Experience in regulated or life sciences settings, with attention to controls, auditability and data quality.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Here, technologists and scientists sit side by side to unlock the potential of data and platforms that transform how medicines are discovered, developed and delivered. You will join an empowered network with the backing to innovate—pairing SAP expertise with cloud, analytics and automation—where unexpected teams around the same table spark bold thinking. We value kindness alongside ambition, encourage experimentation through events like hackathons and invest in your growth so you can take ownership, move at pace and see your work ripple across the enterprise and ultimately reach patients faster.
  
  
Step into a high-impact SAP FI/CO role where your craft shapes the finance backbone of breakthrough science—make your move today!
  
  
**Date Posted**
27-Nov-2026
  
  
**Closing Date**
10-Dec-2026
  
  
AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.
