title: Oracle Fusion HCM - Consulting Technical Manager (Absence & OTL)
description: Job DescriptionAs Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM Workforce Management Workstream Lead within Consulting Services, you will own integrated solution architecture across Absence Management and Time and Labor, with demonstrated depth in Workforce Scheduling. You will guide complex engagements from requirements and design through configuration or development, testing, cutover, go-live, and stabilization. Your work will connect planned schedules, recorded time, absence transactions, and downstream Payroll processing to support consistent business outcomes and production readiness. Working with geographically distributed clients and functional, technical, integration, security, data, and Payroll teams, you will resolve cross-service dependencies and explain design options and trade-offs. You will govern rules, formulas, approvals, testing, performance, and solution quality while addressing relevant security, Redwood, AI, and Workforce Health and Safety implications. The role suits an experienced architect or domain lead who can demonstrate personal implementation ownership, mentor consultants, and communicate workstream risks and decisions to project leadership.The role supports clients across all geographies. Hiring location, official grade, final experience range, employment model, hybrid attendance, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.Responsibilities Key Responsibilities Own integrated Workforce Management architecture from requirements and design through configuration or development, testing, cutover, go-live, and stabilization to support successful delivery. Lead end-to-end successful implementations, guide functional team in the team and have a strong customer facing skills. Lead requirements and architecture workshops; evaluate design options against business fit, maintainability, performance, security, user experience, and delivery complexity. Resolve dependencies across Workforce Scheduling, time capture and calculation, absence processing, and Payroll, including processing sequence, retrospective corrections, reconciliation, and exception ownership. Govern business rules, Fast Formulas, validations, approvals, and exception handling to deliver consistent outcomes across services. Lead cross-stream design reviews with functional, technical, integration, security, data, and Payroll teams; address relevant Workforce Health and Safety, security, Redwood, and AI implications. Define and govern integration, regression, exception, performance, and user acceptance testing across services to validate end-to-end business outcomes. Establish solution quality criteria, review delivery evidence, and drive resolution of functional issues and design defects to meet agreed quality expectations. Review migration and integration designs, data ownership, error handling, recovery, reconciliation, and cutover dependencies to establish production readiness. Maintain design decisions, dependency maps, documentation, and configuration or development standards; demonstrate the integrated solution and explain business and operational implications. Guide delivery teams, mentor consultants, and communicate workstream risks, dependencies, and decisions to project leadership to support coordinated delivery. Skills - Mandatory Experience 10+ years of relevant experience. 3 completed end-to-end Oracle Fusion HCM implementations in Workforce Management, delivered as architect or domain lead. Demonstrated personal ownership from requirements and design through configuration or development, testing, cutover, and go-live, supported by specific implementation examples. Oracle Products Absence Management and Time and Labor: Ability to architect complex solutions spanning both services, with demonstrated depth in Workforce Scheduling. Absence Management: Expertise governing eligibility, entitlement, accrual and qualification rules, balances, approvals, and exceptions. Time and Labor: Expertise governing time capture, calculation, validation, approval, transfer, and correction processes. Workforce Scheduling: Ability to translate requirements and constraints into integrated designs covering worker availability, planned schedules, recorded time, absence, and downstream processing; validate normal, change, and exception scenarios. Functional Skills Ability to assess worker and assignment changes, effective dates, work schedules, and retrospective corrections across the integrated solution. Understanding of downstream Payroll impacts, processing sequence, corrections, reconciliation, and exception ownership, together with relevant Workforce Health and Safety dependencies. Technical Skills Strong understanding of Fast Formula design, review, troubleshooting, and validation; ability to govern rules, approvals, validations, and exceptions across services. Ability to govern integration boundaries, data ownership, error handling, recovery requirements, testing, performance, and solution quality across integrated business processes. Ability to review Oracle Fusion HCM security, including roles, data access, and access across integrated processes. Ability to review Redwood implications for configuration, user journeys, extensibility, and testing, and assess AI use cases, data access, human review, and validation of generated outputs. Stakeholder Management Ability to present design options, explain trade-offs, lead architecture discussions and cross-stream design reviews, and demonstrate business outcomes and operational implications. Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, and problem-solving skills. Leadership Demonstrated delivery leadership, with the ability to guide teams, mentor consultants, and communicate workstream risks and decisions to project leadership. Good to Have Experience delivering multi-country or complex enterprise Workforce Management implementations. Architecture ownership involving integrations, migration, and reconciliation across scheduling, time, absence, and Payroll. Experience governing quarterly update assessments and cross-service regression testing. Relevant Oracle HCM Cloud certifications. Experience mentoring domain leads and supporting solution assessments, demonstrations, proposals, and estimates. Self Assessment Questions Before applying, please consider the following questions: Do I have 12–20 years of relevant experience and 2–3 completed end-to-end Oracle Fusion HCM implementations in Workforce Management as architect or domain lead? Can I demonstrate personal ownership from requirements and design through configuration or development, testing, cutover, and go-live using specific implementation examples? Can I architect integrated Absence Management and Time and Labor solutions with Workforce Scheduling depth, including rules, Fast Formulas, approvals, validations, and exceptions? Can I resolve scheduling, time, absence, and Payroll dependencies, assess relevant Workforce Health and Safety impacts, and govern integration, testing, performance, and solution quality? Can I lead cross-stream architecture discussions, explain design trade-offs, guide consultants, and assess Oracle Fusion HCM security, Redwood, and AI implications? About UsOnly Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Technical Project Manager — SecNinjaz Technologies LLP
  

**New Delhi · Fully on-site · Full-time · 6+ years · B.Tech / MCA or equivalent**

About us
  

SecNinjaz is a cybersecurity and AI solutions company serving enterprise, BFSI and government clients across India. We build and deliver AI products, security platforms and compliance programmes, often for on-premise and air-gapped environments. We are becoming an AI-native company, where AI agents are part of how work gets done every day.

The role
  

You'll own delivery across several parallel product and client projects, from requirements to production acceptance. You'll lead a small delivery team and report directly to the Founder & CTO. This is not a coordination role — you own the plan, the risks and the outcome.

What you'll do
  

* Turn requirements and RFPs into baselined plans: scope, WBS, milestones, Gantt charts and dependencies.
* Support RFP and tender responses with effort estimates and delivery plans.
* Run delivery cadences and keep GitLab as the single source of truth for status.
* Manage risks, issues and change control with written impact on time, cost and quality.
* Track budget, utilisation and SLAs alongside scope and dates.
* Produce audit-ready delivery evidence aligned to CMMI, ISO standards and CERT-In requirements.
* Coordinate QA, testing and client acceptance cycles, including STQC.
* Run security engagements (VAPT, audits, red-team) from scoping to report walkthrough, as assigned.
* Act as the delivery point of contact for government and enterprise clients.
* Lead and coach your delivery team, and help hire as the team grows.
* Use AI tools daily, and help design agent workflows that automate routine project management work.

What you bring
  

* 6+ years in software delivery, including 3+ years managing technical projects end to end.
* Delivery experience on at least one Indian government or PSU project.
* Experience leading a delivery team.
* At least 3 delivered projects you can walk through in detail, including what went wrong.
* Enough engineering depth to challenge an estimate: architecture, APIs, CI/CD, containers, on-prem deployment.
* Hands-on with Agile/Scrum and plan-driven delivery.
* Experience producing evidence for CMMI, ISO or similar audits.
* Clear written English and confidence with senior stakeholders.
* Discretion with confidential client information.

Good to have
  

* GeM procurement and STQC testing experience.
* AI/ML or cybersecurity project delivery (VAPT, audits, SOC).
* BFSI client experience.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum or similar certification; CEH or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.
* Diagrams-as-code (Mermaid, PlantUML).
* Hindi.

Why SecNinjaz
  

* Real ownership, working directly with the founder.
* Work on AI, video analytics and security systems used by government and enterprise clients.
* Shape how an AI-native company runs delivery.
* Certification support and a clear growth path into senior delivery leadership.

Strong exposure to MEP systems, power infrastructure, cooling systems, redundancy architecture, commissioning, and operational readiness. title: Operations Director
description: Overview 170+ Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact. At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. Design, standardize, and enforce SOPs, operational playbooks for consistent delivery across regions and service lines. Manage workflows end-to-end; assign agents and specialist resources to specific assignments based on capability, compliance, and cost. Track program milestones and deadlines; monitor the status of assigned projects and initiate course-corrections proactively. Utilize scorecards to measure activities and outcomes (e.g., Deployable Assets programs), driving continuous improvement. Implement demand planning, capacity models, and pricing/quoting discipline; monitor variance and initiate corrective actions. Strong knowledge of India regulatory environment (PSARA, CLRA, Shops & Establishments, PoSH) and client compliance expectations. Advanced Excel; reporting/BI (Power BI/Tableau) for scorecards and operational insights. Web-based tools for self-assessments/security questionnaires; audit and document control systems. title: Lead Engineer-Battery Industrialization
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**

**Battery Industrialization & Process Engineering**

* Lead end-to-end industrialization of battery module and pack manufacturing processes.

* Define process flow, manufacturing sequence, cycle time, line balancing, and process capability.

* 8+ years of experience in battery manufacturing, industrialization, process engineering, or manufacturing engineering.

* Hands-on experience in battery module and pack manufacturing lines within EV, battery, or energy storage manufacturing.

* Demonstrated ownership of NPI / new product launches from pilot build to SOP.

* Hands-on approach to process development and manufacturing challenges.
* Ability to independently drive industrialization activities.
* Strong team leadership and mentoring capabilities.
* Effective vendor management and technical negotiation skills.
* Excellent cross-functional coordination and communication.

title: AVP Mgr-RRS GCC
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. Interest in exploring AI systems and a willingness to develop awareness of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in Finance, Economics, or Business or qualified CA
* CFA/ FRM preferred

* Lead and manage managers, people and projects supporting data, ratings, research, analytical outreach and apply technical knowledge to guide junior team members and lead process improvements.

The RRS GCC teams perform a range of data, analytical and research services that contribute to the overall credit analysis function performed by the rating groups. title: Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
At NI IP Routing SW, we believe in fostering a flat and non-hierarchical work environment. We are obsessed about delivering high-quality products and ensure the utmost level of excellence in everything we do. We are a passionate bunch and strive to be technological leaders in our industry. You will be integral to a close-knit team to engineer best-in-class products for the most critical networks – data centers for web/hyper-scalers, telcos and enterprises (including AI fabrics), and communication service provider networks.
  
  
We are looking for SW engineers who wish to be a part of developing and evolving the current and next generation of routers that form the core of anything internet. These routers are at the heart of Nokia’s IP product offerings, from data centers (including AI fabrics) to providing strong, resilient low latency and dependable IP backhaul for service providers and mission critical networks. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with one of the best engineering teams in the industry. We value your expertise and offer an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. There are more customers we want to win, more networks to penetrate, more technologies to enable and more applications to support. We want to make smaller products, and we want to make bigger products. We want to build products based on newer standards and newer ASICS in the market.
  
  
You will play a critical role in designing and implementing high-performance data path solutions on both custom and merchant silicon. You will be responsible for writing efficient and modular code that is well-tested and robust, ensuring that it meets the high standards required for the most critical networks. Your role will involve working on advanced packet forwarding techniques in IP, MPLS, Segment Routing, VxLANs. You will also contribute into Traffic Management technologies - QoS (Policers, Schedulers, Shapers), ACLs, TCAM Management, and Packet Extractions to CPU. DCN2026.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Design and implementation: You will gain deep expertise in designing and implementing datapath solutions on both custom and merchant silicon.
* Advanced packet forwarding: Develop your skills in IP, MPLS, Segment Routing, VXLANs, and QoS technologies such as Policers, Schedulers, and ACLs. DPDK and performance optimization: You'll be working with DPDK and similar technologies to maximize performance for high-throughput systems.
* Virtualized environments: Expand your knowledge in working with virtualized Linux environments such as KVM and Dockers.
* Team collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product management and software testers, to deliver customer-driven solutions.
* Robust and modular code: Focus on writing modular, maintainable code that is well unit-tested, improving your coding skills and best practices.

**Key Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree with 3-10 years of Experience.
* Proven experience in packet forwarding technologies (IP, MPLS, Segment Routing, VXLANs).
* Experience with QoS technologies (Policers, Schedulers, ACLs) and TCAM management.
* Hands-on experience with DPDK for high-performance packet processing.
* Proficiency in C/C++ programming, with a focus on networking solutions.
* Contributions to SONiC or other open-source networking projects (desirable).
* Methodical problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Experience working in virtualized Linux environments (e.g., KVM, Docker, etc.).
* Passion for networking technologies and high-performance systems.

**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.

title: Training Content Developer
description:
**About Us**
With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.
  
  
Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.
  
  
At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.
  
  
Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.
  
  
Reports To
  
  
Senior Manager, Technical Content Development
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**
The Training Content Developer will be responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of technical training content and learning paths under the guidance of senior training team members. This role will work closely with internal customer teams (Engineering, Product Management, Support, and others) to ensure accurate, timely technical training is available for all ChargePoint hardware and software products. You will collaborate with technical writers, technical illustrators, and the Staff Training Content Developer to create interactive training experiences for installers, technicians, and other technical audiences. To be successful at ChargePoint, this person must be highly motivated, self-directed, and have a good eye for design and detail while being receptive to feedback and mentorship from senior team members.
  
  
**What You Will Bring To ChargePoint**

* Develop and maintain training content in the learning management system (LMS), following established content standards, style guidelines, and brand requirements.
* Create interactive learning activities, course content, and instructional videos to install, use, and service ChargePoint products (hardware and software).

* Support the development of scalable training solutions to ensure programs are consistent and ready for a global audience.
* Design, develop, and conduct assessments and evaluations to measure learner comprehension and course effectiveness.
* Manage individual project tasks across phases of a learning project, including analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation, while escalating risks and blockers to senior team members as needed.
* Prepare content for localization by following established localization guidelines and processes.
* Collaborate with other teams to ensure consistency and clarity across all training and documentation.

**Requirements**

* Minimum of 2-4 years in the design and development of instructional material in a complex product environment (Hardware AND Software).
* Experience working within a learning management system (LMS) is required.
* Strong knowledge of adult learning theory and its application to learning solutions.
* Ability to write behavioral objectives, tests, and course materials using instructional design theories.
* Demonstrated ability to distill technical information from subject matter experts and translate it into training relevant to the target audience.
* Bachelor's degree preferred in Curriculum Development, Instructional Design/Technology, or Education.
* Proficient in Articulate Storyline 360 is required.
* Familiarity with localization processes and preparing content for different regions.
* Experience with raster and vector-based image editing with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator).
* Basic knowledge of video editing and production is a plus.
* Knowledge of Jira, Confluence, or similar project management tools is a plus.
* Ability to work on multiple projects concurrently while meeting tight deadlines.

title: Curriculum Developer Intern (Math)
description:
**About Codingal**

Codingal is an online learning platform helping school students build strong foundations in future-ready subjects through live, instructor-led learning. We work with students across multiple countries and age groups, combining high-quality curriculum, engaging lessons, expert teachers, and a technology-enabled learning experience.

**About the Role**

As Curriculum Developer Intern (Math), you will work on the design and development of mathematics curriculum and lesson content across relevant grade levels.

This is not just a content-writing role. You will think about what students should learn, in what sequence, how concepts are introduced, and how students practise and are assessed.

You will work closely with teachers, academic leaders, product, and operations teams to improve curriculum quality and student outcomes.

**What You Will Do**

* Design mathematics curriculum across relevant grades: learning objectives, scope and sequence, lesson structure, practice, and assessments.
* Create lesson plans, teacher guides, worksheets, activities, quizzes, and assessments.
* Break complex concepts into simple, age-appropriate lessons that build conceptual understanding and problem-solving, not just rote learning.
* Create real-world problems, visual explanations, puzzles, and interactive activities.
* Write teaching notes, worked examples, common-mistake guidance, and remediation strategies.
* Use student data, teacher feedback, and classroom observations to improve existing curriculum.
* Benchmark against national and international standards, and keep progression and quality consistent across lessons, modules, grades, and freelancer content.
* Take part in curriculum reviews, pilots, and new-course launches, and explore how AI can improve curriculum creation and practice.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong academic foundation in Mathematics, Mathematics Education, Engineering, Science, or a related quantitative field.
* 1+ years of experience in mathematics curriculum design, teaching, instructional design, educational publishing, EdTech, or a related field.
* Excellent command of school-level mathematics and strong conceptual clarity.
* Ability to explain difficult concepts simply and sequence them for different age groups.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and written communication skills, with attention to detail.
* Ability to own curriculum projects from idea to execution in a fast-moving environment.

**Good to Have**

* Experience teaching mathematics to school students.
* Familiarity with international curricula such as Common Core, Cambridge, IB, or Singapore Math.
* Experience designing math content for online learning or using learning data to improve curriculum.
* Familiarity with digital learning tools or AI-assisted content creation.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means:

* Students understand concepts deeply and can apply them independently.
* Teachers find the curriculum clear, structured, and easy to deliver.
* Lessons are engaging, rigorous, and age-appropriate, and keep improving based on classroom data.

**Why Join Codingal?**

* Work on a global EdTech brand serving students in 135+ countries, across AI, coding, Math and ELA.
* Join an AI-first team where Claude and automation are part of everyday work.
* Shape Codingal's curriculum.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Free lunch and dinner every day.
* Health insurance coverage upon completing your internship and transitioning to a full-time role.
* Direct collaboration with Sales, marketing and product teams to contribute to growth of Codingal.
* Claude access with an annual token budget of ₹20 lakh+.

**Stipend:**
INR 28,000/month (about INR 25,000 in hand)

**Working days:**
Monday to Saturday

**Shift Time:**
11am to 8pm

**Duration:**
6 Months

**Location:**
HSR Layout, Bangalore, India (in-person only, no remote option)

* You get to work with a young & smart team, including directly with the founders, who are on a mission to inspire school kids to fall in love with learning. Join us on the journey to provide education to every K-12 student and prepare them for the future.

title: Solution Architect
description:
**Join our Team**
About this opportunity:
  
  
We are seeking a Cloud Architect to design, define, and govern cloud-native infrastructure for SD SL core network deployments. The role covers the cloud platform that hosts 5G and 4G core network functions, including Cloud Network Functions (CNFs), and ensures they meet performance, availability, security, and operational requirements. The architect works across network, cloud, and delivery teams to move solutions from design through deployment and into operation.
  
  
What will you do:
  
  

* Design the end-to-end cloud infrastructure for core network workloads, including compute, storage, networking, and orchestration layers.
* Define cloud platform architecture for CNF hosting, covering Kubernetes-based and NFV-based deployments as applicable.
* Specify placement, resource allocation, and scaling strategies for core network functions such as AMF, SMF, UPF, PCF, UDM, AUSF, NRF, and NSSF.
* Ensure cloud designs meet telecom-grade requirements for latency, throughput, high availability, geo-redundancy, and disaster recovery.
* Define cloud security architecture, including network segmentation, identity and access management, secrets management, and compliance controls.
* Collaborate with core network architects on SBI, interworking, and protocol-level requirements that affect cloud design.
* Lead architecture reviews, design documentation, and solution approval with internal and customer stakeholders.
* Evaluate cloud vendors, platforms, and tools, and make technology recommendations with clear trade-off analysis.
* Support deployment planning, troubleshoot architecture-level issues during rollout, and provide guidance to delivery teams.
* Drive automation, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD practices for core network cloud environments.
* Establish and maintain architecture standards, reference designs, and best practices.

The skills you bring:
  
  

* Proven experience architecting cloud platforms for telecom or mission-critical workloads.
* Strong knowledge of cloud-native technologies, including Kubernetes, containers, and service mesh concepts.
* Working knowledge of virtualization and NFV concepts, including OpenStack or equivalent platforms.

title: Solution Architect And Product Owner
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Unified Support Services (USS) Solution Architect & Product Owner, Support Experience Platforms (U642)**
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization. As part of Enterprise Technology, you'll be at the forefront of integrating technology into what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**The opportunity**
EY's global Enterprise Technology group provides enabling services across enterprise platforms, infrastructure, digital workplace and service operations. The Solution Architect & Product Owner is a pivotal role within Unified Support Services, accountable for the end-to-end solution architecture, integration strategy, product roadmap and delivery of Support Experience platforms.
  
  
The role serves as the architectural authority for the Support Experience technology ecosystem. The individual will design, govern and enable integrated solutions across ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud, LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics, Nexthink, Microsoft Copilot, knowledge platforms, automation solutions and other Service Desk technologies. The role requires deep ServiceNow architecture expertise, strong systems integration capability and sufficient product ownership experience to translate business priorities into a coherent architecture and executable roadmap.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring together business, product, architecture, engineering, security, operations and vendor teams to deliver scalable, secure, resilient and user-centered support solutions from concept through implementation and operational adoption.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the lead Solution Architect and design authority for the Unified Support Services Support Experience ecosystem.
* Define current-state, target-state and transition architectures for Support Experience platforms, including the supporting technology roadmap.
* Own end-to-end solution design across user channels, workflows, integrations, data, knowledge, automation, AI capabilities and operational processes.
* Provide architectural leadership across ServiceNow ITSM, r, Virtual Agent, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, CMDB, IntegrationHub and Flow Designer.
* Design scalable ServiceNow solutions, data models, workflows and platform extensions while protecting platform integrity, maintainability and upgradeability.
* Own the end-to-end integration strategy across ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud, LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics, Nexthink, Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Teams, identity services, enterprise knowledge and automation platforms.
* Define API-led, event-driven, workflow-based and middleware integration patterns, including authentication, authorization, error handling, monitoring, data synchronization and recovery.
* Enable continuity of identity, conversation, intent, device context, case context and interaction history across chatbot, live chat, voice, portal, remote support and assisted-service channels.
* Lead the Genesys integration roadmap with ITSM and digital channels to support intelligent routing and escalation between virtual, digital and voice channels without avoidable loss of context.
* Architect secure integration with LogMeIn Rescue, including remote-session launch, user and case context, technician workflow, audit information and case updates.
* Architect the use of Nexthink telemetry and automation capabilities to support proactive issue identification, contextual diagnostics and remediation workflows.
* Integrate Qualtrics experience data with support platforms to enable feedback capture, experience analysis and closed-loop service improvement.
* Define knowledge integration and orchestration across ServiceNow Knowledge, OEM knowledge sources, internal runbooks and enterprise repositories.
* Define architecture patterns and governance controls for virtual agents, Copilot experiences, agent-assist capabilities, enterprise search and AI-enabled support.
* Establish architecture principles, reference architectures, reusable patterns, technical guardrails, interface standards and non-functional requirements.
* Lead solution architecture reviews and ensure alignment with Enterprise Architecture, information security, privacy, data governance, compliance and resilience requirements.
* Provide technical leadership to engineering teams, platform teams, vendors and implementation partners throughout design, build, testing, deployment and transition to operations.
* Review solution designs, integration specifications, data mappings, user stories, test strategies, release plans and production-readiness evidence.
* Own technical risks, dependencies, architecture decisions, exceptions and technical debt, ensuring timely resolution and transparent escalation.
* Define and communicate the product vision, platform strategy, value proposition and roadmap for Support Experience platforms.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, architectural dependencies, operational impact, risk and user experience outcomes.
* Translate business objectives and architecture into epics, capabilities, features, non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria and release plans.
* Partner with stakeholders to gather and refine requirements, evaluate solution options and validate that delivered capabilities meet intended outcomes.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives, while providing architecture direction and timely decisions.
* Define and monitor measures for platform adoption, reliability, integration performance, self-service, automation, experience and value realization.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to senior leaders and communicate architecture options, trade-offs, recommendations, risks and roadmap implications clearly.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**To qualify for the role you must have**

* 12+ years of experience across enterprise technology, solution architecture, platform engineering, IT service management or digital workplace solutions.
* 7+ years of ServiceNow solution architecture or equivalent senior technical leadership experience.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise-scale employee support, service management or omnichannel service solutions.
* Strong ServiceNow expertise across ITSM, Employee Center, Virtual Agent, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, CMDB, IntegrationHub and Flow Designer.
* Demonstrated experience designing complex integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise platforms using APIs, events, middleware and orchestration technologies.
* Practical architecture or integration experience involving Genesys Cloud and one or more of LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics and Nexthink.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, event-driven architecture, integration security, identity and access management, data flows, observability and resilient interface design.
* Experience leading architecture governance, technical design reviews and delivery assurance across internal teams and external partners.
* Experience translating architecture and business priorities into product roadmaps, epics, non-functional requirements and executable delivery plans.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing, decision-making and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively across a complex, global and matrixed organization.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and ITIL-aligned service management processes.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator and relevant Certified Implementation Specialist credentials.
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer or architect-level ServiceNow credentials; Certified Technical Architect is preferred.
* TOGAF or an equivalent enterprise architecture certification.
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, conversational AI, enterprise search or knowledge graphs.
* Experience delivering Digital Employee Experience, proactive support, intelligent automation or AI-enabled IT support transformation.
* Experience defining AI, knowledge governance and data protection controls for enterprise support solutions.
* Confidence to make timely decisions, articulate trade-offs and challenge proposed options constructively.
* A customer-centric mindset and the ability to connect technical solutions to measurable user and business outcomes.

**What We Look For**

* A technology leader who combines deep ServiceNow architecture expertise with strong product judgment and end-to-end delivery accountability.
* A proven ability to define target architecture, govern complex integrations and lead cross-functional teams from strategy through implementation and operational adoption.
* Strong systems thinking and the ability to balance enterprise standards, user experience, business value, delivery pragmatism and long-term maintainability.
* Overall experience relevant to an Assistant Director-level role in enterprise support technology, solution architecture or service management transformation.
* Willingness to support a global service environment and collaborate across time zones as required.

**What We Offer**
As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, global team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here's a snapshot of what we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Job Details

**About BHIVE Workspace:**

BHIVE Workspace is one of Bengaluru’s leading flexible workspace providers. Founded in 2014, BHIVE has grown into a homegrown brand that offers coworking spaces, managed offices and enterprise workspace solutions across key business districts in the city. We serve thousands of members, from early-stage startups and freelancers to large enterprises and global companies.

Our goal is to make great workspaces accessible, so that businesses of every size can grow without the cost and complexity of traditional real estate. Beyond workspaces, BHIVE is building a wider real estate ecosystem that includes investment-led platforms.

BHIVE is in a strong growth phase, opening new centres and expanding our portfolio across Bengaluru. You’ll have real ownership, work closely with leadership, and help shape how India’s next generation of businesses works.

**Why join us:**

* Join a well-established brand with 30+ centres across Bengaluru’s prime business hubs

* Be part of a fast-growing, founder-led company with a big expansion roadmap

* Take on high-ownership roles with visible impact and direct access to leadership

* Work in a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture where ideas move quickly

* Learn across real estate, hospitality, sales and technology

**About the role:**

The Head – Client Relations will own BHIVE’s entire client portfolio of ~1,100 active contracts, leading account management and customer success end to end – renewals, expansions, exits and the commercial negotiations around them. You will own renewal rate, expansions and exits as business outcomes, engage client founders, CFOs and admin heads as a peer, and build the team, playbooks and processes that make the function run. This is a senior leadership role with direct visibility to the CEO and leadership.

**Why this role matters now:**

Our existing clients are the foundation of BHIVE’s revenue. As the portfolio grows, how well we retain, renew and expand these accounts – and how early we spot the ones at risk – will directly shape the company’s growth and profitability. This role exists to turn Client Relations into a proactive, commercially sharp and metrics-driven function. If building that excites you, the impact this position can have is huge.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Portfolio ownership:** Own the full portfolio of ~1,100 contracts – from post-onboarding through renewal, expansion, contraction and exit; tier accounts by value and risk and set the right engagement cadence for each.

* **Renewals and retention:** Own renewal rate and net revenue retention; maintain a forward 90/180/365-day renewal pipeline so that no renewal is reached without a plan.

* **Commercial negotiations:** Lead negotiations on pricing, escalations, lock-ins, notice periods, exits and other contract terms – protecting revenue and margin while keeping relationships intact.

* **Expansions:** Identify and convert expansion opportunities within existing accounts – additional seats, new centres, managed office upgrades and add-on services – working with Enterprise Sales on large requirements.

* **Exits and at-risk accounts:** Build an account health framework with early-warning signals; spot at-risk accounts early, run structured retention plays, and manage unavoidable exits commercially and cleanly.

* **Escalations:** Act as the senior escalation point for demanding clients and difficult situations, resolving them decisively and fixing root causes with Operations, Facilities, Technology and Finance.

* **Client leadership engagement:** Build peer-level relationships with client founders, CFOs and admin heads; run structured account reviews (QBRs) for key clients.

* **Team, playbooks and processes:** Build and lead a team of 10–20; define roles, KRAs and portfolio allocation; put in place playbooks and SOPs for renewals, expansions, exits, escalations and client communication.

* **Metrics and reporting:** Drive CRM discipline and dashboards so that portfolio health, renewal forecasts, risk and retention outcomes are visible to leadership in real time.

**What success looks like**

* **In 90 days:** You have mapped and tiered the full portfolio, put a renewal and exit pipeline and an at-risk account list in place, and personally engaged the top client accounts.

* **In 12 months:** Renewal rate and expansion revenue are measurably up and avoidable exits are down; playbooks, review cadences and dashboards are running; and the team is built out and owning its portfolios.

**What you’ll need**

* **Education & Experience:** Graduate (MBA preferred) with 15–18 years of total experience, including at least 5–7 years managing a portfolio of B2B clients on recurring contracts.

* **Commercial Negotiation:** Strong track record of negotiating pricing, lock-ins, exits and contract terms with large corporate clients.

* **Executive Presence:** The credibility to deal with client founders, CFOs and admin heads as a peer.

* **Escalation Handling:** Proven at managing demanding clients and difficult escalations while keeping the relationship intact.

* **Proactive & Metrics-driven:** Owns renewal rate, expansions and exits as numbers; spots at-risk accounts early rather than reacting late.

* **Team Leadership:** Has built and led a team of 10–20 and put playbooks and processes in place.

* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal communication; able to influence internal leadership and hold firm with clients where needed.

**Good to haves**

* **Industry exposure:** Integrated facility management (account leadership on multi-year corporate contracts); hospitality (corporate and key accounts); enterprise B2B SaaS (customer success leadership with real commercial ownership).

* **Flex workspace experience:** Experience in flex / coworking / managed offices is a plus, but not essential.

* **Tools:** Hands-on with CRM, account health dashboards and portfolio analytics.

**Not the right fit**

* Commercial real estate developer or leasing backgrounds (very different client size and rhythm).

* Transaction-focused brokerage or pure new-sales profiles.

**What you’ll get**

* Ownership of BHIVE’s most important revenue base – our existing clients – with a clear mandate to shape the function.

* Direct exposure to the CEO and leadership team; you will present portfolio performance in leadership forums.

* The opportunity to build and lead your own team and put your playbooks in place.

* A front-row seat in a fast-growing, founder-led company with a big expansion roadmap.

As part of the India Security Systems Engineering organisation, you will lead the Commercial Systems Engineering team while providing technical leadership and mentorship across the broader India Systems Engineering management matrix, including Enterprise, BFSI and Public Sector. You will work closely with sales leadership, customers, partners and global product teams to drive Cisco's security strategy and accelerate platform convergence across India.
  
  
Your Impact
  
As the Senior Systems Engineering Manager – Security, you will lead the technical pre-sales organisation driving Cisco's security transformation across India. Based in Bangalore, you will combine direct team leadership with national technical leadership, executive customer engagement and strategic go-to-market execution.
  
This is a player-coach leadership role requiring strong technical expertise, business acumen and the ability to develop high-performing engineering teams while driving strategic customer outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Team Leadership& Development: Lead, recruit and develop a high-performing team of Commercial Security Systems Engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, inclusion and career development.
* National Technical Leadership: Provide strategic technical guidance, architectural alignment and operational mentorship to peer Systems Engineering Managers across Enterprise, BFSI and Public Sector, establishing consistent technical go-to-market standards across India.

* Executive Customer Engagement: Build trusted relationships with CISOs, CIOs and senior technology leaders, articulating the business value of Cisco Security Cloud and translating complex security architectures into measurable business outcomes.
* Platform Convergence& Go-to-Market: Champion Cisco's integrated security strategy across Cisco Cloud Control (CCC), Security in Cloud Control, Cisco Secure Access (SSE), Duo Identity Intelligence and Splunk Enterprise Security.
* Partner Ecosystem Development: Collaborate with national system integrators, managed service providers (MSPs), distributors and strategic partners to expand technical capabilities, scale customer engagement and drive partner-led Proof of Value (POV) initiatives.
* Sales& Business Alignment: Partner closely with sales leadership to manage technical pipeline, forecasting, resource allocation and capacity planning, ensuring engineering investments are aligned with business priorities.
* Engineering Excellence: Establish a culture of technical integrity and strategic customer engagement, ensuring Systems Engineers operate as technical co-owners of customer opportunities and focus on high-impact architectural engagements.
* Product& Engineering Collaboration: Represent the voice of the field by partnering with global Product Management and Engineering teams to influence product enhancements, regional requirements, local compliance and market-specific priorities.
* Security Innovation& Market Leadership: Drive customer adoption and technical enablement across Platform Convergence, SASE, AI-driven SecOps (Splunk + XDR), Autonomous Workload Protection (Cisco Hypershield) and Hybrid Mesh Firewall.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in technical pre-sales, systems engineering or enterprise cybersecurity, with demonstrated experience supporting complex enterprise security solutions.
* 3+ years of direct people management experience leading Systems Engineers, technical pre-sales teams or specialist engineering organisations.
* Demonstrated technical expertise in at least two of the following security domains: Cloud Security and SASE/SSE, Zero Trust and Identity Security, SecOps and Threat Defence, or Data Centre and Workload Protection.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience partnering with sales leadership and driving technical win strategies, customer engagements, pipeline management or technical resource planning in an enterprise technology environment.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Advanced industry certifications such as CCIE Security, CISSP, CISM, AWS Security or Azure Security certifications.
* Strong architectural knowledge across modern security technologies, including ZTNA, SWG, CASB, FWaaS, phishing-resistant MFA, FIDO2, microsegmentation, SIEM, XDR, EDR, SOAR, threat intelligence and distributed firewall architectures.
* Experience with security platforms and technologies such as Hybrid Mesh Firewall, Cisco Secure Access, Duo, Cisco ISE, Splunk Enterprise Security, Cisco XDR, Cisco Secure Workload, Zscaler, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike, Illumio, Okta or CyberArk.

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. **About Arbhu Enterprises**

We are building a high-energy, tech-driven platform to transform how businesses worldwide source Indian products.

From **quality checks to seamless logistics, warehousing, and 3PL support**, we ensure that importers around the world can **source and scale Indian products effortlessly**.

Our mission: to simplify global trade through technology, data, and human intelligence
  
  
**Your Role: Sales Executive**

You’ll be the face of the business to global importers — connecting, understanding, and converting opportunities into long-term relationships.

This role blends **sales intelligence, operational understanding, and process precision**. You’ll need to know **products, export processes, and client psychology** — not just talk numbers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Make a **minimum of 150 outbound calls per day** to connect with importers and distributors worldwide.
* Understand and articulate **product categories, pricing, and export workflows** confidently.
* **Qualify leads** from inbound and outbound channels — understand buyer intent, business models, and product interest.
* Prepare and share **quotes, proforma invoices, and product catalogs**.
* Coordinate with **operations** for sample dispatches, lead times, and shipping updates.
* Work with the **marketing team** to fine-tune messaging, campaigns, and lead follow-ups.
* Maintain CRM hygiene — log all activities, calls, and deal stages accurately in Zoho or internal ERP.
* Continuously **learn export terms, international markets, and product insights** to improve conversion rates.
* Participate in training, product walkthroughs, and AI-driven performance tracking.
* Report daily metrics, follow-up statuses, and pipeline progress to the leadership team.

  
  
  

### **Requirements**

  
  

* **1–3 years** of experience in B2B sales / inside sales / export sales (startup or export house experience preferred).
* Ability to handle **high-volume communication** — calls, emails, and CRM management.
* Familiarity with **export jargons and workflows** (Incoterms, MOQ, FOB/CIF pricing, lead times).
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Proficiency in **Excel, PPT, Zoho, or similar CRMs**.
* Highly organized, proactive, and outcome-focused — no hand-holding required.
* Comfortable coordinating with global clients across **multiple time zones**.
* Curiosity to learn tools, automations, and workflows (Zoho, GPTs, Claude, n8n etc.).

  

### **What You’ll Get**

* Access to 100+ AI and automation tools to supercharge your workflow.
* Exposure to **global B2B trade**, across multiple geographies and product categories.
* Structured learning in **exports, logistics, and product operations**.
* Opportunity to scale into **Account Manager / Regional Lead roles**.
* Work directly with founders and senior leadership on strategic growth.

* + After applying, your **first interview will be conducted automatically within 10 minutes** via a call from our AI agent.

Please ensure you’re in a quiet environment to attend the call.

Software Architect – Consumer Payments Platform

Location: Bengaluru | Full-time | Work from office

Compensation: ₹65–90 LPA base · Up to ₹130 LPA total compensation

Experience: 10+ years building highly scalable business applications

About the company

One of India's largest consumer digital payments platforms, used by hundreds of millions of people to send money, pay merchants and manage their finances on mobile.

About the role

You'll turn high-level business problems into scalable designs and code, drive the architecture of multiple subsystems, and own the scalability and reliability of core systems that run at national scale.

What you'll do

* Translate high-level business problems into scalable design and code.
* Build platforms and services on a strong base of distributed systems and large-scale storage design.
* Write performant, unit-tested code; design object models and data structures with systems aspects in mind.
* Create libraries and utilities used across teams.
* Influence product requirements and operational plans; work with product managers to estimate and plan projects, including dependencies.
* Set and champion engineering best practices.
* Mentor engineers on design, coding practices and TDD, with a real mentoring plan for each mentee.
* Own the scalability and reliability of your systems and the wider ecosystem they touch, and share learnings across teams.

Mandatory requirements – please apply only if you meet all of them

1. 10+ years building highly scalable business applications with complex business flows and large data volumes.

2. Expert, hands-on programming in at least one of Java, C or C++ (Python is a plus).

3. Have driven the design and architecture of multiple subsystems, with deep object-oriented design and design-pattern skills.

4. Strong distributed systems and large-scale storage experience.

5. Have worked in a startup environment with high ownership.

6. BTech, MTech or PhD in Computer Science or a related discipline (or equivalent).

7. Based in Bengaluru or willing to relocate.

Nice to have

* Test-Driven Development in practice.
* Payments or fintech experience.
* Clear communicator who can explain complex technical ideas to any audience.

How to apply

Applications are accepted through The Professionals Club application form:

https://www.theprofessionals.club/apply/network?job=5db8b7da-0808-4873-90a6-215410b960a7

Please complete the form and upload your updated résumé. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for next steps.

title: Sr Mgr IT Operations
description:
**We Are Teva**
---------------

We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.

**Our Team, Your Impact**
-------------------------

The Senior Manager, IT Operations is responsible for the strategy, architecture, operations, availability, and lifecycle management of enterprise storage and SAN infrastructure across production and disaster recovery environments.

The role provides technical and operational leadership across **NetApp and Hitachi storage platforms, Fibre Channel SAN infrastructure, VMware Site Recovery Manager (SRM), storage replication, high availability, and disaster recovery**. The position works closely with virtualization, backup, server, database, network, cloud, security, and application teams to ensure infrastructure remains resilient, secure, scalable, and recoverable.

**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------

**Storage Infrastructure**

* Lead enterprise storage architecture, engineering, operations, and lifecycle management.
* Manage **NetApp AFF/FAS and ONTAP** environments, including aggregates, SVMs, volumes, LUNs, snapshots, replication, capacity, performance, and high availability.
* Manage **Hitachi VSP** storage environments and technologies such as **Global-Active Device (GAD), TrueCopy, and Hitachi Universal Replicator (HUR)**.
* Drive storage capacity planning, performance optimization, refresh programs, migrations, upgrades, and technology roadmaps.
* Establish standards for provisioning, monitoring, patching, firmware management, configuration, and storage administration.

**SAN & Fibre Channel**

* Provide technical leadership for enterprise **Fibre Channel SAN** environments.
* Oversee **Brocade/Cisco SAN switches**, zoning, fabrics, ISLs, multipathing, WWPN management, and connectivity.
* Troubleshoot complex end-to-end storage connectivity and performance issues spanning hosts, HBAs, SAN fabrics, and storage arrays.
* Maintain resilient SAN architecture with appropriate redundancy and fault isolation.

**Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity**

* Own storage-related DR architecture and operational readiness.
* Lead **VMware SRM** design and operations, including protection/recovery planning and coordination with storage replication.
* Develop and maintain DR operating procedures, recovery workflows, dependencies, and technical documentation.
* Coordinate periodic DR testing and ensure identified gaps are tracked through remediation.
* Support recovery objectives such as **RPO and RTO** together with application and business stakeholders.
* Lead technical response during storage, SAN, replication, and DR incidents.

**Leadership & Governance**

* Lead and mentor storage/SAN engineers and provide technical direction for complex infrastructure initiatives.
* Establish engineering standards, operational procedures, documentation, and governance.
* Drive problem management and root-cause analysis for major storage and DR incidents.
* Manage technology lifecycle risks including **EOL/EOS**, support renewals, hardware refreshes, capacity risks, and technical debt.
* Participate in change management, architecture reviews, risk assessments, audit activities, and infrastructure governance.
* Manage relationships with strategic technology partners and vendors such as **NetApp, Hitachi Vantara, VMware/Broadcom, Cisco, Brocade, and support/service providers**.
* Support budgeting and investment planning for storage refreshes, capacity growth, maintenance, and modernization initiatives.

**Strong expertise**

* NetApp ONTAP, AFF/FAS
* Hitachi VSP enterprise storage
* Hitachi GAD, HUR and TrueCopy
* Fibre Channel SAN
* Brocade and/or Cisco SAN switching
* Zoning, WWPN, HBA and multipathing
* VMware vSphere and VMware SRM
* Storage replication and DR
* High Availability architectures
* Storage performance and capacity management
* Storage migration and lifecycle management

**Good working knowledge**

* Windows and Linux storage integration
* VMware datastores, VMFS and NFS
* NAS protocols such as NFS and SMB
* Block storage concepts such as FC and iSCSI
* Cloud/object storage concepts
* Monitoring and automation
* ITIL-based incident, problem and change management

**Your Qualification and Experience**
-------------------------------------

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

* 10-12 years’ experience in enterprise storage, SAN, infrastructure, or DR engineering/operations.
* Hands-on background with **NetApp and/or Hitachi enterprise storage**.
* Experience operating highly available, business-critical infrastructure.
* Experience leading storage migrations, hardware refreshes, DR initiatives, and major infrastructure changes.
* Previous responsibility for technical teams, engineering functions, or infrastructure programs is strongly preferred.

Relevant certifications are beneficial:

* NetApp certifications
* VMware certifications
* Cisco/Brocade SAN certifications
* Hitachi Vantara certifications
* ITIL

**How We’ll Take Care of You**
------------------------------

At Teva India, care is at the heart of how we work. From your first day, you’ll be welcomed into a people-first culture built on inclusion, respect, and belonging.

That support extends to you and your loved ones through benefits designed for real life. These include comprehensive medical insurance, OPD coverage, annual health checkups, term life and accident insurance, and confidential emotional wellbeing support through our Optum Employee Assistance Program. You’ll also enjoy healthy meals at work, holistic wellbeing initiatives, and volunteering programs that help you give back to the community.

Your growth matters too. You’ll have opportunities to build future-ready skills, collaborate on projects with global teams, explore internal career opportunities, and learn through programs such as our AI-enabled Teva Twist program, R&D Academy, continuing education, and mentorship.

Join our vibrant workplace, where we celebrate milestones, festivals, achievements, and community impact together.

**Already Working @Teva?**
--------------------------

Make sure to apply through our internal career site on Twist—your one-stop shop for career development

**Teva’s Equal Employment Opportunity Commitment**
--------------------------------------------------

Teva Pharmaceuticals is committed to equal opportunity in employment. It is Teva's global policy that equal employment opportunity be provided without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, disability, pregnancy, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status, national or ethnic origin or any other legally recognized status entitled to protection under applicable laws. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace for all. If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations needed to support you throughout the recruitment and selection process. All accommodation information provided will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of providing an accessible candidate experience.

title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Assume a critical role in defining the future of a globally recognized firm and have a direct and significant effect in a realm tailored for top achievers in site reliability.
  

  

As a Lead Site Reliability Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Infrastructure Platforms team, you hold a leadership role in your team, demonstrate strong knowledge across multiple technical domains, and advise others on the technical and business issues facing them. Take lead and conduct resiliency design reviews, break up complex problems into digestible work for other engineers, act as a technical lead for medium to large\-sized products, and provide advice and mentoring to other engineers.
  

  

**Job responsibilities*** Engineer reliability into enterprise\-scale platforms by writing production software: automation, control loops, self\-healing, and tooling that remove manual operations rather than institutionalise them
* Build systems around declarative, intent\-based design: model the desired state as data in a trusted source of truth and let automation continuously reconcile reality to it, rather than driving change through imperative, one\-off scripts
* Treat data as a first\-class reliability asset: instrument, collect, and reason over telemetry and state data to drive detection, diagnosis, and closed\-loop remediation
* Define and operationalize SLIs and SLOs with stakeholders; implement SLO\-based alerting, telemetry standards, and actionable observability
* Own services end\-to\-end, taking accountability for reliability, performance, security, and cost, and building operability and observability in from the start
* Share an on\-call rotation and act as a technical leader during major incidents: drive triage, mitigation, communications, and blameless post\-incident reviews, then engineer the durable fix
* Drive down toil measurably through automation and better engineering; treat repeated manual work as a bug to be coded out
* Work AI\-native across the SDLC (AI\-assisted development, code review, test generation, incident and root\-cause analysis) with clear validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing), so speed never compromises correctness
* Decompose ambiguous reliability problems into clear, executable work for yourself and for AI agents, and integrate the results into coherent, production\-ready systems; set reliability standards and raise the engineering bar across your team and partner organizations; apply security and operational\-risk judgment throughout the engineering lifecycle
* Leads reuse\-first adoption of AI\-assisted reliability workflows across SDLC/toolchain practices (e.g., CI/CD quality checks, test/validation automation, and operational readiness), ensuring traceability/auditability, resiliency, and security controls.
* Uses enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate major\-incident triage, troubleshooting, and post\-incident analysis, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**
* Formal training or certification on site reliability engineering concepts and 5\+ years applied experience
* Strong production coding skills in an industry\-standard language (e.g. Python, Go, Java, C\+\+, Rust); this is a software engineering role
* Hands\-on experience operating production systems at scale, including on\-call ownership, incident response, and designing for reliability/operability
* Practical SLI/SLO/error\-budget experience (or clear aptitude and appetite to own and evolve it)
* Deep observability experience: white\-box/black\-box monitoring, SLO\-based alerting, and telemetry using tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, or equivalent
* Proficiency with \*nix plus infrastructure automation and tooling (e.g. Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD)
* Strong systems thinking across interfaces, contracts, failure modes, and interactions at scale
* Fluency directing AI tools to do real engineering work (beyond autocomplete), with sound judgment on when AI applies vs. when deep human expertise is required
* Security\-first and outcome\-oriented mindset: integrate risk judgment from design through production, with focus on reliability, impact, and cost (not activity)
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to improve SRE workflows (e.g., incident investigation support and knowledge capture) with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to evaluate AI\-assisted operational recommendations for correctness and risk, define appropriate guardrails for team usage, and ensure outcomes align to resiliency and security expectations.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**
* Networking depth (routing, switching, security, packet/flow analysis) or experience operating network\-adjacent platforms: a strong plus, not a requirement
* Experience across multiple infrastructure domains or programming languages
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g. context/prompt engineering, agent orchestration) and use of AI to redesign workflows for measurable impact
* Prior experience in regulated or large\-scale enterprise environments
* Experience establishing engineering culture

**ABOUT US**

description:

===================

**Job Title:** VPN L1 Engineer  
**Experience:** 2–4 Years  
**Location:** Airoli, Navi Mumbai  
**CTC:** 4–4.75 LPA  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Joining:** Immediate to 30 Days Preferred  
**Working Days:** 6 Days a Week  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office  
**Shift:** Rotational Shifts (24×7 Support Environment)

### **Job Summary**

We are looking for a Network Security Engineer with experience in VPN solutions and network security operations. The role involves VPN implementation, configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, policy management, incident handling, and day-to-day network security operations.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Manage, configure, implement, and maintain VPN solutions.

title: BMS Operator
description:
**Job Designation:** BMS Operator

**Job Summary:**

The BMS Operator will assist the Maintenance Engineer in monitoring all Building Management Systems (BMS) to ensure that environmental systems operate within specified parameters and that all building systems function efficiently and reliably. The role involves identifying deviations from system specifications, coordinating with technicians and staff to resolve issues, and assisting in calibration and fine-tuning of control systems.

**Designation**

BMS Operator

  

**Location**

Navi Mumbai

Department

Administration

  

Key Responsibilities

* Assist in day-to-day monitoring of Building Management Systems across multiple locations.
* Monitor system performance, respond to alarms, and analyze trending data.
* Support monitoring of temperature and humidity-controlled environments.
* Document all changes, modifications, programming updates, and set point adjustments in BMS.
* Coordinate with maintenance and operations teams for troubleshooting system issues.
* Assist in installation and integration of new equipment, instrumentation, and control systems.
* Support preventive and corrective maintenance activities, inspections, and site surveys.
* Assist in replacement and modification of control and instrumentation equipment.
* Support tuning of PID loop controllers and assist in implementing control strategies.
* Assist in updating and maintaining operator interface graphics.
* Support calibration of sensors including temperature, humidity, and airflow devices.

  

**Educational Qualifications**

* ITI / Diploma / Graduation in Electrical / Electronics / Mechanical / Instrumentation or related field.

  

**Professional Certifications:**

* Certification in BMS, HVAC systems, or Industrial Automation (preferred).

  

**Professional Experience**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in Building Management Systems, HVAC automation controls, energy management systems, or related fields.

  

**Skills and Competencies**

* Ability to read blueprints, control drawings, and logic diagrams.
* Knowledge of HVAC systems, BMS programming, and communication networks.
* Understanding of psychrometric charts and HVAC fundamentals.
* Ability to install relays and perform basic wiring tasks.
* Proficiency in using measuring instruments such as temperature, humidity, voltage, and current meters.
* Ability to work with HVAC technicians for maintenance and repair activities.
* Knowledge of commissioning, troubleshooting, and repair of HVAC and environmental control systems.
* Understanding of electronics, DDC systems, pneumatic controls, airflow, hydraulics, and refrigeration principles.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – PURCHASE MANAGER

**Department:** Purchase & Procurement  
**Industry:** Interior Design, Fit-Out & Construction  
**Reporting To:** Director / Head of Operations

1. JOB OBJECTIVE

To manage and execute all procurement activities for the company's interior fit-out and construction projects, ensuring timely availability of materials at competitive prices, approved quality and within project budgets.

2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* **Purchase Planning:** Understand project requirements, BOQs and material indents, and prepare project-wise procurement schedules.
* **Vendor Management:** Develop and maintain a strong vendor network for interior, furniture, electrical, plumbing and civil construction materials.
* **Quotation & Negotiation:** Obtain competitive quotations, prepare comparative statements and negotiate the best possible rates and commercial terms.
* **Purchase Orders:** Prepare and issue POs after obtaining necessary approvals, ensuring correct specifications, quantities, rates and delivery schedules.
* **Material Coordination:** Ensure timely procurement and delivery of materials at project sites in coordination with Project Managers and Site Engineers.
* **Cost Control:** Monitor purchase costs against approved project budgets and identify opportunities for cost savings.
* **Quality Control:** Ensure materials are procured as per approved brands, samples and specifications in coordination with the Design and Project Teams.
* **Vendor Follow-up:** Monitor order status, delivery commitments, pending supplies, replacements and vendor performance.
* **Documentation:** Maintain records of quotations, comparative statements, purchase orders, delivery challans, invoices and vendor payments.
* **MIS & Reporting:** Submit regular project-wise purchase reports, pending material status, cost variations and procurement updates to management.

3. AUTHORITY & RESPONSIBILITY

* No purchase shall be made without an authorised material requisition and prescribed approval.
* No changes in approved specifications, brands or quantities without approval.
* No purchase commitment beyond approved project budgets without management approval.
* Responsible for procurement planning, commercial negotiations and timely material availability.

4. QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE

* Minimum 5 years of experience in purchase and procurement.
* Experience in interior fit-out and turnkey projects is preferred.
* Basic knowledge of civil construction materials and processes.
* Good negotiation, vendor management and commercial skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and purchase documentation.

5. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

* Timely procurement and delivery of materials.
* Cost savings and competitive purchase rates.
* Procurement within approved project budgets.
* Vendor reliability and material quality.
* Proper documentation and reporting.
* Minimum emergency purchases through advance planning.

**OVERALL EXPECTATION:** Complete ownership of the procurement cycle, ensuring the right material, at the right price, with the right quality and delivered at the right time, while protecting the company's commercial interests.
