***Senior BIM Plumbing Engineer***

**About iRivet**

iRivet is a Dubai-headquartered BIM and digital engineering company expanding its operations in Pune, India. We specialize in BIM management, multidisciplinary modelling and coordination, shop drawings, 4D/5D BIM, Scan to BIM, as-built modelling, asset information management and digital construction solutions for international projects.

**Job Overview**

We are seeking highly skilled Senior BIM Plumbing Engineers with expert-level Autodesk Revit MEP proficiency and extensive hands-on experience in LOD 400/500 BIM modelling, plumbing shop drawing production and construction-stage BIM delivery.

The successful candidates must be capable of independently developing detailed Plumbing and Public Health Engineering (PHE) BIM models, producing construction-ready shop drawings and resolving complex multidisciplinary coordination and constructability issues.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, review and maintain detailed plumbing BIM models at LOD 400 and LOD 500.
* Produce construction-ready plumbing and drainage shop drawings directly from Revit models.
* Develop domestic cold water, hot water and hot water return systems.
* Develop soil, waste, vent, sanitary drainage, rainwater and stormwater drainage systems.
* Prepare detailed pump room, water tank, water treatment, riser and service corridor layouts.
* Develop external plumbing networks and coordinate connections with infrastructure and utility systems.
* Prepare coordinated plans, sections, elevations, riser diagrams, schematics and installation details.
* Ensure accurate pipe sizing in accordance with approved designs, slopes, invert levels, routing and system connectivity.
* Interpret IFC drawings, specifications, approved material submittals and equipment technical data.
* Develop complex parametric Revit MEP families with accurate connectors and system parameters.
* Prepare builder's work drawings, service openings, sleeves and penetration details.
* Develop pipe hanger, support and installation details in accordance with project requirements.
* Coordinate plumbing systems with Architecture, Structure, HVAC, Electrical, Fire Fighting, Interior Design, Landscape and specialist disciplines.
* Identify and resolve clashes, accessibility, maintenance clearance and constructability issues.
* Incorporate approved RFIs, design revisions, consultant comments and site instructions.
* Develop as-built BIM models and drawings based on verified site information.
* Extract material quantities, equipment schedules and asset information from BIM models.
* Perform comprehensive model and drawing QA/QC before submission.
* Provide technical guidance and support to junior BIM engineers and modelers.
* Maintain production quality, productivity and project delivery schedules.
* Manage cloud-based collaboration, worksharing, model publishing and issue resolution through Autodesk BIM 360 and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
* Ensure compliance with BIM Execution Plans (BEP), project standards and client requirements.
* Coordinate directly with Dubai-based BIM management and project teams.

**Technical Requirements**

* Expert-level proficiency in Autodesk Revit MEP is mandatory.
* Extensive hands-on experience delivering LOD 400 and LOD 500 plumbing BIM models on actual construction projects.
* Advanced expertise in plumbing shop drawing production and construction detailing.
* Strong technical knowledge of Plumbing, Drainage and Public Health Engineering (PHE) systems.
* Strong understanding of water supply, sanitary drainage, stormwater drainage and pumping systems.
* Advanced knowledge of pipe fittings, valves, pumps, water heaters, sanitary fixtures, tanks and associated equipment.
* Strong understanding of pipe slopes, invert levels, gravity drainage, venting and service routing.
* Advanced knowledge of Revit MEP families, connectors, system classifications, shared parameters, schedules, worksets, view templates and model optimization.
* Strong understanding of plumbing materials, installation methodologies, equipment accessibility and maintenance requirements.
* Proficiency in Autodesk Navisworks Manage and AutoCAD.
* Strong experience in multidisciplinary BIM coordination, clash detection and resolution.
* Hands-on experience with Autodesk BIM 360 and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), including ACC issue management workflows.
* Understanding of Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows, BIM standards and ISO 19650.
* Familiarity with applicable international plumbing standards, including IPC, UPC, BS EN standards and relevant Gulf authority requirements.
* Experience in Fire Fighting, irrigation and external utility systems is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of COBie, asset information management, Dynamo and BIM automation is an added advantage.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering or Building Services Engineering is mandatory.
* 5–10 years of relevant professional experience in Plumbing and Public Health Engineering (PHE).
* Minimum 4 years of hands-on Revit MEP modelling and plumbing shop drawing production experience.
* Proven experience delivering LOD 400/500 BIM models and shop drawings on actual construction projects.
* Gulf / Middle East construction project experience is highly preferred.
* Experience in high-rise buildings, luxury residential developments, five-star hotels, hospitality, commercial buildings and large-scale construction projects is preferred.
* Strong technical, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills.
* A strong team player with a proactive, collaborative and solution-oriented approach.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership and manage assigned technical deliverables with minimal supervision.
* Ability to guide junior team members and share technical knowledge.
* Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and international teams.
* Strong commitment to quality, productivity and project deadlines.
* Immediate or short-notice candidates are preferred.

**Why Join iRivet?**

description:
TScreen TV is a cloud-based, hardware-agnostic digital signage and live-occasion screen platform built for sports academies, tournament organizers, retail stores, restaurants, clinics, and commercial venues. Our software turns any existing Android TV, Fire TV, Samsung Tizen, or LG webOS screen into a live scoreboard, dynamic menu board, notice screen, and sponsor ad display—managed directly from a smartphone with zero specialized hardware required.

Role Overview

We are looking for a dynamic, street-smart **Onboarding, Customer Support & Business Development Executive** to drive end-to-end customer acquisition, screen activation, and client retention across India and the UAE. This is a hybrid growth role: you will bring in new venues and channel partners, hand-hold clients through their 5-minute QR screen setup, and ensure every active screen stays online, engaged, and renewed.

Key Responsibilities1. Business Development & Partner Acquisition (50%)

* **Direct Venue Outreach:** Identify, pitch, and close B2B accounts across sports academies, turfs, tournament organizers, restaurants/cafés, retail showrooms, clinics, and corporate offices.
* **Channel & AV Partner Onboarding:** Build relationships with local AV system integrators, Smart TV dealers, and event production agencies who can bundle TScreen TV with their screen deployments.
* **Product Demos & Trials:** Conduct crisp 15-minute live demos (via Google Meet/Zoom or on-site) showing how easily users can pair a TV via QR code, update live scores/menus from a phone, and run sponsor ad slots.
* **Trial-to-Paid Conversion:** Manage the 30-day free trial pipeline, actively nudging trial signups to convert into monthly/annual Starter, Pro, or Event Pass subscriptions.

2. Client Onboarding & Screen Activation (30%)

* **Zero-Friction Setup:** Guide new customers through installing the TScreen TV app (Android TV, Fire TV, Samsung, LG, or Web Player), scanning the pairing QR code, and uploading their first playlist, brand colors, and logo.
* **Occasion & Sponsor Configuration:** Help sports organizers configure live touchline scoring controls and assist venues in setting up scheduled sponsor/ad slots and play reports.
* **Onboarding Playbooks:** Create simple WhatsApp guides, short Loom/screen-recording tutorials, and FAQs tailored for non-technical venue staff.

3. Customer Support & Retention (20%)

* **Frontline Support:** Resolve customer queries quickly via WhatsApp, phone, and email (support@tscreentv.com), troubleshooting basic Wi-Fi, TV app pairing, or playlist scheduling issues.
* **Proactive Health Checks:** Monitor active accounts to ensure screens remain paired and active, preventing churn before renewal dates.
* **Product Feedback Loop:** Capture feature requests and real-world edge cases from venue managers and relay structured feedback to the product/engineerinteam.

\*

* **Required Skills & Qualifications**
* **Communication:** Fluent in English and Hindi (knowledge of Arabic or regional Indian languages is a strong plus for UAE/regional expansion).
* **Tech Comfort:** Hands-on familiarity with Smart TVs (Android TV, Fire TV Stick), mobile apps, QR pairing workflows, and basic SaaS CRM tools.
* **Sales Mindset:** Comfortable with outbound calling, WhatsApp follow-ups, field visits (when required), and closing SMB/venue decision-makers.
* **Empathy & Patience:** Ability to explain technical steps in plain, simple language to non-technical staff (e.g., café managers, ground scorers, school admins).

title: QA Tester – Sitecore AI Web Testing & Automation
description:
**Job Family**
Software Application & Development (India)
  
  
**Travel Required**
None
  
  
**Clearance Required**
None
  
  
**What You Will Do**
We are seeking a QA Tester to ensure the quality, functionality, accessibility, and performance of websites built on Sitecore AI and related digital experience technologies. In this role, you will plan and execute manual and automated testing across web pages, components, forms, content workflows, APIs, integrations, and releases. You will work closely with developers, content authors, product owners, designers, and delivery partners to identify defects early, expand automated test coverage, and deliver reliable, secure, and user-friendly digital experiences across browsers, devices, and environments.
  
  

* Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test data for Sitecore AI websites, features, components, forms, content updates, integrations, and releases.
* Perform functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, integration, end-to-end, cross-browser, responsive, accessibility, performance, and visual testing across supported environments.
* Build, maintain, and improve automated tests for critical website journeys, reusable components, APIs, and regression scenarios using modern web test automation frameworks.
* Validate Sitecore AI authoring experiences, page and component configuration, content publishing, personalization, search, forms, analytics tagging, consent behavior, and third-party integrations.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and review results to support release readiness and rapid defect detection.
* Document defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, screenshots or logs, severity, and business impact; verify fixes through retesting and regression testing.
* Partner with developers, designers, content teams, and product owners to clarify acceptance criteria, identify test risks, and improve testability early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Create and maintain reusable automation utilities, page objects, test fixtures, test data, and reporting that improve test reliability and reduce manual effort.
* Track test execution, automation coverage, defect trends, escaped defects, and release quality metrics, and communicate findings and risks clearly to stakeholders.
* Contribute to quality standards, test documentation, peer reviews, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of website testing practices.

**What You Will Need**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* At least 4 years of experience in software quality assurance, with hands-on responsibility for testing websites or web applications in enterprise environments.
* Strong knowledge of QA methods, the software development lifecycle, test design techniques, defect management, risk-based testing, and release validation.
* Hands-on experience creating and maintaining web test automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, or equivalent technologies.
* Proficiency with JavaScript or TypeScript and working knowledge of another scripting or programming language such as Python, Java, or C#.
* Experience testing modern websites and web applications, including responsive layouts, reusable components, navigation, search, forms, content publishing, APIs, and third-party integrations.
* Experience with API testing tools and techniques, including request validation, response validation, authentication, error handling, and integration scenarios.
* Experience with Git-based workflows, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, automated test execution, test reporting, and quality gates.
* Ability to use browser developer tools, logs, network traces, and test evidence to isolate and communicate website defects effectively.
* Experience validating cross-browser and cross-device behavior, accessibility, performance, security-related requirements, analytics tagging, and production readiness.
* Ability to write clear test cases, automation code, defect reports, test summaries, and release-quality recommendations.
* Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a hybrid, cross-functional delivery environment.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, review test assets, troubleshoot failures, and share testing and automation knowledge with team members.

**What Would Be Nice To Have**

* Hands-on testing experience with Sitecore AI, Sitecore XM Cloud, Experience Edge, or another composable digital experience platform.
* Experience testing React and Next.js websites deployed through Vercel, Microsoft Azure, or another cloud platform.
* Experience with Selenium, REST clients, accessibility testing tools, visual regression tools, and performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6.
* Experience designing maintainable automation frameworks using page objects, fixtures, data-driven testing, mocking, parallel execution, retry strategies, and actionable reporting.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jira, test management platforms, and browser or device testing services.
* Relevant certification in Sitecore, software testing, test automation, accessibility, cloud technologies, or web quality engineering.
* Experience testing high-traffic, multilingual, personalized, or regulated enterprise websites and coordinating quality activities with distributed delivery teams.

description:

**Description**
This position is ideal for mid-level quality professionals to join the QARA team as a Quality Assurance Engineer, supporting manufacturing operations and ensuring compliance with quality management requirements. assurance activities, process improvements, complaint handling, CAPA management, audits, and regulatory compliance. * Support regulatory, corporate, and external audits and inspections related to the Quality Management System.

* Ensure appropriate quality controls are implemented and maintained throughout manufacturing processes.

Teamwork: Ability to collaborate across interdisciplinary teams, build strong relationships, work independently, and perform effectively in a fast-changing environment.
  
  
**Complementary Skills**

* Black Belt or Green Belt certification preferred.
* ISO 13485 Internal Auditor certification preferred.
* Goal-oriented mindset with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure.

description:
**Business Function**

DBS, recognized globally as the World's Best Digital Bank, is on a continuous mission to reimagine banking. "Live more, Bank less" is our motto, and we aim to make banking a seamless, intuitive journey for people.

At DBS, we operate like a 26,000-person start-up—embracing an Agile culture, leveraging start-up thinking, and adopting cutting-edge technologies to build superior financial solutions.

Within Group Technology, our **Wealth Management Technology (WMT)** team builds and scales the core digital and platform engines that power our regional affluent and private banking segments (including DBS Treasures, Treasures Private Client, and Private Banking) . As we scale our footprint across major markets like Singapore and Hong Kong, we rely heavily on the industry-leading **Avaloq Core Banking Platform** to manage sophisticated multi-asset portfolios, high-volume transactions, automated wealth advisory, and collateral engines . Joining our team means playing a direct role in engineering the future of digital wealth management, working at the intersection of robust core banking software and high-performance database technologies.

**Job Purpose**

We are looking for a strong skilled PL/SQL Developer with 2-7 years of experience in Oracle database development. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in designing, developing, optimizing, and maintaining Oracle database solutions. Candidates with a solid foundation in PL/SQL and database concepts will be provided specialized training in Avaloq Banking Platform after successful selection. This role is an excellent opportunity for developers who are passionate about data processing, performance optimization, and financial technology solutions.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain Oracle PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, triggers, and views.
* Develop and optimize complex SQL queries and manage large datasets for high-volume transactional systems.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into secure, scalable technical database solutions.
* Perform rigorous database performance tuning, query optimization, and resource utilization using Explain Plans and indexing strategies.
* Create and maintain database objects while strictly adhering to internal coding standards, security baselines, and best practices.
* Support production environments, troubleshoot data-related issues, debug complex performance bottlenecks, and implement robust fixes.
* Work closely with business analysts, application developers, QA teams, and regional stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Participate in peer code reviews to ensure high-quality deliverables and prepare thorough technical documentation to support knowledge transfer activities.

**Required Experience and Qualification**

* **Experience:** 2 to 7 years of hands-on Oracle Database and PL/SQL development experience in enterprise or production environments.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Core Competence**

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong core expertise in Oracle Database development, stored procedures, functions, packages, triggers, views, indexes, sequences, and cursors.
* Proven expertise in writing complex SQL queries and advanced query tuning.
* Solid understanding of relational database design principles, normalization, and bulk data processing.
* Familiarity with Unix/Linux commands, shell scripting, and version control tools (e.g., Git, SVN).
* **Preferred Technical Exposure:** Working knowledge of Oracle SQL Developer, TOAD, Java, or application integration technologies, alongside ETL/data migration processes.

**Domain & Behavioural Competencies:**

* Prior experience or strong interest in Financial Services, Banking, Asset Management, Wealth Management, or Capital Markets domain.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills with the ability to understand complex business logic.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong stakeholder management capabilities.
* Highly adaptable, eager to learn new platforms rapidly, and capable of working independently as well as in collaborative global teams.

* **Avaloq Readiness & Flexibility:** High adaptability and willingness to undergo intensive training and cross-skilling to transition onto the Avaloq Core Banking Platform, with the flexibility to take on roles either as an **Avaloq Developer** or an **Avaloq Automation Tester** based on project needs and business priorities.

**Work Relationship**

Collaborate closely with internal technology teams, application developers, QA engineers, business analysts, and regional operations stakeholders.

title: Principal Programming Analyst
description:
**Work Schedule**
Second Shift (Afternoons)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
  
  
Join Us as a Principal Programmer Analystt – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
  
  
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.
  
  
The
**Principal Programmer Analyst**
serves as a senior technical and Computer System Validation (CSV) subject matter expert supporting complex and business-critical Pharmacovigilance (PV) systems and initiatives. The role leads and provides strategic oversight for validation activities associated with PV system implementations, upgrades, hot fixes, client-specific configurations, ad-hoc reports, gateway implementations, data migrations, integrations, and other system changes.
  
  
This position serves as a key validation and technical point of contact for highly complex PV projects, providing expert guidance to business stakeholders, Quality Assurance, IT, project teams, clients, vendors, and external partners. The Principal Programmer Analyst acts as a trusted consultant to the PV organization, helping ensure systems and processes remain compliant, inspection-ready, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.
  
  
The role provides expert input into project strategy, resource planning, effort estimation, risk management, and prioritization. It identifies and drives opportunities for process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across PV system validation and associated business processes.
  
  
The Principal Programmer Analyst also champions the responsible adoption of
**AI, automation, and emerging technologies**
, identifying and implementing opportunities to improve validation efficiency, documentation quality, data analysis, testing, and overall team productivity while maintaining appropriate GxP controls and oversight.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Provide technical and validation leadership for complex, high-impact PV system implementations, upgrades, hot fixes, integrations, gateway configurations, client-specific reports, data migrations, and system enhancements. Establish appropriate validation strategies based on system complexity, intended use, regulatory impact, and risk.
* Lead requirements definition and solution assessment with business stakeholders, translating complex business and regulatory needs into clear functional and technical requirements. Provide expert review and challenge to ensure requirements are complete, testable, traceable, and appropriately translated into system design and validated solutions.
* Define and oversee risk-based validation and testing strategies for validated GxP systems. Independently plan, author, review, and execute System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Performance Qualification (PQ), and other applicable qualification and verification activities.
* Serve as a senior SME and escalation point for Computer System Validation, providing expert interpretation and application of company procedures, GxP requirements, data integrity principles, electronic records/electronic signature requirements, and applicable regulatory expectations, including 21 CFR Part 11.
* Own or provide senior oversight of validation deliverables throughout the system lifecycle, including Validation Plans, Requirements Specifications, Risk Assessments, Test Strategies and Protocols, Traceability Matrices, Validation Summary Reports, change controls, impact assessments, deviations, and other SDLC documentation.
* Apply risk-based and critical-thinking approaches to determine appropriate validation scope and level of testing, ensuring that validation activities are scientifically sound, compliant, efficient, and proportionate to patient safety, product quality, data integrity, and regulatory risk.
* Lead continuous improvement and transformation initiatives across PV systems and validation processes. Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and optimize processes while maintaining appropriate controls and compliance.
* Champion AI-enabled innovation by evaluating and leveraging AI and automation capabilities to improve requirements analysis, risk assessment, test design, documentation, data analysis, quality review, and other validation activities. Help establish appropriate controls and ways of working for responsible use of emerging technologies within the GxP environment.
* Lead resolution of complex and cross-functional system issues, including impact assessment, investigation, root cause analysis, risk evaluation, and validation of corrective and preventive actions, system fixes, and enhancements. Provide technical and compliance guidance where issues have significant business or regulatory impact.
* Act as a strategic liaison among PV business stakeholders, Quality Assurance, IT, clients, vendors, and external partners. Influence decisions and facilitate resolution of complex technical, quality, compliance, and delivery challenges.
* Provide validation leadership within project governance, contributing to project planning, resource and effort estimates, risk management, status reviews, vendor discussions, and client meetings. Proactively identify validation risks, dependencies, and potential impacts to project milestones.
* Review and recommend improvements to procedures, standards, templates, and validation methodologies. Lead or contribute to the development and revision of SOPs, Work Instructions, technical standards, and best practices supporting validated PV systems.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to programmers, analysts, validation professionals, and other team members. Review complex deliverables, share best practices, support capability development, and promote consistent application of validation and quality standards across the organization.
* Lead and support regulatory inspections, client audits, and internal quality audits as a validation SME. Present validation strategies and evidence, respond to complex auditor questions, support documentation retrieval and inspection readiness, and lead or support remediation activities arising from audit or inspection observations.
* Maintain expertise in evolving regulatory expectations and industry practices, including Computer System Validation, Computer Software Assurance/risk-based assurance approaches, data integrity, Pharmacovigilance regulations, emerging technologies, and modern validation methodologies. Assess potential impacts and recommend appropriate changes to organizational practices.
* Provide strategic input into technology and process decisions, including system lifecycle planning, vendor solutions, validation approaches, automation opportunities, and future-state capabilities for PV systems.
* Perform additional responsibilities and lead strategic initiatives as required to support organizational objectives, operational excellence, compliance, and continuous quality improvement.

**Education & Experience Requirements**
**Bachelor's degree or equivalent**
and relevant formal academic/vocational qualification.
  
  
Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the role, typically gained through
**8+ years of relevant experience**
, including significant experience with Computer System Validation, regulated GxP systems, and/or Pharmacovigilance technology environments.
  
  
Experience should demonstrate increasing responsibility in leading complex validation activities, providing subject matter expertise, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and independently resolving significant technical and compliance challenges.
  
  
Years of experience represent the typical level of related experience required to develop the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to perform the essential functions of the role. Years of experience should not be used as the sole determining factor in establishing job classification or making employment selection decisions.
  
  
**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Advanced knowledge of Computer System Validation (CSV), risk-based validation/assurance methodologies, SDLC principles, and GxP-regulated computerized systems.
* In-depth knowledge of Pharmacovigilance systems and business processes, including applicable SOPs, regulatory requirements, industry standards, and local guidelines.
* Strong understanding of applicable regulatory expectations, including GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, electronic records and electronic signatures, and data integrity principles.
* Advanced knowledge of relational database concepts and experience working with complex data systems, system integrations, interfaces, reporting solutions, and data migrations.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and critically review validation strategies, risk assessments, requirements, test approaches, traceability, and lifecycle documentation for complex systems.
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to assess complex technical and compliance issues and recommend practical, risk-based solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex assignments and initiatives independently, including activities involving multiple functions, clients, vendors, or geographic regions.
* Ability to influence and communicate effectively with stakeholders at multiple organizational levels and to explain complex technical and regulatory concepts clearly.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including proficiency in English and the ability to effectively interface with multidisciplinary teams, senior stakeholders, clients, auditors, and external partners.
* Strong organizational and project-management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple complex assignments, competing priorities, dependencies, and challenging timelines.
* Ability to provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior and experienced team members without requiring direct line-management responsibility.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and implement opportunities for automation, AI-enabled efficiencies, process simplification, and continuous improvement within an appropriately controlled GxP environment.
* Ability to adapt to changing business priorities, regulatory expectations, technologies, and operating models.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality outcomes within agreed timelines, project commitments, and budget expectations.
* Demonstrated commitment to collaboration, quality, continuous learning, innovation, and scientific excellence.

Working Conditions and Environment:
  
  

* Work is performed in an office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
* Occasional drives to site locations with occasional travel both domestic and international.

Why Join Us?
  
  
When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience—and where your contributions truly make a difference.
  
  
Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthroughs.

title: Contract Position- Test Automation
description:
Experience: 6 - 10 years
  
  
Max Experience: 10
  
  
Using a suite of modern tools, the Automation Tester will play a pivotal role in helping us to automate our move towards a truly continuous integration and continuous deployment environment. You will work with our product and development teams to ensure that we are constantly analysing the automated tests that we design and execute for each of our products.
  
  
You will report to the QA Manager, work alongside the Test Lead, product and development teams to ensure a high standard of quality in our products. You will carry out automated functional testing on our products. You will have the chance to test modern products based on Microsoft .NET technology.
  
  
You will design, maintain and execute suites automated tests using modern languages and tools such as C#, Visual Studio, Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Mocha, JavaScript, TypeScript and Microsoft Azure DevOps.
  
  
You will be responsible for working through and developing our backlog to make constant improvements and additions to our existing automated tests. You will review and automate existing manual test cases. You will also be responsible for creating and reviewing defects, tracking their progress from their discovery through to their resolution, ensuring that they are adequately documented and tested.
  
  
Over time your role will grow and become more varied as you begin to test a larger variety of products across the NEC SWS. We are constantly developing new and cutting edge, scalable solutions and we need a highly skilled QA expert who embraces problem solving on products built with new, well-structured code as well as elements of legacy code.
  
  
You will be someone who likes to push boundaries and enjoys rising to a challenge. We are a committed and supportive team with a ‘can do’ mindset.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Drive the implementation of modern test automation frameworks and tools.
* Oversee test architecture, ensuring scalability and maintainability of automation solutions.
* Promote shift-left testing practices and support developers in embedding quality.
* Implementation of automation frameworks for middleware and backend service-based applications in critical infrastructure design.
* Designing and executing automated tests on the latest revisions of the software.
* Participating in the development of our automated testing framework, assisting our move towards automated testing in a CI/CD environment.
* Interpreting requirements from existing manual test cases and specification documents. Liaising with Manual Testers and / or Business Analysts to understand the requirements.
* Liaising with the product and development teams to ensure that our backlog is up to date

* Raising bugs and liaising with the development team from discovery through to resolution
* Setting up and configuring the testing environment and associated database(s)
* Preparing the test execution report and sharing it with stakeholders.

* 6 to 10 years of experience in Test Automation using various tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Mocha etc
* Experience developing and executing automated test cases for User Interfaces
* Knowledge of software development in a web and desktop environment

**Required Soft Skills And Experience**

* Clear and concise communicator
* Able to prioritise between several tasks at any one time
* Able to work independently and as part of a team
* Detailed and effective written communication skills for documenting the features teste

title: CIS Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
Lead the Controls & Information Systems (CIS) team within Engineering, GIC Supply Chain in Mumbai, enabling safe, reliable, standardized and cyber-secure manufacturing operations and digital transformation across the global plant network. You will deliver Enterprise Standards CIS solutions that support Make Digital strategies and line performance, partnering closely with Engineering, Digital & Technology, and Plant Operations. This role requires you to operate in 1.30 pm to 10.30 pm.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Strategic & Functional Leadership**

* Translate Engineering GIC and Supply Chain strategy into a clear OGSM for CIS India, with priorities across core controls, plant applications, data, and security.
* Maintain a balanced portfolio of CIS projects and services that delivers impact on safety, service, cost, and cash while supporting long term digital roadmaps.
* Representing CIS in Engineering and platform forums, ensuring strong integration with Machine Design, M&R, and D&T.
* Lead the CIS India team delivering design, configuration, testing, and deployment of controls and information systems for capital projects, initiatives, and continuous improvement.
* Own and execute CIS work across:
* Core technologies (PLCs, SCADA/HMI, networks, industrial PCs).
* CIS Digital (plant applications, visualization, data collection, reporting).
* Warehouse & logistics technologies and integration into enterprise systems.
* Plant floor security and industrial cybersecurity controls.
* Support for EUAU Digital and partnership with CIS OU Leads.
* Ensure robust global plant floor support processes -Incident Management, with clear SLAs, escalation paths, and root cause / corrective action discipline.

**Digital, Security & Standards**

* Implement and maintain CIS standards, architecture, and reference designs for electrical, controls, instrumentation, and platforms of information systems.
* Partner with D&T and Security to ensure all CIS solutions meet corporate requirements for safety, cybersecurity, compliance, and data integrity.
* Drive lifecycle management for CIS assets (obsolescence plans, patching, backups, disaster recovery) to minimize risk and unplanned downtime.

**Business Partnering & Innovation**

* Act as the primary CIS business partner for plant leadership, Engineering, D&T, and Operations, converting site and regional strategies into scalable, standard solutions.
* Identify, pilot, and scale emerging controls, OT, and digital technologies (advanced visualization, IIoT, edge computing, remote diagnostics) and partner with OEMs and integrators to capture innovation.

**People Leadership & Operational Excellence**

* Manage, coach, and develop CIS engineers, defining clear roles and development plans and building an inclusive, high-performance culture grounded in safety and integrity.
* Define clear roles, expectations, and development plans; support career progression aligned with Supply Chain competencies and technical promotion processes
* Establish and maintain standard work, documentation, and audit routines for CIS design, implementation, and support.
* Ensure CIS work is tightly linked to asset care strategies, reliability roadmaps, and digital manufacturing initiatives, delivering measurable improvements in uptime, quality, and cost.

**Minimum Qualifications**
**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering – Electrical, Electronics, Telecommunication, or a related field.
  
  
**Experience:**
10–12 years of relevant experience, including visible leadership managing direct reports and influencing across functions.
  
  
**Technical Skills:**
Ability to drive early management of controls and information systems into design, with strong understanding of controls and IT capabilities in manufacturing environments.
  
  

* Core Ecosystems: Deep expertise in major global automation platforms (e.g., Rockwell Automation / Allen-Bradley, Siemens, or Schneider Electric).
* SCADA & Software: High proficiency in industrial software packages (e.g., Inductive Automation Ignition, AVEVA/Wonderware, FactoryTalk View) and database systems (SQL).
* Industrial Networking: Strong command of industrial networks (Ethernet/IP, ProfiNet, Modbus, OPC-UA, MQTT) and industrial cybersecurity standards.

**Soft Skills:**
Strong people leadership, collaboration, and communication skills, with the ability to build high-performing teams.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Engineering (Electronics / Instrumentation) or an MBA.
* Exposure to Digital Transformation / Smart Manufacturing initiatives.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Facility Manager - Technical Services
description:
A
**Facility Manager - Technical Services**
is responsible for managing technical operations, supervising engineering teams, ensuring safety and regulatory compliance, controlling maintenance costs, and maintaining the reliability of equipment and systems. Responsibilities vary by industry, such as marine, hotel, manufacturing, construction, or facility management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Of a Facility Manager - Technical Services**

* Technical Operations and Management
* Oversee all engineering operations and technical activities.
* Ensure the efficient and reliable operation of machinery, equipment, and systems.
* Develop and implement maintenance schedules and operating procedures.
* Monitor equipment performance and troubleshoot technical problems.
* Ensure minimum downtime and maximum operational efficiency.
* Maintenance and Repairs
* Plan and supervise preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance.
* Diagnose equipment failures and coordinate repair activities.
* Ensure timely servicing, inspection, and replacement of equipment.
* Maintain maintenance records, technical logs, and reports.
* Coordinate with external contractors and service providers.
* Team Leadership and Supervision
* Lead, train, and supervise engineers, technicians, and maintenance personnel.
* Assign duties, establish work priorities, and monitor performance.
* Conduct technical training and safety briefings.
* Ensure proper coordination between engineering and other departments.
* Evaluate staff performance and support professional development.
* Safety and Regulatory Compliance
* Ensure compliance with applicable safety standards, laws, and regulations.
* Implement safe working practices and risk assessment procedures.
* Conduct safety inspections and ensure corrective actions are completed.
* Investigate technical incidents, equipment failures, and accidents.
* Maintain permits, inspection certificates, and statutory documentation.
* Budgeting and Cost Control
* Prepare and manage engineering and maintenance budgets.
* Control expenditure on spare parts, tools, fuel, energy, and repairs.
* Identify opportunities to reduce operating costs.
* Approve maintenance purchases within delegated authority.
* Monitor inventory and ensure the availability of critical spare parts.
* Project Planning and Implementation
* Plan and supervise equipment installation, upgrades, and modernization.
* Evaluate technical proposals and engineering designs.
* Coordinate with suppliers, consultants, and contractors.
* Monitor project schedules, budgets, quality, and safety.
* Ensure commissioning, testing, and handover of completed projects.
* Documentation and Reporting
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly engineering reports.
* Maintain equipment history, maintenance schedules, and inspection records.
* Report equipment performance, breakdowns, costs, and operational risks to management.
* Develop standard operating procedures and technical documentation.
* Recommend improvements to systems and engineering processes.
* Energy Efficiency and Continuous Improvement
* Monitor energy and resource consumption.
* Implement measures to improve equipment efficiency and reliability.
* Identify recurring faults and implement root-cause solutions.
* Introduce appropriate technologies and maintenance systems.
* Support environmental protection and waste-reduction initiatives.

**Key Skills Required**

* Strong technical and troubleshooting skills
* Leadership and team management
* Planning and decision-making
* Budgeting and cost management
* Safety and regulatory knowledge
* Communication and coordination
* Preventive maintenance management
* Problem-solving and analytical skills

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
A Chief Engineer's performance may be measured by:
  
  

* Equipment uptime and reliability
* Reduction in breakdowns and downtime
* Maintenance cost control
* Compliance with safety requirements
* Completion of preventive maintenance on schedule
* Energy efficiency and resource utilization
* Team productivity and project completion

title: On Premise Festival & Events Manager

title: Oracle Fusion HCM - Consulting Technical Manager (Absence & OTL)
description:
**Job Description**
As Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM Workforce Management Workstream Lead within Consulting Services, you will own integrated solution architecture across Absence Management and Time and Labor, with demonstrated depth in Workforce Scheduling. You will guide complex engagements from requirements and design through configuration or development, testing, cutover, go-live, and stabilization. Your work will connect planned schedules, recorded time, absence transactions, and downstream Payroll processing to support consistent business outcomes and production readiness. Working with geographically distributed clients and functional, technical, integration, security, data, and Payroll teams, you will resolve cross-service dependencies and explain design options and trade-offs. You will govern rules, formulas, approvals, testing, performance, and solution quality while addressing relevant security, Redwood, AI, and Workforce Health and Safety implications. The role suits an experienced architect or domain lead who can demonstrate personal implementation ownership, mentor consultants, and communicate workstream risks and decisions to project leadership.
  
  
The role supports clients across all geographies. Hiring location, official grade, final experience range, employment model, hybrid attendance, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own integrated Workforce Management architecture from requirements and design through configuration or development, testing, cutover, go-live, and stabilization to support successful delivery.
* Lead end-to-end successful implementations, guide functional team in the team and have a strong customer facing skills.
* Lead requirements and architecture workshops; evaluate design options against business fit, maintainability, performance, security, user experience, and delivery complexity.
* Resolve dependencies across Workforce Scheduling, time capture and calculation, absence processing, and Payroll, including processing sequence, retrospective corrections, reconciliation, and exception ownership.
* Govern business rules, Fast Formulas, validations, approvals, and exception handling to deliver consistent outcomes across services.
* Lead cross-stream design reviews with functional, technical, integration, security, data, and Payroll teams; address relevant Workforce Health and Safety, security, Redwood, and AI implications.
* Define and govern integration, regression, exception, performance, and user acceptance testing across services to validate end-to-end business outcomes.
* Establish solution quality criteria, review delivery evidence, and drive resolution of functional issues and design defects to meet agreed quality expectations.
* Review migration and integration designs, data ownership, error handling, recovery, reconciliation, and cutover dependencies to establish production readiness.
* Maintain design decisions, dependency maps, documentation, and configuration or development standards; demonstrate the integrated solution and explain business and operational implications.
* Guide delivery teams, mentor consultants, and communicate workstream risks, dependencies, and decisions to project leadership to support coordinated delivery.

**Skills - Mandatory**
**Experience**

* 10+ years of relevant experience.
* 3 completed end-to-end Oracle Fusion HCM implementations in Workforce Management, delivered as architect or domain lead.
* Demonstrated personal ownership from requirements and design through configuration or development, testing, cutover, and go-live, supported by specific implementation examples.

**Oracle Products**

* Absence Management and Time and Labor: Ability to architect complex solutions spanning both services, with demonstrated depth in Workforce Scheduling.
* Absence Management: Expertise governing eligibility, entitlement, accrual and qualification rules, balances, approvals, and exceptions.
* Time and Labor: Expertise governing time capture, calculation, validation, approval, transfer, and correction processes.
* Workforce Scheduling: Ability to translate requirements and constraints into integrated designs covering worker availability, planned schedules, recorded time, absence, and downstream processing; validate normal, change, and exception scenarios.

**Functional Skills**

* Ability to assess worker and assignment changes, effective dates, work schedules, and retrospective corrections across the integrated solution.
* Understanding of downstream Payroll impacts, processing sequence, corrections, reconciliation, and exception ownership, together with relevant Workforce Health and Safety dependencies.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of Fast Formula design, review, troubleshooting, and validation; ability to govern rules, approvals, validations, and exceptions across services.
* Ability to govern integration boundaries, data ownership, error handling, recovery requirements, testing, performance, and solution quality across integrated business processes.
* Ability to review Oracle Fusion HCM security, including roles, data access, and access across integrated processes.
* Ability to review Redwood implications for configuration, user journeys, extensibility, and testing, and assess AI use cases, data access, human review, and validation of generated outputs.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Ability to present design options, explain trade-offs, lead architecture discussions and cross-stream design reviews, and demonstrate business outcomes and operational implications.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, and problem-solving skills.

**Leadership**

* Demonstrated delivery leadership, with the ability to guide teams, mentor consultants, and communicate workstream risks and decisions to project leadership.

**Good to Have**

* Experience delivering multi-country or complex enterprise Workforce Management implementations.
* Architecture ownership involving integrations, migration, and reconciliation across scheduling, time, absence, and Payroll.
* Experience governing quarterly update assessments and cross-service regression testing.
* Relevant Oracle HCM Cloud certifications.
* Experience mentoring domain leads and supporting solution assessments, demonstrations, proposals, and estimates.

**Self Assessment Questions**
Before applying, please consider the following questions:
  
  

* Do I have 12–20 years of relevant experience and 2–3 completed end-to-end Oracle Fusion HCM implementations in Workforce Management as architect or domain lead?
* Can I demonstrate personal ownership from requirements and design through configuration or development, testing, cutover, and go-live using specific implementation examples?
* Can I architect integrated Absence Management and Time and Labor solutions with Workforce Scheduling depth, including rules, Fast Formulas, approvals, validations, and exceptions?
* Can I resolve scheduling, time, absence, and Payroll dependencies, assess relevant Workforce Health and Safety impacts, and govern integration, testing, performance, and solution quality?
* Can I lead cross-stream architecture discussions, explain design trade-offs, guide consultants, and assess Oracle Fusion HCM security, Redwood, and AI implications?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.

Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.

**Position Overview:**

The position will also be responsible for scanner deployment planning, resource optimization, reducing image scanning turnaround time, and monitoring delivery performance metrics including Expected Date of Delivery (EDD) and Time Window Delivery (TWD).
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To ensure effective Pan-India management of POD-DC and image scanning operations by improving POD availability, scanning accuracy, timely submission, service quality, and operational compliance. The role will drive performance improvement through structured monitoring, data-driven analysis, stakeholder coordination, and continuous process improvement across the network.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
**POD-DC & Image Scanning Operations**

* Manage and monitor Pan-India POD-DC and image scanning operations to ensure timely scanning, uploading, and submission of POD documents.
* Track Region-wise, customer-wise, and location-wise performance and identify service gaps.

* Coordinate with Regional, PUD and Service Centre teams to resolve operational issues and improve scanning performance.
* Drive continuous improvement in POD availability and customer visibility.

**POD Accuracy & Service Quality**

* Monitor POD accuracy and completeness, ensuring availability of receiver signature, customer/company stamp, delivery date, delivery time, and receiver name, wherever applicable.

* Monitor POD rejection rates and identify recurring issues and process gaps.
* Coordinate corrective and preventive action with field teams to improve POD quality.
* Ensure compliance with customer-specific POD requirements and document standards.

**Scanner Deployment & Resource Planning**

* Coordinate scanner deployment at new and existing locations in line with approved plans.
* Monitor scanner utilization, availability, maintenance, and operational readiness.
* Identify locations requiring additional scanning infrastructure or resources.
* Support implementation of new scanning technologies and process improvements.

* Analyse delivery delays, EDD misses, trends, and operational bottlenecks.
* Coordinate with Operations teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
* Prepare and circulate MIS, exception reports, dashboards, and performance analysis.
* Drive improvement in delivery adherence and customer service performance.

* Monitor compliance with customer-specific Time Window Delivery commitments.
* Analyse TWD performance, misses, and location-wise service gaps.
* Work closely with field Operations teams to improve deliveries within committed time windows.
* Generate performance reports and highlight exceptions to relevant stakeholders.
* Recommend and drive process improvements to enhance customer satisfaction and service reliability.

**Education**
:

:

* Exposure to courier, express, logistics, distribution, or supply chain operations will be preferred.

**Skills & Capabilities:**

* MIS, dashboard preparation, reporting, and data analysis.

description:

* Mentor QA analysts and testing teams while promoting quality engineering best practices.
* Drive continuous improvements in testing processes, automation coverage, and QA maturity.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 7 to 12 years of experience in Quality Assurance, ERP Testing, or Test Management roles.

* Experience managing QA governance, quality metrics, and testing resource coordination.
* Proven ability to lead testing teams across onsite and offshore delivery models.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and business-facing communication skills.
* Solid understanding of ERP integrations, data migration validation, and end-to-end business process testing.
* Ability to proactively identify and mitigate testing risks and dependencies.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards

title: Field System Engineer – UAV & Radar Systems
description:
**Job Overview**
We are looking for a technically capable Field System Engineer to support the integration, configuration, testing and troubleshooting of advanced UAV-based radar and sensing systems.
  
  
The role involves working with UAV platforms, hardware components, sensors, payloads, communication systems and supporting electronics to ensure reliable performance of complete system architectures during field deployments.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have an engineering background in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace, Mechatronics or a related discipline, along with a strong understanding of Mathematics and Physics.
  
  
Candidates with hands-on experience or exposure to UAVs, robotics, radar systems, RF systems, aerospace hardware, sensors or industrial equipment will be preferred.
  
  
This is a field-based engineering role requiring extensive travel across India to support ongoing projects and technical deployments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Perform system integration, configuration and validation of UAV platforms, payloads, sensors and supporting electronic systems.
  
  
Manage system readiness activities, including hardware checks, interface verification and pre-flight validation.
  
  
Conduct hardware inspections and ensure that all systems are configured and ready for field deployment.
  
  
Maintain configuration records, including hardware versions, system documentation and integration history.
  
  
Troubleshoot platform, payload, communication, power and interface-related issues during field operations.
  
  
Coordinate with mechanical, avionics, RF and data engineering teams for system-level problem-solving.
  
  
Support preventive maintenance activities and ensure the operational readiness of equipment.
  
  
Maintain technical documentation, including system configurations, test results and maintenance records.
  
  
Support field testing, deployment activities and technical validation as per approved procedures.
  
  
Ensure that all field operations follow defined technical procedures, configurations and quality standards.
  
  
Eligibility & Requirements
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace, Mechatronics or a related engineering discipline.
  
  
1–5 years of relevant work experience in system integration, hardware validation, testing or field troubleshooting.
  
  
Freshers without relevant work experience will not be considered.
  
  
Strong academic foundation in Mathematics and Physics, with good academic performance in both subjects.
  
  
Good understanding of electrical, mechanical and communication interfaces.
  
  
Practical exposure to hardware systems, equipment integration and technical troubleshooting.
  
  
Ability to diagnose and resolve system-level technical issues.
  
  
Must be comfortable working in field-based environments and travelling extensively across India.
  
  
Ability to work with multidisciplinary technical teams at different project locations.
  
  
**Preferred Technical Experience**
Candidates with exposure to any of the following areas will be preferred:
  
  
UAV platforms and drone technologies.
  
  
Robotics and autonomous systems.
  
  
Radar systems and RF technologies.
  
  
Aerospace systems and avionics hardware.
  
  
Sensors, payloads and electronic systems.
  
  
Industrial equipment and hardware integration.
  
  
Hardware configuration management and technical documentation.
  
  
Field testing, engineering deployments and equipment maintenance.
  
  
Important Job Information
  
  
This is a field-based engineering position and not a regular office-based role.
  
  
Candidates must be willing to travel across India depending on project locations and operational requirements.
  
  
Travel may involve extended stays at project sites.
  
  
Candidates should be comfortable handling, testing, configuring and troubleshooting technical equipment in field environments.
  
  
Strong practical engineering fundamentals and hands-on problem-solving ability are important for this role.

title: Senior Manager, Application Development
description:
**Job Description**
****Roles and Responsibilities****

* Frame ambiguous R&D and regulatory questions as well-posed modeling problems, selecting the appropriate method — classification, sequence modeling, information extraction, retrieval, generation, or statistical inference — and justifying the choice against alternatives.
* Build and evaluate NLP and LLM systems over large corpora of scientific and regulatory text: document parsing and layout-aware extraction, named entity and relation extraction, semantic search and reranking, retrieval-augmented generation, structured output, and multi-step agent orchestration with tool use.
* Develop predictive and statistical models over structured scientific data — analytical method and stability data, formulation and process parameters, historical submission outcomes — including feature engineering, handling of small and imbalanced datasets, uncertainty quantification, and model interpretability.
* Mine historical health authority correspondence (deficiency letters, information requests, complete response letters) to learn recurring deficiency patterns and build submission risk-scoring models.
* Design and own the evaluation discipline for every system shipped: curated golden datasets, inter-annotator agreement, failure taxonomies, offline and online metrics, A/B and regression testing, and quantitative acceptance criteria agreed with the business.
* Build reusable modeling components — embedding and retrieval pipelines, extraction schemas, evaluation harnesses, fine-tuning and prompt-optimization workflows — on Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, MLflow, Mosaic AI) and cloud model services (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker).
* Operationalize models with monitoring for data drift, performance degradation, and cost, and own remediation and periodic retraining.
* Produce audit-quality technical documentation — model cards, data lineage, validation evidence — supporting Amneal's GxP AI validation framework and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements, working with QA on inspection readiness.
* Establish benefit baselines with R&D and Regulatory owners and measure realized cycle-time, accuracy, and capacity outcomes.
* Present methods, results, limitations, and trade-offs to technical and business audiences; mentor junior scientists and engineers on modeling practice.

**Qualifications**
****3. Qualification and Experience****
**Education**

* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computational Linguistics, or a related quantitative field; PhD preferred (exception, Bachelors from Tier-1 colleges).

**Required Experience**

* 5+ years building and deploying machine learning and NLP models in production, with demonstrated ownership from problem framing through monitoring.
* Deep applied knowledge of modern ML and NLP: transformer architectures, embeddings, fine-tuning and parameter-efficient methods, retrieval-augmented generation, structured extraction, and LLM/agent evaluation.
* Strong statistical foundations: experimental design, hypothesis testing, uncertainty quantification, and modeling with small, noisy, or imbalanced datasets.
* Expert-level Python and the scientific ML stack (PyTorch or similar, Hugging Face, scikit-learn, pandas/PySpark); strong SQL.
* Hands-on experience building agentic systems: multi-step orchestration, tool and function calling, and human-in-the-loop evaluation.
* Track record of designing rigorous evaluation frameworks and defending model quality with quantitative evidence.
* Ability to work within documented, controlled processes and produce audit-quality technical documentation.

**Preferred Experience**

* Document intelligence over long, technical, or scientific documents (OCR, layout parsing, table and figure extraction from legacy PDFs).
* Predictive modeling over chemistry, analytical, or process data; cheminformatics or chemometrics toolchains.
* Experience in a GxP-regulated or other validated environment; familiarity with 21 CFR Part 11, CSV, or GAMP 5 and with AI model validation or governance.
* Exposure to pharmaceutical regulatory content — ANDA/NDA/DMF, eCTD structure, SPL labeling, health authority correspondence. Not required; domain is taught on the job.
* Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, MLflow, Mosaic AI) and Amazon Bedrock or SageMaker.
* Publications, open-source contributions, or competition results demonstrating applied ML depth.

title: Head - Manufacturing HR & Industrial Relations
description:
Head – Manufacturing HR & Industrial Relations

**Company:**
Flo Mattress (Flo Sleep Solutions Pvt. Ltd.)

**Location:**
Talegaon / Mumbai, with travel to manufacturing facilities

**Experience:**
12–18 years

**Compensation:**
₹24–36 LPA, depending on experience

**Reporting to:**
CEO

About the role

Flo Mattress is looking for an experienced manufacturing HR leader to manage workforce planning, industrial relations, labour compliance and HR operations across its manufacturing facilities.

The role will be responsible for building a reliable, productive and engaged manufacturing workforce as Flo continues to expand its production capacity.

Key responsibilities

**1. Workforce planning and recruitment**

* Work closely with plant heads to forecast manpower requirements.
* Lead recruitment of factory workers, operators, technicians, tailors, supervisors and other manufacturing personnel.
* Develop reliable hiring pipelines through local recruiters, training institutes and manpower agencies.
* Ensure manpower availability does not constrain manufacturing capacity.

**2. Industrial relations and employee welfare**

* Maintain healthy relationships between factory management and workers.
* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters and labour disputes.
* Manage union relationships and negotiations, where applicable.
* Improve worker engagement, retention, attendance and welfare.

**3. Contract labour management**

* Identify, negotiate with and manage labour contractors.
* Monitor contractor performance, workforce quality, statutory compliance and attendance.
* Establish transparent systems for contractor billing, overtime and worker payments.

**4. Labour law and statutory compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, factory regulations and statutory requirements.
* Oversee PF, ESI, gratuity, wages, working hours, leave and contractor compliance.
* Coordinate factory inspections, statutory audits and interactions with labour authorities.
* Maintain accurate employee records and documentation.

**5. Productivity and manpower cost optimization**

* Partner with manufacturing leadership to improve workforce productivity.
* Monitor manpower costs per unit manufactured, absenteeism, overtime and attrition.
* Develop skill-development, cross-training and multiskilling programs.
* Support performance-based incentive systems linked to quality and productivity.

**6. Manufacturing HR processes and systems**

* Standardize attendance, payroll inputs, onboarding, training and exit processes across factories.
* Establish plant-level HR dashboards and reporting.
* Manage plant HR teams and ensure consistent policies across locations.

Candidate requirements

* 12–18 years of HR experience, with substantial exposure to manufacturing operations.
* Strong practical knowledge of industrial relations, factory HR and contract labour management.
* Experience managing HR across multiple manufacturing facilities preferred.
* Demonstrated success recruiting and retaining large blue-collar workforces.
* Strong understanding of Indian labour laws and factory compliance.
* Experience in textiles, furniture, FMCG, automotive components, consumer durables or similar labour-intensive manufacturing industries.
* MBA / postgraduate qualification in HR, industrial relations or labour management preferred.
* Comfortable spending significant time on factory floors and working directly with plant managers.

What success looks like

The successful candidate will ensure manufacturing facilities are adequately staffed, labour costs are controlled, employee relations remain healthy and statutory compliance is consistently maintained.

The role should directly contribute to Flo's manufacturing capacity, cost efficiency and ability to scale.

The role is well suited to an organized professional with strong HR fundamentals, communication skills, and an interest in supporting an industrial and manufacturing-focused organization.

**Role Overview**

As Human Resources Coordinator, you will work closely with HR leadership and line managers to ensure smooth HR operations and consistent application of company policies. You will maintain accurate employee records, support onboarding and orientation, coordinate benefits documentation, assist with employee queries, and help organize engagement initiatives.

You will also support recruitment activities by coordinating interview schedules, maintaining candidate and hiring documentation, and assisting with joining formalities. In addition, you will prepare HR reports, maintain HR data, and support compliance with applicable labor regulations and internal policies.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Maintain and update employee records, HR files, attendance-related information, and HR documentation with accuracy and confidentiality.
2. Support end-to-end onboarding and orientation, including documentation, induction coordination, and new-employee follow-up.
3. Assist with benefits administration, including documentation, employee query resolution, and coordination with insurance or benefits providers.
4. Handle routine employee-relations queries professionally and escalate complex concerns to HR leadership as required.
5. Support employee engagement initiatives, communication activities, and workplace culture programs.
6. Coordinate recruitment activities, including scheduling interviews, communicating with candidates, maintaining recruitment trackers, and supporting joining formalities.
7. Prepare HR reports, MIS, and periodic updates for HR leadership and management review.
8. Support the consistent implementation of HR policies, procedures, and applicable labor and company regulations.
9. Maintain and update employee information in HRIS or HR-related systems, where applicable.
10. Work collaboratively with HR leadership, managers, and cross-functional teams to ensure timely and effective HR support.

**Required Qualifications**

1. Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
2. Strong foundational knowledge of HR management, HR operations, employee relations, and HR policies.
3. Familiarity with benefits administration, employee documentation, and coordination with external service providers.
4. Understanding of basic Indian labor regulations and HR compliance requirements.
5. Strong organizational, time-management, and multitasking skills, with high attention to detail.
6. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with employees at all levels.
7. Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
8. Experience with HRIS systems or HR software is an advantage.
9. Prior experience in an industrial, manufacturing, chemicals, or utilities environment is desirable.

**What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will be dependable, people-focused, and able to balance administrative precision with effective employee support. They will help create a well-organized HR function that enables managers and employees to access timely guidance, accurate documentation, and consistent people processes.

title: Software Engineer - Senior

Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.
  
  
**Position Overview**
Join the QuestaSim (Simulation) R&D team at Siemens EDA as a Senior Software Engineer and drive innovation in simulation technology. In this role, you'll architect and develop cutting-edge algorithms and software solutions that power industry-leading simulation tools. Working alongside experienced engineers, you'll solve complex technical challenges in a fast-paced environment, taking ownership of strategic initiatives from conception through delivery. Your technical expertise, problem-solving acumen, and leadership will directly shape the future of electronic design automation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement AI/ML and Agentic AI solutions in design and verification tools, establishing architecture patterns and best practices for enterprise-scale deployments
* Build scalable AI platforms leveraging LLMs, Agentic Frameworks, MCP, LangGraph, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) technologies
* Develop intelligent agents capable of tool usage, workflow automation, reasoning, planning, and autonomous task execution
* Evaluate and select AI technologies, models, frameworks, and infrastructure to meet product and business objectives
* Architect end-to-end AI systems including data pipelines, model serving, observability, memory management, and deployment strategies
* Collaborate with engineering leaders, product management, and domain experts to transform ideas into production-grade solutions

**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* 8+ years of proven industry software engineering experience with at least 5 year in AI/ML focused development
* Demonstrated expertise architecting and delivering enterprise-scale AI/ML solutions from concept to production
* Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn
* Deep knowledge of LLM-based systems, Agentic AI frameworks, RAG architectures, and vector databases
* Practical experience developing AI agents or copilots that interface with tools or external APIs
* Solid understanding of agentic design patterns and strong foundations in algorithms, data structures, and API design

**Preferred:**

* Experience with code understanding systems, AST analysis, or developer productivity tools
* Proficiency in C/C++
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and CI/CD practices
* Background in Digital Design, SystemVerilog, or EDA tools
* Knowledge of compilers, parallelism, or GPU profiling tools

**Why Us?**
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility — choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.
  
  
A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday with Us.

description:

Interested in Alexa+? Ever wonder what's involved in enabling third-party partners to create experiences for Alexa+? Then come help us build the AI-native SDKs that partners use every day to expand Alexa+ capabilities!
  
  
You will join a growing organization working on top technology using Generative AI and have an enormous opportunity to make an impact on the design, architecture, and implementation of products used every day, by people you know.
  
  
We’re working hard, having fun, and making history; come join us!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As the Sr Technical Product Manager for Alexa AI Developer Tech, you will define the vision, product roadmap, and features for building conversational experiences leveraging spoken language technologies and machine learning. This includes enabling other teams in Alexa, other teams across Amazon, and external partners to create highly-engaging Alexa experiences and features that customers love using in their daily lives. You will also be responsible for collaborating with and guiding a cross-functional team of engineers and designers to achieve your vision.
