You are highly analytical, able to work extremely effectively across multiple organizations, and adept at synthesizing a variety of technologies and capabilities into high-quality, simple-to-use products and applications that developers and customers love.
  
  
Next-gen AI Exposure

description:
**Company Description**
Join us as an Agentic Product Creator and help define how customers interact with AI-powered supply chain solutions across the Operate and Service portfolio. You will work at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and AI, creating experiences that enable organizations to confidently adopt autonomous operations while maintaining human oversight where it matters most. This is an Expert individual contributor role reporting to the VP of Product Design for Operate and Service.
  
  
You may come from product management, UX design, software engineering, or a combination of these disciplines. You bring deep expertise in at least one area and several years of senior individual contributor experience applying these capabilities across disciplines. What matters most is your ability to identify meaningful customer problems, personally build and validate solutions, and drive measurable outcomes.
  
  
You take ideas from first customer insight to proven business value. You use AI throughout your work while retaining responsibility for your judgment, decisions, and the quality of what you create.
  
  
**Job Description**
What you bring
  
  

* 8+ years building complex B2B or enterprise software, including several years as a senior individual contributor working across product, design, and engineering.
* 3+ years with AI-powered, intelligent, or autonomous systems, plus daily hands-on use of agentic AI tools to build, test, and evaluate functional prototypes.
* A record of personally building products in emerging technology areas from discovery through launch, adoption, and measurable results.
* Strong product judgment balancing customer value, business impact, usability, technical feasibility, reliability, and cost, grounded in customer empathy and experience.
* Technical judgment to guide implementation, structure context for AI systems, and investigate failures.
* Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to influence without authority, align stakeholders across disciplines, and help teams adopt effective product and AI practices.
* A curious, resilient builder who solves complex problems, tests alternatives, and adapts to new tools and evidence.

What you'll build
  
  

* Define Strategy and Validate Customer Needs:Use market and AI insights to guide product direction; engage customers directly to uncover needs, test hypotheses, and decide what to pursue, change, or stop.
* Design Intelligent Workflows and Experiences:Create scalable workflows that balance agents, automation, and human judgment with transparency and control, delivering intuitive and accessible experiences across interfaces.
* Accelerate Innovation Through AI:Personally build and test functional prototypes using AI, structuring the evidence, rules, constraints, and context needed for effective agentic systems.
* Own Product Outcomes:Drive success from concept through adoption, addressing barriers and improving results through customer feedback and performance data.
* Measure Impact and Guide Improvements:Test AI outputs and agent behavior; track customer impact, reliability, latency, and cost to inform investment decisions and product refinements.
* Influence Stakeholders and Build Discipline:Align stakeholders through clear storytelling about strategy, evidence, and trade-offs; coach peers and strengthen AI adoption and agentic product practices across the organization.

Meet your team
  
  
Supply Chain Management Operate and Service helps organizations run, manage, and continuously improve their supply chain operations. As supply chains evolve from process-driven systems to intelligent networks of autonomous agents, businesses need new ways to operate, decide, and act at scale. Experience and product innovation will be at the center of this transformation.
  
  
**Qualifications**
8+ years building complex B2B or enterprise software; several years of senior IC practice across disciplines.
  
  
Mix of consultancy, agency, start-up and/or in-house product development should be prioritized.
  
  
3+ years with AI powered, intelligent, or autonomous systems, plus current hands on agentic AI practice.
  
  
Repeated independent ownership, product judgment, and influence across teams.
  
  
**Additional Information**

With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives.
  
  
As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience.

At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. title: AI Adoption & Engineering Productivity
description:
**Job Requirements**
**Position Overview**
**Position Title :**
**ASIC Technical Manager – AI Adoption & Engineering Productivity**
**Reporting To : Center Manager / VBU Head**
**Scope**
Drive the adoption of
**AI/ML and Generative AI across the ASIC development lifecycle**
, with a focus on improving engineering productivity, design quality, predictability, and time-to-tapeout across
**RTL Design, Design Verification (DV), Physical Design (PD), and Design-for-Test (DFT)**
.
  
  
The role will work closely with ASIC domain leads, EDA/tool teams, engineering teams, and program management to identify high-value AI opportunities, develop reusable solutions, run pilots, measure business impact, and scale successful approaches across projects.
  
  
**Work Experience**
**Key Responsibilities**

* AI Strategy & Roadmap
* Develop a 12–24 month AI adoption roadmap for ASIC engineering.
* Identify and prioritize use cases based on engineering effort, schedule impact, quality improvement, and scalability.
* Build an AI use-case funnel from idea → PoC → pilot → production → organization-wide adoption.
* Establish measurable KPIs for AI initiatives, such as engineering-hours saved, verification cycle reduction, defect escape reduction, and tapeout schedule improvement.
* RTL Design Drive AI-assisted capabilities such as:
* RTL generation and code completion.
* Specification-to-RTL assistance.
* RTL code review and coding-standard compliance.
* Lint and CDC/RDC issue analysis.
* PPA-aware RTL optimization recommendations.
* Automated documentation and legacy RTL understanding.
* Design Verification Apply AI to improve:
* Testbench and assertion generation.
* UVM sequence/test generation.
* Coverage-gap identification.
* Regression failure clustering and triage.
* Log analysis and root-cause localization.
* Bug prediction and verification planning.

A major target should be reducing engineer time spent manually analyzing thousands of regression failures.
  
  

* Physical Design Develop AI/ML opportunities around:
* Floorplanning and placement optimization.
* Congestion prediction.
* Timing violation prediction and root-cause analysis.
* PPA optimization.
* ECO recommendation/analysis.
* Flow and log analytics across synthesis, P&R and STA.
* Historical design-data learning to improve future project predictability.
* DFT Drive AI-assisted:
* DFT rule violation analysis.
* Scan/ATPG log analytics.
* Coverage-gap analysis.
* Pattern optimization.
* Test-time and test-cost optimization.
* Failure diagnosis and silicon-learning correlation.
* AI Platform & Knowledge
* Create reusable AI accelerators rather than project-specific scripts.
* Build secure RAG/LLM solutions around internal ASIC specifications, methodology documents, design guidelines, historical issue databases and tool logs.
* Integrate solutions into existing engineering environments and EDA flows.
* Ensure protection of customer IP, RTL, netlists, design databases and confidential project information.

**Required Experience**

* 10–15+ years of ASIC/SoC engineering experience, with strong understanding of the semiconductor development lifecycle.
* Deep expertise in at least one of RTL, DV, PD or DFT, with good system-level understanding of the other domains.
* Experience with ASIC/EDA environments and flows from major vendors such as Synopsys, Cadence and Siemens EDA.
* Strong scripting/automation experience, preferably Python, Tcl, Perl/Shell.
* Understanding of LLMs, GenAI, RAG, AI agents and ML-based optimization and how they can be applied safely to engineering workflows.
* Ability to translate engineering pain points into scalable AI/automation solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management skills across engineering, program management, IT/security and customer teams.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree – Engineering.
* Master’s degree – preferred

**Personality Traits Desired**

* Humble
* Hungry
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
* Entrepreneurial mindset
* Innovation Mindset

title: Contract Job for 1 year | Product Implementation Consultant for a Consent Management Product | 3+ years plus experience candidates only | Bangalore
description:
Contract Job for 1 year | Product Implementation Consultant for a Consent Management Product | 3+ years’ experience candidates only | Bangalore

**Selection Process & Instructions**

**1.   Candidates with less than 3 years of relevant experience, including freshers, are requested not to apply. Candidates who have previously applied for this role and were not shortlisted/rejected are also requested not to reapply.**

**2.   This position is open only to candidates currently based in**
Bangalore.

3.   BDO will screen the candidates based on the information submitted through this job posting response (experience, current location, immediate availability, current CTC, expected CTC, etc. would be the key points for filtration). Please note that this is a relatively early-career implementation role, and so the
**salary expectations cannot go beyond 7 to 8 lakhs per annum**
.

4.   For filtered candidates, there will be a short conversation from BDO's side to validate the data submitted. The candidates will be asked to share their CV in a one-slide PPT format, which will be used by BDO for client submissions.

5.   The PPT version of the CVs will be submitted to the client, who will then set up a MS Teams call with multiple candidates together simultaneously, where the candidates will give an introduction of themselves and their work experience. The client will assess the communication skills and smartness of the candidates in this short chat.

6.   The client will then revert to BDO, confirming a list of candidates who may be considered for the Product training on their SaaS-based Consent Management solution. This is a free training session where training content will be shared online, and the candidate has to complete the self-paced training at their convenience. There will be an evaluation at the end (minimum 75% to clear the exam). There will be daily Q&A sessions for 1 hour to clarify doubts, if any, on the training material. No payment, salary, or stipend will be provided by BDO or the Client during this training session period. On average, if you spend 3 hours a day, then the training and certification should be completed within 2 weeks.

7.   The client will then inform BDO of the list of candidates who have cleared the exam and training and are ready to be onboarded or deployed.

8.   Accordingly, BDO will onboard the client-confirmed candidates as BDO employees, but they will be deployed at the client location. There will be a BDO induction in the first week of onboarding.

9.   After the first deployment or first assignment gets over, the employee may get deployed on another project of the client.

**Job Description**

**About the Role**

**We are looking for an Implementation Analyst Products to support the implementation and deployment of a SaaS-based Consent Management solution for Enterprise and Small & Medium-sized Business (SMB) clients. So, the deployment location will be anywhere in**
Bangalore where the client has its office, and the approximate duration of one deployment will be 6 to 8 months – like this, there could be multiple deployments with multiple clients, one following the other. Prior experience in Consent Management, DPDP, or Cybersecurity is not mandatory. Product-specific training will be provided.

This is an early-career implementation role suitable for candidates with 1–3 years of relevant experience.

The role involves working closely with clients, business stakeholders, product teams, and technical teams to drive implementation activities from requirements gathering through go-live and hypercare.

**Responsibilities:**

·          Support end-to-end implementation and deployment of a SaaS/product solution at client locations

·          Translate business requirements into configuration and implementation activities.

·          Support product demonstrations, customer onboarding and configuration activities.

·          Identify risks proactively, mitigate, and escalate as deemed appropriate.

·          Coordinate integration discussions involving APIs, data flows, interfaces and technical dependencies

·          Manage SMB Demo and Implementation deals for Consent Management solution, with a primary focus and special emphasis on supporting Free plan users.

·          Guide SMB customers through self-service setup, configuration, and troubleshooting to ensure quick go-live and fast Time to Value.

·          Gather feedback on product experience during the entire customer lifecycle via targeted surveys.

·     Gather customer feedback and support continuous improvement of the implementation experience.

·          Travel to and work from client locations for extended deployment periods when required.

**Requirements:**

·        1–3 years of experience in Tech products, SaaS, or Cloud products, implementation or technology consulting.

·          Prior exposure to customer onboarding, product demos, technical support, or pre-sales is preferred.

·         Understanding of APIs and basic general technical architecture and components is a must: Good to have development experience in REST APIs, JavaScript, and JSON/XML data structures.

·          Understanding of Kubernetes, Docker, and deployment workflows is preferred.

·      Understanding of infrastructure components – databases, queues, API gateways, firewalls, etc. is preferred.

·          Willingness to learn on-premise deployment concepts and assist senior team members on enterprise accounts.

·          Understanding of BFSI would be preferred.

·          Fluency in English is a must; fluency in Hindi is preferable.

·          Ability to travel to client locations for extended periods of deployments.

title: Product Manager
description:
JD: Product Manager – Agentic AI

**Joining within 45 days | Experience: 5 to 8 years | Location: Bangalore or Mumbai | On-site | Hands-on role**

Cogniflix Artificial Intelligence Pvt Ltd (Mindflix AI) is building the next generation of AI-powered personalisation and engagement systems across voice, conversational interfaces and real-time intelligence. We are persona-driven: we build live AI personas, avatars that talk, listen and respond like people. We are building for EdTech first, with healthcare to explore next.

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the vision, strategy and roadmap for our agentic AI products, starting with EdTech and then exploring healthcare.

Mindflix AI works from Bangalore and Mumbai and is being built with a global outlook, including a Singapore company structure to support international expansion, enterprise partnerships and future growth.

Role

**This is a hands-on role. You will lead the product and execute it yourself.**

You will set the direction and also do the detailed work: writing the requirements, testing the product, working through the data and driving delivery with engineering. There is no team under you to hand work to at the start, and there is the opportunity to build one as we grow.

You will work with the founders, the engineering team and our interns.

Key Responsibilities

* **Product strategy and roadmap:**
  define and prioritise what we build, aligned with business goals and customer needs.
* **Discovery:**
  understand customers and users first-hand, and turn their problems into clear, buildable requirements.
* **AI product quality:**
  work with AI engineers to define how our agents should behave, how quality is evaluated, and what is safe to ship.
* **Analytics and experimentation:**
  define success metrics, track adoption and conversion, and use data to decide what to do next.
* **Cross-functional execution:**
  drive delivery with engineering and design, and support launches and client rollouts.
* **New verticals:**
  build for EdTech first, then explore healthcare with us.
* **Ownership:**
  take the product from idea through launch, adoption and continuous improvement.

Must Have

* 5 to 8 years of professional experience, with at least 3 years in product management.
* End-to-end ownership of a live B2B or SaaS product, from discovery through launch and improvement.
* Practical experience building products with generative AI or agentic AI.
* Comfortable leading and executing at the same time: setting direction and doing the detailed work yourself.
* Technical fluency: APIs, data, and how LLM-based products are built and evaluated.
* Strong analytical skills, and the habit of deciding with data.
* Clear written and spoken communication, including requirements engineers can build from.
* Comfortable working directly with clients.
* Able to join within 45 days.

Good to Have

* Experience in EdTech or healthcare.
* Experience with conversational AI, voice AI, CRM or customer engagement products.
* Experience with multilingual products.
* Experience taking a product from zero to one in a startup.
* Hands-on comfort with SQL and analytics tools.

What We Look For

* Ownership from idea to outcome, not only to launch.
* Sound product judgement and structured problem-solving.
* Curiosity about how AI behaves in the real world, and the patience to read the conversations and the data.
* Pragmatism: the simplest thing that solves the customer's problem.
* Clear communication, documentation and timely escalation of blockers.
* Enthusiasm, and the belief that you can make a real impact in the real world. Open to grind and create.

What We Offer

* Ownership of a product line, not a slice of one.
* Direct work with the founders, the engineering team and our interns.
* Interesting work with live AI personas and avatars.
* The chance to shape the product from an early stage, and where the company goes next.
* The opportunity to build the product team as we grow.
* A high-ownership environment where product quality and execution are taken seriously.

How to Apply

Apply through this page -
https://forms.gle/9HR14qi1b8ciyJfB7

Compensation

Open for discussion

Location

On-site, at either of our offices:

* **Bangalore:**
  JBR Tech Park, Plot No. 77, 6th Road, EPIP Zone, Whitefield, Bengaluru 560066
* **Mumbai:**
  BHIVE Inspire, BKC Road, Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai 400051

title: ServiceNow Technical Product Manager
description:
Technical Product Manager, ServiceNow
  
  
Ecolab is seeking an experienced Technical Product Manager to lead the ServiceNow product roadmap for GBS+ and the enterprise functions it supports.
  
  
GBS+ uses ServiceNow to manage cases, requests, approvals, tasks, service commitments, and operational workflows across Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Legal, and other shared-services functions. As the product continues to expand, we need a leader who can bring these areas together around a consistent case-management model without forcing every function into the same process.
  
  
You will serve as the technical product owner for GBS+ capabilities built primarily on ServiceNow Customer Service Management. You will work with business product managers, process owners, Architecture, Engineering, UX, Data, Enterprise AI, QA, Delivery, and Operations to shape the roadmap and turn business needs into practical platform capabilities.
  
  
This role requires strong CSM knowledge and sound product judgment. You should be able to recognize when a request fits within native ServiceNow capabilities, when an existing pattern should be reused, and when a proposed solution creates unnecessary customization or long-term support risk.
  
  
This is not a project-management or requirements-documentation role. You will own product direction, roadmap priorities, functional decisions, adoption, and product health. You will stay engaged from discovery through delivery, launch, support, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Reporting to the Senior Manager of ServiceNow Technical Product Management, this role will help expand GBS+ while keeping it aligned with the broader ServiceNow platform strategy.
  
  
What’s in It for You
  
  

* Shape the ServiceNow roadmap for GBS+ and enterprise shared services.
* Work across Finance, Legal, Supply Chain, Procurement, and other business functions.
* Lead the expansion of case management, request management, workflow automation, and self-service.
* Partner directly with business service leaders and senior technology stakeholders.
* Create reusable CSM patterns that can scale across functions without creating unnecessary complexity.
* Influence the use of automation, data, analytics, knowledge, search, and AI within shared-services operations.
* Work within a mature ServiceNow platform organization alongside Product, Architecture, Engineering, UX, Enterprise AI, and Operations.

What You Will Do
  
  
Own the GBS+ Product Roadmap
  
  

* Own and maintain the ServiceNow product roadmap for GBS+ and the shared-services functions it supports.
* Work with business product managers, process owners, and service leaders to understand priorities, pain points, and expected outcomes.
* Turn business priorities into product capabilities, release plans, and a focused backlog.
* Maintain a clear view of committed work, new demand, dependencies, constraints, and risks.
* Balance the needs of individual functions with opportunities to build common capabilities across GBS+.
* Make clear recommendations on scope, sequencing, platform fit, and investment priorities.
* Keep the roadmap aligned with the broader ServiceNow strategy, architecture standards, and product direction.
* Communicate decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and expected outcomes in business terms.

Lead Case Management Across GBS+
  
  

* Set the product direction for case management across Finance, Legal, Supply Chain, Procurement, and other shared-services functions.
* Establish common approaches for intake, categorization, assignment, routing, approvals, tasks, escalations, notifications, service commitments, resolution, closure, and feedback.
* Decide where teams should use a common case-management pattern and where a real business difference calls for a different approach.
* Prevent separate teams from creating duplicate case types, processes, data structures, or user experiences.
* Guide the design of case types, service definitions, assignment models, work queues, case tasks, entitlements, and SLAs.
* Make sure case-management designs provide clear ownership, traceability, operational visibility, and a consistent requester experience.
* Challenge requests that simply move an email process into ServiceNow without improving the service model.
* Look at the full request-to-resolution experience, not just the form or workflow being built.

Provide Strong CSM Product Leadership
  
  

* Serve as the product expert for ServiceNow Customer Service Management across GBS+.
* Guide the effective use of CSM case types, service definitions, workspaces, assignment, routing, entitlements, SLAs, knowledge, communications, and reporting.
* Evaluate requirements against native ServiceNow and CSM capabilities before supporting customization.
* Identify where existing CSM configurations and shared components can be reused or extended.
* Work with Architecture and Engineering when a requirement affects the CSM data model, security, integrations, performance, or support model.
* Stay current on relevant ServiceNow releases and bring practical recommendations into the roadmap.
* Manage the lifecycle of CSM capabilities, including introduction, adoption, enhancement, standardization, consolidation, and retirement.
* Help the business understand what ServiceNow can support, where tradeoffs exist, and when another solution may be a better fit.

Manage Demand and Backlog Priorities
  
  

* Establish a clear intake and evaluation process for GBS+ demand.
* Evaluate requests based on business value, user impact, urgency, strategic alignment, functional fit, dependencies, effort, and long-term support needs.
* Work with the Business Analyst to turn approved demand into clear epics, features, stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain a prioritized backlog that reflects agreed outcomes and available delivery capacity.
* Resolve priority conflicts across functions and provide clear options when alignment cannot be reached.
* Make sure urgent requests do not repeatedly displace higher-value roadmap work without a deliberate decision.
* Identify dependencies on process decisions, data readiness, integrations, security, or operating-model changes.
* Keep stakeholders informed when scope, dependencies, or unresolved decisions affect delivery.

Guide Functional Design
  
  

* Lead functional design discussions across business teams, Business Analysis, UX, Architecture, Engineering, QA, Data, Security, and Operations.
* Make sure proposed solutions address the real business problem rather than recreating the current process.
* Review designs for forms, case types, workflows, approvals, routing rules, notifications, workspaces, reports, dashboards, and self-service experiences.
* Keep designs aligned with common GBS+ patterns and broader ServiceNow platform standards.
* Identify unnecessary customization, duplicate functionality, manual handoffs, and avoidable complexity.
* Make sure designs cover exceptions, errors, access, auditability, data ownership, reporting, monitoring, and support.
* Bring Architecture and Engineering into decisions before functional commitments are made.
* Document major product decisions, assumptions, exceptions, and accountable owners.

Improve Intake and Self-Service
  
  

* Shape a consistent intake experience for associates, suppliers, customers, and other users requesting GBS+ services.
* Guide the use of portals, forms, email-to-case, service definitions, guided experiences, and conversational channels.
* Reduce reliance on unmanaged mailboxes by moving the right work into structured and measurable ServiceNow processes.
* Make it easy for requesters to find the right service, provide the required information, check status, respond to questions, and understand the resolution.
* Partner with UX to simplify forms, remove unnecessary steps, and improve the end-to-end experience.
* Use knowledge and contextual guidance to improve self-service and reduce avoidable cases.
* Make sure intake experiences account for accessibility, mobile use, regions, languages, and different user groups where needed.
* Use feedback and usage data to identify where intake remains confusing or creates rework.

Drive Product Delivery
  
  

* Partner with Delivery, Engineering, Architecture, UX, QA, and the Business Analyst to turn roadmap priorities into executable plans.
* Make sure work enters delivery with a clear outcome, defined scope, functional direction, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and accountable business owner.
* Participate in discovery, estimation, backlog refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, release planning, and readiness reviews.
* Stay engaged through configuration, development, integration, testing, deployment, and stabilization.
* Make timely product decisions when delivery teams encounter functional questions or tradeoffs.
* Review scope changes and defects to determine whether they are a missed requirement, design issue, product change, or future enhancement.
* Partner with QA and business stakeholders on end-to-end testing and product acceptance.
* Make sure releases are ready for support and include the required documentation, training, communications, and ownership.

Lead Integrations, Data, and Reporting
  
  

* Define product requirements for integrations between ServiceNow and ERP, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Legal, data, identity, content, and other enterprise systems.
* Work with Architecture, Engineering, Data, and business owners to clarify system ownership and the right source for business data.
* Make sure integration requirements cover triggers, direction, frequency, validation, reconciliation, errors, monitoring, and support.
* Identify dependencies on master data, organizational structures, suppliers, customers, transactions, services, and user access.
* Raise data issues before they become production workflow or reporting problems.
* Define the business outcomes for dashboards, operational reporting, analytics, and data extracts.
* Make sure product decisions maintain appropriate security, privacy, retention, audit, and compliance controls.

Standardize Service Communications and Measures
  
  

* Establish consistent standards for acknowledgements, status updates, requests for information, escalations, resolution notices, closure, and surveys.
* Make sure notifications are clear and useful without overwhelming users.
* Guide the use of templates, event triggers, branding, links, case details, and communication channels.
* Define common service measures across case types, including volume, aging, response, resolution, backlog, SLA performance, rework, and satisfaction.
* Work with service owners to define meaningful commitments and escalation paths.
* Make sure reporting supports both daily operations and leadership visibility.
* Use operational trends to recommend process, product, and experience improvements.

Advance Automation and AI
  
  

* Identify opportunities to automate intake, classification, routing, assignments, approvals, follow-up work, status updates, and resolution.
* Partner with Enterprise AI, Architecture, Data, Security, and business leaders to evaluate Now Assist, AI agents, conversational experiences, and other approved capabilities.
* Focus automation and AI on clear outcomes such as reducing manual effort, improving routing, accelerating resolution, and increasing consistency.
* Make sure automated decisions have clear ownership, appropriate controls, transparency, fallback behavior, and human oversight.
* Guide the use of knowledge and case history to support agents and improve response quality.
* Prioritize AI and automation based on value, readiness, risk, and adoption needs.
* Measure whether implemented automation is delivering the expected outcome.

Own Product Health, Adoption, and Value
  
  

* Define success measures for GBS+, including adoption, case volume, channel migration, service performance, automation, user experience, and operational outcomes.
* Monitor product usage, case trends, integration failures, backlog, defects, incidents, and stakeholder feedback.
* Determine whether recurring issues require a process change, product enhancement, data correction, training, or operational action.
* Maintain visibility into technical debt, functional debt, unsupported configurations, and lifecycle risks.
* Make sure new capabilities have clear business ownership and adoption plans.
* Review whether delivered capabilities are being used as intended and producing the expected results.
* Recommend consolidation or retirement of duplicate, underused, or unsustainable capabilities.
* Provide business and platform leaders with a straightforward view of product health, risk, value, and improvement priorities.

Build Strong Business and Technology Partnerships
  
  

* Serve as the primary ServiceNow product partner for GBS+ and supported shared-services functions.
* Build strong working relationships with Finance, Legal, Supply Chain, Procurement, and other service leaders.
* Help stakeholders understand platform capabilities, product standards, dependencies, and delivery tradeoffs.
* Translate business needs into clear product direction and explain technical considerations in business terms.
* Facilitate decisions when requirements or priorities conflict across functions.
* Challenge proposed solutions when they introduce duplication, customization, or long-term platform risk.
* Stay aligned with the Senior Manager of Technical Product Management and other ServiceNow TPMs.
* Represent GBS+ in platform roadmap, product governance, architecture, experience, and delivery discussions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Ability to facilitate decisions across stakeholders with different priorities and levels of technical knowledge.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence senior business and technology leaders.
* Experience supporting products used across global or distributed business operations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**UI/UX Designer (Product-Minded)**

**Location:**
Bangalore (Work from Office, mandatory)

**Experience:**
Minimum 3 years

**Reports to / works with:**
CEO and Product Manager(s)

**About the Role**

We are looking for a UI/UX Designer with a product manager's mindset. You will own the journey from understanding a user problem to seeing the solution live in production. You will research, design, prototype and test using AI-assisted tools (Claude Artifacts preferred), and write the PRD that gets your design built. You will work closely with the CEO, Product Managers and developers.

Key Responsibilities

* **Understand the problem:**
  Walk through the current product, review user feedback, and agree with the product team on the problem and the concepts to solve it.
* **AI-assisted research:**
  Use AI to organise feedback, summarise research, and explore how similar products handle the same task.
* **Competitor research:**
  Run in-depth research on direct, indirect and related competitors and tools. Turn it into clear USPs and features that set us apart.
* **Flow and interaction design:**
  Map the steps a user takes, and explore alternative layouts and interactions to simplify the flow.
* **Interactive prototyping:**
  Use AI-assisted design and coding tools, preferably Claude Artifacts, to turn the proposed flow into a working prototype people can click through.
* **Usability testing:**
  Ask users or teammates to complete specific tasks in the prototype, observe where they hesitate or get stuck, revise the design, and test again.
* **Collaboration:**
  Work with Product Managers to review designs, align on decisions and concepts, and raise technical constraints early.
* **PRD and developer handoff:**
  Prepare the PRD and hand over the prototype and functionality to the development team. Support them until the feature is deployed.
* **Post-launch UX QA:**
  Once the feature is live, verify that the UX matches the approved design. If there are gaps, re-research the flow and iterate again.

A Typical Workday

1. Sync with the CEO and PM on daily updates, design decisions and upcoming tasks.
2. Pick up a task and discuss it in depth with the PM to align on design decisions and concepts, and get research and design work reviewed.
3. Review the evidence, identify the step causing difficulty, use AI to explore options, and select the one that best addresses the problem.
4. Run AI-assisted competitive research, compare it against our flow, draft the insights and start building the prototype.
5. Build or update the live prototype, then run through the task yourself, including edge cases such as changing one's mind, entering incomplete information, or undoing an action.
6. Review the first iteration with the PM, note the feedback and iterate.
7. Hand the reviewed Claude Artifact or other prototype to the developers, along with the downloadable functionality and the PRD.
8. Review developer feedback against UI/UX principles and laws. Accept what is valid and discuss what isn't.
9. After release, test on dev or production to confirm the UX matches the design.
10. If flaws are found, rework the flow with proper research and iterate again.

**Requirements**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in UI/UX or product design.
* A portfolio showing end-to-end work: research, flows, prototypes and shipped products.
* Solid grasp of UX principles and laws, usability heuristics and user-flow design.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools for research, design or prototyping. Claude Artifacts experience is preferred.
* Ability to write clear PRDs and hand off to developers.
* Strong communication skills for working directly with the CEO, PMs and engineers.
* Comfortable working from our Bangalore office.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in usability testing and iterating on feedback.
* Basic understanding of front-end development and technical constraints.
* Product management exposure, such as prioritisation, roadmaps and feature scoping.

**How to Apply**

Share your resume and portfolio (including at least one case study showing research through to shipped design) with
**akanksh@onlylaw.co.uk**
.

title: Lead UI/UX Designer
description:
As the UX Lead for our ServiceNow platform, you will drive consistency across our UX and UI, document and own the standards that get us there, and build the design system and practice that make great experiences repeatable
   

  

 rather than accidental. This is a hands on leadership role. You will set the design direction and build it, in UI Builder and in React.
   

  

 This is a pivotal moment for experience on our platform. We are raising our ambition from enterprise tolerable to consumer grade, moving beyond a traditional ITSM mindset to design solutions our users genuinely want to use.You will own the success and adoption of what we ship, not just the design behind it.
   

  

 You will establish a formal UX practice on the platform from the ground up and lead the designers and developers
   

  

 who join it. Strong stakeholder management and communication are central to the role. You will be the advocate for experience who aligns product, engineering, and business around a shared bar for quality, and holds us to it.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 UX Standards and Consistency
   

  

* Own and document the UX and UI standards for the platform, and drive their adoption across every team building on ServiceNow.
* Build and own a design system and component library so that consistency is built in, not policed after the fact.
* Establish design patterns, guidelines, and reusable components that raise the floor on every solution we ship.
* Define what “good” looks like on the platform and hold teams to it through design reviews and clear standards.


 Consumer Grade Experience and Adoption
   

  

* Move the platform beyond a traditional ITSM mindset and design solutions where the experience is consumer grade.
* Own the success and adoption of the solutions we ship. Define what adoption looks like, measure it, and use


 it to drive design decisions.
   

  

* Partner with product and business teams to make sure we are solving the real user problem, not just delivering the requested feature.
* Bring an outside\-in view of quality, benchmarked against the consumer products our users actually compare us to.


 Hands On Design and Build
   

  

* Design and build experiences directly in UI Builder and the Now Experience Framework.
* Write front\-end code in React to build components, prototypes, and production experiences where native tooling is not enough.
* Move fluidly between design and implementation so that what gets shipped matches what was designed.
* Set front\-end engineering standards for the UX work on the platform.


 User Research and Accessibility
   

  

* Stand up a user research practice. Talk to real users, run usability testing, and bring evidence to design decisions rather than opinion.
* Own accessibility on the platform. Make sure what we build meets WCAG standards and works for everyone, and build accessibility into the design system rather than retrofitting it.
* Turn research and accessibility from checkboxes into a genuine part of how the team works.


 Mobile Experience
   

  

* Extend the same consumer grade bar to mobile. Our mobile experience is a strength today and this role keeps it that way as the platform grows.
* Design and build mobile experiences that are first class, not afterthoughts, across ServiceNow mobile apps and mobile web.


 Building the UX Practice and Team
   

  

* Establish a formal UX practice on the platform from scratch: the standards, the tools, the rituals, and the ways of working.
* Hire, lead, and grow a team of UX designers and developers, and build a culture where craft and user obsession are the norm.
* Mentor the team and raise the level of design and front\-end work across everyone building on the platform.


 Stakeholder Management and Communication
   

  

* Be the advocate for experience across product, engineering, operations, and business, and align them around a shared bar for quality.
* Communicate design decisions clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, including executive leadership, and bring people along rather than mandating.
* Make the case for investment in UX and show the return through adoption and outcomes.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Deep hands on experience with ServiceNow native UX capabilities, including UI Builder and the Now Experience Framework, across workspaces, portals, and Employee Center.
* Hands on front\-end development experience with React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with the ability to build production experiences directly.
* Proven track record building and owning a design system and component library adopted across multiple teams.
* Experience establishing and documenting UX and UI standards and driving their adoption at scale.
* Hands on user research experience, including usability testing and translating findings into design decisions.
* Strong accessibility expertise, including WCAG 2\.1 / 2\.2 and designing for assistive technologies.
* A portfolio that shows consumer grade enterprise experiences, and the judgment to move a platform beyond legacy and ITSM era patterns.
* Proven people leadership. You have built or led a team of designers and developers.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including with executive leadership.
* Experience owning the adoption and success of what you ship, and measuring it.
* Proficiency with Figma or equivalent design and prototyping tools.
* 8\+ years in UX and UI design, with meaningful time in a lead or player\-coach capacity.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ServiceNow certifications related to UX, UI Builder, or application development (e.g., CSA, CAD).
* Hands on experience with ServiceNow mobile, including Now Mobile and the mobile app builder.
* Experience standing up a UX or design ops practice inside an organization that previously had none.
* Experience turning around the reputation of a platform or product that had outgrown its original design.
* Familiarity with Employee Center Pro intranet and portal experiences.
* Experience with design system tooling such as Storybook, design tokens, and component documentation.
* Interaction and motion design skills, and UX writing or content design experience.
* Experience working with large scale enterprise design systems.

title: Technical Project Manager - Chatbot Delivery
description:
**About Exotel**

Exotel is the emerging market's leading full-stack customer engagement platform and business-focused virtual telecom operator. Founded in 2011, our cloud platform powers over 50 million daily engagements across voice, video and messaging for 6,000+ companies in 60+ countries, including Ola, Swiggy, Flipkart, Zomato, HDFC Bank and Urban Company.

We run three product lines: communication APIs (CPaaS), a modern omnichannel cloud contact center, and a conversational AI platform. Our chatbots and virtual assistants serve 8 of India's top 10 banks, and we are building agentic AI experiences with some of the country's largest consumer brands.

**Experience:**
5–8 years

**Location:**
Bengaluru (Domlur), with customer-site travel as needed

**About the Team**

The
**Chatbot Delivery team**
is part of Exotel's Conversational AI delivery organisation and focuses exclusively on enterprise chatbot and virtual-assistant deployments across WhatsApp, web, in-app chat and other messaging channels. The team takes each deployment from signed deal to stable production, and keeps it performing after go-live.

**Role Summary**

You will own end-to-end delivery of enterprise chatbot projects: kickoff, requirements, conversation design sign-off, integrations, UAT, go-live, hypercare and handover. You'll be the single-threaded owner for the plan, risks, dependencies, timelines and customer communication, working closely with conversation designers, bot developers/FDEs, product and engineering, and the customer's IT, digital and security teams.

This is a delivery and customer-outcomes role, not an engineering-manager role. You won't build the bots yourself, but you need enough technical depth to understand how they work, spot problems early and unblock them.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program ownership & delivery execution**

* Own project plans, milestones, RAID logs and delivery governance for multiple concurrent enterprise chatbot deployments.
* Drive structured execution: kickoff → discovery workshops → use-case and conversation-flow sign-off → integrations → UAT → go-live → hypercare → handover to support.
* Maintain delivery artefacts: project plan, decision log, action tracker, UAT plan, cutover/go-live runbook and status reports.

**Customer-facing leadership**

* Be the primary point of contact for the customer: run status calls, steering reviews and escalation calls, and keep stakeholders aligned on scope, timelines and acceptance criteria.
* Translate business goals (deflection, self-service, lead capture, collections, servicing) into clear use cases, journeys and success metrics.
* Manage scope changes and change requests with clear impact assessment and trade-offs.

**Chatbot solutioning & integrations**

* Coordinate the build of intents, flows, FAQs/knowledge bases and LLM/GenAI-powered experiences with conversation designers and bot developers.
* Manage integration-heavy projects: REST APIs, webhooks, CRMs, core banking/LOS/LMS systems, ticketing tools, authentication/OTP flows and live-agent handover to the contact center.
* Own channel readiness, including WhatsApp Business API onboarding (templates, opt-ins, number/display-name approvals), web widgets and in-app SDKs.

**Quality, go-live & post-launch performance**

* Plan and run UAT with the customer, including test cases for happy paths, fallbacks, edge cases and multilingual journeys.
* Own go-live readiness and hypercare; triage production issues with engineering and drive them to closure.
* Track and improve bot performance after launch: containment/deflection rate, fallback rate, intent accuracy, drop-offs, CSAT and adoption.

**InfoSec & compliance readiness**

* Drive security and compliance workflows with enterprise customers (especially BFSI): security questionnaires, data-flow diagrams, PII/data-handling and access-control requirements, and approvals.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must-have**

* 5–8 years of project/program management, delivering customer-facing technical systems (SaaS, conversational AI, CCaaS/CPaaS or enterprise software).
* Hands-on delivery of chatbot, virtual assistant or conversational AI projects for enterprise customers, owned through UAT → go-live → hypercare.
* Working understanding of how chatbots are built: intents/entities, NLU, dialogue flows, fallbacks, and knowledge-base or LLM/RAG-based answering.
* Solid technical aptitude: comfortable reading API documentation, request/response payloads and logs, and following basic solution architecture.
* Experience managing API/CRM integrations alongside engineering teams.
* Strong client-facing execution: crisp written updates, stakeholder management, escalation handling and negotiation on scope and timelines.

**Good to have**

* Delivery experience with BFSI customers and their security and compliance processes.
* WhatsApp Business API or other messaging-channel experience.
* Exposure to chatbot platforms (e.g. Dialogflow, Rasa, Microsoft Bot Framework, Yellow.ai, Haptik, Gupshup) or LLM-based agent frameworks.
* Multilingual / Indic-language bot deployments.
* Hands-on with Jira, Confluence, Postman, and basic SQL or analytics dashboards.

**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days**

* Independently run 2–3 live chatbot deployments with predictable milestones and high customer confidence.
* Put in place reusable delivery templates for the new team: kickoff checklist, use-case sign-off, UAT plan, go-live runbook and hypercare SOP.
* Establish a post-launch performance review rhythm (containment, fallback, CSAT) with key customers.

**Why Exotel**

* Build and shape a newly formed team at the centre of Exotel's conversational AI growth.
* Work with India's leading banks and consumer brands on high-scale, high-impact deployments.
* A profitable, 14+ year-old company with the pace and ownership of a product startup.

title: Senior Business Analyst - Ops Risk
description:
**Surya at a Glance**
Surya was founded in 1999 by Mr. D.N. Prahlad (an early employee of Infosys), to create software products. Headquartered in Bangalore, we also have offices in the USA, and France.
  
  
Surya Financial Technologies Private Limited (Surya), has been leading the Financial Control & Risk Management solution space with 25+ years of experience in developing and implementing Risk Management and Balance Sheet Management Solutions at 75+ BFSI customers globally. Surya has invested heavily in the research & development in the ever-evolving Financial Risk landscape and has been at the forefront of providing solutions that not just meet the guidelines and requirements for today but also supporting the institutions with future ready investments.
  
  
Surya, being a global player, has a strong clientele spreading across South Asia, Middle East, Africa and North America. In the span of 25+ years, Surya has addressed and successfully implemented Financial Risk Transformation projects, working with marquee clients with an Asset Base of USD 450 Bn+ to less than USD 500 Mn, across the spectrum of financial services industry.
  
  
At Surya, we believe that high quality leads to high productivity. We offer the right balance of technical excellence in software engineering and deep knowledge of risk management. Our core values are focused on simplicity, superior functional architecture, advanced technology, quick deployment, and ease of maintenance. We ensure high levels of efficiency and lower total cost of ownership (TCO) for our clients. We understand that an organization’s risk and reporting requirements are growing more sophisticated every year with evolving and new regulations, expansion into new markets, and competitive pressures. Adopting Innovation in technology and coming up with world class solutions which can be deployed with ease has been the corner stone of Surya’s success globally.
  
  
**Your Growth at Surya**
Surya’s growth is driven by ordinary people who have extraordinary dreams and are bold enough to pursue them. Our leadership team, including our Managing Director, is composed primarily of people who joined Surya as freshers. Through our process of continuous feedback, and regular 1-1 conversations, we believe in upskilling our team, and enabling each of them to grow along paths they find satisfying.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To lead the implementation and continuous enhancement of Operational Risk and GRC solutions by delivering client engagements, conducting fit-gap analysis, and contributing to product development aligned with regulatory requirements and evolving industry needs.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Execute end-to-end implementation of Operational Risk and GRC solutions, including requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, and system configuration.
* Translate client and regulatory requirements into functional specifications and drive solution design within the product.
* Collaborate with product and technology teams to build, test, and enhance GRC modules based on implementation learnings.
* Support product evolution through continuous feedback, data insights, and alignment with emerging regulatory and market needs.

**Functional Responsibilities**

* Lead requirement gathering and fit-gap analysis by mapping client needs to Operational Risk and GRC frameworks (RCSA, KRI, Loss/Event Management, Issues Management).

* Translate regulatory guidelines and business requirements into functional specifications, use cases, and process flows.
* Design risk frameworks within the product, including risk taxonomy, control libraries, assessment structures, and reporting hierarchies.
* Collaborate with stakeholders (Risk, Compliance, Audit, Business Units) to validate requirements and ensure alignment with regulatory expectations.
* Support UAT cycles, including test case preparation, execution, and business validation prior to go-live.
* Drive post-implementation adoption by resolving functional issues, refining workflows, and ensuring effective utilization of GRC modules.
* Contribute to product enhancements by identifying gaps and incorporating implementation learnings into functional improvements.

**Technical Responsibilities**

* Configure and deploy GRC/ORMS platforms, including workflows, forms, rules, and role-based access controls.
* Implement and customize modules such as RCSA, KRI, Risk Events/Loss Data, Issue Management, and Dashboards/Reporting.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to translate functional requirements into technical designs, APIs, and system integrations.
* Support data migration, system integration, and validation to ensure data accuracy and consistency across platforms.
* Build and enhance dashboards and reports using data analytics tools to enable risk monitoring and decision-making.
* Manage system performance, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate with technical support teams for bug fixes and enhancements.
* Ensure system readiness for audits and regulatory reviews through proper data capture, audit trails, and reporting capabilities.

title: Digital Marketing & Social Media Manager – Content, Reels & AI Creative
description:
Delnie is looking for a
**Content Marketing & Social Media Manager**
who lives and breathes content: someone who thinks in stories, builds audiences and turns attention into trust, leads and customers.

This is a fully remote role with complete ownership of content marketing across FavHiker, FavHiker Business Suite and Delnie: strategy, storytelling, social media, reels, AI-assisted creative, publishing, community and results.

We're looking for a content marketer first and a creator second. You understand why people stop, read, watch, share and act, and you can build content that does all of that consistently, across platforms and audiences. You're as comfortable shaping a content strategy as you are writing a hook, editing a reel or reading the numbers behind it.

You'll work closely with the Marketing Director, performance marketing, sales, product and design teams to build a content engine that is creative, consistent and measurable.

Explore Our Brands

* **Delnie**
  : delnie.com
* **FavHiker:**
  favhiker.com
* **FavHiker Business Suite:**
  business.favhiker.com

Your Responsibilities

**Content Marketing Strategy**

* Own the content marketing strategy across FavHiker, FavHiker Business Suite and Delnie.
* Define content pillars, audience journeys, tone of voice and storytelling for each brand.
* Build content that serves every stage of the journey, from first discovery and curiosity to trust, conversion and loyalty.
* Plan and run a monthly content calendar aligned with launches, campaigns, seasons and business goals.
* Turn every piece of content into many: one idea, many formats, many platforms.

**Brand Storytelling & Copy**

* Write compelling hooks, captions, scripts, carousels, posts and campaign copy.
* Create long-form content where it matters: LinkedIn articles, blogs, newsletters, case stories and landing page copy.
* Tell real stories of customers, businesses, our team and our work in a way that builds credibility.
* Keep every brand's voice consistent, clear and recognisable.

**Social Media Ownership**

* Own social media end to end across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and emerging platforms.
* Publish, schedule and manage all posts, stories, reels and carousels.
* Stay ahead of platform trends, formats and algorithm changes, and use them early.

**Reels & Short-Form Video**

* Concept, script and edit high-performing reels and short-form videos.
* Build hooks, storytelling and pacing that earn attention in the first few seconds.
* Work remotely with businesses, creators and internal teams to source footage, photos and stories.

**AI-Assisted Creative**

* Use AI image, video and voice tools to create content at speed and scale.
* Build repeatable AI content workflows that keep quality and brand consistency high.
* Blend AI and real content thoughtfully, so it feels human, credible and on-brand.
* Follow platform rules on AI-generated content, including disclosure, to protect brand trust.

**FavHiker – Consumer Content**

* Build FavHiker into a recognisable consumer brand through engaging, shareable and community-led content.
* Grow followers, engagement and app interest through creators, user stories and trend-led content.

**FavHiker Business Suite – B2B Content Marketing**

* Create content that speaks directly to business owners about their challenges, their wins and their growth.
* Build curiosity and credibility that bring qualified leads to the sales team.
* Support sales with case stories, explainers and content they can share with prospects.

**Delnie – Brand & Thought Leadership**

* Build Delnie's voice on LinkedIn and beyond, sharing our point of view, our work and our culture.
* Create thought-leadership content for the founders and leadership team.

**Community & Engagement**

* Respond to comments and messages, and build an active, positive community.
* Collaborate with creators, influencers and partner businesses.

**Analytics & Optimisation**

* Track reach, engagement, followers, saves, shares, watch time, traffic, leads and conversions.
* Report monthly on what's working and what isn't.
* Run continuous experiments across hooks, formats, topics, timing and creative styles.

What We're Looking For

**3–5 years of experience in content marketing, social media or digital marketing**
, with a portfolio of content that has performed.

Strong candidates will demonstrate:

* **Content marketing depth:**
  a clear understanding of strategy, storytelling and how content drives business results
* **Strong writing:**
  hooks, captions, scripts and long-form content for consumer and business audiences
* **Short-form video expertise:**
  scripting and editing reels that perform
* **AI creative fluency:**
  hands-on use of AI image, video and voice tools in real work
* **Platform intelligence:**
  a deep understanding of Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and Facebook
* **Brand sense:**
  the judgement to keep every piece consistent, credible and on-brand
* **Analytical thinking:**
  making content decisions from data, not guesswork
* **Remote discipline:**
  the ability to plan, create, publish and report independently, with a reliable editing setup

Experience with consumer apps, food-tech, hospitality, SaaS or B2B brands would be an advantage. Familiarity with editing tools (such as CapCut, Premiere Pro or After Effects) and design tools (such as Canva or Figma) is expected.

Excellent English writing is essential. Content ability in Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu or Malayalam is valuable.

Most importantly, we want someone who understands how to connect:

**Story → Attention → Engagement → Trust → Community → Customers**

What We Offer

* Competitive compensation with performance-linked rewards
* Complete creative ownership across three brands and audiences
* Access to the latest AI creative tools
* Fully remote, work from anywhere in India
* Direct collaboration with the Marketing Director and founders
* A clear path to Head of Content as the team grows

What Success Looks Like

**For FavHiker,**
success means a growing, engaged community and content people share, save and come back to.

**For FavHiker Business Suite,**
success means content that builds curiosity among business owners and brings qualified leads to sales.

**For Delnie,**
success means a stronger, more credible voice that supports partnerships, hiring and new business.

* **At an organisational level,**
  success means a consistent, high-quality content engine that publishes every day, learns every week and grows every month.

description:

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

Are you looking to be in a role where you can have a significant impact on the company’s growth and success?

Whatfix is an AI platform advancing the “userization” of enterprise applications, empowering companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments. Technology needs adoption. By combining these signals, Whatfix delivers real-time guidance, nudges, knowledge, and automation directly in the flow of work.

title: Content Marketing Manager
description:
**Role Name: Content Marketing Manager**
========================================

At Kapture CX, we are looking for a **Content Marketing Manager** in our **Marketing team**.

**Who are we?**
---------------

Kapture CX is an AI-native customer experience platform helping enterprises turn their messiest service operations into seamless, intelligent experiences. We build cutting-edge AI (agentic automation, voice AI, real-time intelligence) for industries where complexity is the default: banking, financial services, retail, ecommerce and beyond.

Headquartered in Bangalore with a growing presence in the US and Dubai, we serve 1,000+ enterprise clients across 18+ countries. We’ve raised $20M to date, we’re profitable, and we’re growing 100% year on year, a combination that’s rare at the intersection of AI and SaaS.

Today we’re a 400+ strong team, and we’re looking for people who want to build AI that actually ships, scales and solves real problems.

**What is this role all about?**
--------------------------------

We are looking for a Content Marketing Manager with a strong flair for writing, a natural curiosity for technology, and the ability to turn complex ideas into simple, compelling narratives.

As a storyteller at heart, you will create impactful content that builds brand awareness, drives engagement and supports business growth, while strengthening Kapture CX's brand positioning and thought leadership.

**Sounds interesting?**
-----------------------

Here’s a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:

* Develop and execute content marketing strategies aligned with the company's brand positioning and business objectives.
* Create high-quality content across blogs, whitepapers, e-books, case studies, research reports, newsletters and thought leadership articles.
* Write compelling copy for website pages, landing pages, email campaigns, social media and marketing campaigns.
* Translate complex AI and technology concepts into engaging, outcome-driven narratives for enterprise audiences.
* Identify emerging industry trends, create original thought leadership content, optimize content for SEO and track performance to continuously improve engagement and effectiveness.

This is a **Bangalore-based role**. We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in-person interactions fuel innovation and agility.

**What does success look like in this role?**
---------------------------------------------

You will create high-quality, engaging and impactful content that strengthens brand awareness, thought leadership and audience engagement, while supporting marketing initiatives and business growth.

**What would make you a good fit for this role?**
-------------------------------------------------

**Here are the basic requirements:**

* You have 3–5 years of experience in Content Marketing, Brand Communications or Copywriting, preferably in a B2B SaaS or technology company.
* You have exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a natural flair for writing and storytelling.
* You have strong research, editing and proofreading skills, with the ability to write across different formats, tones and audience segments.
* You have a strong portfolio demonstrating versatility and originality in writing, along with proficiency in leveraging AI tools for content ideation, research, creation and optimization without compromising quality or brand voice.

**What are the most critical skills for this role?**
----------------------------------------------------

* You have strong content writing, storytelling and copywriting skills to create compelling narratives.
* You can simplify complex AI and technology concepts into engaging content for enterprise audiences.
* You have expertise in creating content across multiple formats, including blogs, case studies, whitepapers, website content, emails and social media.
* You understand SEO, content performance optimization and how to leverage AI tools to scale content production while maintaining originality, quality and brand voice.

**You will have an advantage if you:**
--------------------------------------

* You have prior experience working in B2B SaaS or technology companies.
* You have experience creating content for AI-powered products, enterprise software or technology solutions.
* You have experience developing thought leadership content, research reports and industry-focused content.
* You are proficient in using AI tools to ideate, research, create and optimize content while maintaining originality and brand voice.

**Why should you be interested?**
---------------------------------

**Here's what you will gain from this role:**

* **Creative ownership:** Shape content narratives and create compelling stories that strengthen Kapture CX's brand positioning.
* **Business impact:** Create content that builds brand awareness, drives engagement and supports business growth.
* **Innovation:** Work closely with cutting-edge AI, agentic automation, voice AI and real-time intelligence technologies.
* **Cross-functional exposure:** Contribute to brand campaigns, product launches and integrated marketing initiatives.
* **Growth opportunity:** Build your expertise in B2B SaaS content marketing, enterprise technology and AI-driven content creation.

**Does this sound like you?**
-----------------------------

Migration to Salesforce: Supply proactively to migration initiatives from Adobe to Salesforce, ensuring continuity of experience, data integrity, and performance.

Compliance and Data Integrity: Uphold privacy, consent, quality, and security policies across every touchpoint, protecting customer trust and brand reputation.

Continuous Improvement: Bring together lessons learned, refine processes, and share knowledge to drive sustained gains in speed, quality, and collaborator satisfaction.

* Expertise with Adobe Campaign Classic workflows to support segmentation, data ingestion, transformation, and campaign deliveries.

We are problem-solvers at heart. One moment, we’re automating a complex supply chain workflow, the next, we’re testing AI-driven market intelligence tools. title: Lead Analytics Product & Delivery Manager - Senior Vice President
description:
We are seeking an experienced
**SVP, Lead Analytics Product & Delivery Manager**
to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of People Insights and Organizational Effectiveness products and platforms.
  
  
This leader will oversee a portfolio of analytics, reporting, decision-support, and AI-enabled products that support workforce planning, talent management, organizational effectiveness, employee experience, and executive decision-making.
  
  
The role requires a combination of product leadership, strategic thinking, analytical problem solving, stakeholder management, and AI product expertise. The successful candidate will lead a team of product managers while partnering across Data Science, Data Engineering, Technology, HR, and Control Functions to bring innovative and governed solutions from concept through enterprise adoption.
  
  
The ideal candidate can connect long-term product strategy with day-to-day execution, ensuring solutions deliver measurable business value while operating within Citi's governance, privacy, and control frameworks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy and Portfolio Leadership**

* Define and own the product strategy, vision, and multi-year roadmap for People Insights and Organizational Effectiveness products.
* Develop and maintain a prioritized portfolio of analytics, reporting, workforce intelligence, and AI-enabled solutions.
* Identify opportunities where data, analytics, machine learning, and Generative AI can improve workforce decisions and organizational effectiveness.
* Evaluate initiatives based on business value, feasibility, regulatory requirements, adoption potential, and strategic alignment.
* Establish product investment priorities and recommend resource allocation across initiatives.
* Drive alignment between business priorities, product strategy, technology investments, and delivery roadmaps.

**Product Delivery and Execution**

* Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of analytics and AI products, from opportunity assessment and discovery through deployment and adoption.
* Partner with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Technology teams to ensure solutions meet scalability, reliability, security, and usability requirements.
* Establish product delivery standards, governance processes, and success measures across the portfolio.
* Ensure that products are supported by clear business requirements, use cases, KPIs, and adoption plans.
* Monitor product performance and business outcomes, making data-driven decisions regarding future enhancements and investments.
* Drive continuous improvement across product development and delivery practices.

**AI and Analytics Product Innovation**

* Lead the identification and development of AI-enabled product opportunities across People Insights and Organizational Effectiveness.
* Partner with Data Science teams to incorporate predictive analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, agentic workflows, and decision-support capabilities into products where appropriate.
* Guide build-versus-buy decisions for AI capabilities, platforms, and vendor solutions.
* Establish frameworks for measuring product effectiveness, business impact, user engagement, and AI performance.
* Promote responsible AI adoption while balancing innovation, control requirements, and business outcomes.
* Stay current on emerging trends in AI, workforce technology, analytics platforms, and digital product innovation.

**Stakeholder and Executive Leadership**

* Build strong relationships with senior leaders across HR, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and the businesses.
* Translate complex workforce and organizational challenges into actionable product strategies and delivery plans.
* Serve as the primary product partner for senior stakeholders seeking to leverage analytics and AI to solve business problems.
* Present product strategies, investment recommendations, portfolio updates, and business outcomes to executive audiences.
* Influence decisions across teams without direct authority and build alignment among diverse stakeholder groups.
* Drive product adoption through effective stakeholder engagement, communication, training, and change-management efforts.

**Team Leadership and Talent Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of product managers responsible for analytics and AI-enabled products.
* Establish clear goals, accountability, and development plans for team members.
* Build product management capabilities across discovery, roadmap development, prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and product execution.
* Foster a culture of innovation, customer focus, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Promote best practices in product management, Agile delivery, experimentation, measurement, and user-centered design.

Governance, Risk, and Controls
  
  

* Ensure products comply with Citi's model risk, privacy, data governance, cybersecurity, and responsible AI standards.
* Partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Model Risk Management, and Technology teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Ensure appropriate controls, monitoring, documentation, and governance processes are established prior to deployment.
* Maintain oversight of product risks, dependencies, regulatory considerations, and control requirements across the portfolio.

**Required Qualifications**
**Leadership & Product Experience**

* 10+ years of experience across product management, analytics, technology strategy, consulting, or related disciplines.
* Significant experience leading product teams and managing complex product portfolios within a large enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated success owning product strategy, roadmap development, and delivery of enterprise-scale solutions.
* Proven ability to influence senior executives and drive alignment across business, technology, and control organizations.
* Experience leading large cross-functional initiatives with measurable business outcomes.

**Analytics & AI Expertise**

* Strong understanding of analytics, data science, machine learning, and AI product development.
* Experience delivering analytics, data, or AI-enabled products from concept through deployment and adoption.
* Familiarity with Generative AI, Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, AI agents, and emerging AI technologies.
* Understanding of data engineering concepts, data platforms, APIs, enterprise architecture, and modern analytics ecosystems.
* Ability to evaluate technical approaches and translate business requirements into scalable product solutions.

**Business And Problem-Solving Skills**

* Exceptional problem-solving and structured thinking skills.
* Ability to break down complex and ambiguous challenges into practical, actionable solutions.
* Strong executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
* Experience developing business cases, investment recommendations, and executive-ready decision materials.
* Proven ability to balance strategic vision with operational execution.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA, Master's degree, or other advanced degree from a leading institution.
* Experience in management consulting, technology consulting, or digital transformation environments.
* Experience working in financial services or other highly regulated industries.
* Experience with workforce analytics, workforce planning, talent strategy, organizational effectiveness, or HR technology.
* Familiarity with Workday, people data ecosystems, and HR operating models.
* Exposure to model risk management, responsible AI governance, and enterprise AI deployment practices.

description:

Contributes to standards around which others will operate. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the entire function.
