Has responsibility for volume, quality, timeliness and delivery of end results of an area. May have responsibility for planning, budgeting and policy formulation within area of expertise. Involved in short-term planning resource planning. Full management responsibility of a team, which may include management of people, budget and planning, to include duties such as performance evaluation, compensation, hiring, disciplinary and terminations and may include budget approval.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area.
* Employs developed communication and diplomacy skills in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular, colleagues in other areas and occasionally external entities.
* Resolves occasionally complex and highly variable issues.
* Produces detailed analysis of issues where the best course of action is not evident from the information available, but actions must be recommended/taken.
* Responsible for volume, quality, timeliness and delivery of data science projects along with short-term planning resource planning.
* Oversees management of people, budget and planning, to include duties such as performance evaluation, compensation, hiring, disciplinary action and terminations and may include budget approval.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.

**Recommended**
**Qualifications:**

* 6-10 years experience using tools for analysis of large data sets

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience, potentially Masters degree

The Lead Business Analyst & PMO Lead (Data Analytics) – Vice President (VP / C13) is a dual-capability leadership role combining senior program management (PMO), deep business analysis, strategic stakeholder communication, and advanced data analytics expertise.
  
  
This role serves as the central operational engine and strategic bridge between business executives, Markets Line of Business (LoB), Finance, Technology, Risk & Control (R&C), and Internal Audit (IA). The incumbent is responsible for governing the multi-million-dollar program portfolio across internal Project Tracking Systems (PTS), while possessing the deep technical and analytical acumen to step directly into the shoes of a Lead Business Analyst—driving hands-on requirement authoring, complex data lineage mapping, data analytics, and reconciliation framework delivery for major mandates, and Authorized Redistributor Control Onboarding (200+ Applications).
  
  
Comprehensive PTS Management: Maintain total governance and accountability for all program entities, project charters, milestones, deliverables, financials, and resource allocations within the enterprise Project Tracking System (PTS).

Executive Program Reporting: Design and distribute high-impact program dashboards, Executive SteerCo packs, and Key Risk/Performance Indicators (KRIs/KPIs) to Senior Managing Directors and Business Heads.
  
  
Reconciliation & Exception Engineering Oversight: Direct the functional design of complex multi-way matching engines, automated break classification models, and exception triage workflows on enterprise recon platforms (e.g., Internal Tools, TLM, Duco).
  
  
Executive-Level Stakeholder Management: Serve as the strategic communication partner to senior leadership across Front/Middle Office, Product Engineering, Operations, and Quantitative teams.
  
  
Direct Team Leadership: Supervise, mentor, and develop a team of 6–10 Business Analysts, Project Managers, and Data Analysts, cultivating both functional depth and analytical rigor.

description:
**About Us**

AQ Energy, the rooftop solar division of AvalonQuad Engineering and Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd., designs and installs rooftop solar systems for homes, apartments, and commercial and industrial customers across Tamil Nadu. We handle the complete journey: survey, design, PM Surya Ghar subsidy, net-metering, installation and after-sales service.

**About the Role**

This is an office-based role at our Anna Nagar, Chennai office. You will be the customer's main point of contact from first enquiry to installation, subsidy credit and after-sales service, converting leads into orders and keeping every project moving. Site visits are handled by our technical team; you coordinate them from the office.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales and lead management**

* Respond to enquiries from calls, WhatsApp, social media, website and referrals within the same working day
* Maintain the lead register, qualify leads and follow up regularly to convert them into orders
* Schedule site surveys and customer meetings with the technical team
* Prepare quotations and techno-commercial proposals as per approved pricing
* Explain system sizing, savings, subsidy and financing options to residential and commercial customers
* Support B2B and channel partner enquiries from builders, apartments, commercial and industrial customers
* Achieve monthly sales and lead-conversion targets

**Subsidy, documentation and approvals**

* Register and process customer applications on the PM Surya Ghar portal and follow up until the subsidy is credited
* Coordinate net-metering and feasibility approvals with TANGEDCO / TNPDCL and track each application to completion
* Collect and verify customer documents (EB bill, ID, bank details, property proof) and maintain a complete file for each project
* Coordinate solar loan applications with banks and NBFCs
* Obtain DCR certificates, warranty cards and compliance documents from suppliers

**Operations and project coordination**

* Coordinate material orders, dispatch and delivery with suppliers and the stores team
* Plan installation schedules with installation teams and keep customers updated on progress
* Ensure installation, commissioning and handover documents are completed and signed
* Follow up on customer payments as per milestones and share updates with accounts
* Log and track after-sales service requests and AMC visits until closed

**Marketing and reporting**

* Support social media, digital marketing, local promotions and solar expos
* Collect customer testimonials, referrals and Google reviews after installation
* Share a daily activity update and a weekly report on leads, conversions, applications and installations
* Maintain all customer and project records in Excel / CRM

**What We're Looking For**

* Any graduate; Electrical/EEE, Business or Marketing background is a plus
* Minimum 2 years of experience in solar sales, solar project coordination, or a similar sales and documentation role
* Hands-on knowledge of the PM Surya Ghar portal and TNPDCL net-metering process preferred
* Fluent in Tamil and English, with clear phone and WhatsApp communication
* Comfortable with Excel and email; CRM experience is a plus
* Organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple customer files at once

**What We Offer**

* Salary: Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 30,000 per month, plus incentives on conversions
* Exposure to the complete rooftop solar project cycle
* Growth opportunity in an expanding solar business

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

title: AI Migration Lead
description:
**Job Title: AI Migration Lead**
If you’re looking to take an exciting new direction with your HSBC career, an internal move can open the door to many opportunities, allowing you to take on a new challenge, and develop your skills. Bring your knowledge of our brand to a new role and grow yourself further.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of ‘AI Migration Lead’ -
**this role may be based in Bangalore, Gurgaon, Hyderabad or Kolkata.**
This is a pivotal leadership role at the heart of the R&C AI agenda, turning strategy into action and accelerating the delivery of AI-driven outcomes across the organisation. As AI Enablement Lead, you’ll lead the central AI Migration team, connecting deep business expertise with agentic AI delivery and enabling Value Streams to move from ambition to impact at pace.
  
  
A move across the business allows you to continue to access tailored professional development opportunities, and our fantastic benefits packages.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own the R&C AI portfolio strategy and prioritisation, working closely with the R&C CAIO to translate top-down strategy and target outcomes into an executable, portfolio-level roadmap. Aggregate value and delivery progress from across Value Streams to portfolio level, and instrument the relevant benefit metrics (efficiency & capacity, adoption & maturity) feeding the R&C CAIO's overall benefit-tracking framework.
* Own the prioritisation and escalation mechanism across Value Streams: chair a regular portfolio prioritisation forum with Value Stream Product Owners and Value Stream AI Leads, and escalate unresolved conflicts to the R&C CAIO. Lead the AI Migration team: a central, flexible technical pool deployed into Value Streams on a solid-line basis to this role, with a dotted-line working relationship into the Value Stream while deployed.
* Ensure the AI Migration team operates as the bridge between business SMEs and agentic architecture translating and migrating manual or semi-manual tasks into governed, agentic and automated workflows. Partner with Group Technology and the Group AI Platform function, including the Architecture Lead capability, to ensure portfolio delivery aligns to Group tooling, platform and architecture standards.
* Partner with the Re-engineering team and the Knowledge Management Enablement Lead as shared capabilities supporting the migration agenda. Enable, R&C Value Streams Product Owners and Leads to deliver against set targets.

**To Be Successful You Will**

* Technical leadership: Background in analytics, data, engineering, AI or a closely related technical discipline, with credibility to lead multidisciplinary technical delivery teams. Able to challenge technical approaches, delivery plans, dependencies and trade-offs with credibility.
* AI-enabled process transformation: Demonstrable experience re-engineering complex business processes and translating them into automation or AI-enabled solutions, ideally within Risk, Compliance, Financial Crime or Controls. Scaled technical delivery: Proven experience leading multiple technical pods across concurrent delivery streams, bringing together engineering, product, data/AI and business SMEs to deliver complex outcomes. Portfolio ownership and prioritisation: Experience owning and prioritising a portfolio of AI, automation or technology opportunities, making decisions across competing demands based on value, feasibility, risk, dependencies and delivery capacity.
* Agentic AI delivery: Strong practical understanding of agentic AI delivery models, with experience translating business problems into AI use cases and working with engineering teams to move solutions from concept into delivery and adoption. Forward-deployed engineering: Experience of, or strong exposure to, forward-deployed engineering approaches, where technical teams work directly with business SMEs to understand complex workflows and rapidly translate problems into deployable solutions.
* Risk & Compliance: Strong experience operating with senior stakeholders in Risk & Compliance or a comparable regulated financial services environment, with an understanding of the governance, risk and control considerations surrounding AI delivery. Strategy through execution: Demonstrable ability to operate at both portfolio and technical delivery level, translating AI strategy into a prioritised delivery agenda while remaining sufficiently close to execution to challenge, unblock and accelerate delivery.

title: Tech S and T- Tech Strategy - Senior consultant-GDSF04
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Strategy Consultant**
**THE OPPORTUNITY:**
EY's Technology Strategy & Transformation (TST) team is at the forefront of delivering cutting-edge consulting and advisory services to some of the largest enterprises across the globe. Our technology practice is recognized by industry analysts as a leader in leveraging business and technology to drive strategic business-led, tech-enabled e2e transformation. We serve clients across all major industries and work with organizations of different sizes, helping guide them to achieve business success while delivering strategic IT value.
  
  
**Scope of engagements**
We are currently seeking experienced, seasoned IT Strategy practitioners who can be positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and customer to devise creative new strategies based on trends, insights and data. We are looking for folks who have experience in advising clients to …
  
  

* reset, reimagine and re-think their business and operating models with tech-enabled, cutting-edge solutions that re-energize performance across the enterprise
* set and drive enterprise tech vision and strategy in alignment with corporate / business unit strategy, customer focus and solution teams
* drive increased value from technology spend with focus on optimizing cost, agility, productivity and performance

We work with clients to address issues of importance to the Chief Information Officer (CIO) and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) in creating value and delivering world-class IT capabilities to support futuristic business needs. Working closely with our industry groups and leveraging the Ernst & Young brand as independent, trusted advisors, we provide our high-profile clients with range of services including:
  
  

* Tech Strategy & Vision
* IT Operating Model optimization
* 3/5-year Transformation strategy, roadmaps & blueprints
* Office of CIO functions (IT Finance, Sourcing, Project Portfolio Mgt. etc)
* Product strategy & management
* M&A due-diligence, planning and post integration/separation
* Enterprise Architecture Services

**Key responsibilities of candidate include:**

* Understanding the business strategy & vision and translating them into enterprise-wide technology vision & strategy in alignment with strategic priorities for growth, customer experience, efficiency etc.
* Analyze value chain and business capabilities to develop clear understanding of strategic objectives, KPI’s, processes and underlying systems that deliver the business outcomes
* Assess the impact of the business strategy on business capability model and business processes to identify optimization opportunities (through tech-enabled solutions) across organization, systems, data, infrastructure and applications
* Have strong experience in analysing business models, business model innovation/ incubation, and experience in one or more of the following areas preferred: Market Strategy, Pricing/ Monetization, Finance, Ecosystem Management, and/ or Product Management
* Ability to analyse client’s (IT) Operating Model including the organization structure, processes and governance while developing recommendations and/or creating actionable roadmaps
* Significant experience in: 1) developing business capability model for the enterprise; 2) analysing enterprise-wide portfolio of systems / platforms and 3) function as guardian of the transformation strategy and business architecture to make sure that new initiatives comply with strategic priorities
* Solid experience in guiding our clients through large, enterprise-wide transformation to implement their strategies and business architecture. Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the IT strategic and improvement agenda
* Be a trusted advisor on 'innovation' with ability to frame key business and technology trends within the context of the client's objectives. Ability to identify the potential implications and impacts of the associated trends.
* Leverage EY’s global network, and leverage the cross-functional expertise to develop relevant architecture insights

**Within the team, your role will include the following additional responsibilities:**

* Ability to lead conversations with the client stakeholders. Strong communication skills as the profile requires interactions with CIO, CEO, CFO and other senior leadership
* Build and develop trusted relationships as a strategic technology advisor with clients and work internally across EY advisory teams to bring our clients the most comprehensive, end-to-end services and effectively address their business challenges.
* Building and growing TST Strategy practice, developing and maintaining client relationships, and selling and delivering work as an engagement leader or Subject Matter Specialist.
* Develop thought leadership and define approaches to provide structured solutions to complex technology strategy problems of clients, by recombining existing methodologies and teams
* Managing engagement teams and providing leadership in the assessment, design, and management of successful Business - IT transformation engagements in collaboration with our clients. They should provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing EY leadership of engagement status, and managing staff performance
* Help recruit, develop and retain strategy professionals, coach and mentor team members, deliver architecture-related training and take on other practice management tasks as needed (e.g., development of practice offerings)
* Should be very good at using various tools (Such as Word, Excel, Powerpoint, visualization tools, MS-Project, etc.)
* Would support in developing new solution offerings, tools and knowledge repositories
* People skill has worked independently on projects or as part of small consulting teams
* Should be self-driven and organized person with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high pressure environment
* Should have experience in pursuit teams including conceptualizing propositions and presenting solutions to client
* Create expert content for point-of-view and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C-Level discussions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Strong academic background with BE/B.tech and MBA from top Tier-1 B-schools
* A background in Strategy Consulting (in top tier consulting firms), with 5+ years of relevant experience in large-scale, enterprise-wide transformations
* Min. of 5+ years of specific industry / sector experience through completed client engagements related to business transformation. Should have experience in any one or two industry sectors such as Financial services, Retail, Healthcare/Pharma, Telecom, e-commerce, etc.
* Demonstrated experience of driving business workshops as well as conducting deep-dive technology workshops to collaboratively develop transformation vision, strategy, roadmaps and blueprints
* Experience with assessing maturity of IT operating models & organizations structure to determine optimization opportunities. Should understand IT - business alignment, IT strategy and planning, development of current and future state IT architecture, roadmaps, IT/Digital maturity assessment, etc.
* Experience with large transformation related to customer experience, process re-engineering, digital, cloud, automation, AI/ML/advanced analytics, next-gen / emerging tech (IoT, blockchain, virtual twins etc).
* Conducting research and analyses of operational effectiveness, processes, stakeholders, etc., creating end-to-end visibility into how the organization executes their operations today and identifying systemic issues impacting business performance
* Should have experience in designing and managing an effective IT governance framework across the spectrum of IT service delivery
* Should be able to analyze data and translate findings into meaningful insights, integrating relevant business knowledge
* Should have knowledge about or exposure to areas such as IT Service Management and Governance, Agile methodologies, Data visualization, Cloud technologies, emerging technologies

**The following are preferred, but not required:**

* Advanced business and/or technology degrees from tier-1 schools (MBA, Masters)
* Experience in presenting directly to the C-Suite and explain complex concepts to anyone from an intern to a CFO, CHRO or CMO
* Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the strategic and improvement agenda.
* Speaking at industry conferences, round tables, and other public forums
* Authoring articles and white papers
* Business / technology innovation experience with emerging tech solutions leveraging power of combinatorial technologies AI/ML, Data Automation, Blockchain, IoT, etc
* Exposure across key technology domains is preferred (application, data, DevOps, infrastructure, cloud, network. security etc)
* Demonstrated capability to drive sales and bring a network of client relationships to the firm
* Relevant industry certification (e.g., TOGAF Biz Architect, Business Process Framework (eTOM Practitioner of TMForum), AWS Cloud Certified etc.).

**Overall Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Understanding of the current IT environment and industry IT trends to identify the engagement and client service issues.
* Ability to act as day-to-day client contact on the project engagement; run client status and other client meetings and deliver executive-level presentations that drive actions and decisions.
* Proven delivery skills including the ability to scope/size a project; staff a team with the appropriate skill set; provide subject matter direction and guidance to a team; and manage the delivery of an engagement.
* Ability to identify opportunities and help generate sell-on work during client engagements by understanding a range services and offerings and coordinating with personnel in other service lines to help sell integrated solutions that meet client needs.
* Experience in creating points of view on relevant industry trends, solutions, methodologies, and analytical frameworks and tools to bring strategic perspectives to existing solutions.
* Experience in managing a portfolio of executive level clients and developing long-term trusted advisor relationships.
* Experience in building strong teams with a solid understanding of project management, industry content knowledge, and effective client communications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Program Manager III, Transportation Financial Systems (TFS)
description: DescriptionTransportation Financial Systems (TFS) team is looking for a talented and highly motivated Sr. Program Manager who enjoy solving challenging and complex business problems at Amazon scale.Imagine being a part of a team where every single team member is a critical voice in the decision-making process, has a meaningful impact on product features, and has the ability to re-define the customer experience. Welcome to Transportation Financial Systems (TFS), where we are building multiple financial automation products and functionalities to meet Amazon’s ever-growing finance and accounting customer requirements. You will be in a well-funded, highly technical, and highly visible business critical tech platform team.We are a technology team focused on building a suite of products for transportation financial systems and beyond that enable Amazon business units (BUs) to add new offerings at scale. Our products abstract complexities from the world of accounting, invoicing, audit, payment, taxation, and allocation at the required level of fidelity and insights to build generic solutions scalable to multiple businesses and geographies. We ensure that financial functions are complete, accurate, timely and compliant with worldwide regulatory and tax requirements. Our software systems include services that handle thousands or requests per second and make decisions to pay billions of dollars a year and ensure that transportation's liabilities and revenues are correctly accounted. Our current team comprises of ~200+ engineering organization and Program management team of 10+ TPMs and Program Managers with great growth and lateral opportunity.We are looking for a high caliber Senior Program Manager (Sr. PM) who enjoy working on challenging, high impact business problems. The Sr. PM will manage business onboarding to our systems and services, prioritize opportunities in tech systems /process flows and support the functional systems to deliver to defined goals. Successful candidates will be analytical, highly-organized, accustomed to working with technical teams, able to bridge the gap between business and tech, clear communicators, and interested in getting deep into the details of our business. This Program Manager is a high visible role as s/he will front end with Senior Leaders across Amazon Organization.Key job responsibilitiesAs a Sr. PM on the team, you would be responsible for understanding the functional flow of TFS onboarded businesses and key TFS capabilities, required to enable transport finance processes (account payables and receivables) and identifying opportunities to refine both. The Sr. PM will manage the auditing, invoicing, payments products and process with a team of SMEs in TFS and partner teams, identify short term solutions and work with Product/SDM on long term solutions to customer problems. The Sr. PM will evaluate self-serve opportunities to reduce overhead load on TFS, document dashboard or tool requirements and present to TFS Tech team to build consensus for solutions to self-serve on commonly occurring issues. The program manager will work closely with Product/SDM to define the road map. Key responsibilities - Define and manage cross-functional program strategy, including mission, vision, objectives, and measurable success criteria, while driving teams across organizations to deliver on key milestones. Analyze data to identify trends, drive improvements, and inform resource allocation decisions — regularly reviewing metrics and proactively seeking new mechanisms for visibility into program health. Lead stakeholder alignment through clear written narratives and verbal communication, presenting program updates, trade-offs, and recommendations to senior leadership. Identify and mitigate risks proactively, reduce exposure to common failure modes such as unclear requirements or ineffective cross-team collaboration, and solve ambiguous problems with sound judgment. Streamline processes and eliminate unnecessary dependencies, partnering with engineering and business teams to prioritize initiatives that improve efficiency and customer outcomes.A day in the lifeTFS has over 200+ engineers, and 20+ product & program managers. Each Program Manager is responsible for delivering large to medium programs; working closely with business teams and product, building transformation roadmaps to deliver long term benefits for our customers.About The TeamTransportation Financial Systems (TFS) platform owns the technology components that perform the financial activities for Amazon’s transportation business. TFS systems are used across all Amazon’s transportation programs and retail expansion to new geographies. The platform provide financial document creation & management, expense auditing, accounting, payments and cost allocation functions. Our new generation products are highly scalable and operate at finer level granularity to reconcile every dollar in transportation financial accounts with zero manual entries or corrections. The goal is to develop global product suite for all freight modes touching every single package movement across Amazon. description:

Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
As a Senior Salesforce Project Manager, you will lead, orchestrate, and own the end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-cloud enterprise Salesforce implementations using Agile methodologies, SAFe frameworks, and modern, AI-enabled delivery practices. You will be directly accountable for delivery excellence across highly visible global accounts, program-level financial performance, strategic governance, and C-suite stakeholder alignment, operating with a mature business-owner, consultative, and customer-first mindset.
  
  
This role requires advanced strategic thinking, exceptional executive presence, and a proven track record of hands-on delivery leadership to turn around complex Salesforce programs, maximise project margins, mitigate systemic risks, and scale best-in-class delivery practices across the organisation.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* AI-First Delivery & Agentic Productivity Strategy: Champion and strategically scale the adoption of authorized AI technologies and prompt engineering across your delivery teams. Actively utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation, eliminate operational friction and compress overall project delivery timelines.
* Performance Evaluation & ROI: "Collaborate with customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance for their specific use cases."

Own financial performance at the program level—managing macro-scope, multi-track timelines, systemic risks, and cross-project dependencies while driving high-quality business outcomes and aggressively protecting Sold vs. Delivered margins.
* Scale Agile & Delivery Leadership: Champion and institutionalize Agile delivery architectures using Scrum, Lean, and SAFe frameworks. Drive multi-track sprint execution, rigorous backlog prioritization, predictive flow metrics, and foster high-performing, self-organizing, cross-functional global delivery squads.
* Strategic Planning & Portfolio Roadmap Management: Architect and govern integrated portfolio plans and long-term delivery roadmaps. Ensure transparent, data-driven progress reporting, proactive macro-risk visibility, and complex technical dependency management across the global engagement lifecycle.
* C-Suite & Executive Stakeholder Management: Serve as trusted advisor to senior leaders. Drive alignment across global organizations through executive communication, steering committees, and proactive escalation management.
* Quality Governance & Institutional Excellence: Design and enforce delivery governance, engineering standards, and quality benchmarks. Implement quality checkpoints to ensure compliance and continuous improvement.
* Strategic Resource & Capital Optimization: Orchestrate and optimize multi-shore resource demand planning, manage complex program budgets, accurate forecasts, and financial reconciliation while engineering mitigation strategies for structural delivery risks.
* Global Synchronisation & Timezone Flexibility: Maintain the structural timezone flexibility required to ensure seamless synchronisation, seamless governance, and executive support across global delivery regions (AMER/EMEA/APAC).

**You're Our Person If...**

* 15+ years of total experience in the IT consulting/services industry, with 8+ years of dedicated experience leading complex, enterprise-scale Salesforce implementations.
* Proven track record managing multi-cloud, highly integrated Salesforce transformations across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and/or specialised Industry Clouds.
* Advanced, practical proficiency with AI-augmented productivity suites and LLMs (e.g., Gemini, NotebookLM) alongside a clear, actionable vision for applying an Agentic Delivery approach to project tracking, documentation, and risk forecasting.
* Deep, authoritative understanding of the Salesforce ecosystem architecture and delivery lifecycle, with a demonstrated history of collaborating with Enterprise Architects and Technical Leads to map technical scope to business outcomes (hands-on configuration is not required).
* Stellar executive presence with a demonstrated ability to communicate clearly, confidently, and assertively with C-suite executives, global sponsors, and enterprise steering committees.
* Salesforce Core Consultant Certifications (at least two or higher-tier equivalent):Sales Cloud ConsultantService Cloud ConsultantExperience Cloud Consultant
* Advanced Project / Scaled Agile Management Certification (at least one):PMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe Practice Consultant (SPC), SAFe Agilist, PRINCE2 Practitioner, or Senior Scrum Master credentials (CSM, PSM II).
* Expert-level command over modern enterprise project management, portfolio tracking, and collaboration platforms such as JIRA, Azure DevOps (ADO), MS Project, Smart sheet, and Google Workspace.
* Flexibility and willingness to travel internationally or domestically on a need basis.

**Even Better If...**

* Extensive experience delivering localised or global Salesforce transformations within highly regulated sectors: Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS), Financial Services (Fins), or Consumer Goods / Retail Cloud.
* Strong functional awareness of data streaming and mid-tier enterprise connectivity strategies, including MuleSoft, Salesforce Data Cloud, and real-time, event-driven architectures.
* Salesforce Agentforce Specialist or Legend certifications, with a proven playbook for managing and delivering Agentforce-enabled autonomous AI agent work-streams.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*

*do your best*

We are looking for a
**manager**
to support our US Advanced Analytics team. Robust analytics is a priority for our businesses, as the product potential has major implications to a wide range of disciplines. * Lead marketing and sales-related problem-solving activities, leveraging AI/ML techniques

**Stakeholder Management**

* Work collaboratively with the stakeholder teams to prioritize work and ensure timely delivery of requests
* Partner with marketing, media, and commercial stakeholders to answer key business questions and support strategic decision making

**Technical Skills**

* Expert in end-to-end delivery of Marketing Mix Modelling projects
* Proficiency in statistical concepts like hypothesis testing, regression analysis, time series analysis, and probability theory
* Understanding of mathematical concepts like linear algebra, calculus, and optimization
* Expertise in machine learning algorithms (supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning)
* Experience with data mining techniques like clustering, classification, and association rule mining
* Knowledge of feature engineering, model selection, and hyperparameter tuning
* Fluency in programming languages like Python (with libraries like NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch)
* Ability to write efficient and clean code for data manipulation, analysis, and model development
* Strong analytical skills to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies in data
* Ability to break down complex problems into smaller, manageable steps
* A curious and inquisitive mindset to explore data and discover new insights
* Strong project management abilities; capable of prioritizing and leading multiple projects simultaneously
* Working experience of Python and SQL
* Excellent planning, design, project management and documentation skills
* Excellent management of customer expectations, listening, and multi-tasking skills.
* Experience with US pharmaceutical datasets (e.g. IQVIA, Symphony, Komodo, Veeva, Salesforce)
* An aptitude for problem solving and strategic thinking
* Ability to synthesize complex information into clear and actionable insights
* Proven ability to work effectively across all levels of stakeholders and diverse functions
* Solid understanding of pharmaceutical development, manufacturing, supply chain, sales and marketing functions

**Good-to-have Skills**

* Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure and knowledge of cloud-based data services and tools.
* Experience with machine learning operations, including model deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
* Understanding of data pipelines, data warehousing, and data lakes.
* Proficiency in data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Python libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
* Proficiency with Generative AI tools and prompt engineering - Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI platforms to support analytical tasks and data-driven solutions.

**Experience –**
6+ years of relevant work experience, including at least 1+ years of direct people management or team leadership experience with solid understanding of principles, standards, and best practices of Pharma Commercial Analytics, including Business Analytics

Bachelors or Masters degree in areas such as Information Science/Operations/ Management/Statistics/Decision Sciences/Engineering/Life Sciences/ Business Analytics or related field

Strong learning agility; Ability to manage ambiguous environments, and to adapt to changing needs of the business; Good interpersonal and communication skills; strong presentation skills is a must; Team player who is curious, dynamic, result oriented; Ability to operate effectively in an international matrix environment, with ability to work across time zones; Demonstrated leadership and management in driving innovation and automation leveraging advanced analytical techniques

title: Senior Principal AI/Data Science Engineer
description: Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.A Day in the LifeWe are seeking a Senior Principal AI/Data Science Engineer with strong AI Solutions Engineering and Forward Deployed Engineering capabilities to accelerate the design, validation, productization, deployment, and adoption of AI-enabled healthcare solutions across AI Labs programs and pillars.This is a hands-on, stakeholder-facing technical leadership role. The individual will work directly with operating units, product teams, domain experts, and engineering organizations to understand ambiguous business and clinical problems, rapidly develop solution approaches, embed with delivery teams, and translate successful prototypes into secure, reliable, and scalable production solutions.The role combines AI/Data Science solution engineering with full-stack development, frontend and backend engineering, cloud platforms, enterprise integration, data engineering, MLOps, and end-to-end DevSecOps. Working knowledge of Generative AI is preferred and will support emerging requirements involving RAG, AI Agents, copilots, intelligent workflows, and AI-assisted product experiences.The position will serve as a technical bridge between AI innovation and real-world execution, strengthening delivery velocity, solution adoption, engineering governance, and the sustainable execution capacity of AI Labs at MEIC.A Day in the LifeAs a Senior Principal AI/Data Science Engineer, you will: Engage directly with operating units, product leaders, clinicians, domain experts, and engineering teams to identify high-value problems and convert them into actionable AI solution opportunities. Operate as a Forward Deployed Engineer by embedding stakeholders and delivery teams, rapidly understanding workflows, data, constraints, and success measures, and driving solutions from discovery through adoption. Lead technical discovery, requirements clarification, feasibility assessments, solution framing, rapid prototyping, demonstrations, and iterative stakeholder validation. Architect and build end-to-end AI-enabled applications spanning user experiences, frontend applications, backend services, APIs, data pipelines, cloud services, model integration, and enterprise systems. Convert proofs of concept and research into secure, maintainable, validated, and production-ready solutions. Collaborate with Data Scientists and AI Engineers to integrate machine learning, computer vision, NLP, analytics, and GenAI capabilities into usable products and workflows. Design reusable solution patterns, reference architectures, accelerators, and platform components that can be scaled across AI Labs programs and pillars. Establish DevSecOps and MLOps practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, deployment, monitoring, observability, and release governance. Build stakeholder confidence through clear technical communication, working demonstrations, trade-off discussions, implementation plans, and measurable outcome tracking. Troubleshoot complex issues across applications, data, model, cloud, security, and integration layers. Support GenAI use cases including knowledge assistants, RAG-based applications, AI Agents, Agentic AI workflows, copilots, semantic search, and intelligent automation where appropriate. Ensure solutions align with cybersecurity, privacy, responsible AI, quality, regulatory, and enterprise architecture expectations. Mentor engineers, ESP resources, and development partners while raising engineering quality and delivery maturity.Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:AI Solutions Engineering Own the technical solution lifecycle from opportunity discovery and problem definition through architecture, implementation, validation, deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement. Translate business, clinical, product, and operational needs into solution designs, technical requirements, delivery plans, and measurable success criteria. Develop production-oriented AI applications that combine models, data, software, user experience, and enterprise integrations. Create rapid prototypes and demonstrations to validate feasibility, usability, workflow fit, and stakeholder value before scaling.Forward Deployed Engineering Embed with stakeholder teams during critical phases to understand real-world workflows, constraints, data availability, and adoption barriers. Structure undefined problems, identify the shortest path to value, and iterate using direct stakeholder feedback. Configure, integrate, and adapt AI platforms and reusable capabilities to meet program-specific needs without creating unsustainable one-off solutions. Lead technical workshops, solution walkthroughs, demonstrations, pilots, and deployment-readiness discussions. Capture field learnings and convert them into reusable patterns, platform improvements, documentation, and roadmap inputs.Full-Stack, Platform & Integration Engineering Lead the design and development of responsive web applications, workflow tools, dashboards, backend services, APIs, and microservices. Design modular, cloud-native architectures that support extensibility, interoperability, performance, reliability, and reuse. Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, data platforms, authentication services, and operational workflows. Apply strong software engineering practices covering design patterns, code quality, testing, version control, documentation, and technical debt management.AI, Data Science, MLOps & GenAI Enablement Operationalize predictive models, computer vision, NLP, analytics, and optimization capabilities. Enable model serving, inference, API integration, experiment tracking, evaluation, monitoring, drift detection, and lifecycle management. Support implementation of RAG, semantic search, vector databases, prompt orchestration, AI Agents, Agentic AI, copilots, and knowledge assistants. Contribute to GenAI evaluation, guardrails, observability, security, responsible AI, human oversight, and governance patterns.DevSecOps & Production Excellence Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, infrastructure as code, containerized deployment, environment management, and release automation. Integrate security scanning, quality controls, traceability, monitoring, logging, telemetry, and observability throughout the lifecycle. Drive operational readiness, incident troubleshooting, performance optimization, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.Technical Leadership & Program Enablement Serve as a senior technical anchor for complex AI solution engagements across AI Labs programs and pillars. title: Senior Director / Director - RIM Strategy
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
  
  
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
  
  
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
  
  
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
  
  
The Role
  
  
In the Indian pharmaceutical industry, majority of the top 30 organizations are revising their product portfolio to include complex generics, biologicals, biosimilars etc. They are also expanding into high-value therapy areas such as oncology, cardiology, immunology which contribute significantly in saving human lives. These customers are revisiting their go-to-market strategy to expand their presence in markets beyond US such as like Europe, LATAM, Japan and so on.
  
  
These changes demand a proven unified RIM system in place which can provide a robust data model for the regulatory data, manage/track registrations, handle submissions and health-authority interactions and perform publishing activities.
  
  
The Regulatory Strategy (Sr.) Director builds strong relationships with stakeholders, guides the regulatory and IT leaders on the successful transition & adoption to new ways of working and also guides them on the ways to realise exceptional value from Veeva RIM.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and implement the strategy for Veeva RIM suite of applications, customized to meet the unique needs of the Indian market, while driving broad adoption and usage across both large and small customers in India.
* Engage proactively with customers to ensure their success with our products.
* Win customers seeking robust and unified RIM suite by understanding and clearly communicating Veeva RIM suite value through process improvement as well as business metrics such as speed-to-market, right-first-time and operational excellence.
* Collaborate closely with all internal teams—Product, Services, Solution Consulting, Sales —both locally and globally, to evolve our offerings and maximize the value they deliver to customers.
* Identify opportunities for expansion and work with marketing and sales teams to define strategies to capture these customers.
* Own the growth plans and pricing strategies for our products in India.

**Requirements**

* Around 15 year’s experience working in India or global pharma industry either directly in or as a solution provider/consultant to the life sciences industry
* Understanding of Regulatory business processes and technology in the Life Sciences industry
* CEO mentality to drive outcomes internally and externally. Stays focused on results and drives execution among the team. Able to work with autonomy and adapt to change.
* Ability to critically think and develop a strategy and execution plan across all areas of business (Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Consulting, etc...)
* Excellent spoken, written, presentation skills in English
* Has a purposeful vision about helping the pharma industry deploy innovative digital solutions to solve critical issues

****Nice to Have****

* Has worked on overseas assignments in Europe or US
* Worked with a software or systems integration company, either as an employee or part of a project
* Has worked with Veeva software
* Has worked on global teams on projects related to business or IT transformation

**Perks & Benefits**

* Health & wellness programs
* Life Assurance
* Veeva charitable giving program
* Additional annual leave over Christmas break

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
  
  
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

title: Digital Strategy Director
description:
**Job Title:**
Head of Creative Strategy

**About the role**

We are looking for a senior creative strategist to lead our 20-member digital marketing team and to be the face of the agency for our clients. You will set the strategic and creative direction for large Indian corporate brands, own CMO-level relationships, and lead the campaigns, films and content that represent the agency's best work. Day-to-day servicing stays with the client servicing team. You will be the point of strategic engagement and the point of escalation for every client.

This role suits someone who has built award-winning integrated digital campaigns, can write as well as they can lead, and wants to grow an agency through new ideas and new business.

**Key responsibilities**

*Leadership and team*

* Lead, mentor and inspire a 20-member digital marketing team.
* Work with the creative team of 10+ (copy, art, motion and video) to produce original creative work that sets a new standard for the agency.
* Build a culture of high standards, clear feedback and continuous learning.
* Work well with every department in the agency, from client servicing to media and production.

*Client strategy and relationships*

* Act as the senior strategic contact for all clients and handle escalations.
* Own CMO-level relationships at large brands independently.
* Find sharp consumer and category insights, and turn them into brand communication pillars and campaign platforms that drive business results.
* Advise clients across the full digital marketing funnel, including content, influencer marketing and paid media.

*Creative and campaigns*

* Lead the concept and creative direction for integrated digital campaigns from brief to launch.
* Write and review copy across formats, from campaign lines and scripts to social content.
* Push for high-quality art direction and motion design, with a keen eye for current visual trends.
* Use generative AI tools across creative formats (copy, visuals, video and motion) to improve speed, quality and range of work.

*Films and produced content*

* Own end-to-end delivery of films, digital video content (DVCs) and produced content, from ideation and scripting to final delivery.
* Brief, select and manage production houses, directors and post-production partners, keeping work on time and on budget.

*New business and agency growth*

* Lead pitches from brief to final presentation, including strategy, creative and the presentation itself.
* Bring proactive ideas to existing clients to grow the business with them.
* Convert inbound leads into new clients, working with leadership on proposals and pitches.

**What we are looking for**

*Must have*

* A proven record of creating original, award-winning integrated digital campaigns.
* Strong copywriting ability.
* A sharp analytical mind alongside strong creative judgement.
* A full understanding of the digital marketing funnel, including influencer marketing and paid media.
* Experience handling CMO-level relationships independently at large brands.
* Experience in regulated industries such as BFSI and pharma, including working within compliance and approval processes.
* Hands-on experience delivering films and DVCs end to end with production houses.
* A track record of anchoring and winning pitches.
* Practical, regular use of generative AI tools in creative work.
* Excellent communication and people skills, with clients and within the agency.

*Good to have*

* Experience in an independent or mid-sized agency serving large Indian corporates.
* A portfolio that shows both strategic thinking and finished creative output.

**What success looks like in the first year**

* Clients see you as their main strategic partner, and escalations reach you early and get resolved quickly.
* The agency's creative work and award entries get noticeably stronger.
* Existing clients are giving the agency more business, and the agency is winning a steady share of the pitches it takes on.

title: Rolling Mills PLM
description:
**John Cockerill, enablers of opportunities**

Driven since 1817 by the entrepreneurial spirit and thirst for innovation of its founder, the John Cockerill Group develops large-scale technological solutions to meet the needs of its time: facilitating access to low carbon energies, enabling sustainable industrial production, preserving natural resources, contributing to greener mobility, enhancing security and installing essential infrastructures.

Its offer to businesses, governments and communities consists of services and associated equipment for the sectors of energy, defence, industry, the environment, transports, and infrastructures. With over 6,000 employees, John Cockerill achieved a turnover of € 1,209 billion in 2023 in 29 countries, on 5 continents.

**Role: Rolling MIlls PLM**

  

**Location: Belgium**

  

**Introduction**

We are looking for a senior technology-oriented professional capable of combining strong industrial and engineering expertise with a strategic understanding of products, markets and customer needs.
  
The successful candidate will contribute to strengthening and developing our technology portfolio by identifying opportunities for innovation, improving the technical and economic competitiveness of existing solutions, and supporting the development of new concepts in response to evolving market requirements.

The role requires a broad understanding of metals processing technologies and the ability to work at the interface between sales, process, mechanical and electrical engineering, automation, metallurgy and project execution. The candidate should be able to assess technologies not only from a purely technical perspective, but also in terms of performance, reliability, investment cost, lifecycle value, differentiation and market positioning.

**A strong background in cold rolling technologies is required, focused on reversing mills for Carbon steel, specific knowledges and experience in tandems mills and/or PLTCM is a must. Experience with advanced steel grades, HSS and electrical steels would bring high value.**

**Knowledge of rolling process parameters and modelling, as well as familiarity with the main international technology suppliers and competitors, would further strengthen the profile.**

Equally important are leadership, communication and the ability to build alignment across multidisciplinary international teams. The candidate should be comfortable interacting with customers, engineering teams, project managers, R&D specialists and commercial teams, while bringing structure, technical credibility and a strong sense of priorities and commitments. As this is an international role involving regular interaction with customers, partners and our teams worldwide, the candidate should be willing and available to travel internationally on a regular basis, typically around once per month. The position requires someone who can contribute both to today's project and engineering challenges and to the longer-term development and positioning of the product portfolio.

  

The Product Line Manager is the single technical entry point and line owner from entry to exit. The PLM carries the global product-line strategy and coordinates market intelligence, proposals, engineering reviews, experts, R&D and performance follow-up from RFQ to commissioning.

  

**ACTIVITIES**

**P****rofile**

  

**1) Strategy, market and portfolio**

Track regional trends, customers, competitors, references, costs and technology opportunities.

Define and maintain the global product-line strategy, roadmap, positioning and reference list.

Lead marketing content, papers and the technical narrative for the product line.

**2) Sales, proposals and customer interface**

Act as the single technical entry point and clarify customer needs, scope, references and guarantees.

Validate technical Go / No Go, proposal assumptions, calculations, risks and performance commitments.

Support strategic customer discussions and coordinate expert input before communication.

**3) Execution and performance from RFQ to commissioning**

Own line coherence from entry to exit and match equipment performances with overall line guarantees.

Validate progressive design reviews and support transfer reviews and technical project reviews to guarantee performances throughout the project.

Anticipate, reduce and document technical risks; support performance tests, claims and post-mortems.

**4) R&D, expertise and continuous improvement**

Prioritize R&D, standardization and cost reduction according to market needs and competitive gaps.

Coordinate Experts, regional referents, partners and universities; lead technical workshops.

Own and maintain the line technical guidelines and ensure project feedback is captured and applied.

**Main deliverables:**

* Product-line strategy, technology roadmap, market/competitor mapping and reference list.
* Validated technical Go / No Go, proposals, assumptions, guarantees and risk mitigation
* Line technical guidelines and coordinated equipment standards.
* Design-review, transfer, project-review and performance-validation records.
* Prioritized R&D/VAVE portfolio, expert coordination, training and REX implementation.

**Studies****:**

* Engineer or equivalent with broad process-line and equipment knowledge.

* Professional English; another regional language is an asset.

**Experience:**

* Strong experience in processes, proposals, engineering, projects or commissioning for the product line.

* Ability to integrate process, mechanical, thermal, fluids, automation and operational constraints.

* Experience in PLTCM coupling cold rolling mill, global knowledge of all cold rolling mills, process parameters and technical equipments

* Reversing and PLTCM cold rolling mills for carbon steel

* An additional experience in silicon steel

* Process parameters knowledge

* Cold rolling modelisation

* Support for engineering

* Good knowledge of market of rolling mills (suppliers and competitors)

* 10 to 15 years of relevant experience is needed

  

**Knowledge and ability:**

* System-level understanding of the complete line from entry to exit.

* Market, customer and competitor intelligence; technical-commercial judgement.

* Performance guarantees, calculations, design reviews, risk management and project governance.

* R&D, standardization, Cost improvement, IP, partnerships and knowledge transfer.

**Behavioral competencies:**

* Leadership without direct authority.

* Global vision, prioritization and decision-making.

* Ability to communicate, coordinate and convince customers and internal stakeholders.

* Organized, rigorous, autonomous and accountable.

* Constructive challenge, teamwork and customer focus.

John Cockerill offers you career and development opportunities within its various sectors in a friendly working environment.
  
Do you want to work for an innovative company that will allow you to take up technical challenges on a daily basis?
  
We look forward to receiving your application and to meeting you!

title: Brand Manager- Digital Platform
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTIONManager – B2C Digital Growth & E-Commerce**

**Company:** Lord’s Pathology**Location:** Thane, Maharashtra**Department:** Marketing & Communications**Experience:** 4–7 Years**Employment Type:** Full-Time**Reporting To:** AGM – Marketing & Communications

**1. About the Role**

Lord’s Pathology is looking for a business-driven digital growth professional to lead its B2C digital business across the company website and mobile application, with a primary focus on generating revenue through home sample collection services.

The role will own the complete digital customer journey, including customer acquisition, website and app traffic, conversion funnel optimisation, online booking, payment completion, customer retention, and repeat business.

The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing growth strategies that convert digital visitors into paying customers, improve the performance of online health packages, and establish a scalable digital revenue channel for Lord’s Pathology.

This is a hands-on, business-oriented role requiring expertise in performance marketing, funnel management, conversion rate optimisation, digital analytics, customer lifecycle marketing, and revenue growth.

**2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. B2C Digital Business & Revenue Growth**

* Develop and execute the B2C digital growth strategy for Lord’s Pathology's website and mobile application.
* Drive business growth through home sample collection bookings, preventive health check-up packages, diagnostic test bookings, and other approved B2C offerings.
* Build monthly and quarterly digital revenue plans aligned with business targets.
* Identify opportunities to increase online bookings, average order value, customer acquisition, and repeat purchases.
* Develop growth strategies for existing and new geographical markets based on service availability, demand, competition, and operational capacity.
* Work closely with operations, customer support, and collection teams to ensure marketing demand translates into completed bookings and realised revenue.
* Track digital business performance against revenue targets and implement corrective measures wherever required.

**B. Website & Mobile App Business Management**

* Own the commercial performance of Lord’s Pathology's website and mobile application.
* Improve the customer journey from landing on the website or app to selecting a package, booking a test, completing payment, and scheduling home sample collection.
* Identify and resolve conversion barriers, navigation issues, booking drop-offs, and payment failures in coordination with the technology team.
* Optimise package listings, landing pages, product descriptions, pricing communication, promotional banners, and calls to action.
* Develop campaign-specific landing pages and booking journeys to improve conversion rates.
* Coordinate with technology partners to implement tracking, conversion events, analytics integrations, and customer journey improvements.
* Monitor website and app performance to identify opportunities for better customer acquisition, engagement, and revenue generation.

**C. Performance Marketing & Customer Acquisition**

* Plan, execute, and optimise digital acquisition campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other relevant paid media channels.
* Develop campaign strategies for home collection services, preventive health packages, seasonal campaigns, and location-specific diagnostic offerings.
* Manage campaign budgets, audience targeting, retargeting, bidding, creative testing, and performance optimisation.
* Identify high-performing customer segments, locations, packages, and advertising channels.
* Optimise campaigns based on cost per booking, customer acquisition cost, conversion rates, revenue, and return on advertising spend.
* Coordinate with creative and content teams to develop conversion-focused advertising creatives, campaign messaging, and landing pages.
* Establish reliable campaign tracking and attribution to understand which marketing activities generate actual business.
* Scale successful campaigns while maintaining agreed acquisition cost and profitability targets.

**D. Digital Funnel Development & Conversion Rate Optimisation**

* Design and manage the complete digital conversion funnel:**Awareness → Website/App Visit → Package Discovery → Booking Initiation → Payment → Confirmed Booking → Sample Collection → Completed Order → Repeat Purchase.**
* Analyse funnel performance to identify customer drop-offs and opportunities to improve conversion at each stage.
* Develop and execute A/B tests across landing pages, offers, creatives, package presentation, booking flows, and calls to action.
* Improve the percentage of visitors who become confirmed bookings and the percentage of confirmed bookings that translate into completed services.
* Coordinate with customer support and operations teams to recover incomplete bookings and resolve customer friction points.
* Build dashboards to monitor traffic, leads, bookings, payments, cancellations, completed collections, and revenue.
* Establish a continuous experimentation process to improve conversion efficiency and digital business performance.

**E. Customer Retention, CRM & Repeat Business**

* Develop customer lifecycle marketing strategies to increase repeat bookings and customer lifetime value.
* Plan customer engagement and remarketing campaigns through WhatsApp, SMS, email, push notifications, and other relevant channels.
* Implement customer segmentation based on geography, previous purchases, package preferences, engagement, and appropriate repeat-testing opportunities.
* Develop strategies for abandoned booking recovery, customer reactivation, repeat health check-ups, and relevant package recommendations.
* Work with CRM and technology teams to automate customer journeys and campaign triggers.
* Monitor repeat booking rates, customer retention, campaign engagement, and revenue generated through existing customers.
* Ensure customer communications respect consent requirements, privacy obligations, and appropriate medical communication practices.

**F. Package Marketing & Digital Merchandising**

* Develop digital marketing plans for WellCheck and other B2C diagnostic packages offered by Lord’s Pathology.
* Identify packages and diagnostic offerings with strong customer demand and commercial potential.
* Improve package visibility, product presentation, pricing communication, and promotional positioning across the website and app.
* Plan and execute seasonal and occasion-based campaigns, including preventive health awareness, family health check-ups, and other relevant health campaigns.
* Recommend package-level promotional strategies in coordination with management, finance, and laboratory teams.
* Monitor package-wise traffic, bookings, conversion rates, revenue, and customer preferences.
* Ensure all package descriptions, test inclusions, pricing, eligibility, and service claims are accurate and approved.

**G. Local Market Growth & Home Collection Expansion**

* Develop digital acquisition strategies for individual cities, neighbourhoods, and serviceable pin codes.
* Coordinate with operations teams to ensure campaigns target locations where home sample collection is available and operationally feasible.
* Improve local online visibility through Google Business Profiles, local SEO, location-specific landing pages, and relevant search campaigns.
* Identify high-demand locations and recommend marketing investments based on booking potential and service capacity.
* Develop location-wise campaign plans and evaluate the business contribution of each market.
* Work with collection operations to monitor booking fulfilment, service availability, cancellations, and customer feedback.
* Support expansion into new serviceable areas through data-driven demand generation and market testing.

**H. Analytics, Budgeting & Business Reporting**

* Develop monthly and quarterly business plans covering digital revenue, acquisition budgets, conversion targets, and retention initiatives.
* Track marketing expenditure against confirmed bookings, completed collections, net revenue, and contribution margins.
* Prepare regular performance dashboards and management reports covering acquisition, funnel performance, package sales, and customer retention.
* Analyse cost per acquisition, customer acquisition cost, conversion rates, average order value, repeat purchase rate, and return on advertising spend.
* Coordinate with finance and operations teams to reconcile bookings, cancellations, refunds, discounts, and realised revenue.
* Recommend budget allocation based on actual business outcomes rather than traffic or engagement metrics alone.
* Present performance insights, business risks, and growth opportunities to leadership.

**I. Cross-Functional & Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with technology partners, digital marketing agencies, creative teams, CRM providers, and analytics vendors.
* Work closely with sales, operations, customer support, finance, and laboratory teams to improve the digital customer experience.
* Prepare clear briefs, establish deliverables, monitor timelines, and ensure accountability across external partners.
* Maintain a structured review process for campaign performance, technology improvements, customer feedback, and revenue outcomes.
* Ensure all digital initiatives are aligned with Lord’s Pathology's brand standards, service capabilities, and business objectives.

**3. Educational Qualifications & Experience**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* MBA in Marketing, Digital Marketing, or Business Management is preferred.

**Experience**

* 4–7 years of experience in digital growth, performance marketing, e-commerce, or B2C digital business management.
* Demonstrated experience in generating measurable revenue through websites, mobile applications, or online booking platforms.
* Hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.
* Experience in conversion rate optimisation, customer acquisition, funnel analytics, and CRM marketing.
* Experience managing digital marketing budgets and evaluating campaign profitability.
* Prior experience in healthcare, diagnostics, wellness, D2C, e-commerce, or online service businesses is preferred.
* Experience working with technology teams on website and app optimisation is an advantage.

**4. Technical Skills & Tools**

The candidate should have working knowledge of:

* **Paid Advertising:** Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager.
* **Analytics:** Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console.
* **Conversion Tracking:** Pixel implementation, conversion events, UTM tracking, and campaign attribution.
* **Reporting:** Advanced Excel/Google Sheets, Looker Studio, and PowerPoint.
* **CRM & Retention:** WhatsApp marketing platforms, SMS, email marketing, push notifications, and marketing automation.
* **SEO:** Local SEO, keyword research, landing page optimisation, and Google Business Profile management.
* **Digital Platforms:** Website and app analytics, booking funnel tracking, and payment journey optimisation.
* **Business Analysis:** Revenue tracking, CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, average order value, and customer lifetime value.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The candidate will be accountable for agreed business targets across the following areas:

**Performance Area**

**Key Metrics**

Digital Revenue

Monthly revenue generated through the website and app

Home Collection Bookings

Number of confirmed home collection bookings

Completed Business

Completed collections and realised revenue

Customer Acquisition

Customer acquisition cost and cost per booking

Paid Marketing

ROAS and campaign profitability

Conversion Funnel

Visitor-to-booking and booking-to-completion conversion rates

Website & App

Traffic quality, conversion rate, and booking drop-offs

Package Performance

Package-wise bookings, revenue, and average order value

Customer Retention

Repeat bookings, customer reactivation, and customer lifetime value

Local Market Growth

Bookings and revenue by city, locality, and serviceable pin code

Budget Efficiency

Marketing spend against revenue and contribution margin

*Numerical targets will be agreed with management based on the current digital business baseline, available budgets, serviceable locations, operational capacity, and business priorities.*

**6. Desired Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a commercially focused digital growth professional who understands how to turn digital marketing investments into completed customer transactions and sustainable revenue.

The candidate should be comfortable working across marketing, technology, customer experience, and operations, with a strong sense of ownership for business outcomes.

The individual must be capable of developing growth strategies while also executing campaigns, analysing performance data, identifying conversion bottlenecks, and implementing improvements.

**7. Primary Objective of the Role**

**To build and scale Lord’s Pathology's B2C digital business by converting website and app traffic into profitable home sample collection bookings, increasing customer retention, and establishing a measurable, sustainable digital revenue channel.**

Pay: ₹17,000.00 - ₹66,000.00 per month

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund
