title: Unit Manager - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI/Senior Unit Manager - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI
description: Location Name: Pune Corporate Office - MantriJob PurposeAt Bajaj Finance, we help millions of people across India manage their money. People come to us when they want to buy a new phone on EMI, when they need a personal loan for a wedding, when they want to buy insurance, or when they want to grow their savings in a Fixed Deposit. Because we have so many customers, we get thousands of questions every single day. Customers want to know their account balance. They want to change the date their EMI gets deducted. They want to know the fees for closing a loan early.In the past, to get these answers, a customer had to wait on hold to talk to a call center agent, or they had to tap through ten different screens on our mobile app. We want to change that. We want to make it as easy as sending a text message to a friend.We are building a massive, highly intelligent AI (Artificial Intelligence) platform. Think of it like a super-smart chat assistant built right into the Bajaj Finance app. We want our customers to be able to just type out their problems in plain English, Hindi, or other languages, and have the AI fix the problem instantly. If a customer types, "Hey, I need to pause my loan payment this month," the AI should understand them, check their account, and do the work in seconds.Building this is incredibly hard. It is not just a simple robot that gives canned answers. It is a smart system that has to understand human language, connect to our deep banking systems, and follow strict financial rules.Duties And ResponsibilitiesYour Daily Work: The 9 Core AreasAboutYour job will be very hands-on. You will not just be sitting in long meetings talking about big ideas. You will be doing the real, detailed work to make this AI smart. Here are the nine specific areas you will be working on every day: FPR (Future Press Release)Before a single line of computer code is written, you have to know what your end goal is. We do this by writing a Future Press Release, or FPR.A press release is a news article that a company puts out when they launch a cool new product. But here, you will write this news article before we even start building. You will write it as if the product is already finished and launched to the public. You will write a catchy headline like: "Bajaj Finance Launches AI That Solves Loan Issues in 10 Seconds." You will write quotes from pretend customers talking about how much they love the feature. You will explain exactly what problem the feature solves in simple, everyday language.Why do we do this? Because it keeps everyone focused. If the news article sounds boring or confusing, it means your idea is probably boring or confusing. Once you write a great FPR, you show it to the engineers and your bosses. When everyone reads it and says, "Wow, this sounds amazing, let's build it!"—that document becomes your team's guide. FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions)Along with your news article, you will write a massive list of Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ). But these are not just the normal questions a customer might ask. These are questions that anyone involved might ask.You have to put yourself in the shoes of a confused customer. What will they ask? "Is my bank data safe with this AI robot?" You write the answer. You have to think like our call center agents. "Will this AI do my job wrong and make the customer angry?" You write the answer. You have to think like our company lawyers. "Does this AI follow the Reserve Bank of India rules?" You write the answer.The goal of this FAQ is to force you to find all the problems and risks before the engineers start building. If you cannot answer a tough question in your FAQ document, it means your plan has a hole in it, and you need to fix your plan. PPG (Product Program Guidelines)Because Bajaj Finance deals with people's money, we have a lot of strict rules. We cannot just give a loan to anyone. We have to charge exact fees. We have to use exact interest rates. All of these strict rules are written down in company rulebooks called Product Program Guidelines, or PPG.Every single product has a PPG. The personal loan has a PPG. The fixed deposit has a PPG. When we build the AI, the AI must follow the rules in the PPG perfectly. It cannot make a mistake. If the PPG says the late fee is 500 rupees, the AI cannot accidentally tell the customer the late fee is 400 rupees. That would cause a massive legal problem.|As a Product Manager, you will read these PPG rulebooks. You will pull out all the rules related to your project. You will work with the engineers to make sure these rules are permanently locked into the AI's brain. If the company changes a rule in the PPG next year, you are the person who makes sure the AI gets updated immediately. Synthetic TestingOnce the engineers build a version of the AI, we have to test it. But we cannot let a broken, untested AI talk to real Bajaj Finance customers. That is too risky. If the AI is confused, a real customer might get bad advice about their loan.So, we use something called Synthetic Testing. "Synthetic" just means fake or made-up. You will help create thousands of fake conversations to test the AI safely. You will create fake customer profiles. For example, you make a fake customer named Rahul who has a home loan. You will type to the AI pretending to be Rahul. You will ask, "Can I pay off my whole loan today?" and see what the AI says.Does the AI say yes? Does it calculate the early payment fee correctly? What if you pretend to be a customer who types with terrible spelling? What if you type in a mix of Hindi and English? What if you pretend to be very angry? Does the AI still understand and stay polite? You will run hundreds of these fake tests. When the AI fails, you write down why it failed, take that information back to the engineers, and tell them what to fix. You keep doing this until the AI passes every fake test perfectly. LLM Parameters (What We Send to the AI Brain)The core brain of our AI is called a Large Language Model (LLM). Think of the LLM like an incredibly smart person sitting in a dark room. This person knows how to speak perfectly, but they have no idea who they are talking to.If a customer types, "What is my balance?", the smart person in the dark room has no idea whose balance to check. So, we have to send the LLM a package of extra information along with the customer's question. We call this setting the LLM Parameters.As the Product Manager, you will decide exactly what information goes into that package. When the customer asks about their balance, you will tell our computer systems: "Before you let the AI answer, grab the customer's name, grab their last three payments, and grab their current loan amount. Send all of that to the AI."You also have to send strict instructions. You will tell the AI, "You are a helpful assistant for Bajaj Finance. Always be polite. Do not guess numbers. Only use the numbers I just sent you." If you send the AI too much information, it gets confused and it costs the company too much money to process. If you send too little information, the AI gives a stupid answer. Your job is to find the perfect balance of what data to send the AI every time a customer speaks. VisualisationsChatting with an AI should not just be reading massive blocks of text. Nobody wants to read a giant paragraph of words on their small phone screen.|Sometimes, the best way to answer a customer is by showing them a picture, a chart, or a button. We call these Visualisations.Let's say a customer asks, "How much of my loan have I paid off?" The AI could write a long, boring sentence with a bunch of numbers. But it is much better if the AI shows a nice, clean pie chart on the screen. Half the pie is green for the money paid, and half is grey for the money left. The customer understands it instantly.Or, if the AI needs the customer to pick a date, it shouldn't make the customer type "October 15th." It should pop up a small calendar on the screen so the customer can just tap the day. You will decide when to use text and when to use these visual tools. You will work with our designers to sketch out how these charts and buttons should look so the chat is beautiful and easy to use. Product SwitchingImagine you are talking to a human salesman at a store. You ask about buying a TV. Then, suddenly, you change your mind and ask about buying a fridge. The human easily switches the topic to the fridge.Computers are not naturally good at this. If the computer is programmed to talk to you about a TV, and you ask about a fridge, the computer will get totally confused. It might say, "Error, I do not understand."At Bajaj Finance, we have dozens of products. A customer might start a chat asking about their EMI shopping card. But halfway through the chat, they might say, "By the way, I also want to open a Fixed Deposit." The AI needs to smoothly switch from talking about the shopping card to talking about the Fixed Deposit without breaking or crashing.We call this Product Switching. You will write the rules for how the AI handles these sudden changes in conversation. You will plan out how the AI remembers what the customer was talking about first, just in case the customer wants to go back to the original topic later.|8. Conversation FlowsA normal conversation flows naturally. But computers need a map. They need to be told exactly how a conversation should go, step by step. You will create these maps, which we call Conversation Flows.You will literally use a software tool to draw boxes and arrows on your screen. Box 1: The AI says, "Hello, how can I help?" -> Arrow points to Box 2. Box 2: The customer says, "I want to see my statement." -> Arrow points to Box 3. Box 3: The system checks if the customer's phone number is verified.o If Yes -> Arrow points to Box 4.o If No -> Arrow points to Box 5. Box 4: Show the statement on the screen. Box 5: Ask the customer to type in a one-time password (OTP).You have to map out every single path the conversation could possibly take. You have to think of all the "what ifs." What if the customer types the wrong password? What if the customer stops replying and walks away from their phone? What if the internet crashes? You must draw a box and an arrow for every single situation. These flowcharts become the actual instruction manual for the engineers. They look at your map and write the code to make it happen exactly as you drew it.Required Qualifications And ExperienceThe Background You Need (Education & Experience)RequirementsBecause this job requires you to build highly complex computer systems, we are very strict about the background you need to have. We are looking for people who meet these exact requirements: Your Education (The Degree and the College)You must have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical computer field.You must have graduated from a Tier 1 Engineering College. This means premier institutes like the IITs (Indian Institutes of Technology), NITs (National Institutes of Technology), or top-level Regional Engineering Colleges.It is because the AI technology we are building is extremely complicated. You will be working side-by-side with some of the smartest software engineers in the country. You need to know how software is actually built. You need to understand coding logic, databases, and how computer servers talk to each other. Top engineering colleges train you to handle these tough, highly technical problems. If you do not have this strong computer science foundation, you will not be able to keep up with the engineering teams.If you also have a Master's degree, that is great! We love to see it. But if you do not have a Master's degree, that is perfectly fine. It is not required. The Bachelor's degree from a Tier 1 college is what matters the most. Your Work Experience (2 to 3 Years in NLP/AI)You cannot be fresh out of college for this job. You must have at least 2 to 3 years of actual, hands-on work experience.More importantly, this experience must be in a very specific area. You must have worked on NLP platforms. It is the specific technology that teaches computers how to read, understand, and write human language.You must have spent the last few years of your career actually building chatbots, voice assistants, or smart AI text tools. You cannot just be someone who managed a normal website or a standard mobile app.

description:
We are seeking an experienced, high-caliber
**Vice President – Fixed Income Product Owner**
to take end-to-end ownership of the
**Fixed Income (FI) Book of Work**
. In this critical leadership role, you will define and execute the strategic product roadmap across Post-Trade Processing, specifically focusing on
**Fixed Income Settlement, Confirmation, and Regulatory Reporting**
.
  
  
As a VP Product Owner, you will serve as the strategic bridge between Front Office, Market Operations, Market Controller, and Global Technology Delivery teams. You will manage competing priorities, negotiate complex requirements, and interface regularly with senior leadership to ensure timely and high-impact delivery of strategic initiatives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Product Strategy & Book of Work Ownership
* Take full end-to-end accountability for defining, prioritizing, and delivering the Fixed Income Post-Trade Book of Work.
* Formulate a multi-year product roadmap aligned with organizational goals, regulatory imperatives, and operational efficiency targets.
* Translate complex business problems into clear product epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable business outcomes.
* Manage capacity and budget allocations across development pods, optimize resource utilization and release velocity.
* Domain Leadership: Post-Trade Processing & Regulatory Compliance
* Settlements: Drive transformation across global settlement mechanisms (e.g., Euroclear, Clearstream, DTC, Fedwire, local market CSDs), fail management, and cash/securities reconciliation.
* Trade Confirmation & Matching: Lead product enhancements for electronic trade affirmation/confirmation platforms (e.g., Trax, DTCC CTM, SWIFT messaging: MT/MX ISO 20022).
* Regulatory Reporting: Oversee product compliance with international regulatory reporting regimes impacting Fixed Income (e.g., MiFIR/MiFID II, EMIR, Dodd-Frank, FINRA TRACE, CAT, CSDR).
* Proactively monitor market structure changes, industry mandates, and central clearing counterparty (CCP) rules to ensure product adaptability.
* Senior Stakeholder Management & Negotiation
* Build and sustain relationships with key stakeholders, including Desk Heads, Operations Leadership, Technology Directors, Risk & Control Partners, and Legal/Compliance Officers.
* Navigate competing priorities across multiple business lines through structured trade-off analyses, data-driven insights, and executive negotiation.
* Run steering committees, backlog prioritization sessions, and executive status reviews, clearly communicating product vision, risks, and ROI.
* Agile Delivery & Execution Excellence
* Act as the dedicated Agile Product Owner across cross-functional engineering and QA squads.
* Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and acceptance sign-offs.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) to quantify product adoption, operational STP (Straight-Through Processing) rates, and risk mitigation.
* Champion best-in-class product management practices, ensuring adherence to change governance, SDLC frameworks, and audit controls.

**Qualifications & Candidate Profile**
Experience & Domain Knowledge
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Master’s or MBA preferred).
* Experience: 8+ years of total financial services / fintech experience, with at least 4+ years in a senior Product Owner, Product Manager, or Business Analyst role.
* Subject Matter Expertise: In-depth knowledge of Fixed Income asset classes (Bonds, Treasuries, Repos, Security Lending and Borrowing instruments) and post-trade lifecycle.
* Core Technical/Operations Acumen:
* Solid grounding in SWIFT messaging standards (ISO 15022 and ISO 20022), FIX protocol, and trade flow architecture.
* Comprehensive understanding of bilateral and central clearing, tri-party repo mechanics, and exception handling workflows.
* Practical experience delivering regulatory reporting solutions for post-trade transaction reporting.

Leadership & Soft Skills
  
  

* Stakeholder Negotiation: Proven ability to influence and align senior stakeholders with divergent agendas.
* Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Adept at dissecting complex workflow bottlenecks and formulating scalable, automated solutions.
* Agile Leadership: Strong familiarity with Scrum/Kanban frameworks, JIRA/Confluence, and modern product management tools.

title: Product Manager - Growth & Conversion, India
description:
**About The Luxury Closet**

The Luxury Closet is a luxury resale marketplace serving buyers and sellers across multiple countries in English and Arabic.

**About the role**

The Luxury Closet is hiring a Product Manager to own conversion across the buyer and seller experience on its website and apps. You will be accountable for turning more visitors into buyers and more prospective sellers into submitted items.

The site runs in English and Arabic and serves customers in markets including the US, the UK, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Australia. Each market behaves differently in how people browse, pay and trust a luxury resale purchase. Closing the gaps between them is a large part of the opportunity.

This is a hands-on role for someone who has already moved conversion numbers at scale and can show how. You will set the roadmap, run the experiments and answer for the results.

**What you will own**

You own the front-end customer experience on both sides of the marketplace.

**Buyer side**

* Home, category and listing pages, including navigation and filters

* Product pages

* Cart, checkout and payment

* Account, order tracking and the journeys that bring buyers back

* The Arabic experience and market-specific versions of all of the above

**Seller side**

* The entry points and pages that bring prospective sellers into the submission flow

* The usability of the submission experience through to a completed submission

**How success is measured**

The two headline KPIs are buyer conversion rate and seller conversion rate. The supporting KPIs below show where the headline numbers are won or lost.

Side

KPI

What it covers

Buyer

Conversion rate (headline)

Share of visitors who complete a purchase

  

Buyer

Funnel stages

Product page to add-to-cart, cart to checkout, checkout completion, and payment success by country and payment method

  

Buyer

Discovery

Filter and navigation usage, and how often browsing leads to a product page view

  

Buyer

Segment gaps

Conversion in Arabic vs English, app vs web, and each market against the best-performing one

  

Buyer

Retention

Repeat purchase rate and time to second order

  

Buyer

Site health

Page speed on mobile and front-end error rates

  

Seller

Submission rate (headline)

Share of prospective sellers who start and complete an item submission

Gains are expected to hold without leaning on discounting or pushing up returns and cancellations.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the conversion roadmap for the buyer and seller front end, prioritised by expected impact on the KPIs above.

* Diagnose the funnels: find where each market, language and device loses customers, and size each opportunity before committing the team to it.

* Own A/B testing end to end, including the test setup itself, from hypothesis and design through to readout and rollout. Own event tracking across the website and apps, so every funnel step is measured accurately.

* Improve checkout and payment for each market, including local payment methods, currencies, delivery and duties messaging.

* Raise the Arabic experience to the standard of the English one, including right-to-left layout and localised content.

* Improve navigation and filters so buyers reach the right product faster.

* Build the journeys that bring buyers back for a second and third purchase.

* Reduce drop-off between a seller starting a submission and completing it.

* Keep the site fast and stable, working with engineering on page speed and front-end errors.

* Work with the AI product manager so that search, recommendations and seller pricing are presented well in the interface.

* Work day to day with the design lead, engineering, marketing and customer service.

* Report results to leadership regularly, in plain numbers, including what did not work.

**What we are looking for**

**Must have**

* Demonstrable results in improving conversion. You can name the funnel, the starting number, what you changed and where the number ended up.

* Several years of product management in e-commerce or a marketplace, with ownership of a consumer funnel end to end.

* Deep experience running A/B tests, including sample sizing, reading results honestly and knowing when a test is inconclusive. Hands-on experience setting up event tracking and testing tools.

* Strong analytical skills. There is no dedicated analyst on the team. You do your own analysis, using AI tools, and question the data yourself.

* Experience with checkout and payments across more than one country.

* Experience with mobile web and app experiences, where most of the traffic sits.

* Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to work with senior leadership directly.

**Strong advantage**

* Experience with a two-sided marketplace, covering both buyers and sellers.

* Experience with Arabic or other right-to-left products, or with customers in the Gulf.

* Experience in luxury, fashion or resale, where trust and authenticity drive the purchase.

* Arabic language skills.

description:
**Job Description: Operations Manager**

**Job Title:** Manager - Operations

**Department:** Operations/Plant Management

**Job Location:** Ghaziabad

**Reports to:** Plant Head/CEO/Directors (Technical)/Director (B.D.)

**Job Summary**

To lead and manage the overall machine shop and operational activities of the

manufacturing facility, ensuring efficient utilisation of machines, manpower,

resources and infrastructure. The position will be responsible for coordinating and

monitoring Maintenance, Production, Purchase, Quality and PPC functions to

achieve operational excellence, productivity, quality standards, cost efficiency and

timely delivery.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in machining.

processes, machine shop management, manufacturing setup, QMS implementation

and general industrial safety and statutory compliance.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**1. Machine Shop & Manufacturing Operations**

 Manage and supervise day-to-day machine shop operations and ensure smooth

functioning of all machining activities.

 Possess strong technical knowledge of machining processes, tooling, fixtures,

cutting parameters and machining practices.

 Have hands-on experience in operating, managing and maintaining machines

such as:

o VMC (Vertical Machining Centre)

o CNC Lathe and Conventional Lathe

o Milling Machines (Universal/Conventional)

o Surface Grinding Machines

o CNC Routers and Conventional Routers

o Other precision machining and fabrication equipment.

 Ensure optimum machine utilisation, productivity, process efficiency and

minimum machine downtime.

 Monitor production output, cycle time, rejection, rework and overall shop floor

performance.

 Ensure proper allocation of machines, manpower, tools and resources as per

production requirements.

 Identify process bottlenecks and implement corrective and preventive actions.

**2. New Machining Setup & Project Implementation**

 Lead the planning and establishment of new machine shop setups and machining

facilities.

 Evaluate machine requirements, technical specifications, capacities and

infrastructure requirements.

 Coordinate machine installation, commissioning, trials and production

validation.

 Ensure availability of utilities, tooling, fixtures, consumables and trained

manpower before production commencement.

 Develop SOPs, work instructions, process flow and operational standards for

new setups.

 Drive capacity enhancement, process improvement and automation initiatives.

**3. Maintenance Management**

 Oversee preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance activities.

 Ensure preparation and implementation of machine maintenance schedules.

 Monitor machine health, breakdown frequency, MTTR and MTBF.

 Ensure timely availability of spare parts, maintenance tools and technical

support.

 Coordinate with maintenance personnel to minimise unplanned downtime.

 Maintain machine history cards, maintenance records and calibration

coordination wherever applicable.

**4. Quality Management System (QMS)**

 Ensure adherence to the organisation's Quality Management System and

applicable quality standards.

 Coordinate with the Quality Department to ensure process compliance,

inspection readiness and product conformity.

 Ensure implementation of SOPs, process controls, inspection plans and quality

documentation.

 Drive root cause analysis, CAPA, 5 Why, 8D and continuous improvement

initiatives.

 Ensure control of non-conforming products, process deviations and customer

complaints.

 Promote a quality-orientated culture across all operational functions.

 Ensure readiness for internal, external and customer audits.

**5. Production Planning & Control (PPC)**

 Coordinate with PPC for production planning, scheduling and capacity

utilisation.

 Ensure adherence to production plans, delivery commitments and customer

priorities.

 Review daily production reports, pending jobs, WIP and order status.

 Ensure effective coordination between production, machine shop and other

departments.

 Identify production constraints and take timely corrective action.

**6. Purchase & Vendor Coordination**

 Coordinate with Purchase for timely procurement of raw materials, tools,

consumables, spares and other operational requirements.

 Ensure technical evaluation of machinery, tools, equipment and vendor

capabilities.

 Monitor vendor performance, procurement lead time and material availability.

 Optimize operational costs without compromising quality and delivery

requirements.

**7. Safety, Fire & Statutory Compliance**

 Ensure implementation of industrial safety practices across the manufacturing

facility.

 Monitor compliance with fire safety requirements, emergency preparedness and

evacuation procedures.

 Ensure proper functioning and accessibility of firefighting equipment and safety

installations.

 Ensure machine guarding, electrical safety, PPE compliance and safe working

practices.

 Coordinate with EHS/HR/Admin for applicable statutory inspections, licences,

records and regulatory compliance.

 Conduct periodic shop-floor safety inspections and ensure timely closure of

observations.

 Promote 5S, housekeeping and workplace discipline.

**8. MIS, Reporting & Cross-Functional Coordination**

 Act as the central coordination point for Production, Maintenance, Purchase,

Quality and PPC.

 Prepare and review daily, weekly and monthly operational MIS.

 Monitor key operational KPIs and present performance reports to management.

 Conduct regular operational review meetings and ensure accountability for

action points.

 Escalate operational bottlenecks, resource constraints and critical issues to

senior management.

 Ensure effective communication and coordination across all departments.

**9. Supply Chain & Coordination**

 Coordinate with Purchase and Stores departments for uninterrupted material

availability.

 Monitor inventory control and material utilization.

 Support vendor development and supplier performance improvement.

 Ensure smooth dispatch operations and timely product deliveries.

**10. Customer Relationship Management**

 Support customer satisfaction through quality products and timely delivery.

 Attend customer meetings and handle critical operational escalations when

required.

 Coordinate with Sales and Marketing teams regarding customer requirements

and delivery schedules.

 Ensure quick resolution of customer complaints related to operations.

**11. Reporting & Management Reviews**

 Prepare and present MIS reports to senior management.

 Review key operational KPIs and performance indicators regularly.

 Participate in Monthly Review Meetings (MRM), Annual General Meetings

(AGM), and strategic review discussions.

 Submit reports related to production, efficiency, costs, quality, manpower, and

safety performance.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The performance of the Operations Manager will be evaluated on the following

parameters:

1. Overall machine utilization and productivity.

2. Reduction in machine breakdowns and downtime.

3. Production plan achievement and on-time delivery.

4. Reduction in rejection, rework and process wastage.

5. Preventive maintenance schedule adherence.

6. Operational cost control and resource optimization.

7. Implementation and effectiveness of QMS.

8. Successful commissioning of new machines and machining setups.

9. Fire, safety and statutory compliance.

10. 5S, housekeeping and shop-floor discipline.

11. Cross-functional coordination and closure of operational issues.

**Required Qualifications**

Educational Qualification

 Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering / Production Engineering /

Industrial Engineering or related field.

 Diploma in Mechanical Engineering may be considered for candidates with

strong relevant experience and demonstrated operational leadership.

 MBA in Operations Management shall be preferred.

Experience

 An individual aged between 40-45 years having Minimum 12–15 years of

experience in engineering/manufacturing industry.

 At least 5-7 years in a leadership or plant management role.

 Experience in handling large manufacturing operations preferred.

Required Skills & Competencies

Technical Skills

 Experience in manufacturing/engineering industries, preferably in precision

machining, or engineering components manufacturing.

 Experience in managing machine shop or manufacturing operations.

 Strong practical understanding of CNC, VMC, Lathe, Milling, Surface Grinding and

Router operations.

 Experience in new machine shop establishment, machine installation and

commissioning.

 Working knowledge of QMS, preferably ISO 9001 / AS9100D.

 Understanding of preventive maintenance, production planning, machining

processes and industrial safety.

 Experience in handling cross-functional teams and managing multiple

operational functions.

Managerial Skills

 Strong ownership and accountability towards organizational deliverables.

 Result-oriented approach with the ability to drive measurable improvements.

 Strong decision-making and problem-solving capabilities.

 Ability to lead, motivate and manage shop-floor teams.

 Effective coordination and communication across departments.

 Proactive approach towards identifying operational risks and resolving

bottlenecks.

 Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.

 High standards of discipline, integrity and professional conduct.

Remuneration

INR 15-20 LPA CTC

**International Operations & Vendor Development Manager**

Location: Gurgaon (work from office)

Experience: 4+ years

About Yolojet

Yolojet is a logistics company serving shippers across India, with a focus on metros and tier 1 and tier 2

cities. We are now launching an international small and medium parcel business, shipping from India to

overseas destinations. We have no international setup today, so this role builds it.

About the Role

You will set up our international parcel operations from zero. You will find and onboard carriers and

consolidators, negotiate rates, design the export workflow, and get our first shipments out. While you

build supply, the founder will drive sales. This is an extremely high-ownership role for someone who

has built vendor networks before, not just run daily operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify, evaluate and onboard international express carriers, consolidators and cross-border partners.

* Negotiate rate cards, service terms, transit times and credit terms by lane and weight slab with the

carriers/vendors.

* Set up the end-to-end export flow: booking, pickup, documentation, customs handover, line-haul,

overseas delivery and tracking.

* Own export documentation: commercial invoice, packing list, IEC and AD code requirements, HS codes,

and courier-mode export rules. Work with our customs broker (CHA) for compliance.

* Define restricted and prohibited item rules, volumetric weight rules and packaging standards.

* Manage daily vendor escalations and carrier performance reviews.

* Handle freight and carrier invoice checks and claims for lost or damaged shipments.

* Work with the tech team on integrating carrier APIs, tracking and rate calculation into the Yolojet portal.

* Hire and lead international operations executives as volume grows.

* Support sales with lane feasibility, transit times, quotes and customer queries.

90-Day Goals

* Two to three carriers or consolidators onboarded and live.

* Rate cards ready for three to four priority lanes.

* Documentation flow and SOPs in place.

* First shipments delivered end to end.

Requirements

* 4+ years in cross-border express or courier, international freight forwarding or consolidation.

* Proven track record of onboarding vendors or carriers and negotiating rates.

* Working knowledge of export documentation, customs procedures, HS codes, and courier and postal

export routes.

* Understanding of key lanes such as the US, UK, UAE, Europe and Australia, and of volumetric and

chargeable weight.

* Existing relationships with international carriers, consolidators or forwarders are strongly preferred.

* Comfortable with Excel and rate analysis. Able to work with a tech team on portal and API needs.

* Strong negotiation and communication skills, in person and in writing.

* Self-starter who can work from zero without a ready process.

Good to Have

* Experience with e-commerce, D2C or marketplace cross-border shipping.

* Experience with DDP/DDU, duties and taxes handling, and customs clearance at destination.

* Knowledge of GST treatment on export of services and freight.

* Familiarity with carrier and aggregator panels and APIs.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
**Designation:** Digital Marketing Executive  
**Job Type:** Full Time, Permanent  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office (WFO)  
**Working Days:** Tuesday to Sunday  
**Work timing:** 10:30 am to 8:00 pm  
**Weekly Off:** Monday

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a creative, skilled and result-oriented Digital Marketing Executive to manage and strengthen our jewellery brand's online presence. The candidate should have practical experience in running paid advertisements, managing digital campaigns, building brand awareness, video editing and using AI tools for digital marketing.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Social Media & Digital Marketing**

* Manage the company's social media platforms, including Facebook and Instagram.
* Plan, create and execute digital marketing strategies to increase brand awareness and engagement.
* Develop creative content ideas, promotional posts, reels and stories for the jewellery brand.
* Maintain a consistent brand image across all digital platforms.

**2. Paid Advertising & Campaign Management**

* Plan, execute and manage paid advertising campaigns on Meta (Facebook & Instagram) and Google Ads.
* Monitor advertising budgets, campaign performance, leads, reach and conversions.
* Optimize campaigns to improve ROI and generate quality leads.
* Conduct audience targeting, retargeting and performance analysis.

**3. Video Editing & Creative Content**

* Edit promotional videos, jewellery product videos, reels and short-form videos.
* Create engaging visual content for social media and digital campaigns.
* Coordinate with the photography and creative teams for product-based content.
* Ensure that all creatives reflect the brand's identity and premium positioning.

**4. AI in Digital Marketing**

* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini and other AI-powered platforms for content creation and marketing ideas.
* Explore AI-based tools for video editing, creative designing, captions and campaign optimization.
* Use AI to improve marketing productivity and creative output.

**5. Brand Awareness & Performance Monitoring**

* Execute brand awareness campaigns to improve online visibility.
* Track social media insights, engagement, website traffic and campaign performance.
* Prepare regular digital marketing performance reports.
* Identify new digital marketing trends and opportunities in the jewellery industry.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Graduate in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Mass Communication or a related field.
* 1–3 years of practical experience in digital marketing.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
* Good knowledge of Facebook and Instagram advertising.
* Video editing skills using tools such as Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar software.
* Knowledge of AI tools and their practical application in digital marketing.
* Understanding of social media algorithms, audience targeting and campaign analytics.
* Creative thinking, communication skills and analytical ability.

Preferred Candidate

* Experience in jewellery, fashion, luxury retail or lifestyle brands will be an advantage.
* Must be creative, proactive and result-oriented.
* Should be capable of independently planning and executing digital marketing campaigns.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Leave encashment

Work Location: In person

title: Knowledge Management Enablement Manager
description:
**Job Title: Knowledge Management Enablement Manager**
If you’re looking to take an exciting new direction with your HSBC career, an internal move can open the door to many opportunities, allowing you to take on a new challenge, and develop your skills. Bring your knowledge of our brand to a new role and grow yourself further.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Knowledge Management Enablement Lead -
**this role may be based in Bangalore, Gurgaon, Hyderabad or Kolkata.**
As Knowledge Management Enablement Lead within Risk and Compliance and the Chief AI Officer function you’ll accelerate adoption of HSBC’s enterprise knowledge and knowledge-intelligence layer across R&C Value Streams. This is a transformation and change role focused on enablement and adoption rather than building the underlying platform which is delivered by a separate BAU knowledge and data team. You’ll connect knowledge foundations to the agentic AI migration agenda partnering closely with Value Streams and the AI Enablement Lead. Success means more workflows and use cases onboarded onto the knowledge-intelligence layer with clear data and knowledge readiness coverage across Value Streams. You’ll also improve how quickly Value Stream requirements are translated into governed build-ready designs and how consistently adoption is measured and reported.
  
  
A move across the business allows you to continue to access tailored professional development opportunities, and our fantastic benefits packages.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Act as the change and adoption enabler for knowledge management and knowledge-intelligence standards across R&C Value Streams. Partner with Value Streams to understand and translate knowledge and unstructured-data needs into governed build-ready designs
* Coordinate with the BAU knowledge and data engineering team to prioritise and enable delivery of the knowledge-intelligence layer including FIBO-aligned ontology semantic layer hybrid search and GraphRAG foundations. Maintain clear scope boundaries and RACI with the BAU team so build and operational accountability is not duplicated
* Own the interface between knowledge management delivery and the agentic AI migration agenda to ensure knowledge foundations are fit for purpose for AI migration and Value Stream AI workflows
* Track and report adoption of the knowledge layer across Value Streams. Support the Head of AI Monitoring and Governance on evidence and data-quality standards relevant to knowledge management

**To Be Successful You Will**

* Bring experience in knowledge management information architecture or data and content strategy
* Apply familiarity with RAG semantic search or related knowledge-intelligence concepts. Translate business needs into governed delivery designs across business and technical teams
* Partner effectively with senior stakeholders across Value Streams product owners AI leads and central enablement teams. Deliver change or transformation outcomes with clear adoption measures and reporting
* Work comfortably with unstructured data requirements and knowledge standards in a governed environment. Bring financial services experience with exposure to Risk and Compliance where available

**hsbc.com/careers
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC**
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Social Media Marketing Team
description:
**Reel opening idea**

**Visual:**

One woman looks into the mirror. With each change in look, the jewellery shifts too.

**Voiceover:**

“She’s not four different women.

She’s one woman—with four very good reasons to dress differently.

For the room she’s ready to own.

For the date she wants to remember.

For the weekend she’s claiming for herself.

For the celebration where she refuses to blend in.

Different moods. Different entrances.

And each time, one little detail knows exactly how to make its entrance too…

A glint at her ears.

A little drama at her neckline.

A sparkle that stays in the photographs.

**That’s the magic of jewellery. And that’s the world of Shringar Studio.**

Jewellery for the mood she’s in—and the way she wants to feel.”

**Visual:**

A close-up of the jewellery, followed by a quick transition to a content shoot in progress.

**Voiceover:**

“Now we’re looking for someone who can make the world feel it.

Someone to lead our Instagram—from strategy and ideas to shooting, editing and posting.

If you’ve created for
**women’s fashion, apparel, jewellery, beauty, aesthetics or women-focused FMCG**

Distributor Strategy & Channel Health Own distributor strategy for the state — appointment, ROI management, performance reviews, conflict resolution. Map the state's electrical wholesale and distribution landscape; identify and prioritise the right distributor profile for Sturlite Power. Ensure distributors are adequately stocked, trained on the product, and motivated to push Sturlite actively. Activate key electrical wholesale hubs — establish Sturlite Power as a visible, credible option at the counter within the first 90 days. Sumangal Electrician Programme — State Execution Execute the centrally-designed Sumangal electrician loyalty programme at state level; BU Head owns design, RSM owns execution. Drive electrician enrolments, monthly nukkad meets, product demos, and coupon-to-order conversion across all zones. Commercially Literate: Reads scheme ROI, mix margin, and working capital impact natively. Will not over-spend a scheme to chase a billing number. Ranveer Singh as brand ambassador — meaningful pull at the dealer counter. Direct working access to founders. Decisions in days, not quarters. Successful Phase 1 RSMs are first in line for multi-state roles as Sturlite enters Phase 2 and beyond. Clear career path to National / Zone Business Head as the state business scales — Sturlite grows its leaders from within.Confidential — For Internal Use Only | Sturlite Electric Private

**Job Title:** Senior Sales Manager – Retreats

**Department:** Sales & Marketing

**Reports To:** Director of Sales & Marketing

**Work Location:** Infocity, Gandhinagar, Gujarat

**Resort:** Amrit Ocean Resort, Singer Island, Riviera Beach, Florida

**Shift:** US Shift (7:00 p.m. – 5:00 a.m. IST)

**Summary**

The Senior Sales Manager – Retreats will drive sales and ensure the growth of Amrit Ocean Resort’s wellness retreat offerings. This role requires a passion for wellness, excellent communication skills, and a proven track record in luxury hospitality or wellness sales. You will build the retreat pipeline, develop partnerships, and mentor junior team members.

**About the Opportunity**

Amrit Ocean Resort (www.amritocean.com) is one of the leading lifestyle and wellness resorts in the USA. We are now setting up a dedicated corporate sales office in India to drive revenue for the resort across its key business segments, working in close partnership with the resort’s leadership in Florida.

If you are a high-performing, growth-driven hospitality sales professional with a passion for luxury and wellness, this is a rare opportunity to be a founding member of a new, fast-growing team and shape how Amrit sells to the world.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time role for a Senior Sales Manager – Retreats. The role covers wellness retreat sales, partnership development, client relationship management, communication, and customer service.

**Responsibilities**

**Sales Strategy & Execution**

* Develop and implement effective sales strategies to drive revenue growth for wellness retreats, including individual, group, and corporate retreat bookings.
* Identify new market opportunities and build relationships with potential clients, retreat organizers, wellness practitioners, travel advisors, and partners.
* Achieve and exceed sales targets and KPIs set by leadership.

**Client Relationship Management**

* Establish and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential clients.
* Handle client inquiries, provide detailed information about retreats, and close sales.
* Provide personalized, attentive service so that each client’s needs and preferences are met.

**Marketing & Promotion**

* Collaborate with the marketing team to develop promotional materials and campaigns that highlight the benefits of Amrit’s wellness retreats.
* Represent the company at industry events, webinars, trade shows, and networking functions.

**Product Knowledge, Leadership & Administration**

* Stay current on wellness industry trends and competitor offerings to give clients informed recommendations.
* Mentor and train junior sales team members on best practices and product knowledge.
* Coordinate with the resort operations team to ensure seamless delivery of retreat experiences.
* Prepare and present regular sales reports and forecasts to leadership.
* Maintain accurate records of sales activity and client interactions in the CRM.
* Maintain confidentiality of client and company information.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive sales experience in 5-star luxury hotels, resorts, or wellness destinations, with at least 3 years selling wellness, retreat, or experiential programs.
* Strong understanding of the South Florida and overall US wellness and luxury travel market.
* Proven ability to develop and implement effective sales strategies and to mentor team members.
* Ability to understand and evaluate complex information from multiple sources and to multitask and prioritize to meet deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with fluent, clear American-English communication suited to US clients.
* Experience selling to US or other international clients and markets.
* Strong negotiation, presentation, and networking abilities.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and CRM software.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to work independently in a remote, US-hours environment.
* Knowledge of different cultures and languages is a plus.
* A passion for hospitality and a commitment to exceptional customer service.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and commission structure.
* Comprehensive benefits package including insurance.
* Paid time off and holidays.
* Opportunities for professional development and growth.

**Start Date**

* Immediate joining

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
**We're Hiring: Digital Marketing Executive**

**Company:** Immedone  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Work Mode:** On-site – Work from Office  
**Experience:** 3–5 years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**About Immedone**

Immedone is a homegrown technology startup building a real-time neighbourhood service marketplace that connects individuals seeking everyday services with independent service providers.

Our vision is to make everyday services more accessible while empowering individuals to turn their skills, time and availability into meaningful earning opportunities.

As we prepare for our market launch, we are looking for passionate individuals who are excited about building a brand from the ground up, challenging conventional approaches and contributing to the growth of a consumer-facing technology platform.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative, proactive and result-oriented Digital Marketing Executive who can combine creative storytelling, content creation, video production, digital marketing and growth strategies to strengthen Immedone's brand visibility, customer acquisition and platform adoption.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable independently managing end-to-end digital marketing activities, from conceptualising campaigns and creating content to executing paid advertisements and measuring business outcomes.

We are particularly looking for someone with strong hands-on capabilities in independently conceptualising, shooting and editing engaging videos, Reels and promotional content.

This role offers an opportunity to actively shape Immedone's brand identity, market launch and growth journey rather than simply manage an established digital presence.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Social Media & Content Management**

* Plan and manage Immedone's digital presence across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.
* Develop content calendars and creative strategies aligned with business objectives, brand positioning and audience interests.
* Create engaging posts, stories, Reels, short-form videos, promotional creatives and campaign content.
* Develop original creative concepts, scripts, captions and culturally relevant content in Tamil and English.
* Identify emerging digital trends and adapt them appropriately to Immedone's brand personality.
* Maintain consistency in brand communication, visual identity and tone across digital platforms.

**2. Video Production & Creative Storytelling**

* Independently conceptualise, script, plan, shoot and edit high-quality videos for digital platforms.
* Create engaging Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, promotional videos, explainers, interviews, testimonials and brand awareness content.
* Capture authentic stories involving neighbourhood communities, service providers, customers, company activities and brand initiatives.
* Handle camera operations, smartphone videography, lighting, framing and audio recording.
* Edit videos with appropriate transitions, subtitles, background music, effects and visual elements.
* Repurpose long-form content into multiple short-form content pieces.
* Coordinate and participate in on-site video shoots and local field visits whenever required.
* Ensure appropriate consent for filming and publication, customer privacy, copyright compliance and responsible content creation.

**3. Performance Marketing & Paid Campaigns**

* Plan, execute and optimise paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads and other relevant platforms.
* Manage audience targeting, retargeting, app install campaigns, lead generation and conversion optimisation.
* Develop hyperlocal advertising campaigns targeting specific neighbourhoods and serviceable locations.
* Monitor advertising budgets, campaign performance, customer acquisition costs and return on advertising spend.
* Conduct A/B testing of creatives, messaging, audiences and campaign strategies.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure effective conversion tracking and campaign measurement.

**4. Mobile App Marketing & User Acquisition**

* Develop and execute strategies to increase app downloads, user registrations and meaningful platform engagement.
* Contribute to App Store Optimisation (ASO) initiatives for the Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
* Develop targeted campaigns for both Seekers and Service Providers, supporting balanced marketplace growth.
* Monitor the user acquisition journey from app discovery and installation to registration, activation and service transactions.
* Identify opportunities to improve user activation, retention, repeat usage and re-engagement.
* Collaborate with product and technology teams to understand user behaviour and improve marketing effectiveness.

**5. SEO & Digital Discoverability**

* Plan and implement SEO and SEM strategies to improve Immedone's online visibility.
* Conduct keyword research and optimise website content for relevant search queries.
* Monitor organic traffic, search rankings and website performance.
* Explore emerging discoverability strategies, including Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO).
* Identify opportunities to strengthen local search visibility and brand discoverability across digital channels.

**6. Growth Marketing & Launch Campaigns**

* Develop and execute pre-launch, launch and post-launch marketing campaigns.
* Create innovative campaigns that generate curiosity, brand awareness and community engagement.
* Plan and execute referral campaigns, influencer collaborations, brand partnerships, email marketing and WhatsApp marketing activities.
* Develop marketing initiatives that encourage Service Provider registrations, activation and participation.
* Identify opportunities for hyperlocal marketing, neighbourhood engagement and community-driven promotions.
* Conduct competitor research and monitor market trends, consumer behaviour and emerging marketing opportunities.
* Collaborate with management and internal teams to align marketing initiatives with business growth objectives.

**7. Community Engagement & Online Reputation Management**

* Monitor social media comments, direct messages, brand mentions, app reviews and public feedback.
* Encourage meaningful audience interactions and build an engaged digital community.
* Identify recurring customer concerns and communicate relevant insights to internal teams.
* Coordinate with the Customer Support team to ensure appropriate and timely handling of customer concerns.
* Maintain a positive, authentic and consistent brand presence across digital platforms.

**8. Analytics & Performance Reporting**

* Track marketing performance using Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Meta Business Suite and relevant app analytics tools.
* Monitor key performance indicators, including reach, engagement, app installs, registrations, activation, conversions, customer acquisition costs and retention.
* Analyse campaign effectiveness beyond impressions, likes and follower counts.
* Prepare regular marketing performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.
* Continuously refine marketing strategies based on data, audience feedback and business outcomes.

**What We're Looking For**

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* 3–5 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, social media marketing, performance marketing, content marketing or related roles.
* Strong hands-on experience in independently conceptualising, shooting and editing videos.
* Ability to transform creative ideas into engaging, relatable and impactful digital content.

1. Job Purpose

CM Interior Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is seeking a capable and target-driven Sales Manager to oversee sales operations and expand the company's presence in the office and commercial furniture market. The candidate will be responsible for driving revenue growth, developing new client accounts, managing sales activities, guiding the sales team, and maintaining strong business relationships with corporate customers and industry professionals.

2. Roles & Responsibilities

**A. Sales Development & Market Expansion**

* Establish sales plans and business development approaches to meet organisational targets.
* Explore opportunities to expand the company's customer base in the commercial furniture sector.
* Build professional networks with corporate clients, startups, co-working operators, architects, interior designers, and construction firms.
* Research potential markets and identify new customer groups for business expansion.
* Develop sales leads through professional networking, customer references, direct outreach, and market visits.
* Review market conditions and competitor strategies to identify potential business opportunities.

**B. Customer Handling & Business Relationships**

* Connect with prospective customers to understand their furniture requirements and project needs.
* Suggest suitable furniture products based on customer preferences, budgets, and specifications.
* Arrange product demonstrations, business meetings, and showroom appointments.
* Maintain regular communication with existing customers and prospective business accounts.
* Manage customer enquiries, prepare quotations, conduct follow-ups, and convert opportunities into orders.
* Address customer issues and coordinate with the concerned teams for timely solutions.

**C. Product Promotion & Commercial Negotiations**

* Maintain updated knowledge of office furniture ranges, including workstations, ergonomic chairs, conference furniture, storage systems, and modular office solutions.
* Communicate product details, specifications, pricing, and benefits effectively to customers.
* Oversee the preparation of quotations, proposals, and commercial offers.
* Negotiate pricing, payment conditions, and other business terms within the company's approved limits.
* Track competitor products, market pricing, and changing customer demands.

**D. Sales Team Supervision & Performance**

* Manage the day-to-day activities of the sales team and ensure achievement of assigned targets.
* Distribute leads and allocate sales responsibilities among team members.
* Review individual performance, client interactions, and sales conversion progress.
* Organise periodic team meetings to review targets, discuss challenges, and plan sales activities.
* Provide guidance and support to improve the team's selling capabilities.
* Participate in the selection and training of sales employees when necessary.

**E. Order Follow-up & Internal Coordination**

* Work with procurement, purchase, suppliers, and execution teams to process customer orders.
* Track order progress, product readiness, dispatch, delivery, and installation schedules.
* Ensure coordination between customers and internal teams from enquiry to order completion.
* Monitor pending customer payments and follow up with the accounts department.
* Ensure that customer requirements and agreed delivery commitments are properly communicated and fulfilled.

**F. Sales Monitoring & Management Reporting**

* Maintain an updated database of prospects, enquiries, quotations, customer accounts, and sales orders.
* Review sales activities and prepare regular performance reports for management.
* Monitor revenue targets, order confirmations, conversion ratios, and sales pipeline progress.
* Prepare sales projections and business development updates.
* Identify areas of underperformance and recommend suitable corrective actions.
* Undertake other sales-related duties assigned by management.

3. Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.

4. Experience

* Experience in sales, business development, or sales team management.
* Background in office furniture, commercial furniture, or interior product sales will be preferred.
* Experience handling B2B clients and corporate accounts is an added advantage.

5. Required Skills

* Sales planning and business growth strategies.
* B2B sales and corporate client acquisition.
* Customer relationship and account management.
* Knowledge of office furniture products.
* Team management and sales target monitoring.
* Negotiation and presentation skills.
* Sales reporting and business analysis.
* Communication, coordination, and problem-solving abilities.

* **Location:** Kochi, Kerala

description:
About Esperer Motors

Esperer Motors is a premium automotive aftermarket company headquartered in Kochi, Kerala. Esperer Motors designs and develops its own body kits, spoilers, side skirts, splitters, diffusers and interior accessories for popular Indian and imported cars.

We are also authorised partners for global performance brands including Brembo, Eibach, EBC, BMC, H&R, DGR, MTS Technik, Forge, Blüsteine and Brake Kraft, and sell through retail, a tiered dealer network and export markets.

Role summary

We are hiring a Sales Executive to grow sales of Esperer Motors products through face-to-face selling. You will visit car accessory shops, detailing studios, body shops, workshops, dealerships and car clubs to demonstrate Esperer Motors body kits, spoilers, skirts and interior accessories, win new dealers and installers, and close orders.

This is a target-driven, on-the-ground role for someone who loves cars, enjoys meeting people and can turn a product demo into a sale.

Key responsibilities

Field sales & product promotion

* Meet customers, shop owners and installers face to face to present and demonstrate Esperer Motors body kits, spoilers, side skirts, splitters and interior accessories
* Explain fitment, materials, finish and value versus competing products; carry samples, catalogues and fitment photos
* Generate and close orders from retail customers, accessory shops, detailing studios and body shops
* Follow up on leads from the website, Instagram, WhatsApp and IndiaMART with in-person visits

Dealer & installer network development

* Identify, onboard and grow new dealers and Authorised Installers in the assigned territory
* Manage existing dealer accounts: stock levels, display, reorders, schemes and payment follow-up
* Train dealer and workshop staff on Esperer Motors products, fitment and selling points
* Coordinate with the installation team to ensure smooth fitment and customer satisfaction

Events & brand activation

* Represent Esperer Motors at auto expos, car meets, club drives and in-store activations
* Build relationships with car clubs, influencers and modification enthusiasts in the region

Customer relationships & reporting

* Build long-term relationships with customers and dealers for repeat orders and referrals
* Handle after-sales queries and coordinate quick resolution with the service team
* Update visits, leads and orders in the CRM and submit a weekly sales report
* Share competitor pricing, new products and customer feedback from the market with the team

Targets & KPIs

KPI Measure

Monthly sales Esperer Motors product revenue against monthly target (₹)

Field visits Number of customer / dealer visits per week

New dealers & installers New accounts onboarded per month

Lead conversion % of leads and visits converted to orders

Collections Payments collected on time against outstanding

Reporting CRM updated daily; weekly report submitted on time

Exact numeric targets to be set by the BDM at joining and reviewed quarterly.

Required skills & qualifications

* 1–4 years of field sales experience, ideally in automotive accessories, car care, tyres or spare parts
* Confident face-to-face communicator with strong presentation, negotiation and closing skills
* Genuine interest in cars and modifications; able to talk fitment and styling with enthusiasts
* Comfortable with targets, daily travel and a high volume of visits
* Basic computer skills: Excel / Google Sheets, CRM and WhatsApp Business
* Ability to track numbers and present simple sales reports
* Fluent Malayalam and English; Tamil, Kannada or Hindi is a plus
* Own two-wheeler and valid driving licence

Preferred / nice to have

* Existing network of accessory shops, body shops, detailing studios or car dealerships in Kerala
* Knowledge of body kit materials (ABS, PP, FRP, carbon fibre) and installation basics
* Experience with B2B dealer sales and distributor schemes
* Active presence in car clubs or the automotive enthusiast community
* Four-wheeler driving licence

What we offer

* Salary of ₹20,000 – ₹25,000 per month plus performance incentives
* Travel and fuel allowance for field visits
* Product and fitment training on Esperer Motors products and partner brands
* Clear growth path to Senior Sales Executive and Area Sales Manager
* The chance to build a home-grown performance brand alongside world-class names

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Recruitment Manager to lead and manage the company's end-to-end recruitment operations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing effective hiring strategies, managing recruitment teams, ensuring timely fulfilment of manpower requirements, and building a strong talent pipeline for our retail showrooms and corporate departments across Kerala.

The candidate should have strong expertise in volume hiring, retail recruitment, talent acquisition, team management, and recruitment analytics.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Recruitment Strategy & Planning**

* Develop and implement effective recruitment strategies aligned with business requirements.
* Prepare monthly and annual manpower recruitment plans.
* Coordinate with department heads and store managers to identify staffing requirements.
* Ensure timely fulfilment of vacancies across all retail outlets and corporate departments.
* Maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future requirements.

**2. End-to-End Talent Acquisition**

* Manage the complete recruitment cycle, from sourcing candidates to final onboarding.
* Handle bulk hiring for retail sales executives, senior sales executives, store managers, cashiers, and other positions.
* Manage recruitment for corporate roles, including Finance, Accounts, Marketing, Inventory, Purchase, and Management positions.
* Conduct initial screening, interviews, salary negotiations, and offer management.
* Ensure proper candidate follow-ups to improve offer-to-joining conversion.

**3. Recruitment Team Management**

* Lead, monitor, and guide the recruitment team.
* Allocate hiring targets and responsibilities to team members.
* Track daily recruitment activities and individual recruiter performance.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide necessary training.
* Improve recruiter productivity and overall hiring efficiency.

**4. Recruitment Performance & MIS**

* Monitor recruitment KPIs, including:
* Leads generated
* Candidate screening and shortlisting
* Interviews scheduled and attended
* Offers released
* Candidates joined
* Offer-to-joining conversion ratio
* Cost per hire
* Time to hire
* Recruitment source effectiveness
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment reports.
* Analyse recruitment bottlenecks and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure recruitment targets are achieved within the approved budget.

**5. Sourcing & Employer Branding**

* Explore effective hiring channels such as Naukri, LinkedIn, Apna, Indeed, referrals, social media, and walk-in interviews.
* Develop local recruitment networks across Kerala.
* Organise recruitment drives, walk-in interviews, and campus hiring activities.
* Strengthen the company's employer brand to attract quality candidates.

**6. Onboarding & Employee Coordination**

* Ensure smooth coordination between recruitment and HR operations.
* Monitor joining formalities and new employee onboarding.
* Maintain candidate databases and recruitment documentation.
* Follow up with newly joined employees to monitor joining stability and early attrition.
* Coordinate with store managers to ensure smooth manpower deployment.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* MBA in HR will be an added advantage.
* Minimum 5–7 years of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition.
* At least 2–3 years of experience in recruitment team management or leadership.
* Strong experience in bulk hiring and multi-location recruitment.
* Retail, footwear, fashion, FMCG, or other high-volume recruitment experience preferred.
* Excellent knowledge of recruitment portals, sourcing strategies, and recruitment MIS.

Required Skills

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent communication and negotiation abilities.
* Strong analytical and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Target-oriented and result-driven approach.
* Good knowledge of Excel, Google Sheets, and recruitment reporting.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet strict hiring deadlines.
* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of monthly recruitment targets.
* Reduction in time-to-hire.
* Improvement in interview-to-offer conversion.
* Improvement in offer-to-joining ratio.
* Reduction in early employee attrition.
* Recruitment team productivity and performance.
* Cost-effective sourcing and recruitment.
* Timely fulfilment of approved manpower requirements.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a proactive, accountable, and performance-driven Recruitment Manager who can independently manage high-volume recruitment operations, lead a recruitment team, and ensure consistent manpower availability across multiple locations.

The candidate must have the ability to build recruitment systems, improve hiring processes, take ownership of recruitment targets, and support the company's expansion plans.

ROLE SUMMARY Drincity Healthtech Solutions is looking for a Field Executive with 1–2 years of experience to carry out daily market visits, generate leads and support the onboarding of hospitals, clinics, doctors, pharmacies and distributors in the assigned territory. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS • 1–2 years of experience in field sales, medical representative work or healthcare / diagnostics / medical device / healthtech sales. • Good knowledge of the local city and its hospital, clinic and pharmacy network; existing doctor contacts are an advantage. • Good communication and convincing skills in Hindi and the local language; working English for reporting. • Self-motivated, disciplined and comfortable with daily field work and travel within the territory.DRINCITY Healthtech Solutions • Comfortable using a smartphone for GPS attendance, WhatsApp, Google Sheets / forms and basic reporting apps. • Own two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred. 4. PERFORMANCE MEASURES • Daily and monthly field visits completed against target. • Number of new leads generated and new customers onboarded. • Sales achieved against the monthly target. • Reporting discipline: daily reports and GPS-enabled attendance submitted on time. • Customer feedback and relationship quality. 5. title: Project Manager
description:
**About Orange Elephant Interiors**

Orange Elephant Interiors Pvt. Ltd. is a Chennai-based turnkey interior fit-out and construction firm with its own manufacturing facility in Ambattur. We design, make and install interiors for residential, commercial and office clients, working closely with architects. Our in-house factory means the site team, the drawing team and the factory work as one chain, from measurement to handover.

Office: near American Tourister, RK Salai, Chennai, within walking distance of the Lighthouse railway station | Factory: Ambattur, Chennai

Our website – http://www.orangeelephant.in/

Our Instagram Page - https://www.instagram.com/orangeelephant.interiors/?hl=en

**Who are we looking for?**

We are looking for an experienced **Project Manager** to own every assigned interior fit-out project from handover by Estimation to final handover to the client. In this role, you will define the scope, budget and schedule, identify risks, lead the site team and vendors, coordinate with our factory, keep the client and architect informed, and report progress and variances to the Directors every week.

The Project Manager is part of the Projects department, reports to the Directors, and is a full-time role based in Chennai, working across our office, factory and project sites.

Our ideal candidate has run multiple fit-out projects at once and delivered them on time and within budget. They spot risks early and have a plan ready, document everything (minutes, reports, photos and approvals), and deal confidently with clients, architects, vendors and a factory team.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Project setup and planning**

* Reviewing the scope of work, drawings and approved quote with Estimation, and clarifying requirements with the client and architect where needed.
* Setting the project budget, resource requirements, work plan, schedule and milestones.
* Verifying site measurements and site marking, including electrical marking, before work starts.
* Giving the Factory Manager the production schedule at least one week ahead, and updating the weekly factory schedule.

**Risk management**

* Identifying project risks such as material lead times, vendor availability, client approval delays and design changes.
* Maintaining a risk register with mitigation and contingency plans, and acting early to reduce or remove risks.

**Site execution and quality**

* Leading day-to-day site execution as per approved drawings, BOQ and specifications.
* Supervising site engineers and supervisors, and giving clear instructions and direction to meet project goals.
* Checking measurements, light and plumbing fittings, and tile and granite quantities against approvals.
* Carrying out quality checks as per the QC schedule and taking site decisions that protect work speed and quality.

**Vendors and procurement**

* Maintaining a pre-qualified vendor list, comparing vendor quotes with Estimation, and building alternate vendors and manpower.
* Giving vendors schedules and checking that they are followed.
* Ensuring timely release of vendor POs and raw material POs, and checking them.
* Checking that vendors have the right material and labour at site, and verifying supply quantity and quality.
* Checking and approving vendor final bills, and raising vendor payment requests as per work completion.

**Factory coordination**

* Checking job cards against site dimensions.
* Coordinating time schedules with the Factory Manager and making sure raw material reaches the factory on schedule.
* Passing installation and QC issues to the Factory Manager by email.
* Ensuring on-time, good-quality dispatch and installation of woodwork.

**Client and architect communication**

* Running the communication plan: coordinating and attending weekly client meetings with the Directors, and minuting all site meetings.
* Communicating delays and revised dates to clients and architects in writing.
* Presenting project information clearly to clients, architects and the Directors.

**Cost and progress control**

* Tracking progress against the approved budget, schedule and milestones.
* Preparing and checking M-Books and preparing client billing.
* Sending a weekly variance report (planned vs actual progress and cost) to the Directors, with an action plan to recover schedule or budget.

**Documentation and governance**

* Keeping project documents accurate, timely and coordinated: drawing register, signed paper drawing sets, approvals log, change and variation log, M-Books and the site register or WhatsApp group.
* Making sure every client and architect approval is documented before work proceeds.

**Snagging, handover and safety**

* Preparing and completing snag lists with client and architect approval, and arranging manpower to close them.
* Handing over the site, with bills, to the client.
* Conducting the site pooja, and enforcing site safety and cleanliness.

**Team leadership**

* Planning and monitoring staffing and labour use, including overtime, and managing third-party vendors and subcontractors.
* Hiring site engineers and supervisors with Finance Director approval, and mentoring and coaching the team.
* Conducting monthly assessments of site supervisors’ performance.
* Leading by example and modelling the company’s values.

**Key Skills and Qualifications:**

* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Interior Design or a related field.
* Minimum 10 years’ experience in interior fit-out execution, including at least 3 years leading projects independently.
* Supervisory ability to manage engineers, supervisors and vendors across several sites.
* Excellent written and spoken communication, and the ability to read and apply contracts, work orders, BOQs, drawings and approvals.
* Confidence with budgets, billing, vendor payments, retention, margins and variance calculations.
* Ability to analyse documents and solve problems with several options, with intermediate analytical and quantitative skills.
* Intermediate skills in MS Project (or similar scheduling software), Excel and MS Office, and the ability to read AutoCAD drawings.
* Strong knowledge of joinery, finishes, MEP coordination and installation techniques.

Application Question(s):

* Do you have a Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Interior Design or a related field?
* Do you have a minimum of 10 years’ experience in interior fit-out execution, including at least 3 years leading projects independently?
* Are you proficient in MS Project (or similar scheduling software), Excel and MS Office?
* Do you have the ability to read AutoCAD drawings?
