title: Project Manager
description:
**Project Manager – Interior Fit-Out & Execution**

**We are looking for a Project Manager who is an Interior Designer experience because this is for an Interior Projects**

**End-to-End Site Leadership • Mid-to-Large Scale Turnkey Interiors • Full Schedule & Budget Ownership**

**Location: Thane West**

**Salary: 45,000/- to 55,000/- Per Month or can be also discussed**

**Required Number of Work Experienced in Interior Designing: 3+ years**

**ROLE OVERVIEW**  
Our client (headquartered at Wagle Industrial Estate, Thane West) is seeking a high-energy, decisive, and relentless Project Manager to take complete end-to-end ownership of mid-to-large-scale interior fit-out projects from mobilization to handover. This role requires a commanding site leader with a strong personality who thrives under pressure, resolves bottlenecks in real time, and drives contractors, vendors, and internal teams to meet aggressive deadlines. You will hold full accountability for delivering projects on time, within budget, and to exact quality standards—including working extended or late-night site hours whenever critical project milestones demand it.

**CORE PERSONALITY & BEHAVIORAL TRAITS**

**▪ Driver & Go-Getter Mentality:** Proactive, action-oriented executor who pushes back firmly against delays, excuses, or subpar workmanship on site.

**▪ Commanding Site Presence:** Strong interpersonal authority capable of leading diverse labor teams, subcontractors, building management, and vendors simultaneously.

**▪ High Resilience Under Pressure:** Calm, decisive problem-solver who thrives in fast-paced environments with tight, non-negotiable handover dates.

**▪ Extreme Ownership:** Treats project timelines and budgets as personal commitments; willingly stays late at site during critical installations, snags, and handover sprints.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. End-to-End Project Execution & Schedule Control**

**▪ Master Schedule Ownership:** Own the master project schedule (Gantt charts and micro-schedules) from site mobilization through civil, MEP, HVAC, carpentry, finishing, and final client handover.

**▪ Daily Site Cadence:** Lead morning and evening site huddles to assign daily targets, detect schedule slippage early, and execute immediate recovery plans.

**▪ Cross-Team Coordination:** Align design teams, structural/MEP consultants, mall/building management, and site execution crews to prevent drawing or statutory approval bottlenecks.

**▪ Extended & Night Shift Leadership:** Supervise high-intensity night shifts and extended site operations during noisy/restricted work windows, critical installations, and pre-handover sprints.

**2. Client Communication & Progress Reporting**

**▪ Weekly Client Updates:** Deliver structured weekly project progress updates to the client covering milestone achievements, visual site progress reports, upcoming look-ahead schedules, pending client approvals, and risk mitigation plans.

**▪ Primary Site Point of Contact:** Maintain transparent, proactive communication with client representatives on site to build trust and ensure rapid decision-making.

**3. Budget, Cost & Commercial Accountability**

**▪ Full P&L & BOQ Control:** Hold complete financial responsibility for project execution, ensuring all site works stay strictly within the approved Bill of Quantities (BOQ) and budget.

**▪ Wastage & Overrun Prevention:** Monitor daily material consumption, eliminate site wastage, and flag potential cost variances before they impact margins.

**▪ Billing & Variations:** Verify contractor measurements, audit running account (RA) bills, manage variation orders (VOs), and ensure accurate commercial sign-offs.

**4. Contractor, Vendor & Supply Chain Management**

**▪ Vendor Accountability:** Enforce strict performance standards across civil, electrical, HVAC, fire-fighting, modular furniture, and bespoke joinery contractors.

**▪ Long-Lead Material Tracking:** Coordinate closely with procurement so imported finishes, lighting, glass, and custom millwork arrive on site aligned with the installation sequence.

**▪ Rapid Bottleneck Resolution:** Resolve vendor disputes, manpower shortages, and material rejections decisively on site without stalling workflow.

**5. Quality Assurance, Safety & Handover**

**▪ Zero-Rework Quality Checks:** Enforce stage-wise quality inspections (concealed MEP, framing, substrate prep, final finishes) so defects are caught before snagging.

**▪ EHS & Site Compliance:** Maintain strict site safety, housekeeping, and building management compliance throughout execution.

**▪ Snagging & Final Handover:** Drive aggressive snagging and de-snagging closure to achieve clean client sign-off alongside complete as-built drawings, warranties, and handover dossiers.

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

**▪ Experience:** Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience managing mid-to-large-scale commercial, retail, hospitality, or luxury residential interior fit-out projects.

**▪ Education:** Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, or Construction Management.

**▪ Technical Proficiency:** Strong ability to interpret AutoCAD architectural, structural, and MEP shop drawings; proficient in MS Project / Primavera, MS Excel (BOQ/cost tracking), and site reporting tools.

**▪ Domain Expertise:** Deep practical knowledge of turnkey interior finishes, custom millwork, false ceilings, flooring, MEP integration, and building NOC/compliance workflows.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS)**

**KPI AREA**

**TARGET & MEASUREMENT STANDARD**

**On-Time Project Delivery**

100% adherence to committed project handover milestones and critical path dates.

**Budget & Margin Adherence**

Zero unapproved budget overruns; strict control over material wastage and variations.

**Client Reporting Discipline**

100% on-time delivery of structured weekly client progress updates and look-ahead trackers.

**First-Time-Right Quality**

Minimal post-handover snags and rapid de-snagging closure prior to client sign-off.

**Site Execution Velocity**

High daily target completion rate and immediate resolution of vendor or technical bottlenecks.

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹55,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
**Company Description**

**Who is Turner & Townsend?**

All over the world people are using buildings, infrastructure, and assets we helped to deliver. It could be the hospital they work in, the railway they travel on every day, the fuel that powers their car or the data centre they depend on at work. For more than 75 years we’ve been helping to deliver transformational programmes across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors, making a difference to people’s lives and ensuring a return on investment for our clients and their investors.

**Our purpose:**

**Transforming performance for a green, inclusive, and productive world.**

The world is changing and we have a responsibility to support that change, helping drive it and be part of it. Through the commitment, capability and care our team brings, we build trust between clients, suppliers, governments and society. Delivering better outcomes that have a positive impact on the world around us. We work smarter to face the challenges of the future; bringing the clarity that helps teams realise their full potential across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors. It’s how we’ve made the difference for more than 75 years.

**Our values:**

**Love a challenge:** We love a challenge and we work hard to make change happen and see things through. We don’t stand still, challenging ourselves and others to do better every day. And we are trusted to do the right thing, raising standards all the time.

**Stronger together:** We’re stronger together by connecting people in diverse teams, so that we can all collaborate to deliver our best work. We focus on what matters and use our influence to build a better world for everyone.

**Bring out the best in everyone:** We bring out the best in everyone. We help each other to make the most of our potential, always learning from our experience. We treat each other with care and respect and make time to give everyone a voice

 **Job Description**

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced **Data Centre Project Lead** to oversee end-to-end delivery of large-scale data centre projects from planning through commissioning and handover. The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in managing hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, or mission-critical facilities, with strong expertise in project execution, stakeholder management, construction management, and data centre infrastructure systems.

The role requires leadership across multidisciplinary teams to ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with quality, operational, and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Delivery

* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and successful delivery of data centre projects.
* Manage the complete project lifecycle including design coordination, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, and handover.
* Establish project execution strategies, milestones, budgets, and resource plans.
* Drive project performance against cost, schedule, quality, and safety objectives.

Stakeholder & Client Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders.
* Conduct regular project reviews and provide executive-level reporting on project progress, risks, and mitigation plans.
* Ensure alignment of project objectives with client business requirements.

Design & Technical Coordination

* Review and coordinate civil, structural, architectural, MEP, and specialist data centre designs.
* Ensure compliance with Uptime Institute, Tier requirements, TIA-942, local statutory regulations, and client specifications.
* Facilitate resolution of technical and construction-related challenges.

Construction & Site Management

* Oversee site execution activities and contractor performance.
* Ensure adherence to quality standards, construction methodologies, and project schedules.
* Monitor key project deliverables and proactively address schedule risks.

Testing, Commissioning & Handover

* Lead integrated systems testing (IST), commissioning activities, and operational readiness assessments.
* Coordinate with commissioning consultants, OEMs, and facility teams.
* Ensure successful handover of facilities with complete documentation and compliance records.

Commercial & Risk Management

* Monitor project budgets, change management, contract administration, and financial performance.
* Identify project risks and implement mitigation plans.
* Manage claims, variations, and commercial negotiations where required.

Health, Safety & Quality

* Champion a strong safety culture across all project activities.
* Ensure compliance with HSE policies, statutory requirements, and quality management standards.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and lessons learned programs.

  
**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-PgMP, or equivalent project management certification preferred.
* Additional certifications in Data Centres, Commissioning, or Mission Critical Facilities will be advantageous.

Experience Requirements

* 16–18 years of experience in project management, construction management, or PMC services.
* Proven experience delivering large-scale data centre projects, mission-critical facilities, hyperscale campuses, or colocation facilities.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and multiple stakeholders across project phases.
* Strong exposure to MEP systems, power infrastructure, cooling systems, redundancy architecture, commissioning, and operational readiness.

  
**Additional Information**

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

SecNinjaz is renowned for providing world-class IT services and cybersecurity solutions globally. Founded in 2018, SecNinjaz has evolved into a leading cybersecurity force, combining the agility and innovation of a startup with the expertise and depth of seasoned professionals.

  

We serve clients across various industries, including Healthcare, Fintech, Manufacturing, Telecom, Infrastructure, and e-commerce. Our solutions are always customised, future-ready, and designed to blend technical excellence, innovation, and a deep commitment to protecting the digital world.

  

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Technical Project Manager — SecNinjaz Technologies LLP**
==========================================================

**New Delhi · Fully on-site · Full-time · 6+ years · B.Tech / MCA or equivalent**

**About us**
------------

SecNinjaz is a cybersecurity and AI solutions company serving enterprise, BFSI and government clients across India. We build and deliver AI products, security platforms and compliance programmes, often for on-premise and air-gapped environments. We are becoming an AI-native company, where AI agents are part of how work gets done every day.

**The role**
------------

You'll own delivery across several parallel product and client projects, from requirements to production acceptance. You'll lead a small delivery team and report directly to the Founder & CTO. This is not a coordination role — you own the plan, the risks and the outcome.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Turn requirements and RFPs into baselined plans: scope, WBS, milestones, Gantt charts and dependencies.
* Support RFP and tender responses with effort estimates and delivery plans.
* Run delivery cadences and keep GitLab as the single source of truth for status.
* Manage risks, issues and change control with written impact on time, cost and quality.
* Track budget, utilisation and SLAs alongside scope and dates.
* Produce audit-ready delivery evidence aligned to CMMI, ISO standards and CERT-In requirements.
* Coordinate QA, testing and client acceptance cycles, including STQC.
* Run security engagements (VAPT, audits, red-team) from scoping to report walkthrough, as assigned.
* Act as the delivery point of contact for government and enterprise clients.
* Lead and coach your delivery team, and help hire as the team grows.
* Use AI tools daily, and help design agent workflows that automate routine project management work.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 6+ years in software delivery, including 3+ years managing technical projects end to end.
* Delivery experience on at least one Indian government or PSU project.
* Experience leading a delivery team.
* At least 3 delivered projects you can walk through in detail, including what went wrong.
* Enough engineering depth to challenge an estimate: architecture, APIs, CI/CD, containers, on-prem deployment.
* Hands-on with Agile/Scrum and plan-driven delivery.
* Experience producing evidence for CMMI, ISO or similar audits.
* Clear written English and confidence with senior stakeholders.
* Discretion with confidential client information.

**Good to have**
----------------

* GeM procurement and STQC testing experience.
* AI/ML or cybersecurity project delivery (VAPT, audits, SOC).
* BFSI client experience.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum or similar certification; CEH or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.
* Diagrams-as-code (Mermaid, PlantUML).
* Hindi.

**Why SecNinjaz**
-----------------

* Real ownership, working directly with the founder.
* Work on AI, video analytics and security systems used by government and enterprise clients.
* Shape how an AI-native company runs delivery.
* Certification support and a clear growth path into senior delivery leadership.

title: Lead Implementation Consultant [CRM BFSI]
description:
**Role :**
Lead Implementation Consultant [CRM BFSI]
  
  
**About LeadSquared**
One of the fastest growing SaaS companies in the CRM space, LeadSquared empowers organizations with the power of automation. More than 1800+ customers with 2.50 lakhs users across the globe utilize the LeadSquared platform to automate their sales and marketing processes and run high velocity sales at scale.
  
  
Known for its verticalized, industry-centric solutions, LeadSquared serves EdTech, Education, Healthcare, BFSI, Real Estate, Automotive, and Hospitality industries. The company is headquartered in Bengaluru with a local presence in New Jersey, Philippines, South Africa, Australia, and Indonesia.
  
  
**The Role**
We are looking for a seasoned Implementation Leader to drive large-scale deployments of LeadSquared’s platform. This role will own end-to-end delivery, stakeholder management, and team leadership, ensuring successful implementation, adoption, and long-term customer success.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Regional Delivery Ownership (North India)**

* Own end-to-end implementation delivery for clients across North India
* Manage multiple high-value projects, ensuring timelines, quality, and customer satisfaction
* Act as the escalation point for critical client issues within the region

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong relationships with enterprise clients and key stakeholders
* Lead requirement discussions, solution design, and implementation strategy
* Drive customer success outcomes and ensure high retention & expansion

**Team Leadership & People Management**

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Implementation Consultants across North India
* Drive hiring, onboarding, and capability building within the team
* Allocate resources effectively and ensure optimal team utilization
* Set performance goals and conduct regular reviews

**Solutioning & Implementation**

* Translate complex business requirements into scalable CRM solutions
* Design workflows, automations, and integrations using LeadSquared platform
* Ensure adherence to implementation best practices and standard frameworks

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams for seamless delivery
* Support pre-sales for enterprise deals requiring complex solutioning
* Provide feedback to product teams based on regional client needs

**Requirements**

* 4–8 years of experience in SaaS implementation/CRM delivery
* Strong experience in managing enterprise implementations
* Proven experience in team handling and regional ownership
* Hands-on experience with CRM platforms
* Strong understanding of sales, marketing, and operational workflows
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

**Why Should You Apply?**

* Fast-paced environment with exposure to leading Banks, NBFCs, and FinTech lenders
* Accelerated growth & rewards based on deal closures and revenue targets
* Easily approachable management with direct access to leadership
* Work with the best minds in lending technology and industry leaders
* Flexible work timings with hybrid working options
* Opportunity to work on complex, large-scale implementations
* Collaborative and high-growth culture

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Project Role :**
Business Analyst
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Analyze an organization and design its processes and systems, assessing the business model and its integration with technology. Assess current state, identify customer requirements, and define the future state and/or business solution. Research, gather and synthesize information.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Openlink Endur Functional
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Business Analyst, a typical day involves thoroughly examining the structure and operations of an organization to understand how its processes and systems function together. This role requires evaluating the existing business model and how it aligns with technological components. The day includes identifying the needs of customers and stakeholders, envisioning improved future states or solutions, and conducting detailed research to collect and integrate relevant information. Collaboration with various teams to ensure a comprehensive understanding of the business environment and its challenges is also a key part of daily activities.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Facilitate communication between business units and technical teams to ensure alignment of objectives.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing business processes and recommending enhancements.
* Support junior team members by providing guidance and sharing knowledge to foster professional growth.

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Openlink Endur Functional.
* Strong analytical skills to interpret complex business requirements and translate them into functional specifications.
* Excellent communication abilities to effectively liaise between business stakeholders and technical teams.
* Experience in process mapping and business process re-engineering to optimize workflows.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work collaboratively in a dynamic environment.
* Skilled in problem-solving and decision-making to address challenges and deliver practical solutions.

Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 7.5 years of experience in Openlink Endur Functional.
* This position is based at our Gurugram office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Scrum Master
description:
We are looking for a highly accomplished Scrum Master to join the GEDU IT Engineering Team at our Noida office. The ideal candidate should have prior experience working as a Scrum Master within a software product development environment, with hands-on expertise in Agile methodologies.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Helping the product owner and development team to achieve customer satisfaction.
* Lead the scrum and development teams in self-organization.
* Coordinate sprints, retrospective meetings, and daily stand-ups
* Facilitate internal communication and effective collaboration.
* Remove impediments and coach the scrum team on removing impediments!
* Help the scrum and development teams to identify and fill in blanks in the Agile framework.
* Resolve conflicts and issues that occur.
* Help the scrum team achieve higher levels of scrum maturity.
* Support the product owner and provide education where needed.
* Help build a productive environment where team members ‘own’ the product and enjoy working on it.

**Skills**
**Essential Skills**

* Ability to analyse and think quickly and to resolve conflict.
* Excellent knowledge of Scrum techniques and artifacts (such as definition of done, user stories, automated testing, backlog refinement)
* Knowledgeable in techniques to fill in gaps in the scrum.
* Experience with successful Agile techniques
* Strong communication, interpersonal and mentoring skills
* Ability to adapt to a changing environment.
* Self-motivation and ability to stay focused in the middle of distraction.
* Prior experience of using Agile Project Management tools like JIRA, Azure DevOps Boards
* Prior experience of using the right Agile metrics like Velocity and terms in Sprint burn down, Epic and release, Control charts, Cumulative flow diagram etc.
* Prior experience working with global clients.
* Prior experience of development in .Net Technology Stack
* Must have certifications like PSM I, PSM II, CSM, Agile SAFe (at least one is required).

**Experience**

* 6+ years of overall experience in IT and software development environments.
* Minimum 3+ years of experience working as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach.
* Proven experience within software product development organizations.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams and stakeholders.

**Education**
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Applications, or a related discipline (BE / B.Tech / MCA / M.Tech or equivalent).

title: Sales Specialist
description:
The Sales Executive will be the first point of contact for customers exploring trips with Dream On Travel, responsible for understanding their travel needs, answering questions with confidence, and converting inquiries into confirmed bookings. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role centred on individual sales performance handling your own pipeline of leads from first contact through to a happy, booked traveller. The consultant will manage day-to-day follow-ups, resolve customer doubts around pricing and itineraries, and ensure every interaction reflects the warmth and reliability Dream On Travel is known for. Success in this role is measured primarily by personal conversion rate, responsiveness, and the quality of the customer experience you deliver.

**Key Expectation**

You are expected to independently manage a steady volume of inbound and outbound leads, respond quickly and accurately to customer questions, and consistently convert a healthy share of inquiries into bookings. You'll work within sales scripts, pricing guidelines, and follow-up cadences set by the leadership team, executing them well rather than designing them from scratch. You're expected to flag patterns you notice recurring objections, drop-off points, customer feedback to your manager, even though refining the overall strategy isn't your responsibility at this level.

**Role Nature**

This is an individual-contributor role suited to someone early-to-mid in their sales career who enjoys talking to people, is comfortable on the phone and over chat, and is motivated by hitting personal targets. It's a strong fit for someone who wants to build deep travel-industry sales experience and grow into a leadership track over time, rather than someone looking to manage a team immediately.

**Key Responsibilities**

You will handle inbound customer inquiries across calls, WhatsApp, and social media, qualifying each lead and understanding what kind of trip, budget, and timeline the customer has in mind. You will explain trip itineraries, pricing, inclusions, and exclusions clearly enough that customers feel confident booking, and you will proactively follow up on warm leads using the cadence and templates provided by your manager rather than improvising your own. You will maintain accurate, up-to-date records of every lead and its status in the CRM or tracking sheet so nothing falls through the cracks, and you will coordinate with the operations team once a booking is confirmed to ensure the customer's details and preferences are handed off correctly. You'll also pass relevant customer feedback or recurring questions back to the marketing and leadership team, since you're closest to what customers are actually asking and objecting to.

**Requirements**

Candidates should be graduates in any field, with a specialisation in marketing, communication, or travel preferred. 3–5 years of experience in sales, telesales, or customer engagement is required, ideally including some direct phone-based selling. Proficiency in both Tamil and English is essential, along with clear, confident verbal communication. Basic comfort with CRM tools or lead-tracking spreadsheets, and the ability to stay organised across a high volume of conversations, will be important day to day.

**Other Important Details**

Experience: 3–5 years

Salary: ₹28,000 – ₹40,000/month

description:
**About the Company**

 

Jobin & Jismi is a fast-growing IT services and consulting firm specializing in Oracle NetSuite ERP solutions, eCommerce platforms, and emerging technologies such as AI, IoT, and robotics. With a strong global client base, the company delivers end-to-end business solutions including implementation, customization, integration, and ongoing support. Backed by a team of 200+ skilled professionals, Jobin & Jismi focuses on helping organizations streamline operations, improve efficiency, and accelerate their digital transformation journey across multiple industries.

 

**Job Overview**

 

We are looking for a highly experienced
**Senior NetSuite Techno-Functional Consultant / Solution Lead**
to take ownership of an existing, heavily customized NetSuite environment.
 

The ideal candidate should possess strong functional expertise across finance, procurement, order management and inventory, combined with the ability to independently read, analyze and explain SuiteScript 1.0 and 2.x code.
 

This role involves auditing existing customizations, understanding business processes, identifying optimization opportunities, leading technical and functional teams, and serving as the primary point of contact for client business stakeholders.
 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

**1. NetSuite Account Discovery & Technical Audit**

 

* Conduct a comprehensive audit of existing NetSuite customizations and configurations.
* Inventory and analyze User Event, Client, Scheduled, Map/Reduce, Suitelet and RESTlet scripts.
* Review existing workflows, custom records, fields, forms, Saved Searches and integrations.
* Read and interpret SuiteScript 1.0 and 2.x code to understand script logic, execution triggers, dependencies and business purpose.
* Trace transaction flows across multiple scripts and workflows.
* Prepare customization registers and process documentation.

**2. Functional Analysis & Business Engagement**

 

* Act as the primary point of contact for client business stakeholders across finance, operations and supply chain.
* Conduct requirement-gathering sessions, discovery workshops and business process walkthroughs.
* Translate technical findings into understandable business-process implications.
* Identify gaps between existing system functionality and business requirements.
* Recommend practical solutions aligned with standard NetSuite capabilities.

**3. Customization Optimization**

 

* Identify redundant, conflicting, failing or unnecessary scripts and workflows.
* Evaluate existing customizations and recommend whether to retire, consolidate, rebuild or replace them with native NetSuite functionality.
* Optimize Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C), inventory, fulfilment and financial processes.
* Assess customization dependencies, script execution order and governance limits.
* Develop an optimization roadmap with impact, effort and implementation priorities.
* Track measurable improvements such as reduced script complexity, faster transaction processing and fewer system errors.

**4. Functional & Technical Coordination**

 

* Translate business requirements into Functional Design Documents (FDDs) and technical specifications.
* Assign development and configuration tasks to technical and functional team members.
* Review technical designs and code deliverables for alignment with business requirements.
* Coordinate with developers on SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, integrations and other customizations.
* Own functional validation, UAT coordination and business sign-off.

**5. Integration & System Analysis**

 

* Review and assess existing RESTlet and SuiteTalk / REST web services integrations.
* Understand middleware integrations such as Celigo, Boomi or similar platforms.
* Evaluate EDI and third-party logistics (3PL) integration flows.
* Identify integration dependencies and potential system-performance issues.

**6. Project Governance & Team Leadership**

 

* Lead a team of NetSuite developers and functional consultants.
* Manage project scope, priorities, timelines and change requests.
* Establish release management processes between Sandbox and Production environments.
* Maintain technical and functional documentation, process maps and customization registers.
* Provide regular updates to client stakeholders and internal delivery leadership.

**Mandatory Skills & Technical Expertise**

 

* Minimum 7 years of overall ERP experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on NetSuite experience.
* Experience with at least 3 full-cycle NetSuite implementations or account rescue/optimization projects.
* Strong functional expertise in:
* Procure-to-Pay (P2P)
* Order-to-Cash (O2C)
* Inventory Management
* Fulfilment
* Core Financials – Accounts Receivable (AR), Accounts Payable (AP), General Ledger (GL) and Period Close.
* Ability to independently read, interpret and explain SuiteScript 1.0 and 2.x.
* Understanding of major SuiteScript types:
* User Event Scripts
* Client Scripts
* Scheduled Scripts
* Map/Reduce Scripts
* Suitelets
* RESTlets
* Strong knowledge of SuiteFlow, custom records, custom fields, custom forms and Saved Searches.

**Preferred Skills / Additional Qualifications**

Kaasma Private Limited is a wastewater management company committed to providing sustainable environmental solutions. We specialize in wastewater treatment systems and are dedicated to creating a cleaner, healthier and more sustainable future.

We are looking for enthusiastic and technically motivated freshers to join our team as **Project Management Technicians**.

The selected candidates will be involved in field-level project execution, site assessments, installation and commissioning of wastewater treatment plants (ETP). This role provides hands-on technical exposure, practical training and opportunities to grow into project coordination and management positions.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct site assessments and feasibility studies.
* Coordinate civil works at project sites.
* Coordinate electrical and plumbing installation activities.
* Assist in wastewater treatment plant installation, erection and commissioning.
* Coordinate with technicians, vendors, contractors and internal teams.
* Monitor project progress and ensure timely project execution.
* Ensure quality, safety and proper execution of assigned works.
* Prepare basic project reports and provide regular updates to the management.

* Basic knowledge of civil, electrical and plumbing works.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Basic problem-solving and organizational abilities.
* Must possess a two-wheeler and a valid driving license.

* **Starting Salary:** ₹12,000 per month + Travel Allowance.
* **Performance Incentives:** Project-based performance incentives of up to ₹20,000 per month after successful completion of the training period.

Training & Career Growth

Selected candidates will undergo practical, on-the-job training and gain exposure to live wastewater treatment plant projects.

**Career Progression:**

Technician → Project Coordinator → Assistant Manager → Manager

High-performing employees will have opportunities for structured promotions and leadership responsibilities based on their skills, performance and experience.

* Hands-on experience in real-world engineering projects.
* Practical technical training and field exposure.
* Performance-based earning opportunities.
* Clear career progression and promotion opportunities.
* Opportunity to develop project execution and management skills.
* Be part of a team working towards environmental sustainability.

**Email:** hr@kaasma.in  
**Contact:** +91 9526223444  
**Website:** www.kaasma.in

**Freshers are strongly encouraged to apply!**

Join Kaasma and build a sustainable future with us.

Pay: From ₹12,000.00 per month

description:

**Position Summary**
**Specialist Manager (Pursuit Design) - Pursuit CoE**
**Position Summary**
Deloitte is seeking an experienced Creative Strategist (Individual Contributor) to lead the creative vision and hands-on execution of high-impact pursuit collaterals across print and digital platforms. This role is ideal for a senior design professional who thrives as a maker, thinker, and visual storyteller, someone who can independently translate complex business ideas into compelling, brand-aligned creative solutions.
  
  
In this role, you will serve as the creative strategist for new business pursuits supporting Deloitte’s businesses. You will work closely with senior leaders, pursuit strategists, writers, and cross-functional teams to shape the visual narrative of pursuit materials, elevate design quality, and bring clarity to complex information through strong conceptual thinking and refined execution.
  
  
This is not a people-management role. Instead, it is a senior individual contributor role for a creative professional who sets direction through expertise, influence, innovation, and exceptional design craft. You will also help advance the team’s capabilities by exploring emerging tools, technologies, and GenAI-enabled design approaches.
  
  
**Work Responsibilities**

* Lead the creative direction and hands-on design development for high-priority new business pursuits, ensuring work is visually compelling, strategically grounded, and aligned to Deloitte’s brand.
* Conceptualize and produce sophisticated design collaterals across print and digital formats, including presentations, infographics, proposals, videos, and other pursuit-related sales assets.
* Translate complex business concepts, data, and messaging into clear, engaging visual communication that strengthens storytelling and client impact.
* Partner closely with senior leaders, pursuit teams, strategists, and cross-functional stakeholders to develop visual solutions that support business goals and elevate the quality of pursuit materials.
* Operate as a senior creative expert and trusted advisor, influencing outcomes through strong design judgment, executive presence, and strategic thinking.
* In collaboration with creative leadership, explore and apply emerging design technologies, platforms, and methodologies to keep work current, differentiated, and effective.
* Leverage advanced Generative AI tools to improve creative exploration, speed, quality, and innovation across complex design assignments.
* Maintain high standards of craft, consistency, and attention to detail while managing multiple deadlines in a fast-paced, pursuit-driven environment.
* Present and articulate creative concepts, rationale, and design recommendations to senior stakeholders with confidence and clarity.
* Contribute to a culture of creativity, experimentation, and continuous improvement through thought leadership, collaboration, and strong individual execution.

**Qualifications Required**

* Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA), BSc in Visual Communication, or related field.
* 11+ years of progressive experience in graphic design, visual communication, or creative direction, with a strong emphasis on hands-on execution.
* Demonstrated experience operating as a senior individual contributor in a high-performance creative or marketing environment.

* Strong understanding of Generative AI tools and their application within the creative and design process.

* Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working within established brand systems and implementing brand strategy across multiple formats.
* A strong portfolio that demonstrates conceptual strength, creative range, and excellence in solving complex communication challenges through design.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
Product Marketing Manager - Vihara

**Full-time · 6 days a week · Location: [remote]**

**About Vihara**

Vihara (vihara.ai) is building a smarter way for investors to find and buy real estate, working with auctioneers and brokers to bring bank-owned and auction properties to buyers who want them. We're a small, fast-moving team, and marketing here isn't a support function. It's how we grow.

**The role**

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager who can own growth end to end: figure out who we're talking to, what to say, where to say it, and how to make it work better every week. You'll sit right next to the product development team, shape how features get positioned and launched, and turn what we build into demand.

This is a high-ownership role. You won't be handed a playbook. You'll write it, run it, measure it, and fix it.

**What you'll own**

* **Growth.**
  Find the channels that work, run experiments, track the numbers, and double down on what moves them.
* **Positioning and launches.**
  Work with product to understand every feature, then decide how it's named, explained, and launched.
* **Content.**
  Write and ship content that people actually read: landing pages, blogs, guides, social posts, and product pages.
* **Paid ads.**
  Plan, build, and optimize campaigns on Meta, Google, and wherever our buyers are. Own the creative, the copy, the targeting, and the results.
* **Copywriting.**
  Headlines, ads, emails, onboarding, in-product text. Every word that faces a customer goes through you.
* **Email marketing.**
  Build lifecycle flows, newsletters, and outreach sequences that get opened, read, and acted on.
* **Design and taste.**
  Know good when you see it. Make (or direct) visuals, ads, and emails that look as sharp as they read.
* **AI-powered marketing.**
  Use AI tools daily to move faster: research, drafting, creative, analysis, and automation.

**What we're looking for**

* You understand growth: funnels, acquisition, activation, retention, and how to test your way to better numbers.
* You write clearly and persuasively, and you can switch between punchy ad copy and long-form content.
* You've run paid campaigns and know how to read the data and act on it.
* You've built email campaigns and flows, and you care about deliverability, open rates, and conversions.
* You have strong design taste and a high bar for how things look and feel.
* You know AI well, beyond just chat. You understand
  **MCP**
  (Model Context Protocol), can work with
  **APIs**
  , and know how to write and use
  **Skills.md files**
  to build repeatable AI workflows.
* You're comfortable working with product and engineering: you can read a spec, ask the right questions, and translate features into benefits.
* You take ownership. You don't wait to be told what to do next.

**Nice to have:**
experience in real estate, proptech, or real estate investing.

We care about skills, not résumés

We're not listing years of experience, and we're not hiring based on titles. We care about what you can do and how well you execute. Show us your work: campaigns you ran, copy you wrote, emails you designed, AI workflows you built, and the results they drove.

**The schedule**

This role is 6 days a week. It's a demanding pace, and we're upfront about it. If you want to own a lot, learn fast, and see your work directly shape a growing company, this is that job.

**How to apply**

Send us:

1. A short video on why this role and why Vihara.
2. Links to 2–3 pieces of work you're proud of (ads, content, emails, landing pages, or AI workflows), with a line on the result each one drove.
3. A Take Home assignment.

**Apply at:**
https://www.vihara.ai/careers/product-marketing-manager

description:

Vidhitsa Design Studio is a full-service interior design practice in Gurugram, specialising in luxury residential and commercial interiors. Our work is rooted in thoughtful design and meticulous execution — and our brand presence, online and offline, should reflect exactly that.

We’re looking for a creative, self-driven Social Media Executive to own and grow our digital footprint across all platforms, and contribute to how we show up in the real world too.

* Excellent written communication in English
* Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Notion, or similar) for content and workflow

* Knowledge of Google Ads and/or Meta Ads
* Understanding of SEO for social and web content
* Experience in Public Relations — press outreach, brand collaborations, or offline activations

₹2.4 – ₹3.6 LPA, based on experience

Send your CV, a brief note about yourself, and links to social media accounts or content you’ve managed to 
**hr@vidhitsadesignstudio.com**

Subject line: 
**Application — Social Media Executive**

Or apply directly through this posting.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
**Job Description – Marketing Lead (Doors & Windows)**

**Company:**
Ozone Overseas Pvt. Ltd.

**Department:**
Marketing

**Business Vertical:**
Doors & Windows (D&W)

**Location:**
Gurugram, Haryana

**Experience:**
8–12 Years

**About Ozone Overseas**

Ozone Overseas is a leading provider of architectural hardware, security solutions and innovative building products. With a strong presence in the architectural and building materials industry, Ozone offers a comprehensive range of solutions catering to residential and commercial infrastructure requirements.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented
**Marketing Lead – Doors & Windows**
to drive the overall marketing strategy and execution for our Doors & Windows business vertical.

The role will be responsible for developing category-specific marketing strategies, strengthening brand positioning, driving product marketing initiatives, generating market demand and supporting business growth through integrated marketing campaigns.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in B2B and B2C marketing, preferably within the building materials, architectural products, construction or related industries.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Category Marketing & Strategy**

* Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies for the Doors & Windows business category.
* Drive category growth through effective brand positioning, market penetration and demand-generation initiatives.
* Identify market opportunities, customer segments and emerging industry trends.
* Align marketing strategies with overall business objectives and sales targets.

**2. Brand Management & Positioning**

* Strengthen Ozone's brand presence and positioning in the Doors & Windows segment.
* Develop marketing communication strategies highlighting product USPs, quality, innovation and differentiation.
* Ensure consistent brand communication across all marketing channels and customer touchpoints.

**3. Product Marketing & New Product Launches**

* Drive product marketing initiatives, including product positioning, communication and go-to-market strategies.
* Plan and execute new product launches in coordination with Product Development, Sales and Business Teams.
* Develop product catalogues, brochures, presentations, product videos and other marketing collaterals.
* Translate technical product features into compelling customer-focused marketing communication.

**4. B2B & Channel Marketing**

* Develop marketing initiatives targeting architects, interior designers, builders, developers, contractors and institutional customers.
* Drive dealer and distributor marketing initiatives, including dealer engagement programmes, showroom branding and product displays.
* Organize architect meets, dealer meets, exhibitions, trade fairs and industry events.
* Support the sales team with marketing tools and campaigns to improve market reach and business conversion.

**5. Digital Marketing & Lead Generation**

* Plan and execute integrated digital marketing campaigns across relevant platforms.
* Drive SEO, SEM, social media marketing, website engagement and performance marketing initiatives.
* Develop strategies for qualified lead generation and improve digital customer acquisition.
* Monitor campaign performance, lead quality and marketing effectiveness.

**6. Market Research & Competitive Analysis**

* Conduct competitor benchmarking, market research and customer insights analysis.
* Track industry developments, product innovations, pricing trends and competitor marketing activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve Ozone's competitive positioning in the Doors & Windows category.

**7. Budget & Performance Management**

* Plan and manage the category marketing budget effectively.
* Monitor marketing spends, campaign performance, lead generation and ROI.
* Establish measurable KPIs to evaluate marketing effectiveness and business contribution.
* Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure timely execution of marketing initiatives.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* MBA in Marketing or an equivalent qualification.
* 8–12 years of relevant marketing experience, preferably in building materials, architectural hardware, construction materials, Aluminium/uPVC windows and doors or related industries.
* Strong understanding of B2B marketing, category marketing, brand management and product marketing.
* Experience in handling integrated marketing campaigns across online and offline channels.
* Exposure to architect, builder, dealer and channel marketing initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, strategic planning and execution skills.
* Ability to connect marketing initiatives with business growth and revenue objectives.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic & Category Marketing
* Brand Management & Positioning
* B2B & Channel Marketing
* Product Marketing & Launch Management
* Digital Marketing & Lead Generation
* Market Research & Competitive Benchmarking
* Marketing Budget & ROI Management
* Team Management & Stakeholder Collaboration

description:
Job Description – Lead, Apparel Category (Kidswear)

**Function:**
Buying & Merchandising

**Designation:**
Lead – Apparel Category

**Business:**
Kidswear

**Reporting To:**
Product Director

**Location:**
Gurgaon

Role Purpose

To lead the apparel category for the kidswear business, with end-to-end ownership of category strategy, range planning, product development, buying and commercial performance. The role will ensure the development of a relevant, commercially viable and differentiated product range that meets consumer needs, supports brand positioning and delivers business growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Category Strategy & Range Planning

* Develop and execute the apparel category strategy in line with the brand’s business objectives and consumer proposition.
* Build seasonal range plans across relevant product categories, age groups, price points and channels.
* Identify consumer trends, market opportunities and emerging product needs to strengthen the category offering.
* Ensure the range reflects the brand’s positioning while remaining relevant to the Indian market.
* Partner with the business team to align category plans with sales, margin and growth objectives.

2. Product Development & Buying

* Lead the product development and buying process from concept and range architecture through final selection and order placement.
* Work closely with design, sourcing, vendors and quality teams to develop products that meet design, quality, cost and delivery expectations.
* Drive product differentiation through design, fabric, fit, colour, print and construction.
* Ensure timely execution of seasonal collections and product launches.
* Review samples, costing and product specifications to ensure alignment with the category strategy.

3. Commercial & Financial Performance

* Own category-level sales, margin, markdown and inventory performance.
* Develop and manage the category’s Open-to-Buy (OTB), option plan and seasonal buying budgets.
* Monitor sell-through, stock turn, ageing, availability and markdown performance, and take timely corrective action.
* Identify opportunities to improve full-price sell-through and optimise inventory investment.
* Ensure the category delivers against agreed business and profitability targets.

4. Market & Consumer Insights

* Track market trends, competitor activity, pricing, product launches and consumer preferences.
* Use sales data, customer feedback and market insights to inform range and product decisions.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen the assortment across key occasions, seasons and consumer needs.
* Conduct regular store and market visits to understand product performance and customer response.

5. Cross-functional Collaboration

* Partner with Design, Sourcing, Quality, Supply Chain, Retail, E-commerce and Marketing teams to ensure effective category execution.
* Work closely with Retail and E-commerce teams to understand channel-specific requirements and optimise the product mix.
* Align product availability and launch timelines with business calendars and promotional plans.
* Ensure effective communication and coordination across all stakeholders.

6. Team Leadership

* Lead, coach and develop the category team, building strong buying and merchandising capabilities.
* Establish clear ownership, operating rhythms and performance expectations.
* Build effective working relationships with internal teams and external partners.
* Drive a culture of commercial accountability, consumer focus and continuous improvement.

Key Performance Indicators

* Category sales and growth
* Gross margin and markdown performance
* Full-price sell-through
* Inventory turn and ageing
* OTB and buying budget adherence
* Product availability and launch timelines
* Range productivity and option efficiency
* Quality and customer feedback
* Team capability and performance

- Create delightful and customer-focused designs that provide a superior experience, working on an area of lending ecosystem and drive things end to end - including AI-powered experiences that feel simple, trusted, and human.

Design agencies working for product companies will not work. Candidates from Startups are highly preferrable as the candidate would have done things from start to end.

Requirements
  
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  

* Strong Senior UX Designer Profile with full-stack design depth (UX research, UX design, UI) and product thinking
* Mandatory (Experience 1): Must have 5+ years of professional design experience with a track record of designing world-class products, and the most recent 3+ years in a product company

* Mandatory (Education): Graduation is mandatory; higher design education preferred
* Mandatory (Stability): Must not have switched jobs frequently; one short stint is fine if the candidate otherwise stays 1.5+ years per company

title: Intern - Stack Design and Integration
description:
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
Testing & Characterization
  
  

* Execute electrochemical testing of cells, short stacks, and full-stack assemblies.
* Conduct performance, efficiency, durability, and diagnostic evaluations.
* Analyze test results to identify performance trends and degradation mechanisms.
* Prepare technical reports and communicate findings.
* Develop and maintain test procedures and laboratory best practices.

Design & Development
  
  

* Support stack design activities through engineering analysis, experimentation, and validation.
* Participate in Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize stack performance.
* Evaluate the impact of design and material changes on electrochemical performance.
* Support development and validation of stack components and assemblies.
* Assist in root-cause investigations and engineering improvements.

Technical Analysis
  
  

* Process and interpret electrochemical and operational data.
* Correlate test results with design parameters and operating conditions.
* Support development of engineering calculations and performance models.
* Contribute to technical reviews and design discussions.

**Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering or electrochemical Engineering.

**Preferred Skills**

* Understanding of electrochemistry and water electrolysis fundamentals.
* Familiarity with laboratory experimentation and electrochemical testing.
* Knowledge of techniques such as polarization testing and impedance analysis.
* Experience with Excel, Python, MATLAB, or similar analysis tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary engineering environment.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Independently execute assigned test campaigns and data analysis activities.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of electrolyzer stack operation and performance drivers.
* Contribute to stack design improvements through data-driven insights and experimentation.
* Develop into a key contributor for stack testing and electrochemical performance evaluation.

Ohmium is seeking a motivated Junior Engineer - Electrochemical to support the design, testing, characterization, and performance improvement of PEM electrolyzer stacks. The engineer will work closely with stack design and development teams to execute experiments, analyze performance data, evaluate design concepts, and contribute to advancing next-generation electrolyzer stack technology.

title: Field Service Specialist
description:
Field Application Engineer – Job Description

Company: Client of D'GenMinds India Pvt Ltd

Job Location - Bangalore (Hybrid)

**Summary**

The Field Application Engineer combines two roles: field service for Pfeiffer Abatement & CMS

(contamination management) equipment, and application engineering for our customers.

* Field service: on-site installation support, troubleshooting, repair and preventive maintenance of Pfeiffer CMS equipment at customer sites.
* Application engineering: first point of contact for customers' application queries, and technical lead in customer discussions while travelling with the sales team.
* Instrumentation: hands-on work with mass spectrometers and other analytical instruments used for contamination and gas monitoring.

**Essential duties and responsibilities**

**A. Application support**

1. Acts as the first point of contact for customers' application-related queries on vacuum,

abatement and contamination management (CMS) solutions.

2. Analyses each query, recommends a suitable solution and responds within agreed timelines;

escalates to product management or the factory where needed.

3. Records application queries, answers and lessons learned in CRM to build a shared application knowledge base.

4. Prepares application notes, technical comparisons and sizing or selection support for customer requirements.

**B. Technical discussions with customers, alongside sales**

5. Travels with the sales team to customer sites and leads the technical part of customer

discussions.

6.Understands the customer's process, contamination or vacuum challenge and proposes the right products and configuration.

7. Supports sales with technical presentations, technical clarifications, compliance statements and inputs for proposals.

8. Shares a short visit report after each joint visit with technical findings, customer needs and

agreed next steps.

C.
**Mass spectrometry and instrumentation**

9. Works hands-on with mass spectrometers and other analyzers.

10. Supports installation, start-up, calibration, demonstrations and troubleshooting of these

instruments at customer sites.

11. Interprets measurement data and explains the results to customers in the context of their

application.

D.
**Field service**

12. Performs on-site troubleshooting, repair and preventive maintenance of Pfeiffer CMS &

Abatement equipment installed at customer sites.

13. Additional tasks related to Pfeiffer Vacuum's installed base may be requested by the customer,

where appropriate and safe for the engineer to complete.

**E. Technical sales support and training**

14. Through in-depth knowledge of the industry, technology and the company's products, assists both sales and customers in defining suitable products for their specific applications.

15. Provides applications and technical sales support to key accounts at the direction of the Sales Semi organization.

16. Reviews customer requirements and presents company products that will fill those needs.

17. Identifies new applications and opportunities to help gain market share at assigned customers.

18. Helps the Semi Sales team meet established sales quotas and revenue goals.

19. Provides mentoring to the customer support and technical support teams to advance their

technical product and application knowledge.

20. Organizes and provides product training programs for the sales force and customer base, with the involvement of product managers and application engineers.

21. Delivers basic and high vacuum seminars, training programs and "Lunch and Learn" sessions to our customer base.

22. Coordinates new product introductions, and arranges product demonstrations, training events and other activities that help customers understand company products.

23. Works with Marketing, R&D, Product and Sales Management to define new products that meet customers' technical requirements.

24. Uses CRM and Outlook to manage activities, opportunities and pipeline.

25. Submits status reports on current projects and new opportunities as defined by management.

26. Communicates with other departments and customers to ensure satisfactory customer support.

27. Attends all training sessions and meetings as required.

**Position requirements**

**General qualifications**

Strong organizational and creative problem-solving skills, good planning and technical equipment troubleshooting skills are required. The role requires the ability to work under tight deadlines in a dynamic group environment. Experience in vacuum technology is essential, as is knowledge of the field service requirements this position supports.

The engineer must be comfortable leading technical discussions with customers, from engineers on the shop floor to technical managers, and presenting solutions clearly.

**Education and/or experience**

• Experienced engineer or senior technician with a scientific or technical background (Electronics or Electromechanical or equivalent), passionate about new technologies.

• Ideally a broad scientific culture with expertise in physics, instrumentation and measurement.

• Knowledge of vacuum technology, data analysis and data analysis tools.

• Experience in application engineering or technical customer support is an advantage.

• Skills in mass spectrometry, optics and fluorescence are a plus, as is knowledge of the

microelectronics environment in a clean room or an equivalent field.

• Curious and autonomous, with good customer relations skills and a taste for teamwork in a

multicultural environment.

* Experience supporting process improvement or automation initiatives

**Company Description**

title: Inside Sales Representative
description:
**Location:**
Outer Ring Road, Banaswadi, Bangalore

**Timings:**
Day shifts only (no night shifts); 6-day week during probation, 5-day week after. Saturday and Sunday are compulsory working days; the weekly off is rotational between Monday and Friday.

**Role type:**
Phone-based & client-facing | D2C premium brand | Not a store role

Sunday (www.sundayrest.com) is a premium D2C mattress brand. We are looking for someone with a hospitality, airline, premium retail, or banking background who knows what it means to deliver a 5-star experience and who can turn that into revenue.

**Why This Role Exists**

We do not need someone to answer calls and close tickets. We need someone who can own the client relationship from first enquiry to lasting loyalty. Repeat purchases, referrals, upsells, and conversions are how we measure success in this role.

**What You Will Do**

* Convert inbound telephone enquiries into sales through consultative, relationship-based selling
* Build personal relationships with high-value clients that drive repeat purchases and referrals
* Manage escalations with the kind of poise and tact you would use with a hotel guest or airline passenger
* Collaborate with logistics, operations, and sales to resolve issues quickly

**Who Should Apply**

You bring warmth, polish, and emotional intelligence to every interaction. You know the difference between solving a problem and creating an experience. And you have the commercial instinct to turn that into results.

* Hospitality: five star hotel sales and business development
* Luxury retail: high-end fashion, jewellery, watches, premium electronics
* Premium banking: relationship managers handling HNI or affluent client portfolios
* B2B or B2C sales in premium segments: real estate, luxury automotive, premium insurance, wealth advisory
* High-end D2C or e-commerce brands where client experience was a differentiator

**Must-Have Qualities**

* 2-7 years in a client-facing role in any of the industries listed above
* Strong spoken and written English
* Willingness to work from our Bangalore office (Banaswadi, Outer Ring Road)
* Evidence of commercial results sales targets met, revenue grown, clients converted, or upsells closed

**Good to Have**

* In addition to excellent English, fluency in Kannada, Hindi, or any South Indian language
* Graduate degree.
* Experience in organisations or sectors with premium focus such as American Express, MPower, Aviation, Taj, Oberoi, Marriott

This role is NOT a fit if your experience is mainly mass-market BPO, chat/email support or technical support, or if you have changed companies every 6-12 months. We read every CV and reply only to profiles that match.

**Compensation**

Rs 6,00,000 to Rs 12,00,000 per annum (based on experience and fit)

**Perks and Benefits**

* Rs 5 lakh private medical insurance coverage
* Annual health/hobby learning sponsorship up to Rs 25,000
* Professional yet informal work environment
* 30-50% employee discount on all Sunday products

**Why Join Sunday?**

* Bring your hospitality or service DNA to a brand that actually values it
* Own real client outcomes, not ticket queues
* No night shifts just meaningful work with clients who appreciate quality

**Company Description**
NoBrokerHood is a technologically advanced visitor, community, and finance & asset management platform designed to make life secure and convenient for gated societies across India. Launched in 2018 as a subsidiary of NoBroker—India’s first prop-tech unicorn—it has rapidly grown to manage over 25,000 societies and support the safety and convenience of millions of families. The platform serves all society stakeholders through dedicated interfaces for admins, management committees, guards, and residents, while also offering services such as home maintenance and property renting or selling. With features like Monetisation and Marketplace, NoBrokerHood enables societies and businesses to create new revenue streams. Backed by strong security credentials including Level 1 PCI-DSS, GDPR, PDPB 2019, and ISO 27001, and supported by recent funding from Google, NoBrokerHood offers a dynamic and growth-focused environment for professionals.
  
**Role Description**
The Client Acquisition Manager – ERP Sales is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Bengaluru Area. In this position, the team member is responsible for identifying and prospecting gated communities and housing societies, presenting NoBrokerHood’s ERP and community management solutions, and driving end-to-end sales cycles from lead generation to closure. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting product demos, engaging with society management committees and key decision-makers, negotiating commercial terms, and ensuring smooth onboarding of new clients. The role also involves maintaining a strong sales pipeline, collaborating with internal teams for implementation and support, tracking market trends and competitor activities, and preparing regular sales reports and forecasts. The Client Acquisition Manager is expected to build long-term client relationships and contribute directly to revenue growth and market expansion for NoBrokerHood.
  
**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience in B2B sales, preferably in SaaS, ERP, or prop-tech solutions, with a track record of meeting or exceeding acquisition targets.
* Strong client relationship management skills, including stakeholder engagement with society management committees, facility managers, and other decision-makers.
* Proficiency in consultative selling, product presentations, negotiations, and closing deals within defined sales cycles.
* Ability to conduct market research, analyze customer needs, and translate them into tailored solution proposals.
* Comfort with using CRM tools, sales reporting systems, and basic data analysis to manage pipelines and forecast revenue.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in local languages of the Greater Bengaluru Area is an advantage.
* Strong organizational and time-management abilities, with capacity to handle multiple prospects and priorities simultaneously.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is a plus.

**12 of the top 15 generic pharma companies in the world run on Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.**
We are now growing our enterprise sales team to sign the next 100 pharma enterprises.
  
  
**Who You Will Sell To**
The CXOs, VPs and site heads who run these functions buy Leucine:
  
  

* Manufacturing
* Quality Assurance
* Quality Control
* Regulatory Affairs
* Validation and Engineering
* Supply Chain
* IT and Digital, who evaluate and help select the platform

**Why this role exists**
Most pharma plants still run on paper batch records, Excel trackers and tribal knowledge. A single missed step in a batch record can mean a recall, a regulatory warning, or a drug that should never have left the plant.
  
  
Leucine replaces that with systems of action: software that runs the work on the shop floor and in QA, rather than recording it after the fact. We are Series A, with 75+ pharma enterprises in production. We need AEs who can open, run and close these deals themselves, with the founders and product team behind them rather than in front of them.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Run the full cycle, from first call to signed contract, on 6- and 7-figure ACV deals
* Build outbound pipeline into Quality, Manufacturing, and IT leaders at pharma enterprises
* Grow existing customer accounts to more sites and more Leucine products
* Bring what you hear in the field back to the product team
* Help hire and ramp the sellers who join after you

**What We Will Do**

* Sales engineers heavylifting for you, from discovery through technical evaluation
* A product team that listens to you. When a gap is costing deals, it moves up the roadmap
* A structured ramp program built to get you to revenue within your first quarter
* Marketing-sourced pipeline alongside your own outbound
* The full Leucine suite to sell, not a single product
* Warm paths through existing customers, for references and for expansion

**Requirements**

* You like complex, technical products, and long cycles with eight-person buying committees don't intimidate you
* Hunters by instinct, consultants by posture. People who'd rather earn a champion's trust than win on volume
* You want the upside of an early seat and the credibility of working with global pharma from day one
* You are comfortable spending time at plants, not only at corporate offices
* Bonus: You have sold into regulated industries manufacturing, quality or lab teams. That could be GxP software (MES, QMS, LIMS, LMS, DMS, cleaning validation, serialization) or the instruments, chemistry and services those teams buy

We're not rigid about years. If you've closed complex enterprise software deals and can tell us a clear story about how you did it, we want to talk.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Market leading base with uncapped variable
* A fast path to leadership as the team grows
* Comprehensive Health Insurance with industry-leading coverage
* Breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks at the office
* Family-Friendly Leave Policies, including Paternity Leave and Compassionate Leave, to support you through life's important moments

title: Account Manager, SMB - AMER
description:

G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace. When you join G2, you’re joining the industry’s leading team that helps businesses reach their peak potential by powering decisions and strategies with trusted insights from real software users.

Does that sound exciting to you? Come join us as we try to reach our next PEAK!
  
  
**About G2 - Our People**
At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our PEAK values— (

erformance +

ntrepreneurship +

indness. Working at G2 means you are part of a value-driven, growing global community that climbs PEAKs together. We cheer for each other’s successes, learn from our mistakes, and support and lean on one another during challenging times. With ambition and entrepreneurial spirit we push each other to take on challenging work, which will help us all to grow and learn.
  
  
You will be part of a global, diverse team of smart, dedicated, and kind individuals - each with unique talents, aspirations, and life experiences. At the heart of our community and culture are our people-led ERGs, which celebrate and highlight the diverse identities of our global team. As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people.
  
  
**About The Role**
G2 is looking for a SMB Account Manager to join our AMER sales team. Your role will be responsible for building relationships and expanding revenue by managing their customer book and selling our branding solutions to marketing and sales teams in the software and services industry. This individual should be a proven farmer who has successfully managed and grown their book of business in their designated territory.
  
  
This individual thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic sales environment and enjoys building and growing engagements. The opportunity awards accelerated compensation and career progression for driven, top performers. Since this team will be managing AMER customers out of India, this role will require you to work in AMER shifts (5:30 PM to 02:30 AM IST) and collaborate closely with your AMER counterparts. This role is expected to begin with a full-time, five-day work week to support the team's initial ramp-up and training for 3 months. Once the team is fully operational, the position will transition to a hybrid work model with 3 days in office presence.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own existing business quota for G2 Marketing Solutions for one of our fastest growing segments.
* Collaborate with internal resources to tell data-driven stories.
* Own the entire renewal cycle for your assigned segment and region.
* Identify opportunities to upsell customers with additional G2 products.
* Drive urgency with prospects and help them see value in G2’s solutions.
* Advocate for our customers’ needs with internal stakeholders

**Responsibility Area: Customer Engagement (45%)**

* Working closely with our Customer Success Managers to deliver value to customers to ensure they renew with G2.
* Ensure any new customers get off to a fast start with G2 and see value quickly.
* Actively engage key and potential stakeholders to ensure they understand the value G2 brings, understand their needs, and how G2 can help them achieve their goals.
* Prospect into our existing customers, identifying new opportunities for growth with existing and new products.

**Responsibility Area: Opportunity Management (40%)**

* Manage the entire renewal cycle, with a focus on renewing and growing customers.Confirm renewals early and drive renewals to close ahead of subscription expiration dates.
* Keep all renewal and growth opportunities up to date in Salesforce and submit accurate forecasts for expected sales.

**Responsibility Area: Closing (15%)**

* Close business with existing customers.Provide all agreement paperwork and ensure everything is in order.

**Minimum Qualifications**
We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.
  
  

* 2–5 years of relevant full-time experience as an Account Manager or, preferably, a Customer Success Rep.
* Willingness to work five days a week from the Bengaluru office, aligned with AMER business hours (5:30 PM to 02:30 AM IST)
* Proven experience selling SaaS or subscription-based solutions.
* Strong understanding of marketing fundamentals and how modern marketing teams operate.
* Exceptional storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to articulate value clearly and persuasively.
* Ability to collaborate strategically with internal stakeholders across teams.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce (SFDC) or similar CRM platforms.
* Quick learner with a strong aptitude for data and analytics-driven decision-making.
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Consultative sales mindset, focused on understanding customer needs and delivering tailored solutions.

**Our Commitment to Inclusivity and Diversity**
At G2, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment where people of every background can thrive and feel welcome. We consider applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, genetic information, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, or marital, veteran, or physical or mental disability status. Learn more about our commitments here.

description:

Kshetra Consulting, a subsidiary of Kshetra Research Initiative, is a not-for-profit, non-partisan, impact-driven consulting and research firm grounded in India’s development realities. * Relevant academic background in public policy, economics, political science, development studies, communications, law, or related fields (current students or recent graduates are welcome).
* Prior internship or project experience in consulting, research, government, nonprofit, or advocacy organizations is an advantage.
