title: Creative Content Writer
description:
We need a writer who can take a one-line idea and turn it into a story, a shootable script, or a post that people stop scrolling for. You'll write across formats every week. Some days that means a short film draft. Other days it means 30 Instagram captions before lunch.

What you'll do

**Story writing**

• Develop original story concepts from briefs or from scratch

• Build characters with clear wants, flaws and arcs

• Plot storylines that hold attention from the first scene to the last

**Screenplay writing**

• Write screenplays in industry-standard format

• Turn approved concepts into scene-by-scene drafts with working dialogue

• Revise drafts based on notes from directors and producers

**Scriptwriting for ads and video**

• Write scripts for ad films, brand videos, promos and campaign content

• Write to fixed durations (15, 30 and 60 seconds) and production budgets

• Prepare two-column AV scripts that map visuals to voiceover and audio

**Article writing**

• Research topics and write accurate, well-structured articles

• Check every fact and source before submission

**Social media content**

• Write posts, captions and campaign copy for Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, X and Facebook

• Script Reels, Shorts and other short-form video

• Write carousel copy and thread sequences

**Photo descriptions and visual copy**

• Write captions and descriptions that add context a viewer can't get from the image alone

• Write alt text for accessibility

**Skills we need**

**Core writing**

• Strong English grammar, vocabulary and sentence control

• Clean editing and proofreading of your own work and others'

• Research skills, with the habit of checking claims against primary sources

• Ability to read a creative brief, ask the right questions and deliver on deadline

**Screenplay-specific**

• Working knowledge of screenplay format: sluglines, action lines, character cues, parentheticals and transitions

• Experience with Final Draft, Celtx, Fade In, WriterDuet or a similar tool

• Understanding of three-act and other story structures, beat sheets and step outlines

• Ability to write loglines, synopses and treatments for pitching

• Dialogue that carries subtext, so characters don't state what they feel

• Scene economy, with each scene moving the plot or the character forward

• Awareness of page-to-screen timing (roughly one page per minute) and what is practical to shoot

• Ability to take notes, defend choices when needed and turn around revisions fast

**Social media-specific**

• Writing for each platform's format, character limits and audience habits

• Hooks that work in the first line or the first two seconds of a video

• Short-form video scripting with on-screen text, voiceover and shot cues

• Hashtag and keyword research for discoverability

• Following trends and judging which ones fit the brand and which to skip

• Reading basic performance data (reach, saves, shares, watch time) and adjusting copy based on it

• Planning content calendars and writing in batches ahead of schedule

• Writing ad copy within Meta, YouTube and LinkedIn ad specs

• Replying to comments and DMs in the brand's tone

**Good to have**

• Reading and writing Telugu or Hindi

• Basic knowledge of storyboarding or shot types

• Experience using AI writing tools responsibly, with full human editing before anything ships

**Job details**

• Experience: 1 to 3 years

• Location: Hyderabad

• Employment type: Full-time

**How to apply**

Send your portfolio with at least one sample from each of these to Hr@inscapemodern.com:

• A screenplay or script excerpt (5 pages or fewer)

• A short story or narrative piece

• A set of social media posts or a short-form video script

**Position Summary**

title: Head of Sales- Electric Mobility
description:
Location: Hyderabad, India • Experience: 10–15 years

Reporting to: CEO • Employment: Full-time

**About Leanwatts**

Leanwatts is a deep-tech power electronics company developing intelligent power conversion solutions for

electric mobility and clean energy applications. Our capabilities span hardware design, firmware

development, product validation and manufacturing. We work with leading OEMs to deliver reliable,

efficient and competitive power electronics solutions.

Our vision is to become a globally trusted leader in intelligent power conversion technology, built in India

for the world. We value innovation, ownership, engineering excellence, customer centricity and continuous

learning.

**Role overview**

We are looking for a commercially driven and technically competent leader to lead and scale our Electric

Mobility sales function. The role owns sales strategy, revenue growth, strategic OEM acquisition, key

accounts, commercial performance, sales operations and customer-side programme management from

initial engagement to start of production (SOP).

This is a hands-on leadership role serving electric two-wheeler, three-wheeler (including L5), electric

tractor and other emerging mobility OEMs.

Key roles & responsibilities

1. Sales strategy & business growth

 Develop and execute annual and quarterly sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives.

 Own revenue, volume, gross margin and collection targets for the Electric Mobility vertical.

 Identify high-potential segments, customers, vehicle platforms and business opportunities.

 Build a predictable sales pipeline and drive customer acquisition, account expansion and geographical

growth.

2. OEM business development & technical sales

 Acquire new OEM customers and build relationships across engineering, sourcing, quality, programme

management and leadership teams.

 Understand vehicle architecture, battery systems, charging requirements and integration challenges.

 Position EV chargers, onboard chargers, DC-DC converters and integrated power conversion solutions.

 Drive RFQs, technical discussions, feasibility assessments and techno-commercial proposals with

Engineering.

 Convert qualified opportunities into business nominations, product approvals and recurring revenue.

**Key roles & responsibilities (continued)**

3. Customer programme management & OEM onboarding

 Own the customer-side programme lifecycle from initial engagement and RFQ to product approval,

SOP and volume ramp-up.

 Coordinate SORs, technical specifications and programme deliverables with internal stakeholders.

 Establish customer-specific programme plans with clear milestones, owners, timelines and

dependencies.

 Drive sample development, submission, feedback and customer approvals.

 Coordinate DVP finalisation, customer validation, test progress, technical observations and

revalidation.

 Drive drawing approvals, specification freeze, technical clearances and engineering change requests.

 Coordinate APQP, PPAP, PSW and customer-specific production approvals with Engineering and

Quality.

 Conduct customer programme reviews, track risks and blockers, and drive cross-functional resolution.

 Drive commercial closure, purchase order readiness, SOP and production ramp-up.

 Act as the primary point of commercial and programme accountability towards strategic OEMs.

Engineering and Quality retain technical approval and product release authority.

4. Strategic account management & customer experience

 Personally manage strategic OEM accounts and develop long-term relationships across customer

functions.

 Understand customer roadmaps and increase share of business through new platforms, cross-selling

and portfolio expansion.

 Drive timely resolution of customer complaints, technical concerns and commercial escalations with

Quality and Customer Service.

 Improve customer satisfaction, retention and overall experience.

5. Commercial management & profitability

 Lead quotations, pricing, negotiations and customer agreements within approved policies.

 Manage payment terms, warranty, MOQ, development charges and other commercial conditions.

 Work with Finance, Supply Chain and Engineering to ensure competitive pricing and sustainable

margins.

 Own collections, overdue receivables and credit discipline.

 Monitor customer concentration, contractual commitments and commercial risks.

**Key roles & responsibilities (continued)**

6. Sales operations, forecasting & business planning

 Own Sales Operations performance, ensuring seamless execution from order receipt to delivery.

 Drive customer-wise, product-wise and segment-wise forecasting and rolling demand planning.

 Establish structured Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) in collaboration with Operations, Supply Chain

and Finance.

 Oversee purchase order management, order book visibility, backlog, customer schedules and delivery

commitments.

 Align customer demand with production capacity, inventory availability and working capital

requirements.

 Monitor order fulfilment, on-time delivery, forecast accuracy and revenue realisation.

 Identify supply constraints, demand fluctuations and execution risks, and drive cross-functional

resolution.

 Establish sales MIS, dashboards, reporting mechanisms and performance reviews.

 Drive standardisation, digitisation and automation of sales processes.

 Lead and develop the Sales Operations team to ensure operational excellence and customer

experience.

7. Market intelligence & product strategy

 Monitor market developments, competitor products, pricing, technologies and emerging

opportunities.

 Track OEM roadmaps, upcoming vehicle launches and evolving power electronics requirements.

 Capture structured Voice of Customer (VOC) inputs and translate them into actionable product

requirements.

 Work with Engineering and leadership to identify new product opportunities and develop business

cases.

 Collaborate with Marketing on positioning, lead generation, collateral, exhibitions and industry

engagement.

8. Sales leadership & organisation development

 Lead, mentor and develop Sales, Key Account Management and Sales Operations teams.

 Establish clear account ownership, individual targets and performance expectations.

 Build a culture of ownership, accountability, customer centricity and execution excellence.

 Establish CRM discipline, opportunity tracking, programme management and reporting systems.

 Conduct regular pipeline, customer programme and business performance reviews.

 Identify capability gaps, recruit talent and develop future leaders to build a scalable, process-driven

commercial organisation.

Candidate profile

**Educational qualifications**

 BE/B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Electrical & Electronics, Mechanical, Automotive Engineering or a

related discipline. Electrical or Electronics is preferred.

 MBA in Sales, Marketing, Strategy or General Management is an advantage, not mandatory.

 Project or programme management certifications are an added advantage.

Experience requirements

 10–15 years of overall professional experience, including at least 6 years in automotive, electric

mobility or automotive component/power electronics businesses.

 Minimum 5 years of direct OEM-facing technical sales, business development or strategic account

management experience.

 Proven automotive customer programme experience from RFQ and samples through validation,

approval and SOP.

 At least 2–3 years of sales team or commercial function leadership.

 Demonstrated OEM acquisition, revenue achievement and long-term account development.

 Automotive Tier-1, EV component or power electronics supplier experience highly preferred;

established EV OEM relationships are an advantage.

Technical & commercial competencies

 Understanding of EV architecture, battery systems, BMS, CAN and automotive electrical systems;

familiarity with chargers, OBC and DC-DC converters.

 Knowledge of RFQ, SOR, DVP&R, APQP, PPAP, PSW and SOP.

 Strong programme management, cross-functional coordination, negotiation and stakeholder

management.

 Commercial understanding of costing, pricing, margins, credit and working capital; proficiency in

forecasting, CRM and analytics.

Leadership & behavioural competencies

 Ownership, integrity, accountability, analytical thinking and an entrepreneurial mindset.

 Ability to combine strategy with hands-on execution, influence across functions and empower high-

performing teams.

 Customer-centric approach and willingness to travel extensively.

Key performance indicators

Revenue and gross margin; new OEM wins; programme milestone adherence; sample-to-approval and

approval-to-SOP conversion; account growth; forecast accuracy; on-time delivery; collections; customer

satisfaction; team performance and process maturity.

**Why join Leanwatts?**

Lead and shape the commercial function of a growing deep-tech company, work with leading mobility

OEMs, and build a high-performing team with autonomy, learning opportunities and competitive

performance-linked compensation.

Join us in building globally competitive power conversion technology from India, for the world.

title: Head of International Sales
description:
**RETAINED SEARCH · CONFIDENTIAL**

Head of International Sales – Middle East, Africa & Southeast Asia

**Reports to**

CEO & Director

**Location**

Hyderabad, with extensive international travel (about 40–50%)

**Markets**

Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia

**Team**

Individual contributor at first, leading a network of channel partners

**About the company**

Our client is a founder-led, engineering-driven Indian technology group. It designs and builds advanced inspection and quality systems in-house, used by manufacturers in automotive, aerospace and defence, electronics and heavy engineering. It has appointed its first overseas channel partner in the Gulf and is now building a dedicated export business.

The group is about ₹150 Cr in revenue today and aims to reach
**₹500 Cr in the next three to four years**
. Opening export markets is one of the main levers to get there.

**Why this role now**

The company believes its products have strong acceptance in markets with no local manufacturer. This role will test that in the field, build the channel and create the first export revenue. What this person learns will decide where the company invests in local presence next.

**Key responsibilities**

Market entry

* Map and prioritise markets across the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia within the first 60–90 days.
* Report back on where acceptance is strongest, to guide the next phase of investment.

Channel partners

* Identify, appoint and contract channel partners, building on the Gulf partner.
* Train partners on the product range, applications and selling approach.
* Set targets for each partner and manage their performance.

Demand generation

* Plan and run trade-show participation and customer visits.
* Pursue key accounts and tenders directly, alongside partners.

Commercial and regulatory

* Own export pricing, quotations, payment terms and export documentation, with finance.
* Coordinate country-specific radiation certifications and standards, including European (CE) requirements where they apply, with the quality team.

Next phase

* Recommend the right local model for each priority market: agent, partner, local representative or service centre.

Must-haves

* Engineering degree; an MBA is an advantage.
* 10–15 years in B2B export channel sales of capital equipment to customers in automotive, aerospace, defence and security, electronics or heavy engineering.
* Has opened new export markets from scratch, not only managed existing ones.
* A proven record of building and managing distributor or channel-partner networks in the Middle East and Africa, or Southeast Asia.
* Techno-commercial strength: can present systems to engineers and close commercial terms.

description:

Role Overview
  
  
Zithara.ai is looking for a strategic, results-driven, and data-oriented
**Head of SaaS Sales**

As we continue to expand our market presence, we are looking for an experienced sales leader who can build a predictable revenue engine, strengthen our go-to-market strategy, and drive sustainable growth across the mid-market segment.
  
  
In this leadership role, you will take ownership of the overall sales function, develop scalable sales strategies, build high-performing teams, and establish structured processes that drive consistent revenue outcomes. Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Sales Strategy & Execution

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing sales organization, including mid-market Account Executives.
* Build structured hiring, onboarding, and training processes to help new team members achieve productivity within 60 days.
* Establish clear sales targets, KPIs, accountability measures, and performance review mechanisms.
* Design effective commission structures, incentive plans, SPIFFs, and quota tiers aligned with company revenue objectives.

* Standardize sales processes, reporting frameworks, and playbooks to improve operational efficiency and revenue predictability.

* Strategic Deal Management

* Lead complex commercial negotiations, address business objections, and drive strategic opportunities towards successful closure.
* Take ownership of revenue targets, deal conversion, and overall sales performance.
* Build strong customer relationships and identify opportunities for account expansion and long-term business growth.

* SaaS Sales Experience: 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, with strong exposure to mid-market or mid-segment customers.

* Revenue Track Record: Demonstrated success in achieving revenue targets, managing sales pipelines, and closing high-value B2B deals.
* Deal Management: Experience handling deal sizes ranging from ₹20 lakh to ₹80 lakh+ ARR.
* Sales Methodologies: Strong understanding of consultative sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Gap Selling, or SPICED.
* CRM Expertise: Hands-on experience with CRM and sales enablement tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or equivalent platforms.
* Strategic Thinking: Ability to translate business objectives into actionable sales strategies and measurable outcomes.
* Leadership & Communication: Excellent communication, negotiation, team building, and stakeholder management skills.
* Growth Mindset: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, take ownership, solve challenges, and build scalable sales operations.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive Base Salary.
* Performance-linked On-Target Earnings (OTE).
* Opportunity to lead and scale a growing SaaS sales organization.
* Direct involvement in strategic business decisions and revenue growth.
* Opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a high-growth technology company.

At Zithara.ai, you will have the opportunity to shape our go-to-market strategy, build and lead a high-performing sales team, and directly influence the company's growth journey.
  
  
If you are a results-driven SaaS sales leader who enjoys building teams, closing strategic deals, developing scalable sales processes, and driving business growth, we would love to hear from you.

title: BCM-Business Analyst - Cards and Payments-Senior-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title:**
Senior Consultant – Cards and Payments Business Analyst
  
  
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Cards and Payments Functional Business Analyst
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* 5+ years’ experience in banking payments transformations or implementing new cards and payment systems
* 3+ Years of experience of working as Tech Business Analyst for Payment Processing Systems in large banks.
* Familiar with Payments messaging standards such as NACHA, ISO 8583, ISO 20022, SWIFT
* Proven experience as a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst in the payments or financial services domain.
* Strong understanding of payment systems, processing, and industry trends (e.g., ISO 20022, digital payments, payment gateways).
* Expertise in Cards Management platforms like HPS PowerCard, VisionPLUS, TSYS Prime
* Expertise in Enterprise Payment platforms like Finacle, Base24.
* Proficiency in technical documentation and modelling tools (e.g., UML, BPMN).
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Scrum, JIRA).
* Experience with API integrations and payment technologies.
* Knowledge of regulatory requirements in the payments industry.
* Certification in Business Analysis (e.g., CBAP) or Agile methodologies.
* Good Knowledge of check payments value chain involving Fraud and Dispute management, Clearing and Settlement processing, Network regulations and compliance.
* Demonstrable payment processing and clearing knowledge especially data mapping and modelling to support triaging issues raised in development and production
* Proven track record of working on multiple projects and change management initiatives in a fast-paced and complex environment including liaising with external third-party companies as necessary.
* Experience in stakeholder management and governance in large scale implementations.
* Sound knowledge of upstream and downstream systems in payments landscape like Core banking, Payment Switches, Compliance, FX, Advising, Billing etc.
* Knowledge about payments regulatory frameworks like SEPA, BASEL, PSD2, PCIDSS etc. is desirable
* Experience in working with payment processing stakeholders like Payment Intermediaries, Aggregators, Switches

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
Skills and experience
  
  

* BE/BTech+ MBA candidates with a minimum of 3 years of experience in client-facing consulting roles
* Bring deep industry expertise in payments & digital banking and large-scale payments modernization programs
* Provide innovative ideas with our clients to explore disruptive strategies that create business value, including usage of new age technologies, such as Blockchain and AI.

Behavioral Attributes:
  
  

* Analytical, organized, team player, relishes working in a multicultural, multi-national business context.
* Strong delivery mindset, customer focus, commitment to results and high-quality standards.
* Good communication skills, teamwork and customer focus are essential.
* Building influential relationships with colleagues, partners and customers is an essential part of the Services team strategy for success to date
* Being able to work independently or in a team as needed.
* Stakeholder engagement, management, and governance.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:

**Role Description**
The Digital Marketing Executive role is a full-time, on-site position based in Kochi. The individual in this role will plan and execute digital marketing campaigns to promote Delta International Institute’s programs and brand, including managing social media channels, email campaigns, and online advertising. Daily responsibilities include creating and updating web and social media content, coordinating with the academic and sales teams to align marketing messages, and supporting events and promotional activities. The role involves monitoring campaign performance, using web analytics tools to track key metrics, and preparing reports with recommendations for optimization. The Digital Marketing Executive will also engage with prospective learners online, respond to inquiries, and contribute to overall marketing strategy to enhance lead generation and brand awareness.

* Strong foundation in Marketing, including campaign planning, branding, and lead generation.
* Excellent Communication skills for writing, presenting, and engaging with audiences across channels.
* Hands-on experience with Social Media Marketing, including content scheduling, community management, and paid promotions.

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfort working on-site in Kochi and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Interest in financial markets or education services is an added advantage.

title: Cyber Security Trainer
description:
**Company Description**
Offenso Hackers Academy is a leading cybersecurity training institution based in Kerala, recognized by Kerala Startup Mission and accredited as a CompTIA partner. The academy focuses on hands-on, real-world, attack-simulation-based learning that prepares students and professionals for roles such as SOC Analyst and Penetration Tester. With core programs ranging from beginner to advanced levels, including OCSA, OCSP, and ADIS, Offenso offers comprehensive coverage of offensive and defensive security domains. The academy provides internships, live workshops, CTFs, and industry projects as part of its training, supporting strong placement outcomes. Offenso delivers training to learners in Kerala and worldwide, positioning itself as a trusted path to mastering cybersecurity skills.
  
**Role Description**
The Cyber Security Trainer will design, deliver, and continuously update cybersecurity training modules aligned with Offenso’s core programs and industry standards. Day-to-day responsibilities include preparing lesson plans and lab environments, conducting classroom and lab sessions, guiding learners through concepts such as ethical hacking, network and application security, malware analysis, and information security fundamentals, and mentoring students on CTFs, projects, and internships. The trainer will assess learner performance through assignments, practical evaluations, and exams, provide feedback, and support their skill development and career readiness. Additional responsibilities include contributing to curriculum enhancement, collaborating with the academic team on new course content, and staying current with emerging threats, tools, and security frameworks. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Kochi.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong foundational and advanced skills in Cybersecurity and Information Security, including security principles, threat landscapes, and risk management.
* Candidates should possess hands-on expertise in Network Security, covering secure network design, monitoring, intrusion detection, and common attack vectors.
* Candidates should possess skills in Application Security, including secure coding practices, vulnerability assessment, and remediation of web and mobile application flaws.
* Candidates should possess capabilities in Malware Analysis, such as static and dynamic analysis, behavior profiling, and understanding of common malware families and evasion techniques.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CEH, OSCP, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent) and prior experience in teaching, mentoring, or conducting technical workshops are highly beneficial.
* Strong communication, presentation, and documentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to learners at different skill levels.
* Experience with CTF platforms, security labs, and common offensive and defensive tools (e.g., Burp Suite, Wireshark, SIEM solutions, EDR tools) is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in cybersecurity roles

title: Senior Content Writer
description:

The role also involves leading content strategy discussions, mentoring junior writers, and presenting content ideas and drafts to internal teams and clients. * Candidates should possess strong Web Content Writing and general Writing skills, with a portfolio showcasing brand storytelling and digital content.
* Candidates should possess experience in Content Strategy and Research to develop informed, audience-focused narratives and messaging.

title: Key Account Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Popular Foods Co. is a multi-category Indian food brand built on over a century of legacy and expertise, evolving from a family business established in 1912. Founded in 2016 by Asgar Ali and Mohammed Ashfak, the company now offers 250+ SKUs across rice, pulses, dry fruits, dates, spices, organics, flours, and health-focused products. Its strength lies in disciplined sourcing, strict grading standards, and process-driven quality control, with products undergoing 3X lab testing and responsible packaging to ensure safety and consistency. With strong distribution across leading marketplaces and an expanding offline presence, Popular Foods delivers premium staples at competitive prices. The company is committed to building long-term kitchen trust through reliability, scale, and uncompromised quality.
  
**Role Description**
The Key Account Executive role is a full-time, on-site position based in Nelamangala. This role focuses on managing and growing key accounts by maintaining strong relationships with buyers, distributors, and retail partners, while ensuring consistent availability and visibility of Popular Foods products. Day-to-day tasks include monitoring sales performance, analyzing account-level data, coordinating promotions and merchandising activities, and executing agreed business plans. The Key Account Executive collaborates closely with sales, supply chain, and marketing teams to ensure timely order fulfillment, resolve issues, and support new product launches. The role also involves identifying growth opportunities within existing accounts, negotiating terms within defined guidelines, and providing regular reporting and insights to management.
  
**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience in key account management, sales, or business development within FMCG, food, or related consumer goods sectors.
* Strong skills in relationship management, stakeholder communication, and negotiation to effectively manage and grow key accounts.
* Ability to analyze sales data, track performance metrics, and use insights to drive account-level strategies and decisions.
* Solid understanding of retail and distribution operations, including merchandising, inventory management, and promotional execution.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and basic reporting tools; familiarity with CRM or sales management systems is an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with internal teams and external partners.
* Proactive, organized, and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities on-site.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field; relevant industry certifications or training are a plus.

* Ensure consistent follow-ups and effective lead management.
* Coordinate with internal operations and hospitality teams to ensure seamless execution of confirmed bookings and events.
* Focus on repeat business, referrals and long-term client relationships.

**5. Market Intelligence & Reporting**

* Monitor competitor activities, local market trends and emerging business opportunities.
* Maintain an updated database of prospects, leads, client interactions and conversion status.
* Submit regular sales reports, field visit updates and pipeline forecasts.
* Provide actionable market insights to improve sales strategies and business performance.

* Graduate in any discipline; candidates with a background in Sales, Marketing, Business Administration or Hospitality will be preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in field sales, business development, corporate sales or hospitality sales.

* Proven ability to generate leads, build relationships and close sales.

* Prior experience in the hospitality, F&B, brewery, restaurant, events or entertainment industry will be an added advantage.
* Experience handling corporate accounts, institutional clients, event bookings and B2B partnerships.
* Existing professional networks within the corporate and hospitality ecosystem will be beneficial.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Monthly revenue generated through field sales initiatives.
* Number of qualified leads generated and converted.
* Corporate accounts and strategic partnerships acquired.
* Number of confirmed group bookings and corporate events.
* Lead-to-conversion ratio.
* Repeat business and client retention.
* Achievement of assigned sales targets.

description:
Job Description:

Process Automation Lead (Triconex and Foxboro):

This is an elite, hybrid role requiring a rare combination of technical systems mastery and people leadership.

Must have proven on-site field commissioning credentials, the ability to independently debug plant-level DCS/SIS failures without supervision, and the executive maturity to lead L1 Process Automation team and manage complex APAC client relationships.

Technical Support Team Lead & Principal Escalation Authority Process Automation & Safety Systems. (Triconex and Foxboro DCS)

Seeking a high-calibre Technical Support Team Lead to serve as the principal regional escalation authority across Greater India and the wider APAC landscape. This dual-focus leadership role is responsible for directing Level 1/Level 2 technical support operations, driving people management and coaching, and personally delivering deep-tier Level 3 diagnostic resolution for mission-critical Process Automation accounts.

This role bridges enterprise customers, regional site operations, field services, systems integration, and global product engineering. The ideal candidate will combine deep architectural mastery across the Foxboro DCS and Triconex SIS ecosystems with proven leadership capabilities to mentor engineers, govern operational queue health, manage multi-geography stakeholder escalations, and protect client plant uptime in mission-critical industries (Refineries, Chemicals, Power Industries).

* **Technical Escalation & High-Severity Incident Command:** Act as the ultimate regional escalation authority for complex, plant-critical failures, communication outages, system halts, and critical software/hardware anomalies under aggressive SLA deadlines.
* **People Leadership & Technical Mentorship:** Lead, coach, and supervise a frontline team of technical support engineers; establish quality governance, conduct technical performance assessments, balance workload distribution, and drive structured technical enablement and development roadmaps.
* **APAC Installed-Base Intelligence & Critical Diagnostics:** Diagnose intricate operational and legacy installation challenges across diverse APAC customer topologies; leverage systems-level thinking to map multi-generational automation layers (from legacy I/A Series to modern virtualized DCS) and resolve site-specific operating bottlenecks.
* **Lab-Based Advanced Failure Reproduction & Forensic Analysis:** Lead physical simulation setups within the laboratory environment to replicate complex field defects, analyse memory/core dumps, reproduce controller communication failures, and validate firmware patches and logic workarounds prior to site deployment.
* **Field-to-Support Operational Alignment:** Interface seamlessly with field service engineering units and plant asset leads during critical turnarounds, outages, or commissioning phases, applying field-tested engineering acumen to de-escalate complex site issues.
* **High-Integrity Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS) Governance:** Review and debug safety logic sequences, emergency shutdown systems (ESD), and high-availability hardware (Triconex) to enforce compliance with IEC 61508 / IEC 61511 standards, loop safety mandates, and SIL3 parameters.
* **Complex Industrial Network & Communications Troubleshooting:** Own end-to-end diagnostic reviews of mission-critical networking, including The MESH topology, industrial switch routing, redundancy failover mechanisms, VLAN segmentation, and multi-protocol industrial conversions (Modbus TCP/IP, OPC DA/UA, Foundation Fieldbus, Profibus).
* **Process Logic Engineering & Narrative Dissection: Audit**, troubleshoot, and validate custom control loops, continuous batch logic, complex interlock matrices, and sequence flowcharts directly against client Process & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) and functional control narratives.
* **Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) & Knowledge Leadership:** Author high-tier diagnostic playbooks, root-cause investigation whitepapers, and operational troubleshooting frameworks to continuously elevate regional first-contact resolution and support delivery efficiency.
* **Industrial Cybersecurity Governance & Installed-Base Hardening:** Oversee OT cybersecurity compliance across regional installed bases, identifying vulnerabilities, validating patch integrity, and enforcing secure industrial network protocols (IEC 62443, perimeter firewalls, and encrypted communication layers) to safeguard plant-critical automation assets against operational risks.
* **Customer Relationship Management & Net Satisfaction (NPS):** Establish and maintain trusted-advisor partnerships with key plant stakeholders and internal cross-functional leaders to protect customer satisfaction, accelerate time-to-resolution, and reinforce brand reliability.
* **Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement:** Identify recurring operational bottlenecks and systemic support constraints, converting them into structured continuous improvement initiatives and Lean workflows that enhance team efficiency.
* **Technical Governance & Operational Cadence:** Direct structured technical reviews, team syncs, case health retrospectives, and milestone governance meetings to maintain proactive queue management and project momentum.
* **Cross-Functional Solution Architecture:** Define, review, and govern technical requirements across multidisciplinary teams (Product Engineering, Quality, Field Services, and Sales) to deliver robust, scalable engineering solutions for regional customer bases.
* **Regional Escalation Authority & Account Governance:** Act as the principal escalation owner for all India and APAC customer escalations, orchestrating rapid multi-tiered technical responses, managing high-stakes client communications, and driving plant-critical recovery actions to protect customer uptime and business continuity.

(External) English Qualifications:  

* Bachelors or master’s degree in Instrumentation, Electronics & Communication, or Electrical & Electronics Engineering.
* 8–12+ years of demonstrated success within Process Automation, DCS/SIS engineering, and technical escalation operations.
* Minimum 3+ years of direct, hands-on on-site field engineering experience (commissioning, system startup, site acceptance testing [SAT], site troubleshooting, and direct plant client interface).
* Demonstrated experience mentoring, leading, or supervising technical teams, balancing queue workloads, tracking service delivery KPIs, and handling operational governance.
* Proven capability in managing enterprise accounts across the APAC region, demonstrating strong cross-cultural client engagement, critical thinking, and technical communication skills under mission-critical downtime scenarios.
* Good verbal and written communication with ability to analyse data and metrics and represent the trends and patterns to leadership in reviews.

**Business Unit**

BXTI

**Business Description**

Blackstone Technology & Innovations (BXTi) is the technology team at the core of each of Blackstone’s businesses and new growth initiatives. Serving both internal and external clients, we work to build the next generation of systems that manage risk, create efficiency and improve transparency within the firm and across our broad community of investors and portfolio companies.

BXTi is nimble and entrepreneurial – our open, iterative design processes and rapid pace of development mean that everyone on the team has the opportunity to make an impact from day one. We are problem solvers who can take projects from idea to implementation. We believe in active mentoring and developing excellence. We collaborate to find the best answers for our customers and for Blackstone. We are critical to the firm maintaining its competitive edge.

**Job Title**

VP – Operations, Enterprise Technology

**Job Description**

The VP, Operations, Enterprise Technology is a leadership role, responsible for establishing and driving the operational management framework across Enterprise Technology Operations.

The role serves as the central coordinating and governance function that ensures consistency, accountability, transparency, operational rigor, and continuous improvement across all technology products and services. Working across Enterprise Technology teams, this leader will drive operational excellence through governance, service management, operational intelligence, process transformation, risk management, resilience planning, and executive communications.

The role will act as a strategic advisor to the Enterprise Technology Leadership Team and will be responsible for ensuring that technology operations consistently deliver reliable, resilient, secure, and business-aligned outcomes. This position plays a critical role in enabling Enterprise Technology’s transition toward a product-centric, predictive, engineering-led operating model focused on incident prevention, rapid recovery, operational excellence, and superior employee experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish and continuously evolve the governance framework that drives accountability, consistency, transparency, and operational excellence across all Enterprise Technology products and services
* Define and maintain the Technology Operations governance framework, including decision rights, accountability structures, operating principles, and escalation models
* Establish governance forums including operational reviews, service reviews, reliability reviews, risk reviews, executive business reviews, and transformation steering committees
* Drive adoption of the product-centric operating model across Technology Operations, clear ownership across Product Owners, Engineering, Operations, Service Management, SRE, and external partners
* Drive operational maturity through standardization, simplification, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives, establishing a formal Operational Excellence program across Technology Operations
* Identify and improve operational inefficiencies, process bottlenecks, organizational friction points, and service delivery gaps
* Promote engineering-led operations and automation-first principles, including operational maturity assessments and benchmarking frameworks
* Develop operational policies, standards, procedures, and controls that support enterprise-wide consistency
* Define and monitor operational KPIs, SLAs, XLAs, objectives, and performance commitments
* Ensure vendors and strategic partners deliver services consistent with BXTI operational standards and expectations, with defined service expectations and control mechanisms
* Ensure operational performance is continuously reviewed, improved, and aligned with business expectations, establishing formal service review and operational review programs for reliability, availability, and other key service attributes
* Drive Continual Service Improvement (CSI) initiatives, partnering with Product Owners to improve operational outcomes
* Develop operational scorecards and executive dashboards, partnering with the Technology Operations Analytics & Intelligence team to generate actionable insights.
* Ensure operational risks are identified, measured, managed, and mitigated across Enterprise Technology Operations, supporting audit, compliance, and regulatory activities
* Oversee governance of Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, Operational Resilience, and Recovery Testing
* Ensure timely, accurate, business-focused communications during operational events and ongoing service management activities, defining templates and standards for key operational communication across the firm

**Qualifications**

Blackstone seeks to hire individuals who work well in a team-driven working group, are highly motivated, intelligent, have sound judgment and have demonstrated excellence in prior endeavors.

* 12+ years of experience in Technology Operations, IT Service Management, Operational Excellence, Technology Governance, or Enterprise Service Delivery
* Proven experience leading large-scale global technology operations organizations
* Deep expertise in ITIL and enterprise ITSM frameworks, including strong experience with Incident, Problem, Change, Service Level, and Knowledge Management disciplines
* Experience operating within product-centric, engineering-led, or SRE-enabled organizations
* Experience with observability platforms such as Splunk

* Experience managing operational risk, resilience, business continuity, and crisis management

**ABOUT SARVOHAM:**

Sarvoham Welfare Trust is a charitable organization dedicated to the welfare of under-privileged animals in Bangalore, India. Sarvoham was established in April 2017 by co-founders Haris Ali & Madhusmita Sahu with a vision to create an inclusive eco-system that co-exists with animals providing them a respectable life that contributes to the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) frameworks and Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs’) for the planet.

Over the past 9 years, Sarvoham has grown from a small charity effort to a well-established animal welfare organization. We have rescued more than 3500 street animals, and provide a shelter for more than 200 dogs.

Sarvoham means the harmony between all elements of nature, both human and non-human, and the organization is guided by the spirit of harmonious coexistence.

**ROLE PURPOSE:**

Sarvoham stands at a defining moment in its journey to create a more compassionate world for animals and seeks to expand its impact by building a sustainable ecosystem of partnerships and philanthropy that will enable many more lives to be saved and transformed.

The Talent Acquisition Specialist & HR Business Partner is a key role responsible for building the Foundation's internal & external ecosystem of partnerships, influence, and trust The core objective is to position Sarvoham as a sustainable and trusted partner integrating attracting the best fit talent for the foundation to supporting the employee lifecycle with community mobilization, public communications, advocacy, and brand stewardship into a unified strategy that advances the Foundation's mission and long-term sustainability.

**WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS:**

* **Building Sarvoham as a purpose driven employer of choice for Talent:** Sarvoham has built a reliable and credible rescue and rehabilitation model since 2017. The Foundation is looking for an experienced member as the Talent Acquisition Specialist & HR Business Partner to attract, engage, build sustainable and meaningful relationships with individuals who resonate with the Foundation’s purpose to build a society that provides a ‘respectable’ life to all animal species.
* **Build a Talent community with a Stewardship mindset:** Working closely with the CEO, Board, leadership team and civil society organisations, the incumbent will cultivate meaningful relationships that generate talent in the form of full-time employees and volunteers who inspire collective action and expand the Foundation's impact across India.
* **Design the People, Culture and Talent Community:** Work closely with the leadership team at Sarvoham to design, implement and lead the talent attraction and retention strategy at Sarvoham that can attract desired talent across technical and functional requirements with a sense of purpose and commitment to contribute positively to perpetuity of Sarvoham's veterinary and sanctuary missions.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**End to End Talent Acquisition (50%):** Spearhead end to end talent acquisition across roles for the foundation including but not limited to:

* Veterinary professionals
* Animal caregivers
* Shelter and Sanctuary staff

* Fundraising professionals
* Storytelling, Communications and Branding roles
* Finance, HR and Administration in addition to Leadership and Specialist positions

***Responsibilities:***

* Partner with the leadership team at Sarvoham to project manpower requirements.
* Design job descriptions and recruitment campaigns.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, social media, referrals, universities and professional networks.
* Build available talent pipelines that align with the vision, mission and purpose of Sarvoham for critical positions.
* Screen resumes and conduct competency and skills assessments including initial interviews.
* Conduct reference and background checks for shortlisted candidates.
* Own the candidate engagement and communication engagement throughout the recruitment process.
* Prepare letters of intent, letters post compensation and fitment assessment within approved guidelines.
* Ensure an exceptional candidate experience from recruitment and onboarding to across the employee life-cycle.

**HR Business Partnering (50%):** Partner with the leadership team at Sarvoham to support the employee life-cycle including but not limited to the following:

* Manage employee lifecycle processes such as joining, onboarding, transfers, confirmations, attendance, leave, documentation and exit formalities adhering to mandated organisational policies and practices.
* Maintain accuracy and integrity of employee records, HR files and HRIS data.
* Organise meaningful employee engagement initiatives including learning and development.
* Design the Performance Management policy in line with the organisational philosophy, monitor performance trends and implement necessary corrective actions as per organisational policy.
* Introduce and support wellness and recognition programmes.
* Design and implement HR policies, including the code of conduct, grievance re-dressal, whistleblower and other policies aligned with organisational values and statutory regulations.
* Address employee queries and grievances, initiating corrective and disciplinary measures as required.
* Partner on Strategic Projects at Sarvoham including volunteering for animal welfare activities and programs.

**SUCCESS MEASURES:**

**Community Engagement & Social Impact:**

* Build partnerships with agencies and groups for building a network of veterinarians’ , NGOs, and volunteers that empower communities to become active participants in animal welfare, environmental sustainability, and community resilience.

**Candidate & Employee NPS:**

* Build Sarvoham as a brand an employer brand that places employee experience at the core of it's operations that drives genuine compassion for employees to become active participants in animal welfare, environmental sustainability, and community resilience.

**Candidate & Employee Experience:**

* Build credibility for Sarvoham as an employer of choice with a vision that resonates and attracts employee acquisition, sustainable retention and development to become active participants in animal welfare, environmental sustainability, and community resilience.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE:**

The ideal candidate is a purpose-driven individual who combines strategic thinking with a blend of compassion, influence, and execution, engaging prospective employees and communities, while inspiring internal teams around a shared purpose.

* **Work Experience:** 0-2 years of progressive experience in talent acquisition and business partnering. Freshers are welcome to apply.
* **Proven Track Record:** of fulfillment and employee satisfaction.
* **Operational Skills:** Proven ability to recruit and design, people thinking policies and processes with psychometric assessments, assignments and data-driven management.

**PREFERRED BACKGROUNDS:**

We are on a mission to establish equity, inclusion, and compassion for animals in society, so that they can lead a fulfilling and respectable life. We are looking for a clinician who resonates with this mission and believes that their experience, skills, and judgment can genuinely change outcomes for the animals who need it most — leading by example, and helping build a shelter medicine practice that will sustain for generations to come.

**Company Description:**

Tempcon Express Private Limited is a quality-focused, temperature-controlled shipment transportation company, providing complete logistics solutions to the healthcare, pharmaceutical, and clinical trial industry. Tempcon operates eight well-established cold chain facilities across India, which provide connectivity to import and export for many remotely spread API, finished products pharmaceutical manufacturers. Their global network reaches all the continents from South and North America, Canada, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Southeast, Asia-Pacific, Australia, and New Zealand. Tempcon is committed to providing first-class transportation services for temperature-sensitive and time-critical shipments, such as biological samples, Infectious samples, API's, Reagents, Reference standards, Chemical compounds, Investigation products, Clinical trial supplies, and Live animals.

As an Operation Executive at Tempcon Express Pvt Ltd, you will play a crucial role in managing and optimizing the operational processes within our temperature-controlled logistics division. You will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations, ensuring seamless coordination between various stakeholders, and maintaining the highest standards of service delivery.

7. : Identify areas for process improvement and optimization, implementing innovative solutions to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction.

8. : Oversee inventory levels at warehouses and distribution centres, implementing inventory control measures to minimize stockouts, excess inventory, and product spoilage.

9. : Liaise with internal departments such as sales, procurement, and finance to ensure seamless coordination and alignment of operational activities with business objectives.

**Qualifications and Skills:**

1. Bachelor's degree in logistics, supply chain management, business administration, or a related field.

2. Minimum of 2 years of experience in temperature-controlled logistics or a similar role within the logistics industry.

3. Strong understanding of temperature-controlled transportation requirements and best practices.

4. Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

6. Proficiency in logistics software and systems for route planning, tracking, and inventory management.

**Business Development and Sales Executive**

The selected candidate will independently generate sales opportunities and manage the complete sales cycle, including prospecting, lead qualification, client meetings, site visits, technical-commercial discussions, proposal coordination, negotiations, order closure and account follow-ups.

* Support negotiations within approved commercial limits.
* Convert qualified opportunities into purchase orders and coordinate payment follow-ups.

3. Industrial Technology Solution Sales

* **OEE & Production Monitoring:**

* **Industrial IoT & Smart Telemetry:**

* **Industrial Automation & Digitalisation:**
  Smart factory solutions.
* **Digital Twin & Smart Manufacturing:**
  Digital representation and optimisation of industrial processes.
* **AR/VR Industrial Training Solutions:**

* Build relationships with manufacturing companies, OEMs, Tier-1 and Tier-2 suppliers and industrial customers.
* Maintain regular communication with prospects and existing customers.
* Identify opportunities for repeat orders, software renewals, additional deployments and cross-selling.

* Update the CRM on the same working day after every call, meeting, visit and proposal.
* Maintain accurate records with clear next steps and expected order dates.
* Prepare daily activity summaries and weekly sales pipeline reports.
* Track meetings, proposals, expected orders and revenue opportunities.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

description:
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will lead the sales team and ensure that the hotel’s revenue targets are met. This role involves developing and implementing sales strategies, building relationships with key clients, and overseeing the daily operations of the sales department. As a **Director of Sales** , you’re not just driving revenue growth across all hotel segments – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

  

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

* **Shape and execute sales strategy:** Develop and implement revenue-driving sales strategies across group, business transient, leisure transient, and catering segments, aligned with the hotel’s commercial goals and strategic plan
* **Drive revenue performance and profitability:** Contribute to achieving revenue targets and profitability goals by optimizing pricing, improving business mix, and guiding forecasting accuracy
* **Lead business reviews and planning:** Facilitate regular strategy and performance meetings while contributing to long-range commercial planning through analysis of performance trends, market shifts, and revenue opportunities
* **Ensure commercial alignment:** Collaborate with revenue and marketing leaders to align sales tactics with pricing, distribution, and promotional strategies, and to support forecasting and rate strategies
* **Foster stakeholder relationships:** Engage with Hilton Worldwide Sales, Convention and Visitors Bureaus (CVBs), third-party travel partners, and key clients to drive demand, improve conversion, and support high-impact site visits and pre-convention meetings
* **Develop data-informed strategies:** Track market and competitor activity to inform strategy and help maintain competitive positioning in group and transient segments
* **Cultivate a high-performing team:** Recruit new talent while driving team growth and engagement through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

  

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of **Hospitality** . Acting with **Integrity** and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through **Leadership** . A belief that **Teamwork** drives the best outcomes. A sense of **Ownership** and accountability. And a focus on the **Now** , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:

* Degree qualifications in Business Management or equivalent.
* At least 5 years of experience in managing a hospitality proactive sales role preferred.
* Minimum 5+ years in a revenue-generating or commercial role within hospitality or travel.
* Proven experience managing and developing high-performing sales or commercial teams.
* Skilled in creating and presenting sales strategies to senior executives and stakeholder groups.
* Proficient in analyzing departmental financial data to inform strategic decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and capitalize on new business opportunities.
* Experience working in matrixed environments across departments.
* Experience in multi-complex hotel or travel operations.
* Technical Proficiency in hotel management software (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey systems) is a plus.

title: Digtal Marketing Manager
description:
We are hiring
Digital Marketing Manager

Apply here-
https://arobit.equihr.com/jobs/digital-marketing-manager-000006Job Role

Arobit Digital is hiring a
Digital Marketing Manager
to lead performance marketing and search for its client portfolio from Sector V, Salt Lake, Kolkata. This is a senior, hands-on role for a specialist with
4 to 5 years of performance marketing experience
who owns budgets, owns the numbers, and can stand in front of a client and explain both.

This is an
ads-first role
: the bulk of your week is Google and Meta — structure, bidding, creative testing, budget allocation and the measurement that proves any of it worked. It is not ads-only. You will also set
keyword strategy
and steer the
SEO roadmap
alongside the SEO team, because the same search demand feeds both.

Two things are non-negotiable. The first is
measurement
— if you cannot set up conversion and e-commerce tracking from scratch and defend the numbers it produces, this is not the right role. The second is
communication
— you will carry client relationships directly, including the difficult conversations.

**What you will own**

* Paid media strategy and execution
  — plan, build and optimise campaigns across
  Google Ads
  (Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Demand Gen) and
  Meta Ads
  , with LinkedIn and other platforms as the client mix demands.
* Budget ownership
  — hold monthly budgets across several accounts, allocate between channels and campaigns on evidence, and forecast what a given spend should return.
* Keyword research and planning
  — own the keyword universe for each client: demand and volume research, search intent mapping, commercial versus informational splits, competitor and keyword gap analysis, cannibalisation checks, and the decision about which terms to buy, which to earn, and which to leave alone.
* SEO direction
  — set the SEO roadmap with the SEO team: on-page priorities, content briefs built from keyword and search query data, technical hygiene with the developers, internal linking, and Search Console monitoring. Paid and organic inform each other, and you are the person holding both halves.
* Tracking and measurement setup
  — own it end to end:
  GA4
  ,
  Google Tag Manager
  , Google Ads conversion actions, the Meta pixel and Conversions API, event deduplication, UTM governance, Consent Mode and server-side tagging where it is warranted. You verify your own implementations.
* E-commerce tracking and revenue reporting
  — implement and audit the full GA4 e-commerce event sequence, item-level data, coupon and shipping handling, and refund and cancellation adjustments, so that the revenue you report reconciles with what the client actually banked.
* Funnel recovery
  — own abandoned cart and abandoned browse: the email and automation flows, dynamic remarketing audiences, exclusion logic and the timing behind them, measured on incremental revenue rather than on last-click credit.
* Conversion and KPI definition
  — agree with each client what counts as a conversion and what it is worth, then build the KPI framework that follows: CPA, CAC, ROAS, blended performance, qualified lead volume, pipeline contribution and lifetime value where the data supports it.
* Reporting and client communication
  — run monthly reviews that lead with the number, explain what moved it and what happens next. Written and spoken, to marketing managers and to founders.
* Conversion rate optimisation
  — brief and test landing pages, offers and funnels; run A/B tests that are designed properly and read honestly.
* Email and lifecycle marketing
  — own campaign and automation flows, segmentation, deliverability and the reporting around them.
* Team and vendor coordination
  — brief designers, copywriters and developers; review what comes back; keep the SEO, social and content teams aligned on the same client plan.
* AI-assisted work
  — use ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini for ad copy variants, keyword clustering, audience research, script and report drafting and data summarising. Strategy, budget calls and client-facing numbers remain your judgement, and client data, credentials and unreleased plans never go into a public AI tool.

Qualification

**Experience**

* Minimum 4 to 5 years in performance marketing
  , with a majority of that time spent hands-on in ad platforms rather than managing from a distance. Agency experience across multiple accounts is strongly preferred.
* A demonstrable record of owning monthly ad budgets and being accountable for a cost or return target, not only for campaign delivery.
* Be ready to walk us through the
  last campaign you personally built and ran
  — platform, objective, budget, audience, creative, bidding and the result in numbers — and to be asked where your measurement came from.

**Must-have**

* Bachelor’s degree; any discipline, provided the performance record is there.
* Deep, current command of Google Ads
  — Search, Shopping, Performance Max and Demand Gen; campaign structure, match types, bidding strategies, negative keyword hygiene, audience signals and budget pacing.
* Deep, current command of Meta Ads Manager
  — campaign objectives, audience and placement structure, creative testing frameworks and the Conversions API.
* Keyword research and planning as a core skill
  — you can build a keyword universe from scratch, read search intent, separate commercial from informational terms, run a competitor keyword gap, and decide what to buy versus what to earn. Comfort in Keyword Planner plus at least one of Ahrefs, SEMrush or Moz.
* Working command of SEO
  — on-page fundamentals, content briefing from search data, technical basics you can brief a developer on, and Search Console fluency. You do not need to be a specialist, but you must be able to own the roadmap and challenge the work.
* Complete ownership of tracking setup.
  You can implement GA4 and Google Tag Manager from scratch, configure and import conversion actions correctly, understand attribution models and conversion windows, and debug a broken tag yourself with Tag Assistant and GA4 DebugView.
* E-commerce tracking
  — the GA4 e-commerce event sequence end to end, item-level parameters, purchase deduplication between the pixel and the Conversions API, and reconciling platform-reported revenue against the client’s own back office.
* Fluency in the metrics and the arithmetic behind them
  — CPC, CPM, CTR, CPA, CAC, ROAS, blended CAC, conversion rate, impression share, AOV, LTV. You can tell when a reported number is wrong before a client does.
* Very strong spoken and written English.
  You will own client relationships, present monthly reviews and write the reports that go with them. This is weighted as heavily as the technical skill.
* Email marketing
  — campaigns, automation flows, segmentation, deliverability and the reporting around them, including cart and browse recovery.
* Analytical discipline: you form a hypothesis, change one thing, and read the result honestly rather than reporting the flattering cut.
* Integrity with client data and client numbers. A broken conversion event gets reported, not quietly corrected.
* Working fluency with modern AI tools — ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini — and the judgement about what must never be pasted into one.
* Willingness to work on-site from our Sector V, Salt Lake office.

**Good to have**

* Technical SEO depth — crawl diagnostics, site architecture, schema, Core Web Vitals — and experience running an SEO audit with Screaming Frog or similar.
* Conversion rate optimisation and structured A/B testing experience, with tools to match.
* Server-side tagging, Consent Mode v2, or enhanced and offline conversion imports.
* Shopify, WooCommerce or Magento tracking experience, and feed management for Shopping campaigns.
* CRM and marketing automation exposure — HubSpot, Zoho, Mailchimp, Klaviyo or similar — and closed-loop reporting from ad click to revenue.
* Looker Studio, Power BI or similar for client-facing dashboards.
* International or multi-currency campaign experience; e-commerce and lead generation across both.
* Google Ads and Meta Blueprint certifications.
* Experience mentoring executives or interns on a performance team.

**Selection process**

* Application review, then a
  mandatory recorded video assessment
  — roughly 45 minutes, part spoken answers and part multiple choice. Expect to talk about your own experience and the last campaign you ran, and to work through real use cases on e-commerce tracking, abandoned cart recovery, keyword planning, attribution and client communication.
* HR screening, followed by a department interview with the CMO. Expect to walk through real accounts and real numbers.

**Compensation & terms**

* Compensation
  as per industry standards
  , benchmarked to demonstrated performance record and the assessment outcome. Come with a number in mind.
* Full-time role, reporting to the CMO.
* Working on-site from our Sector V, Salt Lake office, Kolkata.
* Ownership of a real client portfolio from the first month, with the mandate to change what is not working.
