description:
Job Description – Business Development Executive (International Markets & HNI/UHNI)

**Company:**
ETYCIA GLOBAL PRIVATE LIMITED

**Position:**
Business Development Executive (BDE)

**Experience:**
3–7 Years

**Location:**
Gandhinagar

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Compensation:**
₹7–12 LPA (Based on Experience and Proven Track Record)

About the Role

We are looking for a highly driven and result-oriented Business Development Executive with a strong understanding of the software development and technology services industry.

The candidate will be responsible for independently identifying, acquiring, nurturing, and converting high-value business opportunities, with a primary focus on international markets, particularly the
**USA, UK, and Australia**
, along with India's
**High Net-Worth Individuals (HNIs) and Ultra-High-Net-Worth Individuals (UHNIs)**
.

This is an end-to-end business development role. The candidate is expected to take ownership of the complete sales cycle, from prospect identification and lead generation to pitching, negotiation, deal closure, and client relationship management.

We are specifically looking for someone who has demonstrated the ability to generate their own business opportunities and successfully close high-ticket software development projects.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

**1. Lead Generation & Market Development**

* Independently identify and generate qualified business leads across the USA, UK, Australia, and Indian HNI/UHNI segments.
* Develop and execute strategic lead-generation approaches through LinkedIn, networking, cold outreach, email campaigns, industry platforms, referrals, and other relevant channels.
* Identify potential clients, decision-makers, founders, CXOs, business owners, and investors.
* Research target industries and identify opportunities for custom software development, SaaS solutions, enterprise applications, web and mobile applications, and technology consulting.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified prospects.

**2. Business Development & Deal Closure**

* Own the complete sales lifecycle, from initial prospecting to successful deal closure.
* Understand client requirements and translate business challenges into relevant technology solutions.
* Conduct discovery calls, client meetings, product demonstrations, and business presentations.
* Prepare proposals, commercial quotations, project scopes, and business presentations in coordination with internal technical teams.
* Lead commercial negotiations, handle objections, and drive prospects towards successful closures.
* Consistently achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual business development targets.

**3. International Client Acquisition**

* Develop and maintain relationships with clients across the USA, UK, and Australian markets.
* Understand international business expectations, communication standards, pricing structures, and client engagement practices.
* Confidently interact with international stakeholders across different time zones.
* Explore strategic partnerships, channel opportunities, referral networks, and long-term business associations.

**4. HNI & UHNI Client Acquisition**

* Identify and engage with affluent individuals, business owners, entrepreneurs, family offices, and high-value decision-makers in India.
* Build relationships with premium clientele and identify opportunities for bespoke technology solutions.
* Demonstrate a professional approach to high-value client interactions, presentations, negotiations, and relationship management.

**5. Client Relationship & Account Management**

* Build long-term relationships with acquired clients.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business, cross-selling, and upselling.
* Ensure smooth coordination between clients and internal technical, project management, and delivery teams.
* Maintain regular communication with clients and ensure a positive business engagement experience.

**6. Sales Reporting & Pipeline Management**

* Maintain an updated CRM with lead details, follow-ups, opportunity stages, deal values, and closure probabilities.
* Track sales performance, conversion ratios, average deal size, and revenue generated.
* Prepare periodic business development reports and provide insights into market opportunities and sales performance.

Required Experience & Qualifications

* Minimum
  **3+ years of relevant experience**
  in Business Development, International Sales, IT Sales, or Software Services Sales.
* Ideally 3–7 years of experience with a proven track record in acquiring and closing software development or technology service deals.
* Demonstrated experience in independently generating leads and converting them into paying clients.
* Strong understanding of software development services, including custom software, SaaS, web applications, mobile applications, enterprise solutions, and IT consulting.
* Experience dealing with international clients, particularly from the USA, UK, and Australia, will be highly preferred.
* Experience handling high-value clients, HNIs, UHNIs, founders, CXOs, and senior decision-makers.
* Strong negotiation, presentation, communication, and relationship-building skills.
* Proficiency and fluency in spoken and written English are mandatory.

Mandatory Performance Track Record

Candidates appearing for this position must be able to demonstrate their previous business development performance with measurable achievements.

During the interview process, candidates will be expected to present:

* **Average Deal Size:**
  Average ticket size of projects successfully closed in previous organizations.
* **Highest Deal Size:**
  Largest individual project or client contract successfully acquired.
* **Revenue Generated:**
  Total business revenue generated during their previous tenure.
* **Lead Generation Performance:**
  Number of qualified leads independently generated.
* **Conversion Ratio:**
  Lead-to-client conversion rate and overall sales performance.
* **Client Geography:**
  Markets and regions from which they have acquired clients.
* **Sales Ownership:**
  Clear distinction between self-generated deals and leads provided by the organization.
* **Achievement Against Targets:**
  Previous monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets versus actual performance.

Candidates should be prepared to substantiate their achievements through examples, sales reports, deal histories, or other verifiable performance indicators, subject to confidentiality requirements.

Essential Skills & Competencies

* Exceptional verbal and written English communication.
* Excellent business presentation and pitching capabilities.
* Strong negotiation and deal-closing abilities.
* Strategic thinking and independent lead-generation capabilities.
* Confidence in interacting with international clients and premium clientele.
* Ability to understand technical requirements and communicate software solutions effectively.
* Strong networking and relationship-building skills.
* Self-driven, target-oriented, and accountable for business outcomes.
* Ability to work independently and take complete ownership of assigned markets.

Performance Expectations

The selected candidate will be expected to:

* Build an independent and consistent sales pipeline.
* Generate qualified opportunities across target international and domestic markets.
* Convert prospects into high-value software development engagements.
* Improve average deal size and overall revenue contribution.
* Establish long-term business relationships and generate repeat business.
* Demonstrate measurable business growth through actual closures rather than lead-generation numbers alone.

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for a business development professional who is not just experienced in sales but has a demonstrated ability to
**identify opportunities, open doors, build trust, negotiate commercially, and close high-value technology deals independently.**

* **If you have a proven history of acquiring international clients, managing high-ticket software development projects, and consistently delivering business revenue, we would like to hear from you.**

title: Finishing Engineer
description:
Job Description – Finishing Engineer

Location: Mumbai

Department: Projects / Construction

Industry: Real Estate – High-Rise Residential Development

Experience: 8 -12 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Objective

We are looking for an experienced Finishing Engineer to manage and execute finishing works for premium high-rise residential projects in Mumbai.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring superior workmanship, adherence to drawings and specifications, timely completion, coordination between multiple agencies, systematic snagging and possession-ready delivery of apartments and common areas.

The role requires strong on-site execution capabilities and a keen eye for finishing quality and detailing.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Finishing Works Execution**

\* Plan, supervise and execute all internal and external finishing activities.

\* Manage works including:

\* Blockwork and internal plaster

\* Waterproofing

\* Screeding and flooring

\* Marble, granite and tile works

\* Gypsum/plaster and false ceilings

\* Internal and external painting

\* Doors, frames and hardware

\* Aluminium/windows and glazing

\* Railings and metal works

\* Sanitary and CP fittings

\* Kitchen and utility finishes

\* Carpentry and joinery

\* Façade finishing interfaces

\* Common areas, lift lobbies and staircases

\* Entrance lobby and other premium finishes

\* External development and landscape interfaces

**2. Quality Control**

\* Ensure finishing works are executed strictly as per approved drawings, specifications, material approvals and established quality standards.

\* Inspect workmanship at every stage instead of identifying defects only at completion.

\* Check line, level, plumb, alignment, joints, slopes, surface finish, shade variations and overall aesthetics.

\* Ensure proper protection of completed finishes to prevent damage by subsequent agencies.

\* Establish and maintain benchmark/mock-up standards before commencement of repetitive finishing works.

\* Identify defective workmanship and ensure timely rectification.

**3. MEP & Services Coordination**

\* Coordinate finishing works with electrical, plumbing, fire-fighting, HVAC, ELV and other service contractors.

\* Ensure all concealed services are inspected and approved before closing walls, ceilings, shafts or flooring.

\* Prevent rework arising from improper coordination between civil, finishing and MEP agencies.

**4. Planning & Contractor Management**

\* Prepare floor-wise and activity-wise finishing schedules in line with the overall project programme.

\* Monitor daily and weekly progress against targets.

\* Coordinate multiple contractors and vendors to maintain proper work sequence.

\* Assess manpower and material requirements in advance to avoid delays.

\* Conduct regular site coordination meetings and follow up on pending activities.

\* Verify contractor work quantities and assist in certification of bills where required.

**5. Drawings & Technical Coordination**

\* Study and implement architectural, interior, structural and MEP drawings.

\* Identify drawing discrepancies and constructability issues before execution.

\* Coordinate with architects, consultants and the project team for RFIs and technical clarifications.

\* Ensure only the latest approved drawings are being followed at site.

**6. Snagging & Possession Readiness**

\* Conduct systematic apartment-wise, floor-wise and common-area snagging.

\* Maintain snag lists with clear responsibility and closure timelines.

\* Carry out pre-handover inspections before units are offered for customer inspection.

\* Coordinate with CRM/Post-Sales teams for customer inspections and possession.

\* Ensure customer snags are attended to promptly and closed to the required quality standard.

\* Ensure flats are thoroughly checked, cleaned, functional and possession-ready before handover.

**7. Material Management**

\* Check incoming finishing materials for approved make, specification, shade and quality.

\* Monitor material consumption and minimise wastage.

\* Ensure appropriate storage and protection of high-value finishing materials.

\* Coordinate material requirements and delivery schedules with Procurement.

**8. Documentation & Reporting**

Maintain proper records of:

\* Daily progress

\* Quality inspections

\* Material approvals

\* Mock-up approvals

\* RFIs and drawing revisions

\* Snagging and closure status

\* Contractor performance

\* Floor-wise completion status

Provide regular progress and quality reports to the Project Manager/Management.

Candidate Profile

\* B.E./B.Tech Civil or Diploma in Civil Engineering

\* 10 + years of relevant experience, preferably with reputed developers or contractors executing high-rise residential projects in Mumbai.

\* Strong hands-on experience in premium residential finishing works.

\* Should have independently handled finishing of multiple floors/apartments through final possession.

\* Good understanding of architectural drawings, finishing details and MEP interfaces.

\* Strong knowledge of finishing materials, installation methodology and quality standards.

\* Ability to manage multiple contractors and large site teams.

\* Strong problem-solving and coordination abilities.

\* Extremely detail-oriented with a strong eye for workmanship, alignment, aesthetics and final presentation.

**Preferred Experience**

Preference will be given to candidates who have:

\* Worked on premium/luxury high-rise residential buildings

\* Managed finishing from bare shell through possession

\* Experience with sample/mock-up flats

\* Managed apartment and common-area snagging

\* Coordinated directly with architects and interior designers

\* Experience in customer handover and possession

\* Delivered projects with high-quality marble, stone, façade, lobby and interior finishes

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will primarily be measured on:

\* Finishing quality and workmanship

\* Floor-wise completion against schedule

\* Number of snags at internal inspection

\* Customer snags at possession

\* Snag closure turnaround time

\* Rework and material wastage

\* Contractor productivity

\* Protection of completed works

\* Readiness of apartments for possession

\* Quality of common areas and final project presentation

**Key Requirements:**

\* Strong experience in high-rise residential finishing

\* Expertise in flooring, marble/tiles, painting, gypsum, doors/windows, sanitary fittings & common-area finishes

\* Strong Civil–MEP coordination

\* Contractor & floor-wise execution management

\* Excellent eye for quality and detailing

\* Experience in snagging, possession readiness & customer handover

\* B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in Civil Engineering

Candidates who have independently handled finishing from civil completion to possession will be preferred.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: Assistant Manager BTL & Trade Marketing
description: JOB DESCRIPTION Assistant Manager – Trade & BTL Organisation QI Spine Function Sales & Business Growth (Trade and BTL Channels) Education Graduate in any discipline (MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing or Business Management preferred) About QI Spine QI Spine is a spine care provider that helps patients, particularly those aged 35+ with spine-related pain, move from first consultation to treatment through its clinics. Our Trade and BTL teams build doctor referral partnerships and run hyperlocal community activations that bring patients to QI Spine for their First Consultation and Treatment Onboarding. 1. Role Overview The Assistant Manager - Trade & BTL will drive patient acquisition and business growth for QI Spine through on-ground Trade and BTL channels. The role involves leading and managing a team of Medical Representatives (MRs) and BTL Executives, building doctor referral networks, executing hyperlocal BTL activities and delivering business outcomes across the complete funnel: Lead Generation, First Consultation (FC), Treatment Onboarding (TO) and Revenue. The incumbent will be accountable for team productivity, territory expansion, channel performance and achievement of assigned FC and TO targets. 2. Roles & Responsibilities A. Team Management & Leadership • Lead, manage, hire and develop a team of MRs and BTL Executives across assigned territories. • Define daily, weekly and monthly targets for each team member. • Conduct daily morning huddles to communicate targets, field plans and priorities. • Monitor daily field productivity, visits, lead generation, FCs and TOs at an individual level. • Conduct regular field visits with team members for coaching, training and performance monitoring. • Ensure proper territory allocation, beat planning and utilisation of field resources. • Identify underperforming team members and drive structured improvement plans. • Participate in recruitment, onboarding and training of MRs and BTL Executives. • Build a high-performance field team and ensure team stability and accountability. B. Trade & Medical Representative Management • Develop and manage referral relationships with doctors, clinics, physiotherapy centres, hospitals and other relevant healthcare stakeholders. • Identify and onboard new referral partners across assigned territories. • Drive regular engagement with existing referral partners. • Develop territory-wise doctor mapping and prioritise high-potential referral sources. • Ensure consistent referral generation from mapped doctors and healthcare professionals. • Track partner-wise leads, FCs, TOs and revenue contribution. • Ensure regular field visits and structured follow-ups with referral partners. • Identify opportunities to expand the referral network and improve productivity from existing partners. • Develop strategies to activate dormant partners and increase referrals from existing ones. • Ensure MRs maintain strong relationships and generate sustainable business from their territories. C. BTL & Hyperlocal Marketing Execution • Plan and execute hyperlocal activations across residential societies, corporate parks, commercial hubs, gyms, clubs and other relevant catchments. • Identify high-footfall locations and potential patient cohorts, particularly individuals aged 35+ with spine-related pain. • Plan and execute health camps, awareness drives, screening activities, stalls and community engagement programmes. • Build relationships with RWAs, society committees, corporate HR teams and local influencers. • Identify new locations and opportunities for regular BTL activations. • Ensure maximum relevant lead capture and conversion from every activation. • Monitor activity-wise expenditure, lead generation, FC contribution, TO conversion and ROI. • Ensure timely execution and reporting of all planned BTL activities. • Continuously evaluate the performance of different activation formats and optimise execution based on business outcomes. D. FC, TO & Revenue Ownership • Own monthly FC and TO generation targets across assigned Trade and BTL channels. • Drive the complete funnel from lead generation to FC scheduling, FC completion and Treatment Onboarding. • Track FC-to-TO conversion at partner, activity, territory and individual team-member levels. • Work closely with Inside Sales and clinic teams to improve lead follow-ups, appointment scheduling and FC show-up rates. • Ensure timely handover of quality leads to the Inside Sales team. • Review non-converted FC cases and identify reasons for drop-offs. • Coordinate with relevant teams to improve patient follow-ups and treatment conversion. • Identify low-performing territories, partners and activities and implement corrective actions. • Drive revenue contribution through improved FC volumes and TO conversions. • Ensure the team is accountable for actual business outcomes, not only field visits and lead generation. E. Reporting, Analysis & Performance Management • Maintain daily field activity and productivity reports. • Track individual MR and BTL Executive performance against assigned targets. • Maintain partner-wise, territory-wise and activity-wise lead, FC and TO tracking. • Monitor daily, weekly and monthly target achievement. • Analyse funnel drop-offs and identify gaps in lead-to-FC and FC-to-TO conversion. • Prepare corrective action plans for underperforming channels and team members. • Ensure discipline in CRM usage, lead tagging, data accuracy and reporting. • Share daily execution updates and weekly performance reviews with leadership. 3. Required Experience • 4–7 years of overall experience in field sales, healthcare sales, pharma sales, trade marketing or BTL activation. • Minimum 1–2 years of experience managing field teams. • Prior experience managing MRs or field sales executives is strongly preferred. • Experience in doctor engagement, healthcare partnerships, referral generation and hyperlocal activations is an advantage. • Experience handling territory-wise sales targets and business conversion. • Candidates with an existing network of MRs, or the ability to bring experienced field resources along, are highly preferred. 4. Educational Background • Graduate in any discipline. • MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing or Business Management preferred but not mandatory. • Candidates with strong field execution and team management experience will be prioritised over educational qualifications. 5. Key Result Areas (KRAs) & KPIs KRA Key Performance Indicators FC Generation Monthly FC target achievement from Trade and BTL TO Generation Monthly TO target achievement from Trade and BTL Revenue Contribution Revenue generated through assigned channels FC-to-TO Conversion Percentage of completed FCs converted into TOs Lead Generation Number of qualified leads generated against target Doctor Partnerships New doctors onboarded and activated Partner Productivity Active doctors, referrals per doctor and TOs per partner Trade Productivity Leads, FCs and TOs generated per MR BTL Execution Number of activations executed against plan BTL Productivity Leads, FCs and TOs generated per activation Lead Quality Lead-to-FC conversion and FC show-up percentage Team Productivity Individual FC and TO target achievement Territory Expansion New territories covered and active referral/activation points Cost & ROI Cost per lead, cost per FC and channel ROI Team Management Attendance, retention, training and performance improvement Reporting & Governance Daily reporting, CRM hygiene and execution tracker adherence 6. Ideal Candidate Profile • Strong field-oriented leader with an execution-first mindset. • Prior experience managing a team of MRs or healthcare field sales executives. • Strong relationship-building and networking capabilities, particularly with doctors and healthcare stakeholders. • Ability to independently plan territories, identify business opportunities and drive revenue. • Comfortable managing both Trade and BTL channels. • Strong ownership of targets, team productivity and business outcomes. • Willing to spend significant time in the field alongside the team. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify funnel gaps and improve channel performance. 7. Preferred Hiring Profile Preference will be given to candidates from Pharma Sales, Healthcare Sales or Healthcare Field Business Development backgrounds who have: • Managed a team of 5–10 or more MRs/field executives. • Experience in doctor mapping, referral generation and territory management. • Exposure to BTL activations and hyperlocal marketing. • Experience handling FC/appointment or sales conversion targets. • The ability to bring a few experienced and productive MRs through their professional network. We are looking for a hands-on field leader who can build and manage the Trade and BTL team, scale referral partnerships and hyperlocal activities, and take complete ownership of channel business outcomes, from Lead Generation to FC, TO and Revenue.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

UK International is looking for a Performance Marketing Manager who can turn a budget into qualified enquiries, and qualified enquiries into enrolled students. You will own paid acquisition for a career-focused beauty education brand, from the first impression to the admission, and you will be judged by what lands in the admissions register, not by what looks pretty in a dashboard.

We’re not hiring someone to celebrate a ₹90 lead cost while the counselling team asks why nobody picks up the phone. We want a manager who knows that a cheap lead can be the most expensive thing you buy, who treats every campaign as a hypothesis with a budget and a kill rule, and who can say “I was wrong, here’s what the data says now” without needing a lie-down.

**WHAT YOU’LL OWN (AND KEEP HONEST)**

● Paid acquisition strategy and execution across Meta, Google Search, Display and YouTube/Demand Gen, plus other platforms where they earn their place, with full ownership of budgets, pacing and targets.

● The whole funnel: click, landing page, form, counsellor call, application, admission. You track cost per qualified lead and cost per admission, not just CPL.

● Audience, creative and offer testing with our design and content teams: sharp briefs in, clear learnings out, and no “let’s just boost it.”

● Landing page and conversion rate optimisation: forms, WhatsApp and call flows, page speed, and the speed at which a lead actually gets a call back.

● Tracking and attribution: GA4, GTM, pixels, Conversions API, UTM discipline, CRM integration and offline conversion uploads, so platforms learn to chase admissions instead of junk.

● The lead-quality loop with admissions and counselling: feedback, lead scoring, disqualification reasons and what they mean for targeting.

● Budget planning, forecasting and monthly reporting to leadership in plain language: what worked, what didn’t, what we do next.

● Remarketing, lookalikes and seasonal admission cycles, coordinated with SEO and organic so we don’t pay for what we’d get free.

● Guiding junior executives, freelancers or agencies: setting standards, reviewing work and protecting the budget from enthusiasm.

**WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO BRING**

● 4–7 years of hands-on performance marketing, ideally in ed-tech, admissions or other long-consideration, highticket lead-generation funnels.

● A record of managing meaningful monthly budgets across Meta and Google, with results measured down to revenue or admissions rather than leads alone.

● Strong command of Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, GA4 and GTM, plus a CRM and a reporting tool (Looker Studio or similar). Excel or Sheets fluency is expected.

● A real grasp of funnel maths, attribution limits, incrementality and the delay between a lead and an admission.

● Experience fixing lead-quality problems: junk leads, form fills without intent, instant-form traps and platform-versusCRM mismatches.

● A feel for what makes a student or a parent click, and for what makes them convert once they’ve clicked. ● Comfort with AI-assisted workflows for creative, copy and analysis, with a habit of checking the output before it spends money.

● Experience leading a small team or managing an agency is a plus.

**THE NON-NEGOTIABLES**

● You can explain why a number moved, not just report that it moved.

● You don’t scale a campaign because the dashboard is happy; you check whether the counsellors are, too. ● You test with a hypothesis, a budget and a kill rule, not vibes and a screenshot.

● You say “I don’t know yet, here’s how we’ll find out” when that is the truth.

● You report the numbers that make you look bad as clearly as the ones that make you look good.

● You flag budget burn, broken tracking and ad disapprovals early, not in the monthly review.

**1. Role Objective**

**Build and manage a high-volume, multi-platform content production and distribution ecosystem for Doctors Foodstore.**

**The objective is to establish Doctors Foodstore as a leading nutrition, food and preventive wellness media brand by consistently producing and distributing high-quality content across multiple niche media pages and digital platforms.**

title: Product Marketing Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Vervotech, a Constellation Inc company, builds technology that helps travel businesses turn messy supplier data into clean, conversion-ready inventory. Its flagship product, Vervotech Mapping, standardizes and enriches complex accommodation data so customers can offer accurate, bookable listings. The company also offers Profit Maximizer, a solution designed to turn every confirmed booking into additional margin and improved profitability. Together, these products help travel and hospitality companies optimize inventory quality, increase revenue, and deliver better experiences to end customers.
  
**Role Description**
The Product Marketing Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Pune City. This role focuses on positioning and promoting Vervotech’s products, including Vervotech Mapping and Profit Maximizer, to drive adoption and growth. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing product messaging and value propositions, collaborating with product management to understand feature updates, and translating technical capabilities into clear, customer-focused materials. The specialist will plan and execute go-to-market campaigns, support sales enablement with presentations and collateral, and conduct market and competitive research to refine targeting and pricing. The role also involves working closely with cross-functional teams to gather feedback, measure campaign performance, and continuously improve product communication and market presence.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Market Research skills, including competitive analysis and customer insights gathering.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, covering written, verbal, and presentation abilities for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Candidates should possess Go-to-Market Strategy skills, including launch planning, segmentation, and messaging development.
* Candidates should possess Sales-related skills, such as sales enablement, collaboration with sales teams, and understanding of sales funnels.
* Candidates should possess Product Management-related skills, including familiarity with product lifecycles, feature prioritization, and translating customer needs into product requirements.
* Experience in B2B SaaS or travel-tech industries is beneficial.
* Strong analytical abilities, comfort with data-driven decision-making, and basic proficiency with marketing and CRM tools are preferred.
* A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is desirable.

title: Senior HR Business Partner (Tech + Ops)
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're seeking a Senior HR Business Partner to support our rapidly growing R&D & Ops team in BLR. In this role, you’ll play a pivotal part in shaping our high-growth organization while contributing to the evolution of our HR function. As we build and scale to meet the dynamic needs of the business, you’ll have the opportunity to drive meaningful impact in a fast-paced and exciting environment. It’s an exciting time to join!
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Partner with Engineering & Ops leaders to translate business priorities and the broader HRBP roadmap into clear people recommendations and action plans for aligned India client groups.
* Serve as a trusted thought partner to leaders on organizational health, leadership effectiveness, performance, employee relations, and manager capability.
* Coach and advise managers on complex leadership and HR matters, including sensitive employee relations issues, performance challenges, team dynamics, and manager effectiveness.
* Independently drive defined HRBP workstreams from diagnosis through execution, bringing forward recommendations, tradeoffs, and escalation points where needed.
* Lead & improve core HR programs for Engineering & Ops, including performance management, manager effectiveness, talent reviews, engagement planning, and compensation cycles, ensuring they are executed with strategic context and operational rigor.
* Use Rippling, data, and emerging AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to improve insight generation, reduce manual work, and create leverage in recurring people processes.
* Identify patterns and recurring pain points across aligned Engineering & Ops teams, then recommend practical improvements to HR processes, workflows, and manager enablement.
* Partner cross-functionally with HR, Talent, Compensation, Legal, People Ops, HR Systems, and regional HR teams to deliver solutions that support India Engineering & Ops leaders and align with broader HRBP priorities.

**What Will You Need**

* Minimum of 7+ years of previous HRBP experience & overall HR experience of 10-12 yrs.
* Broad HR expertise across performance management, employee relations, manager effectiveness, organizational design, talent development, and compensation cycles.
* Experience supporting or building people programs, frameworks, processes, or operating rhythms that improve leadership effectiveness, talent outcomes, and organizational health.
* Strong business acumen, with the ability to connect business priorities to practical people strategies, recommendations, and HR solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to use data to diagnose organizational health, identify talent risks, and shape recommendations for leaders.
* Ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution and knowing when to escalate or align.
* Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust, challenge thoughtfully, overcome resistance, and advise leaders through sensitive or complex organizational decisions.
* Experience working in an AI-forward environment, with hands-on experience using AI-enabled tools, workflows, prompts, automations, or skills to increase HRBP leverage, improve manager enablement, and strengthen execution of people programs.

**The final compensation offered to a successful candidate will depend on several factors, including but not limited to, location, experience, education, training, and business need. This position may also be eligible for bonuses, commissions, and/or equity, subject to applicable plan documents and company policy. Successful candidates hired for this role may also be eligible to participate in the company's benefits programs, which may include, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement benefits, and/or paid time off, as determined by company policy.**

description:

**Job Description:**
**About The Role**
The People Experience Partner - Cluster Lead leads a co-located team of People Experience Partners within a Global Capability Centre, delivering people partnership across an assigned geographical cluster. The role is accountable for how support is allocated, delivered and experienced by leaders across the countries, business units and functions in scope.
  
  
This is a working leadership role. Alongside leading the team, you remain hands-on in the most complex, sensitive and high-impact people matters in the cluster, acting as the escalation and decision point for People Experience Partners and as the named account contact for the HR Business Leaders your cluster serves.
  
  
You also hold a specialised regional practice area — for example leave management, employee relations, compensation and benefits, or organisation design and talent — acting as the region’s deep expert, setting standards, building capability and resolving matters that need specialist judgement. The role sits above the People Experience Partner in seniority and reports to the Regional HR Lead.
  
  
How you will contribute
  
  
Leading the cluster team
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop a co-located team of People Experience Partners, setting priorities, balancing workload and supporting capability and career development.
* Assign People Experience Partners to business units and functions within the cluster, ensuring clear coverage and resilience as demand, people and business priorities shift.
* Act as the escalation and decision point for complex, high-impact or sensitive people matters raised by the team, providing timely guidance and resolution.
* Build a strong team culture at the Global Capability Centre site, fostering learning, inclusion, peer coaching and continuous improvement across the cluster.

Delivering HR partnering work
  
  

* Carry a personal portfolio of HR partnering work, taking the most complex and senior-facing people matters in the cluster — restructurings and reductions in force, sensitive employee relations cases, senior leader coaching and significant change activity.
* Coach and advise leaders across core people priorities — employee relations, performance, talent, succession, rewards, mobility, talent acquisition, change and organisation design — applying sound judgement and escalating where legal or Centre of Excellence and Innovation input is required.
* Model the expected standard of partnering and raise the quality of advice given to leaders across the cluster.

Regional practice area specialisation
  
  

* Hold a named regional practice area — such as leave management, employee relations, compensation and benefits, or organisation design, learning and talent management — acting as the subject matter expert the region consults.
* Resolve the cases in that practice area that need genuine specialist judgement, wherever in the region they arise, working with the relevant Centre of Excellence and Innovation on policy interpretation, precedent and risk.
* Set and maintain the regional standard in your practice area through current playbooks, decision criteria, templates and guidance.
* Build capability in that practice area across People Experience Partners and People Solutions Advisors (PSA) through coaching, case review and training, so that routine matters are handled at the right tier and only true exceptions reach you.

Stakeholder and account management
  
  

* Act as the account manager and point of contact for the HR Business Leaders your cluster serves, keeping ownership clear and the number of contacts to a minimum.
* Own escalations from HR Business Leaders relating to your cluster, resolving them or routing them to the right accountable party with clear ownership and timelines.
* Partner with HR Business Leaders, People Solutions Advisors and Centres of Excellence and Innovation to adapt programmes, policies and tools to country and client-group needs.
* Represent the cluster to the Regional HR Lead and senior stakeholders, giving transparent reporting on service performance, risks and resourcing.

Service quality, standards and compliance
  
  

* Ensure clean handoffs and clear escalation paths between Direct Access, People Solutions Advisors, People Experience Partners and specialist teams, so that cases sit at the right tier and are not passed unnecessarily.
* Monitor key performance indicators and service levels across the cluster, performing quality checks, analysing trends and implementing corrective action to maintain high standards.
* Drive standardisation of people processes and tools across the cluster, and enable people leaders to own routine people processes with timely support from HR.
* Ensure adherence to data privacy, employment and labour law and internal policy across the countries in your cluster, supporting audits and risk mitigation.

Data, AI and digital enablement
  
  

* Embed the use of people data, workforce analytics and AI-enabled tools in how the cluster works, using insight to identify trends, inform decisions and automate repeatable work.
* Drive adoption of digital HR platforms and self-service, so that People Experience Partner time is focused on higher-value and more complex people matters.
* Identify and deliver opportunities for automation, standardisation and process improvement in the cluster and in your practice area, sharing what works with the other clusters in the region.

**Skills And Qualifications**

* Eight or more years of progressive Human Resources experience, including strong HR partnering experience in regional or global contexts.
* Deep expertise in at least one HR practice area — leave management, employee relations, compensation and benefits, or organisation design, learning and talent management — sufficient to act as the reference point for a region.
* Experience leading, coaching and developing others, whether as a people manager or as a team or workstream lead, with the ability to set priorities and enable on-the-job development.
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Organisational Psychology or a related field; a master's degree or professional HR certification is preferred.
* Proven experience in complex global matrix organisations, aligning priorities across regions, functions and geographies, and operating within a clustered, shared-service or tiered HR model.
* Knowledge of employment law and regulatory requirements across multiple countries, with the judgement to manage complex matters and the discipline to escalate appropriately.
* Credibility to influence and coach senior leaders and HR Business Leaders, with strong stakeholder management, facilitation and conflict management skills.
* Practical experience using people analytics, data visualisation, HR information systems and AI-enabled tools to inform decisions and improve service, with a track record of driving adoption.
* Change management experience delivering process and operating model change, with clear written and verbal communication, comfort with ambiguity, and willingness to travel regionally as required.

description:
Job Purpose

We are looking for an experienced and proactive HR Manager to lead key HR functions, focusing on employee engagement, employee relations, career development, HR policies, performance management, employee lifecycle management, and organisational effectiveness.

The role requires regular interaction with Heads of Functions (HOFs), business leaders, management, and employees to understand workforce requirements, address employee concerns, drive HR initiatives, and ensure effective implementation of HR policies and processes across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Employee Relations & Engagement**

* Act as a key point of contact for employee relations and address employee grievances, concerns, and workplace challenges.
* Conduct regular interactions with employees to understand their expectations, concerns, and career aspirations.
* Build strong relationships with employees, HOFs, and management.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives and improve employee satisfaction and retention.
* Handle sensitive employee matters with confidentiality and professionalism.

**2. Employee Induction**

* Design, coordinate, and manage employee induction and orientation programmes.
* Ensure smooth integration of new employees into the organisation.
* Review induction effectiveness and continuously improve the onboarding experience.

**3. HOF & Management Coordination**

* Regularly meet and discuss with HOFs and management to understand departmental challenges, workforce expectations, and employee-related concerns.
* Partner with business leaders to provide appropriate HR solutions.
* Identify employee-related issues and recommend suitable interventions.
* Support management in implementing HR strategies and organisational initiatives.

**4. Employee Career Development**

* Conduct employee career discussions and career progression meetings.
* Understand employee aspirations, competencies, and development requirements.
* Coordinate with HOFs to identify internal career growth and development opportunities.
* Facilitate internal movements, promotions, and succession planning.
* Support the development of employee retention strategies.

**5. HR Policies & Process Development**

* Develop, review, update, and implement HR policies and procedures in line with organisational requirements and applicable labour laws.
* Establish standard HR processes and ensure consistent implementation across departments.
* Communicate HR policies effectively to employees and management.
* Ensure compliance with statutory requirements and organisational guidelines.

**6. POSH & Workplace Compliance**

* Oversee the implementation of POSH policies and ensure awareness across the organisation.
* Coordinate POSH awareness sessions and employee sensitisation programmes.
* Work closely with the Internal Committee (IC) to facilitate POSH-related processes.
* Ensure confidentiality, documentation, and compliance with applicable statutory requirements.

**7. Performance Management & Annual Hike Cycle**

* Coordinate and manage the annual performance appraisal and salary revision cycle.
* Work with HOFs and management to facilitate performance reviews and employee evaluations.
* Coordinate performance ratings, salary recommendations, promotions, and increment proposals.
* Ensure timely completion of the appraisal process and effective communication of outcomes.
* Maintain performance management records and reports.

**8. Employee Exit Management**

* Manage the complete employee separation and exit process.
* Conduct exit interviews and analyse employee feedback to identify attrition trends.
* Coordinate with HOFs, payroll, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth employee exits.
* Identify key reasons for employee attrition and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure proper exit documentation, clearance, and adherence to company policies.

**9. HR MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare and present HR reports related to employee engagement, attrition, retention, employee grievances, performance, and other HR activities.
* Track key HR metrics and provide actionable insights to management.
* Maintain accurate employee-related records and documentation.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resource Management or equivalent qualification.
* 8–12 years of relevant HR experience, preferably with experience in the real estate, construction, infrastructure, or other large-scale organisations.
* Strong experience in employee relations, HR operations, and employee lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience in designing and implementing HR policies and processes.
* Experience in managing annual appraisal, performance evaluation, and salary revision cycles.
* Good understanding of POSH regulations and employee grievance management.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to interact confidently with senior management and HOFs.
* Ability to handle sensitive employee matters with discretion and confidentiality.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

Key Competencies

* Employee-centric approach
* Stakeholder and relationship management
* Conflict resolution and problem-solving
* Strategic HR thinking
* Policy formulation and implementation
* Communication and interpersonal skills
* Confidentiality and professional integrity
* Leadership and decision-making

Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:**
At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.
  
  
As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

**About the Role:**
This role ( Specialist - HR Operations) is the operational backbone of our employee experience across multiple entities. You will play a crucial role in managing our HR operations, Vendor management, Benefit administratement, payroll, compliance, audits and general HR functions and You will solve complex compliance and lifecycle challenges, ensuring our internal HR engine runs flawlessly as we scale. It's an exciting opportunity to build scalable workflows, bridge the gap between HR and other cross functional teams.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**

* Payroll Management : Oversee and manage the end-to-end in house payroll process, ensuring timely and accurate salary payments, deductions, and tax saving benefits administration. Maintain accurate and confidential payroll records and documentation.
* Tax Reporting : Prepare and file all required tax documents and reports, including quarterly and annual tax filings, 24Q to generate form 16 and other related forms.
* Payroll Reporting : Generate and share payroll reports in prescribed formats, including payroll summaries, tax reports, and compliance reports etc with the finance team.
* Audits and Reviews : Conduct regular payroll audits to ensure accuracy and compliance. Prepare for internal and external audits as required.
* Statutory compliance : Ensure timely preparation and payment of Statutory dues (PF, ESIC, LWF etc) and filling of paid challans.
* Compliance : Ensure adherence to all relevant employment laws and regulations. Conduct regular audits to maintain compliance and address any discrepancies or issues.
* Benefits Administration : Ensure accurate payroll deductions of employee benefits and timely process the payment to respective partners to record in employees wallets/accounts. Support Wellness benefits including health insurance, wellness benefits etc.
* Vendor Management: You’ll be the go-to person for all things related to our HR vendors and consultants. From the moment we decide to partner with someone new, you’ll take the reins—guiding them through onboarding, sorting out NDAs and InfoSec approvals, and getting their agreements finalized. You’ll also keep track of when contracts are up for renewal and handle them smoothly via Spotdraft. But your impact doesn't stop at contracts; you’ll be deeply involved in the financial side of things, too. You’ll run the PR-PO workflows on NetSuite, process invoices, reconcile accounts, and keep our HR Expense Tracker perfectly organized so we always know exactly where things stand.
* HR Operations : Support daily HR operations, including employee onboarding, records management, and HRIS maintenance. Act as a point of contact for HR-related inquiries. Work closely with other HR team members and departments to ensure seamless integration of HR processes and support organizational goals.
* HR System Management : Administrate and update HRMS as per the requirement. Implement and test system upgrades and changes to ensure continued accuracy and efficiency.
* Dashboard and Reporting : Develop and maintain HR dashboards and reports to track key metrics, identify trends, and provide insights.
* Project Management : Lead and participate in HR projects aimed at improving operational efficiency and employee satisfaction. Manage project timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder communications.
* Attention to Detail : Maintain high levels of accuracy in all aspects of payroll processing, compliance, and reporting. Identify and resolve issues proactively. Ensure compliance with data protection regulations.

**You’ll Excel in This Role If You Have:**

* Think in first principles and act like an owner, taking absolute accountability for sensitive data and compliance deadlines.
* Possess a sharp eye for numerical accuracy and meticulous attention to detail.
* Communicate with precision and empathy, effectively resolving employee queries and collaborating with external vendors.
* Thrive in a fast-paced environment, seamlessly balancing the operational needs of multiple entities.
* Have a strong bias for action and efficient problem-solving, turning operational bottlenecks into streamlined processes.
* Navigate ambiguity with ease, staying proactively updated on evolving state gazettes and labor laws.

﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿
  
  
**You’ll Know You’re Winning When:**

* You’re delivering 100% error-free and on-time monthly payroll and statutory filings with zero compliance defaults or penalties.
* You’ve established a frictionless benefits administration process, consistently resolving employee queries and enrollments within targeted SLAs.
* You’ve successfully streamlined the PR-PO and vendor onboarding workflows, resulting in fully reconciled and up-to-date HR expense trackers.
* You’ve elevated the new joiner orientation experience, ensuring all statutory forms, COCs, and compliance declarations are seamlessly executed on day one.

**Why This Role Matters & What’s In It For You**
As the anchor of our HR team, Your work directly ensures that the people building CoinDCX feel genuinely supported, cared for, and paid on time, all while keeping our company safe and compliant. Along the way, you’ll get incredible hands-on experience managing HR and finance workflows across multiple entities. This is a special chance to shape how we care for our team from the ground up, doing meaningful work in an industry that's changing the world.
  
  
**Hiring Process:**
Here’s what your journey with us looks like:
  
  

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving
* Assignment / Simulation Round –A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios

**Where We Work:**
We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
  
  
With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our
**Bangalore**
office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
  
  
**Perks That Empower You:**
We believe great people deserve great experiences.
  
  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
* Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities

**Ready to Build What’s Next?**
If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it. Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

title: Training & Placement Manager
description:
1. Job Purpose

The Training & Placement Manager will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive training and placement strategies to enhance students' employability and career opportunities. The role involves establishing strong relationships with corporate organisations, identifying employment opportunities, coordinating campus recruitment activities, and ensuring students are equipped with the necessary technical, communication, and professional skills to succeed in the workplace.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities

**A. Training & Development**

* Develop and implement structured training programmes to improve students' employability.
* Identify skill gaps and design appropriate training interventions.
* Organise training sessions on communication skills, aptitude, logical reasoning, interview techniques, group discussions, resume writing, and personality development.
* Coordinate technical and domain-specific training programmes in collaboration with faculty and industry experts.
* Monitor student participation, performance, and training effectiveness.
* Conduct mock interviews, aptitude assessments, and employability evaluations.

**B. Placement & Corporate Relations**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with corporate companies, recruiters, HR professionals, and industry partners.
* Identify and generate placement opportunities through continuous corporate engagement.
* Plan and coordinate campus recruitment drives, job fairs, internship programmes, and recruitment events.
* Invite companies for campus placements and facilitate the recruitment process.
* Negotiate recruitment partnerships and explore long-term industry collaborations.
* Maintain an updated database of companies, recruiters, job openings, and placement opportunities.
* Ensure maximum placement opportunities for eligible students.

**C. Student Career Development**

* Provide career guidance and counselling to students.
* Identify students' career aspirations and guide them towards suitable opportunities.
* Support students in preparing professional resumes and LinkedIn profiles.
* Guide students on interview preparation, workplace etiquette, and professional conduct.
* Facilitate internship opportunities, live projects, apprenticeships, and industry exposure.

**D. Industry & Institutional Engagement**

* Establish partnerships with industries for internships, projects, industrial visits, and placements.
* Organise industry interaction sessions, guest lectures, seminars, and career awareness programmes.
* Coordinate with academic departments to align training initiatives with industry requirements.
* Build a strong industry-institute interaction ecosystem.

**E. MIS, Reporting & Administration**

* Maintain student placement records, company databases, and training attendance.
* Prepare periodic training and placement reports for management.
* Track placement statistics, salary packages, internships, and employer feedback.
* Develop and monitor placement-related KPIs.
* Ensure timely communication with students, faculty, management, and recruiters.
* Maintain accurate records of placed, unplaced, and higher-education-bound students.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Overall student placement percentage.
* Number of companies participating in campus recruitment.
* Number of new corporate partnerships established.
* Number of students trained and certified.
* Improvement in students' employability and interview performance.
* Number of internship opportunities generated.
* Average and highest salary packages offered.
* Student and employer satisfaction levels.
* Timely completion of placement activities and reporting.
* Achievement of annual placement targets.

4. Educational Qualifications

* MBA in HR, Marketing, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in Management, Education, or related fields will be preferred.
* Additional certifications in HR, Training & Development, Career Counselling, or Corporate Relations will be an advantage.

5. Experience Requirements

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in training, placements, corporate relations, HR, or employability development.
* Experience in managing campus placement activities and corporate recruitment relationships.
* Prior experience in educational institutions, universities, professional colleges, or skill development organisations is preferred.
* Proven track record of achieving placement targets.

6. Required Skills & Competencies

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong corporate networking and relationship management abilities.
* Good presentation, negotiation, and coordination skills.
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Knowledge of recruitment processes and industry hiring trends.
* Ability to conduct training sessions and career development programmes.
* Strong planning, execution, and problem-solving abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, PowerPoint, and placement management systems.
* Target-oriented approach with a strong focus on results.

7. Key Deliverables

* Preparation and execution of the annual training and placement calendar.
* Achievement of institutional placement targets.
* Development of a strong corporate recruiter network.
* Improved student employability and career readiness.
* Increased internship and placement opportunities.
* Regular reporting of training and placement performance to management.

8. Personal Attributes

* Proactive, self-motivated, and result-oriented.
* Professional approach towards students, parents, recruiters, and management.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Passion for student development and career progression.

**Overall Objective:** To establish a robust Training & Placement ecosystem that bridges the gap between academic learning and industry expectations, ensuring improved student employability, strong corporate relationships, and sustainable placement outcomes.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
JD: HR Executive, AJEMS

AJEMS is hiring an HR Executive to run hiring, onboarding and day-to-day people operations as the team grows.

• Location: Pune, work from office

• Type: Full time

• Experience: 1 to 3 years in HR

About AJEMS

AJEMS is a no-code enterprise platform system that brings a company's CRM, ERP and HRMS into one workspace. AJEN, its built-in AI, answers questions about the business's own data. The team is growing ahead of the platform's full launch.

The role

You own the full employee journey, from the first job post to the exit interview. You will run hiring for a fast-growing product team and help shape how HR works as the company scales.

Key responsibilities

• Run end-to-end hiring for tech and non-tech roles: job posts, sourcing on job portals and LinkedIn, screening, interview scheduling and offer closure

• Onboard new joiners: documentation, offer and appointment letters, induction and first-week setup

• Maintain attendance, leave and employee records

• Prepare monthly payroll inputs and coordinate with accounts

• Handle statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, professional tax) with the compliance consultant

• Draft and update HR policies, the employee handbook and HR letters

• Plan engagement activities and hold regular check-ins with employees

• Manage exits: resignations, full and final settlement, exit interviews

• Report hiring and HR metrics to management every month

What we're looking for

• 1 to 3 years of experience as an HR Executive or HR Generalist

• Hands-on recruitment experience, ideally including tech roles

• Working knowledge of labour laws, PF, ESIC and payroll processes

• Clear written and spoken English

• Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets and HR software

• Organised, discreet with confidential information, and able to handle several open roles at once

• Graduate in any stream; MBA or PGDM in HR preferred

Good to have

• Experience at a startup or software company

• Familiarity with HRMS tools

• Comfort using AI tools to speed up screening, drafting and reporting

• Experience setting up HR processes from scratch

How to apply

Send your resume to admin@ajems.com

title: Delivery Rider Sourcing and Onboarding Executive - Pune
description:
**Delivery Rider Sourcing and Onboarding Executive - Pune**

**Location:**
Pune

**Department:**
Fleet Ops. - Supply

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Delivery Rider Sourcing and Onboarding Executive to drive the acquisition, onboarding, activation and ongoing management of delivery partners across assigned locations. The role will focus on building a strong and reliable delivery partner fleet by identifying area-wise supply requirements, sourcing new partners, managing the onboarding funnel, improving activation and retaining existing partners. The executive will work closely with field recruiters and internal teams to ensure a consistent pipeline of delivery partners and healthy fleet availability across key areas.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, target-oriented and comfortable managing field teams and engaging with delivery partners in a fast-paced environment.

**1. Fleet Acquisition & Sourcing**

* Drive delivery partner acquisition to meet location-wise and area-wise fleet requirements.
* Identify high-potential sourcing locations, rider catchment areas and relevant acquisition channels.
* Build and maintain a consistent pipeline of prospective delivery partners through field sourcing, referrals, local networks and other channels.
* Plan and execute on-ground acquisition activities to generate qualified partner leads.
* Set daily and weekly acquisition targets and ensure consistent progress against them.
* Track lead generation, follow-ups, conversion and joining performance to improve acquisition efficiency.

**2. Onboarding & Activation**

* Own the delivery partner onboarding journey from initial enquiry through registration, verification and activation.
* Coordinate with onboarding and verification teams to ensure timely completion of partner documentation and formalities.
* Drive newly onboarded partners to complete their first order and become active on the platform.
* Monitor the onboarding funnel and identify reasons for partner drop-offs at each stage.
* Follow up with pending and partially onboarded partners to improve conversion and activation rates.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, onboarding status, activation and first-order completion.

**3. Existing Fleet Management, Engagement & Retention**

* Manage and build relationships with the existing delivery partner fleet across assigned areas.
* Track partner activity levels and identify inactive, low-activity and at-risk partners.
* Drive partner reactivation initiatives to bring inactive partners back onto the platform.
* Conduct regular partner interactions and field visits to understand concerns, expectations and reasons for inactivity.
* Communicate partner earning opportunities, incentive programmes, referral schemes and relevant policy updates.
* Develop engagement initiatives that improve partner participation, satisfaction and long-term retention.
* Identify recurring reasons for partner churn and recommend initiatives to improve fleet stability.

**4. Field Team & Recruitment Management**

* Coordinate and manage field recruiters or acquisition executives to achieve assigned fleet acquisition targets.
* Allocate sourcing areas and daily activity plans to the field acquisition team.
* Monitor individual team performance across lead generation, partner onboarding and activation.
* Conduct regular reviews, provide guidance and support the team in improving conversion and productivity.
* Ensure field team members maintain accurate lead and partner acquisition trackers.
* Identify hiring or sourcing capacity gaps and escalate requirements to the relevant team.

**5. Area-wise Fleet Planning & Supply Growth**

* Understand area-wise fleet requirements and identify locations where additional delivery partners need to be acquired.
* Maintain visibility of active, inactive and newly onboarded partners across assigned areas.
* Prioritise acquisition efforts based on identified supply gaps, partner availability and business growth requirements.
* Recommend local sourcing strategies to strengthen fleet coverage in priority areas.
* Work with internal stakeholders to align acquisition plans with changing supply requirements.

**6. Reporting & Performance Tracking**

* Maintain daily and weekly trackers covering leads generated, partners onboarded, activated and retained.
* Prepare regular updates on acquisition pipeline, conversion rates, activation performance and field team
* productivity.
* Track key performance indicators and take corrective action where targets are not being achieved.
* Highlight sourcing challenges, onboarding bottlenecks and partner churn trends with supporting data.
* Share progress against assigned acquisition and fleet growth targets with the reporting manager.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong communication, interpersonal and relationship-management skills.
* Ability to acquire, onboard and engage delivery partners at scale.
* Experience in field recruitment, lead generation and target-driven sourcing.
* Strong team coordination and the ability to manage field acquisition teams.
* Good understanding of delivery partner behavior, fleet supply and last-mile delivery ecosystems.
* Strong follow-up, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
* Working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and basic performance trackers.
* Self-driven, organized and comfortable working towards daily and monthly targets.
* Willingness to travel locally for field visits and partner acquisition activities.

**Preferred Experience**

* 1–3 years of experience in fleet acquisition, delivery partner onboarding, field recruitment, logistics, e-commerce, food delivery, quick commerce or similar sectors.
* Experience working with delivery partners, riders, drivers, field recruiters or on-ground acquisition teams.
* Prior experience in managing sourcing targets, onboarding funnels or partner engagement initiatives will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and an aptitude for field acquisition may also be considered.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* New delivery partner leads generated against assigned targets.
* New delivery partner acquisition and joining rate.
* Onboarding completion and verification rate.
* New partner activation and first-order completion rate.
* Onboarding funnel conversion and drop-off rate.
* Active fleet growth across assigned areas.
* Existing partner retention and reactivation rate.
* Reduction in partner inactivity and churn.
* Field recruiter productivity and target achievement.
* Area-wise fleet supply gap closure.

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
**Join Voy to build India's leading Healthtech company**

Voy is one of the fastest growing global health-tech startups - serving over 25 Lakh customers and redesigning healthcare from the ground up. We operate in a broad range of healthcare categories - including weight loss, hair loss, dermatology, men's & women's health, and preventative health. We're present in the UK, Germany, & Brazil, and have recently expanded to India.

**About the space**

GLP-1s represent a quantum leap in healthcare (think penicillin!) and possibly the biggest healthcare opportunity of our lifetimes. The GLP market went from 0 to $60B in just 8 years and estimated to grow to $200B in the next 10. Several multi-billion dollar companies like Voy, Found, Ro and Hims and Hers have ridden this wave that’s only just arrived in India with the 2025 launch of Mounjaro and Ozempic. We’re 8 years behind the US and Europe (which is super frustrating but also…) means there is a unique opportunity to category-create in a white space (think Paytm for mobile wallets) and in the process, give 10+ years of healthy life to each patient we onboard. Sure, we have some catching up to do but the Indian GLP space has something the West doesn’t - Generics. The patent for semaglutide (Ozempic) in India expired in March 2026 bringing monthly medication prices from Rs 20k a month to Rs 3k a month. With 250 million obese Indians who can now suddenly afford life-changing medical help that’s never existed in the country before, you do the math.

**Why Intern with Us?**

**Career Growth:**
70% of our Jan 2026 interns converted to full-time roles. This is a real opportunity to build a long-term career with us

**Competitive Stipend:**
Earn a competitive monthly stipend

**Hands-on Learning:**
Gain practical experience in a fast-growing healthtech business

**Global Exposure:**
Work with a global company with teams across the UK, Germany and Brazil

**Ownership & Impact:**
Take real ownership of projects and responsibilities from week one

**Who Can Apply?**

Undergraduate students currently in their final or pre-final semester

**Full-Time Conversion**

Intern-to-full-time conversion will be based on individual performance and will be considered after submission of a provisional certificate or equivalent proof of graduation

**Work Location & Schedule**

**Location:**
Voy India, DLF Tower A, Jasola, New Delhi – 110025

**Work Mode:**
Work from office

**Working Days:**
6 days a week

**Role Overview**

The Talent Acquisition Intern role offers an opportunity to help build the team behind Voy India (formerly EarlyFit), as we scale aggressively across business, tech, clinical, and operations. This role needs a high-ownership executor with a people-first mind and a builder mindset. You will be thrown at many hiring problems over your time here, some that need a quick sourcing push and some that take weeks of focused work to find the right people for a hard-to-fill role. You take the role head on: understand what great looks like, find and reach out to candidates, run quick experiments on sourcing channels, tell us what is working, and then help close great hires.

For example, if a hiring sprint for a new team is where you land, you would work across

Talent Acquisition, hiring managers, and leadership to plan the pipeline, source and screen

candidates, and own the candidate experience from first message to offer.

● Track the hiring pipeline and maintain candidate data in our ATS and trackers

**What we are looking for?**
